eng_odengeiger_callout_004: Business must be good for you to grace my office once more.
eng_odengeiger_callout_005: Welcome back. My skills are at your disposal, as always.
eng_odengeiger_callout_firstaccess: Welcome, friend. It is always an honour to have a Commander visit my home.
eng_odengeiger_choose_equipment_001: Which canvas will host my art?
eng_odengeiger_choose_equipment_002: I presume you have an item in mind?
eng_odengeiger_choose_slot: Which slot would you like to modify?
eng_odengeiger_option_suit_increasedbatt: Some additional time to act, perhaps?
eng_odengeiger_option_suit_nightvision: A unique blueprint to let you see what others can't.
eng_odengeiger_option_weapon_scope: Knowing your enemy is half the battle.
eng_odengeiger_option_weapon_stability: Reliably hitting your target is often decisive.
eng_odengeiger_purchase_suit_nightvision: Of course. Make the night your ally.
eng_odengeiger_signoff_004: Goodbye. I shall likely be seeing you again.
eng_odengeiger_signoff_005: Enjoy all the galaxy has to offer.
eng_petraolmanova_annotation_001: So you know, I scanned your ship for hidden explosives just after you landed. Call it an old habit. What do you need?
eng_petraolmanova_annotation_002: I'll apply any design you have the materials for. It's about as fair a deal as you're going to find, so don't complicate things with 'suggestions'.
eng_petraolmanova_annotation_003: I'm glad you're doing okay. What, you thought because I avoid small talk that I don't care about my clients? I'm not a total asshole. Let's work.
eng_petraolmanova_annotation_004: Some clients tell me I'm a heat sink launcher expert. It wasn't a career goal or anything.  I doubt there's a heat sink award waiting for me. It just happened. Anyway, let's go.
eng_petraolmanova_annotation_005: Before you say anything, I've hardly got a spare hour in my schedule this week. Just tell me what you want and we'll get it fitted. Okay?
eng_petraolmanova_annotation_firstaccess: Call me Petra. Don't bother with the surname because you won't say it right. Pleasantries don't interest me, but your ship might. I'm handy with most launchers and can improve your defensive options. Wanna check out my blueprints?
eng_petraolmanova_callout_001: I'm certain we can improve that vessel of yours.
eng_petraolmanova_callout_002: Interesting. Didn't think you'd become a regular.
eng_petraolmanova_callout_003: Do you have work for me, or are you here for the ambience?
eng_petraolmanova_callout_004: My usual designs are ready, as always.
eng_petraolmanova_callout_firstaccess: Thanks for the cells. I guess we should talk.
eng_professorpalin_annotation_001: My study of Thargoid technology has got me into trouble more than once. A Thargoid craft hovering outside the bedroom viewport is particularly effective at curing one's tiredness.
eng_professorpalin_annotation_002: A few years ago, Federal ships blockaded my old research centre during the fuss over meta-alloys. While I disagreed with that action, I understood the logic. Sometimes a prize is worth the strife it may cause.
eng_professorpalin_annotation_003: I was hoping for a distraction shortly before you arrived. Perhaps fate heard my call. Though, it's probably just coincidence.
eng_professorpalin_annotation_004: Our knowledge of Thargoid culture is a mixture of theories, estimates and the occasional scrap of data. What I wouldn't give to view one of their homeworlds in person...That is if they even still inhabit worlds outside of their ships.
eng_professorpalin_annotation_005: I'm very pleased with my lab here in Arque. The equipment is perfect for my research, and can easily accommodate ships like yours. Let's get started.
eng_professorpalin_annotation_firstacces: My name is Ishmael Palin, and I am considered to be one of the leading figures in Thargoid research. However, I enjoy the occasional, more finite project as a change of pace. Your ship will do nicely. I can modify the frame shift drive and thrusters, if you wish.
eng_professorpalin_callout_001: Well then. Let's get started, shall we?
eng_professorpalin_callout_002: Welcome, Commander. Good to have you back at the lab.
eng_professorpalin_callout_003: Good to see you again, Commander.
eng_professorpalin_callout_004: I have many clients, but members of the Pilots' Federation certainly stand out.
eng_professorpalin_callout_005: Well isn't this a sight for tired eyes?
eng_professorpalin_callout_firstaccess: A Commander that contributes to the study of Thargoid technology. Quite commendable!
eng_ramtah_annotation_001: My research of the ancient Guardian civilisation has led to many technological breakthroughs, some of which have bolstered our defence against the Thargoids. I'm delighted that a genuine passion of mine has proven so helpful to others.
eng_ramtah_annotation_002: Human-Guardian hybrid technology is a source of incredible potential in our continued progress. The weaponry and modules offered by technology brokers are just the beginning. Given time, we may find ourselves at the dawn of a new technological era.
eng_ramtah_annotation_003: One can never have enough relics. Some have accused me of stockpiling them, but I assure you that each one is vital to my research. Most people wouldn't know what to do with them, anyway. Let's get on with your work.
eng_ramtah_annotation_004: I consider myself a humanitarian. My research and business relationships; the distrubution of my many discoveries. All done with the best of intentions for humanity. Having ideals is motivating, I assure you.
eng_ramtah_annotation_005: Work is a constant in my life, and I wouldn't have it any other way. It does make me a rather poor choice for social events, but it is what it is. Now, about your ship...
eng_ramtah_annotation_firstaccess: A formal introduction is in order. My name is Ram Tah, and I've been known to adjust a defensive module here, or limpet controller there. Some would say that a handful of my designs are among the best available to pilots such as yourself. Providing you have materials to invest, I'd be willing to share them with you in time.
eng_ramtah_callout_001: Yes, yes. You're back - and I'm busy. Let's not tarry, Commander!
eng_ramtah_callout_002: You're back? Then I'm eager to know what you require this time.
eng_ramtah_callout_003: Short-tempered? Me? Who said that? Now hurry up!
eng_ramtah_callout_004: Data on everything and anything? One can never have enough information, Commander!
eng_ramtah_callout_005: Back for more, Commander? How may I assist you?
eng_ramtah_callout_firstaccess: Ah, you got the databanks. That's exactly what I needed. Let's get straight to it, Commander!
eng_rosadayette_annotation_001: Back home I had people stop by morning, noon and night with things to fix. I'm busy enough here, no doubt. But I do miss the hustle of my younger days.
eng_rosadayette_annotation_002: Best advice I ever got was to always trade skills. I've fixed up things for musicians, cooks, pilots...isn't all about credits, I promise you.
eng_rosadayette_annotation_003: I can fix up anything you've got to make it just that little bit better than most other gear. If you've got the materials for the job, that is.
eng_rosadayette_annotation_004: You don't seem the type to need your vidscreen or your shower repaired. Luckily for you, I'm just as handy with combat equipment.
eng_rosadayette_annotation_005: Some friends of mine bought me this workshop. Hum, well, a whole lot of friends! I smile every time I think of the dumb look I must have had when they surprised me. Anyway, what can I help you with?
eng_rosadayette_annotation_firstaccess: Nothing brightens my day like a new face walking through that door. And a member of the Pilots' Federation, too! My name is Rosa, and I can work wonders with most gadgets and gizmos. If you want some modification for that gear of yours, I'll be able to help
eng_rosadayette_back_003: Happy to wait until you're ready.
eng_rosadayette_back_005: You take all the time you need.
eng_rosadayette_callout_001: There's no better compliment than repeat business.
eng_rosadayette_callout_002: Look who it is. Nice of you to drop by.
eng_rosadayette_callout_003: Keen for more of my work? I'm flattered.
eng_rosadayette_callout_004: Just pop it on the desk-- Oh, my bad! I thought you were the food guy.
eng_rosadayette_callout_005: Happy to see you back here, Commander.
eng_rosadayette_callout_firstaccess: I'm so pleased to see you, Commander. Welcome to my home.
eng_rosadayette_choose_equipment_001: What do you want me to look at?
eng_rosadayette_choose_equipment_002: So what have you brought me?
eng_rosadayette_choose_slot: Just pick a slot before we start.
eng_rosadayette_nextengineer: Well, aren't you a star? I'll hold up my side and send a nice word over to Yi Shen. He can do some amazing things with your equipment but he's a little picky about his customers. Good luck making the list.
eng_rosadayette_option_suit_backpackcapa: Can always use some extra room in there.
eng_rosadayette_option_suit_improvedrada: Better to know what's coming before it arrives.
eng_rosadayette_option_suit_increasedbat: Those suits need a lot of juice. This'll help.
eng_rosadayette_option_suit_reducedtoolb: My specialty keeps your tools running longer.
eng_rosadayette_option_weapon_range: A little extra distance can make all the difference.
eng_rosadayette_option_weapon_scope: Good for watching what's going on.
eng_rosadayette_option_weapon_stability: Steady as you'll get with this.
eng_rosadayette_purchase_suit_backpackca: Put this to good use, won't you.
eng_rosadayette_purchase_suit_increasedb: I'll just get that fixed up.
eng_rosadayette_referraltask: I find the inner workings of everyday equipment fascinating. It's so fun learning how a piece of tech is put together! Bring me some reading material and I'll refer you to a quality engineer.
eng_rosadayette_resourcedonate: That's exactly what I was after. Thanks!
eng_rosadayette_signoff_002: Well, better get on with my backlog.
eng_rosadayette_signoff_004: Hopefully I'll be seeing you, Commander.
eng_rosadayette_signoff_005: Take care of yourself on your travels, okay?
eng_selenejean_annotation_001: I've spent a lot of time mining planetary rings. They are the perfect place for self-reflection. Tranquil, silent... Assuming there isn't a pirate on your tail, of course.
eng_selenejean_annotation_002: Shields are all well and good, but finite. Dependent on power. Now, a reinforced hull? You've got to admit, armour plating and alloy compounds are nothing if not consistent.
eng_selenejean_annotation_003: I had a wonderful dream last night. They come quite often these days, but this one was particularly delightful. Still, you didn't come here to be bored with the details of my subconscious. Let's begin.
eng_selenejean_annotation_004: Prospector's Rest is located in an ideal location. Plenty of work for pilots in the system, you see. And I advise all my clients that a strong hull will keep them safe!
eng_selenejean_annotation_005: Do keep in mind that you can trade goods at this base as well. Regular imports may convince me to offer my premium blueprints. My clients typically want those.
eng_selenejean_annotation_firstaccess: Thanks for the minerals, Commander. My name is Selene Jean. I specialise in designs that dramatically enhance a hull's integrity. Or, put more simply, I'll turn that ship of yours into a mobile fortress.
eng_selenejean_callout_001: I'm always glad to see a client return.
eng_selenejean_callout_003: I'm happy to see you once more, Commander.
eng_selenejean_callout_004: Aren't you a ray of sunshine on an otherwise dreary day?
eng_selenejean_callout_005: Always a joy to see you around these parts.
eng_selenejean_callout_firstaccess: You know your way around an asteroid. Welcome to my operation.
eng_selenejean_signoff_001: May the galaxy bless you, Commander.
eng_selenejean_signoff_002: I see profit in your future. Go get it.
eng_terravelasquez_annotation_001: Providing you've brought the resources I can offer you plenty of options while on assignment.
eng_terravelasquez_annotation_002: Feel free to browse through my blueprints and pick a mod that tickles your tail in just the right kinda way.
eng_terravelasquez_annotation_003: Let's not waste time with banal chatter about the latest galactic drama. My workshop is ready to go.
eng_terravelasquez_annotation_004: Trust me: You have to think big if you're going to think at all. My mods are just the thing for an ambitious mind.
eng_terravelasquez_annotation_005: My modifications will help your plans go off without a hitch. Providing your plans involve shooting stuff, anyway. Shall we?
eng_terravelasquez_annotation_firstacces: Jude sent you, right? He's a sweetheart. My name's Terra, and I'll be your engineer today. Most of my clients know their way around a gun, and I improve their chances of walking away after the shooting starts.
eng_terravelasquez_callout_001: Hi again, Commander. Have you brought me some new gear to play with?
eng_terravelasquez_callout_002: I'd ask what you've been up to since your last visit, but the less I know the better. Right?
eng_terravelasquez_callout_003: If you've come all this way you must want some work done. Good, because I am bored out of my mind!
eng_terravelasquez_callout_004: How are you today, Commander? Got something for me?
eng_terravelasquez_callout_005: Over here, Commander. Staying out of trouble, still? God, I hope not.
eng_terravelasquez_choose_slot: Choose a slot and we can.
eng_terravelasquez_nextengineer: I'll put this data to real good use. Now, listen up: There's an engineer named Oden Geiger that you'll want to meet for some high quality work. The guy's older than the universe but he's a straight-up badass, trust me. I'll send you his info.
eng_terravelasquez_option_suit_adsmoveme: The odds of winning a gunfight go way up if you're the first to draw.
eng_terravelasquez_option_suit_increased: Extra reserves can make all the difference.
We've all gotta run some time. This will help.
eng_terravelasquez_option_weapon_accurac: Point, aim, shoot. With this? Aim better.
eng_terravelasquez_purchase_suit_adsmove: I've fit your choice as requested.
eng_terravelasquez_purchase_suit_increas: And we are good to go.
eng_terravelasquez_purchase_weapon_accur: You'll be knocking the pimples off their noses now.
eng_terravelasquez_purchase_weapon_suppr: Bang bang. You're good to go.
eng_terravelasquez_referraltask: The Commanders I've met so far have worked for a few major corps in their time. Y'know what I like the most about interstellar factions? Their numbers. Bring me some financial data to read, and I'll give you the location of a real tech-wizard in return.
eng_terravelasquez_resourcedonate: You actually found some! Nice one.
eng_terravelasquez_signoff_001: Go high or go home, Commander!
eng_terravelasquez_signoff_002: Make sure they all know your name!
eng_terravelasquez_signoff_004: You'll be back. They all come back.
eng_thedweller_annotation_001: If it seems too good to be true, it probably is. If it seems too bad to be true, that's likely a fact. Let's work.
eng_thedweller_annotation_002: I need more like you around, Commander. Pilots willing to take the occasional risk. Shall we get your ship ready for a few?
eng_thedweller_annotation_003: S'funny that a Commander's here for my work. A couple of hours ago I had a wanted criminal asking about my blueprints, too. It's nice to have options.
eng_thedweller_annotation_004: A good laser will get you through shields quickly enough. And through locks, crates, panels; All depends on the size of the laser, really.
eng_thedweller_annotation_005: How can I help you today, then? Not that I'm rushing you, but it's usually better if folks don't hang around here too long. People might take notice.
eng_thedweller_annotation_firstaccess: At some point in my career, other people started calling me the Dweller. It's not a nickname I'd have picked, but it has an ugly charm. Means I don't have to share any extra details, either. I can fix up your energy weapons or distributor if you've got the stuff. So, what'll it be?
eng_thedweller_callout_001: This is a secure facility. No telling who's snooping around.
eng_thedweller_callout_002: The Feds have been sniffing around, so you might want to watch your back.
eng_thedweller_callout_003: Great to have you back. You've been behaving yourself, I hope?
eng_thedweller_callout_004: I thought you'd be back. Any big scores?
eng_thedweller_callout_005: The Black Hide is always open to trade.
eng_thedweller_callout_firstaccess: I think you might be handy to have around, Commander. Thanks for the donation.
eng_thedweller_signoff_001: Make sure you're not scanned after leaving the base, yeah?
eng_thedweller_signoff_003: Don't let the bastards find ya.
eng_thesarge_annotation_001: Prefer repeat clients. Easier to deal with. Let's check your ship out.
eng_thesarge_annotation_002: Better get to work. Ain't paid hourly.
eng_thesarge_annotation_003: You got materials? Hope so. Waste of time otherwise.
eng_thesarge_annotation_004: Good limpet will get you far. Makes things nice and quick.
eng_thesarge_annotation_005: Got cannon designs. Lots of 'em. Take a look.
eng_thesarge_annotation_firstaccess: People call me Sarge. Don't care what you call me. I modify limpet controllers, a few weapons. I'll take bounties or survey data, too. We should start.
eng_thesarge_callout_002: Face looks familiar. We've spoken before.
eng_thesarge_callout_firstaccess: Got the data. Let's talk mods, okay?
eng_tianafortune_annotation_001: Modern limpets are remarkably adaptable. I can only imagine what the next generation of limpets will be capable of.
eng_tianafortune_annotation_002: I've been keeping an eye on the Pilots' Federation District. Quite a unique venture, that one.
eng_tianafortune_annotation_003: Let me offer some advice: never give in to anybody who seeks to push you down. I expect a pilot such as yourself already knows that, though.
eng_tianafortune_annotation_004: Those permitted to do business within Achenar often stop by here for work. Repeat business goes a long way.
eng_tianafortune_annotation_005: Which modules are we working on today?
eng_tianafortune_annotation_firstaccess: I'm Tiana Fortune. Welcome to my workshop. Here you can access mods that improve ship scanners, sensors and limpet controllers. Cargo may be traded in the hangar bay, also. These two avenues offer a healthy foundation on which to build a strong working relationship.
eng_tianafortune_callout_001: I presume you require further engineering work?
eng_tianafortune_callout_002: Hello again. Shall we get started?
eng_tianafortune_callout_003: A familiar face. Loyalty is something I respect.
eng_tianafortune_callout_004: Information, Commander. The primary tool of the victorious.
eng_tianafortune_callout_005: Consider this facility at your disposal, Commander.
eng_tianafortune_callout_firstaccess: The data you provided is quite interesting, thank you. Of course I'll share my talents to a true friend of the Empire.
eng_todtheblastermcquinn_annotation_001: Most pilots get nervous when their shields drop, but they panic when you start hammering their hull. Let's get your weapons ready to do that.
eng_todtheblastermcquinn_annotation_002: I'll take Allied bounty vouchers if you have them. Pilots who take out nearby scumbags are worth sharing my high-grade designs with.
eng_todtheblastermcquinn_annotation_003: So many modules these days are incredible feats of engineering. But when some bastard thinks they can put you down, it's the power of your guns that will keep you alive.
eng_todtheblastermcquinn_annotation_004: I don't regret committing to my engineer work, but I'd be lying if I said I didn't miss the hunt. Maybe one day I'll get back in the game. So what's the plan?
eng_todtheblastermcquinn_annotation_005: I always did like a good multi-cannon. You line that sucker up, get spinning and bam! It's a thing of beauty. Let's check out what your loadout's like.
eng_todtheblastermcquinn_annotation_firs: I'm Tod McQuinn. People call me 'The Blaster' because I've always believed attack is the best defence. Shows in my ship loadout, too. In all my years as a bounty hunter, strong cannons never let me down. I try and prove that theory with my engineering work, too. If you prefer kinetic weapons, my designs should be just what you need.
eng_todtheblastermcquinn_callout_001: Hi, Commander. What do you need?
eng_todtheblastermcquinn_callout_002: Seems I'm getting more and more customers these days.
eng_todtheblastermcquinn_callout_003: How's the hunt treating you? Well, I hope.
eng_todtheblastermcquinn_callout_005: A pilot of your calibre is always welcome.
eng_todtheblastermcquinn_callout_firstac: Skilled bounty hunters can always take a breather at this base, Commander.
eng_todtheblastermcquinn_signoff_005: Stop by next time you pass through the system.
eng_umalaszlo_annotation_001: So what have you brought for me this time?
eng_umalaszlo_annotation_002: A tinker's work is never done. What do you need?
eng_umalaszlo_annotation_003: Are you interested in suit or weapon upgrades? I offer both, of course. One should always seek to have an expansive repertoire.
eng_umalaszlo_annotation_004: I hope you've brought me plenty of work. These old hands of mine get restless without a project.
eng_umalaszlo_annotation_005: So many clients have been coming here recently. I'm glad. In my advanced years it's satisfying to feel wanted.
eng_umalaszlo_annotation_firstaccess: So Beck has sent another Pilots' Federation go-getter my way, hm? I'm starting to think he appreciates our long-distance friendship. Very well: My name is Uma Laszlo. Welcome to my home.
eng_umalaszlo_callout_001: Welcome back to my facility, Commander.
eng_umalaszlo_callout_002: Welcome. Still making your mark, I hope.
eng_umalaszlo_callout_003: Hello, Commander. I trust your journey was pleasant.
eng_umalaszlo_callout_004: Oh, it's you... Sorry, I've been a little distracted.
eng_umalaszlo_callout_005: Well, well. It's good to see you again, Commander.
eng_umalaszlo_callout_firstaccess: I received word of your pending arrival, Commander. We have a mutual contact.
eng_umalaszlo_choose_slot: Tell me which slot you want fixed.
eng_umalaszlo_option_suit_improvedarmour: This special design should keep that  pretty head of yours intact.
eng_umalaszlo_option_suit_increasedshiel: If shields are your preference, this will help.
eng_umalaszlo_option_weapon_backpackrelo: The enemy will find it harder to hurt you with this.
eng_umalaszlo_option_weapon_headshotdama: If you have a steady aim, you'll want this fitted.
eng_umalaszlo_option_weapon_reloadspeed: You'll reduce the time between volleys with this.
eng_umalaszlo_purchase_suit_improvedarmo: You're a tough nut to crack now, Commander.
eng_umalaszlo_purchase_suit_increasedshi: Done. You'll be protected for longer.
eng_umalaszlo_purchase_weapon_backpackre: Finished. Providing you don't try catching a grenade between your teeth, you'll do well.
eng_umalaszlo_purchase_weapon_reloadspee: All done. You'll be smooth as whisky now.
eng_wellingtonbeck_annotation_001: I can provide modifications to your suit and your weapons.
eng_wellingtonbeck_annotation_002: Each of my flawless designs is available for selection providing you have the necessary resources.
eng_wellingtonbeck_annotation_003: We should not delay. I am sure you have other places to be.
eng_wellingtonbeck_annotation_004: I do not wish to distract you from your other tasks, so we should continue at once.
eng_wellingtonbeck_annotation_005: You remind me of a character introduced in a recent instalment of The Eversphere Sequence, which is my favourite fictional series of all time. The similarities in your demeanour are uncanny.
eng_wellingtonbeck_annotation_firstacces: My name is Wellington Beck. You have come here to exchange microresources for access to my considerable engineering skills. I am ready to proceed with this arrangement.
eng_wellingtonbeck_callout_001: I have seen you before, Commander. Let us repeat our prior trade of items for talent.
eng_wellingtonbeck_callout_002: A repeat journey to my workshop implies a satisfaction with my designs.
eng_wellingtonbeck_callout_003: Hello again. I am ready to proceed with our established professional relationship.
eng_wellingtonbeck_callout_005: Commander. We should continue in the same manner as your prior visit.
eng_wellingtonbeck_callout_firstaccess: This office is open for business, Commander.
eng_wellingtonbeck_choose_equipment_001: Which apparatus do you wish to improve?
eng_wellingtonbeck_choose_equipment_002: Please confirm which hardware I must enhance.
eng_wellingtonbeck_nextengineer: Thank you for bringing me the items I requested. As agreed, I will send you the information to locate Uma Laszlo. She is an experienced engineer whose designs may complement my own.
eng_wellingtonbeck_option_suit_backpackc: This design increases your suit's capacity for holding items.
eng_wellingtonbeck_option_suit_increased: This design increases your suit's battery capacity.
eng_wellingtonbeck_option_suit_reducedto: This design reduces the power draw of your suit's tools.
eng_wellingtonbeck_option_weapon_range: This design increases the effective range of your weapon.
eng_wellingtonbeck_option_weapon_scope: This design increases the magnification of your weapon scope.
eng_wellingtonbeck_referraltask: In addition, I have a very keen interest in visual entertainment and related media. Please bring me Insight Entertainment Suites. I have the details of another engineer to share if you do.
eng_wellingtonbeck_resourcedonate: This is a fine addition to my library.
eng_yardenbond_annotation_001: If you ever get the chance to visit Utopia, take my advice: don't. Let's get to work.
eng_yardenbond_annotation_002: When the hangar's scan flagged your details I guessed we'd be preparing mods. Unless you're here for the ambiance, in which case you go sit outside.
eng_yardenbond_annotation_003: A soldier of fortune should act with principle. Most corporations would happily take advantage of those who simply chase credits.
eng_yardenbond_annotation_004: Shall we get started? I'm keen to keep my fingers practised. Wouldn't want to lose my edge at this stage.
eng_yardenbond_annotation_005: I presume you are here though choice. I would hate to think you were spending your resources at someone else's request.
eng_yardenbond_annotation_firstaccess: You must have had quite the journey to reach my base. I hope that my work proves worthwhile. Though, I do take pride in having had very few complaints so far.
eng_yardenbond_callout_access_level1: Welcome back. My workshop is ready to prepare any mods you need.
eng_yardenbond_callout_access_level2: Hello, Commander. What would you like me to work on today?
eng_yardenbond_callout_access_level3: Hello again. I hope life is treating you well.
eng_yardenbond_callout_access_level5: Repeat business is always welcome. As are you, of course.
eng_yardenbond_callout_firstaccess: Welcome. I'm Yarden. And you're new here?
eng_yardenbond_choose_equipment_001: Would you like me to examine your weapon or your suit?
eng_yardenbond_choose_slot: Please choose the slot in question.
eng_yardenbond_option_suit_adsmovementsp: Suitable for those with swift reactions.
eng_yardenbond_option_suit_improvedjumpa: If you prefer the high ground, try this.
eng_yardenbond_option_suit_quieterfootst: This is a special design I've created for the light of foot.
eng_yardenbond_option_weapon_accuracy: A modification for the assertive fighter.
eng_yardenbond_option_weapon_handling: A few tweaks here and there will make your weapon a joy to use.
eng_yardenbond_option_weapon_suppression: This is a special design I've created for the light of foot.
eng_yardenbond_purchase_suit_quieterfoot: Finished. A subtle upgrade, but very useful.
eng_yardenbond_signoff_003: I'll be here if you need upgrades in the future.
eng_yardenbond_signoff_004: Until next time. Good fortune to you.
eng_yishen_annotation_001: My designs have many applications. Some are peaceful. Some less so. Only you can decide which are suited to your path.
eng_yishen_annotation_002: My designs are not available anywhere else in Colonia. Some unscrupulous mechanics have tried to replicate them, but a Commander deserves authenticity.
eng_yishen_annotation_003: My first company specialised in terraforming. What better way to witness the potential of technology than by using it to modify an entire world?
eng_yishen_annotation_004: The basic joy of engineering is making something greater than its individual parts. Parallels are found in many areas. Cuisine. Music. Family.
eng_yishen_annotation_005: Colonia's population grows day by day. Settlers. Refugees, Workers. Opportunists. Most seek a new life. Some hope to forget an old one.
eng_yishen_annotation_firstaccess: My name is Yi Shen. You have made an impression on my peers, for I have received several messages on your behalf. I am willing to improve your equipment providing you have the materials. Do you wish to browse my designs?
eng_yishen_callout_001: Welcome back to my workshop. Do you have a request?
eng_yishen_callout_002: I can only assume you have further need of my work.
eng_yishen_callout_003: Welcome back. A familiar face is rare these days.
eng_yishen_callout_004: Hello, Commander. I am curious to know what brings you here this time.
eng_yishen_callout_005: Commander, your return to my workshop honours me.
eng_yishen_callout_firstaccess: Your name precedes you, Commander. Welcome.
eng_yishen_choose_equipment_001: Which item would you like to modify?
eng_yishen_choose_equipment_002: What do you intend to enhance?
eng_yishen_nextengineer: The approval of those who vouched for you was well deserved. I shall hold up my side of our agreement. Details of another engineer have been made available to you. A pleasure doing business, Commander.
eng_yishen_option_weapon_headshotdamage: This modification rewards a skilful aim.
eng_yishen_option_weapon_suppression_unp: Few things are as dangerous as silence.
eng_yishen_referraltask: There are many talented engineers in the galaxy. One in particular is worthy of your attention. I will provide you with their location if you bring me what I want.
eng_yishen_signoff_005: You may return whenever you need to.
eng_zacariahnemo_annotation_001: A distinctly average humanoid with hereditary bi-lateral symmetry. Like the vast majority of my clients, I must say. Have you considered alternatives?
eng_zacariahnemo_annotation_002: Your primary method of communication is imprecise and inefficient. Nonetheless, it will have to serve. Please indicate as best you can how I may enhance your vessel.
eng_zacariahnemo_annotation_003: Outsiders consider the inhabitants of my base to be cultish, somehow. I much prefer to think of them as a network of like-minded individuals. Many of them have inspired my work here.
eng_zacariahnemo_annotation_004: Fragment cannons are exceptionally dangerous at close quarters. If you are capable of manoeuvring your vessel close to your target, a burst can finish most confrontations swiftly.
eng_zacariahnemo_annotation_005: I have noted a gradual adjustment to my speech patterns over time. While initially concerning, I have chosen to accept this development as a reasonable exchange for my many neurological advantages.
eng_zacariahnemo_annotation_firstaccess: I am Zacariah Nemo. I have created an assortment of blueprints to raise the effectiveness of several kinetic weapon models. You are very welcome to browse these and select any which appeal to your violent tendencies.
eng_zacariahnemo_callout_002: You have travelled far to access my technological refinement.
eng_zacariahnemo_callout_003: Your presence has become a semi-regular feature of this base, Commander.
eng_zacariahnemo_callout_004: Your visit elicits a certain measure of satisfaction.
eng_zacariahnemo_callout_firstaccess: You have an appreciation of automata, Commander. Consider yourself worthy of whatever acknowledgement you find appropriate.
engineer_adjustspecialtip: You have $#value:number:separated=1; favour(s) available. Choosing one of these options will reduce your rank with this engineer. Deductions occur when you apply the modification.
engineer_blueprint_experimentallocked: Currently applied blueprint prevents application of experimental effects.
engineer_cantconvertdialogue: We need to convert your previously modified module to the new standards. However, I am not yet able to do this for you. Come back once you have crafted a few blueprints.
engineer_cantconvertnorecipesdialogue: Your module has a legacy blueprint equipped to it, it will need to be converted, however I don't have anything I can convert it into, try another engineer.
engineer_convertdialogue: Your previously upgraded module requires conversion to the new standard. To accomplish this, the module will be downgraded by 1 grade. This will temporarily reduce the module's performance, but the enhanced blueprint will ultimately grant a superior performance than the module's current configuration.
engineer_convertwarning: Modifications will be converted to new engineer standards.
engineer_cost_help: Each blueprint requires materials to apply. This is the cost of the modification.
engineer_currentlyapplied: THIS EFFECT IS CURRENTLY APPLIED TO THE MODULE
engineer_excesshullmass: Cannot apply modification: hull mass would exceed shield generator
engineer_excessshipmass: Cannot apply modification: module would exceed maximum mass
engineer_existing_modification_subtext: The previous modification will be removed
engineer_experimentalremote: Experimental effects can only be applied at engineer workshop locations
engineer_generate_help: Every time you click and generate a blueprint, you will gain reputation with the current engineer (unless with a remote engineer).
engineer_insufficientresources_experimen: You have insufficient materials to purchase this effect.
engineer_legacy_mod_too_high: This legacy modification can not be converted, engineer grade is too low.
engineer_losteffects_help: You can only have one modification on a module at a time. If you apply this modification, your existing modification will be reset. The effects of that reset are shown here.
engineer_materialtrader: This material can be traded by a Material Trader
engineer_modcompleted_experimentallocked: Experimental effects cannot be applied to this pre-engineered module.
engineer_noblueprintsavailablewarning: This engineer is not capable of converting this module, as it does not have the blueprints required.
engineer_nofiltermodsavailable: No blueprints available, please remove the filter to view unlockable blueprints.
engineer_nomodules: You currently do not have any modules I can work with.
engineer_nospecial: No chance of an experimental effect.
engineer_notification_outfitting_tip: You can view and remove modifications within Outfitting.
engineer_notification_pin: Blueprint pinned. To see pinned blueprints, visit the 'Engineers' section of the cockpit status panel.
engineer_outcomestip: Attributes will be changed within ranges shown.
engineer_playerchoice_askforreferral: I'd like you to introduce me to another engineer.
engineer_playerchoice_donate: I have some $#itemName; for you ($#numAvailable; available).
engineer_playerchoice_modship: I'm interested in modifying my ship.
engineer_playerchoice_modsuits: I want to modify my suits.
engineer_playerchoice_modweapons: I'm here to modify my weapons.
engineer_primaryeffects_help:
These bars represent the range of possible outcomes for each attribute that it affects. Every time the engineer generates this modification, the results will be different. 

After the results are generated, you will have a chance to confirm before it is applied to your ship. Once you apply a modification to your module, you can review it within Outfitting.
engineer_recipelocked: To craft higher grade blueprints you need enough engineer reputation, and to have completed all lower grade blueprints of the same type
engineer_recipelocked_preengineered: This module is pre-engineered and cannot be modified further.
engineer_recipelockedremote: Craft modules at an engineer's workshop to improve your reputation and unlock this blueprint
engineer_recipes_help: Selecting an item from this list will let you view its stat changes. Select "show all" to toggle the filter between all the blueprints and just the available ones.
engineer_remotecantconvertwarning: Legacy modules cannot be converted at modifications workshops. Only engineer workshops can perform the conversion
engineer_remoteworkshopdescription:
This workshop grants you the ability to craft any blueprints you currently have pinned, without the requirement of an engineer's facility. Please be aware that there are certain limitations:

Using this workshop to craft blueprints means you will not gain reputation with the associated engineer.

You cannot buy or change any experimental effects that may be applied to the crafted module.
engineer_removeeffectdesc: Choosing this option will leave your reputation unchanged, but your module will no longer have any special effect applied.
engineer_sideeffects_help: Some modifications have a chance of additional random secondary effects. The likelihood of a positive result is shown by the amount of blue in the right side of the bar above.
engineer_specialeffects_help: If you wish, you may purchase an experimental effect. These effects can offer anything from reduced power draw to burn effects.
engineer_stats_help: Your stats will be updated here. The top number is your base value, while the middle number indicates the maximum increase or decrease you will receive.
engineer_warning_discard: You will lose this result and any spent materials. You cannot undo this action. Do you wish to proceed?
engineer_warning_generate_cost: Generating this modification will cost materials, The results will be automatically applied to the module.
engineer_warning_negativeeffects: This will improve the overall performance of your module. However, if any attributes are listed in red they will have negative effects. Are you sure you wish to proceed?

This rare good is legal in all markets except for Imperial Prison Colony markets, Federal and Allied Theocracy markets and Federal Confederacy, Corporate, Demo and Dictatorship markets.

Please note that if a market’s controlling faction changes, some formerly legal rare goods may become illegal. Should this occur the rare good will be unavailable for sale or purchase at that market for the duration of the prohibiting faction’s tenure.

escapedconvict_arrival01: I don't know how you found me, but you're gonna wish you hadn't.
escapedconvict_arrival03: I think you took a wrong turn, friend.
escapedconvict_arrival04: You should never have come after me.
escapedconvict_niggledbynewship01: No one invited you to the party, punk.
escapedconvict_onauthoritydetection02: It took a dozen Feds to take me down last time. By my count you're a bit light.
escapedconvict_onauthoritydetection04: You'll never take me in alive.
escapedconvict_onauthoritydetection05: This can only end one way.
escapedconvict_ondeclarepiracyattack01: Red light special coming your way.
escapedconvict_ondeclarepiracyattack02: Guess whose name I pulled out the hat?
escapedconvict_ondeclarepiracyattack03: You ain't gonna like how this turns out.
escapedconvict_ondeclarepiracyattack05: Don't be a chump all your life. You don't have long left.
escapedconvict_ondeclarepiracythreaten01: Now accepting contributions to my new life.
escapedconvict_ondeclarepiracythreaten03: This can go well, or it can go real bad. Make your choice.
escapedconvict_ondeclarepiracythreaten04: Nice of you to bring my stuff back.
escapedconvict_ondeclarepiracythreaten05: Lay yer cargo down and I'll only hurt you a little.
escapedconvict_onenemyshipdetection01: You think you can take me on?!
escapedconvict_onenemyshipdetection03: Big guns you've got there. Mine's bigger.
escapedconvict_onenemyshipdetection04: I don't know what they told you, but I ain't gonna go down easy.
escapedconvict_onhulllowjumpaway01: I ain't being strung up for nobody.
escapedconvict_onhulllowjumpaway02: You haven't got the juice to take me down.
escapedconvict_onhulllowjumpaway04: Good try, just not good enough.
escapedconvict_onnocargofound01: No treats? Guess I'll have to treat myself.
escapedconvict_onnocargofound02: Empty? Never mind, the junkers pay well for scrap.
escapedconvict_onnocargofound03: Looks like you're having a really bad day.
escapedconvict_onnocargofound04: Hahaha. How does it feel to die for nothing?
escapedconvict_onnocargofound05: Disappointing. Still... I've got a feeling you'll make it up to me.
escapedconvict_onpiratedcargotheft01: That may not be a lot, but it's mine, and it's staying that way.
escapedconvict_onpiratedcargotheft04: You think you can steal from me!
escapedconvict_onsatisfactorycargodroppe: Bump it on down, baby. We're good.
You best get some dust between us while I'm still in a good mood.
You're all right, speck. Now beat it.
You bought some time, but the meter's ticking.
escapedconvict_onstartscancargo01: Let me get a look at you.
escapedconvict_onstartscancargo02: I know there's something good in your pipeline.
escapedconvict_onstartscancargo03: Run if you want. I love it when they run.
escapedconvict_onstartscancargo04: What've you got tucked away there?
escapedconvict_onstartscancargo05: Hook me up and I might let you live.
escapedconvict_onunsatisfactorycargodrop: Ha! You're gonna need to do better than that.
Add some more sweets and I'll think about letting you live.
Are you serious? I know you're not serious.
This is what you bring me? They're gonna be finding pieces of you for months.
escapedconvict_patrolcoms03: Back away before I get up close and personal.
escapedconvict_patrolcoms04: Nothin' and nobody can keep me down.
escapedconvict_patrolcoms05: You can't keep the sky from me.
escapedconvict_startinterdiction01: There's always time for a quick robbery, even on the run... Especially on the run.
escapedconvict_startinterdiction02: Ahh freedom. Freedom to take everything you have. Come 'ere!
escapedconvict_startinterdiction03: I'll be needing you to fund my new life.
escapedconvict_startinterdiction04: You're not getting away, escape is my thing.
escapedconvict_startinterdiction05: Don't fight this, you can't escape me. I know all the tricks.
escapedprisonership_arrival01: Keep your eyes peeled, make sure we weren't followed.
escapedprisonership_arrival04: This is what all those months of planning were about, boys!
escapedprisonership_arrival05: Can you taste that... That's the taste of freedom, lads. They won't follow us all the way out here, I guarantee it.
escapedprisonership_onauthoritydetection: We ain't going back alive. Don't test us!
We're gonna show you what real justice looks like.
escapedprisonership_ondeclarepiracyattac: Squeal for me... I love it when they squeal.
I didn't realise how much I missed this.
You could at least try to make this interesting.
The best bit is when you explode and I get to fly through the place you used to be.
I'm gonna break you. You're gonna beg me to stop. Then when you're at your lowest, I'm gonna keep going.
escapedprisonership_ondeclarepiracythrea: You may not know what we've been through, but you're about to experience it firsthand!
Give us everything you've got and no one has to die.
Cargo or credits? It's your call, but you're giving us one or the other.
I'm not sure whether to kill you then take your stuff, or take your stuff then kill you. Tell you what, you decide.
This is the point you pay me not to hurt you too badly.
escapedprisonership_onenemyshipdetection: Looks like we've got ourselves a showdown.
escapedprisonership_onhulllowjumpaway01: I didn't go through all that trouble just for it to end this way.
escapedprisonership_onhulllowjumpaway03: Looks like all that time in the clink dulled my reflexes. Don't you worry though, I'll make sure we meet again real soon.
escapedprisonership_onhulllowjumpaway04: Ha, good attempt, but not good enough.
escapedprisonership_onnocargofound01: Looks like you're going to have to take out the advanced payment plan.
escapedprisonership_onnocargofound02: You're almost as broke as we are. I feel bad for you, Commander, though I'm still gonna have to turn your ship into scrap.
escapedprisonership_onnocargofound03: No cargo? If you've got family... never mind, you ain't gonna be seeing them again.
escapedprisonership_onnocargofound04: How's an honest criminal meant to make a few credits round here?
escapedprisonership_onnocargofound05: Oh dear, oh dear, oh dear.
escapedprisonership_onsatisfactorycargod: Well you've bought yourself to the count of a hundred, I'd make good use of it if I were you.
Get those canisters loaded up, boys!
escapedprisonership_onstartscancargo01: Hold still. You move and I cut you. That's a promise!
escapedprisonership_onstartscancargo02: Don't panic. Give us what we want and we might let you limp out of here.
escapedprisonership_onstartscancargo03: Don't hold out on us now!
escapedprisonership_onstartscancargo04: Let's see what this tin can is keeping fresh for us!
escapedprisonership_onstartscancargo05: You've got approximately 15 seconds before we start shooting. Use 'em wisely.
escapedprisonership_onstartscancargo06: This is a stickup! Haha I always wanted to say that. For real though, drop your cargo or I'm going to blow you out of the sky.
escapedprisonership_onunsatisfactorycarg: For your sake I hope you've got more than that on you.
No, no, no. That won't do at all.
Now you're just making me angry.
escapedprisonership_startinterdiction01: I've been away a while, but this is just like riding a bike. Tethered to another bike. In space.
escapedprisonership_startinterdiction02: Lucky you, I'm free and ready to make a big score.
escapedprisonership_startinterdiction03: They can't stop me now! You're mine
escapedprisonership_startinterdiction04: Let me show you what being caught was like...

escort_escortstayandfight03: I have failed in my duties, for this you will die!

escort_escortstayandfight06: The mission is failed, but I will avenge them!
escort_escortstayandfight07: This isn't how it should have gone, but I will fight to the end.
escort_escortstayandfight08: I might not get paid, but I will get revenge.

escort_neardeath02: This is escort to lead, critical systems damage.

escortbodyguardpatrolcoms01: This is Primary to remaining escorts, tighten up those flight paths, I want full spectrum coverage for our guest.
escortbodyguardpatrolcoms02: I don't have to tell you how important our dignitary is, squadron, so lets keep it professional.

esusekucaviar_info:
After being discovered in an ancient gene bank, the last of the cryogenically stored sturgeon eggs were purchased for an undisclosed, but reliably enormous sum. After a long search for an appropriate environment, they were introduced to the waters of Esuseku, and to their owner's relief, hatched and established a breeding colony. These ancient fish continue to thrive in the waters of Esuseku making them the primary producer of caviar in known space.

This rare good is legal in all markets except for Independent and Allied Communist markets.

Please note that if a market’s controlling faction changes, some formerly legal rare goods may become illegal. Should this occur the rare good will be unavailable for sale or purchase at that market for the duration of the prohibiting faction’s tenure.
esusekucaviar_info_short: These ancient fish thrive in the waters of Esuseku making them the primary producer of caviar in known space.
ethgrezeteabuds_info:
These tea buds have to be hand-plucked from the dangerous Ethgreze Carnivorous Camellia Sinensis plants. Only those with sharp reflexes make it through their first season without losing fingers or entire hands to the deadly fast plants. Due to the danger in collecting it, this tea is famously expensive.

This rare good is legal in all markets.

With cutting-edge modular compatibility, the Caspian Explorer is an attractive choice for pilots with dreams of exploring the galaxy in style. It offers full integration with several Mk II modules to provide an expansive hyperjump range, optimised orbital glides, expert thruster control and a remarkable FSD supercharge capacity. Zorgon Peterson have also packed the Caspian Explorer with plenty of internal module slots to accommodate one’s personal loadout needs.

The Caspian Explorer has been designed for large-size landing pads.

faction_description_anarchy: Anarchist factions are typically criminal gangs or organisations that possess no official (or recognised) form of government, yet still wield influence within a system. They usually have no formal laws, except those of self-preservation and personal loyalty to an individual, and as such anarchy systems are lawless and dangerous places.
faction_description_communism: Communist governments believe in an equal society, although one controlled by a central group. The means to choose that central group are varied, and often contradict the altruistic aims of such a society. Generally such governments are totalitarian and centralised.
faction_description_confederacy: Confederacy factions are sometimes considered forms of proto-democracy. Although instead of a centrally elected government their society is governed by smaller parties and interest groups working in concert. The votes of the individual are not a core concept for these societies, although can be found in some.
faction_description_cooperative: Cooperative factions are similar to communist ones in that their core precept is the equal stature of all members of society. Unlike communist factions, a cooperative's governance is not centralised, but organised through devolved parties and committees. All are expected to work equally for the betterment of their society, rather than that of the individual.
faction_description_corporate: Corporate State governments extend the corporate structure throughout their society, with shareholding being the equivalent to citizenship. The principles will vary, but are generally set to ensure smooth operations for the corporations, often to the benefit of the attached population.
faction_description_democracy: Democratic governments are chosen by the voting public. The government then sets the law. While the specifics often vary between democratic states, they are all unified by the concept of being accountable to their voters.
faction_description_dictatorship: Dictatorships have an overall ruler, who will remain leader until they die, or are overthrown. Power in the society is controlled (often by extreme measures) by that single individual. Succession is often a tumultuous affair. All members of society owe their allegiance to that individual.
faction_description_feudal: Feudal societies are based around a group of feudal leaders, each of which have absolute power within their region. They usually cooperate to appoint a single overall representative, but power rests with the feudal lords, rather than the appointed representative.
faction_description_patronage: Factions and societies based upon Patronage have at their root the family structure, with a hierarchy extended beyond that. Loyalty and honour is generally at its centre, similar to that of the Empire. Some argue this provides a truer form of democracy.
faction_description_prison: Prison organisations are based on specially adapted capital ships, designed to maintain a large off-world prison population. Some of these will specialise in punishment and rehabilitation to a greater or lesser degree, depending on the organisation in question.
faction_description_prisoncolony: Prison colony factions deal with the governance of prisoner inmate populations, usually on a large scale. While they are authoritarian and often controlled at the top end by a law enforcement element, they do sometimes contain a political element contributed by the prisoners.
faction_description_theocracy: Theocratic factions are based upon the structures of their respective religions. The practical processes are different between the religions, but they all share the concept that their society exists in devotion to their religion and the deity or deities or beliefs at their centre.
faction_happinessband1_description: This faction is elated with how things are going, and its people are optimistic for the future.
faction_happinessband2_description: This faction is pleased with its progress and would like to maintain an upward trajectory.
faction_happinessband3_description: This faction is content with life at the moment but believe there is room for improvement in its status.
faction_happinessband4_description: This faction is unhappy with recent developments and hopes to turn things around soon.
faction_happinessband5_description: This faction is despondent at recent setbacks and its people are desperate for the situation to improve.
faction_happinesshappiest_description: This faction is as happy as it could possibly be.
factionassociates_info: Information on a faction's political allies and related beneficial relationships.
factionassociates_longinfo: Information on a faction's political allies and related beneficial relationships.
factionbackground_aislinggenerictier1:
Imperial Humanist

As members of Aisling Duval's de facto court, this group has been openly showing its support for Aisling's movement by buying up large numbers of Imperial Slaves and gifting them to the Princess to do with as she sees fit.
factionbackground_aislinggenerictier2:
Imperial Reformist

This faction is well known for actively attempting to promote reform within Imperial society.

The most recent example of which would be the outlawing of slavery in all regions under their control, a move which is commonly believed to have been inspired by Aisling Duval's open revulsion at the practice of slavery.
factionbackground_aislinggenerictier3:
Imperial Loyalist

This group has a history of supporting the Imperial family, regardless of whatever stance the current ruler happens to be purporting at any given point in time.
factionbackground_aislinghomebase:
Imperial Courtier

This faction operates as an extension of the Princess Imperial's will. Their numbers have recently begun being bolstered by liberated slaves who have chosen to become the princess' servants in order to repay her for freeing them from bondage.
factionbackground_patreusexpansionwing1:
Imperial Expansionist

This faction has earned a reputation for being ruthlessly expansionist.

As an active wing of Senator Patreus' Classis, members of this group have both the training and the resources to capture and hold any objective the senator chooses to set for them.
factionbackground_patreusfederaldissent1: This group has recently begun openly expressing its dissatisfaction with Federal policy decisions. Rumours abound among the local populace about a potential split from the Federation, a rumour backed by the fact than an ever increasing amount of armaments and ships are working their way through the system's ports.
factionbackground_patreusgenericexternal:
Imperial Corporate

This minor trade organisation first rose to prominence due to the ease with which they are able to supply other local factions with technology that originates from the Imperial war worlds.

This organisation has seen its operations swell significantly after a recent spate of hirings. Financial records indicate that much of their new found success can be attributed to orders placed by businesses owned by Denton Patreus.
factionbackground_patreusgenerictier1: As members of Senator Patreus' coterie, this faction can attribute much of its success to the senator's direct guidance.
factionbackground_patreusgenerictier2: This faction has benefited greatly from its association with Senator Patreus, whose continued patronage offers many opportunities for expanding its influence well beyond the borders of this sector.
factionbackground_patreusgenerictier3: This group has recently become very a vocal supporter of Senator Patreus' expansionist policies. Rumours of Senator Patreus offering a stipend to factions that support his bid to expand Imperial influence beyond the current borders have not been verified.
factionbackground_patreushomebase: Under the direct employ of Senator Denton Patreus, this faction acts as an extension of Patreus' will, ensuring that everything runs like clockwork in the senator's home system.
factionbackground_patreusowned1:
Neo-Nationalist Dictatorship

Known for aggressively promoting an agenda of strength through unity, this faction exerts rigid control over anyone unfortunate enough to fall under their care. Despite the occasional uprising, this group has managed to maintain control of the system due to their working relationship with Imperial Senator Denton Patreus.
factionbackground_patreusspecial1: Well known for being the best independent source of Imperial Armaments in the entire sector. A recent falling out with their supplier has left the Nasaraudi Dominion struggling to meet demand.
factionbackground_torvalgenericexternale:
Imperial Hedonist

It is commonly known throughout the system that this group's rise to power has been almost entirely built off the backs of slaves. Shipments of which have started to be imported from Imperial space in ever increasing numbers.
factionbackground_torvalgenericexternali: This faction's fortune changed significantly after entering into a pact with Zemina Torval, whose custom now makes up over 50% of this group's reported revenue. Despite seeing an increase in profits, reports indicate that many members of the faction work for what appears to be a slave wage.
factionbackground_torvalgenerictier1: As members of Senator Torval's Coterie, this group has managed to become extremely wealthy and extensively influential, despite being reviled by many of its peers.
factionbackground_torvalgenerictier2: This faction has benefited greatly from its association with Senator Torval, whose contacts have supplied the faction with a steady supply of skilled slaves to aid them in their endeavours.
factionbackground_torvalgenerictier3: This group has recently begun to openly support Senator Torval in her bid to loosen the laws regarding slave labour. They stand to see considerable gain should the Senator succeed in her bid to allow slavers to seek further afield for stock.
factionbackground_torvalhomebase: Counted among Senator Torval's most loyal servants, this faction has developed a reputation for working hard and playing even harder. Despite rumours of excessive hedonistic behaviour among the organisation's membership, this group is respected by the citizens that live in the Senator's home system.
factionbackground_torvalspecial1: Workers and residents living under the rule of the LTT 700 Front have begun going missing at an alarming rate over the past few months. Those who disappear are never heard from again. All attempts to find the missing members have come up empty handed.
factiondonatorlist_info: A record of individuals or organsiations that have made financial contributions to a faction.
factiondonatorlist_longinfo: A record of individuals or organsiations that have made financial contributions to a faction.
factionnews_info: Publicly available press releases and ongoing news stories related to a faction.
factionnews_longinfo: Publicly available press releases and ongoing news stories related to a faction.
factionstate_aid_desc: The faction has chosen to help another local faction currently experiencing hardship.
factionstate_aid_guide: Complete relevant missions to help the ailing faction recover.
factionstate_anarchy_desc: Your Universal Cartographic Module appears to have malfunctioned. Please alert Technical Support as soon as possible.
factionstate_anarchy_guide: Your Universal Cartographic Module appears to have malfunctioned. Please alert Technical Support as soon as possible.
factionstate_blight_desc: An agricultural blight is affecting crop yields.
factionstate_blight_guide: $AgronomicTreatment_Name; can counter the blight before famine takes hold.
factionstate_boom_desc: An economic boom is a period of economic growth and prosperity.
factionstate_boom_guide: Complete relevant missions and engage in profitable trade to maintain the boom state.
factionstate_bust_desc: An economic bust is a period in which economic growth decline rapidly.
factionstate_bust_guide: Complete relevant missions and engage in profitable trade to pull the faction out of the bust state.
factionstate_civilliberty_desc: A sustained period of stability has boosted confidence in faction security.
factionstate_civilliberty_guide: Complete relevant missions and engage in bounty hunting to maintain the period of civil liberty.
factionstate_civilunrest_desc: A period of civil unrest represents a failure in local security leading to riots, looting and terrorist activity.
factionstate_civilunrest_guide: Collect bounties, complete relevant missions and scenario objectives to end the unrest.
factionstate_civilwar_desc: A civil war is a large scale and violent conflict between two factions within the same system.
factionstate_civilwar_guide: Complete relevant missions, win local conflict zone battles and hand in combat bonds to help win the civil war.
factionstate_coldwar_desc: The faction is in a state of conflict with another faction, but overt conflict has not yet occurred.
factionstate_coldwar_guide: Complete relevant missions to help win the cold war.
factionstate_colonisation_desc: The faction intends to colonise a nearby unpopulated system.
factionstate_colonisation_guide: Complete relevant missions and deliver any required commodities to support the colonisation effort.
factionstate_drought_desc: A shortage of safe drinking water is making life difficult for the local population.
factionstate_drought_guide: Complete missions and deliver water alongside other emergency supplies to bring the drought to an end.
factionstate_election_desc: An election is a peaceful conflict between two factions with reasonably similar ideologies.
factionstate_election_guide: Complete relevant missions to help this faction to win the election.
factionstate_expansion_desc: Expansion represents a factions intention to spread into a nearby system in the near future.
factionstate_expansion_guide: Maintain happiness within this system to grow the faction into a nearby system.
factionstate_famine_desc: A famine represents a widespread scarcity of food caused by the economic failure of the faction.
factionstate_famine_guide: Complete relevant missions, and deliver food to pull the faction out of the famine.
factionstate_fullstatedesc_aid: This faction has answered a request for assistance and is helping to improve another faction's infrastructure. While the target will benefit from this, this faction will experience a slight downturn while paying for the humanitarian work.
factionstate_fullstatedesc_blight: Agricultural blight has a devastating effect on a system's economy while driving up the demand for food. Deliveries of agronomic treatment can help counter the blight before a full-blown famine develops.
factionstate_fullstatedesc_boom: Boom is usually the result of consistent trade profit and completed trade contracts. When a faction experiences a boom, the wealth of the system it controls temporarily increases and trade missions completed in the system have double the effect on influence. The faction's influence may also increase. Booms typically last until they naturally expire.
factionstate_fullstatedesc_bust: When a faction experiences a bust, the wealth of the system it controls is temporarily reduced and the faction's influence is temporarily diminished. Trade actions do not contribute to boom while a bust is active. A bust typically has to run its course before ending.
factionstate_fullstatedesc_civilliberty: Within this system, the faction is enjoying a period of stability, resulting in widespread happiness among the local population.
factionstate_fullstatedesc_civilunrest: Civil unrest is the result of illegal activity. When a faction is affected by civil unrest, the standard of living in the system it controls temporarily decreases, as does the system's wealth. Combat missions and activities can bring civil unrest to an end.
factionstate_fullstatedesc_civilwar: Civil wars occur when minor factions compete for control of major assets such as starports. When a faction is involved in a civil war, the standard of living, development level and security level in the system it controls are temporarily reduced. Combat activities can bring a civil war to an end.
factionstate_fullstatedesc_drought: A significant lack of safe drinking water is slowing this faction's economy and standard of living. Deliveries of water and other emergency supplies will help to end drought sooner.
factionstate_fullstatedesc_election: Elections occur when two minor factions with a similar political structure resolve a conflict over ownership and influence within a system.
factionstate_fullstatedesc_expansion: Expansions occur when a minor faction reaches a sufficient level of influence and there is a populated system within striking distance. Expansion is costly, so when a faction expands, the wealth and development level of the system it controls are temporarily reduced.
factionstate_fullstatedesc_famine: When a faction is affected by famine the standard of living in the system it controls temporarily decreases. Combat activity has no effect on influence while a famine is active. Completing food-trade missions can bring a famine to an end.
factionstate_fullstatedesc_infrastructur: This faction’s infrastructure has failed, disrupting operations and reducing both security and economic standards. The increased demands on alternate system infrastructure may lead to similar failures for other factions. Food and machinery deliveries can speed up the repair process.
factionstate_fullstatedesc_investment: Within this system, the faction is enjoying a period of economic good fortune, resulting in widespread happiness among the local population.
factionstate_fullstatedesc_lockdown: When a faction experiences a lockdown, the security level of the system it controls temporarily increases and the system's wealth temporarily decreases. Bounty hunting activity can shorten the lockdown period.
factionstate_fullstatedesc_naturaldisast: A natural disaster results in a significant disruption to a faction’s overall status. The disaster can lead to infrastructure failures or drought for other factions in the system.
factionstate_fullstatedesc_outbreak: When a faction is affected by an outbreak the standard of living in the system it controls temporarily decreases. Combat activity has no effect on influence while an outbreak is active. Completing medicine-supply missions can bring an outbreak to an end.
factionstate_fullstatedesc_pirateattack: This faction is battling an increase in pirate attacks, lowering its security level. Pirate activity and interdictions in the system increase. Bounty hunting contracts and related missions will help push the pirates back.
factionstate_fullstatedesc_publicholiday: This faction is enjoying a public holiday, increasing the faction’s standard of living and influence. The celebration’s cost and resultant large crowds can negatively impact economic and security levels, however.
factionstate_fullstatedesc_retreat: Factions are considered to be in retreat if their level of influence within a system drops below a certain level. If the faction's influence remains low for a total of five days, the faction must leave the system entirely. If the faction manages to increase its level of influence, it remains in the system.
factionstate_fullstatedesc_terrorism: Prosperous factions may attract the attention of terrorist groups seeking to sow chaos and dissent. An active terrorism state will negatively affect a faction's influence and security levels. Importing weaponry and selling bounties to the faction will help resolve the problem. If the faction enters lockdown, the terrorist threat will end.
factionstate_fullstatedesc_thargoid_cont: Thargoids have established full control of the system. Human settlements and ports have been abandoned. Destroying Thargoid ships and handing in Thargoid combat bonds to local ports will contest the Thargoids' control of the system.
factionstate_fullstatedesc_thargoid_harv: Large numbers of Thargoid craft are active the system, resulting in social and economic ruin for the local population. Destroying Thargoid ships and handing in Thargoid combat bonds to local ports will help drive the Thargoids out of the system.
factionstate_fullstatedesc_thargoid_prob: Thargoid vessels have been detected in the system, triggering social and economic instability among the local populace. Destroying Thargoid ships and handing in Thargoid combat bonds to local ports can prevent the Thargoids from establishing a long-term presence.
factionstate_fullstatedesc_thargoid_reco: Humans are returning to this system after a period of Thargoid control. They will need assistance to re-establish the local economy, security force and infrastructure.
factionstate_fullstatedesc_thargoid_stro: A Thargoid Titan is present in the system and Thargoids are in full control. All humans have either fled or are assumed lost. Brave pilots may investigate the maelstrom's dangerous environment for any information about its purpose.
factionstate_fullstatedesc_thargoidincur: Significant numbers of Thargoids have been reported in the system, resulting in social and economic instability. Destroying Thargoid ships and handing in Thargoid combat bonds to local starports will push the Thargoids out of the system.
factionstate_fullstatedesc_war: Wars occur when a minor faction invades a star system controlled by another minor faction. For the duration of the war, the standard of living, wealth level and security level in the disputed system are reduced. Combat activity between the two warring factions determines the outcome of the conflict. If neither faction succeeds in dominating the other, the war ends in a ceasefire.
factionstate_historicevent_desc: A significant social event has inspired a period of celebration.
factionstate_historicevent_guide: This is good opportunity to relax and enjoy the period of celebration.
factionstate_incursion_desc: Thargoids have entered the system and are attempting to take control.
factionstate_incursion_guide: Engage in Thargoid conflict zones and complete Thargoid-related missions to prevent the Thargoids from occupying the system.
factionstate_incursionpending_desc: Thargoids are massing on the fringes of the system, suggesting an imminent incursion.
factionstate_incursionpending_guide: Destroy local Thargoid threats to prevent a Thargoid incursion.
factionstate_infested_desc: The system has been overrun by Thargoids.
factionstate_infested_guide: Engage in Thargoid conflict zones and encounters, and complete relevant missions, to help reclaim the system.
factionstate_infestedcured_desc: Most of the Thargoids occupying this system have been destroyed.
factionstate_infestedcured_guide: Destroy local Thargoid threats to prevent the Thargoids from returning.
factionstate_infrastructurefailure_desc: An infrastructure collapse has resulted in severe disruptions to this faction’s operations.
factionstate_infrastructurefailure_guide: Complete relevant missions, and deliver food and medicine, to help the ailing faction recover.
factionstate_investment_desc: The faction has experienced a very strong economic upturn and is reinvesting the profits into its population.
factionstate_investment_guide: Complete relevant missions and engage in profitable trade to maintain the investment state.
factionstate_lockdown_desc: A faction in Lockdown is suffering such poor security levels that it has invoked martial law and has closed off its services to outsiders.
factionstate_lockdown_guide: Complete relevant scenarios and collect local bounties to move the faction out of lockdown.
factionstate_naturaldisaster_desc: A natural disaster inflicts infrastructure damage and mass casualties.
factionstate_naturaldisaster_guide: Complete relevant missions, and deliver food and medicine, to help the ailing faction recover.
factionstate_none_desc: This faction is currently not experiencing any specific states.
factionstate_none_desc_future: This system will not be impacted by the war effort
factionstate_none_guide: Increase the faction's security status, economic status and influence to increase its standing in the system.
factionstate_outbreak_desc: An outbreak reflects the spread of a virulent disease among members of the faction.
factionstate_outbreak_guide: Complete relevant missions, and deliver medicine to help end the outbreak.
factionstate_pirateattack_desc: Pirates have entered the area and are targeting passing ships.
factionstate_pirateattack_guide: Complete relevant missions and bounty hunting contracts to drive the pirates from the system.
factionstate_powershift_desc: Your Universal Cartographic Module appears to have malfunctioned. Please alert Technical Support as soon as possible.
factionstate_powershift_guide: Your Universal Cartographic Module appears to have malfunctioned. Please alert Technical Support as soon as possible.
factionstate_pseudo_humancontrolled_desc: This system is currently populated and controlled by humanity.
The system will return to a state of full human control
factionstate_pseudo_humancontrolled_guid: Humanity controls this system. Check local mission boards for available contracts.
factionstate_pseudo_unpopulated_desc: There is no human population present in this system.
factionstate_pseudo_unpopulated_desc_fut: Thargoids will retreat from the system, leaving it unpopulated
factionstate_pseudo_unpopulated_guide: This system is currently unpopulated, but may contain mineral resources or collectable data.
factionstate_publicholiday_desc: A period of good fortune has impelled the faction to declare a public holiday.
factionstate_publicholiday_guide: This is good opportunity to relax and enjoy the public holiday.
factionstate_retreat_desc: The faction feels that it does not have enough support from the local populace to remain in the system and is planning to leave.
factionstate_retreat_guide: Increase this faction's influence before it is forced to leave the system.
factionstate_revolution_desc: A revolutionary group is trying to force a change in government.
factionstate_revolution_guide: Support or oppose the revolutionaries by completing relevant missions.
factionstate_technologicalleap_desc: Recent advancements could result in an increase to the faction's development level.
factionstate_technologicalleap_guide: Complete relevant missions to help the faction reach the next development level.
factionstate_terrorism_desc: The faction has been targeted by a terrorist group.
factionstate_terrorism_guide: Complete relevant missions and engage in bounty hunting to help defeat the terrorists.
factionstate_thargoid_controlled_desc: Thargoids have established control over this system. Destroying Thargoid vessels in high numbers will drive the xeno force out.
factionstate_thargoid_controlled_desc_cu: Thargoid forces will maintain control of this system.
factionstate_thargoid_controlled_desc_fu: Thargoids will take full control of this system
factionstate_thargoid_controlled_guide: Destroy Thargoid vessels to contest ownership of the system.
factionstate_thargoid_harvest_desc: Thargoids are attempting to take control of this system. Control will be established when all local ports are burning. Achieving the victory state before this happens is key to repelling the Thargoid advance.
factionstate_thargoid_harvest_desc_futur: Thargoid forces will invade this system in an attempt to take control
factionstate_thargoid_harvest_guide: Engage in AX conflict zones and complete anti-Thargoid missions to prevent the Thargoids from controlling the system.
factionstate_thargoid_probing_desc: Thargoid vessels are present in this system. If they are not repelled in one week, an invasion force will arrive.
factionstate_thargoid_probing_desc_futur: Thargoid vessels will enter this system as a precursor to invasion
factionstate_thargoid_probing_desc_unpop: Thargoid vessels are present in this system. If they are not repelled in one week, Thargoids will establish system control.
factionstate_thargoid_probing_guide: Engage in AX conflict zones and complete anti-Thargoid missions to prevent the Thargoids from invading the system.
factionstate_thargoid_recovery_desc: This system is recovering after repelling Thargoid forces. Recovery progress is automatic and will complete when all ports in the system have been repaired. Contributing to a port's repair efforts will bring it online faster.
factionstate_thargoid_recovery_desc_futu: Humanity will initiate efforts to repair damaged assets in this system
factionstate_thargoid_recovery_guide: Complete missions for local factions and engage in profitable trade to help the system recover.
factionstate_thargoid_stronghold_desc: A Thargoid Titan is present here. The system is heavily guarded.
factionstate_thargoid_stronghold_desc_fu: A Thargoid Titan will occupy this system with a dangerous defensive fleet
factionstate_thargoid_stronghold_guide: Investigate the Thargoid Titan to learn more about its purpose.
factionstate_tradewar_desc: The faction is in a state of overt conflict with another corporate faction.
factionstate_tradewar_guide: Complete relevant missions and make profitable trades to help the faction win the trade war.
factionstate_unknown_desc: Your Universal Cartographic Module appears to have malfunctioned. Please alert Technical Support as soon as possible.
factionstate_unknown_guide: Your Universal Cartographic Module appears to have malfunctioned. Please alert Technical Support as soon as possible.
factionstate_war_desc: The War state represents a conflict between the controlling faction in a system and a new faction that has expanded into the system.
factionstate_war_guide: Complete relevant missions, win local conflict zone battles and hand in combat bonds to help win the war.

federation_corvette_armour_grade1_info: Hull reinforcement that provides standard protection against all types of attack.
federation_corvette_armour_grade2_info: Hull reinforcement using an advanced structure and higher quality compounds, offering improved protection against all types of attack.
federation_corvette_armour_grade3_info: Hull reinforcement using an advanced structure and military-grade compounds, offering superior protection against all types of attack.
federation_corvette_armour_mirrored_info: Hull reinforcement using a specially formulated structure, offering superior protection against thermal damage caused by energy weapons. It is vulnerable to projectile weapons and other kinetic attacks.

federation_corvette_info:
The Federal Corvette is one of the most powerful combat ships on the market. With a total of seven hardpoints, the ship has few rivals in terms of damage output, and is remarkably manoeuvrable given its size. Despite its comparatively small jump range, owning a Corvette is the ultimate ambition of many independent combat pilots, its astonishing power making it one of the most formidable vessels in the galaxy.

The Federal Corvette has been designed for large-size landing pads.

federation_dropship_info:
