gs_slingshot_001_body:
Technician Farrow, Work Log 943-56. Gen Ship: Spear of Hope

Looks like one of the long-distance Pathfinder probes has malfunctioned. It wouldn't normally be a big deal, but we've already lost two so they're becoming precious. Finding a habitable planet depends on having as many working probes as possible. And that means yours truly will have to head out and fix it.

I'm not expecting it to be a challenge from a technical point of view, but the probe is light years away. It will take the maintenance shuttle six months to reach it and another six to get back. So I'll be on my own for a year.

Maybe someone will let me have their coffee ration.
gs_slingshot_002_body:
Technician Farrow, Work Log 943-97. Gen Ship: Spear of Hope

I just returned to the Spear of Hope having repaired the Pathfinder drone. There's just one problem...I've returned to a ghost ship. I mean, the whole place has been evacuated.

I've checked the data logs and it looks like the crew found a viable planet about eight months ago. The Spear of Hope was going to take them right past it, so they staged an emergency evacuation. According to the log, five thousand people left the ship in about an hour. I guess no one had time to think about one lonely technician out in the black.

So now I've got to work out how to get to them... I always did enjoy a challenge.
gs_slingshot_003_body:
Technician Farrow, Work Log 944-01. Gen Ship: Spear of Hope

Every last ship and shuttle is gone. There's no emergency fuel either, so my shuttle is all but useless. I can't even tap into the Spear of Hope's fuel line because it's powered by a propulsion drive. That said, all is not lost.

I took a look at the engine schematics, and I think I can adjust the ship's trajectory using a nearby star. The idea is to get close enough to the star's gravity well to slingshot around it. Hopefully, I'll be able to put the ship on an approach vector for the planet.

Honestly, I think the chances of it working are slim. But it's the only chance I've got.
gs_slingshot_004_body:
Technician Farrow, Work Log 944-04. Gen Ship: Spear of Hope

I've gone over the numbers…and I think I can make it work. The only snag is that it'll take a while to reach the next viable star. ...and when I say a while I mean a really, really long while. If the numbers are correct, I should reach the planet in...about 93 years.

I've run the calculations countless times, but the results are always the same. The next time I see another human being, I'll be 132 years old. Let's just hope they've built a retirement home on this planet.
gs_thechromosomeincident_001_body:
Medical Log 247/4

I've researched some statistics and there could be a problem. Over the past three months 75% of pregnancies have provided a male foetus. I'm sure it's nothing to worry about right now. Although I'm starting to think my predecessor made a mistake not bringing any medical equipment that could manipulate gender at the embryonic stage. I mean I can understand the ethics behind it, but this has left us hanging a little bit. Especially now we're in this situation. I can only hope it evens itself out.
gs_thechromosomeincident_002_body:
Medical Log 320/9

Situation is now critical. We've had no female newborns for the past nine months and all recent pregnancies have produced male foetuses. I'm currently looking into the problem and it would appear that none of the ship's complement are producing male gametes with the XX chromosome. That means that even if we could artificially inseminate with a sample we still wouldn't produce any zygotes with the potential to form a female embryo. I have no idea how to solve this as we have no stock with both XX and XY samples on the ship - another mistake my predecessor made. If I can find out the cause of this anomaly hopefully it will lead me to a solution. We have time to fix this, and I'm not panicking yet, but this has the potential to be disastrous to the success of our mission.
gs_thechromosomeincident_003_body:
Medical Log 398/1

After all these years I finally have to come to terms with the fact that we're never going to find a solution to this problem. The last member of the ship's complement of child bearing age has now had a boy. She was sixty nine. If I could find a solution, even if I applied the stims and gene therapy that allowed any of them to carry a child, none of the women aboard ship would reach full term anyway.
gs_thechromosomeincident_004_body:
Medical Log 537/5

This will be my last entry. The men aboard are preparing to evacuate. They know the mission is doomed and don't want to die here. I don't blame them. I could still go with them, but I've refused the offer. I failed this ship and everyone aboard. It's only right that I die with the mission. Good luck to them.
gs_thegolconda_001_body:
This is Captain Jonathon Forester. The Golconda colony needs help. 
I don't know how else to say it. To anybody hearing this, this is what's happening. We have a full colony on board this vessel - that's tens of thousands of people. Until recently we've been entirely self-sufficient, but supplies are starting to run low. More specifically we're lacking a lot of technical components. Air filters, water recyclers, circuit boards. Things like that. It's getting harder to patch this equipment up each year. There's only so long we can make do with what we have.
And the other thing - and this is the real kicker - is that there's a disease going around which is knocking people sideways. Flu-like symptoms but much more serious. People are dying. We're coping as best as we can, but our medical supplies are running low. If it turns into a full-blown epidemic then we're going to be in real big trouble.
So I made the decision to reach out to you. Whoever you are. Hopefully the tech has moved on enough for our signal to be picked up this far out. But the others really weren't sure if I should be doing this, because...People here don't want interference from outsiders. But I don't want to worry them by explaining the reality of our situation. They're good people; I don't want them to be scared.
So here I am. Recording a call for help. Trust me, I wouldn't be asking if I didn't need to. 
I feel like I don't really know how to do this. I hope you understand. It's been a while.
This is Captain Jonathon Forester, signing off.
gs_thegolconda_002_body:
This is Dr Shay Tandis. Captain Forester has asked me to summarise the situation on board the Golconda, particularly in regards to a recent outbreak of disease. 
I must preface this by saying that any attempt to summarise the situation feels inadequate. There is so much to say about the symptoms, the development of our detection methods and existing treatment philosophies. Nevertheless, I will attempt to speak concisely for the purpose of this broadcast.
The disease - known colloquially among the people as 'the wasting kiss' - is a mutated strain of viral nasopharyngitis. One of the drawbacks of living in an atmospherically self-contained structure for hundreds of years is that illness tends to linger. We can't very well sterilise a ship of this size, and with each generation these illnesses adapt to remain virulent. This one particularly so. 
Antiviral treatments aren't particularly effective, merely delaying the disease's progress. We have confirmed six deaths in the past month attributable to the disease. Our medical supplies are somewhat limited, adequate for maintaining health and the occasional serious illness or accident. In the event of a full outbreak, with hundreds of patients requiring treatment, we may be forced to resort to measures such as full quarantine and isolation.
When the Captain first suggested opening communication with outsiders, I must confess to a certain hesitation. On reflection, it would seem the logical decision for the well-being of the crew. One can only imagine what pharmaceutical advancements have been made over the last millennia. The possibilities are fascinating.
gs_thegolconda_003_body:
Ric Blanchard, Security Chief of the Golconda.
First thing's first. The safety and protection of the people aboard this ship is my primary objective. During my tenure we have reduced the rate of crime aboard this vessel by 32%. Violent crime is rare, and there hasn't been a murder in over six years. My team are well trained and do this ship proud in how they address the very specifics demands of the Golconda. You might think an isolated space-faring colony of thousands with no horizons, seasons or other planetary benefits would have gone mad and initiated some kind of mass tragedy. Well not on my watch.
Which is why I need to be clear in my opposition to the Captain's decision to send out a distress call. Humanity doesn't enjoy a stellar record of respecting the rights and well-being of indigenous communities. Hell, we don't know what humanity is anymore past the confines of this thousand-year hull. The risks outweigh the advantages. 
I'll follow the Captain's order, because he's not let us down yet. Got a good mind, that one. But I'm asking whoever hears this message to understand that we're looking for a trade of goods and resources only. Communication with the general populace of the Golconda is forbidden. Messages regarding developments outside of the Golconda is forbidden. Direct contact between outsiders and Golconda colonists during an exchange of cargo is forbidden.
We've always dealt with hard times ourselves. If it were my call, we'd deal with this by ourselves too.
gs_thegolconda_004_body:
This is Erin Grey of the Golconda. It is my responsibility as custodian to manage the needs of our people and ensure that everyone is fairly represented. I'm recording this message to satisfy the curiosity of anyone who may respond to our distress signal, I suppose. Truth be told, I'm not sure what to say.
We're more than just a colony, you see. We're a family. Whenever a challenge is put in front of us, we resolve it together. When success is achieved, we celebrate collectively. We have a...
It's hard to put into words. Our ancestors chose to remain on this vessel, centuries ago, and leave our original destination behind. They did so because they had grown to love what they had achieved. Logs from that period show their anxiety at the prospect of leaving the Golconda. 
The generation ships were designed to keep colonists healthy, happy and entertained. Somewhere on our journey, we came to feel loved, too.
And yet all things must come to an end. Sickness is rife and supplies are low. After so long fending for ourselves, the time has come to seek assistance from a civilisation we no longer know. 
The captain believes humanity has a heart and will come to our aid. If you're listening to this message, we're probably going to find out if he's right soon enough.
gs_thegolconda_005_body:
Somas Cobb, chaplain. I serve the Golconda, and the Golconda embraces me.
Long ago, I would have been called a priest. Somebody authorised to provide guidance according to the rules of a religion. That's the role my predecessors fulfilled, at least. 
Eventually, the old texts were set aside in favour of a less rigid spiritual philosophy. Being able to view the entire nebula over breakfast inclines one towards the contemplative. There are few things more reformative than a sense of complete insignificance. 
Now, my role is to show my brothers and sisters that we are all important. Each of us has a role to play. We cannot concern ourselves with the scale of the stage - all we can do is deliver the best performance we can.
Each person aboard the Golconda can trace their heritage from the first inhabitants to the current day. In the present we contemplate the spirit and the soul, allowing the voices of the past to inform our future. Our respect for them, combined with our belief in each other, creates a community of hope.
And here we are, over a thousand years later, about to reach out a hand and hope that humanity accepts it. What lies in store for us, I wonder? What lessons have been learned from history? While I am nervous at the thought of outside assistance, I must admit the question intrigues me. 
What did we become?
gs_thelasthumans_001_body:
Warrant Officer Noonan - Personal Log 512/9

I must admit, sometimes our mission seems futile. It's still difficult to accept that we're the last humans in the galaxy. But who am I to argue with Command?

Details regarding the end of humanity are scarce, and discussion of it is forbidden.  The rumour is there was some kind of cataclysm. Sol was the first to fall, followed by every inhabited system in the core. Plague, famine, war - it could have been anything. All I know is we're the last vestige of humankind. And we must find a new home if our race is to survive. 

Who knows what would have happened without Command. They've guided and protected us for hundreds of years. If I prove my worth, maybe one day they'll ask me to join them. But for now I'm happy to serve in whatever way I can.
gs_thelasthumans_002_body:
Warrant Officer Noonan - Personal Log 576/4

Something really weird happened today. I was accompanying Admiral Kerr on a tour of the ship. Actually, it was more a case of pushing his wheelchair while he mumbled about the good old days. Everyone knows the Admiral should have been put out to pasture years ago - he's certainly not dealing with a full deck. Anyway, he said the strangest thing.

As we were passing communications he suggested we send a progress report to Sol. I tried to explain that Sol was gone, but he was insistent. Then he seemed to clam up, as if he'd said something he shouldn't have. He was silent for the rest of the tour.

I'm not sure whether or not to mention it to Command. Talk of Sol is forbidden you know, but I don't want the old man to get in trouble. At his age who wouldn't be confused?
gs_thelasthumans_003_body:
Warrant Officer Noonan - Personal Log 612/8

The incident with Admiral Kerr really played on my mind, so I decided to do some digging. I shouldn't have done it, I know, but I just couldn't stop thinking about what he said. I used his Command clearance to access the ship's archives. I almost wish I hadn't now. 

We're not the last bastion of humanity. That was a lie. A deception designed to dupe every man, woman and child aboard the ship.

Our mission should have ended generations ago, but when the ship reached its destination the planet was found to be uninhabitable. Most people wanted to turn back, but Command wanted to continue and find a new colonisable planet. There was an uprising, which was violently brought to an end. Afterwards, they put out reports that we were the last members of the human race in an effort to keep us under control. It was all a lie.

I'm not sure what to do with this information. Would anyone believe me if I told them?
gs_thelasthumans_004_body:
Warrant Officer Noonan - Personal Log 625/7

I didn't mean for things to get out of hand, but the people had a right to know the truth. I only told a few people I thought could be trusted - but it spread like wildfire. Within hours, Command was faced with an angry mob threatening mutiny and they responded with overwhelming force.

Over the last few days the ship has been engulfed in conflict. Two factions have emerged - one that wants to return to the core, and one that wants to continue with the mission. 

People are dying and it's all my fault. Why did I tell them? All I can do now is try to stop the killing, before every last person on this ship is wiped out.
gs_theprisoner_001_body:
Detainee #947, Collins, Comms Log Day 1

Hello? Can anyone hear me? There's been a mistake. I'm not supposed to be in here. I only borrowed that data chip. I was going to give it back. Locking me in the brig is completely unnecessary! Where do you think I would go if you let me out? We're in the depths of the black!

Keep it down in there, Collins!

All right, keep your shirt on. I'm sure we can work all this out. If I could just explain myself to the Captain, he'd realise this is all a big misunderstanding.
gs_theprisoner_002_body:
Detainee #947, Collins, Comms Log Day 3

What's happening? I can hear a siren. Can anyone hear me? I've been in here for two days and no one's come to check on me. Can't someone tell me what's going on...please?

Is the ship being evacuated? You can't leave me behind! You have to let me out of here! I'm not even supposed to be in here!
gs_theprisoner_003_body:
Detainee #947, Collins, Comms Log Day 9

Can anyone hear me? Am I just talking to myself?
It's been days. Everything's so quiet. Thank god that siren finally stopped, but now the silence is killing me. Where is everyone?

The automated systems provide me with food and water, and flush away my waste. But for how much longer? Someone will find the ship soon, surely? We can't just drift through the void forever…can we?
gs_theprisoner_004_body:
Detainee #947, Collins,Comms Log Day 1,047

It's whispering to me. I can hear it through the air vents. The void is speaking to me. It wants to tell me something, but I can't make out the words. It must be a way out of this prison. A solution to the puzzle.

I'm innocent. They knew I'd done nothing wrong but they put me in here anyway. It was a test - I know that now. Part of some greater game. I just need to find the answer.

How long have I been here? A week? A year? Maybe only a matter of hours. Isolation does strange things to people. A lesser man might have gone insane, but not me. Not Joe Collins.

Joe...Collins. That is me, isn't it?
gs_thepromisedland_001_body:
Midshipman's Log 54/6:

Our voyage continues apace. All systems fully operational. We had some issues with the hydroponics units, but maintenance has managed to solve that problem. The only other thing to report is the religious fervour that seems to be gripping some sections of crew and passengers. Apparently there's this boy - I think he's around ten or something - and people are heralding him as the second coming. There's a rumour he can perform miracles but it's obviously only a story. Commander Jefferson wasn't too impressed when he heard but I managed to calm him down. Told him it was good for people to have something to believe in... especially on a voyage like this one.
gs_thepromisedland_002_body:
Midshipman's Log 57/9:

This situation is becoming critical. Support for the child - they're just calling him Zachariah - has developed into some sort of mass hysteria. They're hailing him as a kind of messiah. Over half the ship's population now thinks this boy is going to deliver them to the promised land. Jefferson has tried talking to his acolytes but they no longer recognise the commander as the main authority figure on the ship. It wouldn't be so bad but there are whispers of weird ceremonies, and people have started to go missing. I don't know what Jefferson's next move is but he needs to do it quick if we're gonna regain order.
gs_thepromisedland_003_body:
Midshipman's Log 59/6:

We have an emergency situation. Commander Jefferson is... he's dead. They killed him... an offering they called it. He went with a security team to break up one of their gatherings and take Zachariah into custody when they just turned on him. The kid refused to go and ordered the security team to throw Jefferson out of the air lock. I can't believe they did it! It's like he has some kind of power - I've never seen anything like it.

There's only me and a few others who don't follow him now, but it's safer if we just go along with these religious fanatics until they find their promised land and I can ditch them. I don't want to be the next one getting vented!
gs_thepromisedland_004_body:
Midshipman's Log 62/4:

I don't have much time. He's going to kill everyone... and I have to stop him. Turns out Zachariah's 'promised land' isn't a fertile planet. It's the cold vacuum of space!! He intends to open up every airlock on the ship and vent all the corridors and containment units. He just proclaimed it to the entire ship in that little voice of his. Everyone seems to be going along with it - thinking it'll take them to a higher plane or some garbage. Am I the only one here still sane? Because it sure feels like it.

I have to stop him. I got a loaded carbine and I'm not going to let anyone get in my way. I just hope I'm in time.
gs_thepromisedland_005_body:
AUTOMATED SYSTEMS MESSAGE:

SYSTEM REPORT: LIFE SUPPORT COUNTERMAND REQUESTED AT 09:43.

MANUAL OVERRIDE GRANTED ON ALL AIRLOCKS.

FULL SHIP PURGE INITIATED 09:52

gs_twotribes_001_body:
Ship Log - Year 5, day 234

We have a situation. There have been, erm, system failures in navigation, habitat and communications. Life support seems to be working normally, but we only have enough power in bio-systems for a few decades.
We're drifting aimlessly. Assuming we don't reach a habitable planet soon, we'll be out of food in a few years. The Captain has ordered us to keep a lid on this. I mean, we've got 3,000 souls aboard this vessel - the last thing we need is a ship-wide panic.
gs_twotribes_002_body:
Ship Log - Year 187, day 12

The War of the Four Tribes continues. We, the Mechanics, are once again fighting for our survival. The Peacekeepers - curse their name - have become dominant. After they allied with the Colony they destroyed most of us. But if we can form an alliance with the Cultivators we might yet gain control of the food stocks and avert our destruction.
With prayer and zeal we will prevail. We fight for the wrench and the driver. We fight for the Engine.
gs_twotribes_003_body:
Ship Log - Year 369, day 327

Still we fight. Still we quest for victory over the Mechlords. I hear them in the long night, creeping through the vents like ghosts.
From my earliest days, the Elders told me of their rites and their sacrifices. Never venture out alone, my mother said. But still I do. I have to. What would we eat if we didn't forage in the bowels of the beast?
The Mechlords won't catch me - I am too quick and too wily. My brood brothers and sisters think me mad, but I don't care. They're just scared. Too taken with the old tales. Now if I see one of those mechs they'll get full steel to the face, and I'll be off quicker than starlight.
gs_twotribes_004_body:
Ship Log - Year 537, day 45

Tonight we feast. The flesh of the vanquished will be our banquet. Few remain, but those who do stand victorious. Unbroken within this tomb...this eternal prison.
The Sayers will tell our legend for generations. They will tell of the Last Eaters, of how we rose from the depths of the Engine. How we claimed our throne. But tonight they will feast alongside us. And we will sing forever in the dark with a curtain of light ahead, heralding the journey to come.
gs_wolfinsheepsclothing_001_body:
Ship Security Log:

I thought this would be a new start, I thought coming out here things would be different.

But now after this I see that nothing has changed. People lie and other people just pay the cost.

It seems like someone smuggled an illegal animal on board. A dog. They had been keeping it in one of the storage pods, stealing food for it from one of the kitchens. But it looks like that wasn't enough.

By what we can piece together the dog got out somehow and killed a bunch of people. I mean a real mess. Bite and claw marks all over the bodies. Bite marks on the walls, on the doors, even on the airlocks.

The only thing is, it was found exactly where they had been keeping it all along, and I mean there wasn't a drop of blood on this thing. If you ask me, this dog didn't seem like the killing type. That didn't stop them from destroying it. I asked the captain to keep the case open, to let me investigate, but no dice. He just saw it as open and shut.

I can't shake the feeling that there's something we're missing here.
gs_wolfinsheepsclothing_002_body:
Unregistered Log 062:

What sheep they are, these fools of man. How they prance and bleat, knowing nothing of the true nature of things. Blind sheep following blind shepherds. I have been sent as a wolf amongst this flock to teach them the meaning of their existence. They are nothing, sacks of flesh flung out into the cosmos to spread their seed, uncaring children ejected from an uncaring womb. Spreading like a disease, infecting all they touch. So soon all will bleat as they do. They take only the choicest this flock, cast down those that will not follow their sightless herders to nothing. They prey on the weak for their own gains while they preach about unity and togetherness. They shall be snatched, they shall be scattered, they shall be ravaged.
gs_wolfinsheepsclothing_003_body:
Ship Security Log:

Everybody on board knows the stories. I remember my dad and grandfather telling me about the wolf; that if we were bad the wolf would get us. I figured it was just a scary story they tell kids to make them behave... a superstition. That was until I saw the files.

This has been going on for generations, each time the same. The bodies are found ripped apart by some kind of animal, but there hasn't been an animal on board for decades. The evidence leads us nowhere, claw marks, bite marks on their necks. Every time a full search of the ship is conducted and nothing. Just some scratch marks on the walls and airlocks. Wait... airlocks?

What if it's not in the ship? What if it's on the ship? What if it's out there?
gs_wolfinsheepsclothing_004_body:
Unregistered Log 291:

The shepherds hunt but see nothing. They scuttle and scurry and gather their precious flocks to them. But they cannot protect them.

I have opened so many eyes to the ways of things and still they do not see. I have opened them up to new ways, to see what's inside. But they refuse to heed the lesson. What arrogance they show, as if this was all made for them. What gives this virus that is mankind the right to infect the cosmos?
gs_wolfinsheepsclothing_005_body:
Unregistered Log 412:

The sheep lay out their sacrifices. They think that will sate the wolf's hunger. They do not see the wolf hunts not for hunger. They are blinded by the lies they tell themselves, the lies that tie the fabric of their tiny little world together. But the cord frays and will snap. The lesson must be repeated... 

...until the baying falls silent.

gunsightsystem_description:
For projectile weapons that require leading the target, this sets how to handle the targeting assistance:

$GunsightSystem_Traditional; will provide an aiming point ahead of the target to aim at for an accurate shot.

$GunsightSystem_Trailing; will move the gunsight itself to take lead into account, so placing it on the target will result in an accurate shot.
haematite_info:
Produced by: Extraction
Consumed by: Industrial and Refinery

Haematite: Ferric Oxide, Fe2O3. Iron ore. A dark red or grey  mineral used in creating jewellery, and refined to produce Steel.
haematite_info_short: Produced by: Extraction Consumed by: Industrial and Refinery Haematite: Ferric Oxide, Fe2O3.
hafnium178_info: Hafnium 178m2-Hf, atomic number 72. This nuclear isomer has the potential to unleash enormous quantities of gamma radiation, making it an excellent ingredient for use in devastating weapons of mass destruction. As a result Hafnium 178 is a highly controlled substance that is universally illegal to own without special dispensation.
hafnium178_info_short: Hafnium 178m2-Hf, atomic number 72. This nuclear isomer has the potential for use in devastating weapons of mass destruction.
haidneblackbrew_info:
Brewed over a low heat for days, this tea is comprised of fine mineral shavings, rather than traditional leaves. This mineral based tea is high in salts and nutritious metals. Over consumption of this has been known to temporarily cause the drinker's skin to take a metallic hue.

This rare good is legal in all markets.
haidneblackbrew_info_short: This tea is comprised of fine mineral shavings, rather than traditional leaves. Temporarily cause the drinker's skin to take a metallic hue.
handweaponry_info: Personal firearms of every conceivable nature are available for trade, from the clinically efficient to the creatively bizarre. Depending on the system, trade in hand weaponry may be restricted or outlawed completely.
handweaponry_info_short: Personal firearms of every conceivable nature are available for trade. Trade in hand weaponry may be restricted or outlawed completely.
harmasilversearum_info:
Based on a secret 24th Century recipe taken from the log of one Captain Smolenski, Harma Silver Sea Rum has been developed by blending a range of rare alcohols to create a beverage any corsair would be proud of. The Harma Silver Cartel, who manufacture and distribute the potent brew, enjoy the controversy their product has gleaned after it became a favourite among pirate gangs across the galaxy.

This rare good is legal in all markets except for Prison Colony markets and Federal and Allied Theocracy markets.

Please note that if a market’s controlling faction changes, some formerly legal rare goods may become illegal. Should this occur the rare good will be unavailable for sale or purchase at that market for the duration of the prohibiting faction’s tenure.
harmasilversearum_info_short: Based on a secret 24th Century recipe taken from the log of one Captain Smolenski, Harma Silver Sea Rum has been developed by blending a range of rare alcohols to create a beverage any corsair would be proud of.
hauler_armour_grade1_info: Hull reinforcement that provides standard protection against all types of attack.
hauler_armour_grade2_info: Hull reinforcement using an advanced structure and higher quality compounds, offering improved protection against all types of attack.
hauler_armour_grade3_info: Hull reinforcement using an advanced structure and military-grade compounds, offering superior protection against all types of attack.
hauler_armour_mirrored_info: Hull reinforcement using a specially formulated structure, offering superior protection against thermal damage caused by energy weapons. It is vulnerable to projectile weapons and other kinetic attacks.
hauler_armour_reactive_info: Hull reinforcement using a dynamically reactive, impact-resistant material offering superior protection against projectile weapons and other kinetic attacks. It is vulnerable to thermal damage caused by energy weapons.
hauler_cockpit_info: Transparent protective canopy on a ship's cockpit that shields pilots from the many dangers of space travel.
hauler_info:
The galaxy is full of successful traders who started their career with a Hauler. The ship's comparatively low cost and significant carrying capacity have made it the most popular small cargo ship in human space. The Hauler is highly specialised, however, and consumers are advised that it is unsuited to activities other than trade.

The Hauler has been designed for small-size landing pads.
havasupaidreamcatcher_info:
Re-live your dreams! This device can record, consolidate and replay the neural activity of dreams, allowing you to re-experience them whenever you desire, or even share your dreams with friends!

This rare good is legal in all markets.
havasupaidreamcatcher_info_short: This device can record, consolidate and replay the neural activity of dreams.
hazardousenvironmentsuits_info:
Produced by: High Tech
Consumed by: Industrial, Refinery, Extraction and Military

Suitable for human use in hostile environments including vacuum, together with spare parts. Fitted with atmospheric scrubbing and life support, vital signs monitoring, automatic medical systems and a multichannel communications interface.
hazardousenvironmentsuits_info_short: Produced by: High Tech Consumed by: Industrial, Refinery, Extraction and Military Suitable for human use in hostile environments including vacuum, together with spare parts.
headlookdefault_description: Sets headlook to be on by default. You can still disable it with $HeadlookToggle;.
headlookincrement_description: Set what increments the headlook angle is changed by when using keys. $HeadlookIncrement_Continuous; will emulate an analogue scale.
headlookmode_description:
Sets how to handle head movement with an Axis:

$HeadlookMode_Accumulate; will move the head in the direction and speed based on the input but will remain fixed in that direction once input is stopped.

$HeadlookMode_Direct; maps the input to the direction with a neutral input representing straight ahead and full input resulting in a fully rotated view in the direction the input corresponds to.
headlookmotionsensitivity_description: Adjusts how sensitive motion headlook is to changes in the motion sensor function.
headlookpitchaxisraw_description: Analogue input for looking in the vertical axis within the cockpit.
headlookpitchdown_description: Digital input for looking down within the cockpit.
headlookpitchup_description: Digital input for looking up within the cockpit.
headlookreset_description: Reset the current view to the centre and forward (only applicable with $HeadlookMode_Accumulate; enabled).
headlookresetontoggle_description: Centres the headlook orientation when the headlook controls are toggled off.
headlookrollaxis_description: Analogue input for tilting the view axis within the cockpit.
headlookrollleft_description: Digital input for tilting the view left within the cockpit.
headlookrollright_description: Digital input for tilting the view right within the cockpit.
headlooksensitivity_description: Adjusts the sensitivity of the headlook while using $HeadlookMode_Accumulate;.
headlooktoggle_buggy_description: Enables the ability to look around and out of the cockpit via the dedicated inputs (below).
headlooktoggle_description: Enables the ability to look around and out of the cockpit via the dedicated inputs (below).
headlooktranslateaxis_description: Analogue input for moving the view forward or backward within the cockpit.
headlooktranslatebackward_description: Digital input for moving the view backward within the cockpit.
headlooktranslatedownward_description: Digital input for moving the view downward within the cockpit.
headlooktranslateforward_description: Digital input for moving the view forwards within the cockpit.
headlooktranslatelateralaxis_description: Analogue input for moving the view left or right within the cockpit.
headlooktranslateleft_description: Digital input for moving the view left within the cockpit.
headlooktranslateright_description: Digital input for moving the view right within the cockpit.
headlooktranslateupward_description: Digital input for moving the view upward within the cockpit.
headlooktranslateverticalaxis_descriptio: Analogue input for moving the view upward or downward within the cockpit.
headlookyawaxis_description: Analogue input for looking in the horizontal axis within the cockpit.
headlookyawleft_description: Digital input for looking left within the cockpit.
headlookyawright_description: Digital input for looking right within the cockpit.
headlookzoomaxis_description: Analogue input for zooming the view in or out within the cockpit.
headlookzoomin_description: Digital input for zooming the view in within the cockpit.
headlookzoomout_description: Digital input for zooming the view out within the cockpit.
healthmonitor_info: A personal device designed to monitor the user's general health.
healthpack_info: A portable medical kit used to treat wounds.
heatconductionwiring_info:
Component found in ships: frequently used by haulage vessels. Destroyed haulage vessels can be scavenged from the aftermath of combat in shipping lanes. Known to be salvaged from signal sources.

Heat conduction wiring is used to transfer heat through a material.
heatconductionwiring_info_short: Component found in ships: frequently used by haulage vessels. Destroyed haulage vessels can be scavenged from the aftermath of combat in shipping lanes. Known to be salvaged from signal sources.
heatdispersionplate_info:
Component found in ships: frequently used by haulage vessels. Destroyed haulage vessels can be scavenged from the aftermath of combat in shipping lanes. Known to be salvaged from signal sources.

Heat dispersion plates use their surface area to disperse heat into the environment.
heatdispersionplate_info_short: Component found in ships: frequently used by haulage vessels. Destroyed haulage vessels can be scavenged from the aftermath of combat in shipping lanes. Known to be salvaged from signal sources.
heatexchangers_info:
Component found in ships: frequently used by haulage vessels. Destroyed haulage vessels can be scavenged from the aftermath of combat in shipping lanes. Known to be salvaged from signal sources in anarchy systems.

Heat exchangers transfer heat between separate systems.
heatexchangers_info_short: Component found in ships: frequently used by haulage vessels. Destroyed haulage vessels can be scavenged from the aftermath of combat in shipping lanes. Known to be salvaged from signal sources in anarchy systems.
heatresistantceramics_info:
Component found in ships: frequently used by military and authority vessels.

Known to be salvaged from signal sources in anarchy systems. Heat resistant ceramics provide enhanced protection against thermal sources.
heatresistantceramics_info_short: Component found in ships: frequently used by military and authority vessels. Known to be salvaged from signal sources in anarchy systems.
heatsinkinterlink_info:
Produced by: Gresley Enterprise, LHS 3980
Consumed by: High Tech

These specially made heatsink interlinks provide the mechanism for the emissive cooling plates within a heatsink.
heatsinkinterlink_info_short: Produced by: Gresley Enterprise, LHS 3980 Consumed by: High Tech These specially made heatsink interlinks provide the mechanism for the emissive cooling plates within a heatsink.
heatvanes_info:
Component found in ships: frequently used by haulage vessels. Destroyed haulage vessels can be scavenged from the aftermath of combat in shipping lanes. Known to be salvaged from signal sources in anarchy systems.

Heat vanes use a series of fins for a greater surface area to disperse heat.
heatvanes_info_short: Component found in ships: frequently used by haulage vessels. Destroyed haulage vessels can be scavenged from the aftermath of combat in shipping lanes. Known to be salvaged from signal sources in anarchy systems.
heavyindustrialshieldgenerator_info: Engineered shield generators, increasing the shield strength but also increasing the time to regenerate shields.
heist_megaship_chatter_001: They're trying to steal our cargo. Take them out!
heist_megaship_chatter_003: Kill those pirates before they can get away with our cargo!
heist_megaship_chatter_004: Make sure they don't get away!
heliostaticfurnaces_info:
Produced by: High Tech
Consumed by: Refinery

Bio-engineered microbes that separate specific elements from a powdered ore. Produced on High Tech worlds, their name is historic having replaced thermal furnaces for the refining of many ores.
heliostaticfurnaces_info_short: Produced by: High Tech Consumed by: Refinery Bio-engineered microbes that separate specific elements from a powdered ore.
helium3_info:
Produced by: Surface Mining only
Consumed by: Industrial

Chemical formula He-3. Helium-3 is a light, stable isotope of helium and was the focus of 22nd century mining across the Earth's Moon lunar surface. Once commonly found as a result of tritium decay, it is now a sought after natural element since the demand for tritium as fleet carrier fuel has increased.
helium3_info_short: Produced by: Surface Mining only Consumed by: Industrial Helium-3 is a light, stable isotope of helium.
helium_info:
Produced by: Surface Mining only
Consumed by: Industrial, Military and High Tech

Chemical formula He. Helium is a colorless, odorless, non-toxic, inert gas. Mostly used in the manufacturing of superconductors. Liquid helium was used widely in early suspended animation experiments with little success.
helium_info_short: Produced by: Surface Mining only Consumed by: Industrial, Military and High Tech Helium is an inert gas Mostly used in the manufacturing of superconductors.
help_slide1_label1: Faulcon deLacy thanks you for choosing <font color='#ffffff'>Sidewinder Classic Navy Edition</font>.
help_slide1_label2: Use <font color='#ff4e11'>Pitch, Roll, Yaw, Vertical thrust and Lateral thrust axes</font> to manoeuvre vessel.
help_slide1_label3: Use <font color='#ff4e11'>Throttle axis</font> to set desired speed. Drives will accelerate and decelerate to match desired speed.
help_slide1_label4: Optimum manoeuvre capability is achieved at 50% of current maximum speed.
help_slide1_label5: Use <font color='#ff4e11'>Engine boost</font> to engage emergency thrust.
help_slide1_label6: Use <font color='#ff4e11'>Toggle flight assist</font> to enable/disable automatic flight.
help_slide1_label7: ATTENTION! If <font color='#ff4e11'>Flight assist</font> is disabled, no automatic counterthrust is available, Throttle is set to apply momentary thrust.
help_slide2_label1: <font color='#ffffff'>Sidewinder Classic Navy Edition</font> features an elegantly functional interface. Make real-time decisions with confidence.
help_slide2_label2: Hold <font color='#ff4e11'>UI focus</font> and use <font color='#ff4e11'>Left/Right</font> to view side panels.
help_slide2_label3: Use <font color='#ff4e11'>Select</font> to activate highlight cursor on side panel.
help_slide2_label4: Use <font color='#ff4e11'>Left/Right/Up/Down</font> to manipulate highlight cursor on side panel.
help_slide2_label5: Tap <font color='#ff4e11'>UI focus</font> to return to main view.
help_slide2_label6: Warning! Please read this operations manual before attempting spaceflight. Incorrect operation of <font color='#ffffff'>Sidewinder Classic Navy Edition</font> may result in damage to the vessel/death.
help_slide3_label1: <font color='#ffffff'>Sidewinder Classic Navy Edition</font> comes with a high grade shield generator fitted as standard.
help_slide3_label2: When absorbing incoming attacks, shield regeneration will temporarily cease. This is normal behaviour as regeneration will resume after a short delay once attacks have ended.
help_slide3_label3: ATTENTION! To prevent feedback damage to the shield generator, shield emission will cease if emission integrity is reduced to zero per cent. Shield emission will resume once integrity is restored to 50%.
help_slide3_label4: ATTENTION! To prevent feedback damage to the shield generator, shield emission will cease in the event of ship overheating. Shield emission will resume once normal ship operating temperature has been restored.
help_slide3_label5: Warning! In the eventuality of shield emission cessation, please take precautions to avoid permanent damage to ship structure and systems.
help_slide4_label1: <font color='#ffffff'>Sidewinder Classic Navy Edition</font> has integrated power distributor functions.
help_slide4_label2: Use <font color='#ff4e11'>DIVERT POWER TO WEAPONS</font> to increase WEAPONS COOLING capability.
help_slide4_label3: ATTENTION! Weapons may become inoperable if WEAPONS COOLING system is overloaded.
help_slide4_label4: Use <font color='#ff4e11'>DIVERT POWER TO SYSTEMS</font> to increase SYSTEMS CAPACITOR charge rate.
help_slide4_label5: ATTENTION! Shields and utility systems may not be able to activate/replenish if SYSTEMS CAPACITOR charge is too low.
help_slide4_label6: Use <font color='#ff4e11'>DIVERT POWER TO ENGINES</font> to increase maximum speed and charge EMERGENCY THRUST CAPACITOR.
help_slide4_label7: ATTENTION! Emergency thrust may not be able to activate if EMERGENCY THRUST CAPACITOR charge is too low.
help_slide4_label8: Use <font color='#ff4e11'>BALANCE POWER DISTRIBUTION</font> to restore power distribution to factory default ratios.
help_slide5_label1: <font color='#ffffff'>Sidewinder Classic Navy Edition</font> incorporates deployable hardpoints and integrated twin-fire control.
help_slide5_label2: Use <font color='#ff4e11'>Deploy hardpoints</font> to deploy/retract selected fire group hardpoints.
help_slide5_label3: Use <font color='#ff4e11'>Primary fire</font> and <font color='#ff4e11'>Secondary fire</font> to activate selected fire group systems.
help_slide5_label4: To customise fire groups, cycle <font color='#ff4e11'>Primary/Secondary/Off</font> switch for modules in the Fire group system menu.
help_slide5_label5: Use <font color='#ff4e11'>Cycle next fire group</font> to cycle through available fire groups.
help_slide5_label6: ATTENTION! In order to maintain combat efficiency, Faulcon deLacy does not recommend simultaneously deploying different targeting systems.
help_slide6_label1: <font color='#ffffff'>Sidewinder Classic Navy Edition's</font> sensor system is capable of resolving contacts and performing subsystem scans as standard*.
help_slide6_label2: Flickering <font color='#ff4e11'>Signature</font> indicates potential pattern match; manoeuvre closer to resolve contact.
help_slide6_label3: Use <font color='#ff4e11'>Select target ahead</font> function to <font color='#ff4e11'>Lock contact</font> and calibrate ballistics assist computer.
help_slide6_label4: Face <font color='#ff4e11'>Locked contact</font> to initiate subsystem scan.
help_slide6_label5: ATTENTION! Facing away from contact during subsystem scan may cause failure to complete.
help_slide6_label6: Warning! * Faulcon deLacy does not guarantee subsystem scan capabilities initiated against protected systems.
help_slide7_label1: <font color='#ffffff'>Sidewinder Classic Navy Edition</font> features advanced module management functions.
help_slide7_label2: You can power up/down individual modules from the Modules system menu.
help_slide7_label3: Powered up modules increase power plant Draw and Heat.
help_slide7_label4: Highlight and use <font color='#ff4e11'>Select</font> to turn on/off.
help_slide7_label5: ATTENTION! Excessive heat will increase your vessel's signature, increasing your visibility to enemy sensors.
help_slide7_label6: In the event of power loss, modules are automatically shut down based on priority. Use the left and right buttons on a selected module to increase/decrease priority.
help_slide8_label11: Divert System/Engines (U)/Weapons (R)/ Reset (D) and UI U, D, L, R.
helvetitjpearls_info:
Oysters have been one of the more successful adaptors to other worlds with their rapid genetic modification. Due to the chemicals in the water, the oysters of Helvetitj produce a range of vividly coloured but natural pearls which are in high in demand for decorative purposes, but are valued as a food source as well.

This rare good is legal in all markets.
helvetitjpearls_info_short: Due to the chemicals in the water, the oysters of Helvetitj produce a range of vividly coloured but natural pearls which are in high in demand for foods and decorative purposes.
higen_destructible_barrela_info: A pressurised canister containing combustible materials.
highdensitycomposites_info:
Component found in ships: frequently used by military and authority vessels. Known to be salvaged from signal sources in low security systems.

High density composites pack the materials into extremely dense layers for added protection.
highdensitycomposites_info_short: Component found in ships: frequently used by military and authority vessels. Known to be salvaged from signal sources in low security systems.
highperformancefuels_info: Formulated over a millennium of development, this high performance fuel meets the evolving needs of users everywhere, in every industry.
highperformancefuels_info_short: Formulated over a millennium of development, this high performance fuel meets the evolving needs of users everywhere, in every industry.
hip10175bushmeat_info:
A wide range of strong-tasting exotic meats native to HIP 10175, famed for its hunting and natural environment. One commonality between all the available species is a strange spicy flavour. This is believed to be due to the rich local ecosystem. Restricted trade has brought high prices.

This rare good is legal in all markets.
hip10175bushmeat_info_short: A wide range of strong-tasting exotic meats native to HIP 10175. Has a strange spicy flavour.
hip118311swarm_info:
Swarm is the codename of the weaponised form of the tiny but lethally poisonous biting insects native to HIP 118311. Manipulated by a control field, the weapons can be targeted onto enemy positions using a remote electromagnetic beam, then unleashed to wreak chaos and death on enemy ranks. The weapon's trademark buzzing quickly made it a favourite with crime syndicates, favoured for intimidation and enforcement purposes. Banned in most jurisdictions.

This rare good is legal in all Imperial, Independent and Allied Dictatorship markets; Independent Feudal markets; and Imperial Confederacy markets. It is prohibited in all other markets.

Please note that if a market’s controlling faction changes, some formerly legal rare goods may become illegal. Should this occur the rare good will be unavailable for sale or purchase at that market for the duration of the prohibiting faction’s tenure.
hip118311swarm_info_short: Swarm is the codename of the weaponised form of the tiny but lethally poisonous biting insects native to HIP 118311.
hip41181squid_info:
Though there is no genetic link between the huge creatures of HIP 41181 and the now-extinct squid once found on ancient Earth, the evolutionary similarities are remarkable. Perhaps they share some ancient space-faring ancestor. There was much protesting at the use of these animals as food. Claims of sentience still remain high on the agenda for those trying to stamp out the trade.

This rare good is legal in all markets.
hip41181squid_info_short: Though there is no genetic link between the huge creatures of HIP 41181 and the now-extinct squid once found on ancient Earth, the evolutionary similarities are remarkable.
hiporganophosphates_info:
The high phosphorous content of this powerful pesticide is highly effective, but can cause a number of highly dangerous side effects. This has led to some governments classifying it as a chemical weapon, and many independent agricultural worlds taking legal action against the producer after cattle and workers have been left maimed.

This rare good is legal in all markets except for Independent and Allied Cooperative markets and Independent Communist markets.

Please note that if a market’s controlling faction changes, some formerly legal rare goods may become illegal. Should this occur the rare good will be unavailable for sale or purchase at that market for the duration of the prohibiting faction’s tenure.
hiporganophosphates_info_short: The high phosphorous content of this powerful pesticide is highly effective, but can cause a number of highly dangerous side effects.
hitman_hunterhostilesc_relevant02: Contract details confirmed. I have the ship on my scanner.
hitman_hunterhostilesc_relevant03: Found the ship, tracking it now. It's not getting away.

hitman_hunterhostilesc_relevant05: The eagle is in the nest, repeat, the eagle is in the nest.
hitmanmissionfailure_arrival01: Commander, there's a contract on your head.
hitmanmissionfailure_arrival02: I guess you backed out on one contract too many, Commander, because now you are the contract.
hitmanmissionfailure_arrival03: Commander, I'll be brief. You screwed up a contract, I'm here to boil you for it.
hitmanmissionfailure_arrival04: Nothing personal, Commander, there's a contract on your head for failing to complete work for some important people.
hitmanmissionfailure_arrival05: Commander, you know that path you took, screwing up a contract? Guess what, I'm at the end of it.
hitmanmissionfailure_attack01: I intend to collect that contract on your head, Commander. Prepare to die!
hitmanmissionfailure_attack02: Your previous employers have a message... goodbye, Commander.
hitmanmissionfailure_attack03: Important people don't like to be messed around, time to pay the price for incompetence, Commander.
hitmanmissionfailure_attack04: I specialise in taking out people like you, Commander. Those who take a contract and fail to complete it. I assure you, I complete my contracts.
hitmanmissionfailure_attack05: Business is all about respect, Commander. You crossed the wrong people, and now you must pay the price.
hitmanmissionfailure_flee03: They're not paying me enough for this!
hitmanmissionfailure_flee05: You can't kill the killer! Muwahahahah!
hitmanmissionfailure_neardeath01: This isn't right, I'm supposed to be the predator, not the prey.
hitmanmissionfailure_neardeath04: You can't kill the contract killer! That's not right!
hitmanmissionfailure_neardeath05: I should have listened when Mom told me contract killing was a dangerous business.
hitmanmissionfailure_neardeath06: I think we have our roles the wrong way round.
hitmanmissionfailure_neardeath07: I would be grateful if you didn't mention this to anyone.
hitmanmissionfailure_neardeath08: This is the end for me.
hitmanmissionfailure_neardeath09: This isn't the last you will see of me.
hitmanmissionfailure_neardeath10: Enjoy the taste of victory while you can. I will return.
hitmanmissionfailure_onenemydetect01: Don't worry, I'll make this quick, I do this for a living.
hitmanmissionfailure_onenemydetect03: Don't be sad. Your failure is my payday.
hitmanmissionfailure_onscandetect01: What are you looking for, mercy? Sorry, I'm all out.
hitmanmissionfailure_onscandetect02: Gaze upon the method of your destruction.
hitmanmissionfailure_onscandetect04: I don't deal in cargo, I deal in death.
hitmanmissionfailure_onscandetect05: If you're looking for mercy, you're out of luck - I'm a professional.

The sect was soon infiltrated by corporate agents, and the psychoactive compound identified. hostagetaker_civilian_01: Don't come any closer or we'll start killing these hostages!

hpt_antiunknownshutdown_tiny_info:
The Shutdown Field Neutraliser creates interference on the frequency used by Thargoid shutdown fields, almost fully negating the incapacitation effect on human vessels. The interference must be maintained for the duration of the Thargoid shutdown field, quickly draining SYS energy from power distributors. Once power has been depleted the module will require a period of recharge before further use.

This module does not offer protection against the massive energy surges found in Thargoid Maelstroms.
hpt_antiunknownshutdown_tiny_longinfo:
The Shutdown Field Neutraliser creates interference on the frequency used by Thargoid shutdown fields, almost fully negating the incapacitation effect on human vessels. The interference must be maintained for the duration of the Thargoid shutdown field, quickly draining SYS energy from power distributors. Once power has been depleted the module will require a period of recharge before further use.

This module does not offer protection against the massive energy surges found in Thargoid Maelstroms.
hpt_antiunknownshutdown_tiny_v2_info: Counteracts Thargoid shutdown technology when used within proximity.
hpt_antiunknownshutdown_tiny_v2_longinfo:
The Thargoid Pulse Neutraliser creates adaptive interference on frequencies used by Thargoid shutdown fields, preventing the incapacitation of human vessels. This specific module's primary function is to protect ships from the massive energy surges found in Thargoid Maelstroms.

This protection must be activated for the duration of the Thargoid shutdown field, quickly draining SYS energy from power distributors. Once power has been depleted the module will require a period of recharge before further use.

While the Thargoid Pulse Neutraliser offers the same protections as the Shutdown Field Neutraliser, its increased mass and power-draw make it less efficient for most anti-xeno assignments. It is recommended that the module is outfitted on ships prior to approaching a Thargoid Titan.

hpt_cannon_gimbal_medium_burst_info: A cannon variant that sacrifices damage per shot to achieve a more effective three-round burst.
hpt_cannon_gimbal_medium_burst_longinfo: This cannon variant fires a burst of three shots instead of one. These individual shots offer less damage than a standard round, but hitting with the full burst is more effective.

hpt_causticmissile_fixed_medium_info: Missile rack with warheads that inflict corrosion damage to ship hulls.
hpt_causticmissile_fixed_medium_longinfo: Enzyme missiles replicate Thargoid organic hull corrosion weaponry. While lacking the potency of the alien version, the enzyme applies caustic damage to all types of human hull armour at the point of contact. The missiles must impact directly against the target's hull; they are unable to penetrate active shields. The enzyme is ineffective on alien hulls, being neutralised by even long-dead Thargoid ships.
hpt_causticsinklauncher_turret_tiny_info: Module that utilises a form of cathodic protection to temporarily protect a ship's hull from corrosion. Corroded material is diverted to an insulated container which can be ejected.
hpt_chafflauncher_tiny_info: Defence system to counteract signature tracking, causing gimbal- and turret-mounted weapons to lose target lock. Requires ammunition.
hpt_cloudscanner_size0_class1_info: Scanner that can calculate the destination of a hyperspace jump by analysis of frame shift energy wake.
hpt_crimescanner_size0_class1_info: Scanner that incorporates real-time communication with multiple law enforcement networks to confirm outstanding bounties.
hpt_crimescanner_size0_class1_longinfo: Kill warrant scanners reveal any known bounties a ship may have, including those from outside the current jurisdiction. They are particularly useful when bounty hunting in anarchy systems, where supposedly clean pilots may have outstanding bounties in civil systems. Attacking a ship that is clean in the current star system will be seen as a crime by local authorities, even if the target has bounties elsewhere. Kill warrant scan results do not persist after supercruise and hyperspace transitions.
hpt_datalinkscanner_info:
First manufactured by Jick Nackson Enterprises, this scanner was installed as a communication and survey device available as standard on all "Scarab" surface reconnaissance vehicles and is predominantly used to scan mineral deposits and receive data from uplinks and other devices.

JNE has recently signed a contract with all leading ship manufacturers to outfit the latest version of the data link scanner to all ship types. This has been seen as a major coup for the fledgling technology company.
hpt_drunkmissilerack_fixed_medium_info: Missile launcher that fires a salvo of homing micro-missiles, which swarm towards a target.
hpt_drunkmissilerack_fixed_medium_longin: Pack-hound missile racks fire multiple homing micro-missiles that swarm and attack the target from all directions, making them difficult to defend against. Individual micro-missiles are significantly weaker than a standard missile, but a full salvo striking a target will inflict greater total damage.
hpt_dumbfiremissilerack_fixed_large_info: Missile battery that launches dumbfire missiles.
hpt_dumbfiremissilerack_fixed_medium_adv: Fixed-mount variant of the standard missile rack which launches dumbfire missiles. This hybrid of human-Guardian technology is designed to fire synthesised anti-xeno ordinance when needed, making it an effective choice against both human and alien vessels.
hpt_dumbfiremissilerack_fixed_medium_inf: Missile battery that launches dumbfire missiles.
hpt_dumbfiremissilerack_fixed_medium_las: Launches sophisticated dumbfire rockets that reboot a target ship's frame shift drive upon impact, preventing it from escaping. Standard damage output is reduced, however.
Launches sophisticated dumbfire rockets that reboot a target ship's frame shift drive upon impact, preventing it from escaping. Standard damage output is reduced, however.
hpt_dumbfiremissilerack_fixed_small_adva: Fixed-mount variant of the standard missile rack which launches dumbfire missiles. This hybrid of human-Guardian technology is designed to fire synthesised anti-xeno ordinance when needed, making it an effective choice against both human and alien vessels.
hpt_dumbfiremissilerack_fixed_small_info: Missile battery that launches dumbfire missiles.
hpt_electroniccountermeasure_tiny_info: Defence system to counteract missiles and torpedoes, causing affected weapons to lose target lock.

hpt_flakmortar_turret_medium_info:
Projectile weapon that fires remotely detonated flak rounds, designed for use against Thargon swarms.

hpt_flechettelauncher_fixed_medium_info: Projectile weapon that fires remotely detonated flechette rounds. Holding down the launch trigger will delay flechette detonation until required.
hpt_flechettelauncher_fixed_medium_longi: This weapon fires flechette rounds that produce thousands of tiny, ultra-sharp metal fragments. These are capable of penetrating shields and dealing the majority of their damage directly to a ship's modules. Holding down the launch trigger will delay flechette detonation until trigger release or upon reaching maximum range.
hpt_flechettelauncher_turret_medium_info: Projectile weapon that fires remotely detonated flechette rounds. Holding down the launch trigger will delay flechette detonation until required. The turret-mounted version can be controlled by an active Gunner.
hpt_guardian_gausscannon_fixed_medium_in: High-power energy projectile weapon on a fixed mount. Based on Guardian technology.
hpt_guardian_gausscannon_fixed_medium_lo: Gauss cannons fire high-energy projectiles across large distances. Holding down the weapon trigger charges the cannon, which will fire when the charge is complete but fail if the trigger is released early. A hybrid of human-Guardian technology, this weapon is effective against both human and alien vessels.
hpt_guardian_plasmalauncher_fixed_medium:
High-power energy burst weapon on a fixed mount based on Guardian technology.
- Trigger controlled functionality.

Plasma chargers allow a more controlled release of energy than standard plasma accelerators, allowing users to regulate its destructive power. Holding down the weapon trigger charges the weapon; releasing will launch the plasma. Damage dealt is determined by the length of time the weapon is charged. A hybrid of human-Guardian technology, this weapon is effective against both human and alien vessels.
hpt_guardian_plasmalauncher_turret_mediu: High-power energy burst weapon on a turret mount based on Guardian technology. The turret-mounted version can be controlled by an active Gunner.

hpt_guardian_shardcannon_fixed_medium_in: Short-range projectile weapon on a fixed mount based on Guardian technology.
hpt_guardian_shardcannon_fixed_medium_lo: Shard cannons utilising an incredibly hard material discovered at ancient Guardian sites. The weapon fires thin shards of this material with a conical spread designed for short-range engagements. A hybrid of human-Guardian technology, this weapon is effective against both human and alien vessels.
hpt_guardian_shardcannon_turret_medium_i: Short-range projectile weapon on a turret mount. Based on Guardian technology.
hpt_guardiangauss_fixed_gdn_fighter_info: Focused energy weapon on a fixed mount. Based on Guardian technology.
hpt_guardianplasma_fixed_gdn_fighter_inf: Rapid-fire plasma weapon on a fixed mount. Based on Guardian technology.
hpt_guardianshard_fixed_gdn_fighter_info: Short-range projectile weapon on a fixed mount. Based on Guardian technology.
hpt_heatsinklauncher_turret_tiny_doublec: A modified heatsink launcher that offers a higher ammo capacity, though reload time is also increased slightly.
hpt_heatsinklauncher_turret_tiny_info: Module that transfers thermal energy into a disposable heat sink and ejects it, immediately reducing a ship's temperature.
hpt_human_extraction_fixed_medium_info:
Repurposed mining tool used to extract Thargoid pods from under the surface of Titans.
- Trigger controlled functionality.
- Functions in analysis mode.
hpt_human_extraction_fixed_medium_longin:
These armaments, essentially a redesign of the displacement missile used by mining vessels, are capable of drilling into weak points detected on a Titan before detonating a controlled charge to expose storage chambers housing Thargoid pods. The sudden depressurisation forces a number of these pods to eject into space. 

The missile will fly straight until it hits the Titan, then drill down at the point of impact. Holding down the trigger will delay detonation until required. The explosion will result in ejected Thargoid pods if timed correctly.
hpt_minelauncher_fixed_medium_info: Module that deploys proximity-triggered explosive charges.
hpt_minelauncher_fixed_small_impulse_inf: Launches mines that detonate with enough concussive force to shove nearby vessels off-course. While effective in disorienting ships these mines inflict less direct damage.
hpt_minelauncher_fixed_small_impulse_lon: Launches mines that detonate with enough concussive force to shove nearby vessels off-course. While effective in disorienting ships these mines inflict less direct damage.
hpt_minelauncher_fixed_small_info: Module that deploys proximity-triggered explosive charges.
hpt_mining_abrblstr_fixed_small_info:
Mining tool used to extract surface deposits from asteroid surfaces.
- Functions in analysis mode.
hpt_mining_abrblstr_fixed_small_longinfo: Abrasion blasters remove surface deposits from asteroids. In contrast to the thermal power applied by mining lasers, abrasion blasters fire a finely modulated pulse of energy. A refinery module is required to process asteroid chunks into saleable commodities. Ship must be in analysis mode to operate an abrasion blaster.
hpt_mining_abrblstr_turret_small_info:
Mining tool used to extract surface deposits from asteroid surfaces, when used with a Refinery module.
- Functions in analysis mode.
hpt_mining_abrblstr_turret_small_longinf: Abrasion blasters remove surface deposits from asteroids. In contrast to the thermal power applied by mining lasers, abrasion blasters fire a finely modulated pulse of energy. A refinery module is required to process asteroid chunks into saleable commodities. Ship must be in analysis mode to operate an abrasion blaster. The turret-mounted version can be controlled by an active Gunner.
hpt_mining_seismchrgwarhd_fixed_medium_i:
Mining tool used to extract deep core deposits from the heart of an asteroid.
- Trigger controlled functionality.
- Functions in analysis mode.
hpt_mining_seismchrgwarhd_fixed_medium_l: Seismic charges are warheads designed to penetrate pre-existing asteroid fissure before activating a countdown to detonation. When the timer hits zero, a destructive shockwave will break down the fissure, potentially cracking the asteroid apart into smaller chunks. Any additional seismic charges attached to the same asteroid will automatically sync with the first and detonate simultaneously. The launch trigger can be held down to set the detonation strength of an individual charge. A refinery module is required to process asteroid chunks into saleable commodities. Ship must be in analysis mode to launch seismic charges.
hpt_mining_seismchrgwarhd_turret_medium_:
Mining tool used to extract deep core deposits from asteroids.
- Trigger controlled functionality.
- Functions in analysis mode.

Seismic charges are warheads designed to penetrate pre-existing asteroid fissure before activating a countdown to detonation. When the timer hits zero, a destructive shockwave will break down the fissure, potentially cracking the asteroid apart into smaller chunks. Any additional seismic charges attached to the same asteroid will automatically sync with the first and detonate simultaneously. The launch trigger can be held down to set the detonation strength of an individual charge. A refinery module is required to process asteroid chunks into saleable commodities. Ship must be in analysis mode to launch seismic charges. The turret-mounted version can be controlled by an active Gunner.
hpt_mining_subsurfdispmisle_fixed_small_:
Mining tool used to extract sub-surface deposits from within asteroids.
- Trigger controlled functionality.
- Functions in analysis mode.

Displacement missiles are designed to penetrate the surface of an asteroid before detonating a shaped charge to release sub-surface deposits. The missile will fly straight until it hits the asteroid, then drill down at the point of impact. Holding down the trigger will delay detonation until required. The explosion will dislodge and eject material but also damage the deposit, making it less viable with every use. A refinery module is required to process asteroid chunks into saleable commodities. Ship must be in analysis mode to operate an abrasion blaster.
hpt_mining_subsurfdispmisle_turret_small:
Mining tool used to extract sub-surface deposits from within asteroids.
- Trigger controlled functionality.
- Functions in analysis mode.

Displacement missiles penetrate the surface of an asteroid before detonating a shaped charge within to release sub-surface deposits. The missile will fly straight until it hits the asteroid then drill down at the point of impact. Holding the trigger will delay detonation of the missile's ordnance until released. The explosion will dislodge and eject resources but also damage the deposit, reducing viability with each use. A refinery module is required to process asteroid chunks into saleable commodities. Ship must be in analysis mode to launch sub-surface displacement missiles. The turret-mounted version can be controlled by an active Gunner.
hpt_mininglaser_fixed_small_advanced_inf: Operates as both a standard mining laser with increased range and a reduced-strength beam laser for added protection.
hpt_mininglaser_fixed_small_advanced_lon: Mining lance beam lasers operate as both a standard mining laser with increased range and a reduced-strength beam laser that functions as a weapon. It does not affect surface, sub-surface or deep core resource deposits.
hpt_mininglaser_fixed_small_info: Mining tool used to extract resources from asteroid surfaces.
hpt_mininglaser_fixed_small_longinfo: Mining lasers are used to carve resources from asteroids at a rate determined by the amount of power applied. Additional lasers will increase the rate of effectiveness. Asteroid chunks can be scooped once detached. A refinery module is required to process asteroid chunks into saleable commodity units. Mining lasers cannot access surface, sub-surface or deep core deposits. Ship must be in analysis mode to operate a mining laser.

Once a potential deposit is identified a prospector limpet can be used to gain more detailed information. Ship must be in analysis mode to deploy a pulse wave.

hpt_railgun_fixed_medium_burst_longinfo: This rail gun variant fires a burst of three shots instead of one. These individual shots offer less damage than a standard round, but hitting with the full burst is more effective.

hpt_shieldsacrifice_tiny_info: Transfers power directly from your ship's active shields to quickly increase shield strength on a targeted teammate's ship. Only vessels currently in your team can be targeted.

hpt_xenoscanner_advanced_tiny_info: Pulse scanner that gathers data about capital-class alien vessels. Intended for use with Thargoid Titans, though it can analyse smaller xeno vessels.
hpt_xenoscanner_advanced_tiny_longinfo:
Pulse scanner that gathers data about alien vessels in a forward conical zone. This identifies points of interest on capital-class xeno vessels, generating ship manifest results drawn from existing xenological databases.

The pulse wave xeno scanner is Intended for use near Thargoid Titans, which are too large to analyse using single-target scanners. Though it does function like other xeno scanners when pointed at smaller vessels, it offers mid-level range and comes with higher mass and power draw.
hpt_xenoscanner_basic_tiny_info: Scanner that can gather data about alien vessels by analysing their structural makeup and internal modules.
hpt_xenoscanner_basic_tiny_longinfo: Xeno scanners gather information about xenobiological vessels. A passive scan element reads an alien ship's dimensions and classification, as well as hull integrity and combat information. The active scan is short-range but produces more detailed information such as sub-targets, variant details and vital data required for research and development.
hpt_xenoscannermk2_basic_tiny_info: Variant of the Xeno Scanner with an extended range, at the cost of extra power draw.
hpt_xenoscannermk2_basic_tiny_longinfo: Xeno scanners gather information about xenobiological vessels. A passive scan element reads an alien ship's dimensions and classification, as well as hull integrity and combat information. The active scan is short-range but produces more detailed information such as sub-targets, variant details and vital data required for research and development. This version offers extended range at the cost of extra power draw.
hr7221wheat_info:
This blood-red, grain-like plant - sometimes known as 'Mars Grass' - has proven itself to be terribly invasive and highly aggressive to all other plant types. For this reason, its growth is now restricted to HR 7221. Its restriction has proved a blessing as its unique colouring and flavour are in demand in exotic cookery.

This rare good is legal in all markets.
