humanoidengineer_baltanos_desc: Hailing from a nation where technology is considered a gateway to spiritual fulfilment, Baltanos serves his church in spreading its transhumanist creed. Many subdermal implants have altered – or 'blessed' – his ability to manipulate components facilitating a successful engineering career. Eager to complete a long pilgrimage to humanity’s furthest reaches, Baltanos now functions as a missionary from his workshop in the Colonia region.
humanoidengineer_baltanos_history: Hailing from a nation where technology is considered a gateway to spiritual fulfilment, Baltanos serves his church in spreading its transhumanist creed. Many cybernetic implants have altered – or 'blessed' – his ability to manipulate components facilitating a successful engineering career. Eager to complete a long pilgrimage to humanity’s furthest reaches, Baltanos now functions as a missionary from his workshop in the Colonia region.
humanoidengineer_baltanos_history_initia: Baltanos shared knowledge of another engineer in exchange for 10 Faction Associates data.
humanoidengineer_baltanos_history_invite: You gained access to Baltanos by reaching Friendly reputation with the Colonia Council.
humanoidengineer_baltanos_history_unlock: You learned about Baltanos through common knowledge.
humanoidengineer_baltanos_initialcontrac: My insight to the true path will be well-received by the influential in Colonia. Bring me 10 Faction Associates data to identify that audience and I will endorse you to a prominent engineer.
humanoidengineer_baltanos_invitationmess:
$#CommanderName;,

I understand your recent activities have earned the friendship of the Colonia Council.

Consider yourself welcome at The Divine Apparatus. I shall be glad to bless your personal equipment.

Baltanos
humanoidengineer_baltanos_prerequisite: I take pride in my positive relationship with the Colonia Council. This standard extends to my customers, so please establish a Friendly reputation with the Council.
humanoidengineer_baltanos_referralcomple: Seek me out when you require further spiritual guidance.
humanoidengineer_dominogreen_desc: Orphaned at the age of seven, Domino was placed in a public relations initiative by the Rockforth Corporation; the company housed and educated her, but expected her to work for Rockforth as an adult. While displaying a prodigious talent for technology, Domino also lacked discipline and proved highly irreverent. She was dismissed as a poor investment and now operates a workshop established with her family inheritance.
humanoidengineer_dominogreen_history: Orphaned at the age of seven, Domino was placed in a public relations initiative by the Rockforth Corporation; the company housed and educated her, but expected her to work for Rockforth as an adult. While displaying a prodigious talent for technology, she also lacked discipline and proved highly irreverent. She was dismissed as a poor investment and now operates a workshop established with her family inheritance.
humanoidengineer_dominogreen_history_ini: Domino Green shared knowledge of another engineer in exchange for 5 doses of Push.
humanoidengineer_dominogreen_history_inv: You gained access to Domino Green by travelling at least 100 light years in shuttles.
humanoidengineer_dominogreen_history_unl: You learned about Domino Green through common knowledge.
humanoidengineer_dominogreen_initialcont: I have a bit of a business relationship with Push. It keeps me focused when my brain's all 'waaahhh'. Y'know? Anyway, bring me 5 measures and I'll make it worth your while.
humanoidengineer_dominogreen_invitationm:
$#CommanderName;,

Yoooo, how's it going? I checked out your Apex registration info - don't ask how. Don't ask why, either. We all entertain ourselves in different ways. But you passed!

Come visit The Jackrabbit. Orishis system. I'll show you stuff way wilder than shuttle rides.

Domino Green
humanoidengineer_dominogreen_prerequisit: You ever just sit back and contemplate the majesty of space? Well, you should! Travel 100 light years in shuttles until you're suitably awed and then maybe I'll blow your mind with technology.
humanoidengineer_eleanorbresa_desc: Raised by her industrious mother, Eleanor experienced a nomadic upbringing. She would often find herself isolated from other students in the many educational facilities she passed through. As a result Eleanor chose not to apply for university, instead becoming her mother's apprentice. Her engineering talent quickly became evident, and after a decade of on-the-job experience Eleanor was granted a workshop to finally make her own name.
humanoidengineer_eleanorbresa_history: Raised by her industrious mother, Eleanor experienced a nomadic upbringing. She would often find herself isolated from other students in the many educational facilities she passed through. As a result Eleanor chose not to apply for university, instead becoming her mother's apprentice. Her engineering talent quickly became evident, and after a decade of on-the-job experience Eleanor was granted a workshop to finally make her own name.
humanoidengineer_eleanorbresa_history_in: Eleanor Bresa shared knowledge of another engineer in exchange for 10 Digital Designs.
You gained access to Eleanor Bresa by visiting 5 settlements in the Colonia system.
humanoidengineer_eleanorbresa_history_un: You learned about Eleanor Bresa through common knowledge.
humanoidengineer_eleanorbresa_initialcon: Mama Bresa always said engineering is about taking someone else's idea and making it better. Bring me 10 Digital Designs and I'll help you make contact with one of Colonia's finest techs.
humanoidengineer_eleanorbresa_invitation:
$#CommanderName;,

I hope you found the settlements of Colonia interesting! The region has been hard at work, which is part of why I decided to establish my business here.

If you're interested in my designs, drop in at my workshop. It's Bresa's Modifications, just in case. I'll look forward to your visit.

Eleanor Bresa
humanoidengineer_eleanorbresa_prerequisi: Anyone passing through Colonia should check out the sights and see how things are developing. Visit 5 settlements in the system and I'll have my workshop ready when you're done.
humanoidengineer_eleanorbresa_referralco: I hope you'll be a regular client, Commander.
humanoidengineer_heroferrari_desc: Little is known of Hero’s history, and it is widely believed that she operates under a pseudonym. She is skilled with weapons modification and demonstrates a keen knowledge of military-grade technology, but appears comfortable in the relatively sedate world of engineering. When not upgrading equipment, Hero practices traditional calligraphy and watercolour techniques.
humanoidengineer_heroferrari_history: Little is known of Hero’s history, and it is widely believed that she operates under a pseudonym. She is skilled with weapons modification and demonstrates a keen knowledge of military-grade technology, but appears comfortable in the relatively sedate world of engineering. When not upgrading equipment, Hero practices traditional calligraphy and watercolour techniques.
humanoidengineer_heroferrari_history_ini: Hero Ferrari shared knowledge of another engineer in exchange for 5 Settlement Defence Plans.
humanoidengineer_heroferrari_history_inv: You gained access to Hero Ferrari by completing 10 surface conflict zones.
humanoidengineer_heroferrari_history_unl: You learned about Hero Ferrari through common knowledge.
humanoidengineer_heroferrari_initialcont: New automated weapons are sketched out every day. There's always a new calculation or alloy variant being tested. Bring me 5 Settlement Defence Plans to help inspire my ideas.
humanoidengineer_heroferrari_invitationm:
$#CommanderName;,

A friend recommended your name as a Commander with potential. Stop by my facility in the Siris system for engineering work, if you need it.

Hero Ferrari
humanoidengineer_heroferrari_prerequisit: I prefer to work with experienced customers. Complete at least 10 surface conflict zone engagements before coming to me.
humanoidengineer_heroferrari_referralcom: My services are available when you need them, Commander.
humanoidengineer_judenavarro_desc: The son of a freedom fighter killed defending his home system, Jude entered military service as soon as he was able to continue his family’s struggle. Years of resistance in an under-equipped militia wore on him until injuries sustained in combat forced him to retire. Jude now puts his engineering talents to use for private clients, but is rumoured to send much of it to family and former comrades.
humanoidengineer_judenavarro_history: The son of a freedom fighter killed defending his home system, Jude entered military service as soon as he was able to continue his family’s struggle. Years of resistance in an under-equipped militia wore on him until injuries sustained in combat forced him to retire. Jude now puts his engineering talents to use for private clients, but is rumoured to send much of it to family and former comrades.
humanoidengineer_judenavarro_history_ini: Jude Navarro shared knowledge of another engineer in exchange for 5 Genetic Repair Meds.
humanoidengineer_judenavarro_history_inv: You gained access to Jude Navarro by completing 10 Restore or Reactivation missions.
humanoidengineer_judenavarro_history_unl: You learned about Jude Navarro through common knowledge.
humanoidengineer_judenavarro_initialcont: I try to keep a stock of Genetic Repair Meds at the base. Don't concern yourself with the reasons. Bring me 5 of these and I'll point you towards a talented friend of mine.
humanoidengineer_judenavarro_invitationm:
$#CommanderName;,

You've been making a name for yourself bringing settlements back online. May just be a job to you, but people don't easily forget that kind of help.

Come visit my workshop in Aurai and I'll look at how we can improve your gear.

Jude Navarro
humanoidengineer_judenavarro_prerequisit: Prove to me that you're willing to help others and I'll agree to help you. Complete 10 Restore or Reactivation missions before coming to see me.
humanoidengineer_judenavarro_referralcom: I've added you to my regular customer database, Commander.
humanoidengineer_kitfowler_desc: Politically conscientious from adolescence, Kit has a reputation for indulging fringe ideologies and conspiracy. An aptitude for engineering makes it easy for him to find work; this income funds an independent broadcast called ‘End Times’ that serves as a platform for his paranoid rants and apocalyptic predictions.
humanoidengineer_kitfowler_history: Politically conscientious from adolescence, Kit has a reputation for indulging fringe ideologies and conspiracy. An aptitude for engineering makes it easy for him to find work; this income funds an independent broadcast called ‘End Times’ that serves as a platform for his paranoid rants and apocalyptic predictions.
humanoidengineer_kitfowler_history_initi: Kit Fowler shared knowledge of another engineer in exchange for 5 Surveillance Equipment.
humanoidengineer_kitfowler_history_invit: You gained access to Kit Fowler by selling 5 Opinion Polls to bartenders.
humanoidengineer_kitfowler_history_unloc: You learned about Kit Fowler from Domino Green.
humanoidengineer_kitfowler_initialcontra: There are always new ways to spy on each other, Commander. I can never have enough eyes and ears.  Bring me 5 Surveillance Equipment and I'll consider introducing you to an associate of mine
humanoidengineer_kitfowler_invitationmes:
$#CommanderName;,

You've been making credits from the thoughts of the people. Not unusual these days. Immoral, but not unusual.

I run a workshop in the Capoya system. Stop by while there is still time. 

Kit Fowler
humanoidengineer_kitfowler_prerequisite: It never ceases to baffle me how willing people are to surrender their personal information. Bartenders will purchase opinion polls to stay informed…if you're willing to provide them. Let's say 5 in total.
humanoidengineer_kitfowler_referralcompl: You have permission to visit my facility whenever you need modifications. Just don't tell anyone.
humanoidengineer_odengeiger_desc: Born into a wealthy Imperial household, Oden was prepared from a young age to join his family’s corporation. But Oden set about turning himself into a lucrative brand, establishing a profitable personal empire by his thirties. His life since has been tumultuous but never boring; gaining and losing several fortunes, brief incarceration and remarkable engineering feats barely scratch the surface of his long history.
humanoidengineer_odengeiger_history: Born into a wealthy Imperial household, Oden was prepared from a young age to join his family’s corporation. But Oden set about turning himself into a lucrative brand, establishing a profitable personal empire by his thirties. His life since has been tumultuous but never boring; gaining and losing several fortunes, brief incarceration and remarkable engineering feats barely scratch the surface of his long history.
humanoidengineer_odengeiger_history_init: Oden Geiger has no outstanding donation request.
humanoidengineer_odengeiger_history_invi: You gained access to Oden Geiger by selling a total of 20 Biological Sample, Employee Genetic Data and Genetic Research to bartenders.
humanoidengineer_odengeiger_history_unlo: You learned about Oden Geiger from Terra Velasquez.
humanoidengineer_odengeiger_initialcontr: Consider my workshop at your disposal, Commander.
humanoidengineer_odengeiger_invitationme:
$#CommanderName;,

I understand you have contributed towards the distribution of genetic research, in some small part at least. It is appreciated, I assure you.

My workshop is located in the Candiaei system. I am confident you will find my modifications to your liking.

Oden Geiger
humanoidengineer_odengeiger_prerequisite: Genetics is the key to humanity's future. Encourage the spread of knowledge by selling Biological Samples, Employee Genetic Data and Genetic Research. 20 items collectively would be acceptable.
humanoidengineer_odengeiger_referralcomp: Consider my workshop at your disposal, Commander.
humanoidengineer_rosadayette_desc: As a child, Rosa often tinkered with the gadgets in her home to reverse-engineer them and learn how they worked. Her natural talent blossomed over the years as she offered her services to anyone with faulty tech, building a reputation across her home starport. She eventually apprenticed with an experienced suit mechanic, learning to apply her skills to combat equipment. Rosa’s charitable nature and focus on community was eventually rewarded with her own workshop, paid for by thousands of donations from friends, family and customers accrued over the years.
humanoidengineer_rosadayette_history: As a child, Rosa often tinkered with the gadgets in her home to reverse-engineer them and learn how they worked. Her natural talent blossomed over the years as she offered her services to anyone with faulty tech, building a reputation across her home starport. She eventually apprenticed with an experienced suit mechanic, learning to apply her skills to combat equipment. Rosa’s charitable nature and focus on community was eventually rewarded with her own workshop, paid for by thousands of donations from friends, family and customers accrued over the years.
humanoidengineer_rosadayette_history_ini: Rosa Dayette shared knowledge of another engineer in exchange for 10 Manufacturing Instructions.
humanoidengineer_rosadayette_history_inv: You gained access to Rosa Dayette by selling a total of 10 Culinary or Cocktail Recipes to stations in Colonia.
humanoidengineer_rosadayette_history_unl: You learned about Rosa Dayette through common knowledge.
humanoidengineer_rosadayette_initialcont: I find the inner workings of everyday equipment so fascinating. Bring me 10 Manufacturing Instructions and I'll refer you to a quality engineer.
humanoidengineer_rosadayette_invitationm:
$#CommanderName;,

I heard about your recent donation to the wellbeing of our tastebuds. A friend in the industry flags up Pilots' Federation members visiting Colonia.

Why not stop by my shop? I have some designs which you'll want to look at. Don't be a stranger!

Rosa Dayette
humanoidengineer_rosadayette_prerequisit: The cuisine out here in Colonia doesn't have the variety of back home. Bring some recipes to the local stations - I'll trade my work for the chance of a good meal.
humanoidengineer_rosadayette_referralcom: Make sure to drop by the next chance you get!
humanoidengineer_terravelasquez_desc: As the only daughter of a prosperous entrepreneur, Terra was born into extraordinary wealth. But a highly rebellious streak led her to reject the familial expectations placed upon her. She fled home, falling in with an antiauthoritarian group that engaged in a string of daring robberies. One failed heist and a decade of incarceration later, Terra operates an independent workshop and claims to have left her criminal past behind.
humanoidengineer_terravelasquez_history: As the only daughter of a prosperous entrepreneur, Terra was born into extraordinary wealth. But a highly rebellious streak led her to reject the familial expectations placed upon her. She fled home, falling in with an antiauthoritarian group that engaged in a string of daring robberies. One failed heist and a decade of incarceration later, Terra operates an independent workshop and claims to have left her criminal past behind.
humanoidengineer_terravelasquez_history_: Terra Velasquez shared knowledge of another engineer in exchange for 15 Financial Projections.
You gained access to Terra Velasquez by completing 6 Covert Theft and Covert Heist missions.
You learned about Terra Velasquez from Jude Navarro.
humanoidengineer_terravelasquez_initialc: Y'know what I like the most about interstellar factions? Their numbers. Bring me 15 Financial Projections, and I'll give you the location of a real tech-wizard in return.
humanoidengineer_terravelasquez_invitati:
$#CommanderName;,

Had your name flagged up with me after your most recent heist. Nice work. 

I should be able to improve your gear. You can find me in the Shou Xing system.

Terra Velasquez
humanoidengineer_terravelasquez_prerequi: Nobody who needs my work should be squeaky-clean. There are covert heist and theft contracts available in most systems. Complete 6 of them and get back to me.
humanoidengineer_terravelasquez_referral: I'll give your equipment a makeover whenever needed, Commander.
humanoidengineer_umalaszlo_desc: The former CEO of Laszlo Industrial, Uma famously rejected a takeover bid by Sirius Corporation several years ago. She was then unanimously voted out of her position by her own board of directors. The true details of this event are unconfirmed, but media speculation suggests Uma was deeply hurt by the betrayal and operates a workshop simply to demonstrate the talent Sirius Corporation once sought to own.
humanoidengineer_umalaszlo_history: The former CEO of Laszlo Industrial, Uma famously rejected a takeover bid by Sirius Corporation several years ago. She was then unanimously voted out of her position by her own board of directors. The true details of this event are unconfirmed, but media speculation suggests Uma was deeply hurt by the betrayal and operates a workshop simply to demonstrate the talent Sirius Corporation once sought to own.
humanoidengineer_umalaszlo_history_initi: Uma Laszlo has no outstanding donation request.
humanoidengineer_umalaszlo_history_invit: You gained access to Uma Laszlo by reaching Unfriendly reputation or lower with Sirius Corporation.
humanoidengineer_umalaszlo_history_unloc: You learned about Uma Laszlo from Wellington Beck.
humanoidengineer_umalaszlo_initialcontra: Now we are acquainted, you may visit my facility as you please.
humanoidengineer_umalaszlo_invitationmes:
$#CommanderName;,

Seems you're not popular with Sirius Corporation - which means you're just fine with me.

Next time you're near the Xuane system, come and take a look at my modification designs. Perhaps we can help each other.

Uma Laszlo
humanoidengineer_umalaszlo_prerequisite: Gossip media claims I 'hold a grudge' against the Sirius Corporation. Though I would not use such a banal phrase, it is true that my customers must have an Unfriendly or lower reputation with the organisation.
humanoidengineer_umalaszlo_referralcompl: Now we are acquainted, you may visit my facility as you please.
humanoidengineer_wellingtonbeck_desc: From an early age Beck demonstrated a prodigious talent for the sciences. He flourished at the prestigious Dormu Academy, earning several advanced degrees. Beck briefly worked for the Sirius Corporation but this relationship did not last long, due to a reported difficulty working as part of a team. Using the credits earned from Sirius, Beck established an independent workshop to pursue more personal projects.
humanoidengineer_wellingtonbeck_history: From an early age Beck demonstrated a prodigious talent for the sciences. He flourished at the prestigious Dormu Academy, earning several advanced degrees. Beck briefly worked for the Sirius Corporation but this relationship did not last long, due to a reported difficulty working as part of a team. Using the credits earned from Sirius, Beck established an independent workshop to pursue more personal projects.
humanoidengineer_wellingtonbeck_history_: Wellington Beck shared knowledge of another engineer in exchange for 5 Insight Entertainment Suites.
You gained access to Wellington Beck by selling a total of 15 Multimedia Entertainment, Classic Entertainment and Cat Media to bartenders.
You learned about Wellington Beck from Hero Ferrari.
humanoidengineer_wellingtonbeck_initialc: I have a very keen interest in visual entertainment and related media. Please bring me 5 Insight Entertainment Suites. I have the details of another engineer to share if you do.
humanoidengineer_wellingtonbeck_invitati:
$#CommanderName;,

I am writing to confirm that your details have been referred to me by a mutual acquaintance: Hero Ferrari.

You may visit my facility in the Jolapa at your convenience. I provide high-quality equipment modifications.

Wellington Beck
humanoidengineer_wellingtonbeck_prerequi: A majority of media created by past generations is dismissed as dated and worthless. I disagree. Collect and sell 15 Classic Entertainment, Multimedia Entertainment and Cat Media in total to prove there is a market for it.
humanoidengineer_wellingtonbeck_referral: My quality workmanship is available as and when required, Commander.
humanoidengineer_yardenbond_desc: Yarden was born in the heart of the so-called Utopia commune, setting out on her own as a young adult. A shuttle accident almost took her life as an adult, and she endured years of arduous recovery to overcome injuries and pessimistic diagnoses. Using her engineering talents to rebuild her skeletal frame, she operates an independent workshop with steely determination.
humanoidengineer_yardenbond_history: Yarden was born in the heart of the so-called Utopia commune, setting out on her own as a young adult. A shuttle accident almost took her life as an adult, and she endured years of arduous recovery to overcome injuries and pessimistic diagnoses. Using her engineering talents to rebuild her skeletal frame, she operates an independent workshop with steely determination.
humanoidengineer_yardenbond_history_init: Yarden Bond has no outstanding donation request.
humanoidengineer_yardenbond_history_invi: You gained access to Yarden Bond by selling 5 Smear Campaign Plans to bartenders.
humanoidengineer_yardenbond_history_unlo: You learned about Yarden Bond from Kit Fowler.
humanoidengineer_yardenbond_initialcontr: Stop by the workshop if you need modifications, Commander.
humanoidengineer_yardenbond_invitationme:
$#CommanderName;,

Consider this message a formal invitation to my workshop in the Bayan system. You'll have to forgive the sudden communication; these days I prefer screening potential customers in advance.

I have a few designs unique designs that you should find interesting.

Yarden Bond
humanoidengineer_yardenbond_prerequisite: Perception can just be as important as fact. Damage to the reputation is common; knowing who is a target can be invaluable. Obtain and sell 5 smear campaign plans.
humanoidengineer_yardenbond_referralcomp: Stop by the workshop if you need modifications, Commander.
humanoidengineer_yishen_desc: Yi Shen grew up in a respected family, with many of the opportunities that come with wealth: a strong education, the finest technology and many willing mentors. The subsequent corporate role had Yi Shen fast-tracked to success. It is rumoured a significant family tragedy led to Yi Shen abandoning his career and retreating to Colonia. Whether this new chapter has helped him move on from the past is unknown.
humanoidengineer_yishen_history: Yi Shen grew up in a respected family, with many of the opportunities that come with wealth: a strong education, the finest technology and many willing mentors. The subsequent corporate role had Yi Shen fast-tracked to success. It is rumoured a significant family tragedy led to Yi Shen abandoning his career and retreating to Colonia. humanoidengineer_yishen_history_invited: You gained access to Yi Shen by completing referral tasks for Baltanos, Eleanor Bresa and Rosa Dayette.
humanoidengineer_yishen_history_unlocked: You learned about Yi Shen from Baltanos, Eleanor Bresa and Rosa Dayette.
humanoidengineer_yishen_initialcontract: My workshop is available when you need it, Commander.
humanoidengineer_yishen_invitationmessag:
$#CommanderName;,

I have been made aware of your activities in Colonia. It is time we met.

My workshop is called Eidolon Hold. I offer several premium modifications for your equipment, should you need them.

Yi Shen
humanoidengineer_yishen_prerequisite: I am highly selective about my clients. Once three other Colonia engineers have endorsed you, I will grant you access to my workshop.
humanoidengineer_yishen_referralcomplete: My workshop is available when you need it, Commander.

hybridcapacitors_info:
Component found in ships: frequently used by military and authority vessels. Known to be salvaged from signal sources.

Hybrid capacitors are a form of supercapacitor capable of storing and releasing vast amounts of energy.
hybridcapacitors_info_short: Component found in ships: frequently used by military and authority vessels. Known to be salvaged from signal sources.
hydrogenfuel_info:
Produced by: All
Consumed by: All

Hydrogen fuel is used in high power systems, from ships' drives to weapons to powering the energy needs of stations and surface cities. Using high pressure and temperature, hydrogen is fused into helium in a simple reactor.
hydrogenfuel_info_short: Produced by: All Consumed by: All Hydrogen fuel is used in high power systems.
hydrogenperoxide_info:
Produced by: Mining only
Consumed by: Refinery and Industrial

Hydrogen Peroxide, H2O2, is the simplest peroxide and has a number of uses as a reacting agent in chemical processes.
hydrogenperoxide_info_short: Produced by: Mining Consumed by: Refinery and Industrial Hydrogen Peroxide, H2O2, is the simplest peroxide.
hydroponicdata_info: Horticultural analysis and results from using soilless methods of plant growth.
hydroponicdata_longinfo: Horticultural analysis and results from using soilless methods of plant growth.
hyperspace_description: This will engage the FSD to perform a hyperspace jump to the currently targeted system or follow a scanned high energy wake.
hyperspacetrajectories_info:
Captured from scanning high energy wakes with a wake scanner.

Hyperspace trajectories follow predictable paths through higher dimensional space, although there are sometimes strange results in the data not accounted for in current theory.
hyperspacetrajectories_info_short: Captured from scanning high energy wakes with a wake scanner.
hypersupercombination_description: This will engage the FSD to either hyperspace jump to another system if it has been target locked, or supercruise if there is no target or a current system target is locked instead. While supercruising, it will exit to normal space as long as another star system hasn't been targeted in the meantime, in which case it will hyperspace jump to that star system.
ibootishyperboresystems_info: I Bootis Engineering Systems are constantly working to improve and enhance on existing models, with the I Bootis Hyperbore System representing the latest in automated mineral extraction services.
ibootishyperboresystems_info_short: I Bootis Hyperbore System represents the latest in automated mineral extraction services.
illicitconsignment_info: Used by Kumo Crew supporters to acquire systems. Deliver these to Power contacts in any unoccupied system located within the control range of the item's source system. They are of no value to anyone but Delaine's followers.
illicitconsignment_info_short: Used by Kumo Crew supporters to acquire systems. Deliver these to Power contacts in any unoccupied system located within the control range of the item's source system.
illicitconsignment_infoalt: Used by Kumo Crew supporters to acquire systems. Deliver these to Power contacts in any unoccupied system located within the control range of the item's source system. They are of no value to anyone but Delaine's followers.
impcapshipplanetexclusion_randomchatter1: This is a general broadcast. This area is certified as an exclusion zone until further notice by authority of the Imperial Navy. Any pilots approaching the site without authorisation will be fired upon.
imperialprisoner_info: Used by Torval's supporters to undermine systems. Deliver these to Power contacts in any rival Power's controlled system. They are of no value to anyone but Torval's followers.
imperialprisoner_info_short: Used by Torval's supporters to undermine systems. Deliver these to Power contacts in any rival Power's controlled system. They are of no value to anyone but their followers.
imperialprisoner_infoalt: Used by Torval's supporters to undermine systems. Deliver these to Power contacts in any rival Power's controlled system. They are of no value to anyone but Torval's followers.
imperialshielding_info:
Advanced component found in Imperial systems. Known to be salvaged from signal sources.

Imperial shielding is an advanced form of shield management using proprietary technology.
imperialshielding_info_short: Advanced component found in Imperial systems. Known to be salvaged from signal sources.
imperialslaves_info:
Produced by: Agricultural
Consumed by: All
Only legal on Imperial worlds or dictatorships and patronage style governed markets.

Slavery is an important part of Imperial Society, providing labour for the Empire and a safety net for its citizens. Many Imperials will choose to sell themselves into a fixed period of slavery rather than face the embarrassment and dishonour of living with a debt.
imperialslaves_info_short: Only legal on Imperial worlds or dictatorships and patronage style governed markets. Many Imperials will choose to sell themselves into slavery rather than face the embarrassment of living with a debt.
improvisedcomponents_info:
Specialist component used by factions in times of civil unrest. Known to be salvaged from signal sources.

These jury rigged components can fill in for crafted or manufactured components in a pinch.
improvisedcomponents_info_short: Specialist component used by factions in times of civil unrest. Known to be salvaged from signal sources. These jury rigged components can fill in for crafted or manufactured components in a pinch.
inbox_colonisation_claimtimeout_body:
$#commanderName; Your system colonisation claim in $#system; will expire in $#time; unless a System Colonisation Beacon is deployed to the system.

Proceed to the Beacon Deployment Site in the system then use the System Colonisation Suite module to deploy the System Colonisation Beacon and complete your claim on the system.
inbox_colonisation_initialcolonisationti:
$#commanderName; Your primary port construction in $#system; will fail in $#time; unless the System Colonisation effort is completed.

Ensure all required commodities are delivered to the System Colonisation Ship to complete the System Colonisation effort.
inbox_finance_intro: Thank you for visiting $#Market;! A summary of your financial dealings at our port is listed below:
inbox_fleetcarrier_assettransfer_body:
Commander,

The decommissioned carrier $#CARRIERNAME; has been removed from the $#SYSTEM; system. However, one or more of your ships or modules were stored on board at the time.

As part of our high-quality service, your assets have entered transit to $#STARPORT; in the $#TARGETSYSTEM; system. We expect this delivery to be completed soon; the estimated arrival can be reviewed in any outfitting facility.

Regards,
Pathfinder Solutions
inbox_fleetcarrier_debtwarning_body:
Attention Commander,

Your carrier, $#CARRIERNAME;, is at imminent risk of seizure and relocation due to ongoing negligence.

There is an outstanding debt of $#CARRIERBALANCE; credits associated with this carrier, due to weeks of unpaid crew wages and maintenance expenses. If this debt is not resolved within seven days of this message, Pathfinder Solutions will be granted the authority to recover the carrier and reallocate the serving crew.

As part of their contract of ownership, all owners are responsible for the welfare of those serving aboard the carrier, including the prompt payment of wages. Any breach of this agreement risks revocation of the carrier.

We hope that this matter can be settled with the prompt payment of credits owed.

Regards,
Pathfinder Solutions
inbox_fleetcarrier_decomcanc_body:
Dear Commander,

This message is to confirm that your carrier, $#CARRIERNAME;, is no longer scheduled for decommission following your cancellation request.

Full carrier operations, including any optional services installed on the carrier, are available once again.

Regards,
Pathfinder Solutions
inbox_fleetcarrier_decomcomp_body:
Commander,

This is a final message to confirm that your former carrier, $#CARRIERNAME;, has been decommissioned as requested.

A total of $#CREDITSREFUND; credits have been transferred to your account. This represents the current carrier value, balanced against outstanding debts and length of service.

Ships and modules stored on the carrier can be transferred, free of charge, to a location of your choosing. If no transfer destination has been confirmed after three months, these assets will be returned to the closest Carrier Construction Facility relative to the carrier’s final location.

Regards,
Pathfinder Solutions
inbox_fleetcarrier_decommission_guesttra:
Commander,

We wish to inform you that the carrier $#carrierName; has been decommissioned with you on board.

As a complimentary service, you have been transferred to $#targetMarket; in the $#targetSystem system.

Regards,
Pathfinder Solutions
inbox_fleetcarrier_decommission_guestund:
Commander,

We wish to inform you that the carrier $#carrierName; has been decommissioned with your ship on board.

As docking services are no longer available, your ship has been automatically launched to a safe distance from the carrier.

Regards,
Pathfinder Solutions
inbox_fleetcarrier_decomreq_body:
Dear Commander,

This message is to confirm that your carrier, $#CARRIERNAME;, has been scheduled for decommission at your request.

The pending decommission order takes on average a week to complete. You may cancel the decommission request at any time during this period. Once the decommission request has been fully processed, the carrier will be removed from service and a portion of its value refunded to you.

Regards,
Pathfinder Solutions
inbox_fleetcarrier_deleted_guesttransfer:
Commander,

The decommissioned carrier $#carrierName; has been removed from the $#carrierSystem; system.

As part of our high-quality service, you have been transferred to $#targetMarket; in the $#targetSystem; system.

Regards,
Pathfinder Solutions
inbox_fleetcarrier_enterdebt_body:
Commander,

We regret to inform you that your carrier's budget is now at a negative value.

All carriers incur running expenses related to crew wages and maintenance. If insufficient credits have been allocated to the carrier budget, Pathfinder Solutions will temporarily cover basic operational costs, allowing you to address the outstanding balance at your earliest convenience.

Your outstanding balance is $#CARRIERBALANCE; credits.

Allocating credits to your carrier budget can be performed using the Budget screen of the Carrier Management service.

Please note that this debt must be paid as soon as possible. If no effort is made to provide for a carrier’s crew for a prolonged period, the carrier may be listed as abandoned and subsequently recalled.

Regards,
Pathfinder Solutions
inbox_fleetcarrier_jumpaborted_reasona: due to a lack of available fuel
inbox_fleetcarrier_jumpaborted_reasonb: due to a failed telemetry check. Your actions are in no way responsible for this outcome. On behalf of the crew, I apologise for this inconvenience, Commander
inbox_fleetcarrier_jumpaborted_reasonc: due to a failed telemetry check
inbox_fleetcarrier_jumplowfuel_body:
Commander,

The scheduled hyperspace jump of your carrier, $#CARRIERNAME;, is at risk of failure due to a lack of tritium fuel. This is likely due to an increase in storage capacity used since the jump was scheduled, which has increased the fuel requirement.

There are two solutions available:
- The addition of tritium fuel
- The removal of goods or services to reduce the carrier’s mass.

If the issue is not addressed within 15 minutes of this message the carrier will be forced to cancel the pending jump to the $#TARGETSYSTEM; system.

$#CAPTAINNAME;
Deck Officer of $#CARRIERNAME;
inbox_fleetcarrier_purchase_body:
Dear Commander,

Congratulations on the purchase of your new Brewer Corporation carrier!

This is a message to confirm that a total of $#CREDITSCOST; credits have been deducted from your balance. As part of this investment, our crew agency partner Pathfinder Solutions have been notified. Your carrier crew will be in place shortly, ready for the maiden voyage from the $#CURRENTSYSTEM; system.

With kind regards,

$#VENDORNAME;
Brewer Corporation
inbox_fleetcarrier_revokedguest_body:
Commander,

We wish to inform you that the carrier $#CARRIERNAME; has been decommissioned with one or more of your ships or modules on board.

These assets can be transferred, free of charge, to a location of your choice. For large ships awaiting transport, please ensure that your chosen location can accommodate them.

If your assets are not claimed within three months, they will be automatically returned to the closest Carrier Construction Facility relative to the carrier’s final location.

Regards,
Pathfinder Solutions
inbox_fleetcarrier_revokedowner_body:
Commander,

We regret to inform you that your carrier, $#CARRIERNAME;, has been seized to cover outstanding debts.

For several weeks, your carrier budget has failed to cover running expenses related to crew wages and maintenance. Consequently, the carrier crew has been operating without pay.

The situation has become untenable and as a result your carrier has been decommissioned.

A total of $#CREDITSREFUND; credits have been returned to your account. This represents the current carrier value, balanced against outstanding debts.

Ships and modules stored on the carrier can be transferred, free of charge, to a location of your choosing. If no transfer destination has been confirmed after three months, these assets will be returned to the closest Carrier Construction Facility relative to the carrier’s final location.

Regards,
Pathfinder Solutions
inbox_issuenewstarterpermit:
Hello $#CommanderName;.

The Pilots' Federation has issued you with the $#PermitName;. This permit grants access to Pilots' Federation Space, consisting of Starter Zones that act as training systems to ensure you will be among Commanders of a similar experience level.

While you are picking up the basics, you will be granted a significant discount on any insurance rebuy payments needed in the event of ship loss. This will last until you attain an increase in any Pilots' Federation rank.

In time your training opportunities here will be completed, and you will feel confident enough to explore the galaxy. The $#PermitName; will be removed along with access to these systems once you have docked at a starport outside of this zone after attaining an increase in any Pilots' Federation rank.

Good luck and fly safe, Commander!
inbox_loginreward_bodylist:
Hello $#CommanderName;,

Happy holidays! As a reward for logging in today, we have added the following to your account:
$#rewardList;

A daily reward is available between the 13th and 25th of December (UTC).

Thank you for your continued support!
Frontier Developments
inbox_move_from_stronghold:
Commander, this is an urgent message from the Pilots' Federation.

The stronghold carrier you were docked at has left the system due to a change of Power status. Your ship, along with any other ships or modules stored on the carrier, has been relocated to $#MarketName;.

You have not been charged for this service.
inbox_move_to_repairedstation:
Commander, this is an urgent message from the Pilots' Federation. Do not be alarmed. The ship you were docked aboard has now left the system and your ship has been relocated to $#MarketName;, which is currently under repair.

The Pilots' Federation will not charge you for this service, but we would appreciate any assistance you could provide towards the restoration of the starport.
inbox_move_to_rescueship:
Commander, this is an urgent message from the Pilots' Federation. Do not be alarmed. The starport you were previously docked at has come under attack and your ship has been moved to $#RescueShipName; for its own safety.

The Pilots' Federation will not charge you for this service, but we would appreciate any assistance you could provide towards the current rescue effort.
inbox_newpermit:
Hello $#CommanderName;.

You have been issued with the $#PermitName;.
inbox_npccrew_overflow_message:
Hello Commander,

Please be aware that the following crew members are being paid $#WagesPercent;% of your income:

$#CrewNames;

If their services are no longer required, you can remove them from any crew lounge or by raising a support ticket.

Regards,
Frontier Support Team
inbox_npccrew_restored_message:
Hello Commander,

The following crew have returned to your service after a leave of absence:

$#CrewNames;

No salary has been paid to your crew members during this time.  If their services are no longer required, you can remove them from any crew lounge or by raising a support ticket.

Regards,
Frontier Support Team
inbox_revokenewstarterpermit:
Hello $#CommanderName;.

The Pilots' Federation wishes you luck on your new journey through the stars. As you have progressed beyond the requirements for access to Pilots' Federation Space, your $#PermitName; has been revoked. Any ships or modules currently located within the district must be transferred to a station of your choice, at your request.
The galaxy awaits!

Fly safe, Commander.
inbox_ship_transfer_arrived_body:
We are pleased to confirm that your $#shipName; has safely arrived at $#marketName; in the $#systemName; system and is ready for collection.

Regards,

 - Inter Astra
inbox_squadroncarrier_decomcomp_body:
Commander,

This is a final message to confirm that your squadron's former carrier, $#CARRIERNAME;, has been decommissioned as requested.

A total of $#CREDITSREFUND; credits have been transferred to your squadron's treasury. This represents the current carrier value, balanced against outstanding debts and length of service.

Personal ships and modules stored on the carrier belong to squadron members can be transferred, free of charge, to a location of their commanders choosing. If no transfer destination has been confirmed after three months, these assets will be returned to the closest Carrier Construction Facility relative to the carrier’s final location.

Regards,
Pathfinder Solutions
inbox_squadroncarrier_decomreq_body:
Dear Commander,

This message is to confirm that your squadron's carrier, $#CARRIERNAME;, has been scheduled for decommission at your request.

The pending decommission order takes on average a week to complete. You may cancel the decommission request at any time during this period. Once the decommission request has been fully processed, the carrier will be removed from service and a portion of its value refunded to your squadron's treasury.

Regards,
Pathfinder Solutions
inbox_tg_shipmoved_body:
Commander,

Welcome to $#marketName; in the $#systemName; system.

Your ship was transferred to this safe port due to an imminent risk of Thargoid attack at your previous docked location. This service was provided for free to all Pilots' Federation members.

Regards,
Inter Astra
inbox_tutorialpaintjob_body:
Hello Commander,

The Pilots’ Federation is pleased to offer a Sidewinder paint job to all licensed pilots.
This is now available in the Livery options available to you.

Regards,

Jarek Larenth
Pilots’ Federation Administration
inbox_undockablemegashipitinerary_body:
Flight operations plan for $#Name;

$#list;

Please maintain a safe flying distance at all times.
incidentlogs_info: Notable occurances or unexpected events that occurred at a settlement.
incidentlogs_longinfo: Notable occurances or unexpected events that occurred at a settlement.
increaseenginespower_buggy_description: Diverts power from the power distributor to the engine system. Diverting power to engines results in higher top speeds and manoeuvring along with increasing the recharge rate on the engine capacitor (used for boosting).
increaseenginespower_description: Diverts power from the power distributor to the engine system. Diverting power to engines results in higher top speeds and manoeuvring along with increasing the recharge rate on the engine capacitor (used for boosting).
increasesystemspower_buggy_description: Diverts power from the power distributor to SRV systems. Diverting power to systems increases the resistive properties of all active shields and increases the recharge rate of the system capacitor (used for recharging shields and using other modules).
increasesystemspower_description: Diverts power from the power distributor to ship systems. Diverting power to systems increases the resistive properties of all active shields and increases the recharge rate of the system capacitor (used for recharging shields and using other modules).
increaseweaponspower_buggy_description: Diverts power from the power distributor to the weapon cooling system. Diverting power to weapons increases the recharge rate of the weapon cooling capacitor, allowing the weapons to fire for longer before overheating shuts them down.
increaseweaponspower_description: Diverts power from the power distributor to the weapon cooling system. Diverting power to weapons increases the recharge rate of the weapon cooling capacitor, allowing the weapons to fire for longer before overheating shuts them down.
independant_trader_armour_grade1_info: Hull reinforcement that provides standard protection against all types of attack.
independant_trader_armour_grade2_info: Hull reinforcement using an advanced structure and higher quality compounds, offering improved protection against all types of attack.
independant_trader_armour_grade3_info: Hull reinforcement using an advanced structure and military-grade compounds, offering superior protection against all types of attack.
independant_trader_armour_mirrored_info: Hull reinforcement using a specially formulated structure, offering superior protection against thermal damage caused by energy weapons. It is vulnerable to projectile weapons and other kinetic attacks.
independant_trader_armour_reactive_info: Hull reinforcement using a dynamically reactive, impact-resistant material offering superior protection against projectile weapons and other kinetic attacks. It is vulnerable to thermal damage caused by energy weapons.
independant_trader_cockpit_info: Transparent protective canopy on a ship's cockpit that shields pilots from the many dangers of space travel.
independant_trader_info:
Based on the Type-6 Transporter, the Keelback is a hardy freighter designed for hostile-environment deliveries. The small hardpoints of the Type-6 have been bolstered with two medium hardpoints, but it is the Keelback's ability to accommodate a vessel bay that really sets it apart. The ship also boasts superior armour and shields to the Type-6, making it a good option for traders who plan to travel without an escort.

The Keelback has been designed for medium-size landing pads.
independent_fighter_cockpit_info: Transparent protective canopy on a ship's cockpit that shields pilots from the many dangers of space travel.
independent_fighter_info: The Taipan is a hardy fighter that compensates for a lack of speed with considerable durability, allowing it to withstand far greater punishment than other fighters.

$Independent_Fighter_Name; $Independent_Fighter_Loadout_AT_Name; with: 
2x Anti-Xeno Fixed Multi-Cannon - Relatively slow but tougher than the other fighters.

indibourbon_info:
Originally used as a medicine to revive those who have suffocated in dust storms, the restorative effects of this potent drink are almost as famous as the hangovers.

This rare good is legal in all markets except for Prison Colony markets and Federal Theocracy markets.

Please note that if a market’s controlling faction changes, some formerly legal rare goods may become illegal. Should this occur the rare good will be unavailable for sale or purchase at that market for the duration of the prohibiting faction’s tenure.
indibourbon_info_short: Originally used as a medicine to revive those who have suffocated in dust storms, the restorative effects of this potent drink are almost as famous as the hangovers.
indirect_enemyreinforcements_001: Enemy reinforcements inbound. All units maintain attack vectors.
indirect_enemyreinforcements_003: Enemy forces zeroing in on our position.
indirect_enemyreinforcements_004: Enemy reinforcements closing fast. Brace yourselves.
indirect_friendlydestroyed_002: Allied ship destroyed. Look alive, team.
indirect_friendlydestroyed_004: Damn it, we just lost another one.
indirect_friendlydestroyed_005: Allied ship eliminated. This is not going well.
indirect_friendlyreinforcements_002: Good news – backup is on the way.

indirect_nothargoiddetected_003: No Thargoid signatures detected. Area secure.

indirect_objectivefailed_002: I'm ordering an immediate withdrawal. It's over.
indirect_objectivefailed_003: I'm ordering a full retreat. We aren't going to win this one.
indirect_objectivefailed_004: This is hopeless. Let's get out of here while we still can.
indirect_objectivefailed_005: Attention, pilots. I'm ordering a full retreat. We aren't going to win this one.

indirect_objectivesuccess_003: A clean sweep. You should be proud of yourselves.

indirect_thargoidsdetected_003: Thargoid vessels on approach vector. Be alert.
indite_info:
Produced by: Extraction
Consumed by: Refinery

Indite: chemical formula FeIn2S4. Indium ore. A rare, black crystalline mineral. Often found in what were once hydrothermal deposits or asteroids that have been heated in their past. It is widely refined into Indium.
indite_info_short: Produced by: Extraction Consumed by: Refinery Chemical formula FeIn2S4.
indium_info:
Produced by: Refinery
Consumed by: High Tech and Industrial

Indium, In, atomic number 49. Melting point 429K. Used industrially and in high tech for a wide range of alloys, including superconductors, sensors and holo projectors.
indium_info_short: Produced by: Refinery Consumed by: High Tech and Industrial Indium, In, atomic number 49. Melting point 429K.
industrialfirmware_info:
Captured from settlement data point networks. Known to be salvaged from signal sources.

Control software for industrial hardware interfaces normally follows strict operational and installation guidelines. Cracked versions of these can be found, but are often kept secret as such industrial espionage is punished severely, making these cracks quite valuable.
industrialfirmware_info_short: Captured from settlement data point networks. Known to be salvaged from signal sources.
industrialminerals_info: Mined and harvested (often on the mega-industrial scale) across the edges of human civilisation, industrial minerals are used as vital base components in various construction industries.
industrialminerals_info_short: Mined and harvested across the edges of human civilisation.
industrialwaste_info: Non-recyclable matter, industrial waste is in vast supply with understandably low demand.
inertiacanister_info: A specialised container for the safe storage of unstable agents.
infectedship_arrival04: Warning! Warning! Hazardous cargo onboard! Maintain your distance!
infectedship_attackrun01: Remember we didn't ask for this!
infectedship_attackrun02: You'll be the one needing medical attention after I'm through with you!
infectedship_attackrun03: We're not going down without a fight!
infectedship_attackrun04: I hope you're ready to die, I know we are.
infectedship_attackrun05: We've got nothing to lose. How about you?
infectedship_neardeath01: At least this way it will be quick.
infectedship_neardeath03: Whatever they're paying you can't be worth this...
infectedship_neardeath04: I won't let you do this!
infectedship_neardeath05: Lady smile on us in our time of need.

infectedship_ondeclarepiracythreaten03: You are not taking our supplies!
infectedship_ondeclarepiracythreaten04: I won't let you burn us. These people can still be saved!
infectedship_ondeclarepiracythreaten05: Just let us pass. This doesn't need to be a fight.

informantcovertmeeting_attackrun_01: I've got some information for you. You're dead.
informantcovertmeeting_attackrun_02: You're not going to be able to tell anyone what you saw.
informantcovertmeeting_attackrun_03: I should inform you of your impending death.
informantcovertmeeting_attackrun_04: You're not going to be able to inform on me when you're dead.
informantcovertmeeting_attackrun_05: When I'm done with you there will be no body to find.
informantcovertmeeting_onarrival_03: Let's make this quick before they miss me and start asking questions.
informantcovertmeeting_oncargodroneattac: Take anything you like, nothing is worth dying over.
You don't know who you're messing with pal.
If you steal this cargo they will hunt you down and kill you. Or worse.
Run and hide, because stealing this cargo will put a huge price on your head.
Trust me pal, you don't want to steal this thing. They'll do more than kill you for it.
informantcovertmeeting_stationed_01: Here's the information you asked for. No questions asked, as usual.
informantcovertmeeting_stationed_02: All this sneaking around is making me nervous. If anyone finds out I'm informing on them I'm dead.
informantcovertmeeting_stationed_03: Here's the data you wanted. I don't want to know what this is about. Just pay me and I'll be out of here.
informantcovertmeeting_stationed_04: If they find out that I'm feeding you information I'm dead. You're going to protect me right?
informantcovertmeeting_stationed_05: No one can know that I've given you this stuff. As far as anyone else is concerned I'm on my way to the other side of the sector.
informantcovertmeeting_stationed_06: This is the last time. I can't do this anymore people are asking questions.
informantcovertmeeting_stationed_07: The transponders have been disabled so no one is going to track this data.
informantcovertmeeting_stationed_08: I'm taking a big risk bringing you this stuff. I expect to be projected when it all goes down. You promised me immunity.
informantcovertmeeting_stationed_09: If I give you this information you're going to put them away right? I mean I don't want to have to look over my shoulder the rest of my life.
informantcovertmeeting_stationed_10: How much more information do you need? It's been long enough, this is the last time.
informantcovertmeeting_underfire_01: They sent you to kill me didn't they.
informantcovertmeeting_underfire_02: I told you, now they're going to kill me.
informantcovertmeeting_underfire_03: They forced me to get them the information. I had no choice. Please don't kill me.
informantcovertmeeting_underfire_05: Please I didn't mean to... I didn't... it was that or the prison colony.
informantcovertmeeting_veryneardeath_01: They'll come for you one day assassin.
informantcovertmeeting_veryneardeath_02: I knew these deliveries would get me killed.
informantcruisechatter_01: Delivery to a shady character in the middle of nowhere. What could go wrong?
informantcruisechatter_02: I'm not getting enough to make these sorts of deliveries. I need to get out of this.
informantcruisechatter_03: Why do I have to fly all the way out here? This is getting too risky.
informantcruisechatter_04: This job is definitely not worth the risks I'm taking.
informantcruisechatter_05: Pilot log: If anything happens to me check locker BRY-861. Send it to GalNet. It's my insurance policy.

inra_site001_001_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...
...Site records found...

Everything is in place.

If the Thargoids take the bait, this facility should come under attack very soon. And when it does, we'll find out if our new weapons are worth a damn.

It's taken a lot of time and effort to make this place look like an important military site. I just hope they fall for it. It's about time we started fighting back.
inra_site001_002_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...
...Site records found...

Everyone's on edge. It's like seeing an approaching storm and waiting for it to break. The air is heavy with the threat of violence.

Maybe they didn't take the bait? Maybe we hid it too well? Or maybe we didn't hide it well enough. What if they realised this is a trap?

I suppose it's too late to worry about that now. All we can do is watch the sky, and wait.
inra_site001_003_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...
...Site records found...

Contact confirmed! Thargoids 1,000 light seconds from site and closing. Ready all weapon systems and prepare to fire on my order. We've only got one shot at this and I don't want to miss.

Wait... wait. What is that? That's not a regular Thargoid ship. It's huge.

Will somebody scan that thing! And tell command we've got a mothership here. Get them the data as soon as possible.

All right, all right, that's close enough. Fire all batteries!
inra_site001_004_body:

Test unsuccessful...targets suffered minimal damage...site lost...all operatives...lost...
inra_site002_001_body:
