To: Trystan Law, Corporate Liaison

I understand that this is lucrative contract, but I really think we need to take a second look at the production schedule. We have neither the facilities nor the workforce to deliver what's been promised. Furthermore, the facility should be subjected to a complete decontamination before we start. That could take weeks.

Essentially, we can't produce the chemicals in the quantity requested within the given timeframe. It just can't be done.

I'd also like to renew my request for more information on the purpose of the chemical.

Jarah Cook
Site Manager
inra_site002_002_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...
...Accessing corporate records...

To: Elgii Sung, Site Manager

Welcome to the position of Site Manager. We are looking forward to working with you on the mycoid project.

I understand that you have raised questions regarding the reassignment of your predecessor. It was decided that her experience and expertise could be put to better use in another part of our organisation.

As discussed, it is of the utmost importance that the chemical be in production within three weeks.

We have every faith in you.

Trystan Law
Corporate Liaison
inra_site002_003_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...
...Accessing corporate records...

To: Elgii Sung, Site Manager

Our analysis has confirmed that the latest batch was contaminated, and is therefore useless. I'm sure we hardly need remind you how essential it is that this project proceeds without complication. The cause of the contamination must be determined immediately. 

We cannot afford any more mistakes.

Trystan Law
Corporate Liaison
inra_site002_004_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...
...Corporate records found...

To: Trystan Law, Corporate Liaison

The issue with the previous batch arose because your unrealistic deadlines forced us to take shortcuts. If we were given more time, mistakes of this kind would not occur.

With that said, we have rectified the issue and extended working hours so we can replace the tainted batch without deviating from schedule. The next shipment will arrive in HIP 7158 A 2 D within 72 hours.

Elgii Sung
Site Manager
inra_site003_001_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...
...Personal log 1/4...

Complex molecular chains detected
Bonds weakened by corrosive agent
Unable to identify agent
Structural analysis complete

Organic material analysed
Possible contaminant identified
Composition scan complete

Always the same results. I keep telling them: there's only so much we can do with the samples we've been given. We need a living specimen.
inra_site003_002_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...
...Personal log 2/4...

Apparently they listened to me. We've been asked to build some testing apparatus and a secure enclosure. I drew up a preliminary specification but was told the enclosure needed to be more robust.

These creatures must be tremendously strong.
inra_site003_003_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...
...Personal log 3/4...

The specimen arrived today. The security reports indicate that it made several escape attempts, the most recent of which resulted in a number of deaths. We must take every precaution.

The specimen appears to be in poor physical health, but it's undoubtedly alive, and it will certainly serve our purposes.
inra_site003_004_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...
...Personal log 4/4...

The specimen is highly resilient and seems to be able to withstand severe physical trauma, even to the point of losing limbs. I was reminded of pulling the legs off spiders as a child. Fortunately, testing on a nonhuman means no legal red tape to slow things down.

Tomorrow we will begin experimenting with chemical and biological weapons. These creatures may be tough, but we will find their weakness.
inra_site004_001_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...
...Accessing communications log...

Every day the haulers come, dropping off more of the stuff. Others come to pick it up. We've been told not to ask questions. See, there's rumours it's some kind of pesticide, right. But with the amount we've got in storage, they must be expecting one hell of an outbreak.
inra_site004_002_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...
...Accessing communications log...

Some of the top brass from INRA's visiting. The boss said he was here to talk about investment, but this guy had a military smell all over him. I know the public thinks that INRA is this great cooperative enterprise, but I don't buy it. I think there's more to them than meets the eye.

One thing's for sure - they're running the show here.
inra_site004_003_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...
...Accessing communications log...

So, the inbound haulers have stopped coming, but the collection ships are still flying in. The place finally is being emptied.

I was talking to one of the hauler pilots down the docks today. According to her, this is all part of some kind of top-secret anti-Thargoid weapon thing. Apparently they're flying the stuff to a med-research facility in LP 389-95 7, wherever that is. She reckons, this has been going on for months, at sites all over the galaxy.

So it's not pesticide then - well, at least not in the conventional sense.
inra_site005_001_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...

Finally, we have a breakthrough. A researcher at the facility in the Hermitage 4 A system has found something - stumbled onto something, by all accounts - and it's pushed our research forward dramatically.

Essentially, it's a kind of fungus - one that appears to have a significant effect on Thargoid technology. We knew their tech was partly biological, but until now we couldn't find a way to use that fact to our advantage.

The theory is that if we could somehow get the fungus into their starships - specifically their hyperdrives - we could shut them down. They'd be unable to leave their system.

We could end the war in a single stroke.
inra_site005_002_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...

We have built a dedicated new laboratory so we can properly test the effects of the mycoid. We also have access to an intact Thargoid ship and a living specimen. I plan to test the mycoid on both. Some of my colleagues have expressed reservations about experimenting on a living creature, but I have no such qualms. We must know what the mycoid can do.
inra_site005_003_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...

Excellent news: we have received a second specimen. We can now accelerate the pace of our testing.

So far, our experiments indicate that the fungus affects not only the Thargoids' technology but also their physiology, as evidenced by the degeneration of our specimen. These results are highly encouraging. If the mycoid can hurt them - truly hurt them - we may have found the means to win this war.

Several of my colleagues have left the project in protest over our treatment of the creature. If it were up to me, I would have them executed as traitors.
inra_site005_004_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...

Our latest tests were extremely successful. The mycoid can paralyse a Thargoid system - either physical or technological - in a matter of seconds. It is extremely effective.

I confess: the knowledge that the mycoid causes the Thargoids physical pain brings me some measure of satisfaction. But when one has seen, first hand, the effect of their weapons - seen the destruction, the chaos, the bodies - can one be blamed for wanting them to suffer, as we have?
inra_site005_005_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...

The haulers have departed for the HIP 59382 1 B system with the samples, ready to start mass production. We know the mycoid works. Now it falls to other members of the project to determine how it can be effectively deployed.

I know there are some who will condemn me for my part in this project. Let them. I harbour no remorse.

The Thargoids understand only one thing: destruction. They will not stop until every last one of us has been reduced to dust. We have created a weapon that can prevent such a catastrophe. We have a moral obligation to use it.
inra_site006_001_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...
...Communications record 1/3...

I'll admit, I had my reservations about this Commander Jameson. I looked into his background and apparently he climbed the ranks of the Pilots' Federation with unprecedented speed. He's revered by other pilots. But that doesn't mean he's suited to the task.

But then it struck me - all we need is someone who can get the payload where it needs to go. The hard work - the development of the mycoid - has already been done. All Jameson has to do is push a button.

The important thing is to play up the whole 'saving humanity' angle. Make him feel like a hero. That should stop him asking too many questions.

And if everything goes wrong, we can just pin the blame on him.
inra_site006_002_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...
...Communications record 2/3...

Having received the payload from the Alnath system we've prepared a number of medium-range missiles loaded with the weaponised version of the mycoid.

Jameson will be here in three days to prep for the mission, which should give us more than enough time to fit his vessel. Apparently he insisted on using his own ship. I've also ordered that some special modifications be made to his craft.

He'll have to get close to launch the missiles, so it's unlikely he'll be coming back. But if he does survive, there are contingencies in place.
inra_site006_003_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...
...Communications record 3/3...

To: Commander Jameson
From: Amaro Hem, Programme Coordinator

Welcome, Commander Jameson. Your reputation precedes you. We are extremely grateful you chose to accept this mission.

I understand that the purpose of the assignment has been explained to you, but allow me to reiterate: this mission, if executed successfully, could mean the end of our war with the Thargoids. Its importance cannot be overstated.

The consignment has been loaded onto your ship. We have made some minor modifications to your vessel, but it should not affect the performance or functionality in any way.

This is an extremely dangerous mission, Commander. You will be heading deep into enemy territory. If anything goes wrong, you're on your own.

Good luck, Commander. The future of the human race is in your hands. All our hopes and prayers go with you.
inra_site007_001_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...

Personal Log: Kiona Li, Senior Medical Officer

I don't know who they were, exactly. Some corporate bigwigs. But they definitely convinced the board.

I can't say I'm surprised. They offered a lot of money for access to our labs apparently. The board probably didn't even ask what they wanted them for.

At least I got the bosses to promise the lab wouldn't be used to make biological weapons. This is a medical facility, after all. I will not be bullied into participating in this so-called war just because some corporation gave us their money.
inra_site007_002_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...

Personal Log: Kiona Li, Senior Medical Officer

It turns out they want us to make some kind of vaccine, an antidote for an unnamed biological weapon.

They've given us samples and data, but whenever we press for more information our requests are met with silence. We're working in the dark. With our hands tied behind our backs.

In practical terms we've got everything we could need, but I have no idea where half of it comes from. They've given us material the weapon has been tested on, both organic and inorganic, human and nonhuman.

I'm starting to wonder if the weapon is even designed to target humans.
inra_site007_003_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...

Personal Log: Kiona Li, Senior Medical Officer

We've finally been given access to a sample of the weapon, and it's opened up all kinds of avenues. 

I still worry about the ease with which our benefactors acquired the samples, but I'm probably just being paranoid. They obviously have deep pockets. Having access to unlimited funds must open all kinds of doors.
inra_site007_004_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...
Personal Log: Kiona Li, Senior Medical Officer

After months of research the solution ended up being pretty simple. Once you break it down it's a fairly straightforward organic compound - little more than a fungus, really.

We tested the vaccine on some of the older samples, and while it doesn't undo any existing damage, it does prevent the weapon from doing any further harm.

Our sponsors certainly seem happy.
inra_site007_005_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...
Personal Log: Kiona Li, Senior Medical Officer

The lab is being dismantled. Seems our sponsors want to move us to a new location. Their representatives appeared a few days ago, demanded that all data be transferred to their servers and all samples be put into storage, ready to be moved.

Why are they doing this? The lab more than meets our needs - they made sure of it. I tried to talk to them, but I just got stonewalled. Apparently all information is on a need-to-know basis. And I don't need to know.
inra_site008_001_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...
Personal Log: Bexley Prince, Chief Researcher

We received a very exciting delivery today: pieces of recovered Thargoid technology, even fragments of spacecraft. Most of the samples are damaged, but we should still be able to put them to good use.

Thargoid technology is, in many respects, far more advanced than our own. Understanding it could open up all kinds of possibilities and rapidly accelerate our own development. Space travel, energy, weapons, even medicine - the applications are potentially limitless.

I suspect there's a key discovery to be made, one that will open up the aliens' technology to us. Who knows? Perhaps I'll be the one to make it.

But I'm getting ahead of myself. There's lots of work to be done before we can start popping champagne corks. I've given the research teams their assignments. Let's see what they can find out.
inra_site008_002_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...
Personal Log: Bexley Prince, Chief Researcher

Progress is slow and much of what we knew about the Thargoids - or thought we knew - has had to be revised. But I suppose that's to be expected.

We now have twelve active research projects, focusing on a number of different areas. I find myself growing impatient with some of my colleagues, but that's the problem with being a perfectionist. I set high standards for myself, and I expect others to do the same.
inra_site008_003_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...
Personal Log: Bexley Prince, Chief Researcher

Phase three has been a failure. I sincerely believed we were making progress, but just because something works in theory does not mean it will work in practice.

There have also been issues with the junior researchers. Some of them think they're being monitored, and one... one actually believes she's being held here against her will. Of course, those who have worked in this sector before, know this is not the case.

Naturally our employers keep an eye on us - the work we're doing is extremely sensitive. We're researching alien technology, after all. It's a question of security.

Some people can find a conspiracy in anything.
inra_site008_004_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...

Personal Log: Bexley Prince, Chief Researcher

Our employers have become preoccupied with one of the research projects, although I've repeatedly told them it's a dead end. It isn't even an official project - it's just something that one of the junior researchers cooked up in his spare time.

He's a specialist in agricultural science, trying to wipe out famine or something. Apparently he's created a biological agent that incapacitates the alien technology. Here we are, devoting millions of credits and countless hours to understanding this technology, and he's trying to destroy it! If it were up to me I'd cut him from the project entirely, but our employers seem to think his work has merit.
inra_site009_001_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...
Personal Log: Effie Ratling, Engineer

They told me not to ask where it came from, just to reverse-engineer whatever I can. Weapons, shields, power management - anything I can figure out. It's... it's like giving a rocket to a Neanderthal and expecting them to fix it. I mean, where do I even start?

At least they're paying me well. That's something.
inra_site009_002_body:
...Bypassing Security Protocols...
...Secure Connection Established...
Personal Log: Effie Ratling, Engineer

I haven't slept for days. I always did find it hard to switch off, you know, even when I wasn't trying to reverse-engineer an alien starship.

I've made a small amount of progress, but it's always two steps forward, three steps back. The guys in charge are getting impatient, but what did they expect? It's not like this thing came with a manual.
inra_site009_003_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...
Personal Log: Effie Ratling, Engineer

I've finally made some progress with the drive technology, which is just as well, since I was running out of options.

Thargoid drive tech differs radically from our own. Rather than shift space around the ship, it appears to create this stable wormhole for the ship to travel through. It sounds crazy, but the maths don't lie. And if my calculations are right, I might even be able to replicate it.

I want to get a prototype up and running as soon as possible. Something tells me the bigwigs are about to step in. I've seen this all before - you get hired by a big company, and once you've gone and done the hard work they swoop in and take all the glory. Well, I'm not going to let that happen, I want to be credited with creating the first hybrid drive.
inra_site009_004_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...
Personal Log: Effie Ratling, Engineer

I knew it. The minute I handed in my report, the company took over. They've retained me as a 'consultant' - whatever that means - but they're basically ignoring everything I say.

They've made some modifications to my prototype, but it was a bit of a rush job. Must be in a hell of a hurry to get to the test-flight stage. I told them it was too soon, that we needed more tests, but once again, I got stonewalled.

Granted, the wormhole is stable, but we have no idea what will happen when you send a human being through it.
inra_site009_005_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...
Personal Log: Effie Ratling, Engineer

So, they decided to push ahead with the test flight, despite my warnings. Some hotshot young pilot, full of spit and vinegar, as my old man would say. And not a single brain cell between his ears.

The wormhole was stable, but that was never a concern. The question is what will happen to the pilot.
inra_site009_006_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...
Personal Log: Effie Ratling, Engineer

The ship didn't reappear for almost an hour. When it did, it just drifted lifelessly. The pilot didn't respond to our hails.

We recovered the vessel and pulled open the cockpit. What I saw in there will stay with me for the rest of my life. The pilot looked like he'd been turned inside out. That cocky young kid who thought he ruled the sky.

I have to say, my sympathy didn't last long when I found out they're going to pin it on me. They've cancelled the project and launched an investigation, but that's just window dressing. There's no doubt in my mind they'll carry on testing in secret. Meanwhile, I'm the one who's going to take the fall.

There is a chance I might be able to make it out of this. Apparently they've developed some kind of Thargoid-killing super weapon, and they don't want so much as a whisper in the public domain. So this is the choice I'm going to give them: Let me walk, and I say nothing. Set me up, and everyone discovers that the INRA is in the genocide business.

It's a risky move, but what other choice do I have?
inra_site010_001_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...

I don't have long. Once they realise I'm gone and the data has been copied, they'll send their attack dogs after me, I know they will. But someone needs to show the galaxy what the INRA really is - what it's doing, what it's hiding.
inra_site010_002_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...

I'm sorry for the part I've played in this. Truly.

I was a researcher at a facility in the Hermitage 4 A system exploring agricultural applications of Thargoid-derived technology. The lab was owned by the INRA.

Publicly, the INRA likes to emphasise the whole altruistic and cooperative thing, but in recent years it's become much more focused on weapons testing and manufacture. Believe me, it's a military contractor in all but name.
inra_site010_003_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...

The nature of my field was the study of disease-resistant crops and mycoproteins, that sort of thing. I was getting good results, even if my superiors took no notice. Then everything changed.

I was running a bunch of control experiments, just trying a few things out really. It was an afterthought - it wasn't even related to the main body of my work.

The results were interesting and I didn't think they were particularly significant, but something made me take it directly to one of the INRA guys. I didn't want to go to Dr Prince, she'd always been pretty dismissive of my work.

I would give anything to be able to undo that decision. Anything.
inra_site010_004_body:
...Bypassing security protocols...
...Secure connection established...

All my equipment and samples were whisked off to some remote facility. Later, I found out they'd been taken to a weapons-testing site in the Alnath A 2 A A system.

My research was used as the basis of a new super weapon designed to destroy the Thargoids. I heard they experimented on live captives. I doubt any of it was strictly legal. It certainly wasn't ethical.

To the public, the INRA is a symbol of all that is possible when superpowers set aside their differences and work together. Well, it might have started off like that, but it's something very different now. Progress at any cost, might makes right - all our worst impulses channelled into an unaccountable organisation focused solely on making bigger and more powerful weapons. Bigger and more powerful weapons. God.

If you find this... if someone finds this, make sure it gets out. Please. It's time people knew the truth.

insurgentuaambush_onarrival_03: We're here for the cargo. Surrender the artefact and you'll get out of this alive.

insurgentuaambush_onarrival_05: This artefact will soon belong to us. Resistance is not advised.
insurgentuaambush_onarrival_06: You see the target, right? Good. Let's go.
insurgentuaambush_onarrival_07: Keep an eye out for security. I don't want any losses this time.
insurgentuaambush_onarrival_08: The transport is our target. Destroy any opposition.
insurgentuaambush_onarrival_09: Okay, you all know what to do. Let's take the transport.
insurgentuaambush_onarrival_10: Attention, civilian pilots. We have come to claim the cargo transport. Do not interfere and you will come to no harm.
int_buggybay_size2_class1_info: Module designed to house ground-based vehicles.
int_buggybay_size2_class1_longinfo: Planetary vehicle hangars are designed to store ground-roving vehicles. Each vehicle bay is equipped to fully support and maintain a single vehicle of a specific type.
int_cargorack_size1_class1_info: Standardised storage rack for use in automated cargo transfer systems.
int_cloud_resistant_sensors_size1_class3: A sensor that can operate within a Thargoid cloud, but has a smaller range than a standard sensor.
Specifically designed to function within a Thargoid cloud, these sensors can generate a detailed assessment of a ship
int_codexscanner_info: Scanner that undertakes a complete compositional analysis of most simple biological and non-biological entities. This data is then uploaded to the ship's codex and catalogued appropriately. If an object has not been previously scanned, a full scan will automatically create a new entry in the codex. Ship must be in analysis mode to operate a composition scanner.
int_colonisation_info: Advanced surface placement calculation and beacon deployment suite to facilitate the colonisation of star systems.
int_corrosionproofcargorack_size1_class1: Cargo rack designed to safely house corrosive payloads. Compatible with automated cargo transfer systems found in hangar bays.
These cargo racks have been insulated with a specialised synthetic material, offering resistance to corrosive materials and protection from all known radiation types.
int_detailedsurfacescanner_tiny_info:
Advanced astronomical scanner that launches probes. Used to reveal important information about planets and stellar bodies.
- Functions in analysis mode.
int_detailedsurfacescanner_tiny_longinfo: Detailed surface scanners launch sensor probes that scan a planet's surface. Each manually aimed probe will arc towards a targeted planet and deploy sensors to sweep a large surface area. Once a body's surface has full sensor coverage all notable sites will be revealed. Can only be used in supercruise. Ship must be in analysis mode to operate this module.
int_dockingcomputer_advanced_info: Ship computer utility capable of completing both the docking and launch sequences without pilot input.
int_dockingcomputer_advanced_longinfo: Advanced docking computers provide guidance to a ship when approaching or leaving a landing pad. To engage the docking function, the pilot must engage the module by moving into range of the destination and throttling down to zero. An 'Auto-Launch' option will be listed when docked which will engage the launch feature. Raising the throttle manually when docking or launching will disengage the module.
int_dockingcomputer_standard_info: Ship computer utility capable of completing a typical docking sequence without pilot input.
int_dockingcomputer_standard_longinfo: Standard docking computers provide additional controls to the main ship computer when approaching an assigned landing pad. Following a successful docking request, the pilot must engage the module by moving within range of the destination and throttling down to zero. Manually raising the throttle again will disengage the module.
int_dronecontrol_collection_size1_class1: Directs limpets to collect canisters, salvage and asteroid chunks.

Limpets controlled by this module collect objects and return them to the parent ship. With a target selected, deploying the limpet will initiate the retrieval of that item. Alternatively a limpet can also be deployed with no target selected, and it will autonomously collect any available nearby object for a set time. Using limpets to collect asteroid chunks requires a refinery module. Limpets cannot be recovered after deployment.
int_dronecontrol_decontamination_size1_c: Directs a limpet to remove caustic chemicals from a ship's hull while simultaneously carrying out a small amount of hull repair.

Limpets controlled by this module are a variant of the standard repair limpet. They clean off corrosive chemicals from a ship's outer hull, carrying out a limited amount of hull repairs at the same time. Any further external damage to the targeted vessel will cancel the process immediately.
int_dronecontrol_fueltransfer_size1_clas: Directs a limpet to transfer fuel to a targeted ship.

Limpets controlled by this module transfer fuel between ships in increments of one ton. Fuel is taken from the parent ship's main tank and delivered to the targeted ship via the limpet. Limpets cannot be recovered after deployment.
int_dronecontrol_prospector_size1_class1: Directs a limpet to assess an asteroid's composition.

Limpets controlled by this module are used to analyse an asteroid to discover its composition. When successfully deployed to the surface of an asteroid, an internal scan displays any deposits and highlights them in analysis mode. Once deployed further composition information can be obtained via targeting the limpet and reviewing the cockpit interface. Limpets cannot be recovered after deployment.
int_dronecontrol_recon_size1_class1_info: Directs a limpet to hack into data points.
int_dronecontrol_recon_size1_class1_long: Limpets controlled by this module utilise advanced decryption software to break into secure data storage nodes. They can be attached to data points on ships or structures, and will quickly retrieve any information stored there. WARNING: this may be considered an illegal act in lawful systems.
int_dronecontrol_repair_size1_class1_inf: Directs a limpet to repair an amount of damage to the hull of a targeted ship.
int_dronecontrol_repair_size1_class1_lon: Limpets controlled by this module carry out repairs on the hull of a targeted ship. Multiple limpets may be required to fully repair a target's hull. During this process both vessels must remain within a reasonable distance of each other. Any external damage to the targetted vessel will cancel the repair process immediately. Limpets cannot be recovered after deployment.
int_dronecontrol_resourcesiphon_size1_cl: Control unit that can program a blank limpet to hack a target's hold, causing cargo ejection.
int_dronecontrol_unkvesselresearch_info: Directs a limpet to scrape samples and bio-matter from the surface of an alien vessel.
int_dronecontrol_unkvesselresearch_longi: Limpets controlled by this module latch onto alien vessels and collect samples directly from the hull. This process takes time, during which both ships must remain within a reasonable distance of each other. Once a sample has been successfully retrieved the limpet will return to its parent vessel.
int_engine_size2_class5_fast_info: Improved propulsion system for ships, capable of greater speeds.
int_engine_size3_class5_fast_info: Improved propulsion system for ships, capable of greater speeds.
int_engine_size7_class5_gravityoptimised: Improved propulsion system for ships, optimised to better counter the effects of gravity near planet surfaces.
int_expmodulestabiliser_size3_class3_inf: Stabilises the stress typically applied to a ship's structural integrity by experimental weapons. This increase the number of such weapons a ship can safely deploy. Increases Experimental Weapon Limit by 1.
int_expmodulestabiliser_size5_class3_inf: Stabilises the stress typically applied to a ship's structural integrity by experimental weapons. This increase the number of such weapons a ship can safely deploy. Increases Experimental Weapon Limit by 2.

int_fighterbay_size7_class1_info: $Int_FighterBay_Size5_Class1_Info; Vessel Hangar variant that can reproduce 30 vessels, a significantly larger number than other models.
int_fighterbaymk2_size5_class1_info: Mk II Internal bay designed to house ship-launched vehicles.
int_fighterbaymk2_size7_class1_info: $Int_FighterBayMk2_Size5_Class1_Info; Vessel Hangar variant that can reproduce 30 vessels, a significantly larger number than other models.
int_fsdinterdictor_size1_class1_info: Forces targeted ships to drop out of supercruise.
int_fsdinterdictor_size1_class1_longinfo:
Frame shift drive interdictors are capable of locking onto a target ship remotely destabilising its frame shift drive, forcing it out of supercruise alongside the interdicting vessel.

The target must be in front of the interdicting ship, facing a similar direction and within range. Once an interdiction attempt is initiated a tether will connect the two ships. The interdictor must keep the target central to the provided reticule. If the target manages to prevent interdiction by establishing an escape vector then the interdicting vessel will drop out of supercruise alone.

Interdiction causes light damage to all ships involved, and targeted pilots may submit to an interdiction by throttling down to prevent this damage. Interdicting a vessel that is not currently wanted by local authorities is a crime.
int_fuelscoop_info: Collects fuel by scooping hydrogen from the vicinity of a suitable star.
int_fuelscoop_longinfo:
Fuel scoops are designed to process hydrogen found in the corona of certain star types and converting it into usable fuel. It is an automatic process if the fuel scoop is active. The rate of fuel gain is based on the quality and size of the scoop and proximity to the star. Venturing too close to a star can cause a ship to incur heat damage. 

The following star classes can be scooped for fuel: O B A F G K M
int_fuelscoop_size1_class1_info: Collects fuel by scooping hydrogen from the vicinity of a suitable star.

int_guardianfsdbooster_size1_info: Boosts the output of frame shift drives, increasing a ship's potential hyperspace jump range.
int_guardianfsdbooster_size1_longinfo: A module that utilises Guardian technology to boost the capabilities of a frame shift drive, providing an increase in power and hyperspace jump capabilities. Fuel efficiency is also enhanced, increasing the distance travelled per unit of fuel and enabling single hyperspace jumps of greater range.
int_guardianhullreinforcement_size1_clas: Powered module that increases a ship's hull integrity and resistance to Thargoid, caustic and thermal damage.
int_guardianmodulereinforcement_size1_cl: Protects other modules against weapons fire that penetrates the hull. This variant is based on Guardian technology and is resistant to Thargoid lightning attacks and HUD scrambling.

Protects other modules against weapons fire that penetrates the hull. The module utilises a built-in damage capacitor to absorb a percentage of incoming damage, eventually burning out when its capacity reaches zero. This variant is based on Guardian technology and is resistant against Thargoid lightning attacks and HUD scrambling.
int_guardianpowerdistributor_size1_info: Distribution system for ENG, SYS and WEP capacitors. Also boosts overall power output of any power plant it is hooked into.
int_guardianpowerplant_size2_info: Primary power source for all ship modules and functions. Enhanced with Guardian technology to generate additional power at the cost of increased heat and mass.
int_guardianshieldreinforcement_size1_cl: Module that uses Guardian technology to increase a ship's shield health.
int_hullreinforcement_size1_class1_info: Increases a ship's hull integrity and resistance to damage.
int_hyperdrive_overcharge_engineered_v1_: Unlocking this will add one engineered FSD (SCO) to your storage. The Engineered FSD (SCO) V1 is a long range, fast boot FSD. This blueprint speeds up boot up times and gives Longer range jumps, at the cost of module integrity, power draw, thermal load and higher mass.

int_refinery_class1_info: Converts fragments of mined resources into tradable commodity units.
int_refinery_class1_longinfo: Refineries are used to process resources collected from asteroids and planetary rings, turning them into standard commodity units. Collected resource fragments are automatically assigned to an available refinery bin. Each bin can hold one resource type at a time. Once a refinery bin reaches 100% a single unit of that resource will be placed in the ship's cargo hold, with any remaining resources left in the bin. Undesired resources can be vented, freeing up the bin for a new type.

int_repairer_info: Allows in-flight repair of internal ship modules and can restore broken modules. Requires ammunition.
int_repairer_longinfo: Auto Field-Maintenance Units (AFM) repair ship modules. With an AFM installed, pilots can set individual modules to a Repair state in the Modules list of the Internal interface screen. The AFM will slowly fix damaged modules that are set to Repair but will consume resources to do so, as indicated in the module list. The AFM can be resupplied at starports and outposts from the munitions interface.

int_shieldcellbank_class1_longinfo: Shield cell banks use pre-charged cells to quickly reinforce a ship's active shields. A shield cell requires a warm-up period before it will regenerate shields. During this period the shield is vulnerable to further attack. If the shield collapses during the warm-up period, the shield cell will engage with no effect.

Activating the discovery scanner will release a massive electromagnetic wave that searches for and identifies energy emissions from planets and other signal sources. The scanner also identifies nearby astronomical bodies by targeting them for a basic scan. Can only be used in supercruise. Ship must be in analysis mode to operate this module.

int_supercruiseassist_info: Ship computer utility that provides additional supercruise guidance to a selected destination.
int_supercruiseassist_longinfo: Supercruise Assist modules regulate a ship's approach towards a set location within its current star system. To engage, the ship should be in supercruise and aligned with the target destination with the throttle centred in the blue zone. Supercruise Assist will disengage if the ship's trajectory or speed are manually adjusted, if a new target is selected, or in the event of interdiction or sudden close proximity to an object. This module can also establish orbit around a planetary body.

iron_info:
Collected on planet surfaces and from asteroids.

Iron, Fe, atomic number 26. Melting point 1811K. Iron is one of the most abundant heavier elements in the galaxy, primarily due to the formation through fusion in massive stars of nickel-56, which decays into an iron isotope. Although it isn't used as much in modern metals it still has many uses in chemical production. It's also an important element in medical molecular engineering applications.

This entertainment device uses concentrated radiation bursts to detect the desires of the player and automatically creates a game with every feature they could desire. Each unit is unique, and will self customise to represent its owner. Use of another person's puzzle box is considered a great social faux pas.

This rare good is legal in all markets except for Dictatorship markets and Imperial Confederacy markets.

This rare good is legal in all markets.
jarouarice_info_short: Grown in the paddy fields of Jaroua, bioengineered filter fish are used to remove any pests or parasites attached to the plant.
jeromearcher_overview_control_ethos: Shadow President Archer is a strong advocate of heavy surveillance and well-funded intelligence services. His supporters utilise these tools to guide Federal security policy in systems under his influence.
jeromearcher_overview_description: Shadow President Jerome Archer is the chosen successor of Zachary Hudson. He holds similar political values to his mentor, prioritising military spending and advocating for minimal government burdens to the individual. Archer also believes that widespread public surveillance deters criminal actions inside the Federation and deters threats from outside it.
jeromearcher_overview_expansion_ethos: A core principle of Shadow President Archer's politics is that regular demonstrations of Federal military authority are used to ensure law and order is maintained.
jeromearcher_overview_preparation_ethos: A true patriot, Shadow President Archer believes that all human colonies would thrive under the auspices of Federal rule. He is willing to approve the use of force when needed, using the pretence of bolstering security within Federation-aligned systems.
jeromearcher_overview_quotation1: A parent watches over a child to keep it safe. To let them know they are loved. A government owes the same duty to its people.
jeromearcher_overview_quotation2: I'm not a career politician, oblivious to life on the streets of a big city. I grew up on those streets, then served as a cop on them. I know how bad things can get if we ignore the cries for help.
jeromearcher_overview_quotation3: Zachary Hudson taught me a lot about politics. I'm honoured to serve as the head of the Republican Party, as he did. I just hope I live up to his expectations.
jeromearcher_overview_quotation4: We owe it to every Federal citizen to maintain order and eliminate threats to the public. The results of this diligence will justify the methods used, I promise you.
jeromearcher_overview_quotation5: The Federation shouldn't forget that it represents the best of humanity. Its rich history and countless achievements are the foundations of our future success.

jotunmookah_info:
A small soft-furred quadruped that stains its multi-coloured fur sludge brown when it dies - an action that this highly nervous creature is pre-disposed to do at the drop of a hat. Professional comforters must work day and night to keep this creature from experiencing a heart attack. The meat is extremely bitter, but they have found a niche as an expensive accessory.

This rare good is legal in all markets.
jotunmookah_info_short: A small soft-furred, highly nervous creature. Professional care is required to keep this creature from suffering a heart attack.

kachiriginleaches_info:
Leeches were used medically for millennia on ancient Earth but were largely superseded by technology. Hundreds of years later, a chance discovery on Kachirigin revealed some very valuable properties of the native creatures. Kachirigin leeches can painlessly filter impurities from the user's blood, so can be used as a cure-all for hangovers and the worst effects of certain addictions. They are prized by the wealthy and hedonistic, and have an almost cult-like following.

This rare good is legal in all markets.
kachiriginleaches_info_short: Kachirigin leeches can painlessly filter impurities from the user's blood, can be used as a cure-all for hangovers and the worst effects of certain addictions.

kamorinhistoricweapons_info:
Kamorin Historic Weapons are happy to provide the re-enactor and enthusiast with fully-functional replicas of weapons from a number of important historical eras. Our expert team of craftsmen use traditional materials and methods, with a modern eye for quality. Exploring and researching the annals of history, our artisans continue to bring you the best of weapons from throughout the ages.

This rare good is legal in all Anarchy, Feudal and Dictatorship markets except for Imperial; Imperial and Independent Confederacy markets; and Independent and Allied Cooperative, Corporate and Communist markets.

Please note that if a market’s controlling faction changes, some formerly legal rare goods may become illegal. Should this occur the rare good will be unavailable for sale or purchase at that market for the duration of the prohibiting faction’s tenure.
kamorinhistoricweapons_info_short: Kamorin Historic Weapons provide the re-enactor and enthusiast with fully-functional replicas of weapons from a number of important historical eras.

krait_light_info:
With a spacious cargo hold and a relatively generous quantity of hardpoints, the Krait Phantom is a versatile ship suited to a range of roles. It has enough firepower to hold its own against larger targets, and enough straight-line speed to outpace smaller targets. The ship also offers eight internal compartments, allowing the pilot to tailor the ship to their requirements. And while it lacks the firepower and vessel bay of its sister ship, the Krait Mk II, it is both faster and lighter.

The Krait Phantom has been designed for medium-size landing pads.

krait_mkii_armour_grade3_info: Hull reinforcement using an advanced structure and military-grade compounds, offering superior protection against all types of attack.
krait_mkii_armour_mirrored_info: Hull reinforcement using a specially formulated structure, offering superior protection against thermal damage caused by energy weapons. It is vulnerable to projectile weapons and other kinetic attacks.
krait_mkii_armour_reactive_info: Hull reinforcement using a dynamically reactive, impact-resistant material offering superior protection against projectile weapons and other kinetic attacks. It is vulnerable to thermal damage caused by energy weapons.
krait_mkii_cockpit_info: Transparent protective canopy on a ship's cockpit that shields pilots from the many dangers of space travel.
krait_mkii_info:
The Krait Mk II is a reimagining of the Krait Lightspeeder, which was originally manufactured by Faulcon deLacy in the 3100s. Although the new ship is larger than the original, it possesses many of the same characteristics, emphasising speed, manoeuvrability and firepower over defensive capability. The ship also boasts a vessel bay and space for up to two crew members, making it a good option for those seeking a medium-weight, multipurpose vessel.

The Krait Mk II has been designed for medium-size landing pads.
kumocrew_overview_control_ethos: After nurturing the criminal element in a particular system, Archon Delaine then instigates infighting and violent insurrection, forcing any that might resist him to try and clean up the problem.
kumocrew_overview_description: Pirate King Archon Delaine grew up as part of the Kumo Crew family. His brutal appearance belies a shrewd and intelligent mind. He has elevated a small pirate gang to become a force feared throughout human space.
kumocrew_overview_expansion_ethos: Archon Delaine has no patience for weakness. He rules through intimidation and will divide and conquer those that are resistant to the Kumo Crew's presence. His enemies will pay the inevitable price in blood and have their families sold into slavery.
kumocrew_overview_preparation_ethos: Archon Delaine both nurtures and exploits criminal elements in a system, providing resources and contacts to ensure they pervade every level of society. Blackmail and bribery ensure that, in time, everyone owes something to the Kumo Crew.
kumocrew_overview_quotation1: A person only has as many rights as they can hold on to.
kumocrew_overview_quotation2: Power is the application of force to achieve one's aims. And one's aims should always include the expansion of that power.
kumocrew_overview_quotation3: Too much of humanity has grown soft and weak. I intend to take advantage of this complacency.
kumocrew_overview_quotation4: If you're not part of the Kumo Crew then you are nobody.
kumocrew_overview_quotation5: True riches will never be shared - they must be taken, through words or through weapons. My crew are experts in such exchanges.
lakonminer_cockpit_info: Transparent protective canopy on a ship's cockpit that shields pilots from the many dangers of space travel.
lakonminer_info:
Built upon the successful Type-8 platform, Lakon Spaceways has positioned the Type-11 Prospector to redefine medium-sized mining efficiency. Bespoke modules, lightweight construction materials and a no compromise cargo capacity make the Type-11 the obvious choice for the modern miner. A redesigned and reinforced drive housing grants the Type-11 superior management of overcharged Frame Shift Drives.

The Type-11 Prospector has been designed for medium-size landing pads.

lavecon_awayout_001_body: I'm on a cargo ship. It's called the Welcome Deviation, I think. Just another in a long list of vessels this gang has ransacked, but I'm determined this will be my last. I'm going to make my move soon. Just need the right opportunity.
lavecon_awayout_002_body: I've managed to hide some of the loot on this ship. I'll be back to pick up the stash when the rest of the gang have left, then with any luck Erin and I will be half way across the galaxy before anyone realises we've gone.
lavecon_awayout_003_body: I've managed to pick up the loot. Now I'm taking off... literally. I'm going to rendezvous with Erin in the Gaura system. I can only hope Norman doesn't try and come after us.
lavecon_blackriband_001_body:
OK this is how it's going to go.

The Lonegans have got fat and sloppy. They think they've got the sector sewn up. Mixing with the upper classes, throwing their parties and holding their races. Well it's time for some new blood round here.

But we can't just start a turf war. They've still got too many supporters, too many people in their pockets. We've got to be delicate with this. Go slow...careful.

First we discredit them, bring them low and then we strike. Start with that stupid race of theirs, The Black Riband.

Tear it down.
lavecon_blackriband_002_body: Time to move to phase 2. I want The Diamond Bear out of the skies and I want it to look like one of the other racers did it on orders from the Lonegans. I don't care who you pin it on, just make sure the pilot doesn't get a chance to get a message out.
lavecon_blackriband_003_body:
Plans working. The Lonegans are losing support and the bosses are almost ready to make their move. Let's clean this place, no evidence to lead back to the Goulds.

This is it boys, we're the new power in the region.
lavecon_cult_001_body:
Ships Log

I got away, I didn't think it would ever happen. Brother Aiden will punish the others when he finds that I'm gone, but I couldn't do this anymore.

There is no redemption, there is no master plan. It is lies, all of it.

I've stolen one of their ships, my plan was to head for Hutton Orbital, It's far enough out the way that no one will look for me there. But the ship is old and falling apart, some modules have begun to fail. I hope I can make it, but if not at least I've escaped that place. I never want to see Shibboleth 2 E again.
lavecon_cult_002_body:
Personal Log: Isla Elmasri

I can't believe I was so blind.

We've been lied to all this time. No one truly ascends. We toil under false truths and when the time comes these chosen ones, the ones that have given everything, are simply fodder for the slavers. Sold like so much cheap meat. One last contribution to the path. Isn't it curious that none of the senior borthers have ever ascended. Those that preach and deliver false truths. They remain.

I need to escape; I need to tell people what is happening here. But I fear that some of the senior brothers and sisters are suspicious of me. They watch me all the time, Brother Aiden especially. He's says we are not worthy to walk the path that our faith is impure. He is always watching.

I fear I will never escape.
lavecon_cult_003_body:
Personal Log: Brother Aiden

Some of the acolytes are in need of re-education, I have reasons to doubt their faith and we must set them upon the path. They are not true believers in the path. They bleat like sheep and follow. But they cannot see. Once they have given their all we shall be rid of them.

Elmasri in particular has become the thorn that digs into our flesh. She must be brought back to the path or silenced. Maybe we can accelerate her path to ascension. Yes, yes. Sister Elmasri will ascend.
lavecon_cult_004_body:
Recorded Message:

We the walkers on the path are chosen, we are the truth, we are the righteous, we are the children of the cosmos and we are the ones who shall ascend.

Ascension is the destination and the journey. It is the path that we all walk my brothers and sisters. We must give up our possessions, our riches, our senses over to it. Only then can we truly ascend.
lavecon_cult_005_body:
Recorded Message:

Many may attempt to divert us from the path, or reject the truth like Sister Isla. But they shall not steer us back to the impure. Our route has been plotted and cannot be altered. The non believer may be shown the path and encouraged to walk it. But only we the righteous may truly walk it.

For us ascension is close at hand. Rejoice. For others the path continues until they have fully given themselves over to it's teachings.

Now drink my brothers and sisters. Rejoice in your transcendence from this plain of existence to the next.

We are the children of the cosmos, the walkers of the path and we are the ones who shall ascend.
lavecon_delmonte_001_body: This is Captain Powell. We're marooned on this rock, but at least we're alive. And everything was going so well! We gathered data from an obelisk at an ancient ruin - a formula for a new alcoholic drink. It seemed too good to be true - we'd be able to manufacture it and then sell it as a new rare item. It was going to make us rich. Anyway, we might have got a bit carried away and started the distillation process on the ship... until something went wrong with the still and it exploded. We managed to crash land the ship and were lucky no one got injured. Now me, Red Wizard and Kyp Shard are stuck here waiting for someone to find us.
lavecon_delmonte_002_body: This is starting to get a little tedious. One day is just blurring into the next and what food we have we've had to ration. The only other thing we've been able to salvage from our ship was the still we'd built, but it seemed a waste not to use it. After all, when you're stranded on a rock in the middle of nowhere what else is there to do? It's a pity we didn't stock up on Kamitra Cigars - that might have turned this into a real vacation!
lavecon_delmonte_003_body: Looks like the vacation is over! Huros has just arrived to rescue us and not a moment too soon - we were starting to run out of booze! When we asked him how he found us he said, "My sensors detected high alcohol levels in this system and I had to check it out. That's when I found you jokers. Good job I've got room on board to take passenger, now lets get you back to the Gnosis... for a reasonable fee."  That guy is all heart!
lavecon_diamondbear_001_body:
They've killed me. I know it now. I'm just a smuggler, did the Black Riband a few times trying to get the record what did I do to deserve this?

On this last run these ships, black Diamondbacks, pull me out of supercruise and start firing. I've dealt with pirates before. These were no pirates. Told me they were sending a message. Making it look like someone else did this on the Lonegan's orders.

Their trying to take control of the sector, muscle in on the Lonegan's territory. Anyone linked to the Lonegan's is a target.
lavecon_greycomets_001_body: Make peace with life, make good of ails, make done all wins and fails. Before you follow into shadows, the silver comet's trail.
lavecon_greycomets_002_body:
We the Grey Comets honour our mistress The Silver Comet in the form of combat against here chosen foes. The hunters, those that prey on man for coin.

We engage now to bring them into the trail of the comet.
lavecon_greycomets_003_body:
These hunters give their lives for the glory of the Silver Comet.
As we follow her trail we find the meaning of true power.
With every sacrifice in the black the Comet's return moves closer.
lavecon_nemb_001_body:
Commanders Log: Ed Hunter:

This is Commander Ed Hunter of the trade ship Nemb. We've been attacked by Pirates.

It was an ambush, they were waiting, knew what we were carrying and exactly where to find it.

They asked for the relics specifically. Not interested in any of the other cargo. Some of the crew locked themselves in an empty compartment. They...they ejected them into space.

Damn it! Once they had what they wanted, they ripped out the ships systems, leaving us adrift. If you can hear this please send help.
lavecon_nemb_002_body:
Commanders Log: Ed Hunter:

It's been 5 days, drifting out here. They did a real number on the ships systems, not only have they left us adrift, but they smashed the life support systems launched the life pods and cleaned out our supplies. The ship is in no state to go anywhere. I guess it's easier if there's no survivors.

All we can hope for is that someone stumbles across us before it's too late.
lavecon_nemb_003_body:
Commanders Log: Ed Hunter:Commanders Log: Ed Hunter:

They've come back! It seems they couldn't pass up the opportunity to get some of the other cargo after all.

We've got no defence this time, they'll just stormed in, take whatever they want.

We're not going to let them get away with this. We might not be able to stop them getting on board. But we can make sure none of them leave. We know what this means.

I doubt they would have left any of us alive anyway and we can't just sit here waiting for them to kill us or worse. We have to do something.

 We're going to vent the ship, we're done for anyway and we're sick of being prey to these jackals.

This is Ed Hunter, Commander of the Nemb, signing off.
lavecon_outspan_001_body: This automated deep space relay is the property of Janus Incorporated.
lavecon_research_001_body:
Chief Research Officers Log: Dr Mitch

The serum is being administered. We won't know the results for a few days. The previous patients had a very low rate of progress and have been disposed of. I have made it clear to our suppliers that I will not tolerate such substandard stock again. I need healthy individuals not the scraps of humanity scavenged from whatever war torn back water they found the last lot. 

At least the latest batch seems more suitable, but only time will tell.
lavecon_research_002_body:
Chief Security Officers Log: Officer Wyatt

 A few of the new batch of patients are not taking the serum. We caught some of them disposing of the injections; they rolled over on the others. This explains their rowdiness and the inaccurate results the Doctors were seeing.

I've raised this with Dr Mitch and we've decided to separate the ring leaders from the general population. If it was up to me I'd flush them all out in to the black. But for some reason Dr Mitch wants to keep them around.
lavecon_research_003_body:
Chief Research Officers Log: Dr Mitch

I was right to keep this group alive and to think I almost let that ape Wyatt toss them out the airlock.

After a sequence of testing it appears that the patients stopped taking the serum all have a common genome. They were able to resist the effects, but how?

 If I can isolate this it might trigger another avenue of study. I must keep hold of them as a control group and screen the others for this genome. It's the key I have been looking for.
lavecon_research_004_body:
Chief Security Officers Log: Officer Wyatt

Corporate and their damn spot checks.

They show up out of the blue, demanding to see manifests and project logs.

The patients were kept out of the way and Dr Mitch's research is not on the books so they didn't find anything. But when we did the count one was missing.

Tommy, he was one of the control group. We've search the entire facility and no sign. The doctor is not going to like this.
lavecon_roguecomet_001_body:
Commanders Log: Ariane Key

I can't believe I survived, the ship is totalled and there is no way I'm getting off this rock without help.

Communications are sketchy at best and I don't even know if this is getting out. The ship scanners did show some ships in my sector before they died.

Hopefully one of them will pick this up and come get me.
lavecon_roguecomet_002_body:
Commanders Log: Ariane Key

I had lost hope, thought I was never getting out of here. But then I heard the landing thrusters.

Someone picked up my signal and I have to say an Asp has never looked so welcome.

This was a close call and I thank my lucky stars that the Winters Grasp and her commander were not a pirate ship looking to pick my bones.

I've rescued what I can of my personal belongings, the insurance will cover the rest. We're heading to Gooch Hangar in Baliscii, where with luck I'll be able to get a transport home.
lavecon_spike_001_body:
...Signal matches at listening post:Alpha Centauri...

I don't want to hear your excuses, just find Alvin Defeer... now!

People have been taking too many liberties and it's time to make them understand that you don't cross Don Antonaci and get away with it. I want the Shady Lady found. Not tomorrow. Not next week. NOW!
lavecon_spike_002_body:
...Signal matches at listening post:George Pantazis...

Tell the Don we've found the target at a space farm in the Wise 0855-0714 system. What does he want us to do with Alvin Defeer when we reach him?
lavecon_splendor_001_body:
Look, Malik, the plan is foolproof. Stop getting your panties in a bunch. The ships get attacked. I turn up with a rescue team and do the salvage. Then you do the repairs. After that we sit back and count the money. It's easy pickings.

So what you're telling me, Hendge, is that this Pirate Lord Luca isn't real?

Of course not - he's just some guy we hired. He turns up, attacks the ships, leaves them crippled and then we arrive. I've got it all worked out.

Okay, Hendge, but what if someone gets killed? What if we get caught?

No one's going to get hurt, Malik. The guy we've hired is an excellent pilot. And as long as you keep your mouth shut and stick to your end of the deal, no one will ever know.

I'm just not sure about this.

What's not to be sure about? You need the money don't you, Malik, that much is obvious. If you don't want your repair yard to be repossessed and this is your way out.

All right, Hendge I'm in. But no one gets hurt.

No one gets hurt. You have my word.
lavecon_splendor_002_body:
Hendge! You said no one was going to get hurt. You said you'd hired an excellent pilot. He's left dead bodies all over the damn system!

Calm down, Malik. There's nothing to link us to any of this.

That's not the point. Damn you, Hendge. I can't have this on my conscience - I don't care how much money we're making. I'm out!

Out? You're out? You don't seem to understand how this works, Malik. There is no out. You're going to see this through till the end.

No? You can't force me to repair those ships at my yard. I'm done with this whole thing.

Really, Malik? That's a shame. I guess you'll get used to the penal colony.

What? What do you mean 'penal colony'.

I mean, Malik, when I said there's nothing linking 'us' to this I may not have been 100% honest. There's nothing linking me to this. But unless you carry on with those repairs I'm going to pin this whole thing on you. I've already done the ground work. Any more talk about quitting and System Security will be all over you like a rash. So get back to your yard and finish those repairs like a good boy.
lavecon_splendor_003_body:
Something's happened. We're going to have to lay low for now, so there'll be no more repairs at the yard for a while.

What do you mean, Hendge? What's going on?

The local security chief has taken a particular interest in the recent pirate activity. He's investigating Lord Luca and he might have worked out his identity.

But Hendge, if the chief finds out who Lord Luca is he might be able to trace this whole thing back to us.

Stop panicking, Malik. Just do as you're told. If the worst comes to the worst we'll just have to take him out.

Who? The security chief? Are you mad, Hendge?

I said stop panicking. Just leave the thinking to me and act dumb. That shouldn't be too much of an effort for you.
lavecon_undercover_001_body:
This is Scarlett, I'm in. Looks like they bought my cover story and alias. Having me murder my own ship sealed the deal. Nothing screams criminal like killing a cop. They wear it like a badge of honour. Word got around and they think I'm some gun for hire.

We've moved about a fair bit, but their base of operations seems to be in the Istanu system.

This is bigger than we thought, not just a smuggling ring they are trading in people and not for slavery, something else is going on here. I'm not close enough yet, but I'll find out.
lavecon_undercover_002_body:
I'm not proud of what I'm doing, I just tell myself that it's not me. But it seems to be working. I've got more access. I got a glimpse into something that looked like a lab, they've got tech here that would be the envy of any hospital in the galaxy.

These people are well funded. But I still need to dig deeper.

What are they really doing here?
lavecon_undercover_003_body:
Got it!

They are shipping people in and using them as mules. They wake up somewhere and are completely unaware of what has happened to them and have no idea what they are carrying. Drugs, data chips, organisms. I guess they ended up being smugglers afterall, but I didn't see this coming.

These innocent people traffic the goods with no knowledge and then turn up missing when the goods are retrieved.

We've got to stop this.
lavecon_undercover_004_body:
There's not much more I can do.

They are starting to ask questions and I've run out of answers. I think they have made me. I've going to have to disappear, there is no way I can get a ship out of here, so I've hidden one of the escape pods and I'm planning on hiding in there.

If you find this, my name is Scarlett, I'm a security officer from Ross 154, I need you to get me back there so we can stop these scumbags.
laveradio_attackrun_001: This is going to be radio's finest hour.
laveradio_attackrun_002: All you'll hear is Radio Boom Boom! Radio Pew Pew! Radio Boom Boom! Radio it's true. Lave Radio just shot you.
laveradio_attackrun_003: I'll show you how to fly dangerous.
laveradio_attackrun_004: And here's another hit for you.
laveradio_neardeath_001: You can never stop the signal. Lave Radio will live on.
laveradio_neardeath_002: This is Lave Radio signing off.
laveradio_neardeath_003: We're experiencing some technical difficulties. But we'll be back on the air soon.
laveradio_onapproach_002: Welcome to Lave Radio, Commander. We're live so please do not swear.
laveradio_onapproach_003: Looks like we've got a special guest here at Lave Radio. I wonder if they are friendly.
laveradio_onarrival_01: Broadcast from an orange Sidewinder and hosted by a vending machine technician. It's Lave Radio!
laveradio_playerneardeath_001: Fly safe, Commander. And if you can't fly safe then... fly dangerous.
laveradio_stationed_001: We'll be right back after these messages from our sponsors.
laveradio_stationed_002: It's hits, hits, hits all day long here at Lave Radio.
laveradio_stationed_003: Lave Radio. The hottest show this side of Diso.
laveradio_stationed_004: Lave Radio. Transmitting to every corner of the galaxy.
laveradio_underfire_001: This is Lave Radio, under attack and bringing you the hits!
laveradio_underfire_002: Some of our critics are currently voicing their concerns with us. But we're still bringing you the hottest tunes in the galaxy.
lavianbrandy_info:
A highly valued liquor from the old world of Lave. Using ancient breeds of grains grown in its tropical climate under a permit from the government, the distillate is kept in old Earth oak barrels and held in an orbital maturing facility for decades to achieve maximum richness.

This rare good is legal in all markets except for Prison Colony markets and Federal and Allied Theocracy markets.

Please note that if a market’s controlling faction changes, some formerly legal rare goods may become illegal. Should this occur the rare good will be unavailable for sale or purchase at that market for the duration of the prohibiting faction’s tenure.

Lead is a heavy metal with a higher density than most other common materials. Although lead's toxicity has been recognised for several centuries it is still used in a large range of processes due to its low cost.

Lead is used in munitions, solders, fusible alloys and radiation shielding.

liyongrui_overview_control_ethos: Li Yong-Rui uses his access to vast funds in order to buy up huge swathes of both private and government sectors, often establishing absolute economic control of the system.
liyongrui_overview_description: Li Yong-Rui is the current head of the Li Dynasty, a family whose involvement with the Sirius Corporation can be traced back to the company’s founding almost 800 years ago. By the age of 25, Yong-Rui had earned doctorates in physics, politics and economics. Sirius hired him straight from college. It was no surprise when, a few short decades later, he was announced as CEO - a position Yong-Rui holds to this day.
liyongrui_overview_expansion_ethos: Li Yong-Rui cements his control of systems by oiling the wheels of industry, distributing much needed technology and resources from its headquarters in Lembava.
liyongrui_overview_preparation_ethos: Li Yong-Rui leverages his connections with Sirius Corp to build an irresistible flood of discounts and media presence, inspiring system populations to increase personal spending and invest in long-term holdings.
liyongrui_overview_quotation1: With enough data, humanity can predict almost anything.
liyongrui_overview_quotation2: Any wise investor would utilise this golden age of interstellar expansion to increase their personal wealth. Those who do not risk being left behind.
liyongrui_overview_quotation3: Sirius Corp has been the corporate leader for centuries. With Sirius Gov we take those proven philosophies and apply them to system governance.
liyongrui_overview_quotation4: Sirius Gov's meta government strategies synergise the benefits of distinct cultures and societies. The results have been inspiring to witness.
liyongrui_overview_quotation5: Freedom to act brings with it the responsibility to choose wisely.
loadingscreentip_icona_001_desc: Training simulations for a variety of ship operations and scenarios are accessible from the Home screen of your Internal interface panel.
loadingscreentip_icona_002_desc: You can find help guides covering all major professions in the Pilot's Handbook, accessible from the Home screen or via links presented in various interface displays.
loadingscreentip_icona_003_desc: The Full Spectrum System Scanner allows Commanders to survey systems, identifying astronomical objects and signal sources.
loadingscreentip_iconb_001_desc: The docking computer can help you to safely land at a starport. The advanced version will guide your departure, too!
loadingscreentip_iconb_002_desc: In the event of ship loss, Commanders must make an insurance payment to recover their ship. Without the necessary credits, a default Sidewinder will be provided.
loadingscreentip_iconb_004_desc: Analysis mode facilitates the use of a variety of ship scanners. Press $BINDING_input_either:#value=PlayerHUDmodetoggle; to switch between Analysis and Combat modes.
loadingscreentip_iconb_005_desc: Analysis mode is required to use most mining equipment, such as the Pulse Wave Analyser and Seismic Charge Warhead. Press $BINDING_input_either:#value=PlayerHUDmodetoggle; to switch between Analysis and Combat modes.
loadingscreentip_iconb_006_desc: New Commanders can leave this area at any time. However, once docked outside of this area following a rise in any rank, permit access will be revoked.
loadingscreentip_iconb_007_desc: Training scenarios take place within a simulated reality, allowing pilots to try out scenarios without risk to their ship or credit balance. Feel free to experiment!
loadingscreentip_iconb_009_desc: Looking for teammates? Want to join a common cause? Consider joining a squadron, accessible from the Home screen in your Internal interface display.
loadingscreentip_iconb_010_desc: The Galnet news service provides an audio option, allowing the latest articles to be read aloud to Commanders busy with other tasks.
loadingscreentip_iconb_011_desc: The Comms system supports opening voice channels with your Team, or individual pilots following an accepted request.
loadingscreentip_iconb_012_desc: Forming a team offers a variety of benefits. This includes additional protection, 5% trade dividends on sold commodities and 100% value of all bounty vouchers earned.
loadingscreentip_iconb_013_desc: For support or assistance visit our Knowledgebase: support.frontier.co.uk.
loadingscreentip_iconb_014_desc: Hauling valuable cargo? Keep an eye on your radar for nearby ships, who may try to take a portion of your cargo for themselves.
loadingscreentip_iconb_015_desc: Commanders can access Galnet from the Home screen in the cockpit interface. Galnet: Your Galaxy In Focus.
loadingscreentip_iconb_016_desc: Unable to see anything on your sensors or contacts panel? Check the Modules panel to ensure your sensors are powered and functional.
loadingscreentip_iconb_017_desc: If your core systems are damaged and you are unable to move, try a reboot/repair sequence to bring modules back online. This option is found in the Functions screen of the Ship tab.
loadingscreentip_iconb_018_desc: Watch your speed in and around starports. Colliding with another ship while travelling above 100 m/s is grounds for a fine, or even a bounty if the other ship is destroyed.
loadingscreentip_iconc_001_desc: Supercruise Assist will help ships maintain course on approach to a location, and disengage at the appropriate time. Interdiction will disrupt the module's function, however.
loadingscreentip_icond_001_desc: If you set a planetary body or settlement as the destination for Supercruise Assist, your ship will automatically enter orbit around the body upon arrival.
loadingscreentip_icond_002_desc: Take care to read all the details of missions before you accept them. You might be getting yourself into trouble if you aren't aware of the travel route or potential threats!
loadingscreentip_icond_003_desc: Be careful when returning from a long exploration voyage. If your ship is destroyed prior to handing in your survey data, you will lose it all.
loadingscreentip_icond_004_desc: If you hire a crew member, they will take a percentage of all credit earnings regardless of whether they are on active duty. Even inactive pilots need to pay the bills!
loadingscreentip_icond_005_desc: As your combat rank increases, so does the likelihood of encountering hostile pilots with increased ranks to match.
loadingscreentip_icond_006_desc: Increasing your reputation with major and minor factions grants access to additional mission opportunities, offering larger rewards.
loadingscreentip_icond_007_desc: If you exceed your power capacity for any reason, modules will shut down in order of priority from lowest to highest.
loadingscreentip_icond_008_desc: Be sure to check the gravity rating of a planetary body in the system map prior to landing. High gravity planets can make a rough landing for the unprepared Commander!
loadingscreentip_icond_009_desc: Planning on a long exploration voyage into the black? Equip a fuel scoop! The following star types can be scooped for fuel: O - B - A - F - G - K - M
loadingscreentip_icond_010_desc: Want to invite another commander to join you on your travels? Access the Multi-Crew function through the Comms panel when in Open Play or Private Group modes.
loadingscreentip_icone_001_desc: Make sure you stock up on consumables before setting off on your next journey!
loadingscreentip_icone_002_desc: Settlement facilities can be authorisation restricted. The profile analyser allows you to clone someone else’s security profile - but try not to get caught!
loadingscreentip_icone_003_desc: Be sure to check the temperature of a planetary body before disembarking. Prolonged exposure to extremely high or low temperatures is hazardous to your health.
loadingscreentip_icone_004_desc: The Surface Mission tutorial can be accessed at any time via the Training Menu. A variety of pilot lessons are also available.
loadingscreentip_icone_005_desc: Suits and loadouts can be equipped while on your ship or at concourse terminals.
loadingscreentip_icone_006_desc: Power regulators used in SRVs follow the same specifications as those in settlement power centres.
loadingscreentip_icone_007_desc: If you need to steal something, make sure there is nobody around to see you do it!
loadingscreentip_icone_008_desc: Stolen items in your backpack are only a problem if you are scanned. Stay clear of local guards and Omnipol agents if you have something to hide.
loadingscreentip_icone_009_desc: Mission providers found on the concourse will generally offer slightly higher rewards than mission board contracts.
loadingscreentip_icone_010_desc: It is possible to scan targets through clear panels.
loadingscreentip_icone_011_desc: You can remove a cloned security profile using the item wheel.
loadingscreentip_icone_012_desc: Trouble seeing in the dark? Activate your flashlight in the item wheel. Some say an Engineer offers a night vision modification, too.
