macabremonsters1_body:
Welcome back to another grim episode of Macabre and Monsters!  

Will Jessup here, bringing you another wretched tale from the black heart of the void. Today, we’re cracking open a case from one of the nastiest legends to emerge from the frontier: the Colgrave family. For decades, this bunch of deviants have been described as so depraved they made the Phagos Clan look tame. I can’t even imagine how sick you need to be to qualify but this family did it!  

I know, I know - it sounds like a tall tale told over bootleg Centauri Mega Gin in a backwater outpost. But this story refuses to die, unlike the poor colonists who ran into them over the years.  Sorry, was that joke too dark? Don’t forget to subscribe to my channel, you ghouls and goblins out there! 

But where is the Colgrave family today? What happened to them? Well strap yourselves in - I’ve got a hot and fresh lead on their last known location. We’re going cannibal hunting, and because I’m such a generous host we’ll be taking a tour of the systems the Colgraves built their notoriety in. I’m locked on a grisly trail and you can come along for the ride. My next stop is 67 104 117 107 117 110 where the story began. 

Fiendship drive charging!

- Will Jessup
macabremonsters2_body:
We made it!  

So... The legend goes that the Colgraves were just another large family here in Benford's Inheritance. Ma and Pa Colgrave, three kids, five cousins and two grandparents. That's some brood, enough to eat a colony out of house and home... Or just the colony. 

Tales about the Phagos dredger are bad enough, just tens of thousands of isolated spacers who liked nothing better than terrorising the fringes of the bubble. Out here, you can only imagine what the deepest, darkest, loneliest reaches of inhabited space do to a person. I mean, some poor sap called Hal Coultard famously cashed in his ticket running into the Phagos and was never heard from again. People whisper that he ended up being the entrée for that evening’s dinner but what really happened is anyone’s guess.   

But the Colgraves….Man, they were something else. Every one of them was well fed... on... Well, you get the picture. Pa used to work in a meat processing factory. His supervisor once made an entry that they’d ‘never seen anybody take as much delight in their work’. Sounds like the ideal employee, right? Well, he was fired for repeat violations of safety codes. Don’t even wanna think what that involved. 

Meanwhile Ma looked after the brood. Records show she kept to herself but used to play loud classical music during the day, with neighbours making complaints all the time. The kids were home schooled and were constantly getting into fights in their apartment block. Happy home, happy life, right? 

I intend to find them. This is going to be my magnus opus if I do. Myth chasers will remember the name Will Jessup…not DISmember I hope! Hahaha... ahem... Anyway! Onwards to 90 105 32 89 105 110 101 115 for the next grisly instalment.

- Will Jessup
macabremonsters3_body:
I’m here in Zi Yines. Ugly place, stupid name too.  

They say this is where the Colgraves got their first taste for murder...And human flesh, too. No one knows why they turned to this particular cravings but, in time honoured tradition, many other monsters of the past started out practicing their art on lesser things. Pa Colgrave went from dicing up meat in a factory to serving up pilots. 

The story goes that he came home with fresh meat for Ma to cook without saying anything about what it really was. Every one of the family chowed down that night on Cargo Pilot Stew. 

And this is where the first of the Colgraves’ alleged victims were found, floating in space in their escape pod. Tomb more like. They said the body looked… altered. Cut open, parts missing, different parts stuffed where they ain’t supposed to be. System authorities stamped it as ‘piracy.’ PIRACY! But locals swore otherwise and I believe them.  

This is what drives me to do what I do. I must know the truths behind the legends; they can’t all be born as monsters...Can they? 

As I sit here staring at the dead space in front of me, I can’t shake the feeling that the Colgraves wanted us to find that corpse. Like it was a message or a calling card. I forget the victim’s name, but ain't nobody going to forget mine when this is over! 

I'm hot on the trail of another clue and bunch of victims, follow me if you dare to 68 117 109 110 105 where we'll scare ourselves some more learning about another victim chased by some crazy cannibal family!

- Will Jessup
macabremonsters4_body:
Imagine just being out here all alone: minding your own business, mining for ore, then...POW! Out of the black comes a flotilla of messed up ships who surround you, board you, then have you for lunch. Yep, that's I reckoned happened to Fred Pholl. Unfortunately all we have to go on here is a garbled log that cut off halfway through but my peers think the Colgraves got him. 

People keep asking why I do this. “Will, why do you do this? Why chase after nightmares, instead of just reporting traffic violations in some backwater system nobody visits?” Easy. History doesn’t remember the victims. History remembers the monsters.  

And the people that catch them! I mean, who remembers anything about poor Fred? Nobody, that’s who. But they all remember when the Colgraves paid a visit and left behind nothing but the remnants of their victim stuffed in the Vintage Intrepid helmet. Probably used it as a human soup bowl. 

If I can prove the Colgraves are real, then I’m not just telling the story, I am the story. That’s what drives me. I’ll be a household name. The galaxy loves a ghost story, but they love the people that bust them even more. Onwards, my bloodthirsty viewers, onwards to 66 114 105 103 117 97 108.

- Will Jessup
macabremonsters5_body:
Hello? Is this thing on? 

This is – hah! - okay, bit weird. My sensors are picking up… Echoes? As if I’m being pinged by another ship, but there’s nothing out there. Lights flickered a moment ago, too, like my systems are being messed with. And my comms just played static that sounded… well, a weird slurping sound. Very funny whoever you are. If the Colgraves are watching, enjoy the show weirdos. Just remember, I’m watching you right back and I’m getting closer to the truth. Subscribe to my channel too!  

…Right. Moving on

From what I can gather from sources, there’s been sightings of multiple ships in this area, all decked out like raiders. One pilot claimed that they saw skulls impaled on those spikes! Not sure I like the sound of ending up as a Colgrave trophy. I hope this won't be my last investigation... 

Ok, time to close in on the Colgraves. Meet me at 74 97 98 97 106 97. I hope!

- Will Jessup
macabremonsters6_body:
This is Will Jessup, and this is Macabre and Monsters and I think… I think I found them. Or they found me!  

Multiple ships, no ship IDs, all with Raider kits. Some of them...They look stained with something...Maybe a trick of the light. They’re closing fast. My systems, damn it, everything’s redlining and going haywire. Engines are dead. They’re on me.  

*panicked breathing* Still broadcasting, though. That’s what matters, right?. If this is the end, at least you’ll all hear it and I’ll be remembered, not like those other chumps. My name’s Will Jessup, this is Macabre and Monsters. And this… this is the Colgrave family, coming to say hello… 

*grinding metallic noises* 

Oh frag, they're boarding... 

*muffled grunting* 

St—stay back!!

*shots fired* 

*screaming and laughter* 

We'll be well fed tonight Pa...
macabremonstersstart_body:
Halloween again!

It's me, your blood soaked host, Will Jessup, about to dig into yet another true tale from the darkest reaches of space.

I'm going searching for one of the most depraved set of spacers to have ever inhabited the edges of the bubble - The Colgraves!

Follow me as I uncover the crimes of this crazy family and maybe we'll even get lucky and locate them. Now wouldn't that be something?!

Come find me at Hertzsprung Terminal in Saragir and join the hunt.

And remember to subscribe to get the unscrambled location of each episode!

- Will Jessup

mamba_info:
Based on an unreleased racing prototype, the Mamba is one of the fastest ships in production. It can also deliver a lot of punishment, boasting one class-four and two class-three hardpoints. This emphasis on firepower and speed means the ship can hit hard and fast, vanishing before the target has a chance to react. Comparisons to the Fer-de-Lance, also produced by Zorgon Peterson, will be inevitable, but the Mamba is in fact faster in a straight line, while being slightly less manoeuvrable.

The Mamba has been designed for medium-size landing pads.

masterchefs_info:
Master Chefs are selected based on genetic markers that tend to favour an aptitude for the culinary arts. Little is known about them except that they are kidnapped as children and then trained under rigorous conditions to bring out their genetic cooking potential. The use of Master Chefs is illegal in most Federal and Allied systems, but is regarded as a sign of high status in many Imperial systems. Many anti-slavery protest groups have tried to free Master Chefs from their life of culinary bondage, yet due to their training, most return of their own free will to serve. Theirs is a life of servitude - they know nothing but to cook.

This rare good is legal in all Imperial markets; Independent Dictatorship, Feudal and Theocracy markets; and Federal Democracy markets. It is prohibited in all other markets.

Please note that if a market’s controlling faction changes, some formerly legal rare goods may become illegal. Should this occur the rare good will be unavailable for sale or purchase at that market for the duration of the prohibiting faction’s tenure.

megaship_damaged_logs_001_body:
I don't care what the company line is, I'm responsible for the crew first and they can fire me if they want. Open local comms.

To all attacking vessels, we are a civilian ship with no weapons, cease fire and we will surrender. Please cease fire and we will adhere to your demands.
megaship_damaged_logs_002_body:
...Open Communication Activated...

To pirate vessels, cease fire and we can negotiate terms of surrendering our cargo.

We don't come for your cargo commander, we come for your crew.
megaship_damaged_logs_003_body: These were no normal pirates. They attacked without provocation, they made no demands, they didn't loot the cargo we spilled into space. They just wanted to see the ship burn.
megaship_damaged_logs_004_body: To attacking vessels please respond, we surrender. I repeat we surrender.
megaship_damaged_logs_005_body: The company is covered by insurance for exactly this kind of thing, I will not risk the lives of the crew and this ship over a few hundred tons of cargo so some corporate CEO can get richer. All hands abandon ship.
megaship_damaged_logs_006_body: Captain, I know these systems and those are not pirate insignias. Those a slaver ships. If we don't fight them off we're either dead or we'll wish we were.
megaship_damaged_logs_007_body: The distress call was a trap. When we pulled up along side it exploded. Damn near took half the ship with it. Fires, hull breached, panic. That's when they jumped in to pick at our carcass. Pirate Scum.
megaship_damaged_logs_008_body:
We're under siege!

They're after the cargo!

Deploy all defence units, we won't let them just turn up and take the payload!
megaship_damaged_logs_009_body: Mayday, Can anyone hear me? They came out of nowhere as we passed an asteroid cluster. They must have been hiding there to cover their ship signatures. They hit us all at once. We had no time. The captain said abandon ship but hey started shooting down the escape pods. I'm trapped on board... please help... wait... wa... no... no let me go I don't......
megaship_damaged_logs_010_body: It's been days since the attack. They came disabled us and took what they wanted, then left us to die out here. The ship is inoperable, all systems dead. They did a real number on us. With the damaged the ship sustained it's just a matter of time until it falls apart. Most of the decks have hull breaches and we can only seal so many with the supplies we've found. We're going to attempt to reach an outpost in the escape shuttle. At least we still have that.
megaship_damaged_logs_011_body: My first thought was that it was a pirate attack. This sector has become a hunting ground of late. But I guess you'd call it a natural disaster, some kind of asteroid collision. It turned our pocket of space into a shooting gallery for a few hours. Rocks slamming into the hull, micro meteors popping and pinging through us. Most of the ships systems are off-line. We've sealed off all the open ship sections and all we can do now is wait for a search and rescue ship. We should be declared overdue by now.
megaship_damaged_logs_012_body: Everyone knows the risks of working in space, but I guess you get complacent after a while. After so long it just becomes automatic. Then the black decides to bite you. It's not the big things that get you out here. It's the little ones, the ones you overlook. Something works loose. Now your ship has a hole in it the size of a corvette and you have a dead stick on your hands.
megaship_damaged_logs_013_body: I told them, I told them this would happen. You can't keep skipping routine services and maintenance checks. I don't care how tight things get. Now we're stuffed. There's no coming back from this. We're going out of business.
megaship_damaged_logs_014_body: I don't like this. I should never have agreed to it in the first place, but the Captain kept insisting, saying it would be OK. But it's not OK, not by a long shot. We're stuck out here, outside the normal shipping lanes and all to save a few days and hope we get some kind of bonus.
megaship_damaged_logs_015_body: There is no way we can outrun them, this is a transport ship not a Buckyball racer. Maybe we can reason with them, make them a deal before the shield fail. Some cargo for our lives. We can adjust the manifest to account for the losses as long as there is no damage to the ship.
megaship_damaged_logs_016_body: They're attacking the Solitary Confinement block! Don't tell me they're trying to break HIM out!
megaship_damaged_logs_017_body: A Riot's broken out in Cell Block B, some of the inmates have made their way towards the on-board hangar and are attempting to hijack ships.  Wait... incoming ships! We're under attack! How did they orchestrate all of this?!
megaship_damaged_logs_018_body: The vessel is under fire! It looks like these guys aren't too happy about their boys being in lock-up. Let them have it!
megaship_damaged_logs_019_body: The ship has been breached! This vessel was designed for keeping people in, not keeping people out!
megaship_damaged_logs_020_body: A couple of would-be thieves. We're not going to just let you turn up and take what's ours!
megaship_damaged_logs_021_body: Why are you firing on us?! We gave you all the cargo you wanted, we just work on this ship!
megaship_damaged_logs_022_body: Once they shot out drives out, they breached the ship. They took the women and children first, and then the supplies. We won't last much longer now. Even if an Evac-team manages to get here, they won't be able to save us all...
megaship_damaged_tg_logs_001_body:
Unknown Ship, Cease Fire. We are a civilian vessel.

No response, hell I don't even know if they can understand us.
megaship_damaged_tg_logs_002_body:
What the hell?

We're being pulled out of hyperspace.

It's one of them, scanning us... oh god... it's going nuts... firing at us... why? All hands abandon ship, all hands abandon ship.
megaship_damaged_tg_logs_003_body:
We've been pulled out of hyperspace.

Unknown vessel commencing scan, systems shut down. Preparing to get under way once scan complete.

Wait... Wait... What... it's charging something new...

...Signal terminated at source...
megaship_damaged_tg_logs_004_body:
We've tried hailing them, Sir, but we don't even know if they can hear us let alone understand us.

We have no choice, we have to abandon ship before it's too late.

All hands to escape pods.
megaship_damaged_tg_logs_005_body:
All Crew abandon ship, repeat all crew abandon ship.

FO is now in command.

FO, get these people to safety. I'll steer the ship away from the escape pods to buy you time to get away.
megaship_damaged_tg_logs_006_body: Helm, get ready to go to full burn as soon as the system comes back online. Until then all we can do is wait and hope it's just curious and will leave once it's scanned us.
megaship_damaged_tg_logs_007_body:
What is it doing?

We're a sitting duck and it's just scanning the compartments one by one as if it's looking for something.

Wait it's stopped, it's... My god! all hands abandon.........
megaship_damaged_tg_logs_008_body:
All efforts to communicate have failed.The ship scanned us and then became aggressive. I know we won't make it out of this.

Consider this a warning message. They are......
megaship_damaged_tg_logs_009_body: Get us out of here! Go to emergency power! Get out and push if you have to, just get us the hell out of here!
megaship_damaged_tg_logs_010_body:
Check the manifest, this thing is scanning out hold for a reason and I want to know what.

Captain, look!

What's it doing? Oh dear god! All hands get to the escape pods. Repeat all hands abandon.....
megaship_damaged_tg_logs_011_body: I don't care if we have no weapons, get me anything I can throw at this thing! Get some power to engines! If we can't shoot it, maybe we can ram it.
megaship_damaged_tg_logs_012_body:
I don't want to hear what we can't do. I need solutions otherwise.

That thing left us for dead, but I'm damned if I'm going out like this.

We're going to split into teams and see what we can salvage. Start with the escape pods and see what we can get operational again.
megaship_damaged_tg_logs_013_body: This is the Captain. Please remain calm, we've all heard the stories and knew this might be a risk. I'm sure once it has scanned the ship it will be on it's way.
megaship_damaged_tg_logs_014_body: There's no use in fighting this thing, we need to jump to the next system ASAP... Wh-What do you mean the drives are all offline? What is this thing?!
megaship_damaged_tg_logs_015_body: Until it's confirmed hostile, do not do anything that it could see as a threat. I repeat - Do not engage! If we don't provoke it, maybe it will just pass us by.
megaship_damaged_tg_logs_016_body:
I told you not to bring that thing on board, it's been acting weirdly for the last few days and now it's brought them down on us.

Jettison it right now and maybe we can get out of this.
megaship_damaged_tg_logs_017_body:
It's scanning our cargo hold Sir, like it's looking for something. 

What did we pick up on the last stop?
megaship_damaged_tg_logs_018_body:
The Unknown vessel just blew a hole in Cell Block D, it seems to be retrieving something... 

Wait, is that...? How did one of the inmates manage to smuggle one of those things aboard?!
megaship_damaged_tg_logs_019_body: The Unknown Vessel shut down the ship's systems, the cell doors have opened and the inmates are starting to riot. Even if the vessel just leaves us be, we can't say the same about the inmates...
megaship_damaged_tg_logs_020_body:
Sir, that thing we picked up a few systems back keeps making these weird noises and it's starting to freak some of the crew members out... 

*Hyperspace Conduit Unstable*

*Systems Offline*

Captain, what do we do? Captain! 

Wait, you knew they'd come looking for this thing didn't you? Damn, you Captain, you've doomed us all!
megaship_damaged_tg_logs_021_body:
What happened to the ship? We were in the middle of a jump and now we're... well, I don't know where we are. Do we even know what system we're in? 

Wait, what was that noise? Can anyone see anything? The systems are down and it's so dark here... 

Sweet mother of Sol, this light, it's blinding.
megaship_damaged_tg_logs_022_body:
The item we found from that wreck has been pointing us in the same direction for countless jumps now; it must be taking us somewhere quite significant. 

*Hyperspace Conduit Unstable*

*Systems Offline*

Captain, we've been approached by a vessel of unknown origin. It appears to be scanning the ship, how do we proceed? 

It seems that wherever we've been headed, we're not welcome... Let it finish its scan and turn back. 

Wait, it's opening fire, and the systems aren't back online yet. We're sitting ducks!
megaship_idle_chatter_003: Scanning complete. We have detected no hostile signatures nearby.

menu_audio_dynamic_range_description:
Optimise the loud and quiet sections of the game to match your listening volume and equipment.

"Normal" = Suitable for all.
"Boost" = Increased volume.
"Full Range" = For playing loudly on big speakers.
"Night Time" = For playing at low volumes, without losing the quieter details.

menu_audio_galnet_audio_automatic_pausin: Automatically pauses the Playlist in situations such as switching vessels and during interdiction.
menu_audio_galnet_audio_automatic_resumi: Automatically resumes the Playlist after jump transitions. Please note, you must assign controller bindings to control the Playlist during Hyperspace.
menu_audio_galnet_audio_description: Playlist options. Control the volume, language, automatic pausing and resuming. Please note, controller bindings can be assigned for the Playlist in the Options Controls screen under Playlist. This is necessary to control the Playlist during Hyperspace and Gunner/Turret view.

menu_audio_galnet_audio_language_descrip: Change the language that GalNet Audio will speak in. This takes effect immediately, and will clear your current and queued articles. Please note, this will not change the language of the text.
menu_audio_galnet_audio_other_voices_pau: Automatically pauses the Playlist when the Ship Voice, Flight Controllers, NPC Crew start speaking.
menu_audio_galnet_audio_switching_vessel: Automatically pauses the Playlist when switching from one vessel to another.
menu_audio_galnet_audio_taking_fire_paus: Automatically pauses the Playlist when taking fire from another ship. After the first shot has been taken, it will not pause the Playlist again until a cool down of approximately five minutes has expired. This allows the commander to resume audio without constant interruption.
menu_audio_galnet_audio_volume_descripti: Adjust the volume of the Playlist. Please note, controller bindings can be assigned for the Playlist in the Options Controls screen under Playlist. This is necessary to control the Playlist during Hyperspace and Gunner/Turret view.
menu_audio_info: Tweak the music and sound levels to your liking.
menu_audio_licensed_music_description: This mutes licensed music, and is recommended for streamers. The licensed music mainly appears in concourses and bar areas. This option does not affect the game's music score.

menu_audio_player_communication_volume_d:

menu_audio_suit_voice_volume_description: Adjust the volume of the suit voice messages.
menu_audio_suitvoice_breathability_descr: Enable/disable alerts for entering or leaving a pressurised environment.
menu_audio_suitvoice_energy_saving_descr: Enable/disable confirmation of low power mode activation.
menu_audio_suitvoice_gravity_magnetic_de: Enable/disable magnetic contact alert for low gravity environments.
menu_audio_suitvoice_medpackused_descrip: Enable/disable confirmation of medical pack healing.
menu_audio_suitvoice_profileanalyser_sca: Enable/disable alerts when scanning others with the profile analyser.

menu_audio_suitvoice_vessel_destroyed_de: Enable/disable alerts for other owned vessels being destroyed.
menu_audio_suitvoice_wingmember_underatt: Enable/disable team member under attack alert.

menu_audio_voice_frameshift_drive_countd: Enable/disable frame shift drive countdown sequence.
menu_audio_voice_landing_gear_not_deploy: Enable/disable “Warning, Landing Gear Not Deployed” alert.

menu_graphic_3d_description: Options group for 3D rendering on supported TVs and monitors.
menu_graphic_3dfocaldistance_description: Determines the distance of the 'stereo window' used in 3D modes. Objects at this distance will not have parallax. Does not apply to HMDs.
Determines the distance of the 'stereo window' used in 3D modes. Objects at this distance will not have parallax. Does not apply to Oculus Rift.
menu_graphic_ambient_occlusion_descripti: This is a technique used to show how materials respond to ambient lighting. Reducing the level (or even turning it off) can improve game performance.
menu_graphic_antialiasing_description:
These are different methods of reducing aliasing in a scene. Aliasing is where straight lines appear jagged.

FXAA: This method of anti-aliasing has a relatively low performance cost..
MLAAX2: This method of anti-aliasing is more expensive than FXAA, but the results are better.
SMAA: This is an expensive method of anti-aliasing with better results.
menu_graphic_bloom_description: Bloom is a technique used to enhance lighting. Use a lower setting to reduce processing.
menu_graphic_blur_description: Blur is a technique used to enhance the visualisation of movement. This can be turned on or off with this option.
menu_graphic_dashboard_gui_brightness_de: Setting for controlling the brightness of the cockpit dashboard.
menu_graphic_description_display: This option group contains settings for the physical display (typically a monitor, or TV).
menu_graphic_description_quality:
Select one of a range of graphical quality presets. If you are experiencing performance issues then try setting this to Mid, or Low.

You can refine the preset by adjust the options by expanding the Quality group.
menu_graphic_directionalshadow_quality_d: Changing this option sets how smooth the shadows are. Higher values require more processing, so use a lower setting if you are experiencing performance issues.
menu_graphic_disable_ui_lockon_descripti:
Enabling this option will disable the camera turn and lock-on that occurs when activating side panels via a button input.

It is intended for use in conjunction with ultra-wide aspect ratios (when the panels are always in view) or head-tracking devices (when you can turn to look at the panels).

It does not apply to HMDs (consider it always on when using one).

Enabling this option will disable the camera turn and lock-on that occurs when activating side panels via a button input.

It is intended for use in conjunction with ultra-wide aspect ratios (when the panels are always in view) or head-tracking devices (when you can turn to look at the panels).

It does not apply to Oculus Rift (consider it always on when rendering to the Rift).
menu_graphic_disablecamerashake_descript: This option can be used to disable some of the camera shake in game.
menu_graphic_disableidlehandanimations_d: Disables the idle hand animations while in first person (other hand animations such as stick and throttle movement will still be visible).
menu_graphic_dof_quality_description: Depth of field is a technique to use camera focus to highlight objects that are closer, or to push those further away into the background.
menu_graphic_environment_quality_descrip: This option controls the detail and quality of environmental assets. Reducing the level of this can improve game performance. Some changes to Environment Quality settings won't apply until you jump to another system.
menu_graphic_envmap_quality_description: The quality of reflections in game can affect performance. Use a lower setting if you're experiencing issues.
menu_graphic_ffxcas_intensity_descriptio: Intensity of the sharpening effect when using AMD FidelityFX CAS.
menu_graphic_fov_description: The field of view control sets the visual angle width for which the scene is rendered.
menu_graphic_fsr_description:
Ultra Quality mode produces an image with quality virtually indistinguishable from native rendering. It should be selected when the highest quality is desired.

Quality mode produces a super resolution image with quality representative of native rendering, with a sizeable performance gain.

Balanced mode produces a super resolution image approximating native rendering quality, with a major performance gain compared to native.

Performance mode visibly impacts image quality and should only be selected in situations where needing additional performance is critical.
menu_graphic_fx_quality_description: This setting governs the level of visual effects such as particles and lighting. Reducing the level can improve game performance.
menu_graphic_galaxymap_quality_descripti: This setting determines some of the rendering used in the galaxy map. A lower setting will usually increase render performance in the galaxy map.
menu_graphic_gamma_description: This setting controls the overall luminosity in a scene, meaning that a higher value is brighter.
menu_graphic_gamma_settings_description: Adjust the brightness settings for your display until the image to the left is barely visible.
menu_graphic_gpu_scheduler_multiplier_de: Increases or decreases the amount of work the graphics card does to generate terrain. A high setting will use more GPU time to calculate terrain, this can lower your framerate. If you see terrain loading in and have a high fps, increase this to smooth out the generation. Remember you can lower the terrain quality and increase the work if you want a high fps and quick generation.
menu_graphic_guieffects_description: This option disables or enables some of the transition effects used in the GUI.
menu_graphic_hardware_cursor_description:
$MENU_graphic_cursor_os;: Renders the cursor on the screen using the OS. The most responsive cursor mode. Not available when using any $MENU_graphic_3d; mode.

$MENU_graphic_cursor_screen;: Renders the cursor as in-world element, allowing the use of $MENU_graphic_3d; modes. Projects the OS cursor screen position into the world. When using head tracking, both mouse and head movements will cause the in-world cursor to move.

$MENU_graphic_cursor_panel;: Renders the cursor as in-world element, allowing the use of $MENU_graphic_3d; modes. Maps the OS cursor screen position directly onto the cockpit interface. When using head tracking, only mouse movements will cause the in-world cursor to move.
menu_graphic_headbobscale_description: Reduces the intensity of first person camera animations while on foot.
menu_graphic_hmd_quality_description: This setting governs overall image quality for Head Mounted Displays. Use a lower setting to improve overall performance.
menu_graphic_hmd_window_note: When using a HMD, this option applies to the monitor window and not the VR output.
menu_graphic_humanoidfov_description: The field of view control sets the visual angle width for which the scene is rendered.
menu_graphic_info: Set the screen size, quality, toggle 3D, virtual reality settings and more.
menu_graphic_ipd_description: Separation between left and right cameras for 3D modes. Does not apply to HMDs.
menu_graphic_ipd_description_old: Separation between left and right cameras for 3D modes. Does not apply to Oculus Rift.
menu_graphic_jet_cone_quality_descriptio: Controls visual quality of jet effects from neutron and white dwarf stars.
menu_graphic_material_quality_descriptio: The quality of displayed materials is governed by this setting. Use a lower setting to help improve performance.
menu_graphic_model_lod_distance_descript: You can control the maximum distance for drawing models with this option. You can reduce it to have fewer models drawn that are further away, which can improve performance in bust scenes like conflict zones, near starports, and resource sites.
menu_graphic_performance_quality_setting: Run the game with higher quality graphics using the “Quality setting”, or smoother performance with the “Performance setting”. Some changes to performance and quality settings won't take place until the game is reloaded from the main menu.
menu_graphic_pilot_gender_description: Choose the body type of the pilot avatar. Note: Cannot be changed when in game.
menu_graphic_resolution_setting_descript: Run the game in 1080p or 4K resolution. This setting changes the resolution the game renders to, and is independent from the resolution to which your system is set. If the system's resolution setting is different, the output will be upscaled or downscaled to match the system setting.
menu_graphic_shader_warming_description: This option determines if the shaders are prewarmed on start-up. This helps with the occasional stalls caused by shader generation - typically with terrain and planets.
menu_graphic_shadow_quality_description: Changing this option sets how smooth the shadows are. Higher values require more processing, so use a lower setting if you are experiencing performance issues.
menu_graphic_spotshadow_quality_descript:
Changing this option sets the number of spot shadows that are tracked and processed.
Higher values use more graphics memory and processing power; use a lower setting if you are experiencing performance issues.

For Ultra an 8GB or higher graphics card is recommended.
menu_graphic_ssaa_description: SMAA is a screen based anti-aliasing technique which is quite computationally expensive. Using a cheaper technique can improve performance.
menu_graphic_terrain_checkerboard_render: Render half of the planetary terrain, reconstructing nearby pixels for optimised performance.
menu_graphic_terrain_lod_blending_qualit:
Determines how smooth transitions between LOD levels are. 

Off: No blending. 

High: Blend patch vertex data between LOD levels. This is equivalent to Ultra when you are close to the surface. 

Ultra: Blend patch vertex and texture data between LOD levels. 

Changes to Terrain LOD Blending settings won't take place until the game is reloaded from the main menu. 

Note: This setting was part of Terrain Quality before 2.3.
menu_graphic_terrain_material_quality_de: This option determines the quality of the surface materials in terrain rendering. A lower setting should be used if there are performance issues.
menu_graphic_terrain_quality_description:
Changing this option sets how much terrain detail is retained at distance. Higher settings use more graphics memory.

For Ultra+ an 8GB or higher graphics card is recommended.

Changes to Terrain Quality settings won't take place until the game is reloaded from the main menu.
menu_graphic_terrain_sampler_quality_des:
The texture filtering sampler quality to use with terrain rendering.

Low: Trilinear Filtering
Medium: Anisotropic x2
High: Anisotropic x4
Ultra: Anisotropic x8
menu_graphic_texture_quality_description: With this option you can control the detail level of the textures used. Lowering this can improve overall performance.
menu_graphic_upscaling_description:
Upscaling and image improvements available for use.

Normal: Use the built-in upscaler.

AMD FidelityFX CAS: AMD FidelityFX Contrast Adaptive Sharpening provides a mixed ability to sharpen and optionally scale an image.

AMD FSR 1.0: AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1.0 is a spatial upscaling technology that produces impressive image quality at fast framerates. Use this with the anti-aliasing setting SMAA for the best possible visual quality.
menu_graphic_vehiclemaintainhorizoncamer: The vehicle maintain horizon direction camera is designed to help reduce any nausea effects with HMD devices.
menu_graphic_vehiclemotionblackout_descr: The vehicle motion blackout effect is designed to help reduce any nausea with the use of HMD devices.
menu_graphic_volumetrics_quality_descrip: Controls visual quality of volumetric effects.

metaalloys_info: Meta-alloys have a complex lattice structure with large internal voids. They are cellular in nature, and formed organically. They are incredibly strong – much stronger than foamed aluminium for example. Many elements form the structure so technically they are alloys, but the composition is different in different parts of the cell walls for strength. They are good thermal insulators, and have a high melting point, but if they are melted they lose all their special properties and become a conventional alloy. They are easily machined, but as yet cannot be manufactured and are only found in space. They are associated with recently discovered alien entities nicknamed 'Large Barnacles' by interstellar explorers. These appear to be common in certain parts of space, although no-one is certain why. This material has been heralded as the next step in materials technology. It is ultra-light and stronger and more versatile than most commercially available alloys.

mission_altruism_bulletincompletemission: Thank you, Commander. These items will make a real difference to our supporters.
mission_altruism_bust_bulletincompletemi: Great job, Commander $#CommanderName;. These supplies will help us beat this economic downturn.
mission_altruism_bust_failureinboxmessag: I expect results, Commander, not excuses. I hope you're not planning on making a habit out of this. Other factions may not be as forgiving as we are.

mission_altruism_civilunrest_bulletincom: Impressive stuff, Commander, and not a moment too soon! Thanks to you, things should quieten down here.

mission_altruism_failureinboxmessage_001: I expect results, Commander, not excuses. I hope you're not planning on making a habit out of this. Other factions may not be as forgiving as we are.

mission_altruism_failureinboxmessage_004: So you've failed us, Commander. I should have guessed that you were like all the others. Just another scumbag taking advantage of the little people for your own agenda. Mission Terminated.
mission_altruism_failureinboxmessage_005: Commander, it doesn't surprise me that you are no better than those mercenaries before you. You're just another pirate, taking advantage of honest folk to satisfy your greed. Contract terminated.
mission_altruism_failureinboxmessage_006: Commander, those supplies were needed urgently, but I guess that word has a different meaning where you're from. It's a pity we can't use your excuses to solve the problem. Mission cancelled.

mission_altruism_failureinboxmessage_011: I expected better from you, Commander. Your reputation was of someone who can get things done. Maybe you need a new reputation. Mission Terminated.

mission_altruism_famine_failureinboxmess: It's too late! What were you thinking? Starvation can wait a while? Blood is on your hands, remember that.
We were depending on you to help us with this famine. Now we simply can't stop people dying here. If you had done a better job, many lives would have been spared. Guilt? Well, that's your problem.
Was it really that difficult? Surely you could have managed to source enough food for us? It was our mistake to rely on independent traders, it seems. We won't make that mistake again.

mission_delivery_war_name: Deliver war supplies of $#CommodityQuantity; units of $#CommodityName;

mission_deliverywing_agriculture_mission: Thank you, Commander $#CommanderName;, for doing your bit to keep this agricultural economy running smoothly.

mission_deliverywing_boom_bulletincomple: That's how you take advantage of an economic boom, Commander $#CommanderName;. We should work together more!
mission_deliverywing_boom_failureinbox_0: Delivering key items might not be the most exciting work, but it has a valuable purpose and in times of economic boom we shouldn't squander those chances. You've let us and yourself down, $#CommanderName;.

mission_deliverywing_boom_killinbox_001: Be careful, Commander. You're likely to encounter some opposition on this run. Destroy them and we'll see about a bonus for you.
mission_deliverywing_boom_missioncomplet: You really are a shining example, Commander $#CommanderName;. With successes like these we can maximise our potential during this time of economic boom.
mission_deliverywing_boom_name: Boom time delivery of $#CommodityQuantity; units of $#CommodityName;
mission_deliverywing_boom_newdestination: There's an opportunity we'd like to take advantage of, but it means bringing the supplies to $#altDestinationStationSystemName;. Do that for us and we'll make it worth your while, Commander.
mission_deliverywing_boom_racefailureinb: You missed the new window, $#CommanderName;. We still need those items, so carry on bringing them.
mission_deliverywing_boom_raceinbox_001: Can you get those items to us sooner, Commander? There's a bonus in it for you if you can.
mission_deliverywing_boom_spawn: The economic boom requires us to make a number of large-scale deliveries to our customers. I suggest that you get the help of some associates for this mission.
mission_deliverywing_bulletincompletemis: You performed exactly as we'd hoped, $#CommanderName;. Well done.
mission_deliverywing_civilunrest_bulleti: This delivery has aided our campaign to put an end to this civil unrest, Commander $#CommanderName;. We truly appreciate your efforts.
mission_deliverywing_civilunrest_failure: All endeavours require suitable supply, $#CommanderName;, and yet you failed so miserably in this simple task. I hope we can expect better from you in the future.
mission_deliverywing_civilunrest_killeda: That looks like the last of them, Commander. Good work.
mission_deliverywing_civilunrest_killedm: Watch your back, Commander, there are more ships looking for you.

mission_deliverywing_civilunrest_mission: Well done, Commander $#CommanderName;. With these fresh supplies we take another step towards ending this civil unrest.
mission_deliverywing_civilunrest_name: Help quell civil unrest by transporting $#CommodityQuantity; units of $#CommodityName;
mission_deliverywing_civilunrest_newdest: The situation is turning more fluid than we anticipated, Commander. Bring the supplies to $#altDestinationStationSystemName; and make the delivery there. There will be a bonus for your time.
mission_deliverywing_civilunrest_racefai: We hoped that you'd meet the new deadline, but thankfully we didn't rely on it.
mission_deliverywing_civilunrest_raceinb: Those supplies can be put to better use, but only if you can deliver them before this new time. We'll add a bonus if you succeed.
mission_deliverywing_civilunrest_spawn: These large-scale deliveries to our associates will help prepare for the worst during the civil unrest. I suggest that you recruit some associates for this mission.
mission_deliverywing_civilwar_bulletinco: The civil war rages on, but with your help we march closer to victory. I salute you, Commander $#CommanderName;.
mission_deliverywing_civilwar_failureinb: We needed those supplies, $#CommanderName;. How can we be expected to win this civil war if you don't play your part?
mission_deliverywing_civilwar_killedallm: That looks like the last of them, Commander. Good work.
mission_deliverywing_civilwar_killedmini: Watch your back, Commander, there are more ships looking for you.

mission_deliverywing_civilwar_missioncom: This civil war is pushing us all to the limits, Commander $#CommanderName;. With your help we are sure to prevail!
mission_deliverywing_civilwar_name: Take $#CommodityQuantity; units of $#CommodityName; in support of the current civil war
mission_deliverywing_civilwar_newdestina: I have a change of the plan for you, Commander. Take the supplies to $#altDestinationStationSystemName; and we'll compensate you for the extra travel.
mission_deliverywing_civilwar_racefailur: The opportunity has been wasted because you couldn't make the new deadline, $#CommanderName;. We're not done yet, complete the mission as planned and let's see how it pans out.
mission_deliverywing_civilwar_raceinbox_: If you can get those supplies to us by this new time, Commander, we might gain an additional advantage in this civil war. Hopefully this bonus will spur you to go faster.
mission_deliverywing_civilwar_spawn: You can support us in the civil war by making large-scale deliveries to our allies. I suggest that you enlist the help of some associates for this mission.
mission_deliverywing_confederacy_bulleti: Keeping things running in this confederacy takes commitment, Commander $#CommanderName; and you've demonstrated that commitment here.
mission_deliverywing_confederacy_failure: This isn't showing your skills in a good light, $#CommanderName;. You need succeed to be taken seriously around here.

mission_deliverywing_confederacy_killedm: Watch your back, Commander, there are more ships looking for you.

mission_demandedgoods: Your passenger has demanded that you source $#CommodityQuantity:style:name=keyword; units of $#CommodityName:style:name=keyword;. You'll need to deliver the goods along with your passenger.
mission_disable_blops_blopsdetails: A message for $#CommanderName;. We have a covert action that requires your attention. Shut down $#disableTarget; at $#destinationSettlementName; and we'll reward you accordingly.
mission_disable_blops_bulletincompletemi: Looks like we chose well, Commander. We appreciate your contribution.
mission_disable_blops_civilunrest_blopsd: Commander, we need your services with a code black operation against a surface target. Assuming you are successful, this will aid us in the current civil unrest.
mission_disable_blops_civilunrest_bullet: We thank you for your assistance, Commander. This civil unrest is stretching our resources thin at the moment.
mission_disable_blops_civilunrest_collec: Well done, Commander $#CommanderName;. Disabling the $#disableTarget; at $#destinationSettlementName; has aided our operations in this time of civil unrest.
mission_disable_blops_civilunrest_failur: Our plan relied on you disabling the $#disableTarget; at $#destinationSettlementName;. That plan is now in tatters, because you couldn't do your part.
mission_disable_blops_civilunrest_missio: Let me congratulate you on a job well done, Commander. The civil unrest will soon be ended if we continue like this.
mission_disable_blops_civilunrest_spawn: Quietly shutting down the right surface bases will stop the troublemakers from coordinating, which should help ease the civil unrest.
mission_disable_blops_civilwar_blopsdeta: Immediate action required. We have a covert mission that needs immediate resolution. Deal with this surface target for us to aid our cause in this civil war.
mission_disable_blops_civilwar_bulletinc: Great job, Commander, your success has aided our campaign in this civil war.
mission_disable_blops_civilwar_collectre: Well done, Commander $#CommanderName;. The disruption from disabling the $#disableTarget; at $#destinationSettlementName; aided us elsewhere. Complete the mission to access your payment.
mission_disable_blops_civilwar_failurein: We needed you to disable the $#disableTarget; at $#destinationSettlementName;. It was part of a wider operation that has failed, thanks to your incompetence.
mission_disable_blops_civilwar_missionco: A mission completed with aplomb, Commander. We're a step closer to victory because of your assistance, and that is no small thing.
mission_disable_blops_civilwar_spawn: This covert mission to sabotage our enemy's systems will give our frontline forces some much-needed breathing space.
mission_disable_blops_collectreward_001: Not bad, Commander. With the $#disableTarget; at $#destinationSettlementName; dealt with, we can proceed with the next stage of our plan.
mission_disable_blops_colony_blopsdetail: Are you interested in a covert assignment? We have one that might suit your skills. Take care of this surface target for us and we'll reward you when you're done.
mission_disable_blops_colony_bulletincom: You completed that job with the skill we hoped for, Commander. It has certainly helped with our continued operations in this colony.
mission_disable_blops_colony_collectrewa: Great job, Commander. The chaos caused by disabling the $#disableTarget; at $#destinationSettlementName; has aided our operations against this rival. Complete the mission to access your payment.
mission_disable_blops_colony_failureinbo: We expected you to disable the $#disableTarget; at $#destinationSettlementName;. I don't understand how you could mess that up. Consider this mission terminated.
mission_disable_blops_colony_missioncomp: You helped us against a rival, Commander. We don't like to rely on black operations for colony business, but they do sometimes come in handy.
mission_disable_blops_colony_spawn: We need a specific planetary base to be shut down as quickly as possible. You don't need to know why – it's an internal matter. Our colony deals with its own problems.

mission_evacuationmissingpassengers: Your $#passenger1Type:style:name=keyword; are missing. Recover them before proceeding.
mission_evacuationstopperassassins_perki: Looks like the enemy is giving up now. You did a good thing putting them down. I'm looking forward to confirmation that you've arrived safely at your destination.
You've given them a black eye for sure, Commander. They're not sending anyone else after you. Get those passengers to safety and we're done.
We're not aware of any more hostiles looking for you. Good thing for us, smart choice for them. Delivery the passengers and we'll arrange your payment. With a bonus, of course.
You've earned your bonus, Commander. Hopefully they'll think twice before going after our people again. Time to drop the refugees at their temporary home.
The bonus you just earned from ending those chumps has been added to the contract. Well done. All that's left is to get those passengers to their destination.
Impressive! I'm praying you can make the rest of the journey in one piece. Keep going!
That's some nice flying, but you're not out of danger yet. More hostiles are on the way.
You're doing great, but more hostiles are on the way. Keep it up, Commander.
It ain't over yet, Commander. More enemies are moving to intercept. Show 'em what you're made of.
Good shooting, Commander. But the fight isn't over yet. Another wave is heading for you now.

We just caught signs of some troubling intel. Apparently a few psychopaths are on their way to prevent you from saving our people. Your priority is keeping our people safe, but if you manage to take any of them out I'll gladly make it worth your while.

One of my contacts just tipped us off to a hit squad heading your way. Our rivals aren't too concerned about refugees fleeing Thargoid attack, it seems. They just want to hit us while we're exposed.

If you manage to destroy any of the ships when they arrive, I'll pay you extra. But the passenger's safety is your priority.

You're not gonna believe this - some asshole has ordered a hit on your ship, to try and prevent us getting our people to safety. Opportunistic scumbags.

Don't risk the passenger's health, but if you can bring down the ships on your tail I'll arrange a bonus for you.

We've intercepted a data transmission ordering a hit on your ship. They don't care that you're on a mission of mercy with refugees in your care. Our rivals have deemed you a valid target to hurt us. 

I can offer some extra credits if you manage to blow them away. Don't forget the main objective though. Keep the passengers safe.

You've got some killers on your trail, Commander. An unknown number of hostiles are moving to intercept you before you reach your destination. They want to hurt us by taking out our personnel.

Don't let that happen. Keep the passengers safe. And if you destroy any of the assassins I'll bump your pay.
mission_evacuationstopperassassins_recom: They're not keen on chasing you after that. Nice job taking them out. Now get our people delivered safely!
Couldn't help yourself, huh? Well, you taught them a lesson. Get the passengers safe before any more snakes turn up.
Maybe 'avoid combat' isn't in your vocabulary. Still, you managed to survive. Well done. Please complete the mission and drop the refugees on your ship to their destination.

It's a good thing you know how to fight, Commander. I imagine your passengers aren't happy, but I certainly am. Lucky for you that I control your contract payment. Get the refugees to safety and collect your credits.
I don't think any more assassins are after you, Commander. It would have been preferable to avoid them, but you certainly can navigate a dogfight. Complete the mission and collect your pay.

Commander, some idiots preying on our vulnerable people have identified your vessel. Avoid them at all costs and get to the rescue ship. I've pulled some extra cash off another job if you do. Just keep our people safe!

A rival faction has sent assassins to intercept you. They want our evacuation efforts to fail, the heartless... whatever. Just get to the rescue ship, we'll bump your pay for keeping the passengers safe.

Heads up - a gang looking to take advantage of our fight against the Thargoids have sent goons after you. Avoid them at all costs. We'll pay extra if you do - your priority is getting the refugees to safety.

Your vessel has been identified by one of our enemies, Commander. They've dispatched a team to take out the passengers on your ship. Don't get drawn into a fight, and we'll pay you for completing the drop off.
You're in danger, Commander. An opportunistic rival is looking to weaken us by hitting our refugee transports. Don't let them get to you. Keep the passengers safe and we'll pay extra upon delivery.
mission_exit_description_contents:
Venture beyond the safety of the Pilots' Federation District and explore the galaxy.
Travel to $#DestinationStationName:style:name=keyword; in the $#DestinationStationSystemName:style:name=keyword; system to collect $#Reward:currency:style:name=keyword;.
Note: Docking outside of the Pilots' Federation district will revoke your district permit.
mission_failgeneric_description: You have failed to complete this contract.
mission_failonscan_warning: Being scanned will result in a mission failure.
mission_famine_authority_stopandsearch01: This is a random stop and scan, we have received numerous reports of foodstuffs being illegally transported in the area.
mission_famine_authority_stopandsearch02: Submit to scanning, pilot. We are on the lookout for illegal cargo and are authorized to seize any illicit foodstuffs.
mission_famine_authority_stopandsearch03: I am authorised to perform a ship scan, pilot. We have reports that high quantities of food are being smuggled throughout the system.
mission_famine_authority_stopandsearch04: Submit to authority crime scan, Commander.
mission_famine_authority_stopandsearch05: I am carrying out scans for illicit cargo. We are authorized to seize any foodstuffs suspected to have been obtained in an illegal manner.
mission_famine_authority_stopandsearch06: Prepare to be scanned for crimes, pilot. I trust you have a permit for any foodstuffs you may be carrying.
mission_famine_authority_thankyoupasseds: Thank you for your cooperation, Commander. We can't be too careful.
You're clean. Proceed, pilot. Thank you for obeying the law.
mission_famine_bountyhunter_attack02: Bounty detected, time to pay for your crimes.
mission_famine_bountyhunter_startinterdi: Someone's been naughty, haven't been stealing food have we?
I'll enjoy this all the more if you're carrying stolen food.
Crime doesn't pay, you. It's going to pay me very soon...
Hello, meal-ticket. You look like you're going to earn me a lot of credits.
mission_famine_pirate_arrive01: I'm sorry but my family need to eat.
mission_famine_pirate_arrive02: I need your cargo, my family are starving.
mission_famine_pirate_arrive03: That food you've got is worth a lot of credits round here.
mission_famine_pirate_arrive04: Look, I gotta eat. Give me that food and I won't kill you.
mission_famine_pirate_arrive05: The food or your life. Pick one.
mission_famine_pirate_interdiction01: I've heard you might be carrying food, hand it over.
mission_famine_pirate_interdiction03: I'm so hungry, have you got food in your cargo?
mission_famine_pirate_neardeath01: I just wanted something to eat!
mission_famine_pirate_neardeath03: At least I won't be hungry anymore.
mission_famine_smuggler_onarriveafterbei: Hey, there was no need for that! I'm not carrying anything too illegal.
I don't suppose we could come to an arrangement? No?
mission_famine_smuggler_onenemyshipdetec: Look, I'm not carrying any food, can't you turn a blind eye?
mission_findcontact: Meet the contact, $#pilotname2:style:name=keyword;, in the $#altDestinationStationSystemName:style:name=keyword; system and receive the data.
mission_findmassacreconflictalttargets: You should find targets in the conflict zones of the $#AltDestinationStationSystemname:style:name=keyword; system.
mission_findmassacreconflicttargets: Find your targets in the conflict zones of the $#NewDestinationStationSystemName:style:name=keyword; system.
mission_findmassacretargets: Try searching local res sites, nav beacons and signal sources to find your targets.
mission_fine_warning: Mission failure could lead to a fine.
mission_fsdinterdictor_tip: An FSD Interdictor will enable you to pull your targets out of supercruise.
mission_generic_alternatetarget: Commander, word has reached us that you have been dispatched to target $#pilotname1;. We can make it worth your while if you choose to take out $#pilotname3; instead. Please let us know your decision.
mission_generic_cargolost: Our scanners show the cargo is no longer in your hold, Commander.
mission_generic_cargoonboard: We can confirm the $#CommodityName; is in your cargo hold, Commander.
mission_generic_cargorequested: Commander, we require $#CommodityQuantity:style:name=keyword; units of $#CommodityName:style:name=keyword;. If you can find it for us, you will be well rewarded.
mission_generic_contactmet: Commander, I am uploading the relevant information to your panel as we speak.
mission_generic_continuetodestination: Mission is complete, Commander. Continue to your destination.
mission_generic_covertoperation: Commander, we have a covert mission that requires the efforts of a very special pilot. We think you're up to it.
mission_generic_crimecommitted: You have just broken the law, Commander.
mission_generic_deliveryneeded: Commander, we have certain goods that need to be safely delivered as soon as possible. Please help.
mission_generic_destinationchange: Commander, my plans have changed. Take me to $#AltDestinationStationName; in the $#AltDestinationSystemName; system instead please.
mission_generic_disabled: Confirmation received. Target has been disabled.
mission_generic_disgruntled: I am not willing to put up with these conditions for much longer, Commander.
mission_generic_distresscall: Mayday! Mayday! We require urgent assistance, Commander.
mission_generic_dontdieinbox: Commander, if you manage to complete this mission without losing your ship, there will be a bonus in it for you.
mission_generic_dontgetscannedinbox: Commander, we need to keep this mission confidential. Ensure that you complete it without being scanned.
mission_generic_emp_alternatetarget: Commander, according to our intelligence you are currently targeting $#pilotname1;. That particular pilot is important to us and we would like to propose an alternative. If you were to target $#pilotname3; instead, we would make it more than worth your while. What do you say?
mission_generic_emp_cargolost: Our scanners show the cargo is no longer in your hold, Commander.

mission_generic_emp_cargorequested: There has been a sudden demand for $#CommodityName:style:name=keyword; within the Empire. If you were to bring us $#CommodityQuantity:style:name=keyword; units of it, we would see you handsomely rewarded.
mission_generic_emp_contactmet: Commander, the data is being uploaded to your system now.

mission_generic_fed_hulldamage: You need to take better care of your ship, Commander.

mission_generic_fed_playerkilled: Your ship has been destroyed, Commander.
mission_generic_fed_playerscanned: Our systems indicate you've been scanned, Commander.
mission_generic_fed_racechance: We are against the clock here, Commander. Destroy those targets within the designated time period and there's a bonus in it for you.
mission_generic_fed_returnmylocation: Return to this location immediately, Commander.
mission_generic_fed_returntome: The mission was a success, Commander. Now get yourself back to my location.
mission_generic_fed_runninglate: You're running late, Commander. Let's hurry this up.
mission_generic_fed_runningoutoftime: You're running out of time, Commander. Get a move on!
mission_generic_fed_scanned: Your ship has just been scanned, Commander.
mission_generic_fed_targetdestroyedbad: The target is destroyed. This is not the outcome the Federation was hoping for, Commander.
mission_generic_fed_targetdestroyednext: Kill confirmed, Commander. The next target is $#pilotname1; in the $#AltDestinationSystemName; system.
mission_generic_fed_taxi: We need someone who can transport a passenger safely. We hope you're willing to take the job.
mission_generic_fed_touristbeaconrequest: Commander, it is important that I make an unscheduled stop on the way to my destination. Your compliance in this matter would be most helpful.
mission_generic_fed_unknownsignaldetecte: Commander, the Federation would like you to investigate an unidentified signal in a nearby system.
mission_generic_fed_visitconflictzone: Commander, I have received word that Federal forces are engaged nearby. Please take me to the conflict zone so I may review proceedings.
mission_generic_hacked: You have hacked the target, Commander.
mission_generic_hulldamage: That was damage to the hull, Commander. I don't want to die in here.
mission_generic_jointhefight: Commander, we need a few good pilots to join us. We hope you're ready and willing.
mission_generic_killchance: Commander, we have received information that enemy ships have been sent to target you. Take them out and there will be a bonus in it for you.
mission_generic_lookingforassistance: Hello, Commander. We require assistance and were hoping you could help.
mission_generic_meetcontact: Commander, we need you to make contact with one of our agents.
mission_generic_missedtarget: You have missed the target, Commander. Better luck next time.
mission_generic_missionfailed: You have failed to complete the mission, Commander.

mission_generic_passengerdeparting: I've had just about all I can take during this journey. I'm initiating escape pod procedures.

mission_generic_playerkilled: Your ship has been destroyed, Commander.

mission_generic_returnmylocation: Commander, please return to my location immediately.
mission_generic_returntome: Mission is complete, Commander. Please return to my location.
mission_generic_runninglate: You're running late, Commander. Please speed up this journey.
mission_generic_runningoutoftime: Time is almost out, Commander. Speed it up or you will fail the mission.
mission_generic_scanned: Your ship has just been scanned, Commander.
mission_generic_targetdestroyed: Target is destroyed, Commander. Good work.
mission_generic_targetdestroyedbad: Unfortunately the target has been destroyed, Commander.
mission_generic_targetdestroyednext: Target destroyed, Commander. Your next target is $#pilotname1; in the $#AltDestinationSystemName; system.
mission_generic_taxi: I need transportation, Commander. I'd like you to take me to my destination.
mission_generic_touristbeaconrequested: Commander, there is an attraction nearby that I would like to visit. Please stop by on the way and scan the beacon.
mission_generic_unknownsignaldetected: Commander, an unidentified signal has been detected in a nearby system.
mission_generic_visitconflictzone: Commander, I have received word that military forces are engaged nearby. Please take me to the conflict zone so I may review proceedings.
mission_genericpermit1_spawn: If you successfully complete this mission, you will be rewarded with access to a previously restricted star system.
mission_gotoconflictsystem_description_c: Pilots interested in honing their combat skills are advised to travel to $#DestinationStationSystemNameSystem:style:name=keyword; and take part in the Wargame training exercise.
mission_hack_blops_blopsdetails: Commander, we have a covert action that we believe your skills are suited for. We need you to retrieve some sensitive data for us. We hope you're up to the task.
mission_hack_blops_boom_blopsdetails: Commander, we need economic data on our rivals, but we must grab it covertly. This is where you come in. We hope you can you help us.
mission_hack_blops_boom_bulletincomplete: Well done, Commander, the data is coming through clearly.
mission_hack_blops_boom_collectrewardmes: A successful mission, Commander. By hacking the $#hackTarget; at $#destinationSettlementName;, we are able to prolong our economic prosperity. Complete the mission to access your payment.
mission_hack_blops_boom_failureinbox_001: By failing to interface with the $#hackTarget; at $#destinationsettlementname;, you've now put our future economic prosperity at risk.
mission_hack_blops_boom_missioncomplete: Good job, Commander! We now have some useful data on our business rivals.
mission_hack_blops_boom_spawn: Although our economy is strong we still need to secure data to ensure future prosperity. And we'll need it under the radar.
mission_hack_blops_bulletincompletemissi: We've confirmed the data integrity. Nice work, Commander.
mission_hack_blops_civilunrest_blopsdeta: Commander, we need you to take on a covert mission for us. There is some data that might aid us in putting down the current civil unrest. You will be compensated for your trouble.
mission_hack_blops_civilunrest_bulletinc: A job well done, Commander $#CommanderName;. This is just the data we hoped for.
mission_hack_blops_civilunrest_collectre: Hacking the $#hackTarget; at $#destinationSettlementName; will give us the data we need to help tackle this civil unrest. Complete the mission to access your payment.
mission_hack_blops_civilunrest_failurein: The civil unrest will continue, and we will never know whether that data could have helped shorten the strife. Most disappointing.
mission_hack_blops_civilunrest_missionco: This data will help refine our plans to tackle the civil unrest, Commander.
mission_hack_blops_civilunrest_spawn: People are taking to the streets, but we think someone is organising them. If you can hack into a communication database, you could trace the architect of this rebellion.
mission_hack_blops_civilwar_blopsdetails: Commander, our forces need tactical data, but we must grab it covertly. This is where you come in. We hope you can you help us.
mission_hack_blops_civilwar_bulletincomp: Well done, Commander, the data is coming through clearly.
mission_hack_blops_civilwar_collectrewar: A successful mission, Commander. By hacking the $#hackTarget; at $#destinationSettlementName;, we've learned more about our opposition in this civil war. Complete the mission to access your payment.
mission_hack_blops_civilwar_failureinbox: By failing to interface with the $#hackTarget; at $#destinationsettlementname;, we are now at a tactical disadvantage in this civil war.
mission_hack_blops_civilwar_missioncompl: Good job, Commander! We now have some useful data on the faction we are fighting against in this civil war.
mission_hack_blops_civilwar_spawn: The enemy are anticipating our troop movements, which suggests we have a mole. If you can hack their systems, you might be able to identify who the double agent is.
mission_hack_blops_collectrewardmessage_: A clean strike. We now have the data from the $#hackTarget; at $#destinationSettlementName;. With that, we can move to the next stage of our operation. Our thanks, Commander.
mission_hack_blops_elections_blopsdetail: Commander, it has come to our attention that some sensitive poll data is stored in a ground facility. If you can retrieve that data for us, it may give us the advantage we need in the coming elections.
mission_hack_blops_elections_bulletincom: Cracking work, Commander $#CommanderName;. Our experts are looking forward to analysing that poll data.
mission_hack_blops_elections_collectrewa: Nicely done, Commander $#CommanderName;. The data is ours. Return here and we'll sort out your payment.
mission_hack_blops_elections_failureinbo: You've let us down, $#CommanderName;. That data could have proved decisive in the coming elections, but I guess we will never know now.
mission_hack_blops_elections_missioncomp: We may have gained the edge we need in the coming elections, thanks to you, Commander.
mission_hack_blops_elections_spawn: Our rival party in the elections is becoming far too popular. We're sure that if you can gain access to their network, you could uncover some juicy secrets that the media would love to hear about.
mission_hack_blops_expansion_blopsdetail: Commander $#CommanderName;. Our expansion plans would no doubt be improved if we had the right data in our possession. We believe you can help us with this.
mission_hack_blops_expansion_bulletincom: Great work, Commander $#CommanderName;. I'm certain this information will provide us with what we need.
mission_hack_blops_expansion_collectrewa: Great job, Commander. Hacking the $#hackTarget; at $#destinationSettlementName; should help us with our expansion plans. Complete the mission to access your payment.
mission_hack_blops_expansion_failureinbo: All you had to do was interface with the $#hackTarget; at $#destinationsettlementname;. I don't understand how you could mess that up. Consider this mission terminated.
mission_hack_blops_expansion_missioncomp: You've been a big help to us, Commander. Our analysts will search through the data to see how we can take advantage of it.
mission_hack_blops_expansion_spawn: Gaining access to private astrographic data will help us expand into another system. Since it's not for sale, that means we're relying on you to obtain it for us.
mission_hack_blops_failureinbox_001: All we required was the data contained in the $#hackTarget; at $#destinationsettlementname;. Your failure will have ramifications, Commander. Be warned.
mission_hack_blops_investment_blopsdetai: Commander, we require some sensitive financial data, but we must grab it covertly. This is where you come in. We hope you can you help us.
mission_hack_blops_investment_bulletinco: Well done, Commander, the data is coming through clearly.
mission_hack_blops_investment_collectrew: A successful mission, Commander. By hacking the $#hackTarget; at $#destinationSettlementName;, we've gained some crucial financial data. Complete the mission to access your payment.
mission_hack_blops_investment_failureinb: By failing to interface with the $#hackTarget; at $#destinationsettlementname;, we are now at a significant financial disadvantage.
mission_hack_blops_investment_missioncom: Good job, Commander! We now have some useful financial data on which we can plan future investments.
mission_hack_blops_investment_spawn: Our company's annual spreadsheet is seriously unbalanced. If you can secure us some important financial data, that would help to keep us in the black.
mission_hack_blops_lockdown_blopsdetails: Commander $#CommanderName;. Our efforts in ending this lockdown would no doubt be improved if we had the right data in our possession. This is where you come in.
mission_hack_blops_lockdown_bulletincomp: This was top-notch work, Commander. I'm certain this data will give us what we need.
mission_hack_blops_lockdown_collectrewar: Hacking the $#hackTarget; at $#destinationSettlementName; is just what we needed. Complete the mission to access your payment, Commander.
mission_hack_blops_lockdown_failureinbox: Your inability to hack the $#hackTarget; at $#destinationsettlementname; has repercussions. We'd hoped to find a way out of this lockdown.
mission_hack_blops_lockdown_missioncompl: Your success has been a big help to us, Commander. Our analysts will comb through the data to see how we can take advantage of it.
mission_hack_blops_prisoncol_blopsdetail: Commander $#CommanderName;. We require some sensitive data from another facility. I hope you can help us with this.
mission_hack_blops_prisoncol_bulletincom: A job completed to our satisfaction, Commander. I'm certain this data will give us what we need.
mission_hack_blops_prisoncol_collectrewa: Well done, Commander $#CommanderName;. By hacking the $#hackTarget; at $#destinationSettlementName;, we've learned a great deal. Complete the mission to access your payment.
mission_hack_blops_prisoncol_failureinbo: Your failure has been noted $#CommanderName;. The information stored in the $#hackTarget; at $#destinationsettlementname; could have changed things for us. This mission is over.
mission_hack_blops_prisoncol_missioncomp: You've helped us here, Commander. Our analysts will extract what we need from this data.
mission_hack_blops_prisoncol_spawn: Somehow, certain prisoners are sending messages to outside the colony. We're looking to hire someone who can intercept them so we can trace them back to the source.
mission_hack_blops_research_blopsdetails: Commander $#CommanderName;. Our research programmes would improve if we had the right data available. You can help us with that.
mission_hack_blops_research_bulletincomp: A splendid effort, Commander $#CommanderName;. I'm certain this research data will give us what we need.
mission_hack_blops_research_collectrewar: Great job, Commander $#CommanderName;. By hacking the $#hackTarget; at $#destinationSettlementName;, we've gained valuable research data. Complete the mission to access your payment.
mission_hack_blops_research_failureinbox: All you had to do was hack the $#hackTarget; at $#destinationsettlementname;. And you managed to screw that up - unbelievable! Consider this mission terminated.
mission_hack_blops_research_missioncompl: We are in your debt, Commander. Our analysts will examine the data to see how we can take advantage of it.
mission_hack_blops_research_spawn: Research is big business around here, and the biggest businesses are those with access to restricted research. Your hacking skills will help us become bigger than ever.
mission_hack_blops_retreat_blopsdetails: Commander, we need to procure data vital to our survival in the system, but we must grab it covertly. This is where you come in. We hope you can help us.
mission_hack_blops_retreat_bulletincompl: Well done, Commander, the data is coming through clearly.
mission_hack_blops_retreat_collectreward: A successful mission, Commander. By hacking the $#hackTarget; at $#destinationSettlementName;, we've learned how to best utilise our few remaining resources in the system. Complete the mission to access your payment.
mission_hack_blops_retreat_failureinbox_: By failing to interface with the $#hackTarget; at $#destinationsettlementname;, you've made our fight to stay in the system that much more difficult.
mission_hack_blops_retreat_missioncomple: Good job, Commander! We now have some useful data with which we can plan our efforts.
mission_hack_blops_retreat_spawn: Gaining access to encrypted data will guide our defensive efforts. Since it's not for sale, we're relying on you to obtain it for us.
mission_hack_blops_spawn: We have an unauthorised mission that involves performing a hack. It's vital that you achieve this for us covertly.
mission_hack_blops_war_blopsdetails: Commander, our plans for the war rely on the right information. We need you to get that information for us.
mission_hack_blops_war_bulletincompletem: Well done, Commander. The data is coming through clearly.
mission_hack_blops_war_collectrewardmess: That's exactly what we needed, Commander. The chaos caused by hacking the $#hackTarget; at $#destinationSettlementName; will give us an edge in this war, I'm sure of it. Complete the mission to access your payment.
mission_hack_blops_war_failureinbox_001: All you had to do was hack the $#hackTarget; at $#destinationsettlementname;. With that data, our victory would have been a step closer.
mission_hack_blops_war_missioncomplete: Great work, Commander $#CommanderName;. Covert actions like these will help in the war.
