mission_tw_refugeebulk_racefailedinbox_0: What's the delay, Commander? We have a lot of matters to resolve now that our home is in ruins. The bonus I offered is no longer on the table.
mission_tw_refugeebulk_raceinbox_001: Get us out of here as fast as you can, Commander! I will pay extra if you get us to our destination before the updated deadline.
mission_tw_refugeebulk_refugeeuss_resolv: Thank you for investigating.  Too bad we couldn't save them.
Thank you for investigating.  I'm glad we were able to make a difference!
mission_tw_refugeebulk_refugeeusslocatio: Commander, I have heard about an attraction nearby that I would like to visit. Please stop by on the way.
Sorry, Commander. We want to help, but I think it's time to cut our losses and get to our destination.
This is the source of the distress call.  Please investigate.
Arrived at source of Distress call
mission_tw_refugeebulk_refugeeussrefused: Fine. I don't suppose I'll change your mind, so let's continue. I can't believe that you don't care for the needs of your passengers!
mission_tw_refugeebulk_spawn: Commander, our group needs evacuation as soon as possible.
mission_tw_refugeebulk_timerunningout_00: Your careful piloting is appreciated, Commander, but we do need to get to our destination. Could you increase rate of travel, please?
mission_tw_refugeevip_abandoned_inbox_00: These continued delays are unacceptable, Commander. I want you to drop me off at the closest port instead so I can make other arrangements.
mission_tw_refugeevip_afterabductions_fl: You have to get us out of here, Commander! They're going to get us all if you don't! We're not safe, don't you see!?
I'm never going to forget what happened... The noise, the gas - it was terrifying. Please, get us to safety as quickly as you can.
The aliens took them! Why would they take them? What do they want with us? Don't let them snatch me too, damn it!
The missiles they hit us with breached the hull and there was this... this stuff inside that made people lose their minds. The look of horror on their faces. My god.

Why are we still here? Where the Thargoids can get us? I don't want to be stolen away by these things. Something happened in that cabin right before the escape pods jettisoned. It scared them witless.
mission_tw_refugeevip_arrivedwithpasseng: We've finally arrived. Thank goodness. Set us down when you're ready, Commander.
Safe at last. Good flying Commander, get us docked so I can find out which system I'll be living in for a while.
We're nearly there. I commend you on your flying, Commander. Almost a flawless journey. Try to make the landing a soft one, eh?
We're so close to leaving that horror behind for good. You've done well to keep everyone safe. Nice job!
At last, we've arrived at our destination! The Thargoids will never get their filthy claws on me, hah! Approach the dock at your earliest convenience, Commander.
You managed to get me to our destination, Commander. It was a rough journey, but it's nearly over.
It's sad that not everyone made it, but we're finally here. Let's get to the port and finish the mission.
That was a stressful trip. Not all of us made it, but those who did are grateful. I'm looking forward to arrival.
You carried me through some dangerous territory and most of us are here to tell the tale. Time to dock at the final stop, Commander.
Not the most pleasant flight, but to be expected - evacuations from a warzone aren't going to be a breeze. At least some of us remain to share the story of this journey.
mission_tw_refugeevip_crimecommitted_inb: Commander, I don't appreciate your flagrant disregard for the law. Especially while I'm onboard.
mission_tw_refugeevip_damagerecieved_inb: Commander, has something damaged our hull? It sounded like it! You should know that I don't handle stress very well...
mission_tw_refugeevip_disgruntledpasseng: We may be refugees but a contract was agreed, Commander. Thank you for your help, but forgive me if I do not sing your praises to my associates.

Are you toying with us, Commander? Why haven't we docked yet? In fact - forget it. We're using the escape pods. 

Good luck with whatever you've decided is more important than our contract.
I can't wait any longer. Take me to the closest port. I will find a more professional pilot to finish the journey.
mission_tw_refugeevip_fluffmessage001_in: Do you travel through Thargoid-infested space regularly? I can't say I like it very much. Will we be leaving soon?
mission_tw_refugeevip_fluffmessage002_in: Not to rush you, Commander, but it would be wonderful if we moved out of range of the Thargoid ships. Soon, I mean. Very soon. The sooner the better.
mission_tw_refugeevip_fluffmessage003_in: If we could hurry this journey up some.... That would be great.
mission_tw_refugeevip_fluffmessage004_in: I don't like the fact that we're still so close to the Thargoid fleet, Commander. Please get us out of here as soon as possible.
mission_tw_refugeevip_fluffmessage005_in: This system has Thargoids in it. Despite the fact I'm paying you to put light years between me and the alien murderers. Get to it, Commander!
mission_tw_refugeevip_fluffmessage_pm_00: Did you not notice that we've lost passengers, Commander? What the hell are we still doing in this area of space! Jump us to safety at once!
I don't want to be the next person lost to those... things. Please hurry up and get us to safe space, Commander. I can't cope with the stress.
If we stay in this system the Thargoids are going to scoop me up and put worms in my brain. I just know it! For God's sake make the jump away from here!
One passenger lost is one too many. I don't want to be the second, or third, or any number at all! Take me out of this system, please.
Are you sure the Thargoids aren't going to get us? We're missing people already... I don't like it, I don't like it at all. Commander, let's hurry!
mission_tw_refugeevip_lostdemandedgoodsi: You're no longer carrying the goods I requested, Commander.
mission_tw_refugeevip_nearlydisgruntledh: I'm at my wits' end in this blasted ship! I demand that you deliver us to the agreed destination immediately.
mission_tw_refugeevip_nearlydisgruntledi: My patience is running out, Commander. When will we arrive at our destination?
mission_tw_refugeevip_newdestination_pas: The loss of passengers from your vessel has necessitated a change of plan, Commander. Take me to $#AltDestinationStationName; in the $#AltDestinationSystemName; system as soon as you can.

mission_tw_refugeevip_newdestinationtime: Commander! This should not be taking so long. Your lack of haste will cost you a portion of your payment.
mission_tw_refugeevip_ntfluffmessage_001: It's so good to be away from that terrifying place. Thank you for taking me to safety. I hope the journey doesn't take too long.
mission_tw_refugeevip_ntfluffmessage_002: No Thargoids... It's such a relief. There's so much to do when I arrive at our destination, though. My whole world is upside-down.
mission_tw_refugeevip_ntfluffmessage_003: You're a very kind person for taking me away from that nightmare. Some of my loved ones have contacted me. I'm going to meet them at our current destination. Please hurry.
mission_tw_refugeevip_ntfluffmessage_004: I can't wait to get to our destination. It's so good not to be staring out the window, wondering when the next Thargoid is going to appear.
mission_tw_refugeevip_ntfluffmessage_005: We're away from the warzone now, right? Thank the stars... I was beginning to think my time was up. You've really helped me out here, Commander.
mission_tw_refugeevip_ntfluffmessage_pm_: Not all of us made it out... It's strange, we were talking right before they were gone. This isn't a good feeling.
I can't believe we made it to safety. When the other passenger was lost I was so scared. You did well to get out of there before things got worse.
We made it! We're out of reach of the Thargoids. I'm so relieved. But there's less people back here now... I hope they survived, but I suppose there's not much chance of that.
Can I relax now? Are the aliens gone? I swear that my heart rate hasn't slowed for days. Please bring us to our destination as quickly as you can. I need a rest.

It's so good to be out of the warzone. And about time, too! I was waiting for hours in cramped conditions, among the regular people... You'd think I would receive special treatment from the security guards.
mission_tw_refugeevip_passengerejectinbo: It seems you can't perform the simplest of actions within the allotted time. Goodbye, Commander.
mission_tw_refugeevip_passengerlost001_i: At least one of your passengers is missing! I think they're lost for good, Commander. This is awful news.
mission_tw_refugeevip_passengerrecovered: Thank you for recovering me! I thought I was doomed.
mission_tw_refugeevip_playerdiedinbox_00: Commander, your ship is destroyed and now I won't reach my destination on time. The contract is cancelled.

mission_tw_rescue_burning_missioncomplet: Thank you, we'll get them straight into medical care. Your credits have been transferred.
mission_tw_rescue_burning_spawn: The Thargoids tore this place to pieces. We still have people to evacuate. Please help us.
mission_tw_rescue_underattack_missioncom: There's no shortage of injured due to this terrible war. Thanks for bringing these poor souls to us - we'll look after them.
mission_tw_rescue_underattack_spawn: Please help us get our people out of here! The Thargoids are trying to destroy this port!
mission_tw_spirecollect_failureinboxmess: You've taken too long to recover the objects from the Thargoid spire site, Commander. We need to recalibrate our military projections, which means cancelling the contract.
mission_tw_spirecollect_missioncomplete: Great work, Commander $#CommanderName;! With these items we can develop more sabotage compounds. I hope you'll consider delivering them.
mission_tw_spirecollect_name: Collect resources from a Thargoid Spire Site
mission_tw_spirecollect_spawn: We must learn as much as possible about these Thargoid spire sites and make use of the materials found there.
mission_tw_spiresabotage_failureinboxmes: You've taken too long to sabotage the Thargoid spires, Commander. We need to recalibrate our military projections, which means cancelling the contract.
mission_tw_spiresabotage_missioncomplete: Nicely done, Commander $#CommanderName;. We can only hope your actions will impede the Thargoid war effort.
mission_tw_spiresabotage_name: Sabotage production at a Thargoid Spire Site
mission_tw_spiresabotage_spawn: We've managed to taint a Thargoid spire compound. Place it into the alien's processing flow to hurt their industry.

mission_unrest_authority_stopandsearch04: Submit to authority crime scan, Commander. Illegal cargo transportation will result in punishment.
mission_unrest_authority_stopandsearch05: I am carrying out scans for illicit cargo. We are authorised to seize any weapons suspected to have been obtained in an illegal manner.
mission_unrest_authority_stopandsearch06: Prepare to be scanned for crimes, pilot. I trust you have a permit for any weapons you may be carrying.
mission_unrest_rebels_arrive01: I'm sorry but I'm going to have to take that cargo. My need is greater than yours.
mission_unrest_rebels_arrive02: I need your cargo, our cause is greater than your greed!
mission_unrest_rebels_arrive03: Those weapons will do a lot of good in the right hands.
mission_unrest_rebels_arrive04: Give me the guns and I won't kill you.
mission_unrest_rebels_arrive05: The weapons or your life? Choose quickly.
mission_unrest_rebels_interdiction01: If you're carrying military hardware we need it more than you do.
mission_unrest_rebels_interdiction02: Word on the grapevine is that you're carrying weapons. I need those guns.
mission_unrest_rebels_interdiction03: Our cause needs weapons. Let's see what you've got.
mission_unrest_rebels_neardeath01: At least I die for a cause I believe in!
mission_unrest_rebels_neardeath02: I was just trying to give my family a better life.
mission_urgent_tip: This mission is urgent. Be prepared to travel to the mission location immediately.
mission_urgentsupplyfailure_001: Time's up. We needed these supplies urgently and I have no idea where you are. I'll find someone else who can deliver.
mission_urgentsupplyfailure_002: You're out of time. Those supplies were urgently needed but you haven't brought them to us. I'll find someone else for the job.
mission_urgentsupplyfailure_003: We don't have time to wait any longer. Those supplies should have been here and you haven't delivered. I'll find someone else who can deliver.
mission_urgentsupplyfailure_004: Time's up. Whatever you were doing, you didn't do it quickly enough. I'll find someone else who can keep track of time.
mission_urgentsupplyfailure_005: I'm rescinding the contract, Commander. The mission supplies haven't been delivered on time and we can't afford to wait any longer. I'll have to find someone more reliable.

Conduct successful operations with us to restore your previous status.

From the $#MinorFaction; operations team.
mission_util_faction_down_hostile:

From the $#MinorFaction; operations team.

mission_util_faction_up_allied:

We hope that you will continue to support us, and you will always be welcomed.

From the $#MinorFaction; operations team.
mission_util_faction_up_cordial:

We are pleased to inform you that your reputation status with $#MinorFaction; has been raised to cordial.

You should keep completing successful operations with us to enhance your reputation further.

mission_welcome_assassinate_alternativei: Greetings, Commander, my sources tell me that $#MinorFaction; have sent you to kill $#pilotname1;. I would like you to consider a different target. We can offer you a substantial reward if you eliminate $#pilotname3;. Let me know your decision.
mission_welcome_assassinate_alternativen: Commander, that scan did the trick. Updating your systems with the target's last known location.
mission_welcome_assassinate_bulletincomp: A difficult task done well, Commander $#CommanderName;. Thank you.
mission_welcome_assassinate_collectalter: Well done, Commander. Our reports confirm that $#pilotname3; has been eliminated. Payment is waiting and will be transferred once you complete the contract.
mission_welcome_assassinate_collectrewar: Well done, Commander. Our reports confirm that $#pilotname1; has been eliminated. Your rewards are waiting and will be transferred once you complete the contract.
mission_welcome_assassinate_contactchat1: If you're looking for $#pilotname1; I recently saw them nearby. If you are quick you might still catch them.
mission_welcome_assassinate_contactconta: Hello, Commander. I was told you were looking for $#pilotname1;? I recently caught sight of them in the $#NewDestinationStationSystemName; system. Details to follow. Good luck, Commander!
mission_welcome_assassinate_contactinbox: Commander, we aren't reading any sign of the target in this system. I've just received a tip off that one of my agents in the $#ContactSystem; system might have more information. Get over there and see if you can find $#pilotname2;.
Commander, I've just received word that $#pilotname1; has been eliminated and you're no longer in need of my assistance. Nice work, now go get that reward!
mission_welcome_assassinate_dontdieinbox: Commander, we want a quick clean kill. If you can take down your target without losing your own ship then there will be a bonus waiting for you on your return.
mission_welcome_assassinate_failureinbox: Was the mission not clear enough, Commander? Should I have drawn you a picture? Mission Terminated.
mission_welcome_assassinate_inboxscannav: Scan the nav beacon to get accurate information about the target's location.
mission_welcome_assassinate_inboxweapons: Your target is in the $#DestinationStationSystemName; system. Make sure you have some weapons before heading there. You can purchase these via Outfitting at certain stations.
mission_welcome_assassinate_killedallmin: That looks like the last of them, Commander. Good work.
mission_welcome_assassinate_killedminion: Watch your back, Commander, there are more ships looking for you.
mission_welcome_assassinate_killinbox_00: Well done, Commander. Our reports confirm that $#pilotname1; has been eliminated. Come back to $#startStationName; to collect your reward. But be careful, it looks like one of our competitors has sent some ships after you. They may try to interdict you. You can avoid interdiction by keeping aligned with the escape vector circle. If you do manage to take them out, you'll earn a bonus.
mission_welcome_assassinate_killnavbeaco: Scan complete, Commander. Your target's last known location is being uploaded to your ship's system now.
mission_welcome_assassinate_locatenavbea: Commander, the nav beacon didn't give us anything useful. Someone is covering the target's tracks. I suggest hacking a radar to find the target.
mission_welcome_assassinate_locateraderi: That's done the trick, Commander $#CommanderName;. The target's last known coordinates are being uploaded to your ship's system now.
mission_welcome_assassinate_massacreinbo: If you are interested in learning more about combat, come back here to see me. I will upload a onslaught contract to the mission board shortly, under the 'follow on' category.
mission_welcome_assassinate_mentorinbox: Welcome, Commander. I have been informed that you are in need of combat training. Accept my mission here on the mission board and I'll get you combat ready in no time.
mission_welcome_assassinate_missedtarget: Mission failed, Commander, you had your chance but you blew it.
Commander $#CommanderName;, your window of opportunity has closed. If you can't find the target soon we will have to abort the mission.
mission_welcome_assassinate_missiontarge: When targeting a ship, you scanner will provide you with extra details about them. Once you find your mission target, unleash your weapons and shoot to kill.
mission_welcome_assassinate_navbeaconinb: Your target's last known location is being uploaded to your ship's system now. Fly around the designated area in supercruise, and look out for your target in a USS (unidentified signal source). Once you find your mission target USS, drop into the USS and take them out.
mission_welcome_assassinate_spawn: Welcome, Commander. You're in the right place to learn about combat. This mission will provide you with the know-how to perform assassinations.
mission_welcome_collect_bulletincomplete: Thank you for your assistance in this matter, Commander.
mission_welcome_collect_destinationinbox: Occasionally, missions will branch. In this case, I would like you to divert to $#altDestinationStationSystemName; and make the delivery there. We will provide a bonus payment for the inconvenience. You are free to accept or reject this offer.
mission_welcome_collect_failureinboxmess: Commander, when we asked you to collect the goods on time, we meant on time. This failure has not done your reputation any favours. Mission Terminated.
mission_welcome_collect_galaxymapinbox_0: The galaxy map can be opened via the left hand menu. Select the view tab, map view and then under filters, select trade data shop to display trade routes. missionpack_dossier_1_harlentong_001_bod:
Harlen Tong is a skilled contractor specialising in covert reconnaissance and espionage. Hailing from the Lave system, he spent six years as a test pilot before going freelance. Since then he has received nothing but praise from this employers.

Tong is a talented pilot, but he doesn't go in for theatrics. If you need something done quickly, quietly and efficiently Tong's your man. If you want something blown up, look elsewhere. 

Tong's last known location was in the Khowei system near Iota Khowei 6.
missionpack_dossier_2_thephagos_001_body:
The Phagos are roaming scavengers of uncommon savagery. Preliminary intelligence indicates that their organisation is surprisingly large and well organised.

These are no mere pirates.

It is essential that the scale of the Phagos's operation be determined. System security can manage a handful of agitators, but a large well organised group is a different matter. It is also important to establish where these scavengers came from, and if they have been driven out of hiding by some other force.

The Phagos are fearsome pilots who show no mercy in combat. Their favorite trick is to rig the shipwrecks of their enemies with explosives, as an unpleasant surprise for anyone investigating the ship's remains.

Lets take a scan the flight recorder to see what we can find out.
Given the state of the wreck it might take a while to extract the data.
missionpack_script_findingphagos_003_bod:
What do we have here?

Someone sticking their nose where it don't belong.
You need to learn to mind you own business friend.

Looks like you've attracted some attention commander. I hope you're in the mood for a fight.

Tell you what, for every ship you take down I'll give you a bonus.

Great shooting Commander, but there's still more out there.
Get them before they can call for backup.
missionpack_script_findingphagos_006_bod:
Thanks for your efforts Commander.

I've reviewed the data and it looks like Harlem found the Phagos base. Obviously they took him out before he could get the data to me.

As I said before my priority is finding how big the Phagos organisation is and how well equipped they are. Assuming you're interested, I'd like you to check out the Phagos base and determine the scale of their operation.

I've got a ship waiting for you, specially configured for stealth missions.

What do you say Commander?

missionpack_script_findingtong_002_body: Tong's ship is close by. Lock on to the ships transponder signal, it should take you straight to him.
missionpack_script_findingtong_003_body:
Damn! It looks like the Phagos got to Tong. That's too bad, he was a good man.

Well there's nothing we can do for him now, can you access his flight recorder, it might tell us something.
missionpack_script_findingtong_004_body:
Still with me Commander?

The Phagos must have booby trapped Tong's ship. The flight recorder indicates that he managed to take one of them out before he went down.

Maybe you could search the area for Phagos ship wrecks.
missionpack_script_hunterbriefing_001_bo:
Thanks for coming Commander. Here's the situation.

I recently hired a pilot named Harlen Tong to perform some surveillance, but not long after he reached his destination he went dark on me. 

Something must have gone wrong, I've used Tong before, he's a professional, reliable.

I want you to travel to Tong's Last known location and find out what happened to him. 

Lets get to it commander.
missionpack_script_hunterbriefing_002_bo:
It's good to have you on board commander.

I recruited Tong to investigate a band of roaming scavengers called the Phagos. We don't know much about them, but we know they're bad news.

I wanted Tong to determine the scale of their operation so we know what we're up against.

The first task is to find out what happened to Tong. I've transferred some background info to your ships computer, you can review it en-route, I'll monitor your progress from here. Good luck Commander.
missionpack_script_hunterbriefing_003_bo:
That's a pity Commander, I thought you were someone I could depend on.

I guess I was wrong.
missionpack_script_hunterbriefing_004_bo:
Let not sit round, we've both got work to do.

I'll be in touch.

Happy hunting Commander.

missionpack_script_rescuesmuggler_001_bo:
This is where the distress signal was coming from, but it looks like you're too late. 
There are no signs of life, looks like the Phagos really did a number here. These attacks don't seem like random raids.

Have a look around, there might still be something useful here.
missionpack_script_rescuesmuggler_002_bo:
I've isolated the signal to a Los Syndicate ship in the wreckage. 

Scan the ship uplinks, their logs might tells us what happened here. 

Oh and don't forget to keep an eye out for boody traps, we don't want a repeat of what happened with Tong's ship.
missionpack_script_rescuesmuggler_003_bo:
Interesting, very interesting. 

So our late friend here was working for Dalton. I've run into him before, your average low life,  gambler, smuggler.
This must be one of their drop sites. 

If the raiders are hitting Dalton and the Synidicate, maybe just maybe they'd be willing to help us.

But Dalton's not going to help us out of the goodness of his heart. We're going to need to win him over somehow.

I've got it! 

Dalton is going to be looking for his cargo and this poor sap Isn't going to be able to deliver. If you the intended cargo to Dalton it might just be enough to get you in with him. 

 Search the wreckage for Dalton's goods.
missionpack_script_rescuesmuggler_004_bo:
That looks like all of it.

Now all you need to do is deliver the goods to Dalton. Oh and speaking as security chief, those things are highly illegal in these parts, so you best not get scanned while carrying them. If you get caught you are on your own. I can't be connected to smuggling.

Oh and don't mention to Dalton that your working for me. You're trying to get this guys to help us and we're not exactly friends.

The rendevous was at insert space station name. Get going and I'll check inwith you later.
missionpack_script_rescuesmuggler_005_bo: There must be more logs to scan. If you find them maybe we can piece together what happened here.
missionpack_script_theheist_001_body:
This is the place. 
Find the prototype powerplants, they will be somewhere well protected.
The installation is well guarded, so watch out for patrols and security systems.
If you are caught, you are on your own.
Get to it Commander.
missionpack_script_theheist_002_body:
These are the items we are looking for.
Bring them back to me at De Horizons in Khowei and I will arrange a meeting with my contact.
missionpack_script_theheist_003_body:
NotDetected

Have you ever thought of becoming a full time smuggler Commander? You seem like a natural.
Now get those items to me and we can see if we can solve you're little problem.
missionpack_script_theheist_004_body:
Bull in a ...

I see what you lack in stealth and discretion you make up for in sheer determination.
You're not here to kill security, you're here so get me what i need!
So stop shooting up the place and find me those prototypes ot the deal is off!

ms_the_alexandria1_001_body:
May 28th, 3307.
Captain Morales, private log.

I guess it's about time for an update, huh? These past few weeks have been rough.

After the Thargoid attacks I mentioned last time, the plan was for the Alexandria to leave Delphi and seek refuge in the Sol system. It's about as safe a location as humanity has to offer, right? Well, the Thargoids followed us to our first waypoint in HIP 16538. The only reason the Alexandria is still intact is due to independent pilots jumping in to protect us. God knows how this war would have panned out without them.

To really put the spit-shine on things, the Federation banned the Alexandria from entering its space a few days ago. They're convinced that our cargo is attracting the Thargoids. Maybe they're right. I thought the 'Thargoid Curse' was nonsense, but something's drawing them like flies around crap. It's no secret that Guardian tech stirs Thargoids up pretty badly. Maybe Aegis should have thought of that before filling my ship's cargo holds with the stuff.

A few of my crew have suggested jettisoning the Guardian artefacts. I understand why. They're nervous. But the cargo is critical to Aegis's work. We have to make sure the cargo is dispersed securely via Aegis craft - not easy to do while there's Thargoids and a civilian population to worry about.

Since Sol's off the menu, The Alexandria has been redirected to HIP 30944. It's a practically empty system. We have vessels farming the tritium for the jump but it's dangerous out there with the Thargoids prowling. I estimate a week before we're ready to move.

Anyway, that's it for now. I need to contact Admiral Tanner to discuss the cargo exchange schedule. Hopefully I'll have some better news next time.
ms_the_alexandria2_001_body:
Attention all crew. This is Captain Morales.

The Alexandria has not arrived in HIP 30944, as planned. Our current location is unknown. All navigational systems have been disabled, and our FSD is offline. Long-range sensors are fried. Communication arrays are down. 

I'll be honest with you: it looks like the ship has been sabotaged by someone who knew exactly what to do. My guess is we're floating between systems. 'Dead space', my grandpa called it. Could be here for a while.

What I can tell you is that life support is still running and emergency power looks stable. We're not going to run out of air or heat anytime soon. Our cargo and stores are intact.

There's a lot of work ahead of us, ladies and gentlemen. I'm confident that we'll get ourselves home but it's not going to be easy. I need every one of your calm and focused. Officers will be given a full rundown of tasks in the next hour or so. Do everything you're told as efficiently as possible, and the Alexandria will be up and running before you know it.

Stay frosty. Morales out.
ms_the_alexandria3_001_body:
July 3rd, 3307.
Captain Morales, private log.

It's been a month since the failed hyperspace jump. We're still dead in the water, so to speak.

Our technicians are working sixteen hour days but aren't achieving much. Whoever sabotaged us knew everything about the Alexandria's operation. They corrupted our computer and wiped all alternates and backups. Most of our interface panels are useless. I can't even order a hot drink from the god-damned vending machines anymore.

The hardware was crippled as well. Even our shuttles and fighters. Grant assessed the damage and can't work out how the hell it happened. But it happened, all right. I'd be impressed if I didn't have four thousand crew looking to me to get them home. Instead I want to strangle whoever did this to us.

Morales. Where? Port side? Meet me in docking bay one.

Vernier says a bunch of heavy freighters just dropped out of hyperspace nearby. Given that we're not broadcasting a signal, they're either the luckiest search party in the galaxy or they knew exactly where to look.
ms_the_alexandria4_001_body:
This is Captain Morales.

We're on the engineering deck of the Alexandria. About... three hundred of us, roughly. We're all that's left.

The unidentified ships hailed us. Claimed a problem with our FSD was detected just before the failed hyperspace jump. Someone called 'The Witch' had arranged the rescue operation and spent a month tracking us down.

I reviewed their orders and everything seemed legit. Not that I had much choice. The Alexandria is stranded. We agreed to take the shuttles, and my crew was separated into groups of a hundred per shuttle. I couldn't shake the feeling that something was off, though. I noticed our rescuers were still carrying their weapons.

Amel saw him first. Dammit, I can't remember the man's name. He hit the viewport from the outside. Just floated out of the black and bounced off the screen. They must have ejected him out of a shuttle. He won't have been the only one.

I gave the order to resist. Not many of us had weapons but my crew trust me. We fought hard but they were better equipped and well trained. I managed to secure a rearguard as we funnelled everyone we could to the rear of the ship, towards the engineering deck. The main entrance is defensible and the hatches have been barricaded. Vernier managed to grab a captive, too. I'll get some answers out of them soon.

It must be the Guardian artefacts they're after. They're the only items on board valuable enough to kill for. No, slaughter for. So many of my crew...

We need a plan, and fast.
ms_the_alexandria5_001_body:
July 15th, 3307.
Captain Morales, private log.

We're still alive for now. The invaders are long gone, along with the Guardian artefacts and almost all our supplies.

The Alexandria's remaining food has been salvaged from vending machines and personal items. The crew are rationing pretty hard, but we'll be lucky to make it over a month. They've left us here to starve.

The captive didn't give us much. Just a name, age, rank... nothing about the organisation that hired him. We roughed him up a bit but he still wouldn't spill. The only interesting thing he said was after I warned him that the amount of Guardian tech his friends were stealing would probably attract Thargoids. The guy smiled and said 'That was the point all along.' Anyway, we've left him tied up.

It's obvious we need to get the Alexandria moving again. One of the engineering team, a rookie named Landis, has proposed a method of getting a single jump out of the frame shift drive. I'll admit, it sounds more dangerous than I'm comfortable with but we're out of options.

The odds are stacked against us but we have one more roll of the dice. Maybe.
ms_the_alexandria6_001_body:
This is Morales. We've just activated the FSD fix. In a minute or so we'll know if it works.

It took longer than expected and we ran out of food six days ago. Anything drinkable from the recycling system was finished yesterday morning. The crew is exhausted; some can barely function. If this is gonna work, it's gotta work now.
Whatever happens, I want to state for the record that the crew of the Alexandria have carried out their duties beyond any reasonable expectation of... the service they should need to give. Despite the sabotage, the betrayal by our supposed rescuers, the stress of tight rations... the gamble that we're taking now.
The crew has done everything asked of them and more. I'm proud of the never-say-die attitude, and the dedication shown to the Aegis project.
Okay. Landis. Start her up.
You have to be kidding me. Come on! Just give us a break for once, you no-good stupid piece of sh-

nakatokaine_overview_description: Councillor Nakato Kaine is a divisive figure in the Alliance Assembly, who has built a reputation as anti-corporate. But her supporters find Kaine to be a determined, intelligent figure who relentlessly champions the Alliance's unique advantages: its culturally diverse population, collaborative leadership and self-sustaining economy.
nakatokaine_overview_expansion_ethos: Preferring debate over violence, Councillor Kaine leads by example in using statecraft to resolve conflicts. She has demonstrated methods of outsmarting adversaries through clear messaging, political leverage and focused media narratives.
nakatokaine_overview_preparation_ethos: Councillor Kaine's commitment to providing a voice to individual systems is appealing in an age where interstellar powers dominate the conversation. Her supporters advocate the value of this trait eagerly, via social networks and ICE-casts.
nakatokaine_overview_quotation1: I implore my fellow representatives in the Assembly to remember the things that makes the Alliance so special.
nakatokaine_overview_quotation2: The Alliance is not consumed with affluence or vanity, like our neighbouring superpowers. I don't mind saying that I'm thankful for that.
nakatokaine_overview_quotation3: We are only as strong as our least prosperous member. The Alliance should endeavour to raise all systems up in every possible metric.
nakatokaine_overview_quotation4: Corporations should not be involved in governance. They already wield far too much influence in our daily lives.
nakatokaine_overview_quotation5: Sirius Corporation have no love for the Alliance and its supposed 'military pact' with us was a disgrace. Approving that contract set a permanent stain on Edmund Mahon's record.

newsfeed_anarchystart:
News Alert
New Regime comes to $#System;

Effective immediately, $#StatusOwner; has declared that $#System; should now be recognised as an independent system. In an announcement, the faction claims to be seeking “independence from the fascist societies whose imposed ideals are suffocating humankind”.
newsfeed_anarchystart1:
$#System; Important News
New Regime Declared

The controlling power of $#System;, $#StatusOwner;, has announced independence. A spokesperson claimed the people of this system will now “blaze their own trails among the stars”.
newsfeed_anarchystart2:
Urgent Bulletin
$#System; Declares Itself Free from Foreign Oppression

The $#System; system has declared itself free of all past political ties. When asked, a spokesperson for the controlling faction, $#StatusOwner;, had this to say:

“Out here in the black we've got to live by our own rules, not by the whims of some bureaucrat. Which is why we're inviting all free-thinking pilots to gather in $#System;, to help us shape the kind of future that you want to live in.”
newsfeed_anarchystart3:
Independent World Declared
Criminal Crew Takes Over $#System;

The $#StatusOwner; faction has declared itself to be the master of $#System;.

How this will affect the future of the system remains to be seen, but for now all Federal, Imperial and Alliance ships are advised to avoid the area until the rule of law can be re-established.
newsfeed_anarchystart4:
$#System; Urgent News
Anarchy Descends upon $#StatusAsset;

A local community announcement states: “As a result of the continued failure of the previous administration to control the rampant criminal activity taking place in $#System;, the band of pirates known as $#StatusOwner; has taken control of the system;.”

What this means for residents remains to be seen, but leaders suggest “all law-abiding citizens vacate the area immediately”.
newsfeed_anarchystart5:
Emergency in $#System;
Allegiances Change as Anarchy Spreads

Chaos has descended on $#System;, according to residents' broadcasts, as $#StatusOwner; has taken control of $#Station;. A community leader commented:

“This event marks the latest in a series of aggressive takeovers that has now left the pirate band in almost total control of the system.”
newsfeed_anarchystart6:
$#System; Emergency Announcement
Criminal Crew Takes Control

An organisation that some residents call 'a criminal gang', $#StatusOwner;, has managed to get elected as the overseer of $#Station;.

The faction's first act in power was to dissolve the $#System; security forces, after which it declared $#Station; 'a free port for all'. This move was widely supported by the long-term residents of the system.
newsfeed_anarchystart7:
$#StatusAsset; Independence Alert
A New Kind of Leadership

An emergency message transmitted to all pilots begins: “Warning: This system has undergone a change in leadership. The pirate crew known as $#StatusOwner; has now officially taken control.”

The message continues: “All law-abiding members of the Pilots' Federation are strongly advised to leave the region immediately. Commanders who remain in $#System; do so at their own risk.”
newsfeed_anarchystart8:
Anarchic State at $#StatusAsset;
Do What You Will is the Whole of the Law

An independent reporter has transmitted this message: “After a prolonged battle with $#System; security forces, the crime syndicate known as $#StatusOwner; took control of $#Station;'s command centre.”

“Loyal ships attempted to take back the station by force, but roaming bands of pirates made short work of the law-keepers. Potential visitors are advised that $#System; is currently considered an anarchy state, and your safety cannot be guaranteed.”
newsfeed_anarchystart9:
$#StatusAsset; Newsflash
Darkness Descends on $#System;

A broadcast from local security forces states: “The pirate crew known as $#StatusOwner; has managed to take control of $#Station;.”

“This marks the culmination of months of lawless activity throughout $#System; from disparate criminal crews.”

The message concludes: “At time of writing, $#System; is now a criminal state. All law-abiding Commanders should avoid the system unless absolutely necessary.”
newsfeed_boomstart:
$#System; Economic Report
The Future Looks Bright

Economic experts have reported that the $#System; system is enjoying a period of sustained commercial growth. The upswing has been attributed primarily to the system's incumbent faction, $#StatusOwner;, which has provided strong, stable leadership following a period of political uncertainty. System authorities have expressed hope that the economic boom will have a positive impact on the wider region.
newsfeed_boomstart2:
$#System; Economic Bulletin
Soaring Sales Boost Employment

Economists have reported that unemployment rates in $#System; have dropped to single digits, as $#StatusAsset; enjoys a period of continued economic expansion. The system's newfound commercial success is being attributed to the ruling organisation, $#StatusOwner;, which has been making waves thanks to the success of its business efforts.
newsfeed_boomstart3:
Financial Report from $#System;
An Economic Boom

Reports issued by $#StatusOwner; indicate that $#StatusAsset; is undergoing a period of unprecedented financial growth. This economic boom follows on from contracts signed with several well-respected interstellar corporations.

One representative had this to say:

“It is hoped that the increase in commercial interest in the region will benefit the whole of $#System;.”
newsfeed_boomstart4:
$#System; Business Report
New Corporate Contracts

Corporate interests in $#System; have soared as trade booms, according to official reports. The controlling faction, $#StatusOwner;, claims that the success is entirely down to the hard work of businesses operating out of $#StatusAsset;. This statement was met with derision by the rest of the system's leadership.
newsfeed_boomstart5:
$#System; Economic Assessment
Entrepreneurial Expansion Brings Financial Boom

Despite a troubling year for its controlling power, $#StatusOwner;, things are finally starting to look up for $#StatusAsset; according to economic experts.

Continued economic growth has resulted in several explorative trade routes. Early assessments indicate that new permanent routes should follow to maintain financial success.
newsfeed_boomstart6:
$#System; Commercial Report
$#StatusAsset; Enjoys Commercial Growth

$#StatusOwner; is pleased to announce a new era of prosperity for the people of $#System;.

This is driven by the newfound commercial success of $#StatusAsset;, which is fast making a name as one of the most active trading hubs in this region.

Those interested in taking advantage of $#System;'s economic upswing should contact its ruling faction, $#StatusOwner;, for details.
newsfeed_boomstart7:
$#System; Economic Report
Success Contributes to Commercial Growth

The implementation of new production techniques at $#StatusAsset; by the incumbent power, $#StatusOwner;, saw the port's GDP increase by a staggering 180% since the previous report.

If the local economy continues to thrive at this level, the residents of $#StatusAsset; will find themselves living in one of the most desirable parts of the region.
newsfeed_boomstart8:
$#StatusAsset; Business Update
Successful Ventures in $#System;

An economic boom is about to descend upon $#StatusAsset; according to financial experts, thanks to the tireless efforts of its controlling faction, $#StatusOwner;.

The organisation has expanded its business influence well beyond the borders of the $#System; system. Local business leaders have pledged to reinvest newfound profits into improving life at the station.
newsfeed_boomstart9:
Economic Report
$#System; Enters a New Period of Prosperity

Under the guidance of its incumbent faction, $#StatusOwner;, a new age of prosperity has arrived at $#StatusAsset;. Independent economists claim that business is booming and unemployment rates have dropped to record levels.

Residents are said to be elated, and business leaders hope to spread this change to their own communities.

$#StatusAsset; Financial News
A Change in Fortune

After much hardship for the people of $#StatusAsset;, business has finally started to pick up in $#System;.

Experts have said that while they expect economic recovery to be slow, the worst is over.

In order to help facilitate continued growth, the controlling faction, $#StatusOwner;, has pledged an injection of credits to help rejuvenate $#StatusAsset;.
newsfeed_bustend1:
$#StatusAsset; Fiscal Report
$#System; Emerges from Recession

An independent fiscal report out of $#StatusAsset; offers a ray of hope, with all signs pointing to an economic recovery.

The controlling power, $#StatusOwner;, released this statement:

“We are glad to see things are starting to look up for the hard-working people of $#StatusAsset;. This turnaround is a testament to their will to succeed.”
newsfeed_bustend2:
$#StatusAsset; Economic Update
Recovery Takes Hold across $#System;

After much hardship for the people of $#StatusAsset;, business has started to pick up in $#System;.

Experts have said that while they expect economic recovery to be slow, the worst is now over.

In order to help facilitate continued growth, the controlling faction, $#StatusOwner;, has pledged an injection of credits into the economy of $#StatusAsset;.
newsfeed_bustend3:
Fiscal Announcement
The Miracle That Saved $#System;

In what many are calling a fiscal miracle, $#StatusAsset;'s economy received a huge boost as traders from all over $#MasterFaction; arrived to take advantage of bargain basement deals.

It remains unclear whether this will have any lasting effect on the recession gripping the port.

The incumbent power, $#StatusOwner;, will continue to organise fire sales for as long as they prove effective.
newsfeed_bustend4:
Economy Newsflash from $#System;
Corporate Investment Lifts Spirits at $#StatusAsset;

In a move that is sure to please the residents of $#StatusAsset;, $#StatusOwner; has struck a deal with leading $#MasterFaction; corporations to finally set up shop in $#System;.

The organisation has released a statement saying: “We are hopeful that this deal will help bring an end to the financial crisis.”
newsfeed_bustend5:
$#System; Economic Update
Regeneration Wrecks Recession

Times have been tough for the people of $#StatusAsset;. A financial crisis saw businesses fail and families fall apart.

That time is no more, as today the controlling faction, $#StatusOwner;, announced an initiative to regenerate the station.

In a press release, the organisation had this to say:

“The worst days are behind us, but it will take all of us together to make $#StatusAsset; the kind of place we want it to be.”
newsfeed_bustend6:
$#System; Latest Financial News
Stay of Execution for Local Production Facilities

Workers at $#StatusAsset; were relieved by news that the production plants at $#StatusAsset; will remain in action.

This follows on from earlier reports released by the controlling power, $#StatusOwner;, stating that the recession affecting this part of the galaxy is finally showing signs of abating.
newsfeed_bustend7:
$#System; Business Report
Employment Rates Soar

After much uncertainty, the people living and working at $#StatusAsset; can finally breathe a sigh of relief. Reports issued by the controlling power, $#StatusOwner;, show that stable employment at $#StatusAsset; has reached the required levels. This marks a turn in the station's fiscal fortunes.
newsfeed_bustend8:
$#System; Economic Announcement
Services Return as Recession Subsides

$#StatusOwner; announced today that after a long period of austerity action, the recession afflicting $#StatusAsset; is finally over.

In an accompanying statement, the organisation revealed: “With trade levels returning to pre-recession norms, the residents of $#StatusAsset; can rest assured that all standard services will resume shortly.”
newsfeed_bustend9:
$#System; Fiscal Announcement
Recovery Takes Hold

A statement from $#StatusOwner; revealed that the GDP for $#StatusAsset; has risen to acceptable levels.

This news marks the end of a long period of financial instability, with key station services forced to suspend their activities. With additional funding now becoming available, station management have announced that operations will soon return to normal.
newsfeed_buststart:
$#System; Economic Report
Hard Times Ahead for $#StatusAsset;

The residents of $#System; are no strangers to hardship, but for those living at $#StatusAsset;, life is about to get harder.

According to a panel of financial experts, crumbling infrastructure and failing businesses have led to an economic downturn from which the port may never recover.

The controlling faction, $#StatusOwner;, has issued a statement urging residents not to panic, claiming plans are in place to rectify the situation.
newsfeed_buststart1:

newsfeed_buststart2:
$#System; Economic Update
Mismanagement Risks $#StatusAsset;'s Downfall

Once the glittering jewel of the $#System; system, $#StatusAsset; has become a dire warning.

Economists agree that constant mismanagement by the ruling faction, $#StatusOwner;, has left $#StatusAsset; in a state of neglect, with businesses failing and residents struggling.

Members of the leadership were not available for comment at this time.
newsfeed_buststart3:
$#System; Recession Alert
Businesses Failing in $#System;

Things are looking grim for the residents of $#StatusAsset;. An economic report outlines how fortunes at the station continue to decline due to the ongoing recession.

The controlling faction, $#StatusOwner;, has released a statement saying plans to regenerate the port are underway. Exact details have not been forthcoming.
newsfeed_buststart4:
Economic Report from $#System;
Mismanagement at $#StatusAsset;

A panel of financial experts have reported that $#StatusAsset; has been run into the ground.

An extract from the report states: “Everywhere you look around the once-thriving commercial port, businesses have closed down and families are going hungry.”

The controlling power, $#StatusOwner;, announced that steps are being taken to rejuvenate $#StatusAsset;. It was unable to say just how long such plans may take.
newsfeed_buststart5:
Economics Newsflash
Trading Declines Throughout $#System;

Life isn't easy in $#System;, as outlined in a report by local economists. It states that trade has slowed to a crawl and vital infrastructure projects are on hold as a result.

How long the residents of $#StatusAsset; will be willing to put up with increased food prices and lower standards of living is a key question in the report. As yet there has been no comment from the incumbent faction, $#StatusOwner;.
newsfeed_buststart6:
$#System; Economic Warning
Recession Rages On

The recession at $#StatusAsset; is still too fresh to have left a lasting impression on residents, according to a report by local economists. But tensions are beginning to rise as services are withdrawn and commodities become scarce.

A vocal subset of the community claims that the local economy has failed due to the gross incompetence of the ruling faction, $#StatusOwner;, a charge which has been vehemently denied.
newsfeed_buststart7:
$#StatusAsset; Business Report
Bad Leadership Blamed for Stalling Sales

What can make a once-thriving port become a derelict shadow of its former self? According to a report by business owners at $#StatusAsset;, letting $#StatusOwner; run your local economy is one sure-fire way.

Residents are furious over the mismanagement of $#StatusAsset;'s assets, with calls to riot streaming across the station's network.
newsfeed_buststart8:
Economic Report From $#StatusAsset;
Businesses Close in $#System;

Times have taken a turn for the worse at $#StatusAsset;, according to a statement by economic experts. Many businesses have been forced to close their doors in the face of an ever-worsening recession.

Rumours persist about large-scale mismanagement by the incumbent faction, $#StatusOwner;, having broken trade agreements.
newsfeed_buststart9:
$#StatusAsset; Economic Summary
Services Affected by Sales Slowdown

Things aren't going well for $#StatusOwner;, with an ongoing economic downturn continuing to drain the life from $#StatusAsset;.

An independent economic summary states: “Residents have complained about the breakdown in vital services, while business leaders openly rebelled against austerity measures put in place by an administration nobody seems to trust.”
newsfeed_civilunrestend:
$#System; Latest Bulletin
$#StatusOwner; Appeases the People

Peace has returned to $#StatusAsset; after small bouts of violence erupted between workers and members of the ruling body, $#StatusOwner;.

A disagreement over the station's maintenance contracts has been cited as the cause of the conflict. This issue was resolved by members of the $#StatusAsset; Business Forum.
newsfeed_civilunrestend1:
Civil Report from $#System;
Protesters Placated

Local media report that a week of mostly peaceful protests at $#StatusAsset; has ended. Community members returned to their homes after receiving assurances from the governing faction, $#StatusOwner;.

Its statement pledged: “Residents' concerns have been noted and a group of committees will be set up to address any grievances.”
newsfeed_civilunrestend2:
$#System; Civil Update
Conciliation with the People

“Peace has returned to $#StatusAsset; after small bouts of violence erupted at popular leisure spots throughout the station,” a civilian council has announced.

They state the issue was resolved after a series of brief but intense negotiations with the controlling organisation, $#StatusOwner;.
newsfeed_civilunrestend3:
$#System; Bulletin
Agreements Ease Anger at $#StatusAsset;

Station news outlets have reported: “After a week of mostly peaceful protests at $#StatusAsset;, community members returned to their homes. They received assurances from the incumbent faction, $#StatusOwner;, that their concerns had been noted.”
newsfeed_civilunrestend4:
Corporate News from $#System;
Business Almost Back to Normal for $#StatusAsset;

The opening of negotiations between community leaders and members of the ruling faction, $#StatusOwner;, has halted the protests that have caused businesses across $#StatusAsset; to suffer.

A spokesperson for the organisation stated: “We are hopeful that the issues at $#StatusAsset; will be resolved before more serious civil unrest spreads to the rest of $#System;.”
newsfeed_civilunrestend5:
$#System; Newsflash
Calm Returns Following Protests

Controlling faction $#StatusOwner; was praised by community leaders for its quick response to the political unrest at $#StatusAsset;. A representative said:

“Violence had been threatening to erupt all over the station, until a midnight meeting between the organisation's management team and dissident leaders saw tensions eased.”
newsfeed_civilunrestend6:
Update from $#System;
Agreement Reached

Community leaders at $#StatusAsset; have announced that an agreement has been reached with the local ruler, $#StatusOwner;, to stop the protests taking place at $#StatusAsset;.

Their statement mentioned “two key concessions were made in order to appease residents”, though details have yet to emerge as to the exact nature of the agreement.
newsfeed_civilunrestend7:
$#StatusAsset; Business Update
Superior Service Offered to Calm Complaints

The $#StatusOwner; faction has announced that a new agreement established with the contending organisation, $#StatusContender;, will “allow for a better level of service to be delivered to all station residents in the very near future”.

This brought an end to a series of protests. Members of the $#StatusAsset; Local Business Council have expressed their hope that life will now return to normal.
newsfeed_civilunrestend8:
$#StatusAsset; Status Update
Civil Unrest Calmed

Residents of $#StatusAsset; have returned home after taking to the streets to express concern about rampant corruption, according to a local media report.

At first the controlling organisation, $#StatusOwner;, refuted the claims. The report added: “After several fights threatened to spark a wave of violence, an investigation was launched that resulted in almost a dozen officers being suspended from duty pending potential criminal charges.”
newsfeed_civilunrestend9:
$#StatusAsset; News
Unrest Ends after Outbreak of Violence

Local media outlets have stated that “An agreement has been reached that will hopefully bring about an end to the ongoing unrest at $#StatusAsset;.”

The governing faction, $#StatusOwner;, refused to comment on exactly what kind of agreement had been made, but did announce: “Both residents and visitors will be pleased with the improvements they can expect to see in the near future.”
newsfeed_civilunreststart:
Civil Warning from $#System;
Residents Rage at $#StatusAsset;

Independent civilian monitors have reported: “Waves of anger have been felt across $#StatusAsset;, as residents engaged in large-scale demonstrations against a series of policies implemented by the $#StatusOwner; faction.”

The monitors added that over 70% of station residents said that they are unhappy with the current administration's handling of life at the station.

There has yet to be any official word on the subject.
newsfeed_civilunreststart1:
$#System; Alert
Unrest Intensifies at $#StatusAsset;

Street preachers have been blamed for causing a series of altercations at $#StatusAsset;, according to local media. Their news report added: “Tensions continue to rise around the issue of artificially suppressed wage levels being paid by the ruling organisation, $#StatusOwner;.”

The preachers were heard to be denouncing “the greed of the soulless oligarchs whose whims dictate the lives of the true owners of $#StatusAsset;”.

As yet, no one has been seriously injured in the altercations.
newsfeed_civilunreststart2:
$#System; Civil Alert
Residents Rage Over Quality of Life

Waves of anger were felt across $#StatusAsset;, according to civilian monitors. They state that residents engaged in large-scale demonstrations against a series of policies that were implemented by the incumbent faction, $#StatusOwner;.

In an independent poll, over 64% of station residents said they were unhappy with the current administration. As yet there has been no official word on the subject.
newsfeed_civilunreststart3:
$#System; Incident Report
'Agitators' Blamed for Altercation

A leaked security report has revealed: “Tensions at $#StatusAsset; continue to rise around the issue of artificially suppressed wage levels being paid by the ruling organisation, $#StatusOwner;.”

“Drunken agitators have been blamed for causing a series of altercations between workers and security agents. When asked to stop by station security, the gathered crowd began to actively force the officers away from the promenade. No one was seriously injured in the altercation.”
newsfeed_civilunreststart4:
Sociology Report from $#System;
Poor Communal Conditions Lead to Unrest

A report from a team of sociologists states: “The residents of $#StatusAsset; are forced to live amongst a crumbling infrastructure, infested with a cruel criminal element that holds many areas of the station in unlawful terror.”

The report notes that a small group of protesters has started a community rejuvenation project, fixing $#StatusAsset;'s decaying lower levels.

A spokesperson for the $#StatusOwner; faction announced: “Anyone caught engaging in such activity will most likely face jail time.”
newsfeed_civilunreststart5:
$#System; Civilian Broadcast
Attempted Credit Grab Makes Residents Rage

Fees and fines implemented by the governing body, $#StatusOwner;, have not been well-received by the people of $#StatusAsset;.

Residents took to the airwaves to complain about the charges, claiming that they would do whatever it took to keep their hard-earned credits where they belong.

In response, the authorities issued this warning: “Anyone found to be avoiding the costs will be dealt with by station security.”
newsfeed_civilunreststart6:
Vigilante Activity in $#System;
Tempers Flare Over Rampant Corruption

A reluctance to curb the activities of criminal gangs operating at $#StatusAsset; has led to civil unrest, according to local spokespeople who report: “Community members feel forced to take matters into their own hands.”

Other residents regret this development, claiming: “The wave of vigilante activity has only encouraged the local gangs to grow bolder.”

The ruling organisation, $#StatusOwner;, has issued a statement saying it will discuss solutions during the next $#System; Council meeting.
newsfeed_civilunreststart7:
$#StatusAsset; Residents Report
Art or Passive Protests?

”Mysterious paintings have appeared throughout $#StatusAsset;,” according to local community members. “The subject? Removing the leading faction, $#StatusOwner;, from all positions of power it holds over the port.”

”The pictures were an instant hit with residents of $#StatusAsset;, having gone viral across the station's network in less than 24 hours.”

So far the talented protester(s) have yet to be identified, but station security stated: “We're doing everything we can to track down those responsible.”
newsfeed_civilunreststart8:
$#StatusAsset; News Bulletin
Spirited Songsters Cause Unrest

A rather strange form of protest is being adopted at $#StatusAsset; according to a local media statement: “Residents both young and old have taken to singing offensive limericks aimed at members of the governing faction, $#StatusOwner;.”

“The limericks peacefully express displeasure over decisions made by station management to hold off on performing crucial upgrades to the port's infrastructure.”

In a counter-statement, the organisation said that due to budget constraints, it would not be able to meet the demands of residents.
newsfeed_civilunreststart9:
$#StatusAsset; Crime Alert
Unsanctioned Slavery Causes Civil Unrest

A riot was narrowly avoided as angry residents of $#StatusAsset; rescued a group of youths who were kidnapped and forced into slavery by a local crime syndicate.

Community members stated: “We petitioned station security to get involved, but were told that the kidnappings were not a high enough priority to justify investigating.”

A spokesperson for the $#StatusOwner; faction apologised to residents, promising that “more money will be made available for additional security personnel.”

newsfeed_civilwarstart1:

newsfeed_civilwarstart2:
$#System; Bulletin

Fighting broke out at $#StatusAsset; as members of the ruling faction, $#StatusOwner;, and the contending faction, $#StatusContender;, clashed over who would decide the future of $#AffectedSystem;.

A local news reporter stated: “Several skirmishes have taken place, but thankfully no one has been seriously injured. Security forces tell us they are doing what they can to quell the infighting.”
newsfeed_civilwarstart3:
$#System; Corporate Warning
Businesses Suffer as Fighting Hits $#StatusAsset;

“It is our sad duty to report that blood flows freely in the halls of $#StatusAsset;,” claimed a local business council.

“A clash between supporters of the controlling power, $#StatusOwner;, and its openly hostile rival, $#StatusContender;, caused widespread panic as pulse lasers were fired in various locations.”

newsfeed_civilwarstart4:

Civil War has Come to $#StatusAsset;

“In what could prove to be the coup of the decade,” according to a local media outlet, “an opportunistic organisation, $#StatusContender;, is on the verge of seizing control of $#StatusAsset; from the $#StatusOwner; faction.”

The news report added: “So far open conflict has remained firmly out of the public eye, but residents are concerned about the potential for fighting in the streets.”
newsfeed_civilwarstart5:
$#System; Emergency Bulletin
Unrest Leads To Open Conflict

A breakdown in communication is being blamed for the open hostilities raging through $#StatusAsset;, according to local media.

Members of the ruling body, $#StatusOwner;, claim that another organisation, $#StatusContender;, reneged on a trade agreement worth millions of credits.

The $#StatusContender; faction has rebuked this claim, stating: “No such agreement was ever put in place. Our rivals are using the excuse of a failed trade agreement in an attempt to secure their base of power.”
newsfeed_civilwarstart6:
Warning from $#System;
Fighting Breaks Out Between Rival Factions

Local security forces have issued an advisory warning asking all non-residents to stay clear of $#StatusAsset; while it continues to experience factional infighting.

Rumours abound regarding what sparked the conflict between the incumbent faction, $#StatusOwner;, and a contending faction, $#StatusContender;.
newsfeed_civilwarstart7:
$#StatusAsset; News Alert
Violence Abounds at $#StatusAsset;

Tensions continue to mount between governing party, $#StatusOwner;, and its rival $#StatusContender;. Local media reports that residents of $#StatusAsset; have found themselves caught in the crossfire. The report states:

“Multiple people have been injured, with several left in critical condition after a fight between supporters of the two groups broke out on the station's main promenade. We can only hope that the situation is resolved quickly.”
newsfeed_civilwarstart8:
$#System; Newsflash
Civil War Unavoidable

A riot broke out at $#StatusAsset; as members of rival organisations clashed in the station's docking bays.

What exactly prompted the fight remains unknown. When local media outlets asked for comment, both the incumbent faction, $#StatusOwner;, and its rival, $#StatusContender;, proved unwilling to provide a statement.

Security forces have advised: “Avoid landing at $#StatusAsset; until the current round of troubles has been resolved.”
newsfeed_civilwarstart9:
$#StatusAsset; Emergency Announcement
Riots Rage

“Broken bones and perforated promises filled $#StatusAsset; as members of rival organisations sought to exert their dominance over the system,” according to an announcement by community leaders.

“Our local security services stepped in, but failed as it became apparent that members of the security team were being swayed to fight for one side or the other.”
