“Members of the Pilots' Federation have come to the rescue of the $#System; system,” according to a statement by the organisation. “Pilots have delivered hundreds of food canisters to $#StatusAsset;. This effectively ends the destitution that had been affecting the port since the food crisis began.”
newsfeed_famineend6:
$#System; News
Food Returns to $#System;

Reports have come in that the scarcity of supplies that was holding the residents of $#StatusAsset; in the throes of hunger have now been resolved by the controlling faction, $#StatusOwner;. All residents are advised that stockpiling and rationing are no longer necessary.
newsfeed_famineend7:
$#StatusAsset; Bulletin
Feast Not Famine

Local authorities would like to assure the general public that the food shortage afflicting $#StatusAsset; has finally come to an end. All outlets should now be fully stocked and all restrictions on buying food-related commodities have now been lifted.
newsfeed_famineend8:
Latest from $#StatusAsset;
Food Crisis Solved

A large number of food canisters have been reported to arrive in the $#System; system. This has dampened the rage that prompted residents to riot in reaction to the worsening conditions at $#StatusAsset;.

A representative of the incumbent faction, $#StatusOwner;, apologised for the lack of food supplies at $#StatusAsset;, citing third-party corporate incompetence as the cause.
newsfeed_famineend9:
Update from $#StatusAsset;
Rationing No Longer Necessary

Residents of $#StatusAsset; are being advised that a new batch of supplies has arrived in port, effectively ending the food shortage that was affecting the $#System; system. The advisory from station management added: “Anyone suffering from malnutrition is urged to report to a clinic for the appropriate treatment as soon as possible.”
newsfeed_faminestart:
$#System; News
Starvation Sets In as Famine Declared

A breakdown in trade negotiations has resulted in $#StatusAsset; being left with a serious shortage of essential supplies. Reports indicate that the station may only have a few days' worth of food cartridges left. The Station Commander could not be reached for comment at this time.
newsfeed_faminestart1:
$#System; Newsflash
Food Crisis Worsens

A breakdown in trade negotiations has resulted in $#StatusAsset; being left with a serious shortage of essential supplies. Reports indicate that the station may only have a few days' worth of food cartridges left.

The Station Commander could not be reached for comment at this time.
newsfeed_faminestart2:
$#System; Info Update
Anger Rises as Food Supplies Become Scarce

An announcement from community leaders states “Rage continues to grip $#StatusAsset; as station authorities fail to address the ongoing food shortage. Several people have been seriously injured in supply-related incidents.”

“At this time, station security has declined to press charges against those involved. Many residents are now choosing to temporarily abandon the system.”
newsfeed_faminestart3:
$#System; Latest News
Famine Causes Food Supply Failure

As food shortages continue to spread throughout $#System;, local authorities have requested that all residents remain calm. Estimates suggest at least three days' worth of food is still commercially available in the system. No official word regarding reserve stock levels has been forthcoming.
newsfeed_faminestart4:
$#System; Update
Workers Begin Stockpiling

Rumours have begun to circulate that a food shortage has hit the $#System; system. Store shelves remain half-stocked and panicked residents have begun stockpiling in anticipation of expected rationing.
newsfeed_faminestart5:
$#StatusAsset; Breaking News
Famine Strikes!

Hunger continues to rampage through the $#System; system, claim local media outlets, as food supplies at $#StatusAsset; continue to dwindle. Officials claim that relief is on the way, though they are unwilling to give any specific details as to when it might arrive.
newsfeed_faminestart6:
$#System; Latest News
Supply Chain Failure

Trouble is brewing at $#StatusAsset; as residents are unable to replenish their cuisine cartridges. Independent reports indicate that the situation could soon expand to a shortage of other vital goods, such as medicines.

The Logistics Officer of the controlling faction, $#StatusOwner;, has stated: “The problem is being addressed and normal services should be resumed shortly.”
newsfeed_faminestart7:
$#StatusAsset; News
Rationing Put In Place

A local media report states: “Problems in the surrounding systems have finally started to have a knock-on effect on $#System;, with the supply situation at $#StatusAsset; starting to look extremely grim. Local corporations have banded together to help deal with the worsening food crisis, but demand is still far outstripping supply.”
newsfeed_faminestart8:
$#System; Inside Report
Hunger Pains Strike

A independent media article from the $#System; system states: “It feels like a dieting fad has hit $#StatusAsset;. Everywhere you look people are losing weight, though not entirely of their own volition.”

“So far residents have remained peaceful despite the ongoing food crisis. Whether they remain so will depend on the authorities being able to provide additional supplies.”
newsfeed_faminestart9:
$#System; News Bulletin
Famine Causes Food Supply Failure

A breakdown in the $#System; system's supply chain has resulted in a shortage of food cartridges being delivered to $#StatusAsset;, claims local news media. Residents are being advised to implement their own rationing while the incumbent faction, $#StatusOwner;, attempts to rectify the situation.
newsfeed_incursion_001:
Thargoid Activity Report
Authorities in $#system; have reported that large numbers of Thargoid ships are active in the system. Anyone travelling in the system is advised to exercise caution.

The Pilots’ Federation is offering combat bonds to pilots who help to repel the Thargoid incursion.

The current threat level is: $#Threat;
newsfeed_infested_001:
Thargoid Activity Report
Authorities in $#system; have reported that large numbers of Thargoid ships are active in the system. Anyone travelling in the system is advised to exercise caution.

The Pilots’ Federation is offering combat bonds to pilots who help to repel the Thargoid incursion.

The current threat level is: $#Threat;
newsfeed_infestedcured_001:
Thargoid Activity Report
Authorities in $#system; have reported that the Thargoid incursion into the system has been repelled.

The system-wide threat level has returned to normal.
newsfeed_investment:
$#System; Economic News
$#StatusOwner; Rebuilds

After its expansion failure, the $#StatusOwner; faction has announced a restructuring programme.

During this time, the organisation will redirect efforts that would have gone into the expansion into supporting local initiatives.
newsfeed_investment1:
News Bulletin from $#System;
$#StatusOwner; Starts Restructuring Initiative

Local media outlets have announced that the ruling faction, $#StatusOwner;, has entered an aggressive programme of local development.

An analyst states: “These packages see a boost to the local development level. The organisation is also calling for more exploration data to help support a possible new expansion attempt.”
newsfeed_investment2:
$#System; Economic Report
Local Investment from $#StatusOwner;

A report by economists states: “With the failure to expand to a new star system, the controlling power, $#StatusOwner;, has announced a new attempt.”

When asked, a spokesperson for the organisation said:

“We are investing in a short-term package of development-level enhancement and are calling for more exploration data.”
newsfeed_investment3:
$#System; Political Bulletin
Faction Keeps it Local

A news outlet has reported: “The controlling party, $#StatusOwner;, has entered an investment phase to attempt a new expansion beyond our system borders.”

“While this will see some short-term gain for our local development level, this reporter cannot help but feel that this does not bode well for our collective futures.”
newsfeed_investment4:
Economic Report
Investment in $#System;

A panel of economists has released this statement: “As a result of its inability to expand beyond $#System;, it is our duty to report that the $#StatusOwner; faction has now entered an extensive investment programme.”

“Its aim is to temporarily increase our local development level, and gather more exploration data to enable a new and potentially longer-range expansion.”
newsfeed_investment5:
$#System; Corporate News
Change as Faction Invests in Local Operations

A panel of business analysts has stated: “In a stunning development, the controlling faction, $#StatusOwner;, has begun activities to increase the local development level.”

The analysts acknowledge that this will help the local operations for a time. “We can also report that the organisation has called for more exploration data to support a longer-range expansion attempt in the future.”
newsfeed_investment6:
$#System; Financial News
Investment from $#StatusOwner;

Financial observers in $#System; have reported: “The incumbent faction, $#StatusOwner;, has not only failed to expand but is preparing for a new attempt.”

“It has called for more exploration data, and will be boosting the local development level for the duration of the programme.”
newsfeed_investment7:
$#StatusAsset; Economic Update
Local Faction Investing in the Future

Economists have observed: “The ruling faction, $#StatusOwner;, has entered a period of investment as a response to its expansion failure.”

“This will give the local development level a boost. It has also called for more exploration data to help a fresh expansion attempt.”
newsfeed_investment8:
$#StatusAsset; Community News
Investment Starts

The residents of $#System; are watching the plans of their ruling faction, $#StatusOwner;, after its failed expansion attempt.

Local community leaders believe: “The organisation has entered into various investment strategies to prepare for a new expansion attempt.”
newsfeed_investment9:
$#StatusAsset; Financial News
Investment for $#System;?

Local media outlets at $#StatusAsset; have received word that the controlling faction, $#StatusOwner;, is working to recover from an expansion failure to commit to another attempt.

A representative declared: “Not only is the move good for the organisation, it will benefit the local development level for a time as well.”
newsfeed_investmentends:
$#System; Update
$#StatusOwner; Completes Investment

The system's ruling faction, $#StatusOwner;, has announced the end of its investment programme.

Many residents in the system hope this will lead to a successful expansion attempt.
newsfeed_investmentends1:
$#System; News
Faction Ends Restructuring Initiative

Breaking news from local media outlets is that the governing faction, $#StatusOwner;, has completed an aggressive programme of local development.

The news report comments: “Some will be saddened that the boost in development level for local industry will now also end.”
newsfeed_investmentends2:
Announcement from $#System;
Local Investment Finished

The ruling organisation, $#StatusOwner;, has announced the completion of a range of measures designed to allow it to succeed with a new attempt.

A spokesperson had this to say: “This period of investment has been a complete success.” However, some local pundits have questioned the veracity of that statement.
newsfeed_investmentends3:
$#System; Community News
Faction Ends Investment Programme

Local community leaders have revealed that the controlling faction, $#StatusOwner;, has ceased its investment initiatives.

They claim: “This now paves the way for the organisation to attempt another expansion beyond our glorious system.”
newsfeed_investmentends4:
$#System; Economic Report
Investment Ends

A panel of economists has released a report that states: “The ruling faction, $#StatusOwner;, has declared that its investment activities in the local economy has ended.”

“This puts an end to the welcome boost in development level, but does allow them another chance at an expansion attempt.”
newsfeed_investmentends5:
$#System; Urgent Bulletin
Chaos as $#StatusOwner; Ceases Investment

In a move that has angered many residents, the governing body, $#StatusOwner;, has ended support for boosting the local development level.

A local community leader declared: “This is another case of this organisation putting its interests before those of local people.”
newsfeed_investmentends6:
$#System; Corporate Report
No More Investment

An independent business summary from $#System; states: “We must report that the controlling power, $#StatusOwner;, has cut support for local businesses by ending its so-called investment programme.”

“This will no doubt encourage the organisation to further disrupt the local economy with a new expansion attempt.”
newsfeed_investmentends7:
$#StatusAsset; Update
Local Faction Stops Investing in the Future

Media outlets are reporting that the ruling body, $#StatusOwner;, has ended a period of investment as it prepares for a new expansion attempt.

This ends the increase in the local development level.
newsfeed_investmentends8:
$#StatusAsset; Community News
Investment Ends

The residents of $#System; are concerned at the latest news that the incumbent faction, $#StatusOwner;, has ended its short-lived investment programmes.

An independent media source stated: “The organisation will no doubt attempt another futile effort at expanding beyond our system.”
newsfeed_investmentends9:
$#StatusAsset; Newsflash
Investment Period Finished for $#System;?

Residents at $#StatusAsset; have received word that their ruling body, $#StatusOwner;, has ended its investment activities.

A representative declared that this would allow the organisation to conduct a new expansion effort.
newsfeed_lockdownend:
Special Report from $#System;
Security Chief Declares an End to Lockdown

The Chief of Security in $#System; has stated: “After multiple skirmishes and a prolonged final battle, our security services were successful in ridding us of the pirate scourge that's plagued the space around $#StatusAsset;.”

The governing faction, $#StatusOwner;, has declared that security personnel temporarily stationed at $#StatusAsset; will return to their normal duties.
newsfeed_lockdownend1:
$#System; Security Bulletin
$#StatusAsset; Status Returns to Normal

$#StatusOwner; announced today: “Security levels around $#StatusAsset; will be returned to normal, after a successful operation aimed at decreasing the amount of violence occurring around the port.”

A spokesperson for the organisation expressed hope that pilots would continue to behave themselves now that the enhanced security protocols have been lifted.
newsfeed_lockdownend2:
$#System; Latest Update
Spirits Rise as Lockdown is Lifted

Today is a 'glorious day' for the $#MasterFaction;, according to its proclamation:

“After multiple skirmishes and a prolonged final battle, our security forces were finally successful in ridding $#System; of the pirate blight that's been terrorising the space around $#StatusAsset;.”

The local faction, $#StatusOwner;, has announced that security personnel temporarily stationed at $#StatusAsset; will be returning to their normal duties.
newsfeed_lockdownend3:
$#System; News
Lockdown No Longer Active

After a thorough investigation into the threatening ships that were spotted passing through the region, the $#StatusOwner; faction has concluded: “There is no immediate threat.”

“As such, system-wide security levels will now be returned to normal. All residents are advised to remain vigilant.”
newsfeed_lockdownend4:
Status Change in $#System;
Security Ships Relieved of Additional Duties

The system's ruling body, $#StatusOwner;, has publicly stated that: “The expenditure of resources focused on increasing security around $#StatusAsset; is no longer necessary.”

“Security levels for the space around $#StatusAsset; will return to normal, effective immediately. All officers currently on reassignment to $#StatusAsset; will return to their normal posts.”
newsfeed_lockdownend5:
Security Update
The Skies of $#System; are Safe Once More

In a public announcement, the $#StatusOwner; faction stated: “We are pleased to announce that criminal activity within $#System; has now been brought back to within acceptable parameters.”

“As a result, all increased security measures currently in effect around $#StatusAsset; are hereby rescinded.”
newsfeed_lockdownend6:
News from $#System;
Residents Relieved as Security Status Lowered

Community leaders have reported that after several weeks of an increased security presence around $#StatusAsset;, no further sign of a hostile force has been spotted.

A representative of the $#StatusOwner; faction stated: “We would like to thank all affected parties for their patience while we investigated reports of unknown aggressors. We are officially repealing the heightened security in operation around $#StatusAsset;.”
newsfeed_lockdownend7:
$#StatusAsset; Independent Report
Extra Security Measures Stopped

An independent investigation into the amount of crime occurring around $#StatusAsset; indicates that the number of acts of violence have decreased below last year's average levels.

As a result, the ruling organisation, $#StatusOwner;, decided to recall all supplementary security forces from their temporary posts at $#StatusAsset;.
newsfeed_lockdownend8:
$#StatusAsset; Security Status Change
Syndicates Removed

The local faction, $#StatusOwner;, has made this public announcement: “Following the successful expulsion of all known criminal syndicates from $#System;, we have issued the order to rescind the lockdown status currently in effect around $#StatusAsset;.”

“The Commander of $#StatusAsset; would like to thank all pilots for the way they conducted themselves during the lockdown.”
newsfeed_lockdownend9:
$#StatusAsset; Newsflash
Lockdown No Longer in Effect for $#StatusAsset;

After a series of successful forays against insurgent bases hidden throughout the system, the $#StatusOwner; faction announced:

“The safety of vessels operating in $#System; has never been more ensured. As such, all security restrictions in and around $#StatusAsset; have now been revoked.”

“We remind all pilots that any unlawful activity should be reported as soon as possible.”
newsfeed_lockdownstart:
Announcement from $#System;
Lockdown in Effect Across System

System security for $#StatusAsset; has reported a significant increase in openly criminal behaviour. Their report says:

“The local pirate gangs are getting bolder, even going so far as to attack vessels as they come in range of port.”

As such the ruling faction, $#StatusOwner;, has announced an increased security presence around $#StatusAsset;. In a press release, it stated: “These additional forces will ensure that all pilots obey the law or face justice for their crimes.”
newsfeed_lockdownstart1:
$#System; Alert
Security Concerns Cause Lockdown

An independent report states that the number of incidents involving violence in the space around $#StatusAsset; has increased by as much as 400%.

In response the ruling body, $#StatusOwner;, has issued a lockdown notice with immediate effect, adding:

“All ships coming in and out of $#StatusAsset; space will be monitored closely, and anyone breaking the law will be dealt with in the harshest possible terms.”
newsfeed_lockdownstart2:
Emergency Notice from $#System;
Lockdown In Effect Across System

Security forces operating around $#StatusAsset; have reported a significant increase in criminal activity. Local pirate gangs are attacking vessels as they approach the station.

An increased security presence at $#StatusAsset; has been announced.
newsfeed_lockdownstart3:
$#System; Announcement
Additional Security Measures

Military-grade reconnaissance ships have been spotted in various locations around the $#System; system, many operating close to $#StatusAsset;.

As a result the controlling organisation, $#StatusOwner;, stated: “We are hiring experienced military personnel to help maintain peace. All visitors and residents should be aware that the security status for $#StatusAsset; is now at high.”
newsfeed_lockdownstart4:
News Bulletin from $#StatusAsset;
Station Security Announce Tough New Stance

Local news services have reported an increase in intoxicated combat veterans taking their grudges to the space around $#StatusAsset;. This has prompted the ruling body, $#StatusOwner;, to temporarily raise security levels around the station.

In a statement, this warning was given: “All pilots should be aware that any acts of unlawful activity will be punished to the full extent of the law.”
newsfeed_lockdownstart5:
$#System; Latest News
Continued Criminal Activity Leads to Lockdown

Dozens of traders have been hit while attempting to make their way to $#StatusAsset;, as reported by many pilots. Despite their best efforts, security forces have been unable to ascertain the true identities of the criminals behind these attacks.

The governing faction, $#StatusOwner;, has issued a statement: “While this unknown pirate wing is operating in $#System;, security will be increased.”
newsfeed_lockdownstart6:
Reports from $#System;
Strange Ships Trigger Local Shutdown

Local media has gathered reports of militarised scouting ships being spotted by pilots as they go about their day-to-day business.

The system's rulers, $#StatusOwner;, had no comment as to whether the reports have been verified or not. The organisation announced: “Security around $#StatusAsset; has been increased, and we ask that all pilots operating in $#System; report any suspicious activity.”
newsfeed_lockdownstart7:
$#StatusAsset; Status Update
Safety Concerns Lead to Lockdown

Station authorities have reported a spate of dangerous flying by space racers around $#StatusAsset;, some of which has resulted in the destruction of transport vessels. The governing organisation, $#StatusOwner;, has ordered an increase in security personnel to ensure that: “Anyone caught endangering other pilots will be stripped of their rights to fly.”

The statement added: “Security levels will be returned to normal once the danger has passed.”
newsfeed_lockdownstart8:
$#StatusAsset; Business Bulletin
Criminality Crackdown Begins

“Dangerous criminals are known to be operating in the area around $#StatusAsset;,” according to local businesses' reports.

As a result the controlling power, $#StatusOwner;, has increased security around the station until the threat has been neutralised. Its statement added:

“All Commanders should be aware that any unlawful activity will end with being prosecuted to the full extent of the law.”
newsfeed_lockdownstart9:
$#System; Newsflash
Safety Protocols In Effect Throughout System;

An urgent announcement from local rulers, $#StatusOwner;, stated: “Due to an increase in unmarked vessels passing through this region of $#MasterFaction; space, we declare a security lockdown until such a time as all visitors to $#System; can be properly identified.”

“Commanders are advised that any suspicious activity will result in an investigation by our security services.”

newsfeed_outbreakend:
$#StatusAsset; Health Report
Medical Staff Master Outbreak

After a thorough investigation by medical staff at $#StatusAsset; it has been determined that “the affliction is not transmitted via interpersonal contact”, according to their report.

No new cases have been identified. As such all restrictions on travelling around the station have now been lifted.
newsfeed_outbreakend1:
$#System; Medical Update
$#StatusAsset; Epidemic Ends

$#StatusOwner; has announced that the outbreak at $#StatusAsset; has finally been brought under control.

The organisation has apologised for the delay in dealing with the problem, though it refuses to accept any direct responsibility for the outbreak.
newsfeed_outbreakend2:
$#System; Update on Emergency
Sickness Halted

After many sleepless nights, doctors at $#StatusAsset; are reporting that they have found a way to safely extract a parasitic infection from hosts.

In related news the controlling faction, $#StatusOwner;, has lifted all quarantine restrictions. Those who suspect they may have come in contact with the parasite should seek out medical attention.
newsfeed_outbreakend3:
$#StatusAsset; Update
Medical Staff Master Outbreak

After a thorough investigation by medical staff at $#StatusAsset;, it has been determined that the affliction is not transmitted via interpersonal contact.

No new cases have been identified. As such, all restrictions on travelling around the station have now been lifted.
newsfeed_outbreakend4:
$#System; Newsflash
Medical Breakthrough Subdues Sickness

After a series of tense days at $#StatusAsset;, doctors have finally declared the station disease-free.

In response the controlling power, $#StatusOwner;, issued a statement saying that all travel restrictions have now been lifted. It expects all port services to return to normal over the next couple of days.
newsfeed_outbreakend5:
$#System; Breaking News
$#StatusAsset; Declared 'Safe'

The Chief Medical Officer at $#StatusAsset; has announced that the station was playing host to multiple occurrences of $#System; Fever.

These cases have now been resolved and the cause has been identified as malfunctioning air filtration equipment.

The controlling power, $#StatusOwner;, apologised for the mistake and announced that new engineering contractors will ensure this never happens again.
newsfeed_outbreakend6:
$#System; Medical Inquiry
Investigators Declare Incompetence Causing Illness

An investigation by independent safety experts has uncovered a series of malfunctioning life support machines at $#StatusAsset;.

The incumbent faction, $#StatusOwner;, apologised for the incident, claiming that station subcontractors are to blame.

The organisation added: “All residents still suffering from respiratory problems should visit the station's medical bay as soon as possible. The cost of any treatment will be covered.”
newsfeed_outbreakend7:
$#StatusAsset; Health Bulletin
Cure Discovered for Outbreak

Medical staff stationed at $#StatusAsset; have announced the successful synthesis of a treatment to combat the contagion.

The controlling faction, $#StatusOwner;, has requested that visitors continue to restrict their presence at $#StatusAsset; until the cure has had several days to circulate.
newsfeed_outbreakend8:
$#StatusAsset; Medical News
Outbreak Successfully Contained

According to its incumbent faction, $#StatusOwner;: “The parasitic outbreak at $#StatusAsset; has finally been dealt with.”

A press release stated: “The situation was resolved thanks to the efforts of selfless pilots locating and donating some much-needed medical supplies. Normal travel conditions are once more in effect for $#StatusAsset;.”
newsfeed_outbreakend9:
$#StatusAsset; Health Check
Chief Medical Officer Declares Station 'Clear'

“After a long struggle, the fungal infections spreading throughout $#StatusAsset; have finally been beaten back,” according to a statement by the station's Chief Medical Officer.

Medical staff have apologised for the delay in tackling the problem, citing lack of available drugs as the main cause behind the slow response.
newsfeed_outbreakstart:
$#System; Alert
Illness Runs Riot at $#StatusAsset;
Quarantine Notice In Effect:

Due to an outbreak of a currently unidentified airborne virus, the area around $#StatusAsset; is under quarantine as dictated by $#MasterFaction; law.

The medical alert states: “It is strongly suggested that all non-residents avoid the system until the quarantine has been lifted. Anyone being identified as carrying the virus will be grounded until further notice.”
newsfeed_outbreakstart1:
$#System; Alert
Illness Runs Riot at $#StatusAsset;

Quarantine Notice In Effect:

Due to an outbreak of a currently unidentified airborne virus, the area around $#StatusAsset; is under quarantine as dictated by $#MasterFaction; law.

The medical alert states: “It is strongly suggested that all non-residents avoid the system until the quarantine has been lifted. Anyone being identified as carrying the virus will be grounded until further notice.”
newsfeed_outbreakstart2:
$#System; Warning
Outbreak Causes Panic in $#System;

A new type of parasitic infection has been detected, according to local doctors in the $#System; system.

A medical alert stated: “So far no obvious adverse affects appear to afflict those suffering from infestation. Despite this, until a full study can be carried out, all infested residents are to be placed under quarantine by order of the incumbent faction, $#StatusOwner;.”
newsfeed_outbreakstart3:
$#System; Announcement
Mysterious Ailment at $#StatusAsset;

The $#System; Centre for Disease Control has issued a warning about an acute neurological illness of undetermined origin:

“In an effort to identify the root cause of this outbreak, the system's controlling faction, $#StatusOwner;, has asked that pilots restrict their movements while at $#StatusAsset;. More details as to which areas are currently under quarantine can be obtained from $#StatusAsset;'s NET.”
newsfeed_outbreakstart4:
$#System; Crisis Warning
Disease Runs Rampant across $#System;

A newly discovered disease is currently working its way through $#System;. Local media claim that doctors are baffled as to the virulence of the disease, which has swept its way through $#StatusAsset;.

Media reports add: “Anyone who finds themselves experiencing dizziness, nausea, loss of appetite, migraines and nosebleeds should report to a medical centre as soon as possible.”
newsfeed_outbreakstart5:
$#System; Newsflash
Sickness Sparks Concerns

$#StatusOwner; would like to address rumours that an outbreak of $#System; Fever has been spotted amongst residents of $#StatusAsset;.

Reports of residents foaming from the mouth and dancing erratically are not to be believed.

On a completely unrelated note, visitors to $#StatusAsset; are advised to stay on their ships as much as possible while the station undergoes some minor, but critical, repairs.
newsfeed_outbreakstart6:
Warning from $#System;
Residents Left Breathless by Outbreak

Medical experts have warned that an outbreak of respiratory problems is currently afflicting workers at $#StatusAsset;: “Signs of infection include a high fever, coughing fits and shortness of breath. Anyone experiencing these symptoms should visit a medical centre as soon as possible.”

According to community spokespeople, some affected residents believe poor upkeep of the station's air filtration is to blame, though this is yet to be confirmed.
newsfeed_outbreakstart7:
$#StatusAsset; Health Alert
$#StatusAsset; Chief Medical Officer 'Seriously Concerned'

Medical staff are at a loss to explain how a previously unknown virus has managed to spread through the population of the $#System; system with such alarming speed.

So far the only symptom appears to be impaired cognitive functioning that mimics intense intoxication.

Non-critical personnel should avoid any contact with residents of $#StatusAsset; until all potential risks have been properly identified.
newsfeed_outbreakstart8:
$#StatusAsset; Emergency Alert
Outbreak Causes Panic in $#System;

Medical advisors in $#System; have announced: “A previously unknown form of parasite, believed to be native to this system, is working its way through the livestock at $#StatusAsset;.”

An unofficial number suggests that over 50% of livestock is suffering from various levels of infestation.

Pilots are being asked to avoid travelling through $#StatusAsset; while this is an ongoing concern.
newsfeed_outbreakstart9:
$#StatusAsset; Scientific Alert
New Discovery Both Sweet and Sour

Astrobiologists operating out of the $#System; system have announced the discovery of a new variant of Absidia Fungi at $#StatusAsset;.

The fungi were identified as having developed when the station's neutrafarm began using locally sourced feed to care for their plants.

In related news, doctors are confident the outbreak of Mucormycosis at $#StatusAsset; can be easily dealt with once the appropriate medical supplies have been secured.
newsfeed_powerupdate:
Power Update

This report summarises the latest efforts to undermine $#PowerName;’s control of the $#system; system.

$#fortification; of fortification supply canisters have been stolen by hostile forces, and $#merits; merits worth of allied ships have been lost.
newsfeed_repairingappealsuccessful:
Starport Status Update

Authorities at $#StatusAsset; have announced that the starport will soon be restored to full functionality, following extensive repair efforts.
newsfeed_repairingappealsuccessful_001:
Repair Work Begins

Personnel at $#StatusAsset; have extended their gratitude to pilots who delivered materials to the starport in the wake of the Thargoid attack. Efforts to restore the station are now underway.
newsfeed_repairingappealsuccessful_002:
$#StatusAsset; on the Road to Recovery

Authorities at $#StatusAsset; have extended their gratitude to pilots who delivered aid to the starport in the wake of the attack. Efforts to restore the station are now underway.
newsfeed_repairingappealsuccessful_003:
Independent Pilots Celebrated

Personnel at $#StatusAsset; have extended their gratitude to pilots who delivered materials to the starport following the Thargoid attack. Efforts to restore the station are now underway.
newsfeed_retreat:
$#System; Politics Newsflash
$#StatusOwner; Retreats from System

An announcement from local political pundits claims: “The ruling faction, $#StatusOwner;, has been forced from $#System;. The organisation's influence dropped below the level needed to sustain its presence in the system. It will not be missed.”
newsfeed_retreat1:
$#System; Urgent Bulletin
Rulers Ousted

An emergency broadcast from $#System; states: “The controlling organisation, $#StatusOwner;, has retreated from the system. With its influence falling through the floor, it could no longer remain in $#System;.”
newsfeed_retreat2:
$#System; News Bulletin
A Grand Retreat

A broadcast from a local media provider has stated that the governing party, $#StatusOwner;, has pulled out of the system.

“Despite its desperate efforts, it failed to maintain the required influence,” the broadcast remarks.
newsfeed_retreat3:
Political Update from $#System;
Ruling Faction Departs System

A political statement from local pundits informs: “In a blessed victory for traditional values, the ruling faction, $#StatusOwner;, has now left $#System;.”

“Even with its substantial resources, it couldn't maintain enough presence to influence the system.”
newsfeed_retreat4:
$#System; Status Change
Rulers Kicked out of System;

Community leaders have published this statement: “As a result of its continued failures in $#System;, it is our duty to report that the controlling organisation, $#StatusOwner;, is no longer present in this system.”

An official claimed that this was merely a 'strategic adjustment'.
newsfeed_retreat5:
Political Update
Retreat From $#System;

In its latest news update the governing faction, $#StatusOwner;, has declared that its operations in $#System; have ceased.

According to independent pundits: “With the organisation's lack of influence, it has retreated from the system.”
newsfeed_retreat6:
Celebration in $#System;
$#StatusOwner; Leaves System

Local residents of $#System; are celebrating the news that the controlling faction, $#StatusOwner;, has retreated from the system.

A community council claimed “With the fall in its influence, the organisation could no longer sustain its efforts.”
newsfeed_retreat7:
Declaration from $#StatusAsset;
$#StatusOwner; Retreats from System
The ruling organisation, $#StatusOwner;, has now officially announced it is leaving the $#System; system.

Despite the protestations of its representatives, residents claims it is common knowledge that it had no choice in the matter.
newsfeed_retreat8:
$#StatusAsset; Status Update
All Change in $#System;

With the announcement that the controlling organisation, $#StatusOwner;, has lost its influence in $#System;, the news was soon followed by a quiet withdrawal from the system.

Local officials have described this as a 'disaster'.
newsfeed_retreat9:
$#StatusAsset; Newsflash
Faction Withdraws In $#System;

Media outlets have received word that the ruling party, $#StatusOwner;, has been forced from the $#System; system.

An editorial statement said: “It remains to be seen what impact that will have on residents.”
newsfeed_retreatrescue:
$#System; Newsflash
Organisation Saved in $#System;?

Local media outlets have issued this report: “The fears about our ruling faction, $#StatusOwner;, retreating from this system have proved unfounded. It was able to restore its lost influence.”
newsfeed_retreatrescue1:
$#System; Political Update
$#StatusOwner; Stays in System

According to a council of community leaders: “The controlling organisation, $#StatusOwner;, has restored its crumbling position in the $#System; system. The organisation is reported to be consolidating its gains.”
newsfeed_retreatrescue2:
$#System; Economic Report
No Retreat for $#StatusOwner;

Local economic analysts have issued a statement: “We have learned that the ruling faction, $#StatusOwner;, has regained its former level of influence.”

The analysts added: “The organisation once faced expulsion from the system, but is now in a more stable condition.”
newsfeed_retreatrescue3:
Rebellion in $#System;
$#StatusOwner; Struggling

Independent political forces have released this proclamation: “In a victory for traditional values, $#StatusOwner; is reported to be losing its grip in $#System;.”

The resistance movement added: “If it doesn't reclaim its lost influence soon, we will be free from its destructive presence.”
newsfeed_retreatrescue4:
Corporate News from $#System;
$#StatusOwner; Stays In System

Corporate allies of the incumbent faction have stated: “As a result of many successes in $#System;, it is our duty to report that our ally, $#StatusOwner;, will be staying in the system.”

The statement concluded: “We are impressed that it was able to restore its position so effectively.”
newsfeed_retreatrescue5:
$#System; Political Bulletin
No Retreat

In the latest summary from local media outlets, the $#StatusOwner; faction has declared that its operations in $#System; have returned to a level that means it won't have to retreat.

This news comes as a disappointment to many residents of the system, according to some media.
newsfeed_retreatrescue6:
$#System; Status Review
$#StatusOwner; Staying in System

Local residents of $#System; have reported being unhappy to hear that their ruling faction, $#StatusOwner;, will stay in the $#System; system.

“It was able to turn around its decline in fortunes with an impressive effort,” admitted a community spokesperson.
newsfeed_retreatrescue7:
$#StatusAsset; Political Update
Faction Not Leaving $#System;
The governing party, $#StatusOwner;, has now officially announced that it will remain in the system.

Many residents have admitted that with its restored influence, the organisation is likely to stay at $#StatusAsset; for some time.
newsfeed_retreatrescue8:
Jubilation at $#StatusAsset;
Faction Stays

With the announcement from the controlling faction, $#StatusOwner;, that it has regained enough influence to stay in the system, residents are overjoyed.

Local officials have described this as “a great success”, and applauded the efforts of independent pilots in aiding the organisation.
newsfeed_retreatrescue9:
$#StatusAsset; Important Announcement
Retreat Cancelled in $#System;

Community leaders at $#StatusAsset; have received word that the ruling faction, $#StatusOwner;, avoided the anticipated retreat in the $#System; system.

The announcement states: “The organisation attributed its reversal of fortune to independent pilots conducting operations for its cause.”
newsfeed_servicessuspended_001:
Galactic News: Services Suspended at $#StatusAsset;

The $#StatusOwner; faction apologises for disruption to services at $#StatusAsset;. The issues are due to power fluctuations and outages.

Until these problems have been rectified, the following services are unavailable:

Restock
Repairs
Mission Board
Contacts
Outfitting
Shipyards
Universal Cartographics

Commodity markets will only accept foods and meta-alloys until further notice.

It has been confirmed that a large number of Thargoid Sensors were sold at black markets at the starport. As meta-alloys are proven to help with issues linked to their presence, the $#StatusOwner; faction has requested that pilots deliver them to $#StatusAsset; to help get the starport back online.
newsfeed_servicessuspended_002:
Galactic News: $#StatusAsset; Experiencing Technical Difficulties

Power outages and fluctuations have been reported across $#StatusAsset;. As a safety precaution, the $#StatusOwner; faction has decided to limit starport activity and close many services.

The starport's Chief Technician reported:

“We'll need to run some tests before we can be sure what the problem is. All I know is that with these malfunctions, the station is not a safe place to be right now.”

Until the issues have been rectified, the following services are unavailable:

Restock
Repairs
Mission Board
Contacts
Outfitting
Shipyards
Universal Cartographics

Commodity markets will only accept foods and meta-alloys until further notice.

As the technical problems in $#System; intensify, some commentators noted that the number of Thargoid Sensors discovered in the system has increased.
newsfeed_servicessuspended_003:
Galactic News: Disruption to Starport Services at $#StatusAsset;

Authorities at $#StatusAsset; have announced that all starport services, apart from refuelling and rearming, are suspended. A member of the starport's technical team released a brief statement:

“We are currently unable to offer access to most facilities. Limited access to the commodities market is available, but only foods and meta-alloys are being accepted.”

“We are still trying to determine the cause of the problems, and will notify the public as soon as services are reinstated."

A Federal source has issued an official travel warning advising pilots to avoid $#StatusAsset; entirely.
newsfeed_servicessuspended_004:
Galactic News: $#StatusAsset; Experiencing Technical Issues

Authorities in the $#System; system have confirmed that services at $#StatusAsset; are suspended due to ongoing technical issues.

Until these are rectified, the following services are unavailable:

Restock
Repairs
Mission Board
Contacts
Outfitting
Shipyards
Universal Cartographics

Commodity markets will only accept foods and meta-alloys until further notice.

Starport technical teams are working around the clock to determine the cause of the malfunctions.
newsfeed_servicessuspended_005:
Galactic News: $#StatusAsset; Forced to Suspend Services

The $#StatusOwner; faction regrets to inform pilots that services at $#StatusAsset; have been suspended due to ongoing technical issues.

Until these have been rectified, the following services are unavailable:

Restock
Repairs
Mission Board
Contacts
Outfitting
Shipyards
Universal Cartographics

Commodity markets will accept foods and meta-alloys exclusively until further notice.

Authorities will keep the public informed as technical teams work to get the starport back online.
newsfeed_servicessuspended_006:
Galactic News: $#StatusAsset; Experiencing Technical Difficulties

Due to widespread technical issues, the $#StatusOwner; faction has suspended all services at $#StatusAsset;, apart from docking and limited commodity market access. A complete list of affected services follows:

Restock
Repairs
Mission Board
Contacts
Outfitting
Shipyards
Universal Cartographics

Commodity markets will only accept foods and meta-alloys until further notice.
newsfeed_servicessuspended_007:
Galactic News: Thargoid Sensors Disrupt Services at $#StatusAsset;

Authorities at $#StatusAsset; have announced the immediate suspension of all services due to Thargoid Sensor-related interference. Starport personnel confirm that only docking, refuelling and limited access to the commodities market is available.

It is not known whether the sale of Thargoid Sensors at the starport represents an act of civil disobedience or is a result of black market trade. Security forces have reminded pilots that trading in Thargoid Sensors is illegal.
newsfeed_servicessuspended_008:
Galactic News: Appeal for Meta-Alloys at $#StatusAsset;

The $#StatusOwner; faction has announced that due to the large quantity of Thargoid Sensors being traded in black markets at $#StatusAsset;, most station services have been suspended. Until the technical issues are rectified, only refuelling and limited access to the commodity market will be available.

The only substance known to counter the disruptive effect of the Thargoid Sensors is meta-alloys. Station authorities have asked pilots to deliver meta-alloys, and also food for the starport's residents.

newsfeed_warend1:

“$#StatusOwner; will therefore retain control of both the $#System; system and $#StatusAsset;.”
newsfeed_warend2:

newsfeed_warendwonasset1:

newsfeed_warendwonasset2:

newsfeed_warstart:
$#System; Alert
War Has Come to $#AffectedSystem;

Residents of $#StatusAsset; expressed alarm today at the news that war has broken out in $#AffectedSystem;.

Details as to what triggered the war remain scarce, but community leaders have expressed the opinion that “the war is a bare-faced attempt by foreign powers to take control of local resources”.

The incumbent faction, $#StatusOwner;, declined to make a statement regarding the conflict.
newsfeed_warstart1:
$#System; Urgent News
War Has Come to $#AffectedSystem;

Residents of $#StatusAsset; expressed alarm today at the news that war has broken out in $#AffectedSystem;.

Details as to what actually triggered the war remain scarce, but local media has claimed that “the invader, $#InvadingMajorFaction;, is making a play to take control of local resources”.

The controlling power, $#StatusOwner;, declined to make a statement.
newsfeed_warstart2:
$#System; Announcement
Fighting Erupts in $#AffectedSystem;

Authorities in $#AffectedSystem; have announced: “War has come to our system, and the youths of $#StatusAsset; are more than willing to show our enemies that we don't want any of them here! Friends of freedom have been cheering on our brave boys and girls as they defend their homes.”

“Contact our rightful leaders, $#StatusOwner;, to find out how you can help defend your loved ones from $#InvadingMajorFaction;.”
newsfeed_warstart3:
Urgent Bulletin
Conflict Erupts in $#AffectedSystem;

“War has broken out in $#AffectedSystem;,” according to an urgent media broadcast. “Fearful residents have begun to stockpile food and fuel in preparation for a long drawn-out engagement. No one seems to know why $#InvadingMajorFaction; chose now to attack.”

The ruling government, $#StatusOwner;, has released a statement saying that it will “never give in to the demands of a foreign power”. Whether or not any such demands were made remains unclear.
newsfeed_warstart4:
Conflict Report
Start of War Sees Residents Fleeing $#AffectedSystem;

An emergency report from local media states: “In a move that no one saw coming, $#InvadingMajorFaction; faction has launched a full-on foray into $#AffectedSystem; space.”

“$#StatusAsset;'s panicked residents are attempting to come to terms with living in a conflict zone. Some have already abandoned the system.”
newsfeed_warstart5:
$#System; Newsflash
War Has Come to $#AffectedSystem;

Independent news outlets in $#AffectedSystem; have released this report: “The forces of $#InvadingMajorFaction; are getting ready to wage war against our way of life. Who will stop this terrible incursion? The $#AffectedSystem; fleet is already spread too thin, leaving residents fearing that no one is capable of protecting them.”

The outlet claimed that when asked for comment, the $#StatusOwner; faction said that it would take steps to ensure $#StatusAsset; is well protected, but declined to offer any specific information.
newsfeed_warstart6:
$#System; Emergency Announcement
Stay Vigilant! Stay Safe!

It was announced today by local media organisations that skirmishes with $#InvadingMajorFaction; forces have resulted in full-blown war, raging across the system.

They added: “For now it looks like major civilian areas aren't being targeted, but residents are asked to remain vigilant. Any suspicious activity should be reported to the appropriate authorities.”
newsfeed_warstart7:
Spotlight on $#StatusAsset;
Conflict Escalates

Political analysts in $#AffectedSystem; have announced: “An incident between the current ruling faction, $#StatusOwner;, and the rival $#StatusContender; faction has resulted in fierce fighting taking place throughout the system.”

“Both sides are tight-lipped over what sparked the fighting. Rumours abound about a waylaid cargo convoy, but there is no indication as to which side lost their shipment in the attack.”
newsfeed_warstart8:
$#StatusAsset; Shock News
Fighting Erupts in $#AffectedSystem;

According to independent media: “The $#StatusContender; faction has let slip the dogs of war after openly declaring an intent to overthrow the governing power, $#StatusOwner;, and take over $#StatusAsset;.”

Any concerned Commanders should contact the local authorities directly for more information.
newsfeed_warstart9:
$#StatusAsset; News Update
$#InvadingMajorFaction; Triggers War

After an attack on a vessel being piloted by a member of the governing authority, $#StatusOwner;, war has now been officially declared.

In response, observers state that the $#StatusContender; faction has begun shipping more agents to $#AffectedSystem; in preparation for a full-scale conflict.

Whether or not the fighting will be contained to $#AffectedSystem; remains to be seen.

ngadandarifireopals_info:
A particularly rich seam of high grade opals famed for their mesmerising fire-like reflections. Imperial citizens view them as a status symbol, representing the fire at the birth of the Empire. Their high market value has led to the planet being systematically strip-mined by Imperial slaves.

This rare good is legal in all markets.
ngadandarifireopals_info_short: A particularly rich seam of high grade opals famed for their mesmerising fire-like reflections.
ngunamodernantiques_info:
Local craftsmen are specialists in bringing the past into your life. Made from authentically accurate materials, each bears the mark of distinction.

This rare good is legal in all markets.
ngunamodernantiques_info_short: Local craftsmen are specialists in bringing the past into your life. Made from authentically accurate materials, each bears the mark of distinction.
nickel_info:
Collected on planet surfaces and from asteroids.

Nickel, Ni, atomic number 28. Melting point 1728K. It is commonly used in various alloys and also for some bio-chemical processes.
nickel_info_short: Collected on planet surfaces and from asteroids. Nickel, Ni, atomic number 28. Melting point 1728K.
nightvisiontoggle_description: Toggles the ship's night vision mode on or off.
niobium_info:
Collected on planet surfaces and from asteroids.

Niobium, Nb, atomic number 41. Melting point 2750K. This element is often used in alloys, but its properties also make it useful for super-alloys needed for high temperature and extreme pressure applications. It's also used in electroceramic applications and for superconductors.
niobium_info_short: Collected on planet surfaces and from asteroids. Niobium, Nb, atomic number 41. Melting point 2750K.
njangarisaddles_info:
The Saddlers of Njangari are renowned for their leather work, and their motto: No job to big or too invertebrate. Whether simple domestic supplies or custom saddles and tack for some of the more exotic species in the galaxy, they are the very best.

This rare good is legal in all markets.
njangarisaddles_info_short: The Saddlers of Njangari are renowned for their leather work, and their motto: No job too big or too invertebrate.
nm_seed_info: A seed obtained from the Radicoida Unica organism. It has a tough, thermally insulating outer shell which offers remarkable protection against extreme variations in temperature, radiation and climate.
