You have arrived at $#StationName;. Ensure you observe security guidelines at all times.
Dissension will not be tolerated at $#StationName;.
This is $#StationName;. Station services are currently available for use.
You have arrived at $#StationName;. Be aware that station security is on high alert at this time.
stationservices_stationcontactrescueship: Welcome to $#StationName;. We've got a lot of refugees heading this way and plenty of demand for help them.
This is $#StationName;. We'll gladly take refugees you bring to us and process their applications to safe new homes.
I'm pleased to welcome you to $#StationName;. I hope you're willing to help the systems facing Thargoid invasion.
$#StationName; has been established to help those forced to flee their home systems. Could you ferry some here?
Hello, Commander. $#StationName; will accept any escape pods you find. The occupants will be processed by our crew.
Greetings, Commander. How can $#StationName; be of service today?
I hope you're here to help, Commander. The recent Thargoid attacks have left so many in need.
Hello, Commander. $#StationName; has a selection of anti-xeno weaponry and utilities if you need them.
Welcome to $#StationName;. If you find black boxes in systems that Thargoids have invaded, we'll gladly accept them.
Thank you for stopping by, Commander. The Pilots' Federation has always been a vital part of humanitarian efforts.
Welcome to $#StationName;. We're here to evacuate people from the damaged station. If you're able, please help get those people off the station or deliver aid.
This is $#StationName;. We are in desperate need of meds and other aid relief to help the people on that damaged station. Or better still, help us evacuate the place.
I'm pleased to welcome you to $#StationName;, Commander. I hope we have a common purpose in wanting to help the people on that damaged station.
$#StationName; is a rescue ship, Commander. We're here to help people get through the hell they're facing over at the damaged station.
Welcome, Commander. The $#StationName; is here to help the people on the damaged station. We would be honoured if you would assist us.
Greetings, and welcome to $#StationName;. If you're looking to help we need aid supplies for the station, or you could fly in there and help with the evacuation.
I hope you're here to help us, Commander. After the recent attacks these people need all the help they can get.
Hello, Commander. We at $#StationName; are glad to have you here. We need help delivering aid and evacuating civilians from the nearby station.
Good to have you at $#StationName;. We're looking to get aid to the station and help evacuate those that are still on board. Please assist us where you can.
Greetings, Commander. After all that's happened I hope we can work together to help the people trapped onboard the nearby station.
stationservices_stationcontactunderattac: $#StationName; needs your help, Commander. The Thargoids are hitting us pretty hard. We need to fight them off.
You're brave to fly in here, Commander. Thargoid ships seem real focused on tearing this place to pieces. Wanna help us out?
Commander, we're in bad shape and need your help getting people off this station. Any aid you might provide would also be appreciated.
$#StationName; needs your help, Commander. Thargoids have been giving us hell. We need both combat and evacuation assistance.
I'm guessing you saw the welcome party outside, Commander? $#StationName; is taking a beating and we need some support. Whatever you can do to help is appreciated.
Thank God you're here, Commander. The Thargoids are trying to kill us all! We need to get our people to safety as quickly as possible.
The Thargoid invasion force in this system are doing their best to destroy this place. You can find contracts to give us some help.
You must have some skill to avoid the Thargoids out there. If you can destroy some of them I'd be grateful. Otherwise we have urgent humanitarian missions available.
$#StationName; has had a rough few days, Commander. We need pilots capable of evacuating our people and bringing supplies. Are you up to the challenge?
Glad you're here, Commander. Whether you're into fighting Thargoids, transporting refugees or delivering aid packages, there's plenty of work to do.
stationservices_stationcontactunderrepai: Welcome to $#StationName;. As you can see we're still repairing this place. If you want to lend a hand please deliver materials to the commodities market.
Welcome to $#StationName;, Commander. We're in desperate need of materials to get the station back up to full operation.
I'm pleased to welcome you to $#StationName;. You might find some of our services are suspended as we repair the station. Feel free to lend a hand in any way you can.
$#StationName; welcomes all friendly pilots. After the hell we've been through we'd appreciate any help you can give us right now.
Welcome, Commander. $#StationName; is not fully operational at present, but the services we do have available are at your disposal.
Greetings, and welcome to $#StationName;. If you're looking for work we need supplies to repair the station. Check out the mission board for available jobs.
It's a pleasure to have you with us, Commander. After the recent attacks I thought this place was doomed, but here we are working together to fix her up.
We're glad to have you at $#StationName;. We need pilots to deliver materials that will get this station back online. Check the mission board for details.
Good to have you at $#StationName;, Commander. We're looking to get the station back online soon, and we'd appreciate your assistance.
Greetings, Commander. After all that's happened we are now trying to restore $#StationName; to her former glory. I hope you'll be able to help us.
stationservices_techbroker_01: Greetings, Commander $#CommanderName;. I have advanced tech available if you can bring me the right materials.
stationservices_techbroker_02: Hello, Commander $#CommanderName;. If you provide me with the right materials I can unlock a range of unique tech.
stationservices_techbroker_03: Welcome, Commander $#CommanderName;. If you can source the right materials I may well be able to provide you with unique technology.
stationservices_techbroker_04: Greetings, Commander. I have unique technology available if you wish to provide me with the right materials for their construction.
stationservices_techbroker_05: Commander $#CommanderName;. In exchange for the right materials I can manufacture some unique technology.
stationservices_techbroker_06: Good day, Commander $#CommanderName;. I will be able to provide bespoke technology if you can find me some specific materials.
stationservices_techbroker_07: Hello, Commander. I have a range of unique technology available. All I require are the right components.
stationservices_techbroker_08: Welcome to $#StationName;. In exchange for the right components I can provide you with a range of bespoke technology.
stationservices_techbroker_09: Good to see you, Commander. If you require any unique tech I can provide it. All I need are the right components.
stationservices_techbroker_10: Thanks for stopping by. I can manufacture unique technology for the most discerning pilot. All I need are the right materials.
stationservices_techbroker_liverydescrip: The item you have unlocked is now ready in Livery.
stationservices_techbroker_outfittingdes: The item you have unlocked is now ready in Outfitting.
stationservices_techbroker_purchased_01: Commander, the items you requested have been sent to the relevant service ready to be accessed. Let me know if there are any other items you require.
stationservices_techbroker_purchased_02: Your items may be accessed from the relevant service. I am always available should you require anything further.
stationservices_techbroker_purchased_03: Commander, your requested tech may now be accessed from the relevant service. If you need anything else, please let me know.
stationservices_techbroker_purchased_04: The items you ordered are now available from the relevant service. I look forward to your next visit.
stationservices_techbroker_purchased_05: Your order is ready and waiting with the relevant service. Should you require anything further just let me know.
stationservices_techbroker_purchased_06: You may collect your order from the relevant service. Please come see us again soon, Commander.
stationservices_techbroker_purchased_07: Access to your items has now been granted. Please collect them from the relevant service.
stationservices_techbroker_purchased_08: You may now access your items from the relevant service, Commander. Should you require further tech, please do not hesitate to contact me.
stationservices_techbroker_purchased_09: I have processed your requested items and they are now available from the relevant service. Please come again soon, Commander.
stationservices_techbroker_purchased_10: Your items have been processed and can be accessed with the relevant service. Thank you for your custom, Commander.
stationservices_techbroker_return_01: Are you looking for something else, Commander? We're always happy to make a deal.
stationservices_techbroker_return_02: Ah, Commander $#CommanderName;. Is there something else you need?
stationservices_techbroker_return_03: What are you looking for, Commander? I'm sure we can come to an arrangement.
stationservices_techbroker_return_04: If there's anything else you need I'm sure we can reach a mutually beneficial arrangement, Commander.
stationservices_techbroker_return_05: Good to see you again, Commander $#CommanderName;. What can I do for you this time?
stationservices_techbroker_return_06: It's a pleasure to see you again, Commander $#CommanderName;. What can I do for you?
stationservices_techbroker_return_07: Nice to see you back again, Commander. Shall we conduct some more business?
stationservices_techbroker_return_08: Hello again, Commander. If you require any more tech I'm ready and willing to make a deal.
stationservices_techbroker_return_09: You're back again, Commander. Have you come to make another deal?
stationservices_techbroker_return_10: It's great to see you back with us, Commander. Have you come to make another deal?
stationservices_techbroker_shipyarddescr: The item you have unlocked is now ready the Shipyard.
stationservices_techbroker_viewing_01: That's an interesting choice, Commander. It won't be easy, but if you can find me the correct materials I'm sure we can acquire this item.
stationservices_techbroker_viewing_02: Excellent choice, Commander. All I require are the correct materials and I should be able to provide the desired item.
stationservices_techbroker_viewing_03: Good decision, Commander. Now, bring me the correct materials and I should be able to provide your item.
stationservices_techbroker_viewing_04: That's a very discerning choice, Commander. If you can bring me the relevant materials I'm sure there'll be no problem providing the tech.
stationservices_techbroker_viewing_05: That should come in very useful, Commander. All I need are the required components and I will provide the tech you require.
stationservices_techbroker_viewing_06: Great choice, Commander. Now all I need are the relevant components and I can produce your tech in no time.
stationservices_techbroker_viewing_07: Nice choice, Commander. All you have to do now is provide me with the right components and the tech is yours.
stationservices_techbroker_viewing_08: I like your style, Commander. Just bring me the correct materials and the item is all yours.
stationservices_techbroker_viewing_09: A much sought after piece of equipment. If you can bring me the right components I can provide you with just what you need.
stationservices_techbroker_viewing_10: An excellent decision, Commander. Once I have the relevant components I can provide you with what you've requested.

superpower_description_alliance: The Alliance, founded in 3230, is the youngest of the galaxy's three superpowers. It rejects both the extreme capitalism of the Federation and the rigid hierarchy of the Empire, choosing instead a third way of voluntary association for mutual benefit. The desire for freedom from interference, both from external threats and internal bureaucracy, was the key motivation behind the Alliance's founding, and is enshrined in its articles of association.
superpower_description_empire: The popular image of the Empire is one of opulence, but it encompasses many striking contrasts: sophisticated technology exists alongside an ancient Roman system of government, and the affluence of the core worlds depends on often unregulated slave labour in the wretched outer colonies. While the hierarchy of Imperial society is rigid, a Citizen can always rise through the ranks if he or she becomes wealthy enough and makes the right connections. Even a slave could, in theory, become a Senator.
superpower_description_federation: The Federation is the oldest of the galaxy's three superpowers, a vast geopolitical entity reaching out from the core system of Sol and encompassing a broad socio-economic spectrum. At its best, the Federation embodies the values of its founding nations – democracy, industry and liberty – but Federal society can also be competitive and unforgiving. Corporations wield too much power, politicians are often corrupt, and a sink-or-swim ethos prevails.

sysadmindaybeacon_001_body:
This beacon pays tribute to the heroic people who, through their tireless and often thankless work, prevent disasters, keep computer and communications networks secure, and put out fires across the galaxy.

To this day a yearly celebration is held on the last Friday of July, typically involving the gifting of sweet confections, greetings cards, and personalised clothing which is rarely worn by the recipients.
This curious tradition is known to date from over 1300 years ago, although the only remaining record of this is a partial stone tablet with the outline of a flightless bird and the word 'uptime' engraved on it.
system_0_key: The Sol system is notable as the birthplace of humanity and the capital of the Federation, one of the galaxy's three superpowers. Mars, which was terraformed in 2286, is the primary residence of the Federal president, and the seat of Federal power. The system is characterised by a widespread reliance on technology and the prevalence of monolithic corporate entities. The permit for this system can be obtained from the Federal military.
system_10012_key:
This modest system is famed for the presence of The Captain Pot Meat Products corporation.

'We only use DNA from the liveliest pigs to make our sausages.'

The home of the 10th Legion, who serve as a special mission unit for Imperial Intelligence. Following its notoriously difficult selection process, all legionnaires are trained in the arts of subterfuge and warfare.
system_1006_key:
A small but developing Imperial industrial system. Its recent growth has been spurred by the newly formed Castro Management Group.

'We bend over backwards, so you don't have to.'
system_10157_key:
The home of the Anti Xeno Initiative.
A public militant initiative assembled as a response to the escalating xeno threat in the year 3303 by Commander Gluttony Fang. This initiative serves both as an academy for future combatants against hostile aliens and a coordination platform for strategic military operations.
system_10273_key:
One of the scrag ends of the galaxy.

The home system for E.X.O:

As a group, we longed to set out across the stars and forge a new society. A society where a pilot's sweat and blood determined his position in society. A true democratic nation not mired in past glories and hungry for the future. A future of the people, dedicated to the people, and decided by the people. There is but one will: free will.
system_1030_key:
Originally founded by a group of volunteers flying family-owned vessels to ward off harassment against critical supply lines, the Regional Paramilitary Guard specialises in armed convoy runs. Members still operate as traders and are commonly spotted with their escorts. Fervent enemies of piracy, it endlessly seeks to purge such activity from every system possible.

Last chip shop for 37 light years.
system_10317_key: The home of the Brotherhood of The Mercenary. Founded in 3299 as a small contractor helping to fill shortfalls in local law enforcement staffing, Brotherhood of The Mercenary has since grown into a well-respected paramilitary service provider. The company's pilots offer a diverse portfolio of skills, ranging from trade escort and pirate suppression, to heavy transport and even high risk survey operations.
system_10383_key: The home of RazGriz Private Contracting, a band of former Federation pilots that have come together to form a small business specialising in combat and secure transport.
system_1038_key: The permit for this system can be obtained via the LTT 198 Order faction.
system_10419_key: La Fundacion is an independent cooperative of explorers. Originally founded as a group of scientists and explorers more than two centuries ago, the organisation evolved to include a paramilitary structure by absorbing various militia groups to protect its work and interests. La Fundacion currently focuses its efforts on the discovery and study of the unknown.
system_10627_key: WARNING: PLAGUE SYSTEM. The only life-bearing body has been cordoned off due to native pathogens. Any ship passing into the moon's atmosphere will be automatically designated a plague ship, refused docking in all systems and destroyed on-sight by all faction and system security forces. System trade consists of rumoured alien artefacts found in deep space, along with moderate mineral deposits in the system's inner asteroid belt. The permit for this system can be obtained via the Peregrina aristocrats faction.
system_10631_key: The StarTritton corporation is engaged in the production of parts for the ships, robots and manoeuvrable engines. They also carry out the liquidation of criminals, transportation and the production of minerals.
system_10662_key: Known as the system where the cure for the infamous Cerberus Plague was discovered in 3301 with the aid of many freelance pilots. Their names are enshrined on a plaque in Hart Station's central hall.
system_10694_key: The home of House of Saga, a close-knit family of traders and bounty hunters, investing in a plethora of enterprises to gain power and status.
system_10711_key: The Roughnecks are an organised group of miners and labourers who grew tired of their corporate "leadership" and decided to take control of their own future.
system_10737_key: The Black Daggers are a military organisation established to free the oppressed and protect miners.
system_10976_key: 160 S.O.A.R. operate from the system. They are a group of independent pilots working together to accomplish great things and keep the galaxy safe.
system_11294_key:
Last Chance funeral specialist franchises operate throughout human space. Their main offices and training facilities can be found in this system.

'We take care of you after the end.'
system_11320_key: The home of Pilot Syndicate 4, a faction made up of former slaves who now fight for their independence.
system_1140_key: The RRC Agricultural Union is a loose organisation of various agricultural corporations affected by the orbital bombardment and subsequent raids of Onion Head fields by the Federation. Formed after this event, the union voted to become patrons of the Empire instead. The RRCAU supplies crops and agricultural technology to independent farmers throughout Imperial space.
system_11417_key: Having established a healthy market out of Kappa Fornacis, Don Clemente Motanero has branched out to bigger and better systems.  BD dash, as its known among its regulars, is in a perfect position to market several rare trade goods. The Kumite Cartel is at your service should you need something smuggled to your location.
system_11440_key: The home of The Forbidden Citizens, a faction of people who tired of politics and took matters into their own hands to form a faction that values equality no matter what.
system_11492_key: The Sentinel operate from this system and they are a fraternity of pilots in the pursuit of collective greatness in all aspects. Sentinel has but one goal: to become Elite.
system_1151_key: High-population outdoor world. Federation founder member. The permit for this system can be obtained from the Federal Military.
system_115260_key: This is the home system of the Paladin Consortium. It is an association of independent mil-spec soldiers, constantly searching for a way to improve well-being and cooperation in their sector of the galaxy by enforcing law and promoting trade, exploration and mining.
system_115281_key:
Dark Hours Private Military Contractors is a Federally-aligned group of veteran pilots who provide services for hire. Dark Hours PMC protects miners, traders and passenger transports against pirates and other threats. It also offers mercenary support and patrols resource extraction sites alongside local authorities

Dark Hours PMC has a simple motive: to make the galaxy safer for those who do not have resources or skills to do so themselves.
system_115283_key: The home of Black Lotus, a guild of assassins that uphold the seven virtues of Bushido. The fight is inevitable and death is a beautiful outcome.
system_115292_key: AEF Legion of LFT 133 is a faction of pilots associated by common bonds to provide for the betterment of the system and for the pilots within the Legion.
system_115296_key:
FrogCorp is an influential and diversified corporation specialising in private security and consulting. It was created after World War III in an ancient country of Earth called France. FrogCorp owns an exclusive contract with the Federation.

This system and its asteroid fields are also the main training base for the FrogSquadron, which is the most famous combat unit of FrogCorp, made up exclusively of veteran pilots.
system_115318_key:
The Alliance of Chinese Elite is a group of pilots who are descendants of the ancient Chinese kingdoms. Even during the age of space travel, these pilots have not forgotten their origin, their culture or their language.

Their mission is to preserve the legacies of their ancestors through the extensive private military and corporate networks established throughout the centuries.
system_115319_key: Software and firmware engineers turned politicians, LHS 20 Engineers seek to promote efficiency, rationality and impartiality into their local governments.
system_115345_key:
The home of The Vindicated.
The Vindicated is a private military corporation comprised of ex-military and security forces.
It is unaligned to any specific power and offers services on contract only.
system_115360_key: This system is locked by the Pilots' Federation, no permits are currently issued.
system_115367_key: The home of 91st Intergalactic Corps, which has a singular, unifying goal: to promote Federation ideals and democratic policy throughout the galaxy. Having served with the Federation for years, the Corps has sought to mend and mitigate what it sees as the slow corruption of its political structure through strong military resolve.
system_115378_key: The Royal Praetorian Guard have operated from the shadows defending its interests both internally and externally for nearly a millennium.
system_115381_key: From space tea to weapons, OTCo is your choice for interstellar logistics.
system_115387_key:
The home of The State of the ART.
Founded by the survivors of horrific conflicts which occurred roughly two centuries ago, ending only when moral superiority could no longer be claimed by either side. Passing down the ‘Tales of the Troubles’ as a warning to subsequent generations, this faction eventually settled in Taliesin where they offer a home to any refugee, traveller or criminal seeking atonement.
system_115391_key: The home of The Funky Bunch. A pirate group operating in and around the Lave cluster. They currently use LHS 263 as their base of operations.
system_115400_key:
The home of the Star Pilots.
The Star Pilots constantly patrol their territory and fight off any threats. The organization is guided by the principle of unity and mutual assistance.
system_115421_key: The Masterless Accord is a tenuous pact of independent people, unwilling to bow to any ruler while recognising the benefits of unified strength. With no centralised power, citizens of The Accord tend to act autonomously within a code of humanism and cooperation. Pilots of the Accord volunteer their time to protect and supply its systems.
system_115434_key: This system is centred around a white dwarf which itself is surrounded by the remains of its closest planet that was pulled apart as the star died. The system contains a number of planets - mostly gas giants that support a mixed industrial and refinery economy. A powerful crime family is said to operate within this system.
system_115445_key: The home of Federal Rangers, a faction that spreads the power of the Federation through peacekeeping and transportation.
system_115448_key:
The home of the New Pilots Initiative.
The New Pilots Initiative is a training cooperative offering a support infrastructure to newly qualified pilots. It seeks to encourage these pilots to develop towards their chosen career, whether that be combat, exploration, mining or trade.
system_115451_key:
The home of Forsaken Remnants of GQ Virginis.
Forsaken Remnants of GQ Virginis is a band of pilots who perform various work in and around the GQ Virginis system. It specialises in combat work including bounty hunting and wetwork, but can also be seen partaking in trade and mining contracts.
system_115457_key: Founded and incorporated in 3304, COREX Space Exploration is focused on lucrative cargo deliveries, cartographics and mining operations.
system_115458_key: ARMADA Corp is a private military corporation that has been incorporated with its respective home government and local armed forces with representation in the Federation. Members of this faction are both representative of a corporate entity and lawful combatants in the eyes of the law.
system_115459_key:
Escuadron Castigador Estelar contains members of varying professions and abilities, with many claiming heritage from the ancient Spanish and South American territories of old Earth.

Originally banding together to push back against a period of tyrannical oppression affecting several factions, a victorious ESCA now seeks to punish criminals and pirates without mercy.
system_115460_key: Diavol Space Fleet is a Federal multi-role operations group. Their task is to the exploit resources from LHS in 2995, keep the peace and protect commanders in transit within the area.
system_115461_key:
Poor, low population extraction economy (Federal colony).

A tiny system, recently (in stellar terms) stripped of its planets in an encounter with another star, leaving just Vulcan in the eccentric orbit it has today. Vulcan is still in the process of reforming with the giant ring system, the only remnant of the other body with which it collided. Ores and minerals are readily available in both the rings and on the surface, and are actively mined by the WCM Corporation.
system_115464_key: The home of Alae Mortem, a tightly knit group of notorious criminals who want to break free from the oppression of the major superpowers and totalitarian corporations.
system_115483_key: The home of Pandora, a community of survivors who left civilization behind.
system_115491_key: The home of GSA. The Ginger Space Alliance are bounty hunters and deep space explorers.
system_115492_key: Shadow company is a conglomerate of pilots who operate in the shadows to oppose large factions and influence the galaxy and its politics in secret. Their goal is to prevent any one faction from becoming too powerful, or too oppressive.
system_115496_key:
Lycan Moon Mining have their primary facilities in this system, although they do operate through Federal space.

'It takes more than machines to mine.'
system_115513_key: The home of The Link. The Link is All; no above, no bellow, we are One. From the Gate, the Conduit leads One to All. They are Many, but there is One Link. Those who are Not, will Never Be. Down below, the followers of the Link care not of politics, or puny power struggle. The One explores the All from the Conduit. They will open their eyes to Others to trade. But close their fists to Who is Not.
system_115514_key: The home of The D Team. The D Team started as a private military organization specializing in mercenary work. After several years of working for the League of LTT 7421 League, unrealised payments for services rendered and differences in philosophy caused this faction to split from their former business partners. With relations now hostile, The D Team look to usurp control of LTT 7421 and establish itself as the dominant faction.
system_115515_key: Galactic Freedom Fighters was formed by entrepreneurs and veteran pilots that were once oppressed by corporate corruption and piracy. The faction now champions the opportunity for economic growth supported by strong democratic governance. Members are known to employ lethal force in their efforts to combat tyranny, organised crime and piracy wherever it may reside.
system_115522_key: DG Transport Company are Space Truckers, here to serve Hudson space!
system_115528_key: A trinary system of dwarf stars with active refinery and extraction operations on the central planets orbiting the primary star. Although there are many other planets in the system they are thought to be of little worth.
system_115566_key: Starblazer Corp was founded on the 12th December, 3302. In addition to trading and headhunting, the group is strongly committed to freedom and opposing piracy.
system_115569_key: The home of The Void, Inc.. The Void, Inc is a conglomerate of well-seasoned and combat hardened independent pilots; pilots who have realized that mastery of the void is the key to survival. Their distinguished accomplishments have earned the respect of their peers, especially in exploration with over 2 million light-years travelled.  Preferred contracts are in bounty hunting, combat and anti-xeno operations, while haulage of both personnel and material are accepted.
system_115570_key: Liberty's Last Armada is a small party of opportunists who made their first appearance during the War of Lugh in 3301. After the conflict subsided they formed an organisation to protect independent space from the ever-encroaching powers of the Federation and Empire.
system_115574_key: Sneak Squadron is a collection of pilots shrouded in secrecy and devoted to wetwork, and other missions requiring the upmost discretion.
system_115578_key: The Galactic Rare Trade Organisation deals rare goods between systems. Its main function is to ensure trade flows as smoothly, profitably and freely as possible by facilitating their self-styled 'Galactic Agreement on Rare Goods and Trade'.
system_115676_key: Named after the great explorer family who discovered it.
system_115755_key:
The home of LDS Enterprises.
LDS Enterprises are opportunists. Its goals and objectives are known to change on a whim, or when following the latest hot tip.
system_115993_key: The home of Corvid Progressive Party, formed by oppressed civilians and those who look to provide aid against tyrannical governments. The Corvid Progressive Party seek to create a corruption-free democracy where civilians come first.
system_11626_key:
Patrons of Little Norway are descendants of migrants from the Scandinavian region of Earth. They are monarchists at heart and avid supporters of the Empire. Patrons of Little Norway work actively to further the influence of the Empire, and believe that the Empire and the Imperial way of life holds the key to peace and prosperity in the galaxy.

The individual activities of faction members are of little concern to the faction as a whole as long as the activities further the faction's main objectives. All members of Patrons of Little Norway are considered equals under the Emperor and have an equal say in the running of the faction.
system_116448_key:
The home of the Lan Lounge Crew.
The Lan Lounge Crew in the il Aquarii system is aligned with the Federation and seek to follow the superpower's code and philosophy. Loyalty for its leadership, its people and il Aquarii come first.
The Lan Lounge Crew do collaborate with other factions but its own beliefs take priority – particularly regarding influence in its home system.
system_116461_key:
This system is famed for its inhabitants' eccentric love for tourists, but is plagued by deadly earthquakes.

In April 3301 the system was taken by pirates but swiftly liberated by the Alliance.
system_116462_key:
This system is noted for its ancient Ma Corn plantations, but is beset by frequent solar activity.

The system received an economic boost when independent pilots responded positively to a request for machinery in May 3301.
system_116463_key: This system is most notable for its fabulous cuisine, but is beset by occasional civil war.
system_116464_key: The Leesti system is notable for Zero-G Cricket and Leestian Evil Juice.
system_116465_key: This system is a dull place.
system_116466_key: The ARC is a volunteer organisation created to defend and advance Alliance interests. In keeping with the Alliance's ideals, the ARC is an open-minded, inclusive group with an aim to coordinate the actions of its members. Although generally sympathetic to Prime Minister Edmund Mahon as an individual, the group does not require that its members support him as a power.
system_116467_key: Uszaa is noted for its inhabitants' eccentric love for tourists and the Uszaian tree grub.
system_116468_key: This system is very notable for its inhabitants' innate shyness.
system_116469_key:
Orrere is mildly well known for Orrerian Vicious Brew.

Formed in 3278, the Code began as a small group of close-knit pirates who began their careers in Ngaliba. In recent years it has grown into a massive interstellar ring of organised criminals, now based in Orrere.
system_116522_key: This is Sicaria's home system. The Sicarians are a warrior race that has spent centuries perfecting the art of war. Preferring to keep to the shadows rather than play in the spotlight of political affairs, the leaders of the Sicarian Empire utilise the elite Sicarian Combat and Logistics Division to achieve its goals and crush its enemies.
system_116530_key: The Soldiers in Arms Community (or SIA) is a corporation dedicated to the unification of mankind under Federal leadership. Members of this faction actively patrol Federation space and protect Federal interests.
system_11683_key: The Pyrite Delta League actively pursues Imperial interests in 1 G. Caeli and beyond.
system_116883_key: A small mining colony, known for good card games and hardy contract workers. The system has five planets. The largest, Darahk V, has vast acidic oceans, a picturesque view for an adventurous tourist.
system_116884_key: A tiny population of less than a thousand, divided between Newtown and de Gaul, eke out a living in asteroid mining. Only the best armed traders survive. It's the kind of place you go to dump the bodies.
system_116885_key: A small but growing corporate system run by Wreaken Construction and Mining, the population has grown dramatically since 3200. Liabefa's Type M flare star is a space tourist highlight during active periods and features in the annual Astrogator sightseeing guide.
system_116886_key:
A tiny colony in 3195, Miola expanded rapidly as part of the 'Freeborn' movement. In 3265, an outbreak of fever stemming from a rescued pilot in Harris hospital decimated the planetary population, turning the settlement into a ghost town. Only the space station is now occupied.

The home of the West Leeds Yacht Club. "All for fun and fun for all" has been the motto of this group since the pre-war days of Slab City on Earth. It started as a small group of yacht captains from Mars who were looking for a vacation home, but has now grown to a fully fledged tourism service.
system_117141_key: A magnetar star formed from the collision and collapse of a previous dwarf binary system in 2672. Highly hazardous.
system_117152_key: Laniakea (meaning 'immeasurable heaven' in Hawaiian) is a hub of technological advancement, trade and a launching point for countless expeditions. Its true strength lies in its inclusive society; all are welcome and the only thing its members do not tolerate is intolerance. The faction was built by a varied, diverse, socially progressive group of individuals coming together to create the one thing they always wanted: a place to call home.
system_11765_key: Karamello Star Trading LTD is a corporation established as part of the Independent Charter of Free Commerce.
system_11777_key: The home of Elite Outlaws, whose core directive is to enjoy the freedom of the stars.
system_11_key: Night Wolves Corporation was created to bring together experienced and rookie pilots for trade, mining and anti-piracy contracts. It seeks to ensure security within the LP 644-15 system, continued prosperity and further expansion into nearby systems.
system_12000_key:
This system contains the central manufacturing plant for Devastator & Sons.

'Guaranteed devastation.'
system_1200_key: The home of the Cult of Nihilum. The Cult of Nihilum are an assorted group of bounty hunters from all over the galaxy. They contain mainly retired Federal veterans, who seek new challenges following active duty. They operate as a dictatorship with a sole leader. Although they are bounty hunters they still side by the Federation in times of need.
system_12129_key: The Huezueira Consortium is formed by trade, mining and security experts active in a broad spectrum of business. It was founded on strong ethical principles of morality and respect.
system_12317_key:
The Grey Council (TGC) is a politically independent group promoting peace and cooperation. Their intent is to encourage the peaceful co-existence of its members and associate groups, and to support collaborative operations (both peaceful and in some cases not). The group itself does not support either side in the case of in-fighting between members and associated groups, but if requested it will help to arbitrate peaceful negotiations between aggrieved parties.

Their motto is: "Pax est somnium" - Peace is the dream.
system_12350_key: The home of the Freedom Flotilla. Disillusioned by the Federation's corporate corruption, former congressman Gideon Ryker formed this democratic coalition to fight for freedom in 3302.
system_12428_key: Travel this sector long enough and you will find yourself in one of the Narim Syndicate network bars. Here, everyone will find company that suits them, hear the latest news or rumours, or find a profitable contract.
system_12430_key: Publicly, this organisation is known as Task Force Royal 5341, but to those inside its elite 'dark' squadrons, the group is jokingly known as the 'Reign of Annihilation'.
system_12508_key: This system is locked by the Pilots' Federation, no permits are currently issued.
system_12799_key: Most notable feature is a Station: home to approximately 2 million people. Because of its close proximity to all three superpowers it is a crossroads of cultural, financial and political influences. Often used as a place to conduct business and trade which wouldn't be entirely legal in one or more of the factional jurisdictions. It also has a reputation for bohemianism: a place of gap-year students, sexual experimentation, artistic ennui and a general anything-goes-ism.
system_12875_key: This system is locked by the Pilots' Federation, no permits are currently issued.
system_12960_key: Home of the Lindum Falcon Militia. The Lindum Falcon Militia was established in 3296 and has only recently expanded to space operations in Decima. Despite their reputation within the region for brutal acts and shady operations, they have grown at an exponentially increasing rate. They continue to pledge allegiance to the Federation, and recent developments suggest Lindum Falcon Militia are expanding to incorporate political operations.
system_13035_key: The Crimson Pathfinders of Achenar are an exploration and scouting wing of the Empire. They explore the deepest parts of the galaxy, and every one of their discoveries is pledged to the Empire.
system_1307_key: The home of the Imperial Stellar Combine. The Imperial Stellar Combine cannot be identified by any one particular specialisation. They have no love for outsiders, but will take advantage of the potential credits they offer. If one is willing to pay, then the Imperial Stellar Combine is willing to at least listen.  They adhere to the cry, 'Long Live the Empire!'
system_13278_key: The Star Dragons hunt down pirates and their ilk for the rich rewards involved.
system_13296_key: The home of Arctic Legion, a group of nomads from across the galaxy, united by common goals of honour, liberty and justice. They pledge allegiance to no major power, preferring to retain independence.
system_13372_key: Badben's Bizznizz is a random group of ne'er-do-wells based in the Benoit system.
system_13465_key:
The home of JagsCrop.
JagsCorp is a dedicated industrial corporation. Founded on the principle of perfection, JagsCorp specialises in long-distance commodity and material hauling.
JagsCorp is dedicated to industry, utilizing all available resources to expand its network of customers, delivery locations and resource acquisition systems.
Its motto is, ‘JagsCorp: We're in it for the long haul!’
system_1381_key: The Hellssina Knights are proud to help their fellow knights and friends.
system_13851_key: The home system for the Booty Bay Butchers. It is an elite group of Imperial bounty hunters. They eliminate all pirates who oppose the Empire or her allies, and complete various mercenary contracts as well.
system_1391_key:
The home of Interplanetary Explorations.
IPX is a tight-knit community of explorers, hauliers and defenders dedicated to being a positive influence in the galaxy. Wherever humanity requires assistance, an IPX CMDR will strive to be there.
system_13_key: Spinward Marches Alliance Concern is an organisation devoted to terraforming and clean energy projects as well as establishing exploration outposts deep in uncharted space. They originated in the Morrina system before moving to BD+22 4939 to establish a new base of operations deeper into unpopulated space.
system_14119_key:
The home of Forsaken Corsairs.
Forsaken Corsairs is an Imperial military corporation specialising in trade and the research of military hardware. Recently it has focused its efforts to eliminate rival corporations based in Federal and Allied space by employing pilots to fly in support of Imperial interests.
system_14154_key: The home of Icarus Interstellar, who promote the exploration and use of space for the benefit of humanity, by connecting worlds to create, inspire, and advance knowledge in all aspects of astronautic and galactic prosperity.
system_14229_key: The home of The Peculiar Brotherhood. The Peculiar Brotherhood are a group of commanders who seek out some of the more eccentric adventures found in the galaxy, and revel in general mischief.
system_14240_key:
Founded by a former White Navy intelligence officer, a woman known as 'The Octopus', IPEC came into being as a private military contractor with an Imperial licence. Under these benevolent circumstances it has grown to govern the CD-63 201 region of space.


Its stated aim is "to support excellent governance through intelligence, and so advance the interests of the Empire". It provides discreet military, security and reconnaissance services. It is thought to have been involved in assassination, data interception and destabilisation of target economies, but its use of 'deniable assets' make these allegations hard to prove.
system_14329_key: The Dark Matter Collective are dedicated to all facets of the dark.
system_14649_key: The Nova Alliance operates in this system and is an independent group that has no direct link to any of the superpowers. They primarily operate in Imperial space and try to maintain good relations with local factions, but are not afraid to fight, if needed, for their own interests.
system_14697_key: CD 73-253 is best known for the garbage world of Tarlak. Purchased by United Sanitec in 3284, it quickly became a major dumping ground for its sector of space. The population is mostly bonded corporate employees, a high percentage of which are refugees from Villist.
system_14701_key: Alexis Centauri is a triple star composed of a main binary yellow dwarf pair (Alexis Centauri A and Alexis Centauri B) and an outlying red dwarf, Paris Centauri.
system_14709_key:
The Lewis Zero G Fitness franchise is based in this system.

'In space no one can hear you pump!' The permit for this system can be obtained via the Pi Mensae Brotherhood faction.
system_14767_key:
Lensher Reclamation are based in this system.

'Finished with it? We're just starting.'
system_14786_key:
Born in the city of Dubrovnik. He developed the precursor to atomic theory and made many contributions to astronomy.

This is the home system for Rudjer Boskovic Inc. Its members are descendants of fiercely independent warriors from the Balkans region of Earth. The founders of this group settled in Rudjer Boskovic system late in the third millennium. Deadly mercenaries who specialise in guerilla tactics and the infiltration of enemy territory, they often inflict heavy casualties against superior enemy forces. Due to their contempt for the Federation, they are often found in Imperial employment wreaking havoc in Federal systems.
system_14840_key: Wolf's Bane is an alliance of miners and mercenaries formed on the fringes of Federation space for their own mutual benefit.
system_15017_key: The Infinitus Odium is a collection of twisted broken souls dedicated to cleansing the galaxy of non-believers in the name of their leader Pravius.
system_15063_key: Established after the Tau Ceti wars by a group of exiled pilots, HR 1980 serves as home to Taco Corp; a corporation founded to support the Federation mission of sabotaging Imperial economies and freeing slaves. With a variety of celestial bodies and ring types, the system provides ample R&R and occupational options. Old Earth recipes can be found on the menu of the restaurant in Foale Orbital.
system_1524_key:
The home of the Dutch East India Company.
The Dutch East India Company was founded at the border of the bubble. Several small companies banded together with the mutual goal of exploiting the opportunities provided by explorers and pilgrims heading towards Maia. Even after the initial rush of new traffic faded, these companies stuck together in mutual co-operation.
system_1532_key:
Star Mercenary Arms Corporation was founded in April 3301. Its founders are former officers and diplomats from both the Imperial and Federation Navies. SMAC remains an independent faction and is known to leverage influence in the corporate climate with reserves of raw materials and investments.

SMAC seeks to bring innovation and experience to the security industry by helping to combat piracy throughout the known galaxy. Members are noted for their integrity and professionalism.
system_15467_key:
The home of the Deep Space Invaders.
The D.S.I. is a group that specialises in protecting the inhabitants of Cet and its surrounding area from all external threats.
system_16149_key: The Federal Privateers aim to liberate Federal systems from Imperial forces through aggressive negotiations.
system_16163_key: The Dragon Fleet is dedicated to keeping inhabited space safe from pirates while also providing humanitarian aid to systems in time of crisis. The faction commonly trades in essential goods such as medical supplies and food.
system_16169_key: Former supporters of President Hudson, the Federal Defence League have expanded their operations by subverting Imperial star systems to the Federal cause.
system_16301_key: Independent Mercenary Corp is an organisation created by ex-professional soldiers of the Federation.
system_1633_key: The HIP 2902 Independents are a fiercely independent population on the outskirts of Imperial space. Famed for their hard work ethic and forthright opinions, the faction's long standing aims are to maintain local trade routes whilst upholding the democratic values of the local populous.
system_16718_key:
Also known as Alpha Carinae.

The home of White Star Surveillance Division, a group specializing in bounty hunting.
system_17021_key:
The vast financial holdings of Gallant Investment Brokers has helped the rapid growth of this system.

'Finding the perfect investment.'

The Bliss Consortium are based in this system. They strive for building a perfect society. One free from violence and hunger. They reject the strife between the superpowers, and support unity between cultures and races. Their goals are freedom, justice, and success!
system_17025_key:
The home of the Interstellar Basking Division.
The Interstellar Basking Division is a group of Imperial-aligned freelancers.  Along with exploring and mapping undiscovered systems, the faction has some involvement in trade the protection of its territory and members. The re-emergence of the Thargoid threat has led to a focus on training for its pilots.
system_1767_key: Maintenance Outfitting and Development Shipyards, or MODS, is a company committed to providing the best service for pilots travelling to the outskirts of the known universe, hauling cargo or engaging pirates.
system_1780_key:
This system is home to the EG Union. This faction was founded with support of EG Pilots with the aim to conduct an independent policy and become a dominant force in the galaxy.

This system is also home to the Colonial Drones corporation.

'Affordable drone technology for all.'
system_17838_key:
The headquarters for Low Profile Workshops is located in this system, although they can be tricky to find.

'Blending in is a statement.'
system_17889_key: The home of the Misfits Security. Misfits Security is a small band of commanders located on the edge of superpower space, who help to support each other. This faction is largely independent of the major powers but individuals of the faction are allowed to support whomever they wish. While activity with the faction is primarily based on security work and bounty hunting, their members are generally free to engage in most career types
system_17959_key:
Terra Republic, also known as Terra Sol Space Ship (T.S.S.S), is an all-purpose, anti-piracy group. It works to maintain peace with other factions and commanders. The faction is involved in a variety of stellar industries.

 Members of Terra Republic adhere to a philosophy of peace, solemnity and self-improvement. They are known to be strong advocates for the betterment of humanity.
system_18025_key: Corrin Marsh, the renegade son of Imperial Duke Balin Marsh, used his privilege and Imperial training to gather a loose confederacy of pilots consisting of explorers, traders, bounty hunters and even pirates. This ragtag band has endured internal conflict and external threats to emerge as a force to be reckoned with on the outer edge of inhabited space. After pooling its substantial resources, the Privateer's Alliance has now set its sights on expansion.
system_18032_key: Home system for Caballeros del Nuevo Orden - a Hispanic feudal knight sub faction loyal to Arissa Lavigny-Duval.
system_1819_key: The skilled soldiers of the Knights of Beneverchio have carried out the will of the Empire for centuries. During periods of peace they have remained silent, calmly waiting  to return from the shadows and bring order in the name of the Emperor.
system_1828_key: The Dagger Legion is a militia group based out of LTT 377. Pilots of the Dagger Legion engage in exploration, security and commerce within LTT 377 and surrounding systems.
system_18295_key: Also known as 23 Gamma Canis Majoris.
system_18642_key: Teurastamo is a small group of independent pilots blazing a path through the stars.
system_18677_key: The Imperial Order of the Knights work in the dark, challenging all enemies.
system_18723_key: Bepsin Gas currently holds the mining claims for this system.
system_18747_key: This is a relatively small star system with an extraction and refinery economy. Its small population exists in orbit around one of the system's two gas giants. The hard working population seems to have little time for fun, although a local criminal organisation does manage to scrape a living.
system_18798_key: The home system for Scorpions Order - a group loyal to the Empire. It has sworn to fight for Imperial interests across the galaxy.
system_18805_key: Bokeh Explorations Ltd was formed with the aim of discovering the unseen and spectacular within the universe. From multi-star systems to black holes, and whatever else may be lying in wait for those brave enough to venture out into the unknown.
system_19042_key: A small and relatively quiet system with a low key extraction economy. Organised crime is known to operate in this system.
system_19069_key: Ao Kang's Federal Merchant Navy is a capitalist democracy founded in the Ao Kang system. They specialise in trading and seek expert commanders to haul loads across the galaxy. Using mostly financial means to solve problems and disputes, they will resort to violence when there is no other choice.
system_1910_key: A luxurious Imperial agricultural world, famed for fine foods and extravagant parties. Also known as Beta Ceti and Dened Kaitos.
system_19155_key:
The home of the Deutsche Elite Piloten Interstellar.
The Corporation Deutsche Elite Piloten Interstellar [DEPI] was founded here in 3305 by Elite pilots German heritage on Earth. It has pledged prosperity, security and freedom for all members. Stated values of tolerance and justice have guided efforts to achieve this goal.
system_19215_key: The Red Squadron are based in this system.
system_19216_key: The home of Guard Frequency Response Ltd, which is primarily concerned with maintaining a low risk environment for space travellers, miners and explorers. Starting as a sub-contractor for RemLok specialising in ejection retrievals, the company has branched out to salvage and disaster response. It maintains cordial relationships with all major powers in an attempt to provide efficient services for all pilots who cross its areas of operations.
system_19230_key: The home of Red Sun Battalion, a well-oiled war machine, always placing the prosperity of the corporate body before that of their own. Since its founding, this private military company has expanded rapidly, consistently surpassing employer expectations.
system_19250_key:
This small independent service system boasts one of the most prestigious learning institutions operated by Grant Academics.

'We make learning easy.'
system_19544_key: This famous system is home to the Astrogator Tours corporation, specialising in deep space adventure holidays. It is a subsidiary of the Saud Kruger corporation also based in this system.
system_19554_key:
The home of the Galactic Security Squadron.
The Galactic Security Squadron is a group dedicated to protecting and helping other pilots travelling throughout the galaxy. While the Galactic Security Squadron focuses primarily on combat, its members are committed to helping coalition partners and independent pilots wherever possible.
system_19653_key: The home of Flat Galaxy Society, which was founded by war-weary and politically-savvy pilots who wanted to change galactic politics. Most of the founding members were Alliance or Independently-aligned and democratically leaning, and so the Alliance Democracy of the Flat Galaxy Society was born with the aim of spreading democracy and the Alliance philosophy of freedom and respect for independence to the edge of the bubble.
system_20262_key: The home of Orbital Security Company. Orbital Security Company was founded as a system-wide joint effort by settlements and stations, as an answer to the increasing pirate attacks. The company has since then widened its operations into exploration and trading as well.
system_20362_key: The permit for this system can be obtained from the Federal Military.
system_20443_key: The Federation Hammer Corp was founded by a ragtag group of vigilantes, united in the cause of reducing any pirate threat to the democratic efforts of factions in and around the Nanomam system. The Federation Hammer Corp's core mission is to expand the Federation’s influence to ensure the safety of the galaxy and the civilians under its protectorate.
system_20540_key: A group of independent Czech citizens who are defending and organising life in Phanes system. Resources provided from this administration enabled the group to establish a decent quality of life within dangerous space. The whole society is working hard to build the ancient image of The City of God (Civitas Dei), a peaceful, perfect and wealthy place.
system_205_key:
The Bottone Asteroid Development consortium is located in this system.

'Mining platforms where you need them.'

The home of the Sisters of Meropis, a religious cooperative founded centuries ago. They strive to use their talents to live as 'artisans of the common good' and promote galactic peace.
The Sisters are well-known in the region for their strict code of honour and respect, as well as their equanimous attitude in political and business dealings.
system_20624_key: The permit for this system can be obtained via the Crom Silver Boys faction.
system_20702_key:
Some of the finest independent fashion is created by Grant's whose core offices are located in this small independent service system.

'Your spacewear - all in one place (onesies our speciality!)'
system_21117_key: The permit for this system can be obtained via the Conservatives of Tiliala or Traditional Kaun Movement factions.
system_21121_key:
The home of the Daughters of Starlight.
With a matriarchal leadership structure, the Daughters of Starlight are dedicated to spreading their vision throughout the Galaxy.
system_21236_key:
The home of the Coalition of Independent Pilots.
The Coalition of Independent Pilots, founded in 3304 by a band of 13 explorers, focuses its efforts on creating a better galaxy. Its stated priority is pushing back the unknown and expanding humanity’s horizons, with occasional philanthropic work.
system_21380_key: Raven's Scouts was established to find new worlds and discover what awaits in the great beyond. Comprised mainly of explorers, Raven's Scouts were founded in the small system of Cai. They were born on Raven's Landing and they take pride in their home and their system.
system_2141_key: This system was given to the Guardians of the Free Spirit religious sect by the Federation in 2480. They believe in maximum hardship and live underground on several of the inner planets of the system. It is forbidden by Federal Law to enter the system without the permission of the Guardians. The permit for this system can be obtained via the Sublime Order of van Maanen's Star faction.
system_21535_key: The home of the District Z Corporation. The District Z Corporation, or "ZCorp" was founded in 3269 from a merger between DistrictCo and the Zhu Corporation. ZCorp is primarily a technology supplier for a wide range of industrial, military, and commercial clients. ZCorp also has numerous non-manufacturing interests; the company claims extensive assets in interplanetary shipping and transport, while funding its own police force to protect these assets.
system_21539_key: Eagle Corporation Industries is based in this system. It is a multipurpose corporation with interests in trading and bounty hunting.
system_21631_key: The home of the Maya Interstellar. Maya Interstellar focuses on the goodness in their people, aiming to better the inhabitants of their home system. Maya Interstellar was founded by a band of brothers and sisters who perceived the existing Maya regime as oppressive, and sought to oppose them.
system_21705_key: This quadrinary system on the edge of inhabited space is home to Invasive, providers of leading edge planetary assault services, and luxurious tourism voyages into deep space.
system_2178_key: Ronin Inc is a corporation that believes in honour and hard work. Its core philosophy is to uphold justice, defend the weak and get the job done by any means necessary. It has zero tolerance for slave-trading and strives to help anyone become independent.
system_2186_key:
This system contains the central offices for the Davies Station Services corporation.

'Doing the impossible, one thing at a time.'
system_2201_key:
Battle Master Ezellian and his lieutenant commanders ruthlessly  transformed this rag-tag group of mercenaries into a legitimate force in their home system. Their rapid ascension to prominence was built on a  meritocracy and dedication to their common goal - the supremacy of the Free Company of Phoenicis. They seek to carve out a region of their own in the galaxy.

The Free Company of Rho Phoenicis specialises in multi-role vessels that are optimised for each contract. Their slogan is "For power and profit."
system_2207_key: Under Imperial charter, Balaur Heavy Industries is a firm specialising in weapons and robotics research and development. Providing components for the manufacture of high-tech weaponry and modifications, their clientèle is primarily the Empire's military and industrial core.
system_22106_key: A wealthy and populous Alliance agricultural system. Also known as Pi-1 Ursae Majoris.
system_22149_key: Also known as Pi-2 Ursae Majoris.
system_2219_key:
The Universal Cooperative is based in this system and subject to the Council of Discord on Eris.

Starports across the galaxy are supplied with specialist parts and pre-assembled modules from Brewer Corp whose main fabrication plant can be found in this system.

'Looking down on worlds since 3100.'
system_22323_key: Home to a religious order from Europe, Earth, and is now famed for its delicious Conventual sweets.
system_2236_key:
The home of CSNU.
CSNU is an independent minor faction which stands for freedom against piracy. Its activities include combat, trading and exploration.
system_22449_key: The Order Of The Transcendent is a shadowy group of mercenaries.
system_2244_key: The home of Dhammacari Knights, a feudalistic monastic society who are fervent in their devotion to Simguru Antal.
system_22462_key: The HIP43197 Military Party is an organisation created by outcast commanders who wish to cut out the corrupt government and take leadership into their own hands.
system_22596_key:
The home of the Ghost Flight Special Tactics Group.
Initially a small group of independent bounty hunters collaborating to bring down a pirate fleet, these pilots recognised their joined capability and established Ghost Flight. With no official ties to any government, members patrol the galaxy conducting counter-piracy operations for a price. Its main focus is bringing as many systems as possible under its protection, pushing out threats to local infrastructures while training security forces.
system_22684_key: The Halley Salvage Force is a group of dedicated salvage specialists primarily focused on the salvage of derelict space vessels and clean up operations. They often claim these ships and their cargo for themselves, and later sell the stripped parts and valuables at underground markets.
system_22883_key: The East Galaxy Company is based in this system. It trades goods and sometimes gets into conflicts.
system_23006_key:
The home of Aesir Heavy Industries.
Aesir Heavy Industries was founded by mercenary pilots working with various factions during a system conflict. After forming a private association, it moved into the Bifrost system after a few short years.
Members study module development, taking advantage of the economic resources and knowledge acquired from years of high-risk combat operations.
system_230_key:
Years ago, a group of brave independent pilots founded the ITR Corporation to develop new combat strategies, fight piracy and criminal activity, and help others who need support.

The renowned Blitz Weapon Stores franchise headquarters can found here.
'All calibres, all power ratings, one store!'
system_23293_key:
The home of the Federal Foreign Legion Strike Force. The Federal Foreign Legion Strike Force is a fierce band of cut-throats, mercenaries, smugglers, assassins and misfits. Legionaries employ unique, unconventional skills and tactics developed from a lifetime of crime.
It is claimed that the Federation tolerates their allegiance, as the Legion is adept at engaging with less admirable mission objectives. The Legion provides asylum to the galaxy's darkest souls; their pasts burned, reborn to operate in the shadows.
The Legion's motto is, 'Born of ashes, from the shadows, together we strike.'
system_23366_key:
The home of the Applied Science Initiative.
The Applied Science Initiative consists of a small group of scientists and rational thinkers who are passionate about investigating the mysteries of the galaxy. The faction works hard to combat misinformation or propaganda with diligence and purpose.
The group has extended its enterprise into existing technologies to assist with and catalyse its efforts. These pragmatists have started to gain some tractions and are looking to establish themselves as champions of the truth.
system_233_key:
Amongst the cluster of industrial corporations is one of the Empire's hidden treasures. The J-Atack Fine Art Studios provide art to the most discerning members of Imperial society.

'Traditional or modern, but always exquisite.'

The home of the Raven and Wolf Company of CD-70 1960, an independent organisation focused on making credits. From cargo hauling to bounty hunting, nothing will stop Raven and Wolf.
system_23400_key: The billionaires club of the galaxy resides in New Yembo. While not appearing often at the front line, the secret billionaires spread their money throughout the galaxy, mostly for social and charitable reasons.
system_2351_key:
The home of UD4 Orion Inc.
A faction of Orion Inc pilots combined with military support from ‘Unidad 4’ to establish themselves in the NLLT 2969 system. It has since declared an ambition of establishing an economic and military empire under its guidance.
system_2406_key: 51TH Massilia Corporation is based in this system. They are a faction of independent mercenaries promoting justice and equality. They wield strong firepower if needed.
system_24117_key: The home of Aetas Eternum. Originally formed by a small group of outcast commanders, Aetas Eternum is a community of like-minded pilots looking for somewhere they can call home. Focusing primarily on trade and pirate hunting, their expansion efforts can be attributed to mutually beneficial trade agreements, democratic negotiations and the precise application of more aggressive methods, where appropriate. Aetas Eternum - Always Eternal
system_24383_key: Originally a system rich in rare ores, its boomtown atmosphere gave way to a strong industry base with ample supplies of basic metals. But every now and then someone hits pay dirt causing a new gold rush, brief reminders of the early days of colonisation.
system_2448_key: The home of Elites of Rose Blessed Queen, a subgroup of Rose Blessed Queen (RBQ).
system_2449_key:
The home of the Mithril Monkeys.
Formed in 3295, the Mithril Monkeys - a private military corporation known for their strange and unorthodox tactics - have seen action on many fronts. Following a violent double-cross by contractual employers, they sought revenge through heavy conflict.
Emerging victorious, the faction subsequently decided to expand its operation to help others fight against the corrupt forces that inhabit the galaxy.
system_24610_key: Elective Amnesia is a large corporation looking to spread its influence through the bubble.
system_24724_key: Binkkerton State Holdings has a rich and varied history dating back to the 11th Century. Originally a secretive and influential Earth order, today it is a modern and efficient interstellar organisation. Affiliated with the Federation, Binkkerton has established its business through corporate means, its expertise lying in specialist missions, trading, mining, policing and data gathering.
system_2480_key:
Most of Long Embedded Systems' fabrication facilities are in this system.

'Under the hood excellence.'
system_2492_key:
Following repeated infighting in 3301, the Phoenix Group emerged out of the ashes, determined to prevent the mistakes of the past from happening again. 

The famed special FX company B-ROOKES FX can be found in this system. Their slogan 'BOOM!' is known throughout the galaxy.
system_24_key:
Jones Synthetic Foodpacs provide a range of processed foodstuffs from this system.

'Bargain munchies for travellers.'
system_250_key:
Frost & King Transport operate their mega-transport vessels throughout Federal space. Their head office can be found in this system.

'We'll get it there!'
system_25346_key: The Black Rock Corp is a Federal Company based in LU Velorum. They chiefly operate in many systems under Federal control.
system_25372_key: The home of Mare Imbrium Actum, an Independent mercenary navy with political interest, backed by military prowess.
system_25442_key: Dominion Emeritus is an independent organisation made up of pilots who are experienced in galactic politics and veterans of numerous military conflicts. Using their combined wealth and broad experience, they have established themselves as a dominant force in this system, ruling it under a benevolent but authoritarian regime.
system_25455_key:
The home of the Greypool Security. Greypool Security was founded in 3304 by Aaron Handler. This faction aims to protect commanders from threats, both xeno and human.
Greypool prides itself in following a strict code of conduct to help keep its members in top shape.
system_25462_key: The home of the I.G.A. The Independent Galactic Anarchists do not approve of governments. They believe that no individual should be above another, promoting anarchist behaviour, and will kill on site if someone disagrees with their ideology. These battle hardened pilots have no fear of death or any opponent that they may face.
system_25558_key: Section 51 R.A.I.D. Division is a cooperative of like-minded individuals who strive to uphold the traditional ways of the warrior. The group stands ready to defend the human race from any threat in the galaxy. Its acronym stands for: Respond, Assist, Intervene, Defend.
system_25595_key: The Pilot's Propaganda Corporation is an independent data provider, formed by like minded commanders to counteract the misinformation communicated by all major powers.
system_25976_key: The home of the New Horizons Initiative. The New Horizons Initiative was founded on the basis of unity under freedom, and doesn't involve itself in the affairs of the galactic powers. The Initiative's only allegiance is to the Pilots' Federation.
system_26011_key: Between January 3300 and February 3301, the Banki and BD+03 2338 systems attempted to leave the Federation, but the effort was violently suppressed.
system_26024_key: Brohman was once a tourist destination for game hunters but with the extinction of the Jumbxta its prosperity evaporated. Villist Transfers grew from the planet's rebirth and came to dominate the Galactic network. The rebuild from the 'Battle of Villist' has drawn many craftsman and traders from around the galaxy.
system_26131_key: Also known as 33 Lambda Ursae Majoris.
system_26280_key: The Exogenesis Research Principal specialises in the exploration of deep space, to both study the origins of extra-terrestrial life and identify worlds as potential colonisation candidates. Funding provided by outside organisations is motivated by the data collected from such discoveries.
system_26348_key: Also known as 34 Mu Ursae Majoris.
system_26521_key: The home of Neutron Star Line. Based on the system's picturesque Planet A2, its operation works from an underwater habitat, surrounded by the wonderfully intricate ice formations caused by erratic currents on the planet. The Abe Reserve starport serves as a springboard to further destinations all over the galaxy. From destinations spanning the entirety of the Milky Way, the staff of the Neutron Star Line is committed to galaxy-class luxury and security for its passengers.
system_265_key: The Dreamers of Ys worship the Republic of Achenar, which died with Marlin Duval at the dawning of the Empire. Driven by the belief that Marlin will be reincarnated and birth a new Republic, as prophesised by the first Sibyl in a dream, most now support Aisling Duval. However, the coronation of Emperor Arissa Lavigny-Duval has shattered many of their Sibyls' premonitions, dividing the cult. Despite infighting, the Sibyls still seek to seed the dream of a new Republic throughout the Empire.
system_2661_key:
This system is famous for the exclusive brand of 'Braben Woollens' that are spun by the fair hand of lovely maidens from only the finest wool of genetically engineered sheep.

'Feel warm with natural wool.'
system_26793_key:
The home of the Carmack Galactic Mining Association.
The Carmack Galactic Mining Association's main responsibilities are twofold: the extraction and trade of high-value resources, and the distribution of deep-space prospecting data for metallic resource sites. The CGMA also conducts research on extraction technology.
In addition to this, the CGMA provides personal protection services to third party operations related to resource extraction.
system_26876_key: The Alliance Democratic Network is a group of free citizens dedicated to ending the tyranny of dictatorial regimes, anti-democratic governments and hyper-corporations in Alliance space. The faction, led by the 'hacktivist' Julia Cross, supports the independence of Alliance systems, but their members believe that dictatorships, crime syndicates and corporation-controlled systems run counter to the values of the Alliance.
system_27356_key: The home of Independent Pilot's Guild, which aims to bring together a diverse group of pilots, believing that the differences we share are our greatest strength when unified.
system_27599_key:
The Praetorianis Libertatis were formed from a small group of traders, smugglers and bounty hunters in the late 33rd century. Continuous problems with the Federal authorities forced them to flee into Imperial space.

After struggling to find peace and fit into Imperial society, the Praetorians finally settled in the Praecipua system. Here they re-grouped and created a new corporation, one they could build upon and call their own. A century later, after expanding and growing in numbers, the Praetorians look to the future and have turned their efforts towards a stronger power base, striving to become a self sufficient faction in their own right.

"No price is too high for liberty and profit!"
system_2787_key:
KD-Cox Spray Specialist have outlets throughout independent space and their headquarters is positioned within this system.

'For that personal look.'
system_27981_key: Also known as 48 Beta Ursae Majoris.
system_28019_key: The Raven Claw Mercenaries primarily works on bounty hunting and mercenary contracts. It aims to support new pilots and fight for any faction or power worth its loyalty, which commonly lies with whoever can offer the most credits. Reports indicate its long-term goal is to expand in influence and operational capacity.
system_2801_key:
One of the leading Imperial weapons manufacturing corporations, Dead-Eye Defence Systems have their central offices in this system.

'Power and laser tech for missions large and small.'

The home of Achilles Corporation, founded by a firm of lawyers and focused on the divisions of aerospace, entertainment, robotics, and security.
system_281_key:
Magda are more famous for their stores and home delivery network but also control a number of key agricultural systems within the Empire.

'Low prices, high quality. All for you.'

This system enjoys the patronage of Senator Zemina Torval.

The home of The Imperial Hattori Clan. Shinigami roughly translates as “death spirit”, which aptly describes the Imperial Hattori Clan's blood-soaked past as enforcers and assassins. However, the clan now stands as a shining example of honour and how the Imperial slavery system should work. No slave in the clan's domain is treated as a second-class citizen. Citizens, both free and slave, are trained as highly skilled warriors and go on to serve the Empire as officers, diplomats, ISA investigators, and royal bodyguards. Currently, the clan is led by Grand Master Seijuro Hattori, who also serves the Empire as a Patron.
system_28310_key: The home of the BBURO Settlers. The BBURO Settlers seek to settle peacefully in their chosen space.
system_28512_key:
The home system of the Rock Rats. Best known for prospecting the "Jumponium Highway" to Beagle Point during the 3302 Distant Worlds Expedition, this friendly bunch of pilots is dedicated to discovering the secrets of galactic geology, helping those in need of materials and pushing their SRVs to the limit through all manner of shenanigans. If you listen closely to one of the landable planets, you might even hear their Polonium Song.

Also known as 70 Theta Leonis.
system_2857_key: The Number was previously a prison colony, which gained independence after the overthrow of the military force controlling it. After the successful rebellion, laws became more lenient but society still embraced the prison structure, which has proved an effective counter against espionage.
system_29047_key: This system is locked by the Pilots' Federation, no permits are currently issued.
system_29111_key:
Prideful and self-reliant, the Legion believes its citizens should be fluent in all trades. A lack of skill in any particular profession is commonly viewed as weakness.  Firm followers of the Federation with members often claiming Lavian heritage, its commitment to duty has earned the respect of many peers.

Its motto is Ab Intra, meaning ‘From Within’.
system_2915_key:
The Neo Galactic Adventure Force is based in this system. It is a pilot association, aimed at recruiting and training young pilots, and giving them a place among a community of like-minded adventurers and eventually guiding them on their way to the stars.

JB Tax Accountants are famed throughout Imperial space for their services. This system contains their prime offices.

'No numbers too real or imaginary.'
system_2931_key:
This system is home to the Order of Shadow.

The Shadow shall rise and with it, the Order. And the Order shall seek out and claim knowledge and power. And the Order shall use its knowledge and power to spread the Shadow's influence, until the Shadow's chains are broken.
system_29341_key: The home system for the Northern Metta Union - a small communist community fighting for equality of rights.
system_29381_key: The home of PORT Transnational, a freight and mining corporation established to fuel the ever growing need for resources and the transportation of valuable commodities.
system_2943_key: The permit for this system can be obtained via the Defence Party of Nastrond Colony faction.
system_29509_key: Foyama Novingo Startourism was founded in 3299 by three brothers from a poor Imperial family. They began specialising in passenger transport and Foyama Novingo Startourism quickly earned its reputation as a VIP transport company.
