system_29716_key: The home of the Deep Villain Gang. The Deep Villain Gang call this system home. They specialise in trading as a primary function, but occasionally participate in bounty hunting as well.
system_29735_key:
The home of the Scattered Bones Mercenaries.
The Scattered Bones Mercenaries are a small group willing to aid other pilots, particular in taking out pirates or running protection on trade runs.
system_29737_key: Joint Task Force Zulu was founded by a group of retired veterans who decided they weren't quite done contributing to the galaxy yet. JTFZ leadership specialises in mentoring and skill training, ensuring the faction as a whole is prepared to tackle any task and conquer each new challenge. Regardless of a member’s chosen profession, its goal is to provide the knowledge necessary to become a loyal and productive member of Imperial society.
system_2976_key:
A small Federal service system where the headquarters for the Aurelius Space Tours corporation can be found.

'Spend your nights with the stars.'
system_29905_key: Also known as 63 chi Ursae Majoris.
system_29990_key: Prisoners are housed in underground cell complexes, and set to work in the mine. Visitors are allowed, but an entry permit must first be obtained. There is reputed to be a seedier side to the colony whereby lonely visitors may enter without a permit while the guards turn a blind eye for a fee, but this is always denied. The permit for this system can be obtained from the Federal Military.
system_30224_key:
A rare anarchy system that maintains a powerful industrial economy. Also known as Gamma Ursae Majoris and Phad.

The home system for The Ancients of Mumu who are adherents to the entity "Mumu". Their aim is to maintain the substance and nature of their society and protect their home system from incursion by any non-believers. Founded in the 12th century, while still planet bound on Mother Earth, the (then) Adherents of Mumu sought to better their environment for the benefit of others.

When first generation ships were due to leave Earth their society sought to colonise a system far from Earth as they believed that Earth itself was not worth saving. The colonists, by and large, survived the journey, arriving several hundred years ago. A significant proportion of the first settlers had developed a sincere hatred of space travel by the time they made first landing. 

Since their arrival they have grown particularly attached to their home and have transformed into a community that is fiercely protective of its chosen system and resistant to any attempts at visitation by those who have not been granted access.
system_30411_key: Admiral Justus Sigfast Karrison leads the Dreadful Nomads within the Alliance's Council of Admirals. The faction is based in Nevermore but has footholds in three more systems. Although an "Admiral" had to be appointed by the Nomads, they chose to keep their ground troop ranks as a symbol of loyalty to their ancestors and each other. The Dreadful Nomads still adhere to these ranks as they scour the galaxy, searching for anyone oppressed by the Federation or Empire who might join their number.
system_30430_key: Elite Force Brazilian Command is a combat squad established to protect and help commanders all over the galaxy. It fights against crime and fear with some of the finest combat pilots in the galaxy.
system_3071_key:
The home of Magnates of Cemiess.
Cemiean specialises in precious metal recovery and refining. It is actively involved in exporting precious metals to other industries. Its goal is to continue maintaining the prosperity of Cemiess through trade while advancing metallurgical research and engineering.
system_30725_key: The Adventurer's Guild is a group of pilots drawn from all corners of inhabited space. Explorers, bounty hunters, scientists are counted among its numbers, along with others who simply wish to live in an independent society. All who join the guild agree to a simple aim: to live life to the fullest.
system_30743_key: The home of the Southern Cross Armada. Claiming ancestors from Earth's southern hemisphere, this group took the name from the famous South Pole constellation, symbol of their roots and heritage. Not only combatants, the SCA includes scientists, explorers, traders and engineers. Originally divided in service of the superpowers, the founding members secretly joined in 3301 and started to unite efforts in order to make the galaxy a better place for humanity. Finally, in 3304 they formally announced their status as an official faction. The SCA seek to establish their own sovereign state free from the influence of the superpowers, leaving outdated ideals behind.
system_30864_key: Homeworld of Victoria Wolf VI, First Merchantress of Wolf 406 Transport & Co., a stalwart defender and promoter of peace, prosperity and freedom. Under her guidance, the Elite Diplomatic Corps constantly strive to expand the influence of the Alliance of Independent Systems. Be it through negotiations, humanitarian aid and water purification or, if deemed necessary, force.
system_30865_key:
May Corporation operates predominantly in the areas of mining and commodity trading, which makes up the bulk of its assets. The faction claims a network of interstellar business contracts.

A dangerous lawless system with little extraction activity. Was also known as Alpha Corvi.
system_30986_key: The EDC Commonwealth operates from this system and was founded by like minded pilots wanting a place to meet and swap stories. Now the Commonwealth has expanded into one of the biggest depositories of knowledge in the known galaxy. So much so, new pilots come here to learn. This has led to the establishment of a neutral system that welcomes all.
system_3137_key: A coalition of independent pilots who publicly gather new medical technologies for the Federation. Their real purpose is to gather military tech for the Federation.
system_31485_key:
The Corporation German Deep Space Squad [GDSS] was founded here in 3305 by pilots who communicate in the ancient German language originating from Earth. Its mission is to ensure the prosperity, security and freedom for its members and those within its territory.

The Corporation GDSS seeks to achieve these goals through trade, science and various contracted services. Its primary values are tolerance and justice, with members noted for their diligence and punctuality.
system_31508_key:
A small but successful Federal system. Several small corporate security firms are based here, offering data encryption consultancy services and private communication support. 

The Federal Reclamation Co. began as a collective conglomerate of companies which banded together in order to create a unified Federal force. They combine trade, finance, combat prowess, and the ability to source enormous influence in an effort to reclaim and resettle faltering economies and non-Federal systems for the Federation.
system_31616_key:
The home of The Orion Chapter.
The Orion Chapter is a misfit group, left to its own devices after many of its fellow pilots retired. The Chapter was formed as an independent organisation to carry on trading, bounty hunting and exploring the black.
Its motto is, 'For The OC!'
system_3168_key: The Brotherhood of GITS is a faction established in the HIP 5700 system. They trade and explore and will defend themselves against aggressors. They welcome new traders and explorers.
system_31842_key:
The locals are noted for their strange customs.

The home of Tomcat Avionics. Establishing a new standard of excellence in the inhabited frontier, Tomcat Avionics innovates and leads the field in technical prowess and efficient design. Their system augmentation firmware and tools provide the latest in high-tech customisation for any vessel.
system_31902_key: HIP 61061 for Equality is a peaceful independent democracy that has emerged from years of struggle in the remote HIP 61061 System. Actively follows the vision of expanding democracy and aims to provide stability, law and order in a ruthless galaxy.
system_32038_key:
In March 3301 the system attempts to leave the Federation, resulting in conflict between the Federation and the Crimson State Group, leaders of the independence movement. The so-called 'War for Lugh' was won by the Crimson State Group.

The home of German War Gaming, a faction that grants independence to its members from the Federation and the Empire. They will protect everyone passing through their systems and continue to expand and spread peace across the Bubble.
system_32104_key:
Former Imperial colony turned independent, once held strategic value due to its proximity to both Imperial and GalCop space. The planet Cullen is the only orbiting body in this system and its space station, James Sneddon station, is home to the Global Border Control Agency and Morten-Marte Orbital Council, the latter of which is an open forum where representatives from all of Cullen's nations can freely discuss ongoing issues. Diplomatic staff from all three galactic governments are also members of the MMOC.

The home of the Tionisla Historical Society, fighting to protect truth and freedom in a galaxy where they are rapidly becoming rare commodities. They explore the galaxy, seeking out artefacts and treasures that reveal where humanity came from and maybe where it is going.
system_32129_key: An independent system known more for a carbonated drink than its piracy, it has recently come under the interest of the Alliance. Basic commodities are always in demand.
system_32156_key:
This binary system is mainly comprised of icy worlds. However the rich asteroid belt and metal rich planet around the companion star supports a mixed refinery and high tech economy. Travellers often report that there are more watchers and combat capable ships passing through than they expected for such a modest system.

The home system for Los Chupacabras. They are a small group of dedicated smugglers, bounty hunters and pirates.
system_32234_key: The home of the Collective of Indepent Agents, a group of pilots who support the law and rules of the Federation.
system_32510_key: Imperial controlled, but with some interesting by-laws left over from its previous independence. Senators of Codorain are colourful characters, renowned for their 'interpretations' of Imperial decree. The main settlements are on Codorain II, a vibrant world on the Imperial periphery.
system_3255_key: The Spectrum Organisation is a trade federation and armed military force, established through a charter approved in 2067. It is tasked within that charter to maintain peace and political stability throughout the system.
system_32831_key: Grandmort is home to a religious enclave which follow a strict minimalist life. There is only one minor starport and no imports, but the enclave produces small statues of their god which have been purchased by many traders over the years.
system_3285_key: A group of traders, bounty hunters and explorers dedicated to personal freedom and the defence of Tarach Tor. The Guardians spread the influence of Tarach Tor through the distribution of Tarach Spice. The spice must flow.
system_32995_key: The home of the 7th United independent trading corporation. This corporation specialises in trade of all types. They do not discriminate against offered deals, instead assigning a price to anything. 7th United set out to control markets, and can be found running cargo and collecting information throughout the galaxy.
system_3308_key: The home of Angels of Death, an independent enforcement organisation focused on the mutual prosperity of its members.
system_33160_key: The Shadow Realm Initiative are traders, explorers and combat pilots that combine their skills and experience to maximise profit and offer protection for any up-and-coming pilots. It is heavily focused on trade and anti-piracy. Bound by similar circumstances, members serve to uphold peaceful morals throughout its controlled territory.
system_33163_key: This is the home system of NULL. They are pilots fighting against piracy, aiming to help those in need.
system_33202_key:
Discovered by the family Dijkstra's fleet. The first man to set foot on the planet was Commander Michel Dijkstra and it was later terraformed by his son Danial and daughter Rianna Dijkstra. Once known as 9 Draconis.

The home of the Dijkstra PLC, Born from the frustrations of communism being the main government of Dijkstra, Dijkstra PLC was formed by a collective of free citizens intending to overcome their communist adversaries. They seek to bring wealth and fortune back to the system they call home.
system_33317_key: The home of the Winters Alliance, which strives to protect and serve the Alliance.
system_33548_key: The Alliance Office of Statistics is based in this system. Its goals are to ensure the safety and prosperity of the Alliance.
system_33594_key: The Symbiotic Evolution Cybercollective, or SEC, is dedicated to creating a free society. It is organised in communities connected via a Great Council.
system_33605_key: The home of the Union of Feuma Resistance, which was born out of a desire to protect the values inscribed in the very heart of the Alliance since its foundation. Respect for human rights, multiculturalism and democracy are the keywords.
system_33757_key: A rich asteroid belt and ring system around one of its gas giants provides the mineral wealth for this system. A gas giant with water based life also provides interest for xenobiologists. A known criminal gang are also believed to operate here.
system_33825_key: A small settlement run by the Wreaken Construction and Mining Corporation. The permit for this system can be obtained via the Hodack Prison Colony faction.
system_33884_key:
The home of Alpha Dogs Corporation.
Alpha Dogs Corporation was founded by a group of peace-loving pilots, with a mission to make information and technological developments accessible to all. They prioritise supporting newer pilots.
system_33909_key:
This system is the home for the Auger Vision corporation.

'Specialist sensors for specialist jobs.'
system_3428_key:
Formerly the home of Darkwater Inc, one of the largest private military forces to ever exist. Its headquarters were situated in this system.

In 3308, Summerland was revealed to be the base of operations for the Lords of Restoration – a secretive group of Imperial Senators who sought to overthrow the Duval Family’s rule. True servants of the Emperor purged these traitors from the system, along with the Darkwater Inc forces that had chosen to defend them.

The permit for this system can be obtained from the Imperial Military.
system_34362_key: Jakobsland Galactic Group is a faction of pilots from the Jakobsland settlement on Earth. They are strong merchants, tireless warriors and discoverers of new worlds.
system_34499_key: A lawless backwater, despite the efforts of Wreaken Construction and Mining. The Furnace battle group from Alioth under the command of Admiral Bryce Jander were based here before they journeyed to Lave to take part in the famous 'Battle for Lave Station' in 3265. Quator remains a haven for pirates. 'Hoopy's Bar' on Quator Station should not be confused with the popular casino chain of the 3200s.
system_34520_key: The home of Eclipsis, whose goal is to protect Wolf 562 from hostile Thargoids or any other hostile alien race.
system_34656_key: Independent Consultants Group provides discreet consulting services, deep space research, hauling, commodity acquisition and other valuable services.
system_34700_key: Lave is famous for its vast rain forests and the now extinct Lavian tree grub.
system_34702_key: Five Points Syndicate is a criminal organization determined to bring about Alliance control of core systems. This would increase bureaucracy and decrease the size of the standing military, thus allowing them to more safely profit from their illegal activities. Though criminals, they are unflinching in their defence of the systems they inhabit.
system_34709_key:
A growing colony that formally joined the Alliance in 3278. Many of the local corporations are now subsidiaries of Wreaken Construction and Mining.

The Wings of the Void were originally a group established to unify pilots within populated space. Now, in addition to that, the Wings aim to help new pilots learn about the workings of the galaxy, and try to maintain peace and contentment wherever they hold power.
system_3472_key: Home to a lost, ancient civilisation with primitive beliefs in divinity.
system_34818_key:
Poor, low population industrial economy (Federal democracy).

A small Federal industrial system whose only claim to fame is the ARG Explorer Ventures corporation. 

'Seeing far and seeing true.'.
system_34883_key: The Disciples of Daedalus were created by Marshall Tom Ledgerwood to rally the people into fighting back against the oppressive rulers of their system. They where offered a position in the Alliance for their honour and bravery. They agreed, and now are apart of the Alliance, dedicated to helping anyone in need.
system_349_key: The home of the Omerta Brotherhood. A secretive brotherhood who live by the ancient Omerta code of honour; this places importance on silence, non-cooperation with authorities, and non-interference in the illegal actions of others.
system_3504_key:
A small independent industrial system that is also home to the Deep Black Missiles corporation.

'For things that go boom.'
system_35076_key: Poor, low population extraction economy (Federal colony).
system_35119_key: The home of Terra-EX Astro Corp, a collaborative initiative assisting with ongoing research into human-occupied space and exploration into the vast unknown.
system_35207_key:
The home of Sky Line.
Sky Line was founded by an independent peacekeeping organization of retired veterans who specialise in bounty hunting and security contracts. They invite calls for assistance from any who feel oppressed.
system_35288_key: Also known as 85 Eta Ursae Majoris.
system_3534_key: The home of the Independent Free Citizens Movement. The Independent Free Citizens Movement (IFCM) is a hard-line communist organisation which arose from a splinter group based within Utopian space. It promotes trade across galactic borders and the decriminalisation of tobacco and alcohol, the prohibition of which deprives many agricultural workers of a livelihood. It also aims to eradicate perceived corruption within systems which the IFCM believe are no longer functioning in line with true Communist ideals. At times it also serves as a union for independent traders and industrialists who wish to work freely, without hindrance across the galactic regions controlled by the Superpowers.
system_3542_key:
Stellar Sailors United originated from a collaboration between traders and explorers seeking profit, knowledge and protection - in that specific order. The union is always seeking out new exquisite goods and trade routes that will help it thrive.

Members are often seasoned pilots, able and ready to support the defence of union assets. For the right price, these pilots are also authorised to fight alongside others in need of military assistance.
system_35502_key:
Poor, low population refinery and extraction economy (Federal colony).

A conventional corporate system belonging to the Federation with industrial-scale extraction of a range of ores and refineries too, producing metallic tantalum, titanium, aluminium and more for nearby manufacturing industries.

The home of Colonial Military Forces, founded to help independent star systems not only survive, but thrive in the galaxy.
system_35759_key:
Poor, low population industrial economy (independent corporate state).

A small independent system known as the home system for the Beamer Pulsed Inc corporation.

'We have both kinds of lasers...'
system_36078_key:
The home of the Silverbacks. The Silverbacks formed decades ago following an anarchist coup of an independent system. Tired of political delays, a small group of retired military veterans winged up to help the local defence & relief effort against the anarchist pirates. 
The inhabitants of Arexe were inspired by this generation of elderly pilots who fought to protect them. This precipitated an influx of new recruits, allowing the Silverbacks to expand their operations further. 
Today the Silverbacks are a reserve unit of veterans and civilians providing humanitarian aid across the bubble. Missions include refugee transport, outbreak relief and system security.
system_36231_key:
The home of the Hip Union of Native Groups. The Hip Union of Native Groups is a revolutionary cooperative government that rose to power through the perseverance of disgruntled miners and their crews. This was a response to the decline of corporate control in the system, leading to sudden tax and tariff increases that bled the working classes dry.
Intel indicates that H.U.N.G was initially a small clandestine group that held enough influence to put a stop to the prior, rampant exploitation of the people to maintain market stock prices. Their solemn wish is to take back the rights of civilians and their freedom to prosper without fear of corporate manipulation.
system_36261_key: Ignis Aeternum is a highly secretive organisation whose motives are a mystery. Rumour suggests they are dedicated to combating the darkness that not only lurks within the void, but also within the heart of humanity.
system_36372_key: The members of Corsarios de Heimdal value humanity above all else. Strong, decisive and independent, they are charged with defending the weak from their enemies and from the real dangers of the galaxy.
system_36698_key:
Once a hotspot for the tensions between the Empire and the Federation, this system is slowly returning to normal under Federal ownership. Ferngate Plexi was one of the first major corporations to set up in this system.

'Get a clear view with Ferngate.'
system_36798_key: The home of the Black Hole Syndicate. The Black Hole Syndicate is a group of unique pilots, founded by four drunk criminals that wanted a different path in life. This group became a haven for wandering pilots from all over the galaxy, many with a terrible history of war and crime, seeking to avoid interactions with the galactic superpowers. With a growing Thargoid threat, The Black Hole Syndicate are seeking to take advantage of this distraction to forge a new destiny.
system_36818_key:
Agricultural economy (independent corporate state).

The home of the Ragnar Dark Warriors, a group dedicated to the ideals of making the universe their own.
system_36957_key:
The home of the Quati Logistics. Following visionary tradesman Erick 'Clef' Rodriguez, a group of professionals with extraordinary skills and an impressive lack of regard for safety boarded an old modified Anaconda and began running missions for anyone willing to pay the price; this was the birth of Quati Logistics. Over time this one ship became a fully-fledged organization.
Rodriguez perished, a victim to his own body, but his legacy lives on and his men have no intention of abandoning their new home.
system_37210_key: The home of the Red Star Line corporation, a trading faction loyal to the Alliance of Independent Systems.
system_37342_key:
Agricultural economy (independent communist state).

This system includes the outdoor world Azeban, with an extensive agricultural economy specialising mainly in grain and livestock, with tea and coffee plantations in the equatorial regions.

The Terran Colonial Forces are a military organisation known for actively following the ideal that all citizens and civilians under their control deserve to have freedom to live as they want, as long they don't abuse it. They use their military capabilities to bring justice and common wealth to systems in their control.
system_37380_key: Home to the 'Booze Brothers' who claim to fight against unfairness and slave trading.
system_37452_key: Rebels of Bootis was founded by an independent pilot looking to establish a legacy in the galaxy. The faction has set up a base of operation within the HN Bootis system.
system_3747_key: Originating from the Federation's core worlds, time has seen this once powerful order fall to decay. The Lost Souls of Orkin were ousted from Earth generations ago after gaining some political power, and disappeared into the black. Led by the enigmatic 'Trinity', the order remained silent for centuries until the discovery of alien artefacts and meta alloys. Then the church's missionaries poured forth once again, spreading their doctrine of survival through the nurturing of the fittest. Their true purpose remains shrouded in mystery.
system_37495_key: The home of the Alpha Guard. Alpha Guard are a group of skilled pilots whose aim is to promote the best qualities of the Pilots' Federation. Their activities include bounty hunting, trade and the defence of humanity against any alien threats. They welcome commanders of all abilities. Only by working together can humanity prosper!
system_37605_key: First organised in 3302, J.Co started offering a helping hand to new pilots and guiding them. They offer their services in the name of goodwill, knowledge and camaraderie. However, there are rumours throughout the galaxy that J.Co is a Shell Company for  a shadow outfit known as “The Consultants”, who take an interest in researching the properties and applications of “unique salvage”, for nefarious purposes.
system_37725_key: Poor, low population extraction economy (Federal colony).
system_37813_key:
This is the home system for the Institute of Galactic Exploration and Research.

The IGER's purpose is to encourage and support the research and exploration of deep space. This information is freely disseminated to its members.

The Institute is politically independent, however members may align with any political group they choose. Members may also engage in any profession, but the Institute discourages aggression between members of the Pilots' Federation.
system_37818_key:
The home of Entropic Void Walkers.
Entropic Void Walkers is a group of fellow pilots, founded in the year 3304. It welcomes any pilot dedicated to harvesting the riches of space. Respect for all non-human life is stated policy.
The faction is known to pressure members into amassing wealth, for the purpose of ensuring their individual freedom.
system_37919_key:
Born in the Lakota system, Argus Corporation is a democratic faction which respects the opinions of all members. It uses all points of view to inform decisions, intending to promote regular improvement.
Argus Corporation is focused on trade, bounty hunting and exploration.
system_38173_key: The Bollwerk Mercenary Corporate is a faction of mercenaries and former security personnel who were originally a small crew of pilots hired for escort duty and system sweeping missions. They are now independently expanding their influence by establishing security contracts and trade agreements, as well as offering protection to shipping lanes and maintaining their own network of equipment and goods.
system_38328_key: Pirates fleeing from all regions of the galaxy founded the Pirates of Scylla. Seeking a new purpose it offered to assist local corporations in acquiring mineral resources and pushing back external threats. The POSx also operate as bounty hunters and will accept any job for the right price. Its code rejects the idea of subservience to others.
system_38466_key:
The home of Andromeda Corporation.
Andromeda Corporation is an interstellar company specializing in planetary exploration and colonization. In addition to funding the establishment of several human colonies, Andromeda Corporation has additionally sought to secure rights in systems with potential undiscovered resources.
system_385_key:
The Black Birds are a secret squadron whose codes are based on former traditions and chivalrous rites. Black Birds' pilots are tenacious and as demanding with each other as they are merciless with their enemies. They work for the highest bidder, and undertake the missions no other pilot would accept.

Although CryMed Healthcare Systems have representatives throughout known space, their headquarters is based in this system.

'Healthcare is our life as much as it is yours.'
system_38775_key:
Poor, low population refinery economy (Federal colony).

The home of Freelance Enforcement and Recon, who are freelance explorers and bounty hunters.
system_38804_key:
Nosira Corporation was formed by several companies seeking to ensure clients had constant access to their services. Members share the ideal that people have the right to do anything or to go wherever they want – providing they utilise Nosira Corporation services to arrange such activities.

Eulexia is a system with a single habitable Earth-like moon, Eurydice, in orbit about the ringed gas giant Tiamoia. It was discovered by the Wagar expedition in 3264. The moon is designated as a site of exceptional beauty.
system_3895_key:
The Avery Aerodynamics corporation is based here.

'Turbulence is someone else's problem.'
system_3905_key:
The home of the BR Federation Force.
The BR Federation Force offers a place to all pilots, believing that nobody should have to fly alone.
system_39073_key: A populous binary star system which supports an extensive agricultural and refinery economy. Despite the rumoured presence of organised crime this is generally a peaceful system.
system_3911_key: A highly populated Imperial system, there are four inhabited planets. Garuda, a water world, has a famous fly-fishing resort often frequented by the Crown Prince. The terraforming of Kerkes was never completed, leaving the environment dry and arid but still habitable.
system_3917_key:
This system's inhabitants have hearts as big as their star is bright, especially where cute furry animals are concerned.

Browncoat Uprising come from Miranda II. Despite being a poor system, the Empire have still exploited it, making slaves of some of the inhabitants. But the Browncoat Uprising aim to misbehave...
system_39366_key: The home of The East Circini Company, which began by running tea out of Bernoulli City, owing to the exceptional growing conditions and quality of the tea leaves on Beta Circini 11. They now have countless other business and political interests and although still loyal to the Federation, pursue their own agenda.
system_39467_key: The home of Black Alliance Industries.
system_39519_key: Also known as 13 Gamma Ursae Minoris.
system_39579_key: A modest extraction and refinery economy exists in this system. The many ring systems of the system's gas giants provide many opportunities for miners. And the locals are happy to supply those looking to make themselves rich.
system_3962_key: Established in 3302, J.Co started offer help and guidance to new pilots. They offer their services in the name of goodwill, knowledge and camaraderie.
system_3964_key: The home of Wolf Heart Industries, an industrial shell company for the private military corporation Wolf Heart Tactical.
system_39720_key: Crimson Mining and Salvage are based in this system. They are an independent corporation set up to supply the ever growing needs of the exploration and colonisation markets.
system_40071_key: The home of the Ghosts of Cydonia. Originally an outlaw group from the Cydonia region of Mars, the Ghosts of Cydonia expanded their network across Federation space. Whilst their current operations are usually legitimate enterprises (specializing in Trade and Bounty Hunting), occasionally they slip into their old role as weapons smugglers.
system_40089_key: This modestly populated trinary system supports a mixed industrial and refinery economy. The system's claim to fame is being the setting for the billion credit grossing blockbuster 'A Warp Through Time'.
system_4019_key:
The struggling independent ship conversion specialist Kelly Shipyards has its only remaining facility in this system.

'Every ship comes to us.'
system_401_key: The Church of the Space Cat was formed after multiple members of the EXO Faction were exposed to dangerous levels of toxic gas. In the darkness of space the 'Meow of the Space Cat' was heard in which the 9 Edicts were given to the Prophet of the Meow Larzok. Adherents of the Meow - followers of The Church of Space Cat - are guided by the 9 Edicts.
system_40478_key:
A small agricultural system known for housing the headquarters of Benton's Natural Remedies.

'For that extra boost in the morning!'

The Federal Enforcers of Ross 1057 are a Corporate command backed by the Federation. The Federal Enforcers of Ross 1057 believe that the current owners of Ross 1057 are not fit to rule the system and hope to overthrow them and take control. Furthermore the company wishes to expand into neighbouring systems and to make a larger profit.
system_40515_key: The Elite Fleet Republican Consortium has stated its goal as providing opportunities for all while defending the rights of the individual. It embraces all forms of liberty, with members known to fight against any threat to its egalitarian goals.
system_4052_key: This up and coming system is known for being the home of the Budget Shields corporation, suppliers of 'cheap and cheerful' shields throughout Federal space.
system_40571_key: The home of the Ecological Preservation & Studies Group. The EPSG is a fully independent cooperative that works tirelessly toward the genetic preservation and study of all lifeforms, habitats and cultures that exist in our galaxy and the universe beyond. They protect these sacred worlds supporting life, and study the origins of life in our universe to increase humanity's understanding.
system_4082_key:
Well known Imperial Navy Base. Most Imperial naval administration is done on Topaz, and there are several outdoor training camps across the surface.

Senator Anders Blaine is the senator for this system and enjoys relative autonomy. The permit for this system can be obtained from the Imperial Military.
system_40904_key: The home of Oblivion Fleet. Originally founded as a Private Military Company, Oblivion Fleet has amassed an excellent reputation and great wealth through the success of its private security contracts and the skill of its pilots. Although the combat fleet is still their primary source of income, its new found prosperity has allowed it to flourish into a multifaceted corporation and expand into multiple business sectors.
system_40953_key: This is the home of The Library, a group of human archivists that work effortlessly to catalogue and preserve human art.
system_41008_key: The home of United Systems Commonwealth, consisting of refugees from Australis who established the colony.
system_41267_key:
The home of Knights of Sidonia.

Knights of Sidonia is a group of independent pilots claiming ancestral Brazilian heritage. Born in the Wolf 620 System, members are comprised of active traders, explorers and experienced combat pilots.
Its allegiance is to but they aim to be ready to take action against any external threats.
system_41753_key: Indonesian Pilots Association is an organisation which aims to unite pilots who are descendants of the Indonesian Republic from ancient Earth. Over the millennia, Indonesian pilots have scattered all over the Milky Way, pursuing their own goals and dreams. In July 25th, 3301 they started banding together and formed their own organisation in this system.
system_4195_key: The Achenar system is notable as the home of the Empire, one of the galaxy's three superpowers. Capitol, a satellite of the sixth body in the system, is the primary residence of the emperor, and the seat of Imperial power. The system is characterised by widespread opulence and ostentation. The permit for this system can be obtained from the Imperial military.
system_41_key: The Oryx Resource Development Group investigates viable planets for colonisation and terraforming. Their goal is to facilitate high-yield production rates for sub-components that aid interstellar travel. As a contractor and parts manufacturer, the Oryx Group invests not only in exploration and terraforming, but also in the mining and refinement of rare materials.
system_4200_key:
The system relies heavily on slavery to maintain the luxurious lifestyle of the very wealthy elite. Most live on the great plantations, common throughout Imperial worlds. The cities house the workers for the service industries and more exotic entertainments.

The magnificent palace where Aisling Duval lives is situated in this system.
system_4201_key: Toby's Independent Traders is a predominantly trade focused organisation of pilots, with a simple goal of creating a sustained, sizeable and secure Trust fund for the benefit of their future protégé Toby and all those who wish to associate with him on a friendly basis.
system_42050_key:
The Home of The Fallen Wing. Recently exiled from a totalitarian administration, these renegade pilots gathered together according to the dogma of corsairs past. Recruited by a letter of marque, they act in multiple fields, their broad scope ranging from war to humanitarian aid.
Thanks to their success, the fallen pilots have established a base of operations within the system HIP 79636, where these pilots were born.
system_42308_key: The Interstellar Trade Corporation is dedicated to enriching the lives of every galactic citizen through its trade networks and economic centres. The central power of the ITC operates under a triumvirate, with power equally shared between three people, and the subordinate roles are elected via meritocratic nomination. The ITC seeks only peaceful economic longevity but pirates and criminals will be dealt with by force when necessary, to protect its members, assets and interests.
system_42325_key:
Agricultural economy (Federal democracy).

The home of the Alliance of Might and Magec. Established by members of the mercenary organisation Legion XIII and like-minded free citizens of the Magec star system, the Alliance of Might and Magec promotes and fights for the goals of democracy, personal freedoms and human rights. It strives to bring peace and prosperity to the people under its guidance and seeks harmonious co-existence with all like-minded groups.
system_42615_key: Galactic Trading Incorporated is a friendly group of traders hailing from their home system LHS 3447, travelling the galaxy and ensuring the safety of their cargo.
system_42658_key: Dead Men Walking are based in this system and are a cooperative group of like-minded combat pilots and traders who decided (over much Gerasian Gueuze Beer and Lavian Brandy) that working together as a team was more social and much safer. This left more time for healthy profit and friendly banter in the deeps of space. Join us and you'll never warp alone.
system_4281_key: The permit for this system can be obtained via the Defence Brotherhood of Terra Mater faction.
system_42890_key: Life is hard in this system, or so they say.
system_43135_key: The home of the Imperial Confederation, which aims to put an end to the injustices of the Empire and Federation.
system_43204_key: Call of the Black is a group which is principally exploration-based but now sees to establish itself as a stellar faction of note. It has recently made a home of the Ross 812 system.
system_43298_key: The Hellspace Corporation, established in 3298, is an independent paramilitary group with a vested interest in bounty hunting and the security of the systems it inhabits. Despite its relatively recent creation, a period of enrichment has financed reestablishment from Svass to LP 918-29.
system_4336_key: The most powerful handguns in the universe (made by Callaghan Firearms corporation) are based in this system.
system_43516_key: Also known as Alpha Trianguli Australis.
system_43587_key: The home of the Space Truckers Union. The Space Truckers Union was established to facilitate trade, hunt criminals who would attack traders and to seek out new trade opportunities. The STU are a group that freely offers aid to anyone that requires it. Their motto is, "We stand together and together we prosper.
system_43708_key: The home of the Dagr Crocodiles. Dagr Crocodiles make their home in this system. They are group of veteran Alliance operatives who have sought refuge from the bureaucracy of the Alioth system. Crocodiles value personal freedom above everything else, represented by the commodity types available in Crocodile operated markets which are often restricted elsewhere. Faction members generally have extensive combat experience and are known for sharing this knowledge with guests.
system_43725_key:
The home of The Lab ADM.
This minor faction is a small independent scientific group specializing in genetic research. The first laboratory was founded by Alvinia de Messalina in October 3304. The laboratory's financial sources come from mining operations.
system_44031_key: Sidhethe Uathne's Pilots' Trading Guild is a cooperative of independent traders and explorers who wish to reform the Empire. They value honesty, and seek to reform the Empire by working from within its borders.
system_4425_key: The Elite Republic Squad are a group of small independent pilots helping the underdogs.
system_4431_key:
The deep and highly mechanised Imperial mines are renowned for their efficiency at ore extraction. Slavery is also important for routine supervision of the machinery in the unpleasant mining environment.

The home of 51st Death Dealers, a privately owned and operated organisation dedicated to eradicating troublesome pilots throughout the galaxy.
system_44333_key: First reported incidents of the Cerberus Plague in June 3301.
system_44433_key: The 17th Federal Fleet was formed after it became necessary for the Federation to begin patrolling inhabited space. It is responsible for defending Federal assets across the galaxy, as well as performing precise military operations. Operations divisions range from homeland defence to black ops and surveillance. The 17th Federal Fleet is capable of rapidly deploying and sustaining forces anywhere in the galaxy, and stands ready to counter any threat to the Federation and its citizens.
system_444_key: The Edmundus Walsh Progeny Syndicate is a group of like minded pilots with a common lineage - Caedimus Noctu: "We slay by night".
system_44555_key: This is the home system of the Children of Raxxla - they are the self-proclaimed descendants of the inhabitants of Raxxla, a mythical planet spoken of only in whispers and in children's bedtime stories. The Children of Raxxla are truth seekers attempting to solve the mysteries of the universe and find their long-lost home.
system_44617_key: The home system for The Golden Armada - Protection to those behind us; respect to those beside us; no mercy to those against us!
system_44762_key:
The home of the Under 25ers.
The Under 25ers are a small, ragtag group specialising in far-reaches exploration and bounty recovery.
system_44768_key: Best known for the seal rescue cruiser.
system_45038_key: Based in the Caelottixa System, the Borinqueneers Alliance is a group of intergalactic pilots who were exiled from earth after a rather scandalous  incident with Zachary Hudson and his method of assuming power.
system_45094_key: Rich, high population agricultural and service economy (independent corporate state).
system_45102_key: The Federation Navy 322nd "Hellrazer" Expeditionary Force is deployed at the edge of known civilised space to provide safe harbour for Federation sponsored expeditions. Their mission is to bring order and stability to their sector, and so allow explorers safe passage between Federation space and "The Wild Black Yonder".
system_4511_key: Disillusioned with the superpowers, and driven to forge a new and free path, the Freelancers took 109 Piscium for their home. A band of leaderless mercenaries and killers for hire, the Freelancers were drawn to Ising dock for its production of the Fer-de-Lance; their favoured ship for hunting among the stars.
system_45242_key:
An obscure Federal mining system that was once known as CPD-46 8664.

The home of Aegean Pirates Inc, which was created by ancient seafaring families of the Old World.
system_45260_key:
The home of the Void Strays.
Void Strays began as a rabble of aimless mercenaries. Their desire to gain respect pushed them to take on perilous contracts. This reputation garnered a following of miners, blue-collar workers and interstellar traders. Today the faction has evolved into a full-fledged corporation which continues to guard its reputation and interests.
system_45291_key: Broken Filter Galactic Fleet consists of pirates and mercenaries whose primary interest is the value of a bounty or cargo manifest. Its only concern is payment, with little regard given for collateral damage in the pursuit of completing a job.
system_4529_key: The home of The Osiris Sentinels. A group of mercenaries believed to be controlled by a leader known only as 'The Watcher'. Taking their inspiration from the history of Earth, Sol, they are isolationists who focus on increasing influence their home system, by any means necessary.
system_45364_key: Also known as 23 Delta Ursae Minoris.
system_45578_key: A relatively lawless system with light extraction activity. It was once known as CI 20-1046.
system_45613_key:
The home of Osiris Interstellar.
Osiris Interstellar is an independent coalition of pilots that fly together under the protection of the Federation. Originating as a trade convoy in Bodedi, Osiris eventually relocated to Luyten's Star to aid Federation.
In 3304, after a failed Federally-backed conflict, the faction proclaimed its independence. Pilots who fly for Osiris are not restricted in their professions.
Osiris is known for its media influence and constant propaganda.
system_45716_key: The home of the Atlas Corporation, who use their wealth, along with ties to multiple law enforcement agencies and shady underground organisations, to spread their influence throughout the galaxy, making them a valuable ally and a powerful adversary.
system_45955_key: Colonial Corp was once contracted by the Federal government to administer the colonization and terraforming of planets. Their current goals are exploration and colonising  worlds outside human habited space.
system_45983_key: The home of the IRON LEGION. This faction is determined to defend those who are in need and destroy any who prey on others. They also operate to bring supplies and order to places that require aid.
system_46204_key:
This system is home to The Gathering - a society focused on the creation and modification of technology. Members of The Gathering are known for the unique, and sometimes dangerous, "tweaks" they add to their ships and, in some cases, to the ships of unsuspecting commanders who happen to dock in one of their shipyards.

An unconfirmed rumour tells of an incident when the Emperor had his ship serviced and later found, in battle, that one of his cannons had been replaced with fireworks and boomboxes (which don't work in space). The local government naturally denied all charges, but as a gesture of good will offered the Emperor upgraded shields that also had the ability to heat the coffee cup holders when the ship was being fired upon. The Emperor graciously declined.
system_4638_key: Claiming ancestry dating back to the ancient Mongolian territory of Earth, the Warlords of Tengri are ambitious folk. Having fled their original home due to their part in a failed military coup, members have recently settled in Tengri. The faction now seeks to establish itself across the galaxy through war, dominant trade and deep-space exploration.
system_46404_key: The Vortex Continuum are guns for hire, pirates, mercenaries, bounty hunters and vigilantes. They support any cause, power or faction that offers profit and blood.
system_46471_key: At the edge of occupied space, when you feel nowhere is safe from the scum that lurk in the dark corners, turn to Pauline for a safe passage into the occupied zone.
system_46519_key:
ENOSIS was originally established in 3301 as a collective to bring together the disenfranchised working class across the galaxy. It has now selected the Sinistra system as a proposed home for all who wish to see power in the hands of the proletariat, utilising local natural resources for the betterment of humanity.

Also known as 64 Nu Ophiuchi.
system_46908_key:
This system was once famous for supporting the liberation of slaves.

The home of Z Team.
The Z Team were formed by pilots dedicated to combat. Potential members cannot simply ask to join the Z Team; instead, the faction will select members who meet specific criteria.
system_47238_key:
The home of The Black Legions.
The Black Legions, a military team independent of any system, were formed to thrive in a galaxy where conflict is not hard to find.
system_47321_key: Born out of the need to share peace and equality, the Nova Crows Republic aims to offer a safe haven for anyone in need.
system_47704_key: A peaceful pastoral commune once known as 22 Lambda Sagittarii.
system_4784_key: The home of the Elite Cutter Society. The Elite Cutter Society was founded by veteran pilots of one of the galaxy's most renowned combat vessels. The power and influence of these few and proud Commanders eventually led to the formation of their own faction. Viewed by some as elitist, by others as inspiring, the Society aims to expand both influence and minds across the galaxy.
system_47876_key: Established in 3300, the Vanguardians have pledged to help defend the Federation from any potential threats. The faction has established a base of operations in the Trella system.
system_48081_key: Survey report: System devoid of life and interest. Don't waste your time coming here, there's nothing to see. - Cmdr Bill Weyson, Dec 3299.
system_48140_key:
The home of the Order of the Black Sun.
The Order of the Black Sun holds no allegiance to any galactic power, believing them to be corrupt. This organisation is committed to preserving and protecting mankind by any means necessary, from whomever or whatever may threaten it.
The Order’s pilots stem from all walks of life drawn to a common cause.
Its motto is, 'Hope gathers beneath a blackened sun.'
system_48241_key: The Crimson Mercenary Dragoons are a centuries-old band of soldiers-for-hire and adventurers based out of Ross 720.
system_48289_key: The home of Zephyr Nation, an anti-pirate faction started by Flip Mendez.
system_48361_key:
The home system for Fretensis Patronage. Commanded by Lucius Octavius, formally known as Fortis et Umbra and rumoured to be of the same bloodline as Julius Caesar, this faction pledges allegiance to Senator Denton Patreus. Its ruthless members show no hesitation in using lethal force against anyone deemed a threat to Senator Patreus or the Empire. With no plans to become a major power, Octavius uses his personal navy, SPQR, to carry out operations of expansion, conquest and sabotage.

An attack on the Emperor was traced to a branch of Emperor's Grace based in the system in April 3301.
system_4847_key: LPV Corporation is an independent guild of pilots excluded from active service due to age limitations, but who want to continue their activity. LPV promote colonisation and expansion and space travel research.
system_48571_key: The home of the Arche Corporation. Arche Corporation formed as a sub-faction of a project known as SEED. This group aims to preserve the sustainability of the human species against any xeno threats, by various means; diplomacy, sciences, trading and, if necessary, war.
system_48577_key: With a headquarters in the Neto system, the PBSF has struggled for years to free the skies of criminal scum and to help every citizen, new or old. Led by the secretive Captain 'Cap' Anaidni, the PBSF is a force free from corruption and with a noble cause.
system_48628_key: Outdoor ice and water world. Tourism and fishing.
system_4894_key: High King Mojo's Techno Union is a monarchical conglomerate of the previously feudal autonomous states of HIP 8865. High King Mojo was one of the many feudal lords who were in control, before he graciously liberated the other states and united them under one flag.
system_49029_key: The Brotherhood of the Dragon is a group of pilots involved in a wide range of activities, such as mining, exploring and bounty hunting.
system_49101_key: The home of White Star Foundation, which has devoted itself to the alleviation of human suffering. No matter how dangerous the situation, WSF pilots will bring food, medicines, and aid workers to those most in need throughout the galaxy.
system_49104_key: The Canary Mining Corporation is the galaxy's leading expert in the extraction of rare minerals from hostile or isolated systems. The CMC was formed when Wollaston Co., de Ulloa Mining Corp. and ACDP Mineral Surveying we're jointly awarded a contract to source and extract minerals for the Federal Navy. As such, the Federal Navy 44th Escort Group is permanently assigned to CMC HQ to provide security for their mining operations.
system_49173_key:
The home of Space Bomb.
An elite group that specialises in technology and exploration. It enjoyed a strong connection with the Federation. Members have pledged to ensure the future of humanity in the galaxy.
system_49218_key: Miltech Industries are designers and manufacturers of some of the best military and heavy industrial equipment. And all at great value!
system_49249_key: Yung Teem Space Commune is a group united to form an egalitarian and humanitarian community for the people of the region.
system_49323_key: A relatively small system which supports a modest population and industrial economy. There is a world known to support water based life here, but it is unsuitable for human habitation.
system_49432_key: Also known as Alpha Coronae Austrinae.
system_4962_key:
The deep and highly mechanised Imperial mines are renowned for their efficiency at ore extraction. Slavery is also important for routine supervision of the machinery in the unpleasant mining environment.

The home of the People's Republic of Posse, which provides space logistical services. Members of People's Republic of Posse run their faction with simple ethical principles - treat others as you want to be treated by yourself.
system_49750_key: The Obsidian Hearts are travellers, merchants and bounty hunters.
system_49919_key:
An unremarkable star system that tends to get congested around Slough during peak holiday season, owing to the bureaucratic nature with which transfers are handled from the Slough Orbital Space Station to the luxury resorts on board the Slough Observer.

The home system for the Hammers of Slough.
system_49974_key: As survivors of the destruction of the once great port, "Celestial Gateway", they have banded together and vowed to fight the forces of Edmund Mahon. Until their dying breath, they will seek vengeance for the death of their loved ones by the Alliance Navy mission gone awry in 3235.
system_4997_key:
This small high tech system is building a name for itself in innovation from corporations like Evans Computation Co-operative.

'We're there when life is shaped like a pear.'

The home of the Black Aurora Corporation, which is dedicated to promoting interstellar economic development across human space. From its beginnings as a small research and investment firm, Black Aurora has grown into a government enterprise with interstellar market reach. Black Aurora guarantees its citizens the highest living standards and the freedom to pursue a healthy, happy life.
system_50026_key:
The home of Niander Technologies.
Niander Technologies was founded in the year 3305 as a corporation focused on fulfilling agricultural needs on terraformed planets. It has since taken an interest in advanced electronics and weaponry, along with synthetic drugs. 
The faction does not accept the laws of the superpowers as the laws of the galaxy itself.
system_50130_key: The Federal Republican Guard handles logistical and combat duties, swearing loyalty to the President of the Federation and operating under the orders of the Federal Republican Command. Its primary responsibility is to ensure the security, safety and expansion of the Federation across the galaxy.
system_50391_key: Small scale refinery operations can be found in this low populated system.
system_50393_key: Derrim Brown Party began as two former Imperial slaves who escaped from their owner and found their way to the Derrim system in a stolen Cobra Mk III. After a few weeks of keeping a low profile they decided to join the Federation in the fight against the Empire. They set up a minor political faction as a base of operations.
system_50552_key: The Forge was founded by a group of commanders who set out to execute secret missions in the black. Led by the Council of Founders, it is a neutral and sovereign establishment acting as a hub for exploration, science and knowledge, as well as diplomatic missions.
system_50600_key: Knights of Fortuitus are a peaceful faction aimed at exploration.
system_50908_key: The home of STAR Confederation, an alliance of independent systems united against the oppression of the superpowers.
system_51117_key: The home of NOVA Ascendancy, a rich sovereign polity focused on inventing new technologies, exploration, the protection of humanity from alien threats and improving people's lives. The Research Institute of Xenobiology and Alien Technology, SAC Exploration Academy and many other educational and scientific establishments are located in the capital system of NOVA.
system_51309_key: A young and rapidly growing Federal colony at the forefront of technological development. Was once known as Omega Sagittarii.
system_5137_key: Gyton's Hope was one of the first offworld colonies to be established, and has since become a producer of high tech goods, from fusion reactors and atmospheric processors to heavy weapons and shields.
system_51619_key:
The cure for the Volungu Blight was discovered here in February 3301.

The Independent Thargoid Initiative Task Force was founded in 3302 after the discovery of a crashed alien ship in the Pleiades Nebula. Perceiving imminent Thargoid contact and realizing the possibility of a direct threat to human-controlled space, the group was founded to study, document, and ultimately defend against any Thargoid incursion. The Task Force has sworn to defend humankind at all costs, and each pilot is willing to sacrifice their ships, fortunes, and lives to keep humanity safe.
system_51670_key: The home of United Federation Defense Force, or UFDF, a faction dedicated to bringing mutual respect and Federal values to the galaxy. They help pilots aligned with the Federation gain rank, money and power, and are available to hire for defence-orientated missions and escorts.
system_5167_key:
A wealthy Imperial service system popular with media corporations like DK and Son Holographics.

'Always show your best side.'
system_51854_key: The home of Neo Guard Corp, which aims to smash the Empire and take all its territories for the Federation.
system_51860_key: The Last Order of Simbad are bound to protect the system and its civilians from bandits and criminals. They are the last order standing in this system.
system_51881_key: Only just sustaining life, the indigenous life forms on this arid planet are very hardy.
system_51956_key: The Intergalactic Fighter Ferret Force is dedicated to keeping the peace, strengthening defence and security, and growing new friendships. Their promise is to try to keep pilots safe by defending them against pirates, Thargoids or any other threat.
system_5195_key:
Between March and April 3301 there was conflict between the system and the forces of Imperial senator Denton Patreus.

The home of the Darkwater Authority. In late in 3303, Darkwater Inc suffered a leadership crisis, opening the way for a takeover by local Imperial Patrons. After rebranding themselves the Darkwater Authority, the leading patrons of the organisation now wield significant political, economic and military influence in the sector. They use this power to gain more clients, securing the resources needed to maintain their fleet and bringing the sector under the control of a single unified Imperial government.
system_51960_key: The Knights of the Void hold honour, loyalty and brotherhood as its highest values. Knights representing this faction are expected to champion these ideals at all times. Those who would oppose these soldiers of darkness will find no quarter given.
system_52078_key: The home of the Wolfpack Initiative. The Wolfpack Initiative believe that they deserve to be heard, either through diplomacy or by force. They have stated clearly that, through their actions, they will be heard.
system_52133_key: The home of DeathLaw, who were originally a group of fighter pilots who defended Achenar against the Federation fleet.
system_52321_key: The home of the Crimson Coalition, a group that is primarily focused on establishing local trading policies and security initiatives.
system_52655_key:
The home of the Grey Squadron. A group of Mercenaries that will complete missions including bounty hunting, assassination, protection details and interstellar trade. 
This faction began as a response to the lack of security response in systems where pirates and murderers are known to lurk in wait for innocent traders and passenger craft. Grey Squadron stands to fight for those who can't.
system_52713_key: The Federal Frontier PMC Initiative is a collection of pilots-for-hire. They are not aligned to any superpower, contrary to their faction name, but instead put the citizens of their home first and foremost. All of the faction's leaders follow the same code of values: honour, respect and integrity.
system_52949_key: The home of Italian Federals, a faction aligned with the Federation.
system_5296_key: The Darkmoon Order defends the weak against pirate attacks, actively searching out pilots to deliver justice across the galaxy. They are also dedicated to defending the human race against any hostile extra terrestrial threat.
system_53071_key: Terralight Industries was founded as a research and development corporation. It grew to become a corporate powerhouse through its contracts with the Intergalactic Naval Research Arm, developing terraforming technology. TerraLight expanded its services to include transport, exploration and security operations. TerraLight prefers to do business with the Federation, using its wealth to gain corporate advantage.
system_53144_key: The Praetorian Curate Assembly is a conglomerate of lords and shareholders who control their sector with a large portfolio of assets. It is structured through a stratified, neo-feudal system with Duke Alden Rowe at its head.
system_53254_key: The home of the 29th Colonial Armed Forces. The 29th Colonial Armed Forces is an independently owned corporate conglomerate of highly skilled and capable pilots. It is spearheaded by an elite fighting force, the 29th Colonial Fleet, and works with other like minded factions toward wealth, security, and in the overall defence of human colonies. Its mission statement includes the expectation that it will maintain human liberty, and protect corporate interests.
system_53360_key:
The home of the Omega Cooperative.
The Omega Cooperative is a small group of independent pilots dedicated to science in deep space, and counter-attacking the seemingly ever-escalating threats in the black.
system_5337_key: Elite Space Wings are explorers and merchants, not soldiers, but we do not hesitate to take up arms when it is necessary. They defend freedom and justice, and we do not believe that people should stand tall and proud on the backs of slaves.
system_53768_key: The home system for the Dirty Gun Mercenaries, whose motto is - "Killing is our business and business is good."
system_53859_key: This system is locked by the Pilots' Federation, no permits are currently issued.
system_5387_key:
Lucan Onionhead, a new strain of Onionhead, grown in the Tanmark system for the first time in January 3301.

In March 3301 growth of Onionhead resumes, illegally, on Panem.
system_53898_key: The home of Evictus for Xihe Freedom, a faction formed to unite combat pilots willing to fight piracy in Xihe and surrounding systems, and to provide safe havens for miners and traders alike.
system_53899_key: Betrayed by the Empire and exiled from their homeworld, the Diamond Frogs have wholly rejected the superpowers and now operate as a private military force, offering their services to whomever needs them, wherever they are, regardless of their allegiance or ideology. Based somewhere in the lawless fringes of the Capricorni sector, the Frogs believe that no pilot should live or die at the whim of a government, and welcome soldiers of fortune who share their vision of a galaxy without borders.
system_53925_key: The home of Space Lions, an altruistic group who lend a helpful hand to new (and not-so-new) commanders, by teaching evasive manoeuvres and self-defence, and enjoying some cold beverages together after a hard working day.
system_54019_key:
The home of the Midnight Sun Defense Corp.
The Midnight Sun Defense Corp. is a group of pilots who operate in Federal territory as guns for hire. Primarily founded by bounty hunters, the group now handles personal security and mercenary work for factions aligned with the Federation.
system_54048_key: Meaning 'stone' in Greek, Petra was the ancient capital city of Nabataeans.
system_54274_key: This scarcely populated system is focused on extraction and refinery operations. Apart from mining and refining there's little to recommend this system to a traveller. Even the bars are dull.
system_5441_key:
This system is home to Houlden Harmonics who are famed throughout the Federation for the quality of their natural form musical instruments.

'For that authentic sound.'

The home of the Pilots Ascension Program, which was created by a small group of pilots in early 3303 as a result of increased dangers throughout the galaxy. To combat these dangers, several highly skilled pilots began teaching others in the hope of finding a way to illuminate the dark void of space.
system_54454_key: Youbee Dominion,  founded in 3202, specialises in the development of programmed intelligence. The faction seeks to establish a resource base and conduct further research in its chosen field.
system_5476_key:
A harshly ruled system whose cheap labour benefits the mega-corporations based there. This includes Devin Armour Specialists, a growing supplier of armour and defensive technologies.

'When a ship isn't tough enough.'
system_54838_key: This binary system is a key supplier of food for this region of the Empire. It also possesses considerable mineral wealth scattered between its many planets. The infamous Red Flag pirate gang operated here until they were wiped out by Imperial forces over a decade ago.
system_54898_key: The Space Poultry are based in this system. They are a corporation run by local mercenaries looking to weed out criminal activity and create diverse employment opportunities.
system_54912_key: The Burn Hill Syndicate is a small group of hardened mercenaries and pirates who live without rules.
system_54933_key: This system is home to The Kuun-Lan. They are a collection of local leaders united in order to maintain independence from the three superpowers. Their combined strength under the rule of a single leader makes them a powerful force in the region.
system_55064_key: The Crimson Flag is an infamous criminal syndicate that consists mostly of pirates, smugglers and mercenaries. The group was recently brought back into power when a few high ranking members of the group decided to establish a permanent foothold in their system.
system_55110_key: The home of the Tyr's Justice. Tyr's Justice seek to ensure that the governance of the Tyr System reflects the spirit of its ancient mythological namesake. The faction is dedicated to the principles of the Federation and equal justice under the law; Tyr's law.
system_55186_key: The home of the nWo Corp. The No Will-less Obedience Corporation is geared toward the transport of goods and people. The corporation's founder, an ex-slave, established their focus on the abolishment of slavery. To this end the nWo Corp hunt those pirates seeking a profit from slavery, willing to offer gained bounties to realise their dream of slavery being outlawed across the galaxy.
system_55261_key:
Veloxi's Vixens are dedicated, above all, to space.

Sometimes described as pilots with jobs, the Vixens are a league of starship pilots who share a common interest in spaceflight as an end in itself.

Believing that humanity's future will be found among the stars, they work to build a common platform to support pilots, space-based industry and exploration. In service to their mandate, they fight to clean the space lanes of plundering marauders. The stations they operate are well known as safe havens for all those rambling pilots who dare to venture into the black.
system_55296_key: The VX9 Defense Corp aligns with the directive of Zachary Hudson, in an ongoing effort to support, supply and expand his power outside of Federal space, and providing security within currently controlled space.
system_5530_key: The home of The Fenris Syndicate. A group known to disregard any laws outside of those it has laid down to govern its members' behaviour. They fly largely for profit and thrill, loyal to the ideas of camaraderie and independence. The Fenris Syndicate are skilled in taking calculated risks for worthwhile rewards in pursuit of both shared and individual goals.
system_55310_key: The home of the Open Space Alliance. The Open Space Alliance have recently settled within the Erio system, after being forced out of their former home system by a rival faction. They faction believed that the system left behind had all the resources, amenities and community they would ever need, and now seek to replicate such comfort in their newly chosen home.
system_55610_key: In this system is located Next Mind Technology (NMT), founded in 3300 by scientists Lenard Eridani and Dmitry Zhebin. After the discovery of new advancements in the field of computer software, the company developed rapidly and soon evolved into a corporation. Currently, the company focus is the development and installation of intelligent software for application in a variety of systems for both ships and stations.
system_55653_key: The home of the Merry Band of Awesome, a freelancer pilot outfit with the goal of bringing stability and unity to the galaxy.
system_55707_key: The home of THE SERENICS, a faction loyal to Archon Delaine.
system_55714_key: A group of pilots renowned for their altruistic, cooperative and innovative response to galaxy-wide calls for assistance. They first came to prominence when responding to the Cerberus Plague outbreak of 3301. Inspired by their success, they settled in the Teaka system, where they found support from the local population. The galaxy remains a dangerous place, but together they help protect the weak, spread harmony, fun and cooperation. And distribute tea.
system_55818_key: Lagrange Interstellar originated as a small mineral extraction colony on 11 Cephei A 2 B. Since then it has grown significantly and seen itself become a major influence in the 11 Cephei business world. After securing recognition, Lagrange Interstellar now seeks to become an influence in the 11 Cephei independent government. Its right arm and security contractor is the subsidiary corporation Lagrange Risk Management. This group protects and secures Lagrange Interstellar assets.
system_55834_key: This quaternary system contains a number of interests, enjoying the profits of the combined refinery and high tech economy. While most of them are legitimate there is at least one known criminal organisation in the system.
system_5593_key: The Empire Corsairs are based in this system and gather all the untitled or banished aristocrats, lone wolves, sociopaths, alcoholics and drug addicts. All the pariahs and marginals that the Imperial Fleet will not accept among its ranks. In exchange for amnesty, they are allowed to conduct a shadow war against the enemies of the Empire and keep all the profits.
system_56133_key:
The Brethren of the Black, a loose coalition of pirates and privateers, are known to be active in this system. Many of the original syndicate were privateers aligned against the Empire. It has since been joined by pirates from various enclaves.

The Brethren are known to be governed by codes of conduct that favour equitable division of revenue. These codes protect the individual rights of its members to defend their freedom as necessary.
system_56162_key: The home of the Balion Imperial Marque. A band of mercenaries, licensed to act under the authority of the Empire.
system_56299_key: A bleak system, playing host to an extreme religious group known as the 'Brotherhood of Resonance'. This group colonised the system during the late 3100s and little is known of their beliefs other than extreme xenophobia. The system is off-limits and requires a permit to access.
system_56368_key: This system is destined for big things with one habitable world already supporting an agricultural economy and with a second in the process of being terraformed. Although the system is a well established Imperial holding there is a significant criminal underworld working to profit from the system's future.
system_56451_key:
The home of Cygnull Interactive.
Cygnull Interactive formed in 3304 following the death of CMDR Cygnull, continuing his legacy to make credits by any legal means. They also run a fully-funded program for hand-picked up and coming pilots
system_56466_key: Black Shadows is a small group of traders and explorers inspired by the shared principles of personal freedom, equality and fundamental rights. Members work to ensure the well-being of all inhabitants of the faction’s territory.
system_56624_key: The home of the Equestrian Naval Fleet. Comprised of pilots roaming the Pegasi Constellation Cluster, with a base of operations within V374 Pegasi, The Equestrian Naval Fleet serves as a for-hire and rapid response mercenary fleet. Small in number, but precise in action, the ENF is known for their rapid deployment and fervent devotion to seeing a job through, regarding retreat as cowardly. While their primary focus is combat, they do offer mercantile aid, as well as the occasional deep space reconnaissance mission out into the farther reaches of uninhabited space.
system_5668_key:
Gayan Melodies are known for their intricate musical creations and they are just one of many developments in this growing Imperial service system.

'Music tailored for your needs.'

The home of the Bounty Hunters' Guild, authorised under Federation, Imperial and Alliance Justice Courts to pursue those that have broken the rule of law and have become a danger to society. The guild is subdivided into components that focus on particular skill sets and targeting specialities. To regulate the organisation, a Bounty Hunters' Creed dictates policy among its ranks and keeps hunters from such diverse backgrounds in line and on task.
system_56706_key: Two planets in this system have now been terraformed, and both are largely given over to agricultural production and to ethically questionable cattle ranching. There is little manufacturing industry other than the production of the famous bourbon.
system_56818_key: The Pleiades Concordat is a theocracy formed from the merger of a political party and the Apocalyptican faith movement. The Pleiades Concordat was signed in 3302 by Primus Timothy Dalen and the leaders of the faith. Since that momentous event, the Pleiades Concordat developed a strong expansionist mentality.
system_56893_key: The Tenshii Sect is a religious organisation born out of desperation and poverty, which believes in a goddess who will bring prosperity and salvation. The highest leader of the sect is usually a former slave who has passed various rituals.
system_56994_key: The Winged Hussars are based in this system. They are a cooperative group of loosely connected pilots, all hailing from different parts of the galaxy and flying under different banners. Their roots dig deep into history, almost 1,800 years ago - to the tradition of heavy armoured assault units fielded in the pre-space era by Earth's ancient nation of Poland. Pilots joining this faction declare that they want to capture the spirit of all-out bravery and unparalleled courage, and the efficiency of these ancient warriors from times long gone.
system_5699_key:
A large Imperial agricultural system whose immense output is governed by Downing Agriculture. They also have extensive operations in other Imperial systems.

'The finest food for your table.'

A recent acquisition of the Sirius Corporation, A Industries is noted for its use of Federation style commerce and trading techniques unusual to Imperial companies.
system_5701_key:
Ship owners looking to maximise their drive performance flock to Drive Performance Specialists (DPS) who are based in this system.

'For the ultimate performance.'
system_57105_key: Founded in 3293, the Zarni Cartel does not pay allegiance to any of the known superpowers or governments. Under their wise leader, Zarniwoob, the Zarni Cartel is dedicated to finding the true ruler of the galaxy. Some rumours suggest that Zarniwoob wants to become that true ruler himself.
system_57210_key: The Tethys Empire Crew is a corporation involved in tourism and industry. They are also try to expand their influence to other systems to create new business opportunities for their investors.
system_5722_key: Very high humidity and native life make this an interesting place to visit. Many exotic food stuffs are grown here. The scenery is strikingly beautiful, though the wildlife can be a little dangerous.
system_57277_key: This relatively quiet industrial system has a minor claim to fame for the home grown band - The Great Jiggles. They had a one hit wonder with their song 'Shaking, Shaking, Shaking' which won the Achilles Entertainment song of the year 3299.
system_57367_key:
LURP Ship Systems is based in this system.

'Our range is everywhere.'

The home of ODIN Agency, a pro-Imperial company focusing on smuggling and trade.
system_5748_key: The home of Verne Partners LLP, an Imperial corporate troubleshooting consultancy, rumoured to have several lucrative, but highly classified, contracts with the Imperial Senate.
system_57504_key: The Eureka Mining Co-Operative is made up of descendants of the Imperial Tantalite mining slaves. Their ancestors were some of the only survivors who fled the Prism system after they decided to break away from Imperial bondage and go into hiding, hoping one day that their progeny might find peace and prosperity.
system_57669_key:
The "DaVinci Corporation" is an organisation of brave and independent pilots trying to leave its mark on the Galaxy through combat, exploration and commerce.

A community that has grown over time, striving to carve out a place within the boundless galaxy.

Per Aspera Ad Astra!
system_57675_key: A busy independent system with a variety of stations and starports. Ferenchia is the most important trading hub in the sector and serves as a supply point for most of the systems in the region. It guards its independence fiercely, resisting influence from both the Federation and the Empire. The result is an eclectic mix of trading opportunities, not all of them legal.
system_57710_key: Conflict between the system and the forces of Imperial senator Denton Patreus from December 3300 to January 3301.
