system_57769_key: The home of Crossbone Vanguard, who are primarily focused bounty hunting and piracy, though they also have wings dedicated to trade and exploration.
system_58129_key: A well connected system that benefits from passing traffic as well as its indigenous high tech and refinery facilities. Although it is a firmly established Imperial system a small democratic movement is known to operate here.
system_58219_key:
Chione was a pleasant pastoral moon until the Prism system was seized by the Loren 'Lineage' (an Imperial family distantly related to the ruling Duval Dynasty) in 3297. The system remains unstable at this time and traders are advised to proceed with caution.

Loren's Legion was commissioned by Ambassador Cuthrick Delaney, administrator of Prism, to serve as an extension of the Prism defence force. Its charter lends flexibility to more offensive operations throughout the region. Loren's Legion sharply contends with enemies of the Empire in the vicinity of Prism and serves as a bulwark against incursion into Imperial territory.
system_58224_key: Starblazers are a group of traders strongly committed to freedom and taking a stand against piracy.
system_5827_key: The home of the Legion of Prometheus,'The Legion of Prometheus' was founded in this system. The faction members are mostly dedicated explorers, bounty hunters, traders and foremost friends, who like to share a few bottles of Eranin Pearl Whisky after days, weeks or even months in space. They long to set out across the stars together to contribute to major discoveries and expeditions, with a focus on finding Earth-like worlds, lost generation ships, undiscovered alien objects and other wonders and mysteries of the Milky Way
system_58325_key: Izumo Heavy Industries Ltd originated as a warship manufacturer. Members of this faction are composed of naval sailors and expert engineers.
system_58337_key: Funded by Nikko Inkari, Cypheroptics Inc is an underground augmentation facility, built atop a club named "The Neon District". It deals in loaned out augments and implants, and is funded by a popular nightclub and its cybernetic engineers.
system_58611_key:
The home of the Neo Roman Republic.
This faction vows to uphold law and order - as well as help the Federation - anywhere it can.
system_58780_key: The Void Society is a consortium of bounty hunters.
system_58886_key: The Wireworld Crew support the Federation and remember the good times.
system_58953_key: The home of the Friends of Gravity. The Friends of Gravity have no specific stated goals, no expectations and no duties. Their primary objective is to have an open forum where players can experience adventures on a respectful, friendly and equal level to each other. All members generally share the same interests of exploring the galaxy, trading and defending each other.
system_58979_key: The RILAF, or Reserve Imperial Logistics Auxilary Fleet, is made up of Imperial reservists that have been called up due to the increased tension between the Empire and the Federation. While subject to the Imperial Fleet chain of command, the RILAF enjoys a level of autonomy that many Imperial units do not possess. The RILAF's duties include support of Imperial fleets in nearby sectors, support of loyal Imperial systems, minor policing roles, and so freeing up forces that can be utilised in the main Imperial fleets.
system_58993_key: The home of Bone Beards Cartel, sizable group of criminals, retired mercenaries and anarchists working towards a unified goal of chaos.
system_59069_key: Vast areas are used for growing custom grain crops in enormous quantities which are then exported to surrounding worlds. No manufacturing industry is permitted, to avoid any polluting emissions. Once known as 24 Alpha Piscis Austrini.
system_59209_key: The home of King Gorgoth's Monarchy, a loyal kingdom of the Empire.
system_59312_key: The home of the Astra Militarum of Beta Sculptoris. This rag-tag bunch of warriors remain loyal to a once a prominent faction, shattered by a disastrous military conflict. The remaining pilots now specialise in bounty hunting contracts for any willing to pay. Those individuals with outstanding warrants would likely find space controlled by this faction dangerous to linger in.
system_59390_key: The Funky Purple Wizards combine their extensive knowledge of engineering along with working as hired guns and mercenaries.
system_59422_key: The home of United Lalande Smuggling Empire, which was formed in response to the economic stranglehold imposed by Lalande 45165's communist regime. This faction supports systems who wish to trade, free of government interference.
system_59454_key: The Quam Singulari have built their own philosophy around the fusion of science, commerce, technology and military advancement. They hold the utmost respect for their allies, but deal mercilessly with their enemies.
system_59645_key:
This system is most famous for the giant Verrix. Stevenson is the home world of this hardy beast of burden now found throughout human space, especially on the emerging worlds of the outer rim.

Home system for The Sovereign Justice Collective:

The Sovereign Justice Collective is an independent, self-governing group whose primary function is to maintain peace and order. Advocates for the law, the collective also ensures the adherence to the rules and regulations set forth by the interstellar law. Holding status of forces Agreements with the Alliance, Empire and Federation, members of this faction are able to enforce interstellar law throughout inhabited space with impunity.
system_59648_key:
The home of the Fists of Andromedae.
The Fists of Andromedae exists primarily to protect its members from those that would wish them harm. While the details of its origin have long since been lost, the Fists of Andromedae have pledged to make its mark upon the Galaxy.
system_59723_key:
The home of the Naval Service Agency. The Naval Service Agency aim to keep their space a peaceful zone.  From fierce warriors to abstract thinkers, they seek to meet this objective. These brotherhood companions are quick to meet any challenges that confront them during their travels in the dark veil of space. 
This faction fulfils a wide variety of operations, from convoy security and passenger hauling, to exploration and fuel rescue missions.
system_5982_key:
The home of The Imperial Cavalry.
The Imperial Cavalry calls this system home.
Demanding absolute loyalty to their initiative, its members dismiss the goals of others in favour of company orders.
system_5990_key: The Turkish Elite Force are based here.
system_59930_key: Money or Blood was founded by some of the most fearsome pirates in the galaxy.
system_5999_key:
The home of War Hawks Initiative.
Whether the contract involves trading, bounty hunting or combating xeno craft, you will find a War Hawk willing to fly – or crash - to the best of his ability.
system_6000_key: All StarS is a militant religious group following a fundamentalist doctrine. Their belief in the rebirth of a stronger human society often results in extreme acts against non-believers, and they've been widely criticised by many - so much so that their religion is officially considered a serious threat to peace.
system_60045_key:
The home of the Utopian Workers Party (UWP).
The home system of the Utopian Workers Party (UWP). Formed in 3304 to provide support and protection for agricultural and industrial workers within Utopia, the UWP support free trade and the protection of important shipping lanes and industrial centres.
UWP Enforcers have threatened paramilitary action against pirates and operatives attempting to exert pressure on Utopian ideals.
system_60107_key: Lunokhod Conglomerate is a corporate faction that specialises in passenger missions and courier missions.
system_6016_key:
The March of the Council of Nobles is based on a feudal system whose lords only report to their overlords. The March levies no taxes, but each lord has a duty of military reinforcement and troop provision. Its economy is based on slavery and export trade. Aligned with the Empire, members are often directed to support Imperial operations.

The deep and highly mechanised Imperial mines are renowned for their efficiency at ore extraction. Slavery is also important for routine supervision of the machinery in the unpleasant mining environment.
system_60204_key: The home of the Mafia of Dread, pirates living out of the system Dread in Archon Delaine Territory.
system_60460_key: The Broke Gear Gang is a group of pilots dedicated to combat. They fight to test and better themselves, and take on all challengers.
system_60584_key: Home system of the Bright Star Dominion - once an Imperially-aligned organisation that declared itself independent as the contract between it and the Empire expired. Soon after declaring independence this organisation became an administrative entity of the Interstellar Autarchy, ruled by sovereign Coriolanus Marr, who can rightfully be called the most mysterious person in the galactic political arena. Their loyalty to the Sovereign is unshakable and they will obey his every command.
system_60626_key: The home of the Windwolves. The Windwolves are a mercenary group founded in Wolf 1039. They travel from war to war and provide bounty hunting services. Though their primary focus is combat, they do operate a delivery service to contested systems and will provide bodyguards on request.
system_60692_key:
The home of Ancient Astronauts.
An influential organisation that combines military power and advanced scientific achievements.
Their motto is, 'Embrace the unknown.'
system_6071_key:
The White Templars are based in this system. They come from an ancient order who are the defenders of the innocent and upholders of justice.

Pledged to Arissa Lavigny-Duval, they are supporters of the Empire. They are devoted to helping mankind progress to a higher level and promoting stability throughout all of the systems across human space.
system_60785_key:
Forrester's Technical Services is one of the driving forces behind this system's recent growth.

'You break it. We fix it.'
system_60786_key: Nueva Castilla was founded by descendants of Lopez de Villalobos at the dawn of the colonisation of the star cluster. Nowadays this faction is dedicated to the mining and trade of mineral resources obtained in the system.
system_6084_key: The Zarni Cartel does not pay allegiance to any of the known superpowers or governments. Under their wise leader, Zarniwoob, the Zarni Cartel is dedicated to finding the true ruler of the galaxy. Some rumours suggest that Zarniwoob wants to become that true ruler himself.
system_61198_key:
The Kekenk Bay Company has only had one goal in its entire history: acquisition and profit. Formerly based in Kekenk, the KBC was driven out following a period of poor financial performance. Company leadership elected to relocate to HIP 117391 after deeming its former home no longer profitable. Since this transition, the corporation has been known to capitalise on any profitable opportunity presented to it. 

The KBC has kept itself firmly independent, with members voting against alignment with any of the superpowers.
system_6123_key:
The home of The Vengeful.
The Vengeful are specialist bounty hunters who incorporate anti-xeno work. It is comprised of loyal members of the Federal navy who remain on standby. While seen as a law-abiding faction, it is solitary and territorial. Aggressive ships acting within HR 692 are often hunted down and destroyed. Traders and explorers should expect a safe passage in this faction’s territory.
system_61244_key: The home of the OrioN Navy. A small faction specialising in bounty hunting and mercenary work during system conflicts. Members work to help each other wherever possible, without imposing on time or resources. They welcome pilots from all walks of life, seeking adventure in the galaxy.
system_61252_key:
Off World Corp were formed from an exploration and colonisation corporation out of Sol who originally used androids for deep space exploration and resource location until their intelligence exceeded their makers' and they mutinied killing their human co-workers. They were last seen heading for Earth.

The Corp now operates out of the Laka system in Empire space still with the same goals as before, whilst hunting down any trespassing androids.
system_61457_key: Senator Denton Patreus favours this system with his patronage.
system_61546_key: Imperial Nagas have benefitted greatly from their association with Senator Zenima Torval, whose continued patronage has helped expand their influence well beyond the borders of their system.
system_61596_key: The home of Cromwell Logistics, a large corporation providing a variety of logistics-based services. It consists of several subsidiaries, involved in mining extraction and refinery, data and intelligence delivery, and movement of cargo and human goods, as well as a private security force to protect the company's and its customer's assets.
system_61609_key:
This system enjoys the patronage of Senator Zemina Torval.

The home of The Great Space Legion, a group dedicated to protecting the space around LTT 9810.
system_61632_key: The system was settled by disorganised hermits and pioneers in 3250s, until the Federation corporation Lycan Moon Mining moved in during the 3260s to start operations in the asteroid belt. After the corporation pulled out of the system soon afterwards, a small Federal orbital station and settlement was left behind. Around the year 3290 the system was finally abandoned by the Federation and has since suffered under various short-lived regimes.
system_61639_key: The home of the Elite Dragons, a collection of commanders who fled the Sol System and defected to the Empire.
system_61657_key: The home system for the Guardians of Harmony. They are a commune of technocrats, explorers and adventurers.
system_61926_key: Welcome to The Federation Of Ravenwood, we protect and serve the members of the Federation - Imperials are no so fortunate!
system_61949_key: Sorrows Battalion is a Federally-aligned hit-and-run squad designed to do the Federation's dirty work. They value their missions, and each other, above all else.
system_61977_key:
The home of KTO Interstellar Conglomerate.
After moving from Altair to Imperial territory, the KTOIC has organised a catch-all operation of bounty hunting, trade and exploration driven by a single incentive: credits.
system_62036_key: The Prismatic Knights of the Phoinix Ascension are a private military order formed and founded by former Imperial Navy Duke Quinton Hannibal. They are a highly specialised military force available to the Empire and its factions to fulfil roles that are not officially recognised at the highest levels of government. These roles can range from simple policing and escort duties inside and outside the Empire, to clandestine missions that the Empire and its factions can disavow.
system_62110_key:
Winter Space Division believes that the continued exploration of the galaxy invites new dangers yet to be discovered. It has therefore pledged to support those under the Division’s protections with their individual goals, no matter how difficult they may be.

There have been rumours of strange sightings in this system.
system_62211_key:
The main Federal Navy Base was moved here from Anlave in 2983 following terraforming in the 2970s, and is an excellent training ground for planetary assault troops. Has the ancient name of Achird.

The home of Marine Forces Special Operations Command, a division of the Federation's military and special operations structure. Its core capabilities are direct action, special reconnaissance, foreign internal and diplomatic defence, counter-terrorism, information operations and special expertise in unconventional warfare. These elite forces are comprised of the military's greatest pilots, operators, engineers and support staff, dedicated to accomplishing their missions, whatever they may be.

"Always Faithful, Always Forward."
system_62232_key:
The home of Reaper Mob.
Reaper Mob is only concerned with one thing: Profit through any means necessary.
system_62256_key:
The home of Twin Stars Industries.
The founding members of Twin Stars Industries were traders and bounty-hunters looking for profit. After years wandering between systems, they settled in Imperial space around Cubeo to do business.
When they saw the chaos and destruction caused by the Thargoid conflict beginning in 3303, the faction decided to change focus by leaving Cubeo and investing its accrued wealth into the creation of an industrial corporation. Twin Stars industries now specialise in defence research and development.
system_62265_key: Foreign Object Damage Inc aims to control systems through military strength. Having pledged support to the Federation, it views the other superpowers as inferior and seeks to capitalise upon this perceived weakness.
system_62417_key: Very high humidity and native life forms make this an interesting place to visit. Many exotic food stuffs are grown here. The scenery is strikingly beautiful, though the wildlife can be a little dangerous. Has the ancient name of Marfak.
system_62423_key:
Also known as 31 Eta Ceti.

The home of the Dheneb Dynasty, a group that focuses on enforcing harmony by removing undesirables with extreme prejudice.
system_62571_key:
Alba Rotam Private Military Contractor was organised by a group of independent pilots during anti-piracy raids in the 89 Leonis system. Its original aim was to protect civilian vessels from pirates, but the resultant generous bounties inspired the creation of a private military enterprise.

Now members are known to accept any military contracts offering a suitable financial reward. The scope of the company includes bounty hunting, military operations of any kind, and the trade of military equipment.
system_62594_key:
The Sober Society was originally formed by a group of pilots who swore off alcohol after one too many collisions. Since then they have expanded their interests well beyond sobriety and aim to share their enlightened beliefs of peaceful cooperation and prosperity. There are unsubstantiated claims that The Sober Society only reached a position of any prominence due to a series of unfortunate accidents that befell its rivals.

While the main focus of The Sober Society is trade, it has occasionally been known to hire external pilots for more unsavoury tasks.
system_62607_key: The Manic Preachers are armed traders, aiming to boost their influence via massive financial input, and with violence when needed.
system_62619_key:
The home of RISE Space Corporation.
Rise Space Corporation is dedicated to finding new ways to travel in space. It understands that such research invites the risk of rival corporations seeking to interfere with its work. Member pilots are encouraged to explore the galaxy, push back hostile rivals and trade with allied corporations.
system_62636_key: The Black Knight Legion are a mercenary group known for the two ideals of money and quality. The legionnaires were founded in 3302 by their leader Zion Daikun.
system_62675_key: In May 3301 the system saw conflict with the forces of Imperial Senator Denton Patreus.
system_62763_key: The home of Imperial Patronage of Marsden, established as a defensive fleet against pirates and other dangers. Their headquarters is at Marsden Port from where the faction is trying to control the system and hunt down criminals
system_62775_key: Panta meaning 'always' and zis meaning 'live', this Central Star system has been known for its healing powers and paranormal phenomena. Peace and prosperity await all who venture within its borders.
system_62782_key:
Kraken Shield Specialists provide shield systems to both military and civilian ships throughout the Empire.

'Fly with the confidence of Kraken protection.'
system_62789_key: First colony outside the Sol system, where the first alien life was discovered. Unfortunately the last remnants are now in zoo enclosures for tourists. Crops cover most of the surface.
system_62825_key:
High population outdoor world. Former Federation Navy headquarters.

The Citizens Office for New Trade Revenue and Individual Liberty was born out of necessity to ensure the safety of trade revenues and routes in Catun and its neighbouring star systems. Its member pilots follow a democratic ideal and are fiercely independent.
system_62829_key:
The home of the Selous Syndicate.
An interstellar corporation formed from the remnants of a monastic order. Driven out of their original home, the remnants of this order reorganized themselves as the Selous Syndicate and settled along the frontier, seeking to avoid the attention of the major powers.
system_62871_key:
The home of Cwn Annwn.
A warrior clan from the outskirts of the Pegasi sector that suffered disaster following a period of persecution. Determined to prevent history from repeating itself, they founded a military academy which is rumoured to employ instructors that were once part of covert pilot research programs.
system_6288_key:
This favoured system is home to the central offices of Donnellan Healthcare, providers of healthcare throughout the Empire.

'Pamper and protect.'
system_62911_key: The INO CORPORATION was created to commercialise technological innovations. They regularly launch new products based on nano and biotechnology, but do not reveal anything about these scientific discoveries. Officially the corporation has no research lab, which raises suspicions about the source of their innovations.
system_62923_key: The home of Sovereign Marauders, a pirate faction.
system_62927_key: Home system for the League of Hel.
system_62930_key: Third Guard is a small group of independent and Imperially-aligned pilots dedicated to the defence of Sowiio and its surrounding systems. Their main responsibilities include cleaning criminals out of resource extractions sites, fighting for the Empire (and themselves) in conflict zones and contributing to the expansion of the Empire.
system_62938_key: This system is locked by the Pilots' Federation, no permits are currently issued.
system_62943_key: The home of the Order of the Sepulchre, a brotherhood of space-faring knights, akin to the ancient chivalric orders of Earth, who came to this system centuries ago in their quest for fame and glory.
system_62990_key: The Twin Lotus Consortium is an administrative union established by a number of the Qetesh system's notable corporations and nobility to forward local interests.
system_6300_key: The home system for the Libertas Cooperative - a group of free citizens dedicated to good governance through the cooperation of individuals, stakeholders and organisations. Held together by a council of elders led by Galleria Huneric, it seeks to coordinate with the various Imperial institutions with an aim to ending Imperial slavery.
system_63024_key: The home of Nusantara Dominion. Originally parts suppliers to Gutamaya, Nusantara Dominion was established after a number of key designers became disenchanted with political meddling between the Empire and Gutamaya directorship.
system_63041_key: The home of Lootan Dominion, a militaristic corporate body which intends to unite human space and take on the alien threat.
system_63059_key:
The home of the Feros Initiative. Feros Initiative is a Dictatorship government, with a policy of zero tolerance for individuals seeking dual citizenship. They believe that any who join Feros, remain Feros until the day they die. Violations of those policies may result in removal from the Initiative and subsequent destruction. 
Drifters passing through are advised to remain cautious and should avoid contact with the Feros Initiative followers. All Feros Initiative civilians are under the protection of the Feros Initiative Navy.
Feros Initiative Navy personnel make regular patrols through all claimed systems, guarding each owned base while also scouting ahead for potential threats and intruders.
system_63119_key: The home of Kriegsmarine Wolfpack, an elite task force under the jurisdiction of the Federal navy.
system_63143_key: The home of Bearers of the Flame, who believe the whole universe is a manifestation of the primordial fire of the Goddess, wanting to light the path of those who need help trailblazing the Via Lactea.
system_63155_key:
This once quiet agricultural system has recently become known for the production of Onionhead. This naturally growing drug was declared illegal by Federal authorities in December 3300.

The headquarters of the East India Company are situated in this system. The company bought up shares, real-estate and local businesses following their cessation of operations with Senator Torval. They work towards the legalisation and wholesale distribution of the cash crop Onionhead throughout the galaxy.
system_63176_key: Senator Denton Patreus favours this system with his patronage.
system_63178_key: The home of Red Rat Mining Co, a group of disgruntled miners who rebelled against the Federation Mining Company with the help of the Empire.
system_63206_key: An independent corporation dedicated to financial independence for all systems within its sphere of influence, Exclusive Mega Universal works tirelessly to solidify that ideal. It sees commerce and free-trade as foundational to maintaining safe, thriving communities where each individual has the potential to succeed.
system_63245_key: Also known as 1 Alpha Ursae Minoris.
system_63256_key: This is the home system for the Emperor's Fist. They were once the Emperor's elite guards but now are remembered only by a few. The Emperor's Fist found themselves outside of the confines of the Emperor's protection and acting alone. A mixture of traders, bounty hunters and covert operatives, they strive to uphold the values of an Empire long forgotten.
system_63260_key:
One of many Imperial worlds that were terraformed during the last major Imperial expansion between 2950-3150, and there are numerous fine examples of architecture of the period.

The New Republic of Aymifa is a faction run by scientists and bounty hunters. Their goal is to liberate nearby systems from the Empire and attempt to strike a peace with any aliens the human race comes into contact with.
system_63285_key:
SPF-LF 2 is the preserved holiday retreat of the RC Commanders of legend (visit SPF-LF 1 to experience their legacy as it has been interpreted in modern times). Some say that the RC bloodlines continue amongst the local population, and that Commander Pepper continues to roam the galaxies today, but most clear-headed commentators believe this is romantic nonsense. 

SPF-LF 2 has strict controls on the most interesting planet in the system carefully preserving the indigenous flora and fauna from introduced species. Originally named 'Down Under' as it felt a lot like the setting of the 33rd century social soap opera of the same name, set in historic Australia from old Earth.

After their disappearance, Down Under was renamed as a tribute to the RC Commanders and their unique flight and combat practices. Its unusual lumbering, jumping and flightless creatures remain to this day.
system_63323_key: The home of The Wild Hunt. The Wild Hunt are bounty hunters, laying claim to the souls of pilots unfortunate enough to see them. No one knows how, or when, they appeared; some suggest they are a group of bounty hunters setting down permanent roots, while others believe them to be something more... Sinister. They take no prisoners, and kill any who cross them.
system_63331_key: One of many Imperial worlds that were terraformed during the last major Imperial expansion between 2950-3150, and there are numerous fine examples of architecture of the period.
system_63340_key: The home of Cajun Galactic Unlimited, a ragtag group of smugglers, traders, combat pilots and explorers from the fringes of galactic society.
system_63392_key: Outdoor ice and water world. Tourism and fishing.
system_63408_key: Aseveljet is a military organisation formed from an alliance of Finnish freelance pilots. It stands to protect its members and allies.
system_63485_key: Since their use of technology in the first Dynasty Wars gave the Marelon Family a tactical advantage big enough to annex half a continent ten generations ago, there has been an arms race as differing factions vie for power. A dangerous place to trade, but the rewards for importing technology are huge. Also of interest to biotech firms – several lucrative patents have developed from the indigenous flora.
system_63549_key:
The prospecting team that discovered the system recognised the wealth inherent in its biospheres and sold the system claim to its current owner, Hippoc Bioceuticals, for an exorbitant fee. The system is now a galactic centre for biological research and exports a wide range of high-spec bio, chemical and medical products. Due to the sensitive nature and value of the research being carried out, entry requires a permit, and business is only conducted with trusted couriers. 

Conflict Resolution Solutions, CoRe Solutions for short, is a corporation dealing in military equipment and supplies, employing and backing mercenary pilots in an effort to expand their share of the market.
system_63586_key:
The home of The Adjudicators of Ross 332.
The Adjudicators of Ross 332 are preparing for the arrival of ‘A’, an unidentified source who made contact during an exploration mission in the black. They claim that ‘A’ has informed them not to allow any kind of resistance, and now hunt all wanted ships within their space. The Adjudicators also bring goods from neighbouring systems to promote a positive standard of life for residents.
system_63596_key:
The home of the Shadow Squadron.
Shadow Squadron is a Federal-aligned faction, rumoured to work behind-the-scenes to keep peace within its space, ensuring the safety of the citizens within.
Its motto is, 'Be sure to stay in the shadows, commanders!'
system_63602_key: United Dutch Space Travelers is a faction involved in mining, trading and exploration.
system_63608_key: Tharsis Corporation is an agency of private military contractors that serves the interests of the Federation. It was created with the objective of offering auxiliary services to the Federation army and navy through an abundant flow of men and arms.
system_63614_key: The Justicars of Helios operate from this system, bringing the light of Helios to the dark corners of the galaxy. Though they are joyful, they are tasked with a terrible purpose. For too long humanity has squabbled while the richness of the heavens lies before its feet. No longer. Heresy such as this must be punished, and theirs is the fist that delivers divine justice.
system_63621_key: The home of the Linebackers. The Linebackers are a private military company founded in 3304. The organisation is independent and takes on orders throughout the galaxy for any suitably wealthy client. The Linebackers are cold, dispassionate, and highly efficient - they're among the elite of industrial mercenary forces.
system_63640_key: Descendants of ancient Wales who were forced to flee during WWIII. Those that survived drifted throughout the galaxy until, in 3302, a chance meeting at a bar in Clement Station, and the unveiling of two pilots' heritages and goals, led to the birth of the Welsh Dragon Wing. Due to a perceived lack of support for miners by Federal and Imperial forces, they are dedicated to helping those in need of protection from any threat in Alpha Fornacis.
system_63874_key: The Independent Fleet of Mothership is a fleet of mercenaries and merchants who have come together to find a new home in the universe. They are currently working to create an infrastructure that can provide materials for building ships and stations for colonising planets. Their first fleet secures operations and completes jobs for third parties. The second fleet trades goods to make profit and provide the money for the first fleet. They are currently trying to set up a third fleet to mine materials that later may be used for construction.
system_63911_key:
The home of the Lem Future Tech. Home system of Lem Future Tech, a company founded in 3304 and named after Stanislaw Lem, a famous 20th century author and futurologist. Its main goals are researching new concepts for improving pilot capabilities; studies on alien civilisations, their origins and the influence of xeno contact on human behaviour; and the psychological effects of long term, deep space exploration on the human mind.
LFT gathers the very best pilots from every corner of the Galaxy, to ensure that 'tomorrow starts today'.
system_63970_key: Astralis Industries is a company focusing on mineral extraction, transportation and trade.
system_63979_key:
A system that some residents believe should be in Imperial space; while beyond the Empire's influence, Dalfur is modelled upon similar lines. The 'lower orders' necessary to run the infrastructure are kept out of sight in ghettos. Outside the enclaves, poverty and crime are increasing along with the level of automation – valued by the upper classes for its efficiency and cleanliness.

Tridicate are a collection of independent pilots and factions, striving to bring peace, prosperity and order to the galaxy. "To achieve prosperity we must have order. Order will set us free in the chaos of the black."
system_63981_key: C.E.A. Psychiatric Institutions Ltd. manages a network of psychiatric inpatient, residential, and outpatient clinics and hospitals. While registered as an Imperial corporation, clients are accepted from all factions and cultures. C.E.A’s flagship hospital, the Wylair Verdure Center, is recognised as a leading authority on the study of cosmopsychosis.
system_63989_key: Manah was colonised by a 'land rush' from nearby poorer systems after word spread of its riches. Hundreds of families claimed large tracts of land and fought until only four remained. A negotiated peace enabled exploration, but the system's purported wealth turned out to be a bar-room tale. The rumours were traced to source, which left only three families remaining. With money gone, they took to couriering goods and people around the surrounding systems. Later, they welcomed the protection offered by Federal affiliation and combined to form Starliner Express.
system_64013_key: The home of the Hive, a faction who hunt and research aliens.
system_64019_key: This system was first colonised with the construction of Obsidian Orbital in November 3301. Many strange artefacts have been discovered in this region of space.
system_64029_key: This system is seen as the key for a mystery starting in 3301 with the discovery of unknown artefacts that point to this system. The first of an alien species known as 'barnacles' was discovered on Merope 5 c in 3302.
system_64037_key: The home of the Federal Navy Special Activities Division, a clandestine special ops unit not subject to oversight by Federal Congressional committees.
system_64060_key:
The home of the Galactic Pathfinding Group.
The Galactic Pathfinding Group is an organization primarily dedicated to exploration. Its members have experience in rescue, trading, mining, and defence also.
system_64061_key: The Stargazer Pioneer Corps is based at the asteroid mine Stargazer in the Pleione system. They are a democratic fleet of independent explorers, miners, mercenaries and fixers, assembled to oppose the militarisation of the Pleiades.
system_64074_key: The home of Hanks Alliance of Anti-Xeno, whose main goal is to reduce the Thargoid presence in the surrounding Pleaides sector, and to enforce the rights of the local people.
system_64116_key: Originally claimed by an idealistic group of itinerant wanderers looking for a 'heaven'. Fujin's original culture has been added to over the years, but where each social group respects the others, there is little interaction and no cross-cultural 'contamination'. Fujin is a place to celebrate and perpetuate tradition. Each social group remains conservative: all the inhabitants value their 'traditional' architectures and controlled social behaviour. With a rigorous policing system, it is not somewhere to party. The most lucrative exports are indigenous plants and herbs that, when combined according to secret family recipes, produce highly effective medicines rivalling or exceeding the best synthetics. Ill-informed combinations have been known to be instantly fatal.
system_64149_key: Darkfleet Logistics is a group of traders from across the galaxy come together to form a trading guild that holds discretion, honour and loyalty above all else.
system_64214_key: On the edge of human space there are few holiday destinations. Struck by Ad Pontes' exceptional natural beauty, and few natural resources, the first colonists saw the economic sense in preserving their discovery and advertising 'The Planet of the Zodiac' as a place of relaxation and renewal. Exports are mostly keepsakes and items with dubious 'ancient' spiritual power and heritage.
system_64220_key: The home of the Peregrina Research and Intelligence Agency. The Peregrina Research and Intelligence Agency is a covert agency founded by a prominent cosmologist. They conduct research and gather intelligence on both human and nonhuman entities. P.R.I.A's main focus is to study and advance human comprehension of all forms of life, to better assist with maintaining galactic peace.
system_64274_key:
Home to the Simbad Regime and its unyielding commanders. 

With its unwavering influence and lust for power, it strives for absolute control with little external diplomacy in hopes of becoming a force to be reckoned with.
system_64312_key:
Trinity Services began as a small bounty hunting group in early 3304. As the faction grew, it started to successfully expand into mining and trading. Currently it maintains these activities both within and beyond inhabited space.

A small refinery operation in a system once known as Keid.
system_64324_key: Kahina's League of Explorers is a group of commanders dedicated to scientific and geological research, with members also specialising in combat and defence.
system_64338_key: The Borderlands Republic will do anything to maintain its territory and help other border worlds gain their independence. The Borderlands Republic is a mix of freedom fighters, outlaws, traders, explorers and bounty hunters.
system_64363_key: Boogaloo Squadron aims to expand its influence throughout the galaxy via trade and financial growth. The faction mostly consists of miners and bounty hunters. It has established a base of operations in the HR 1364 system.
system_64405_key: The Undaunted Pilots of HIP 20440 champions the idea that all members can influence the future of the organisation. The faction is strongly committed to promoting civil liberty. Members are known to engage in most professions.
system_64588_key: Spacecare is an independent organisation that wants to stop pollution in space by prohibiting the use of heatsinks, kinetic weapons and dropped cargo. It demands that ships are only destroyed in predefined zones.
system_64637_key: Aurora is a constitutional monarchy that is built around existentialism. It is currently headed by the Empress Lunea Moeli Valentis, who was nominated after having passed multiple tests of the fundamental laws of Aurora. Her wisdom is recognized by her peers. Born in an Orca, from a commander father and a purser mother, Lunea spent her childhood by travelling. Today, her conquest of space is felt through tourism. The Aurora's technology focuses mainly on interstellar transport, in partnership with the manufacturer Saud Kruger.
system_64693_key: This system is locked by the Pilots' Federation, no permits are currently issued.
system_64710_key:
The home of the Outer Systems Liberation Movement. The Outer Systems Liberation Movement is a faction forged on the outskirts of inhabited space, the result of poor working conditions and a shared resentment for the local exploitative governments. Originally an unnamed force of impoverished miners and refinery workers, the group was born when Sadgati Nechayev came to represent them. The movement seeks to liberate the oppressed, its overall goal stated as establishing fair living conditions for a free and sovereign people.
While there are a conservative few among the OSLM, most reject the authorities of colonized space; many communities ban influences such as GalNet entirely.
system_64729_key: A backwater system with no local laws and with limited extraction activity. Once known as Pi-3 Orionis.
system_64785_key: This system is believed to be controlled directly by the mysterious organisation known as the "Eternal Throne" whose capital is located on the planet Suraan. Little is known about their Emperor, though the locals believe he is an all-powerful and ancient entity.
system_64831_key: The Intergalactic Astronomical Union collects, stores and studies astronomical data. IAU members are known as peaceful deep space explorers who do not condone violence against humans and use the minimum necessary force should defensive measures prove necessary. As an independent science-based entity, the IAU is officially considered neutral with the three superpowers.
system_64846_key:
A young blue star with resource-rich planets, the discovery of this wealthy star system was named by Commander Dan Jameson with friend Nick Lindsey during a failed system jump.

Like a flood, like a storm, rage Galileo Legacy. Fighters, merchants, miners and explorers of this dark space rise, you're sons of Galileo. Join us, find a family, find a flag, become someone.

"From nothing to all, now and forever always together."

The home of the Galileo Corporation.
system_64875_key: The Maxwell Corp. was founded by Kieran Maxwell, who claims to be a descendant of the British physicist James Clerk Maxwell. The company is an interplanetary conglomerate based in Eta-1 Pictoris and operating through many segments, including energy, mining and security. Maxwell currently supports Zachary Hudson.
system_64914_key: The Order of Enblackenment follows and worships the Void. They believe that only through darkness can one reach enlightenment. Born in the shadows of the galaxy, the Order of Enblackenment is set to spread the word of the Void and enforce its will, through peace or war. Those who embrace the Void's teachings and way of life are welcomed into the Order.
system_64974_key: Schokai Private Agency is a local contractor offering services in the field of secure data transport, exploration, mining, VIP transport and combat. The independence of Schokai Private Agency ensures complete anonymity for their clients.
system_65189_key: As the overseers of Bacon Station, this faction's motto is: "If it can't be solved with violence, it can't be solved at all".
system_65357_key: The home of The AZGHARIE. This faction operates under the protection of 'The Supreme Leader'; pilots of the Azgharie operate through their space to provide both mutual aid and a brightened mood.
system_65495_key: The home of the Federal Interstellar Recon. A group of explorers bonded with a group of bounty hunters due to a dizzying event; the death of CMDR Salome. Their goals and motives became one: to discover the truth of what happened
system_65512_key: The home of the Wings of Stressed Iron. Gathering bounty hunters, miners, veterans and anyone else who has proven themselves, the Wings of Stressed Iron were formed after the falling of a now forgotten faction. Forged in combat and comradery, this new team fight side by side to secure their place amongst the stars.
system_65562_key: Spanish Pilots Society (SPS) trains and teaches new pilots and seeks out the greatest challenges for veterans. Its purpose is to expand through the galaxy, and fight together as one for the good of its society and home. SPS is Bok's first and last line of defence.
system_65587_key: The HIP 2902 Independents are a fiercely independent population on the outskirts of Imperial space. Famed for their hard work ethic and forthright opinions, the faction's long standing aims are to maintain local trade routes whilst upholding the democratic values of the local populous.
system_65619_key: This system is locked by the Pilots' Federation, no permits are currently issued.
system_65721_key: Also known as 1 Zeta Canis Majoris.
system_65745_key: Also known as 2 Beta Canis Majoris.
system_65826_key:
An unremarkable system, notable only for a number of women-only enclaves where technology is rejected and the use of ancient wooden and metal weapons is taught and practiced.

Amphipolis Democratic Assembly is a group dedicated to the governance of systems that adhere to the principles of ancient Greek democracy: government by the people, for the people.
system_65896_key: The home of the Adnovi Security Holdings. Adnovi Security Holdings is a private security force, comprising Federal Navy veterans, formed in 3303 amidst struggles between the Federation and the Alliance. They have gained a reputation for being loyal to the Federation, with a reported interest in humanitarian efforts. The company, however, specialises in high value cargo transportation.
system_6596_key: The Bad Apples are misfits, mercenaries, miscreants, and merchants. All for one or one for one is the motto here. What some spacers see as chaos, the Bad Apples see as freedom and capitalism.
system_65988_key: Famous as the first true corporate system and also notable for the first interstellar war. Since 2350, the Sirius Corporation has been using the vast amounts of cheap energy available on Lucifer from coils wrapped around the planet for the synthesis of custom elements (particularly military-grade fuel). Has the ancient name of Alpha Canis Majoris. The permit for this system can be obtained via the Sirius Corporation faction.
system_66084_key: The home of Stellar Piscari, a tourism company owned by thrill seekers, adventurers and hedonists known for trend setting and extravagant ships. Stellar Piscari – where your leisure is our pleasure!
system_66106_key: The home of The Republic of Andaz. The home of The Republic of Andaz: a group of wealthy, like-minded pilots who strive to rid humanity of its detrimental ways through proper education and wisdom. This group is known to take part in occasional peacekeeping missions, but they are prepared to employ deadly force at a moment's notice. Ultimately, the Republic's long-term goal is to ensure the advancement of the human race.
system_66150_key: Also known as 21 Epsilon Canis Majoris and Adhara.
system_66221_key: A faction dedicated to protecting miners at the various resource extraction sites of GCRV 4654 system.
system_66247_key: FireMoon is a group of mercenaries based in Siren, where they brew their legendary apple wine. In controlled systems, FireMoon ensure security and that criminals are hunted down.
system_66295_key: The home of the Reprisal Defense Readiness Initiative. The RDRI is a wing of talented and friendly commanders who strive to protect both their own interests and those of their allies. They fiercely defend their allies who abide by galactic law.
system_66432_key: The home of The Flying HellFish. The Flying HellFish are known to do a bit of mining, space trucking and offer a planetary taxi service. Members are found exploring for weeks and even engaging in the odd bit of piracy all. They welcome all manner of pilots to join their various adventures, using the motto, 'Nobody ever said we are any good.'
system_66456_key: Also known as 3 Beta Canis Minoris.
system_66478_key: Somewhat chaotic, but worth the effort.
system_66481_key: The home of the Benelux Commanders. A independent organisation displaying historical Dutch influences, that has been independent since 3303. The faction is known for claiming neutrality in large scale conflicts.
system_66525_key: A small independent extraction system also once known as Alpha Geminorum.
system_66567_key:
Has an ancient name of 10 Alpha Canis Minoris.

The home of Red Corporation.
Red Corporation was established over 400 years ago. Having enjoyed successful economic development during that time, its goal is to create a high quality of life for all of its citizens along with an excellent economic space for development, trade and production. All pilots may find a place in the ranks of the Red Corporation.
The economic link of the Corporation specialises in the production and transportation of goods. The combat link focuses on engaging pirates and representing the interests of the Corporation in military conflicts.
Its motto is, ‘The Corporation fights for every life!’
system_66599_key:
The home of The Sigma Luminary. The Sigma Luminary is a coalition of pilots who are beholden to neither Empire nor Federation.
The sign of Sigma from the ancient Earth alphabet of the Greek civilization has come to represent self-energy in the field of particle physics, energies created within its own system. Likewise, the pilots of the Sigma Luminary are expected to produce their own initiative, pushing their passions to the cosmos.
Thier motto is, 'This Luminary acts as a beacon for all. Light is a cure to the darkness within.'
system_6660_key: The Nemo Corporation is a faction of bounty hunters working for the Federation, currently based out of CC ERI.
system_66624_key:
A quiet extraction system also known as Beta Geminorum.

The home of the Daedalus Consortium. Formed at the turn of the fourth millennium, the Daedalus Consortium is a loosely bound group of individuals who seek power above all else.
system_66850_key: The home of ANASTASIS of 14 PSI CANCRI, a group looking to expand their influence and still peacefully co-exist with their system neighbours. The group tries not be steered by the politics of the galaxy and follows its own moral code of conduct.
system_66851_key: The home of Kommilaire Response And Projection Inc, serving the Federation's interests via security and aid operations.
system_66907_key:
Uley Corporation has long been engaged in the investment into, and acquisition of technology related to, areas of research related to deep space exploration. After gaining a foothold in the B'Titus system using its scientific and technological resources, the corporation works to establish itself as a research institute supported by both industrial and military endeavours. Reports suggest it has employed numerous bounty hunters to protect its interests.

The end of the universe, or so the tone deaf inhabitants thought. They've turned this system into what they consider the party capital, celebrating each new day with a song and a jig. Visitors are routinely issued with earplugs to drown out the screeching.
system_67047_key: Deep Recon X is a deep space exploration unit, committed to discovering the secrets of the galaxy.
system_67133_key: Raijin Corporation is best known for its manufacturing of home and ship appliances, financial dealings, real estate investments and being a top 100 technology brokerage firm. Recently, under a new CEO, it has branched into the private security industry with great success, reinvigorating its growth and influence, and hiring pilots into its ranks at an unprecedented rate.
system_67138_key:
The home of the Wayward Aviators Solar Praetorian.
Aurora is home to the Wayward Aviators Solar Praetorian (WASP), an elite squadron dedicated to creating a haven for like-minded pilots. Determined to excel in all galactic endeavours, the faction strives to expand its skills and knowledge.

Class G stars are white-yellow main sequence stars. They usually range in mass from 0.8 to 1.2 solar masses and have a surface temperature reaching 6,000 K. This system has 4 high metal content worlds, 4 icy bodies and 3 rocky bodies but is most notable for it's Earth-like world and secondary Class M star.
system_67198_key: The home of Tyger Traders. Tyger Traders, the outer rim's most prominent shipping and procurement specialists. If you are thirsty to drink Fujin Tea from a Hutton Mug, or smoke Kamitra Cigars whilst contemplating a Jaradharre Puzzle Box, Tyger Traders can arrange that for you at the galaxy's most reasonable rates.
system_67209_key:
A quite lawless system with some limited extraction activity. Once known as Delta Velorum.

Ice Storm Squadron are based in this system.

"Have you ever felt the cold... the cold in the darkness?
Have you ever felt the fear... the fear that chills your blood ?
Now you will feel it, this is the storm, The ICESTORM!"

ISS is an Elite unit operating throughout the whole galaxy to represent and defend the values of the Federation, following their guide, the Shadow President.
system_67324_key: Enigma Imperial Holdings was established by a small band of commanders who defected from Federation controlled space. These commanders were highly independent but found mutual benefit in supporting the Empire.
system_67370_key: A well developed Alliance system focusing on mineral and ore extraction. Also known as Iota Ursae Majoris.
system_67499_key:
The home of the Helix Collective.
Helix Collective is a faction that seeks to support its members whenever possible. It allows members to pursue any profession but encourages combat experience.
system_67572_key: A small federation mining corporation - C&S Mining Corp - is based in this system.
system_67580_key: The Marias Corporation is a corporate mining group operating in the Viaduct; a group of three systems with a capital in 38 Lyncis. Marias has been providing metals and minerals for the galaxy since 2384.
system_67608_key:
The home of the Singular Prospective Exports Destitute. A group of miners and explorers looking for respite from the day-to-day grind.
Their motto is, 'Though all are unique, together we will overcome.'
system_67681_key: The home of the MCIP United. Formed by a group of like-minded pilots that took exception to an over-reliance on the Federation in their home system, Mnesota Coalition of Independent Pilots United was established to provide a voice for self-reliant pilots within Federation space. MCIP United is focused on exploration data-cataloguing, but occasionally assists in Federation expansion efforts as required.
system_67805_key: Mando'ade of Subra is dedicated to strength and honour, but most of all loyalty. Their services have been sought far and wide. If one absolutely must have a target destroyed, the only wave to send is Mando'ade.
system_67902_key:
The home of The New Templars, with a religious past tainted by a variety of crimes, the Templars of LTT 3607 disbanded in 3016; some former adherents elected to form a new alliance. They called this alliance 'The New Templars'. After cutting every connection with prior religious tenets, The New Templars now consider themselves an independent group who fight for equality throughout the galaxy.
Despite rumours that prior members had participated in some illegal activities in the past, the faction believes they are on the right path now. The New Templars main activities are exploration and trade, but they will defend their system fiercely against any kind of piracy.
system_68067_key:
Also has an ancient name of 32 Alpha Leonis.

The home of the Regulus Independent Liberators, a free and independent group.
system_68090_key: The Winters Wolves are descendants of Native Americans that fled the Sol System during the Great Path and settled in this system. As their history has shown, not assimilating with expanding powers caused much suffering for their ancestors. Now the Wolves not only assimilate with expanding powers, but use their great organisational skills to get others to assimilate with them as well.
system_6816_key: This system is favoured by Aisling Duval.
system_68245_key: Cerberus was established to ensure stability in the regions that fall between the cracks of humanity. It consists of elite forces formed from the best operatives in wetwork, bounty hunting, mercenary and military operations. Whether on foot or in the cockpit, Cerberus forces are more than capable of handling critical and dangerous situations. They work tirelessly for the good of their people, regardless of political affiliation. Like shadows in the void, they operate discreetly to keep their fellow man safe and secure without interfering in the day to day lives of their just citizens.
system_68279_key: HR 4062 has a variety of celestial bodies, from airless ringed planets to an Earth-like orbiting a Class Y dwarf. This majestic system is home to Dreamstone.
system_68299_key:
The home of the UEF Logistics Group. Founded in late 3298, the Unified Exploration Front was born from an idea to unite various minor factions under the common goal of adventuring out into the furthermost reaches of deep space. Since then, the company has expanded from a small handful of pilots, now controlling a steady flow of materials to supply its own fleet expansion program.
The current UEF base of operations is located on Irvin Hub in the Y Velorum system, where the Logistics Division handles shipment of materials and supplies in and around the area.
system_68419_key: Upon a successful return from the second Distant Worlds expedition, one group of pilots had forged such strong bonds of friendship and respect that they decided to establish a haven for explorers seeking to carry out maintenance, register data and recuperate before the next trip out into the black. They became known as the Distant Veterans. Members are known to meet at notable archaeological sites to swap stories of their adventures.
system_68616_key: A quiet but dangerous anarchy system with some extraction activity. Also known as Alpha Ursae Majoris.
system_68626_key: Onyx Allied Confederation are a peaceful faction seeking riches trough trading and bounty hunting.
system_68632_key: The home of Black Sails Battalion, a Federation-aligned bounty hunting group, who have been known to seed chaos and piracy in non-Federation space.
system_68663_key:
The home of Amuro Advanced Industry.
Amuro Advanced Industry is a rag-tag group of retired military pilots, merchants and explorers.
system_68670_key: This system is locked by the Pilots' Federation, no permits are currently issued.
system_68754_key: Also known as 54 Nu Ursae Majoris.
system_68776_key:
DFST Trading contains former mercenaries that turned to trade and mining as a primary profession. Mercenary work is still commonly accepted by members, however, with suitable contracts accepted with little fuss.

Its motto is, ‘There are no credits too dirty to be earned.’
system_68820_key: Made up of former bounty hunters, miners and other explorers, Astral Memories was established by Commander Papadou in 2927. They prefer to call for calm, peace and reflection, but if necessary they will not hesitate to use force.
system_68875_key:
Cygnian Dream Entertainments are based in this cosmopolitan system and their shows are available throughout the Alliance.

'Where the party never ends...'

Olwain Pirates stand against any threat to the Alliance's power from the rival sinner-states, the Federation and Empire, and will destroy anyone who supports those dictatorships. Mainly they operate out of Olwain, in Alliance space, although they also have operations further afield. Forever live Freedom. Forever live the Alliance.
system_69041_key:
A low-level mining operation in a system once known as Beta Leonis.

The home of BROs Elite (Border Rangers of Outer Space Elite), who secure the boundaries of space from hostile alien species.
system_69053_key: A small mining concern in a quiet system once known as Gamma Corvi.
system_6906_key:
This is a small independent industrial system which is the administrative home of the drive tuning specialists - Daftworks Incorporated.

'To the limit - and beyond!'

Corvos is an Independent organization that took control of Epsilon Hydri by force in early 3302. After careful consideration a deal was struck between Corvos and the Empire. This deal would allow Corvos to reside in Epsilon Hydri and in return the system would remain under Empire control.

Corvos had been well known for importing and exporting illegal goods, hijacking trade vessels in open space and assaulting civilian and military vessels with or without any monetary gain. However these skills are now redirected to aid the Empire in their affairs while also allowing Corvos to operate out of Empire space.

Corvos and its Imperial associates do not welcome outsiders. Entering into Epsilon Hydri without an invitation is ill advised.
system_69172_key: A local civil war blights this lawless system, although a few determined miners keep the small extraction economy going.
system_69250_key:
Dundee International Sales is dedicated to expanding the potential of future technologies. With a keen aptitude for successfully navigating local markets, D.I.S seeks to secure influence within inhabited space.

Its motto is, ‘Shape the universe into a better tomorrow!’
system_69268_key:
This system is directly controlled by the Pilots' Federation, with entry permitted by invitation only. Achieving a high rank with the Pilots' Federation is the most common way to earn such an invitation, but other, more secretive methods are also known to exist.

The system is governed by the Elite Pilots' Federation, members of which are allowed to retire here.
system_69305_key: Not the most exciting place to visit, or so it is claimed.
system_6932_key:
The home of Dark Horse Transport.
Dark Horse Transport is primarily a cargo and passenger transport operation. It also offers combat assistance to other operators, as well as to the Federation and its allied minor factions.
system_69335_key:
The home of Dark Enterprise.
Dark Enterprise is a Federal business organisation which actively participates in galactic research.
system_69337_key: A minor extraction system that was once known as Delta Ursae Majoris.
system_6934_key:
The home of the Ukrainian Pilots Federation.
Ukrainian Pilots Federation consists mainly of pilots claiming ancient Ukrainian ancestry. Its main objective is providing active support to new pilots and the exploration of the Milky Way. The secondary objective is the protection of mankind from any external threats.
system_69432_key: Poor, low population extraction economy (independent corporate state).
system_69467_key: A small agricultural world which is also famous as a popular holiday destination.
system_69492_key:
Also known as 7 Delta Corvi.

The home of Sidewinder Syndicate, dealing in bounty hunting, trading, racing and exploration, has settled amongst the numerous life sustaining planets and abundant orbital stations of Algorab. The ringed earth-like world with the orbiting Forbes Terminal is the ideal base for the group's various activities and operations.
system_69527_key: A growing Federal agricultural world once known as 8 Beta Canum Venaticorum.
system_69567_key: The quaternary system might have relatively few planets but it still supports a powerhouse agricultural and industrial economy. As well as its economic muscle, the local universities are well regarded throughout Federation space.
system_6958_key:
The Privateers of VSOP are based in this system. They were initially a specialist pilot organisation flying tailored and specially designed aircraft, delivered by the aeronautical division of VSOP. This tradition dates back to the early 21st century on Earth. Originally it was a small subset of pilots from their black ops unit who later evolved into a privateer organisation.

Authorities, civilians or other groups may request assistance for a fee.

The VSOP Space Agency mother organisation still upholds their leading edge in space ship design, but due to its secretive nature the number of custom ships operating remains unknown.
system_69607_key: A well-established industrial system also known as Gamma Virginis.
system_69668_key: The home of Fathers Of The Void, who have been known to fund everything from geological surveys to government coups.
system_69678_key: Also known as Beta Crucis and Mimosa.
system_6973_key:
This system is known for the presence of the headquarters of Conway Holo Productions. Their output can be seen on entertainment and news feeds through the galaxy.

'Bite size entertainment for a busy day.'
system_69745_key: The Alioth system is notable as the home of the Alliance, one of the galaxy's three superpowers. The system was the focus of conflict between the Federation and the Empire in the 3200s due to its tremendous mineral wealth, but the expulsion of Federal and Imperial forces by Alioth's indigenous population led to the creation of the Alliance in 3230. The permit for this system can be obtained from the Alioth Independents.
system_69771_key: Also known as 12 Alpha-2 Canum Venaticorum.
system_69829_key:
The home of New Avalon Institute.
New Avalon Institute represents a vision to expand the horizons of human knowledge through exploration; development of trade; the study of science, culture and the military arts; and the protection of those who undertake these labours.
system_69904_key:
The home of the Imperial Defence Forces. The Imperial Defence Forces (IDF) were founded in the year 3304 by a number of dedicated Imperial pilots, as a reaction to various growing threats against the Empire.
As a system security faction, they pride themselves on protecting pilots who are not capable of defending themselves against criminals and enemy factions. In addition to this, the IDF has a focus on prosperity, wealth and high security in all star systems under their influence."
system_69922_key: Also known as 42 Alpha Comae Berenices.
system_69933_key: This pastoral system supports an agricultural economy but doesn't welcome strangers. So much so that the governing council won't permit a starport in orbit for trading. The permit for this system can be obtained via the Chapter of Isinor faction.
system_69947_key: The home of Philosophem Brotherhood, a faction of explorers and conquerors.
system_70006_key: The home of the Alchemy Den. Founded by Arburich, Alchemy Den is seen as a 'tavern for the galaxy' and welcomes pilots of all professions. They dedicate themselves to the enjoyment of what the galaxy has to offer, and hold nothing back in the process. True to their word, the Alchemists hold little respect for anyone that tells them what they cannot do, and take joy from seeking new ways to break from the norms of the galaxy.
system_70037_key: Founded in 3302 by Commander Bremz, and supported by the Federation, this faction started as a small trade corporation and has since rapidly grown to a faction. As trading increased there was also a need for protection, which has resulted in the forming of multiple wings that offer protection to all who seek it.
system_70063_key:
This system's bright F class star is surrounded by a smorgasbord of different planets, including several Helium type gas giants. There is also a binary and a trinary planet system here. Xenobiologists have plenty to study with both water based and ammonia based life discovered in the upper reaches of two of the system's many gas giants. The single terraformed outdoor world supports an extensive agricultural economy and refining facilities.

The home of the Granite Security Agency, who recognise the value of the work done by the galaxy's entrepreneurs and work to shield them from the perils of piracy. Their agents are well armed and trained in close-quarters combat techniques. GSA stands ready to fiercely defend the lives of all enterprising citizens of the galaxy, and to ensure the continued advancement of humankind among the stars.
system_70080_key: Also known as 79 Zeta Ursae Majoris.
system_70297_key: The Fallen Ones was founded in 3304 by a tight-knit group of pilots following a series of missions directing them to commit barbarous acts against their rivals. Finally refusing to follow orders, these pilots were exiled from their home system. The group eventually settled in the Wolf 497 system, taking on a new name: The Fallen Ones. Members have dedicated themselves to building a new life and will do anything and everything to preserve the faction’s work.
system_70410_key: A developed Federal industrial system that was once known as 8 Eta Bootis.
system_70485_key: BPM 89444 is the birthplace of the New Dawn, a renegade group recruited by the Alliance in 3302. They form a task force primarily deployed on humanitarian missions and peacekeeping.
system_70504_key: Also known as Beta Centauri and Hadar.
system_70537_key: A small Federal refinery colony once known as 5 Theta Centauri.
system_70625_key: The Club of the Coldblooded Children Originally hails from Amphiloci. Its pilots actively seek out and participate in some of the galaxy's strangest activities.
system_70647_key:
Early life had just started to emerge on Discovery when human settlers arrived in 2304. This has now been replaced by an Earth-like ecosystem, adapted to live under the red light. Locals are generally confident their star will remain a red giant forever.

The 501st Joint Arcturus Wing is a faction that wants to bring peace to the Arcturus system and neighbouring systems. The 501st believe that you should never attack the innocent, and frown down on pirates and terrorists. They also believe that the only way to truly bring peace is to enlighten the people. The people of the 501st have a certain loyalty to their leaders, five dictators. Only one being known, the rest hiding in the shadows. The only one known to the public is Victor Lexx Crowe. Oddly, though it is a dictatorship the people of the 501st have many freedoms. The only notable thing they outlawed being slavery.
system_70696_key: This system is locked by the Pilots' Federation, no permits are currently issued.
system_7073_key:
Mastopolos Mining Incorporated operate throughout the whole of Imperial space and beyond. One of their flagship operations can be found in this system.

'More from ore.'
system_70754_key:
Rich, low population high tech economy (independent corporate state).

An independent corporate-run binary system, with a central white F7V star and, further out, a captured planet-less M3V red dwarf. The capture event millions of years earlier doubtless stripped Asellus Primus B of any planets that might have formed with it. Asellus Primus is known for its high tech manufacturing. Also known as 23 Theta Bootis.
system_70801_key: The home of the Southern Cross United Mercenaries, a band of misfits from the depths of Terra. Kicked out of their original system, they now offer their services to the highest bidder.
system_70807_key: The home of Axios Intersteller Military, started by a squad of Federation Pilots who wanted to continue to serve the Federation, but under their own name.
system_70813_key:
Eden was the first planet on which liquid water was detected by spectroscopic methods in 2038, and was consequently a major driving force for the exploration of space. However, Eden turned out to be extremely inhospitable with the added danger of hard radiation from Proxima. There is now a small research station on Eden, but little else in the rest of the system. Star was once known as Rigel Kentaurus.

Late in 3301 a rag-tag collection of independent commanders selflessly came to the aid of The Hutton Mug Co. to help kick-start the creation of the Hutton Mug; that rare item that can only be found at Hutton Orbital in the Alpha Centauri system. Over 2.4 million tonnes of scrap were delivered by the Truckers, all the while evading and eventually confronting the many concerted attacks by pirates and other ne'er-do-wells who blockaded the platform, determined to thwart the Mug Company's efforts. In the aftermath of the famed Mug Run many intrepid commanders decided to formalise their association into the Cooperative, vowing to protect the hallowed route and, perhaps one day, find a cure for MODS.
system_70874_key: The Black Knights consists of like-minded independent pilots who banded together to push back against various perceived injustices perpetrated by major governments. It seeks to bring hope and justice to those who have neither.
system_70919_key: Classified Consolidated are involved in exploration and bounty hunting, undertaking undertake tasks to preserve, propagate and collect various types of information.
system_70932_key: The Belanit Interstellar Hanseatic League, also known as the BIHL, is an alliance of trading and corporate pilots in the Belanit system. In order to shield trade routes from pirate attacks and negative political influences, the BIHL joined forces with space truckers, mercenaries and bounty hunters to protect trade and maximise their profits.
system_71051_key:
The Ursa Minor Beta Publishing Corporation is a wholly remarkable organisation. Perhaps the most remarkable, certainly the most successful ever to come out of the great media wars of Kocab. Renowned throughout uncivilised space, and reviled in much of civilised space, for its best-selling title "Wing-Rider's Guide to the Cosmos", indispensable for all curious travellers who wish to enjoy and survive the galaxy's most deadly and delectable experiences.

Also known as 7 Beta Ursae Minoris.
system_71089_key: The home of Ashera Knights, founded to combat the pirates in the system Asherah.
system_71092_key: Very high humidity and native life make this an interesting place to visit. Many exotic food stuffs are grown here. The scenery is strikingly beautiful, though the wildlife can be a little dangerous.
system_71163_key:
Nirvana is an exotic, verdant outdoor world, rich in indigenous life. A high tech (largely biotech and pharmaceutical) industry developed initially from exploiting the biological wonders found in the vast equatorial cloud forests. Tourists come to see the incredible beauty of the largely undamaged flora and fauna, vigorously protected by the Aulin Corporation. There is also some farming of high-value local produce.

The Aulin War Eagles are an independent mercenary group.

This group takes on virtually any job, as long as it brings in enough money and is not directed against their own faith.

The Aulin War Eagles firmly believe in the teachings of the perfect Bratwurst and have even invented the Aulin Bratwurst.
system_71178_key:
The home of P34 Pod Mercenaries.
P34 Pod was founded in early 3301, as a response to the Federation's decision to criminalise Onionhead. It argues that the Federation has lost touch with the masses, who deserve to have the option to choose what to experience in life.
The faction has since evolved into a full mercenary operation, working for anyone who can afford its price.
system_71186_key:
Marine agriculture and industrial economy (Federal democracy).

i Bootis is an interesting and unusual quaternary system with a mixed industrial and marine economy, and also a member of the Federation. Chango is an outdoor water world and orbits i Bootis A - a G0V white-yellow star similar to Earth's Sol. Chango is essentially a giant fish farm. People live on giant floating cities that slowly move with the seasonal migration of the fish - mostly species imported from ancient Earth.
system_71258_key: This system is dominated by five gas giants and contains modest refining facilities. Dangerous gangs are known to operate within this system.
system_71286_key: This quadruple system has an interesting layout. The majority of the planets orbit around the shared gravitational centre of the outer pair of stars. The system supports a mixed extraction and refinery economy.
system_71340_key:
The home of Fluke Works Union.
Sheddie and his Shenanigans took over the Fluke Works brewhouse during the chaos of a civil war. Shortly afterwards, they elected Sheddie as brewmeister of the Fluke Works brewhouse to resolve a system-wide beer shortage.
Through continuous expansion, the Fluke Works Union has expanded from its humble beginnings in the brewhouse. A willingness to share its success with citizens, with the motto ‘There is enough for all’, has proven remarkably popular.
system_71413_key: A binary system with refining facilities around its primary star. The locals claim that a mysterious signal is transmitted from the heart of the companion star every six years.
system_71415_key: The home of Star Norse Union, a minor faction of conquerors.
system_71421_key: Lunatis Interstellar is a collective of pilots that aid in the protection of the Milky Way and the advancement of the human race.
system_7143_key:
Kinematic Armaments has outlets throughout independent space but their main fabrication plant is within this system.

'You want guns. We've got guns.'

Special Tactics and Reconnaissance Squadron was formed in the year 3251 for the purpose of serving galactic peace following a conflict between the Federal and Imperial Fleets in the year 3250. Spectre Squadron is made up of rich pilots, traders and bounty hunters who deserted their oppressive governments' conquests in order to be a part of something greater. A government where all would have say in the actions of leadership. A government that would work to preserve the safety and balance of the galaxy at any cost. Spectres operate out of a weapons manufacturing facility in Tau-1 Eridani, where they develop experimental technologies away from the public. Spectres continue to protect and serve where they are needed, training new pilots, and protecting those who cannot protect themselves.  Spectres act in any way they see fit, either with careful diplomacy or ruthless force, being officially above any law.
system_71442_key: A quiet system known for the occasional pirate attack and rogue mining operation. Also known as Iota Draconis.
system_71479_key:
Also known as 3 Beta Coronae Borealis.

The home of the Azul Corporation, an interplanetary organisation that works under general galactic jurisdiction. It specialises in passenger transportation, day-by-day commerce and research services. To serve well is their nature, and being the greatest is their goal.
system_7154_key: The Imperial Cartographic Cooperative is a faction dedicated to exploration and the mapping of the galaxy in the name of the Emperor. Its personnel regularly pioneer trips into the uncharted cosmos.
system_71556_key: Also known as 5 Alpha Coronae Borealis.
system_71639_key: The home of the Atled Corporation, which is independent of the three major superpowers and open to pilots of any background and any allegiance.
system_71672_key:
This system contains the registered headquarters for the Better Green Developments corporation.

'Keeping your planet green and clean.'
system_71676_key: A minor high tech system once known as Alpha Serpentis.
system_71735_key: Cartographers' Guild is an independent group of explorers, scouts and pacifist scientists. Their purpose is to archive the entire galaxy through their virtual interface connected to their Archigrapher mentor. Their stated goal is to transfer knowledge to our children and thereby to perpetuate the memory of the universe.
system_71788_key: Australe Systems Commonwealth is a movement formed to oppose the Federation in the Beta and Zeta Trianguli Australis systems. With most colonies in these systems descended from Australasia on old Earth, a strong independent streak runs through them all and, like nearby Lugh, they want their freedom.
system_71807_key: Military Militia is a group composed of current and former service men and women. Their common views and continued support of their respective nation's defence brought them together. They serve to protect and defend the system's integrity and to assist those in need. The Spartan hoplite helmet represents fearlessness, harsh and cruel life, and endurance. The Greek letters below the helmet spell “Brothers” and represents their support and respect for each other.
