system_71909_key: Poor, low population industrial economy (Federal democracy).
system_7195_key: Bestowed to Michael Pantazis for his heroics in freeing the Annaiams from oppression. Michael never returned to the system named in his honour as, legend has it, he was sent by divine intervention.
system_71988_key: Binary (white DA1 dwarf, orange K1V dwarf), between Lave region and Empire space, with a single inhabitable ringed planet.
system_7198_key: Recognising the financial and technological rewards that come from centres of excellence, the Federal government along with various corporate sponsors funded the building of The Ekhi Biosciences Institute, now the foremost Federation centre for biochemical research.
system_72052_key: The home of the Black Sun Crew. The Black Sun Crew formed out of the collapse of several factions. They faced either assimilation or the uncertainty of their own independence; they chose independence. The Black Sun Crew spent weeks in the black conducting security missions, cargo transportation, and roaming the galaxy and collecting cartographic data. This time of hardship only made them stronger. Though every pilot is fiercely independent, they will always band together when needed.
system_72134_key:
The home of the Beyond Infinity Corporation.
The Beyond Infinity Corporation was founded in 3301 as a manufacturer of consumer electronics and network equipment supplier. After just a few years the company has grown up into an interstellar conglomerate.
Rumours suggest the company’s swift growth resulted from a massive collection of private data through its consumer and network branches, which was then advantageously exploited.
system_72147_key: The Flying Tigers Squadron is a group of mercenaries that has signed a contract with President Vidar Vondell of the Eta Draconis Gold Vision Company to help them become a major player in the galaxy. They stay in close contact with their sister squadron, the 8th Dragons (another EDC group), and both groups help each other out from time to time.
system_72150_key: Poor, low population extraction economy (Federal colony).
system_72228_key: A poorly developed Federal industrial system that was once known as V2306 Ophiuchi and G 153-059.
system_72284_key: The Order are a secret society obsessed with seeking out the mystery of Raxxla. They are violently dedicated to eradicating all alien life from the Milky Way to ensure human safety, hindering all progress into alien research other than our own, and seeking out all secrets in the universe. They are known to operate through infiltration and deceit to gather intelligence for our own gain.
system_72297_key: The home of Aurora Corporation, which was founded in 3304 by a handful of entrepreneurs, daring explorers and dangerous fighters.
system_72299_key: The system was also known as 13 Zeta Ophiuchi.
system_722_key:
The home of Obsidian Order.
Obsidian Order is a secretive group. Little is known about its ambitions or methods.
system_72383_key:
The home of Veritas Kingdom.
The private organisation of Veritas Kingdom is an expansionist entity, founded as an alternative for outlaws and independents who desired to conduct their business outside of the superpower territories. It is a mega-corporation, which has a professional military squadron to defend its interests, and is rumoured to have employed pirates for certain tasks.
system_72486_key:
The home of Guardians of the Void.
Guardians of the Void supports the less fortunate, mainly through revenues earned from mercenary work.
system_72498_key:
Landfall has one of the most interesting skies of all the known habitable planets, with no less than six stars bright enough to cast shadows at some time.
It also has the best preserved indigenous wildlife which cohabits successfully, often to the exclusion of introduced life.
system_724_key:
The Brightlight Training Corporation headquarters can be found in this small Federal service system.

'Your learning is our business.'
The permit for this system can be obtained from the Federal Military.
system_72556_key: A black-ops group specialising in infiltration, which masquerades as an outer-rim mining colony delivering rare metals to Alliance shipyards. The Sap Core Legion offers sanctuary to political dissidents from Alliance and Federation systems.
system_72583_key: Cerasus Security Forces rule their system with absolute power in order to fight against criminal organisations and maintain security.
system_72613_key: Space Vans Ltd is a small family run business specialising in galaxy-wide delivery of explosive and corrosive materials. Their pilots are trained to deal with all situations, so whether it's recovery, corporate espionage, logistics, they will get it done.
system_72903_key:
This system became famous after Fozard Entertainment's release of their extensive back catalogue in 3298.

'150 years of entertainment.'

Little is know about Arc's Angels. Some say the group is formed from fanatics who are preparing for the return appearance of alien life. Others say that they were formed to protect the innocent. Either way, members of this group should be approached with caution.
system_72976_key: A developing Federal industrial system that was once known as G 240-063.
system_72_ophiuchi_key:
The home of the Omega Imperium. This is the capital system of Omega Imperium, a progressivist welfare state. The Imperium states the exploration of the galaxy, the study of sentient alien species and cooperation with organizations of similar aims as its general goals.
The standard of living in Omega Imperium is high, with the government spending significantly on the development of science; this makes the state very attractive to top scientists.
They take pride in the quality of their architecture. The Palace of the Eternal Dragon, residence of the current Omega Emperor, is renowned for its size and beauty.
system_73033_key: Atlas was established in 3302 and has since had all records regarding its members' actions deemed classified. The permit for this system can be obtained by attaining prestige in CQC.
system_73078_key: Three clans from ancient Earth came together to form this Triad. They adhere to an ancient and esoteric philosophy from Earth's history.
system_73119_key: The home of the Outer Rim Outcast Coalition, a coalition of independent commanders who united to form their own government on the fringes of the bubble.
system_73228_key: The 10th Fleet was established in 3301 to aid in the Federation's military expansion under President Jasmina Halsey. After her disappearance, Zachary Hudson activated the 10th Fleet as a forward offensive force.
system_73303_key:
Ternary system consisting of a pair of yellow dwarf stars orbited by a distant white dwarf.

The Smiling Dog Crew operate from this system. They're a loose organisation of some of the galaxy's most formidable ex-military and criminal pilots. Their enterprises encompass mercenary contracts, murder for hire and infiltration. If there is a job deemed too dangerous for any other pilots, and if you can find them, then maybe you can hire the Smiling Dog Crew.
system_73316_key:
The Lightspeed Accommodation hotel chain has its flagship hotel in this system.

'Putting up with you for the night - or your money back!'
system_73483_key:
The Council of Mages is a secretive society that hides through anonymity amidst the vast population of the galaxy.  It prides itself on having operatives in many different fields, working together to create a cohesive unit. Reports indicate that members prioritise conducting business with outside endeavours without revealing their true allegiance.

Also known as 19 Delta Sagittarii.
system_73596_key: This system was colonised in May 3302 with the construction of the Aucharnie starport.
system_73641_key:
The home of Eichwald Kommune.
The Eichwald Kommune is an organization that primarily supports experimental research. Projects range from prototype spacecraft to weapons, industrial and medical research.
system_73676_key: Very high humidity and native life make this an interesting place to visit. Many exotic food stuffs are grown here. The scenery is strikingly beautiful, though the wildlife can be a little dangerous. Was known in ancient times as 3 Alpha Lyrae. The permit for this system can be obtained from the Federal Military.
system_73689_key: Bullies Mercenary Inc is a cooperative of soldiers, traders and miners for-hire. Got a problem that needs solving? Bullies Mercenary Inc is the answer. Its main purpose is to help independent systems remain independent, free from the corrupt influence of the Federation, the oppression of the Empire and the treachery of the Alliance.
system_73884_key: Originating from Sol, The Illawarra Freelancers consist of commanders from around the galaxy. This organisation does not limit itself to one field, instead they share the common goals of wealth, expansion and discovery.
system_73986_key:
The Fractale Community is primarily focused on bounty hunting and military support. Relatively active in day-to-day trading, members are not afraid to show their teeth if needed - or should a lucrative contract demand it.

Also known as 38 Zeta Sagittarii.
system_74047_key: This system is believed to be the source for the 'Wow!' signal received on Earth in 1977.
system_74145_key: The Crimson Guard is a privateer force that has gained notoriety for its merciless attacks on any ship from the Empire invading Federation space.
system_74167_key:
The home of The Black Watch.
Established at the birth of stellar travel, The Black Watch forms a solemn bulwark against the grim horrors of the endless black. Watchmen specialise in trade and warfare.
Its motto is, ‘The Watch is eternal.’
system_74182_key: The home of the Colonia Travel Agency. The Colonia Travel Agency was formed to give advice and guidance to those Commanders looking to make the long trip to Colonia. This faction takes pride in helping pilots select the correct craft, outfit it accordingly and provide information on routing and survival on the journey. They have since branched out into helping individuals settle in Colonia on a more permanent basis, and invite those interested to contact them.
system_74280_key:
Once a disputed system, this populous world became part of the Empire after the warming of relations between the Empire and the Federation. Once known as Delta Aquilae.

This is the home system for The Silver Skulls - an Imperial taskforce assigned to Liaedin to fortify and expand its strategic position within Federation space.

In May 3301 conflict erupted between Patron's Principles, an Empire-aligned organisation, and Federal pilots.
system_74306_key: The home of the Astronauts International. The Astronauts International group claim to own a lineage back to the beginning of human space travel. They can be seen trading commodities across the galaxy, and they are also known to be excellent combat pilots.
system_74310_key: The Red Baron is a newly formed faction born out of war and  death. It has earned a reputation for being merciless to the enemy and to those who don't uphold the law.
system_74342_key: Somewhat chaotic, but worth the effort.
system_74354_key: A low-level mining operation in a system once known as Alsafi.
system_7438_key: The Order of Mobius' founding principle is opposing aggression between commanders of the Pilots' Federation. The Order of Mobius is non-aligned in galactic politics, and is focused on commerce, exploration and defence.
system_7450_key:
This independent industrial system is home to the Hazardous Filtration Modules corporation.

'Better and cleaner environments for your ship.'
system_74538_key:
Very high humidity and native life make this an interesting place to visit. Many exotic food stuffs are grown here. The scenery is strikingly beautiful, though the wildlife can be a little dangerous. Was also known as Alpha Aquilae in ancient times.

The Elite Rebel Force are based here and are a group of mercenaries and bounty hunters. They are renowned for being both helpful and deadly.
system_74539_key:
The Flaming Fist began as a small band of pilots hired to provide security in unruly Federal systems. Their founder, Eltan Solaire, soon established a corporation independent of the Federation.

The Flaming Fist currently occupies 51 Aquilae and provides security and stability for the systems they occupy so that the people there may live in peace. The Flaming Fist business model is one of constant expansion. Any states or organisations that request the protection of the Flaming Fist must provide a sizable stake in their operations, weaving part of these groups into the Flaming Fist. In return, the Flaming Fist provides security and emergency services. This model allows the Flaming Fist to operate with fluidity and expertise in many fields while focusing on its personal expertise regarding security and emergency response.
system_74580_key: The Pheonix Legion is based in this system and they are mercenaries for hire.
system_7459_key:
Kewell Ergonomics has its main manufacturing plant in this system.

'You sit on it, we'll make it comfy.'
system_7460_key:
The home of the Laughing Camels.
The Laughing Camels are bounty hunters, explorers and traders. They hunt pirates all over the galaxy looking for the next bounty to turn in. Federally aligned, their main objective is to become a prominent faction in the galaxy.
system_74668_key: The home of The Parallax Federation, men and women that were once Federal Navy pilots, who have now come together to protect and serve the people of the Federation.
system_74774_key: The KW Corporation was established by two pilots who fight for freedom, justice and democracy.
system_74944_key:
Also known as Alpha Pavonis.

The home of the Erroneous Principles, Erroneous Principles is a combat focused faction. Reports suggest bounty hunting provides their main income, though they participate in exploration and trade to a lesser degree. They are known to hunt as a pack to ensure their objectives are achieved.
system_74987_key: The home system for Knox & Co - a humanitarian and liberal party, formed in 3301 as an amalgam of various socialist groups, supporting the interests of organised labour, and advocating corporate socialism and social equality.
system_74989_key: The home of the Free Space Rangers. FSR is a group of space explorers, free traders, warriors and adventurers. Their main task is to investigate the galaxy, help researchers and explore the boundaries where no other has gone before.
system_75026_key: Named by mistake, this system is well known for its cybernetics.
system_75072_key: The Kyrev Security Conglomerate are a paramilitary mercenary group with affiliated logistics personnel. They strive to create a safe region for all law-abiding citizens amidst the storm of the three superpowers.
system_75081_key:
A group of honourable men, founded in 932 on Sol 3. Still in the search for the Holy Grail.

We don't take the galaxy too seriously and sometimes fly Pythons indeed. Beware of the rabbit.
system_75107_key: Jesse Exploration and Travel Co is an exploration and travel service specialising in surveying and passenger transport.
system_75145_key:
The home of the Black Dragons.
Members of this group are actively engaged in the promotion of democracy. It seeks to trade and hunt pirates within its territory.
The faction is also motivated to explore the galaxy beyond the borders.
system_75384_key: The planet Scott was terraformed in 2329 as an agricultural colony, but the temperature could not be sustained and was abandoned in 2408 after a disease epidemic. The equatorial belt was resettled in 2641 by settlers who liked the harsh environment, now famous for fishing and tourism. It is particularly popular with industrial workers from nearby systems who otherwise live their whole lives indoors.
system_75426_key: A trinary system with a host of planets and moons supporting a mixed extraction and refinery economy. Its poor location has restricted its economic growth, but the system authorities are hoping that will improve now a new generation of hyperdrives is more prevalent.
system_75512_key: A small lawless system with limited extraction capacity. Also known as Alpha Cephei.
system_75531_key:
This expansive and highly populated system's primary economy is agriculture, but also supports active refinery facilities. The twin A class binary stars are also a popular attraction for spacers.

This system is known to support the freeing of slaves.
system_75590_key: The home of The Angius Imperium, formed in 3304 in the system of Ehecatl. The Angius Imperium are a group of pirates, traders, bounty hunters and everything in-between. They operate craft of all types, from powerful cruisers to nimble fighters, and work towards both the glory of the Empire and the prosperity of Ehecatl.
system_75613_key: The Trans-Galactic Slave Trade Corporation aims to use slaves for their most fundamental purpose: the generation of profit. As such, the corporation seeks to create and maintain popular slave-trade routes, with particular attention placed on routes between the territories of Archon Delaine and Zemina Torval. The corporation will use whatever means it deems necessary to ensure the flow of slaves continues unhindered.
system_75614_key: The Celestial Light Brigade is a ragtag group of idealists, united by their need to free innocents from tyranny. Many members are veterans of the Pegasi Pirate War who were displaced by Archon Delaine after fighting for the liberation of their homes. Many others are independent pilots aligned with the Brigade in order to eradicate evil from the galaxy. The Brigade, under Emily Tennyson, has aligned itself with Aisling Duval's message of liberation, and as such considers itself affiliated with the Empire. Its members remain committed to enfranchising the marginalised, avenging the dead and reclaiming their homeland.
system_75648_key: Hailing from Lo Pegasi, the Perin Initiative is a tight-knit band of pilots united in a mutual desire to maintain balance between the galactic powers. They remain independent from any major power's influence, although individual members hail from all factions, professions and walks of life. The primary goals of the Perin Initiative include exploration, investigating the unknown, scientific advancement, the liberation of people from oppression and slavery in whatever form it may take, and defending human space from both internal and external threats.
system_75811_key:
The TL Armoured Transport Company was founded in 3301 by CEO and Chairman Khalin Kilrain. Its focus is the development and enrichment of the Deneb Algedi system by providing extraction and transportation services, as well as maintaining security and peacekeeping forces for the welfare of the people of Deneb Algedi.

Also known as 49 Delta Capricorni.
system_75886_key:
The home system for the Fuel Rats Mischief.

"Looking for Fuel ? You've come to the right place."

Although the Fuel Rats can be found EVERYWHERE in the Galaxy, some of these philanthropic rodents with a love for all things Fuel think of this place as a home away from home where they can re-fit and re-stock before heading out into the dark to save another commander from a dry tank and death by asphyxiation.

"Don't get stranded, call the Fuel Rats!"
system_7588_key:
The Croft Stellar Dynamics corporation is based in this system.

'Tuning sensors so you never get caught out.'

The Hood Disciples are a corporatist group consisting of military personnel, merchants and explorers. They have settled colonies in the Dinda System and established a system of disciples that collectively make decisions on behalf of the organisation. Strategic Intelligence Agencies based on planet Hood orchestrate trade plans that manipulate nearby economies. THD's goal is to provide an environment within its systems that encourages growth and the refinement of its core skills in order to continually produce elite individuals.
system_76121_key:
The home of the Association of the Diamond Star League.
The Diamond Star League is a coalition of private pilots who believe in their independence. Its income is based on high value ore mining.
This faction focuses on hard work for fairly remuneration. It is involved in diverse transport operations and also employs a handful of bounty hunters.
Its motto is, 'From Dust to Diamond.'
system_7629_key:
The home of the 11th Squadron.
The 11th Squadron is a loosely-organized group of pilots dedicated to supporting all those who seek to spread skills and knowledge throughout inhabited space. It has a small leadership team which requests that members abide by a simple code of honour in all situations.
system_76337_key: Formed many centuries ago, the Swords of Imperius started as a militant sect of Imperial devotees. They took it upon themselves to do whatever was necessary to protect the great Imperial establishment from the savage police state that is the Federation. Throughout the First War, the Swords established themselves as a formidable and ruthless faction of pilots and earned themselves a reputation across civilisation.
system_76419_key:
The home of the Liandri Mining Corporation.
The Liandri Mining Corporation is a rock, mineral and gas conglomerate operating out of WW Piscis Austrini. In recent years it has expanded its interests into privateering and contracting services. It now provides support across inhabited space through both firepower and philanthropy.
system_76492_key: The home of the Sigma Proxy, A group of otherwise affiliated pilots who often band together to take on missions and get away from the political agendas and trickery  of the galactic superpowers.
system_76526_key: This system enjoys the patronage of Senator Zemina Torval.
system_76530_key: This is a poorly policed system with little to interest the legitimate trader.
system_76537_key: The Imperial Hegemony of Palaiologos is a newly constituted state that was born out of the need for security in a region that was politically and economically unstable. This faction specialises in synthesising chemicals commonly used in terraforming, as well as having a robust knowledge of interstellar commerce. It has a sizable fleet to protect its assets and the citizens under its banner.
system_76682_key: Applied Starport Safety Technologies Corporation’s origins date back to the evacuation of a starport during an inter-system conflict, where a group of pilots decided to help in the rescue and evacuation of civilians and personnel. Their ships took on as many passengers as possible, working together to protect the resulting convoy and safely arrive at a secure destination. The shared experience led to the formation of this faction, which prides itself on companionship and selflessness.
system_76713_key:
The home of LHS Mining Crew.
The LHS Mining Crew is a large ensemble of miners constantly searching for wealth, always and via any possible avenues. They are content to pursue profits through mining ventures or diplomacy.
system_76725_key:
The home of the Guardians of Ancient Terrene.
The Guardians of Ancient Terrene are explorers who seek the unknown. It is a collective of passionate warriors.
system_76745_key: The First Imperial Fleet faction are based in this system.
system_76782_key: A quasi-religious group dedicated to the ideals of the Golden King (Aurus Rex), a mythic figure prophesied to lead the human race for 1,000 years in a galactic war against unknown enemies. With the appearance of nonhuman structures, many believe aliens are those prophesied enemies, and now look for the appearance of the Golden King, working to build him a base of power from which he might defend humanity.
system_76867_key: The 502nd Legion was founded by Imperial naval commanders, and is devoted to serving and protecting the Empire. They also have a large presence in the Nehet system, and serve mainly as a military force, but they also offer private security services to wealthy Imperial citizens.
system_76902_key: Senator Denton Patreus favours this system with his patronage.
system_76913_key: G-CLAN found a new home in this system in early 2288, shortly after Mars was terraformed and Earth became a very expensive place to live. Their main goal is to protect their ancestors' great legacy, and to spread their values in every corner of the galaxy.
system_76915_key: Nova Corporation is a multi-service organisation focusing on foreign affairs, such as diplomacy and warfare. They offer escort and espionage services, and their forces are available to promote the expansion of other smaller factions.
system_76924_key:
The home of the Void Lords.
The Void Lords are an enigmatic group that are believed to have contacts in every aspect of spacefaring. They have called the void their home.
system_76987_key:
A developing Federal agricultural world that was once known as Gamma Cephei.

The home system for the Blood Brothers from Alrai. They are a group of combat and trade pilots that protects traders and other pilots, and maintain law and order.
system_76988_key: The Armed Wing is the name of the Qrow Family's royal guard. Currently, the Armed Wing protects the last living heir of the Qrow Family, Percival Qrow. They are not only a royal guard but also a faction open to trading and exploration.
system_76995_key: The Engineering Council are inspiring the next generation of engineers and technicians, informing the wider engineering community, and influencing government to advance society.
system_77007_key: The Bubble Collective started out as a shampoo company, but quickly rose to become the most reliable company to provide all cleaning equipment. 'Warp Cleaners' are their most popular product, which clean the Frame Shift Drives of a spacecraft. The Bubble Collective now has numerous divisions, including transport, exploration and trading. It will help other factions in exchange for protection and business opportunities.
system_7700_key: The home of The Cerberus Confederation. The Cerberus Confederation is a group of pilots aiming to unite the entire Galaxy under one power. This faction is focused on trade, mining and bounty hunting. They are known for spreading their views across the galaxy, calling for both union between galactic superpowers and the cultivation of peaceful diplomacy between humans and Thargoids.
system_77017_key: This star system was named by Commander Flak in loving memory of his late wife, Sheron, who sadly passed away on the 15th of July 3303 in the Sol system.
system_77104_key: Established on August 5th 3301, the Tatar Republican Party's main goal is the development of trade, protection of property and establishment of independent courts. The party is open for free traders, honest miners and advanced researchers. Universal values, human rights and freedom are of the utmost importance to them.
system_77125_key: The home of Wrecking Crew, an independent organisation working cooperatively to disrupt the established governments of the galaxy.
system_77185_key: The Cosmohounds are a fanatical group comprised of combat pilots and scientific researchers. They believe black holes are objects to be studied and preserved, and use force as a means to secure systems for their science teams.
system_77203_key: This barely developed lawless system is known for its shady dealings. Also known as G 158-027.
system_77218_key: The Federation Freedom Corps recruits skilled combat pilots dedicated to the Federation and President Zachary Hudson. They are committed to expanding and defending Federal space, and reject any activities involving the slave trade. They welcome pilots who participate in bounty hunting, trade, mining, hauling, and are loyal to the Federation and the only true supreme commander, Zachary Hudson.
system_77220_key: The home of Project Elite, once a proud centre for advanced pilot training, now run by a ragtag group who attempt to live up to the Project Elite name by training new pilots.
system_77246_key: Black Sails Sq.69 are based here. They are a group of miners that fled from a civil war in order to build up a new home.
system_77248_key:
A small Federal industrial economy that has seen better days - much to the dismay of the Bar Low Clothing consortium.

'For the real you.'
system_77249_key: This system is locked by the Pilots' Federation, no permits are currently issued.
system_77257_key: The Reddot system is named after its red dwarf star. Other than Motherlode and Whit's Station (see below), there is little in the system of worth or interest. It is reasonably close to Imperial and Federation space but not resource-rich enough to receive much in the way of interest from them, which of course makes it a prime place for pirates and other criminals to hide out in. It is also quite close to a number of resource-rich systems that are ripe for raiding.
system_77276_key: Origin Systems United are dedicated to the research of alien species.
system_77307_key: Something happened here, but the locals won't talk about it.
system_77319_key: Praetorian PMC is a group of mercenaries committed to helping civilians and the galactic community.
system_77349_key:
A centre for bio-industrial research. Rumoured to have a thriving black market.

The home of Ruby Incorporated.
Ruby Incorporated aims to provide quality for a number of innovative products. Its manufacturing process contributes to a wide range of commodities, ranging from personal weapons to household products.
system_77360_key: The home of Deathwing Fleet, a Federation-aligned faction.
system_77370_key: The home of STAR Laboratories, a dedicated team of scientist who've taken it upon themselves to venture into the unknown and uncover its secrets.
system_77386_key: The home of the Bounty Hunters Guild. The Bounty Hunters Guild have declared a single purpose: “If you decide to commit a crime, we will find you and remove you from the stars.
system_77389_key: A diverse league of combat pilots and occasional explorers, recruited from the bounty hunters and pirates of the Tascheter Sector and nearby systems. The Order of the Red Wolf carries out missions the Federation Navy will not, or cannot, handle.
system_77396_key: Famous for its Blue Marbled Mountains and Great Sulphur Desert on Amar, and 'The Crystal Sphere' of Sippar, Marduk has become a centre for outdoor activities, sightseers and romantics.
system_77404_key: The Hong Kong Cavaliers were originally a rock and roll band, performing across the bubble. Times and tastes change, and they now serve the galaxy by helping bring peace. They still play great music though.
system_77405_key: Long since mined-out, Lycan Moon Mining has relegated this system to a dumping ground for waste materials and personnel. Dealing with the authorities here is a bureaucratic nightmare. If a contractor can bypass the red tape, there are warehousing, data storage and waste 'treatment' facilities available. There are almost no exports, other than small quantities of metals and minerals, and unsanctioned free-trade carries a hefty surcharge.
system_77410_key: Iridium Wing was founded by Commander WinterCharm on 29 Jan 3302, following the death of Commander Carbonheart during the completion of an exploration mission. Iridium Wing's purpose is to provide armed escort to all exploration vessels as they enter or leave occupied space. These services are run by volunteer pilots and are free of charge. Politically, Iridium Wing is neutral.
system_77412_key: Known colloquially as 'Exec Central', this system hosts the regional headquarters of several companies and corporations who work in close collaboration under the name 'The Proteus Collective'. Unlike most corporate systems, there is rumoured to be a lucrative trade in illegal goods, much of which is high tech. 'Unofficial' smuggling is not tolerated: termination is the only penalty.
system_77420_key: Rich in rare minerals and, at times, ravaged by internecine conflict, Tomas is notable for the unique Hernandez-Campillo trinary planets.
system_77432_key: Chopper Station was built in the system in January 3302.
system_77469_key: The deep and highly mechanised Imperial mines are renowned for their efficiency at ore extraction. Slavery is also important for the routine supervision of the machinery in the unpleasant mining environment.
system_77473_key:
The home of Copernicus Consolidated Enterprise.
Copernicus Consolidated Enterprise began when a small group of traders needed protection. This group sought to profit from the many stations in the Caerus system. They soon realised, however, that the system was too dangerous to travel without escort.
Seeking a reliable solution, the traders hired a number of bounty hunters who had gained experience fighting pirates within the system's planetary rings. After several major successes, the two groups decided to permanently merge and now hope to establish a greater influence in its home system and beyond.
system_77478_key: The home of the Fellowship of 11. The Fellowship of 11 is a loosely organized group of pilots, dedicated to the mentorship of new and experienced pilots alike; often only united in a common goal to share this philosophy through inhabited space. They claim no specific political affiliation or highly structured leadership, and ask only that pilots abide by a simple code of honour in all matters.
system_77493_key: The Diggers Invictus work to better the health and welfare of their system, aiding the Federation using non-violent measures unless provoked.
system_77538_key: Fortune has indeed smiled upon this binary star system with three terraformed planets around the companion star supporting a large agricultural economy. For xenobiologists there are two worlds supporting simple water based life. With so many treasures this is a popular destination for tourists.
system_77543_key: A sparsely populated system which a small extraction and refinery economy. This system is known to be the haunt of a ruthless criminal gang whose income is derived from fixing tug races.
system_77551_key: Phoenix Corp is an elite unit specialising in close combat and xenobiological research and development. It is an independent organisation willing to accept any assignment if the price is right.
system_77556_key: This small extraction and refinery system isn't really known for much of anything.
system_77567_key:
The home of the Federal Mercenaries. Near the end of 3303, a few Commanders unexpectedly crossed paths. They spent months in different systems, fulfilling a wide variety of job roles and engaging in more than a few combat operations, coming to learn about one another. Eventually, these Commanders felt like they should perform their duties under the name of Zachary Hudson and the Federation.
The Federal Mercenaries strive to complete every order given to them, while neutralising any threat that opposes the Federation and the Federal Mercenaries.
system_7757_key:
A disgraced ex-judge's retirement nest egg where he breeds the rare Bog Spaniel, which makes such lifelike duck calls that some interesting cross breeds are now being researched.

The home of Greater Tascheteri Republic (GTR), which seeks to bring the whole of the Tascheteri sector under the influence of the Federation through advancement of its democratic interplanetary charter. It aims to serve as a liberal buttress against the encroaching power of the Empire, given its location in the tense no-man's land of systems that makes up the border between the superpowers, and is willing to use military force to achieve these ends.

The GTR has lately called for the assistance of independent and Federally-aligned pilots to assist in expanding its influence in the region.
system_77580_key: This system supports a small extraction and refinery economy. The locals are known for an extreme sport which involves skimming their local sun.
system_77596_key: The Darklight Order originated as a deep space expeditionary fleet, almost entirely lost to the void. The survivors became the leaders of a council that would soon become the Darklight Order.
system_77604_key: Corinthian Corporate is a mercenary-backed corporation that participates in a variety of business and military ventures.
system_77608_key:
The home of the Lone Night Wolves Association.
The Lone Night Wolves Association was created to unite pilots regardless of experience, in order to jointly engage in a variety of operations. Its stated goal is to achieve prosperity through united actions within legal boundaries.
system_77617_key:
SPF-LF 1's official history is closely tied to the small group who first occupied it.

Inspired by retro-sim space exploration games, Commander Anderson's (a pseudonym understood to be a tribute to a 2D movie) fantasy of a life of exploration and trading became a reality when a school trip to a local fuel-rich star suffered a unexpected 'accident', resulting in the 'loss' of Anderson and a tight-knit crew of retro-sim obsessed friends. 

The group successfully discovered and claimed systems by adopting a technology that became known as 'Retro-Combat' (RC). In RC, ships, planets and stations are rendered on small square screens as simple juddery wireframes and all other visuals are removed (bar 'star dust' to illustrate direction of movement). This simplification of complex reality enabled the RC 'players' to focus solely on their objective, ignoring distractions and reducing adrenalin release.

Some hard-core RC players ritualised their 'game' further by adding bleeps to co-inside with (and drown out) the sounds of laser fire. Some even play tinny but catchy symphonies to pass the time when manually docking. 

So successful was the RC approach in combat, mining and freighting that the small crew were able to not only hold on to, but flourish on SPF-LF 1 and go on to discover and populate other systems. 

SPF-LF 1 is unspoilt, beautiful and high tech but fashions and tastes are stuck nostalgically on 'old Earth' in the last quarter of the 20th century.
system_77637_key: The Screaming Goats are a cooperative of miners, explorers and bounty hunters looking to defend and protect others from piracy.
system_77641_key: The home of The Terran Corporation. The Terran Corporation is a company that deals with most branches of galactic business and operations. However, reports have suggested that this is a front for a clandestine organization responsible for piracy, smuggling and alien technology acquisition.
system_77646_key: The home of the 42nd Federal Fleet. The 42nd Federal Fleet was formed in 3304 as a direct response to growing threats to Federation space.
system_7765_key: An Imperial prison colony famed for its harsh treatment of inmates.
system_77666_key: An unfriendly system run by a dark cult whose members always number 666.
system_77705_key: This system is home to the corporate arm of the Minutemen - a private fleet of Federal pilots that formed in response to the growing bureaucracy of the Federal Navy. The Minutemen are dedicated to providing a safe place for any pilot looking for an organisation free from drama and politics. As a group they support the Liberal party and the Shadow President Felicia Winters, but not all of their members share that allegiance.
system_77711_key: Parallax Stellar Dynamics has long been an innovator in the spacecraft industry, most notably for the development and production of propulsion-based components. Despite an extensive reputation as an upstanding corporation backed by the Federation, many pilots hear rumours of illicit operations orchestrated by a corrupted power from within the shadows.
system_77715_key: The Galactic Co-operative of Worlds was once the unifying galactic government of the majority of human populated space. However, due to a series of catastrophic problems they collapsed and many of their worlds re-aligned to the Federation and Empire, which both rose up to fill the void as superpowers. GalCop's core worlds went on to join the Alliance, similar to the alliance which spawned GalCop in the beginning. Now, factions from all over human space have pulled together to recreate GalCop and attempt to revive the once great unifying power.
system_77728_key: The home of the Lucky Rocket Privateers, a loose-knit band of plucky privateers who lead a rather bohemian, anarchic life performing daring capers throughout the cosmos. Their major pass-times are bounty hunting, exploration and SRV racing.
system_77740_key:
The home of Platinum Fuel Corporation.
Platinum Fuel Corporation was founded in 3304. It is researching existing fuel technologies with the intent of improving the efficiency of thrusters and frame shift drives to support deep space navigation. As part of this initiative, the corporation is studying new fuel compression technology to make the ship carry more fuel.
system_77751_key: Ace Pilot Association was formerly an independent organisation that has since incorporated with its respective home government.
system_77775_key: The home of the 44th Vulture Syndicate. The 44th is an independent Federal fighter squadrons. They are comprised mostly of ex-Federal navy pilots or independent pilots with a special bond to the Vulture craft, and embrace the duty of eradicating crime and murder within Federal space. This faction offers escort services, combat support and many different skills where numbers and firepower are needed; The Vulture Syndicate will happily adapt to your needs.
system_77776_key: Twin Suns Assassins is a group of outcasts who left home and hearth to seek their fortunes, renouncing the tyranny and corruption to which they had become accustomed. After months of wandering, fate rewarded them with a beautiful system to call their own.
system_77787_key: The home of the Affiliates of Rhea-Sol Entrepreneurial Society. The Affiliates of Rhea-Sol is a venturist organisation which received a charter in 3304 to help facilitate existing and future corporate investments from Sol into Rhea and its nearby systems, from their home system of LP 908-11. By being granted the opportunity to manipulate the flow of capital into significant systems such as Rhea, the Affiliates of Rhea-Sol aim to become a substantial political force.
system_77788_key: Poor, low population refinery economy (independent corporate state).
system_77805_key: Poor, low population extraction economy (independent dictatorship).
system_77820_key:
A group of independent pilots, calling themselves "The Allies" rose from the Quivira War. Their goal was to support the Alliance of Independent Systems in the name of freedom and justice. To aid those in need, the group ultimately founded the "Perez Ring Brewery".

Today the famous Perez Beer from LHS 2637 funds most of the group's activities - and thereby freedom and justice for millions of people. Even though the Perez Ring Brewery is from a legal point 'corporate', it is politically a strong advocate of democracy and human rights.
system_77823_key:
The home of Nexxus Drako Interstellar.
Nexxus Drako Interstellar is a collective of traders, explorers and bounty hunters seeking to blaze their own trail across the galaxy.
system_77824_key: Quisquilious Starlight Co is a faction that puts their lives on the line to preserve the peace and order of their sanctuary.
system_77832_key: The home of the Low Stargazers Co, which was once a part of a wider community until its members rebelled against their governor and escaped to seek new horizons.
system_77834_key: One Ring Explorers is an interstellar organisation with the goal of selling the results of scientific research to the highest bidders.
system_77842_key: Lore and Myths Sciences is a group of pilots interested in information about all kinds of legends and myths. It finances various expeditions through exploration and trade. It is independent and happy to work with other organisations to create an information trading network. Rumours point towards a secret database of discoveries that is kept under careful guard.
system_77898_key:
Poor, low population extraction economy (independent corporate state).

The home of the Stellar Tracker Initiative, a private military organisation dedicated to bringing justice and security where needed.
system_778_key:
JetForce Dynamics have their primary manufacturing facilities in this system.

'Getting you there with the power of air.'

The home of Hyperion Intelligence Agency. Chastised for their imperialistic views while serving their original faction in Federation space, these renegade members broke from their conservative masters. A conflict ensued where the separatist forces expedited the destruction of their former faction, exiling them from their home. These progressive commanders reformed as the Hyperion Intelligence Agency and then sought out a home in Imperial space to begin building their ruthless and effective faction, specialising in subterfuge and system control.
system_77900_key: Poor, low population refinery economy (Federal colony).
system_77914_key: This system is locked by the Pilots' Federation, no permits are currently issued.
system_77917_key:
Poor, low population refinery and extraction economy (Federal democracy).

The home of Acihaut Naval Front, which consists of highly skilled, battle-hardened pilots who have taken an oath to provide combat assistance, security, and reconnaissance for areas in Federation control.
system_77919_key: The Beyond Interstellar Agency is a faction actively dedicated to exploration, trade, knowledge-sharing and defence.
system_77920_key:
Poor, low population extraction economy (anarchy).

LP 98-132 is an anarchic system with a solitary small M2V type dim red star. There isn't a lot here, though there is some mining of valuable minerals like cobalt, rutile and coltan, and very occasionally of gold. Piracy is rife here with pirates on the lookout for those high value cargos. There is a station called Freeport operated by a group of locals, and this is the nearest thing to law that exists in the system.
system_77926_key: Poor, low population industrial economy (Federal democracy).
system_77939_key: Poor, low population extraction economy (Federal colony).
system_77944_key: The home of The Lightwave Initiative, an organisation dedicated to enlightening civilisations to the Truth. By hook or by crook, there will be light.
system_77945_key: The Thunderbird Corporation is actually a democratic government, whose goals feature research, science and exploration.
system_77956_key: This system is locked by the Pilots' Federation, no permits are currently issued.
system_77965_key:
The home of the Helix. Helix is a player group focused on cooperation and teamwork, pursuing research, trade, exploration and combat in squads. They have pledged to spill blood while protecting humanity.
Trade is focused on the production of materials required to construct ships and weaponry; they explore the unknown and search the galaxy for mystery; they fight all adversaries with great tenacity.
system_77977_key: The home of the United Systems Imperium. The United Systems Imperium is an independent dictatorship that rose to prominence in response to the perceived corruption of the Alliance, Federation, and Empire. The Imperium is dedicated to helping others, as well as dedicating its members to three basic principles: Peace, Power, and Progress. The Imperium seeks to unite the Galaxy under a single banner and single ruler, the aim being to protecting humanity from any who threaten it.
system_77979_key: 10th Legion Industries was founded by former Federation pilots. Since its formation it has provided a number of services in the private sector including defence contracts, consultancy, espionage and private security.
system_77993_key: Poor, low population industrial economy (Federal democracy).
system_77999_key:
In 2959, a lone commander was ripped out of hyperspace by an unknown vessel. While the ship was rendered inoperable, this commander managed to salvage parts for a makeshift escape pod.
The commander reached Faraday Station in the LHS 6309 system some time later, but his story was regularly dismissed until the year 3125 and the first officially recorded contact with the Thargoids.
Those who always believed this commander’s tale, passed down within his community, eventually became known as Drifters.
system_78007_key:
Agricultural economy (Federal democracy).

This system is the pride of the Berg's Trans Stellar Food, which is one of the most successful corporations in the food industry.

'Fresh for You.'
system_78021_key: LeMat Partnership was native to Earth, in a country called France. Created by Honoré LeMat in 1980, they were a small business producing models of guns. By selling weapons originally, they were one of many firms who supported the terraforming and building of bases on Mars. After profitable trading in Sol, they moved to a surrounding star system, LHS 3262, where they developed their own government.
system_78043_key: The home of We Got This Corp. Uttering their famous last words, "I've got this guys", is the trademark of the faction as they delve headfirst into combat far beyond their capabilities. They fight for the freedom of all, and seek the annihilation of pure evil.
system_78052_key: Your Husk Federation is a small faction, mainly engaging in bounty hunting and passenger transportation.
system_78067_key: The home of 501st Legion, whose members are actively engaged in the promotion of a democratically-approved political agenda.
system_78080_key: The home of the Infinite Corporation. A Federal corporation that excels in trading and other lucrative endeavours. This faction originated from a group of smugglers, assembling from across the inhabited galaxy.
system_78088_key: Aurora Australis Axiom is an organisation built on hard lessons. Guided by ancient cultural ideals which are reportedly known only to the upper levels of its hierarchy, the faction works to bring security and prosperity to those within its sphere of influence. Axiom promotes the distribution of knowledge, scientific learning and strategic business tactics.
system_78101_key:
The home of Galactic Squadron of Torgue.
Galactic Squadron of Torgue is an independent cooperative of pilots. It considers anti-xeno combat as its main activity, alongside some trading, mining and bounty hunting.
system_78120_key: The permit for this system can be obtained via the Luyten 347-14 Prison Colony faction.
system_78158_key: Once a family business specialising in creating recognition and tracking systems, Smart Industry is now a major scientific manufacturing corporation. It received its main revenue during the civil war in Achelous 1 by fulfilling military contracts and successfully implementing its designs on the frontline. In appreciation, Planetary Democratic Coalition contributed to the building of the orbital space station Smart Hub. Nowadays it seeks to expand its markets and influence beyond the system.
system_78163_key: Starship Enterprises was first founded in 3295 to provide rare artefacts and goods of high value exclusively to the rich and famous. Using the success of this venture as a launch pad, Starship Enterprises then branched out into various other sectors, including private security, exploration and mining, and now has a good working relationship with a number of other corporate entities as well as having strong diplomatic ties to the republican party of the Federation. Starship Enterprises currently operates to secure the corporate interests of a number of Federation factions. Their head office can be found in the Whitson Orbital in 339-7.
system_78183_key: The Canadian Space Enterprise was founded in the year 2951 by three fearless pilots. They are an underground agency willing to do anything if the client has enough money.
system_78184_key: KAOS ENGINEERING is a select group spurning the requirements of Government and society to create a new truth. K.E. rejects restrictions placed on the Galaxy by established government and advocates equality for all. It is the ultimate aim of K.E. to bring about the downfall of these established governments through any means available.
system_78233_key: The Order of the Frozen Light enacts the will of its sun gods, the bringers of frozen light. Zealots and fanatics steered by prophets and oracles, they worship dying stars and the glacial worlds around them.
system_78242_key:
The Democrats of LHS 3749 are noted for training pilots for the Federation. The high level of activity in the system makes this a good system to train pilots for smuggling, transport and combat. The Big G Squadron was the first squadron created to support the logistical transport routes between Nanomam and LHS 3749. They also protect LHS 3749.

The Democrats swore allegiance to the Federation after the Great War of LHS 3749. The Federation supported them during the conflict and pushed them to become a democracy.
system_78256_key: The Hyperion Star Alliance operates from this system. It is an alliance of cultures and trades from all corners of the galaxy who pride themselves in being the top operators in all fields including trade, exploration and combat.
system_78266_key: The Knights of Sol Eternal are dedicated to the protection of the Sol system. The faction also seeks to establish a more influential role in the galactic community for itself. Reports indicate that members regularly delve into the mysteries of the galaxy, with a willingness to share any discoveries with the rest of humanity.
system_78273_key:
Gilgamesh Corps Orbital Protection (GCOP) is a militaristic dictatorship originating from Chambo. Reports suggest June 3305 as the date of its foundation, though this estimate comes via third-party sources as GCOP members are notoriously reluctant to discuss specifics with outsiders.

Starting out as a bounty hunting organisation, the group recently relocated its forces to LHS 3836 with greater ambitions. Its history suggests that members are authorised to use force in pursuit of GCOP goals.

Its motto is, ‘Alea Iacta Est; Ad Astra Per Asperato.’
system_78337_key: The Reserve Imperial Logistic Auxiliary Fleet (RILAF) is a front organisation which in reality is the product of Imperial Navy Intelligence. Dr. Maxwell Shradre has been chosen to head up this organisation of pilots (some of which are new to Clandestine Operations). The Stated goal of RILAF is to support Imperial Efforts, providing supplies and logistical support for Imperial Fleet after increased tensions between the Empire and the Federation. RILAF's real goal is to slip across Federation borders and destabilise their governments!
system_7841_key:
The home of the Abysse Corp.
This young group of independent pilots monitors the commercial flow of ships in this system. It also works to contain the risk of external strikes and ensure the safety of the region’s inhabitants.
system_78444_key: SIRA (Settlement, Investment & Realty of the Arietis) Interstellar is a peculiar corporate group consisting of well-equipped and experienced individuals of various creeds who aim for a life without oppressive superpowers and impotent bureaucracies. The members share an unorthodox methodology in achieving their goals, such as the reallocation of commodities from unsuspecting traders, and issuing involuntary existence suspension on opposing pilots.
system_78448_key: The home of Zeus and Apollo Industries, a supplier to many larger industrial factions. It specialises in procurement, escort and distribution of industrial supplies.
system_78454_key: A system as dull as its dwarf star. Move along, nothing to see here.
system_78480_key: The home of the German Dealer and Fighter Union. The German Dealer and Fighter Union is an independent faction made up of traders, explorers and fighters. They have joined forces to confront the elements of space, yet still support each member to further development and experience.
system_78502_key: The F99th were established by the Federal government to support democracies in and around LHS 215. The founding members can trace their lineage to an ancient Sol fighter squadron.
system_78512_key: This binary star system contains a few terrestrial planets around the companion star supporting a mixed industrial and refinery economy. Its modest population are known to enjoy various forms of low gravity sports.
system_78534_key:
The home of the Corte dos Lobos de Ferro.

The Court of the Iron Wolves started as a home for pilots claiming Brazilian ancestry who were unwilling to carry banners for the superpowers. The pack grew bigger and now contains combatants, explorers and traders from across the galaxy. 
Members adhere to the tactic of wolves: many individuals can triumph over the mighty when working together.
system_7854_key:
The Independent Light Wheel operates from this system. It is a mysterious group who claimed ownership of the Porco City station from an anarchistic faction at the end of the year 3301. The search for the proper base lasted for several years and required considerable effort and credits.

The group is strictly led by one of the Friman Clan elders.

It was rumoured that one of the members went from one side of the galaxy to the other and found something related to an unknown alien race.

After that he went forward and, with mysteriously gained riches, he "claimed" HIP 14031. The mysterious artefact is rumoured to be researched in Boss City station by the name "Project Light Wheel".
system_78557_key:
The home of the Sirius Research Corp. Sirius Research Corp invests in the exploration of our galaxy, gathering data about its inhabitants, and establishing strategic partnerships through trade. They believe there is no alternative for our survival. Their faith is in finding and developing technology to allow us to discover, cultivate and defend humanity's new frontiers.
Sirius Research Corp technicians have a reputation for producing finely-tuned ships.
system_78625_key:
The home of the Solaires Sunbros, 'Praise the Sun!'
Solaires Sunbros joins together in jolly cooperation to achieve its goals of intergalactic collaboration, aid, and economic prosperity.
system_78667_key: Disavowed by the Federation because of their past losses, the 7th Armada has returned. With the approach of unknown life forms,  encounters with Unknown Artefacts, and the Federal Intelligence Agency ignoring the Alliance war machine, the 7th Armada has returned from exile to push back the Alliance, and regain control of Federation Space and restore their honour.
system_78681_key: The True Federal Corporation is dedicated to increasing profits through any means possible. Their ultimate purpose is the betterment of the Federation's corporate system.
system_78699_key: This system is home to the Sons of Icarus. They are a tightly knit group of independent pilots working for themselves... and the money.
system_78721_key: Poor, low population extraction economy (Federal colony).
system_78745_key: This system is rich with minerals and metallic ores supporting an established extraction enterprise. In the outer reaches of the system is a treat for xenobiologists with an ammonia world with active lower order life.
system_78755_key:
Agricultural economy (Federal democracy).

The home of Confederate Coalition, a military organisation comprised of pilots looking to protect all who seek liberation from the Empire and Alliance.
system_78788_key:
The home of the Legionarios Corp.
The Legionarios Corp. was established by adventurers in the Draco constellation, founded on a policy of mutual aid and sustainable development. It is devoted to a handful of enterprises including commerce, exploration and bounty hunting.
system_78835_key:
A binary system with a well established agricultural economy and population on its single terraformed world. There are also ample mineral riches in the system supporting a secondary extraction economy. Two gas giants orbiting around the companion star are often visited by xenobiologists researching the life forms living in their upper atmospheres.

Bluford Orbital built in May 3302.
system_78940_key: Dedicated to the betterment of mankind, Sentinel Logistics Services prides itself on offering transport, exploration, materials acquisition and security to everyone, no matter their political leanings.
system_78962_key: The home of Aegion Cartel, which aims to control all trade, illegal or otherwise, in the area.
system_7898_key: The Militia for Independent Research was formed in 3302, when a group of pilots banded together to defeat the Imperial blockade of a crashed alien ship in the Pleiades. MIR claims to stand for unity, science and peace. Their stated goal is to liberate all alien-related research sites from the control of superpowers they deem “corrupt”, allow any civilian scientist to access these sites, and release all findings to the public for free, without any censorship.
system_79002_key: Also known as Wezen or Wesen.
system_79004_key: A tiny mining operation whose importance resides in its proximity to Sol. The system was once known as WISE 1049-5319.
system_79075_key: Redshift Logistics is an independent corporation whose main business operations include logistics, mining and security contracting. Redshift Logistics chose Wise 1506+7027 as a headquarters due to its central location within inhabited space and relative proximity to Sol. From here Redshift Logistics deploys members to engage with new business opportunities and rapidly respond to any threats. Disruptive operations are reportedly aimed at rivals to hamper competition in acquiring new contracts.
system_791_key:
While Gal-Cop has been accused of cashing in on the historic name of GalCop, that hasn't stopped the corporation from flourishing.

'To Protect and Serve.'
system_7984_key:
ATU Corp specialises in galactic trade and warfare. It provides aid in many ways, offering assistance to local systems embroiled in conflict while facilitating the long-haul trade of supplies with remote communities.

Its motto is, ‘United Nationally, One Team’
system_8108_key:
The home of Inferno Express Corporation.
An independent business organisation that works in conjunction with its home government. Inferno Express Corporation began as a collective of individuals who participated in many fields of expertise. They decided to form a defensive coalition, overseeing a firm of hired mercenaries. This success led the faction to receive contract offers in a variety of specialised areas.
system_81304_key: The Elite German Commanders are an ancient group of pilots established centuries ago on the old planet Earth. They fight for justice and to keep the universe in balance.
system_8141_key: The home of the Sun Bat's Raiders. Sun Bat's Raiders is a group of handpicked combat oriented pilots who follow no laws
system_8193_key:
This developing system is known for being the corporate headquarters for Consolidated Plasma Corp.

'We fight fire with fire. Hotter fire.'
system_8205_key:
The home of the Shadows of the Void. Hidden amongst the many planets of their home system, the Shadows of the Void formed in this region of space. Spoken of only in rumours and whispers, the Shadows move amongst the weak, the oppressed and the enslaved: bringing hope where there is only fear. 
While their presence is seldom seen, their influence is often felt. Their motto is, 'A shadow only exists where there is light, and where there is light, there is hope.'
system_8210_key: A religious sect, parishioners of Obsidian Sky Enclave are followers of Pietas, a faith which draws parallels between classic Earth mythology and modern knowledge of the universe. Obsidian Sky Pietans focus their worship on the Pietan god Nyx, goddess of the night, who they believe manifests via the creation of black holes. Obsidian Sky's administrative centre of worship is located in HIP 14619.
system_8277_key: Interstellar Line is a transport company, dealing mostly with passengers. They also have a security arm, and will occasionally accept mercenary contracts.
system_841_key:
The headquarters for Manticore Munitions is situated within this system.

'Efficient. Deadly. Manticore.'
system_8455_key: A barren system with rich asteroid mineral deposits and one hospitable world. An ice planet, Fafner, has the distinction of possessing a top soil free from crop pathogens when kept below 2C. However, the indigenous vegetation is slow-growing. Its most expensive export is the 'mookah', a small soft-furred quadruped that stains its multi-coloured fur sludge brown when it dies – something it does easily unless regularly stroked. The meat is extremely bitter, but they have found a niche as an expensive pet. Most trade is done with the Imperials, who use slaves to tend the animals individually during transit. The permit for this system can be obtained via the Dukes of Jotun faction.
system_84_key: This system is home of the Black Sky Division, a group of elite pilots that resigned from the Federal Navy to help defend the galaxy from threats both foreign and domestic.
system_8504_key: Brazilian Armada X is an independent faction with a democratic government that supports the freedom of its commanders. Its ultimate purpose is to unite the galaxy under one flag, and Brazilian Armada X is ready to do whatever it takes to achieve that; from controlling markets to starting wars.
system_8552_key:
Also known as 13 Zeta Eridani. The home of The Brigade.
A group of mercenaries specialising in turning the tide of war in favour of the highest bidder, The Brigade travels anywhere that forceful resolutions are needed and quickly makes its presence known.
system_8554_key:
The Dark Society Network operates from this system.

"We are not here to protect the weak or save the innocent. They must protect themselves from us.
We make war to get what we want.
For the right price our services can be bought. 
Only our allies are safe from us.
We are loyal to our allies and true to our word.
We are for fair play."
system_8626_key: Armada was born from an elite cadre of mercenaries who opposed the exploitation of vulnerable targets for a meagre reward. In 3305, these founding members established a faction focused on the recruitment and mentorship of any explorers, miners, traders and fighters willing to further its cause. Armada has vowed to protect those in need and destroy those who deserve punishment.
system_8693_key: The home of the DEFENSIVE TRADERS ALLIANCE. A solid and loyal crew that is primarily focused on commodity trading and general large-scale profiteering. Their stated goal is to own the very best ships, the very best tech and the very best chance against their enemies, human or otherwise. To do this they seek the very best trade routes and the very best pilots.
system_8738_key: Rhatigan Industries aims to provide the galaxy with innovative robotic and cybernetic solutions to keep civilisation moving upwards and onwards. They strive to push the limits of known technologies to make the galaxy a better place for all.
system_878_key:
A prosperous and well-populated Imperial system. It is famed for having the headquarters to the Allen Flight Dynamics corporation.

'Upgrade your controls to the perfect system.'

Rogue Runners is a logistics company built on altruistic principles, but also with an eye for making money. If you need it transported, they can do it, regardless of the legality of the cargo. It was founded by a young woman named Autumn Leif, who got into the smuggling business out of necessity, but stayed in it for profit. They have acquired their own security force and have been pushing the Empire out of the Run system since before their official formation. The company has recently begun hiring smugglers and traders to help expand their reach. They hold a firm belief that anyone should be able to acquire what they need, regardless of what their governing body has to say about it or how far out they are located.
system_8833_key: This system is locked by the Pilots' Federation, no permits are currently issued.
system_8834_key:
In Depth Protection are a relatively new player on the military supply scene but they are already making some big waves.

'Countermeasures and military grade electronic warfare suites for those close encounters.' The permit for this system can be obtained from the Federal Military.
system_888_key:
The home of Cerulean Royalty Cruises.
Cerulean Royalty Cruises is an Imperial passenger charter corporation that aims to bring luxury to the edges of the Empire’s space. The corporation's focus is the transportation of luxury products, passengers and construction materials for high-class facilities.
system_8939_key: Argus Panoptic Corporation is non-governmental private organisation, and their main objective is studying and monitoring alien technologies.
system_8975_key:
Deep Space Area Denial produce most of their armaments in this system.

'We make safe environments hostile.'
system_9006_key: A nondescript system with an average population base. The Order of Intrepidus is based here and rules with an iron fist.
system_903_key:
The mines and other ordnance manufacturer Blast All Inc is based in this small but key system as part of the Federal military-industrial complex.

'Mines. You want 'em, we got them.'

The home of United Galaxy Exploration and Tourism, whose mission is to explore the nature of the galaxy. Scientific activities range from applied basic research to deep space exploration. In political terms UGET stays neutral in regard to the three major powers, yet has close connections to the Federation. When it comes to raising funds UGET relies on its tourism branch, offering trips for wealthy tourists to interstellar landmarks and points of interest.
system_9040_key: The home of Broadcast Cobra. Originally founded by a small group of broadcasting enthusiasts, this faction has now grown into a fully-fledged media group.
system_9068_key: The Guardian Angels hail from all over the universe and are made up of traders, miners and mercenaries who will respond to distress calls, wing requests or the call of war.
system_9135_key: The home of The Terran Enclave. Lp 888-62 was first colonised for its strategic location and rich minerals, and later became an important military supply district.
system_9191_key: The home of the Veiled Mafia. The Veiled Mafia is an organisation of anarchists and crusaders. They have core religious beliefs and care not for the politics of the various galactic powers. They have historical Imperial allegiances, but recently endeavour not to involve themselves in such matters.
system_9291_key: It's got a sun and planets and rocks. A quiet, unassuming system - maybe a nice place for a nap.
system_9386_key: The home system of Red Dice Systems - a secretive rabble of rough-and-ready miners, fighters, traders and explorers united and guided by a benign expert system that defines itself as 'the humble servant of humanity'.
system_9432_key: The home of United Imperial Clans. An alliance of newly formed "clans", the UIC seeks to establish their own shogunate in service to the Emperor. Following the Old-Earth philosophy of Bushido, these warriors aim to restructure and lead the Empire's military.
system_9445_key:
Members of the Blau Pilot Party of Yinjian met while working on the construction of the starport Explorer’s Anchorage. After the project was complete, it was clear that these pilots worked extremely well together, with a good-natured relationship filling the void with laughter. The faction’s path since is one built on friendship and shared destiny.

This well established independent industrial system is home to the Galectric corporation.

'Powering the universe.'
system_9498_key: The home of Sisters Guard, which arose to meet the escalating Thargoid threat. The initial focus quickly evolved to include protecting the weak and vulnerable as pirates began attacking rescue ships evacuating stations damaged in the initial Thargoid attacks. Finding the production of the Type-10 Defender a great boon to their efforts they seek to bolster the Alliance's power.
system_9521_key:
The home of the ArmBorr Ind. Once a part of a wider community, ArmBoo Ind rebelled against their local governor and escaped to seek new horizons. Their stated main task is research, often towards theories that have not been studied previously.
Periodically, they organize large exploratory expeditions. However they are also known to help other researchers in their endeavours, helping with the planning of routes.
system_981_key: The home of Outlander Flight Wing, a collection of outcasts and rebels who have banded together for strength in unity and solidarity, hoping to make a name for themselves by getting rich and exploring the darkest parts of the universe.
system_9834_key: A democratic and Federally aligned organisation working for Ambassador Aedaho Hyras-Olymva. This faction's main focus is sustaining the Federation's control and dominance across the galaxy, while also seeking out and researching the unknown. They are organised and prepared for whatever the Federation needs from them, while also fighting its rivals; the Alliance, Empire and independents.
system_9844_key:
This system is famed for being the home of the Defence Gizmos corporation.

'Recycled parts to equip your ship.'
system_9865_key:
The home of The 46th and 2nd Galactic Regiment.
The 46th and 2nd Galactic Regiment is committed to protecting the advancement of humanity's progress via engagement with hostiles. It also seeks to spread knowledge of the Milky Way's intricacies and promote a sense of growth and camaraderie among pilots
system_9918_key: For hundreds of years, Lavigny's Legion has been the private guard of the prestigious Lavigny family. The events that followed the first assassination attempt on Emperor Hengist Duval precipitated a need for Lavigny's Legion to induct members of the Pilots' Federation into its ranks. Lavigny's Legion remains fiercely loyal to the Lavigny family, and especially to Emperor Arissa Lavigny-Duval.
system_9_ceti_key: Elite German Commanders is a stubbornly independent group founded by settlers originating from central Europe on Earth in 2969. These people are known for their weird sense of humour, their annual beer festival in the colourful crystal caves, and their strong dark beer.
system_aarti_key: The Dacogent Initiative is a secretive group focused on uncovering the mysteries of the galaxy. It is an independent group with no known alliances or political affiliations. Very little is known about its agenda or what its goals are.
system_aasgananu_key: "The Cooperative Of Metaliar" is a consortium of the five biggest merchant companies from GCRV 1568. The chief executive is the famous businessman, Commanders Jarym. It is a group with a big goals: to go bigger and capture other systems for greater earnings.
system_aasgay_key:
The home of Knights of the Dark.
Knights of the Dark is a peaceful brotherhood of helpful commanders. They specialise in trade, but aren't afraid of protecting themselves when necessary. Members also enjoy searching the galaxy for beautiful sights and interesting discoveries.
system_abasina_key: The home of the Mare Tranquillitatus. The Retrotech Collective Agency encourages pilots to follow their own curiosity to explore the unknown.
system_abukunin_key: Federal Legion is a bounty hunting organisation that has been working out of Beckman Terminal for over a year.
system_ac_yax_baru_key: The home of the Thargoid Research Mafia. This faction journeys through the cosmos, looking obtain and research anything of alien origin by any means necessary, hoping to make a lucrative profit in the process.
system_acantha_key: Wanderers of Witch Space have plans to spread across the galaxy and rule all systems, uniting humanity under one banner. Humanity is safer if it is united.
system_achrende_key: The home of K9 Corporation, who were exiled from their previous system by the Federation.
system_acurus_key: The Nexus Union was formed from various independent corporate entities. It was decided that a more direct hand was needed to provide information and protection for pilots, and that a union of these participating corporations could provide the necessary training. The Nexus Union left the comfort and safety of the bubble for a frontier system, away from political ambitions and goals of the major powers.
system_adityan_key: After being betrayed by its former allies, the Tethys Independent Crew managed to escape and search for a new system to call home. Now established in Adityan, the crew will do whatever is necessary to achieve its goals. Reports suggest this includes reaching agreements with the local criminal cartels, strengthening its influence through questionable activities or mercenary work.
system_adivarakhe_key: The home of the Xebon Syndicate. The Xebon Syndicate, a group of pilots who align to Federation ideals but who choose to place humanity first before political agendas. They task themselves with protecting those who can't protect themselves whether it be against pirates, Thargoids, or domestic threats.
system_agarla_key: Brazilian Empire Pilots are a faction honouring an ancient nation from old Earth, and seeking to bring together Brazilian pilots linked to the Empire.
system_agastani_key:
The home of the Kisaragi & Co. Kisaragi and Company (Kisaragi & Co.) is an intergalactic trading, commerce, and logistics enterprise. Their mission statement is to offer a wide variety of merchandise for a reasonable price, faster than light speed. Services include, but are not limited to: trading, wholesale, logistics, material transportation, courier and common carrier operations.
Their motto is, ""More stuff, more quickly.'
system_ahayan_key:
The Gunslinger Brotherhood is a gathering of mercenaries who share an affinity for freedom and restricted goods. It is primarily involved in the bounty hunting trade, the profits of which are believed to finance several illicit operations.

Members are known to have a very strong pack mentality. They don't see themselves as criminals, but will not hesitate to retaliate with questionable methods to any perceived threats.
system_ahemez_key: The home of the Royal Phoenix Corporation. Founded by anti-piracy raid veterans, Royal Phoenix Corporation understands better than most that more remote systems require a greater level of protection against criminal elements. They offer security in such areas at a reasonable price.
system_aiabiko_key: The Forgotten are the vanguard wing of Expedition Medusa, an expeditionary force of seasoned explorers, miners, tenders and escort ships sent out on a deep space mission in 2900. After losing communications for over a century, the fleet council sent a wing back to inhabited space. Its mission was to claim a home system and prepare it for the return of the main fleet, which would eventually bring order and unity beneath a single banner to the now divided powers.
system_aisoci_key: The Phalanx Empire League's purpose is to provide the Empire with support in times of war, and trade with them in times of famine.
system_aka_key: The home of the Wolves of AKA. The Wolves of AKA are a loosely organised group of anarchists. All reports suggest The Wolves oppose any effort to enforce system laws, instead seeking autonomy and profit through violent means.
system_akandi_key:
The home of Arcadia Corporation.
A business organisation that has been incorporated into its respective home government.
system_akba_atacab_key: The Fatal Shadows live, fight and fly with honour, protecting their own and governing themselves.
system_akuni_key:
The home of the Antares S.A.
Antares S.A. is dedicated to exploring distant systems, seeking to record and learn from historical human expeditions through the galaxy. Income is derived from mining.
