Members are always ready to combat external threats or take advantages of opportunities to increase the faction’s power. Its only allegiance is to humanity.
system_alano_key: The Shadow Society was founded after a dispute with the Empire. Its members include elite fighters, mercenaries, pirates and assassins, who are also called the "Shadows".
system_albarib_key: The Hawks of Rahu were originally a small group of bounty hunters from  the system of Rahu. Over time their numbers increased, leading to an attack from a local pirate group. The pirates chased them for many light years until the Hawks had mostly been split up or killed. Eventually, a small number of the Hawks made their way to the Albarib system and are hoping to increase their numbers again and seek vengeance for their fallen comrades.
system_aleumoxii_key: Ouroboros Holdings Corps started off as a smuggling ring to serve the local black market. Outraged by the increasing tariffs demanded by the local pirates, they became a legitimate corporation in 3303 and have vowed to bring law and order to this crime infested sector.
system_alici_key: The Dark Demon Cartel was born near the Alici system under the rule of Archon Delaine. These merciless pirates work as mercs for hire or assassins, but will take petty smuggling jobs if necessary.
system_allobog_key:
The home of the Interstellar Strike Force. Interstellar Strike Force is a group of pilots focused on combat and anti-xeno operations.
Born from an alliance between several CMDRs whose common interest is combat and the detailed outfitting of ships, ISF aims to make the galaxy safer while helping train amateur combat pilots.
system_allowair_key: White Horizons Corporation is a Federal corporation that pursues commercial enterprise in support of political advancement and galactic prosperity.
system_almad_key: The Cult of the Void is group known to spend most of their time skulking in the dark unknown regions of the galaxy.
system_alourovices_key: The home of the Heathen Knights. The Heathen Knights are a faction of renegades with several orders, each specialising in different vocations. Following a lack of Imperial support during recent military conflicts, the Heathen Knights relocated to Alourovices to independantly found a new base of operations.
system_aluriates_key: The home of the Phalanx Imperial League. Due to the increased threat of the Thargoid incursions, the Emperor has assigned the Phalanx Imperial League to the system of Aluriates. There, they stand ready for any call to action.
system_amaneque_key: This binary system has a small extraction economy. Ruthless criminal gangs are believed to operate within this system.
system_amang_tzu_key: The home of Solar Wind. If you need illegal goods or specific services, you are in the right place. Solar Wind guarantees the confidentiality of its customers.
system_amarak_key:
The Ronin of Amarak are based in this system. They are a party of pirates and low-lifes who managed to gained control of the system through a dubious deal.

From their base of operations they raid traders, smuggle illegal wares and battle local security. It has been known for the Ronin to pick a fight over trinkets like booze or drugs and start a war over just a few credits.

The Ronin are not known for their trustworthiness. Small issues or hiccups have collapsed entire intergalactic peace treaties. There have been rumours that only a few organisations have maintained a steady and positive alignment with them.

The Ronin have a strict internal code of conduct concerning honour which is the only thing that really matters to them.
system_ambo_key: This colony of bodyguards, bounty hunters and soldiers offers private protection to high paying government officials within the Empire, and pride themselves on their combat prowess. Secretly they are engaged in high-level wetwork operations for the Empire.
system_amenniya_key: The home of the Ater Dracones. Ater Dracones Syndicate has a long history, their beginnings lost to the sands of time. They prefer fighting smart to fighting hard. Subversion, stealth and backroom deals are tools featured prominently in their arsenal, but when need arises the "Dragons" won't shy away from using force. They do whatever work brings a profit, primarily bounty hunting and trading.
system_amenta_key: The Imperial Guard's duty is to defend empire space and complete the tasks no one else will take.
system_ammatis_key:
The home of Independent Allied Forces.
Independent Allied Forces was founded on one principle: Provide support and aid to those who request it while remaining independent of any superpower. It is a coalition of pilots who fight for the greater good.
system_amphisatsu_key:
The home of Phoenix Inc.
Phoenix Inc. is a faction based around the idea that every pilot remains in the learning process. It focuses on the improvement of skills through training and learning from mistakes. Rising from adversity and the downfall of a disbanded faction, Phoenix Inc. acts as a burning flame in the dark reaches of the void.
system_anagorovici_key: The home system for the Communist Interstellar Union. It is a faction that believes that all assets and means of production should be communally owned. It also asserts that each member is equal, that they should contribute according to their ability and receive support according to their needs. The union was formed with the aim of protecting and uniting communist peoples.
system_ancermoten_key: The home of USCE (Special Combat and Exploration Unit), a company of explorers and fighters.
system_andarici_key:
The home of Goblin Fleet.
Goblin Fleet's objective is to unify the Andarici system under its banner, whether by diplomacy or force.
system_andonnus_key: House of Firefly is the guiding light in the dark reaches of space. It is the light of the Empire shining in the dark, to protect and serve their own and to serve the Empire. It is a house not willing to fall, but instead willing to shine. By right they fight, and by right they win.
system_andowa_key:
The home of the Waylon Research Corporation. Waylon Research Corporation researches the evolution of indigenous life on untouched worlds. Their study of how these creatures survive in a variety of environments could be very beneficial to future colonisation & expeditions outside of the bubble. From the nightmarish gravity pull of the monstrous vortex at the core of our galaxy, known as Sagittarius A*; to the edges of the spiralling arms of the Formidine Rift; all the way to the farthest any CMDR has ever been: the cold & lonely Beagle Point.
Their motto is, 'Waylon Research Corporation: Leaving No Stone Unturned.'
system_ane_key: Driven by a need to serve and maintain justice, the Hakurei Stargaze Musketeers patrol Imperial space with little restraint. These Musketeers have made it their sacred mission to protect those within the Empire's domain, seeking to eliminate both piracy and unchecked profiteering.
system_anek_wang_key: This binary system is a rare gem with only a single planet, but one that was terraformable. The system now supports an extensive population with a primarily agricultural based economy.
system_ankata_key: The Ankata Mining Collective was formed in response to a lack of security for local miners. After a brutal piracy attack severely impacted the extraction industry, the perceived lack of a security response prompted workers to take things into their own hands. The Collective seeks to do this through regulated trade routes and fulfilling independent security contracts within the system.
system_anlave_key: C.O.N.T.R.A.I.L (The Citizens Office for New Trade Revenue and Individual Liberty) was established to secure trade routes in Catun and its neighbouring star systems. Its members follow a democratic ideal and are fiercely independent.
system_anotchadiae_key: This relatively quiet system supports an extraction economy supplying nearby refineries. Except for the harsh working conditions there is little of note here.
system_anouphis_key:
The home of the Brotherhood of Helvetia.
Starting as a small group of pilots claiming Swiss ancestry from Earth, the Brotherhood of Helvetia follows the same historical principles and values. With great ambitions, it offers support to those in need. 
Its motto is, ‘For a safe and prosperous Milky Way!’
system_antove_den_key:
The home of the 28th Federal Fleet.
The 28th Federal Fleet emerged from a period of system conflict. These Federally-aligned pilots decided it was time to put an end to the fighting and work to maintain a period of stability within Antove Den.
system_anukas_key: Established on December 29, 3305, the Veles Company is a young, rapidly growing corporation operating in the shadow of great superpowers. Its founders claim direct heritage from the ancient Polish territories of old Earth. The Veles Company pursues its interests across the galaxy, operating in such fields as mining, deep space exploration, xenobiology, xenoarcheology and technological research.
system_anum_key: The home of the Blue Rose Corporation, which facilitates the manufacture and distribution of arms and armaments throughout Imperial space.
system_anuron_key: The Guardians of the Skies are dedicated to settling new worlds and bringing peace to the galaxy.
system_aobriguana_key: Bringing the word of Bacon to the systems of anarchy. Burning the impurities of bureaucracy and immoral piracy from the systems that need it most.
system_aonii_key: The 'Red Imperial Company' is a collection of pilots from all different backgrounds who have many differing specialities. Formed on November 07 3305, it has quickly established an effective combat force intent on supporting Imperial interests.
system_aowica_key: The Shields of the Eagle is a military order that engages in various activities designed to strengthen the influence of the Empire throughout the galaxy.
system_apadecavi_key: The home of Sirius Special Forces, founded by members of Sirius Gov looking to pursue a more active role in safeguarding Li Yong-Rui space. While other sub-divisions of Sirius are more product-oriented, the SSF represents a paramilitary branch, willing to explore all available options when the paths of diplomacy and fair trade prove less than effective.
system_apala_key: The home of the Rising Fortune Corporation. Rising Fortune Corporation is a business centred group based in Apala. The company was recently established as a fully-fledged corporation; expanding beyond their roots as a small, independent start-up company. They seek to use their current status to help others.
system_apalar_key: The home of the Apalar Penal Expansion Services, a services orientated organisation that specialises in penal colony construction, management and expansion. Initially focused on the expansion of their services within the Apalar system, the organisation now looks to provide inmate transportation, law enforcement and bounty collection services to local and surrounding systems.
system_apisni_key:
The home of Canis Lupus Majoris.

Founded by Xenon of Arcticus, Canis Lupus Majoris has made its home in the Apisni system to further its goals of unrestricted growth and expansion. Canis Lupus Majoris – meaning ‘Great Wolf’ - offers new and veteran pilots an environment to learn, grow and prosper.
Its motto is, ‘You write the future, let it be a good one.’
system_apoyota_key:
This trinary system of dwarf stars supports a modest combined refinery and extraction economy. Most of the system's activity is focused around the inner planets of the main star.

Gothic Imperium is dedicated to protecting the innocent within the Empire.
system_aptet_key:
The home of the Vanguard of Pravda, a communist society which dedicates itself to personal freedoms whilst also enforcing the law with an iron fist. The Vanguard of Pravda considers itself to be the last beacon of truth among the galaxy against the perceived corruption of the galactic superpowers, and they have vowed to share what it considers to be the truth to all willing to hear it.
They maintain a largely self-serving group, displaying no interest in others who do not initiate contact with them.
system_apteti_key: The home of The Merczateers. The Merczateers are a group of Mercenary soldiers.
system_apurui_key: The home system for Protectores Zemina Nostri. It is a faction of Imperial traders dedicated to supporting Zemina Torval, keeping her strong and safe wherever she goes. It was granted sanction for a specific area of influence by the Imperial Senate.
system_aracenus_key: Dedicated to friendship, morality and brotherly love, the Space Masons are a shining beacon in the darkness of space. Pilots of every creed, faction and power come to the masons to find true friendship.
system_arakapajo_key:
The home of the Praetorian Fleet.
The Praetorian Fleet is an Imperial faction based in the system of Kamito. It aims to support the Emperor’s interests across the galaxy. The faction believes in honour, bravery, loyalty and order.
system_arakwibut_key: The home of Black Widow, an association of disaffected former Imperial and Federation citizens. Together this ruthless paramilitary organisation roams the space lanes seeking fame, riches and glory as mercenaries flying under the banner of Archon Delaine. Wherever Black Widow establishes itself, one should expect to see the Eight-legged Skull emblem flying proudly. “Take what you can, give nothing back.”
system_arawere_key: The Barbera Crew swear loyalty to Archon Delaine, declaring themselves the nemesis of every dictator and corrupt governor in the pay of greedy corporations and power-drunk politicians.
system_argenoi_key: Armenia Corporation is a faction whose members claim ancestry from the ancient Earth territory of Armenia. These pilots strive for the security and welfare of new colonists from Earth through trade and military operations. The Corporation has aligned with the Federation due to the superpower’s Earth origins as well as for increased security.
system_ari_hesa_key: Northern Light are based in this system. They are a faction of independent pilots, allied for the protection, advancement and freedom of human inhabited space. They seek to safeguard neighbouring systems through progressive enlightenment.
system_ariatia_key: The Bar of Dreamers Inc has set up establishments to satisfy any customers wishing to taste high-end liquor sourced from various systems around the galaxy.
system_arietis_sector_fw_d_w_c1_d_4_key:
The home of Pigeon Shipping Lines.
PSL is a peaceful corporation devoted to transportation, search-and-rescue and humanitarian relief. It welcomes all pilots, no matter the level of experience. 
Its motto is, ‘Gold always shines.’
system_arigens_key: The home of The Altruists. The Altruists are a group of friendly pilots who enjoy helping others. They seek to make the galaxy a pleasant experience for those hoping to do the same. This faction does not care for power, control nor satisfying the ego. They engage in all aspects of space operation, however will only fight against wanted pilots.
system_arjung_key: The Terran Trade Authority is based in this system.
system_arnemil_key:
The home of U.Raid Corp.
U.Raid Corp. was founded to help consolidate a Federal presence in the systems it occupies. Consisting of pilots, traders and politicians, U.Raid Corp. act in the interest of the Federation and its agents.
The faction has a reputation for swiftly responding to threats in border systems.
system_arro_kop_key:
The home of The Refined Gentlemens Club.
The Refined Gentlemens Club is a group of elitist old men who love nothing more than to flaunt their wealth and status to the masses. Its members’ egos are vast and unapologetic, whilst their piloting skills are as antiquated as the pilots themselves.
When not sleeping, the group engages in almost all credit generating activities, such as trade, mining, exploration and bounty hunting. The unscrupulous amassing of wealth is its ethos.
system_arro_naga_key:
The home of Celestial Horizon Corp.
Celestial Horizon Corp is a private company set up to support exploration within uncharted space. It works to maintain the security of its controlled territory, seeking to create a safe haven for all pilots who journey through.
system_arth_key: In 2380 a small group of entrepreneurs of the Wittkampf Family, and some wealthy friends, left Earth to explore the galaxy. An accident left them stranded on Arth, where they built a small outpost that would steadily evolve into a large trading hub. The Wittkampf Family are mostly explorers and traders but will ferociously hunt down pirates who are foolish enough to invade their territory.
system_arungu_key: Operating on the fringes of inhabited space, the Inconnu Collective strives to impose its sense of law and order within their territory, independently of any outside influence. Financed by trade and supportive of bounty hunting, members regularly advocate for the faction’s policies and political agenda.
system_arverda_key: New Horizons is an independent corporation which specialises in terraforming, colonisation and station construction. Tired of the intense power struggles inside populated space, the corporation plans to expand human controlled space beyond its current boundaries. Using cutting edge terraforming and frame shift drive technologies, the corporation can help anyone with enough credits to colonise a terraformable planet. New Horizons upholds its own political ideologies and does not service anyone that jeopardises peace and harmony.
system_aseges_key: The home of The Holy Order of Blee, an independent feudal faction.
system_asetsi_key: Ocellus Interstellar Corporation was founded in 3303 by two traders. Its main aim is to expand into every business sector with a free mind, independent of any dictatorship, and become a self-reliant state where people are in control of their own fortune.
system_asgaa_key:
The home of Federal Expeditionary Armed Response.
Federal Expeditionary Armed Response (F.E.A.R.) is a counterterrorist response unit with deep space search and rescue specialists. Created in 3304, it enjoys a reputation for efficiency within the Federal Navy.
system_asooraja_key:
The home of the Kitsune Wanderers. The Kitsune Wanderers are a vagabond, ragtag group of mercenary pilots who shoot first and ask questions later. Formed from a band of outcasts that united with the common goal of finding a place to finally call home after drifting in exile for years. No one is ever turned away from this faction, so long as that person has proven their mettle in combat.
Never content to stay in one place for too long, the Kitsune are more at home in the cockpits of their finely tuned ships than anywhere else. If you have the credits, they have the guns.
system_asoorajara_key:
Home of The Razor Whips.
When the pirate cartels need someone to disappear, The Razor Whips are happy to oblige. Specializing in mayhem and carnage, no mission is too savage for these hardened criminals.
system_asturindjin_key: The home of Scorpius Arms Syndicate, a private military company which takes contracts of any nature for any faction.
system_asurasairu_key: The home of The 100 Zeros Club. The exact origins of this organisation are not known, only that it is more than three hundred years old. Rumour has it that recruits undergo very unorthodox initiation rituals, involving strange, colourful headwear decorated with ancient aviation-themed elements.
system_atatis_key: The International Centre for Tactical Research carries out experiments in many different scientific areas.
system_atese_key: FireWall is an independent faction originating from the Atese system. Members carry out its operations to ensure territorial security and maintain order.
system_atins_key: The Smiters Company is a commercial faction with profit as its main goal. They are bolstered by a powerful military which commands the utmost respect within their system.
system_atroco_key:
This is the home system for the FireBird Wing. 

In December of 3300, the Federation declared Onionhead an illegal narcotic. Under direct order from Admiral Vincent, the system where the plant was grown was blockaded and its farms were bombed by Federal gunships. There were many people living on Panem when the bombings began, and many tried to flee. A handful of commanders who banded together and escaped the Federal blockade were nicknamed the 'FireBird Wing' as, just like the Phoenix, they rose from the ashes.
system_audheim_key: Sapere Aude, formed in 3305, has vowed to establish a haven for like-minded individuals seeking to establish a home while fighting against injustice. The group has set up a base of operations in the system of Audheim, from where it now seeks to form coalitions, alliances and trade partnerships in neighbouring systems.
system_audhr_key: Reclaimers of the Lost was founded on the idea of liberating systems from the tyranny of corporate and political entities. It believes large factions have acquired too much influence in most populated space. As such Reclaimers of the Lost seeks to bring about the end of this monopoly.
system_aurus_key: Dark Angels of Aurus have been working to wrest their home system from tyranny. They will rise to their former glory and Aurus will be theirs once again.
system_autahenetsi_key: The home of Ultra High Ping Crew, a pirate faction.
system_avik_key:
The home of Independent Space Association.
I.S.A. is an alliance created to assist newcomers. It intends to uphold a high level of order in systems where the I.S.A. is present. Its security forces are always ready to help law-abiding pilots.
system_avikarli_key: Titan Industries was formed by the previous stakeholders of a mining organisation in the Delkar system. This corporate group operates in and around the high tech system of Avikarli, and is extremely protective of local trade routes and extraction sites. Titan Industries primarily deals with resource extraction and metal trade as well as the provision of security, but it also provides employment opportunities for pilots with other skill sets. Freelancers and third parties are welcome in Titan space, but must abide by local taxes enforced by Titan security, and in return are provided an escort where necessary.
system_awawa_key: The home of Asherah Knights, exiled soldiers from the Asherah system.
system_awawar_key: The home of Armed Wanderers Enterprises, whose services include bounty hunting, VIP transport, secure data and cargo transport, explorer escorts and salvaging.
system_azaladshu_key: The home of Reeee Patrol. Honour, integrity, valour – these are the distinguishing traits of the Reeee Patrol. Their pilots frequently contract themselves out to local system security forces in order to protect prisoner transport vessels from jail breaks. This sense of justice is the glue that binds Reeee Patrol pilots together.
system_azaliba_key: The home of the Space Elite Engineers. The Space Elite Engineers are a peaceful and friendly group. They believe in justice and democracy, with a willingness to defend their independence. Members engage in all kinds of activities, such as transportation, bounty hunting and exploration. They also seek to ensure they contribute against the Thargoid threat.
system_ba_narr_key: The home of the Eternal Fleet, who seek to bring justice and peace to the galaxy at large.
system_badbadzist_key: The home of Galactic Rangers, who exist to protect all of humanity from internal and external threats regardless of political affiliation or government type.
system_badia_key:
The home of the Royal Elite of the Grand Duke.
The Royal Elite of the Grand Duke are pilots of the Empire that assembled themselves around a charismatic Noble. It explores the galaxy, hunts bounties and supports rescue operations to enhance its reputation.
system_badjarans_key: The Strata Space Program (SSP) is an anarchist organisation born from the meeting of old dog fighting pilots, seasoned explorers and pirates in search of more honest incomes.
system_baga_key: Wings Of Justice is an organisation imposing its vision of justice and following the doctrine "Our Justice for All".
system_bahilo_key: Followers of the legendary pilot Quozl, The Cult of Quozl is a loosely tied group of fanatics determined to spread the word of their saviour by any means necessary.
system_balante_key:
The home of The Conclave.
The Conclave is compromised of commanders that are strong, curious, and experienced in trade. It has made progress towards research in mysterious environments as part of an effort to discover new alien races.
system_balastya_key:
The home of Skobel Space Industries.
Skobel Space Industries is an independent megacorporation primarily interested in military technology.
system_baldur_key: A group of like-minded individuals drawn from across inhabited space, Ultima Thule is committed to the advancement of truth, the acquisition of knowledge and maintaining the natural balance of the universe. Aligned with the Empire, it offers freelance services in support of trade, mineral extraction and military enforcement.
system_balis_key:
The home of the Galactic Commonwealth of Nations.
The Galactic Commonwealth of Nations is an alliance of pilots who want their names to become historic. Its strives to establish a safe and economically strong territory through bounty hunting and trading. The exploration of undiscovered areas of the galaxy is also considered important.
system_bamu_key: The home of the Black Mesa. An independent business organization that has incorporated its respective home government. What began as a simple mining crew now reaches deep into the black to spread influence as explorers, traders and bounty hunters.
system_bana_key:
The home of Regiment Tactique du Quebec.
Regiment Tactique du Quebec (RTQC) is a military faction aligned with the Empire. It consists of bounty hunters, assassins and mercenaries. The faction is known to trade in Imperial slaves to finance its initiatives. 
Its motto is, ‘FOR HONOR WE FIGHT! FOR THE EMPIRE WE DIE!'’
system_banemu_key: The Aeipoetue Meritocracy is an independently led commune, dedicated to purifying the balance of power inside its sphere of influence, and reinforcing the values of personal freedom and harmony. All of its major decisions are agreed upon by a council of trusted individuals.
system_banephtha_key: The ADVENT coalition is dedicated to bringing unification by any means necessary.
system_bango_key: Septum Industries is a corporation established by a group of wealthy traders, miners and explorers. The corporation is very loyal to the Federation but has been known to deal with the Children of Raxxla and other pirate and anti-Federation groups.
system_bangyani_key:
The home of the Aces Wild Aerospace Corporation. The Aces Wild Aerospace Corps started as an offshoot of a planetary mercenary unit. They branched out to provide interstellar security services in 3301. The Aces took on jobs ranging from armed escort of personnel and goods to bounty hunting.  As success and profits helped expand the Aces' fleet and operations, they quickly incorporated as the Aces Wild Aerospace Corporation in 3302.
The corporation pushed into other markets including casinos and secure cargo delivery.  Issues with criminal groups in Federal space and accusations made against several AWAC pilots caused the faction to move to the edge of Imperial space in the Bangyani System.
system_banisas_key: The home of the Atlantic Protectorate, a group of pilots from various backgrounds dedicated to rooting out injustice. Despite internal conflicts regarding superpower affiliation, this is a tight knit unit of skilled fighters and tacticians.
system_banki_key: Between January 3300 and February 3301, the Banki and BD+03 2338 systems attempted to leave the Federation, but the effort was violently suppressed.
system_baramanago_key: The Alliance Outriders are a band of mercenaries, explorers and misfits who support the Alliance, and have pledged to protect and explore the fringes of Alliance space.
system_barathaona_key:
The home of Blackstar
Blackstar is a mercenary organization founded in late 3304. The group specialises in claiming dangerous bounties and assassinations, but also accept non-violent contracts provided they pay well.
system_bard_key: The Cosmic Caretakers are nomads who seek out those in need.
system_barillian_key:
The home of The Sons of Ragnarok.
The Sons of Ragnarok is a group of anarchist pilots who established itself in the Barillian system to trade and fight while leaving nothing unexplored.
system_barku_key:
The home of the Federal Security Corp.
The Federal Security Corp is a faction working to make the territory under its control secure and safe for trade. While willing to engage in military action to expand their control, the faction works hard to re-establish security within any gained space.
system_basterni_key: The home of 7th Legion, a newly commissioned fleet devoted to performing any naval role that would serve the Empire, be it reconnaissance, warfare or defensive actions.
system_basuki_an_key: The Ancient Order exists to battle corruption within the three major superpowers. Its goal is to unite the Federation, Empire and Alliance under a single banner and bring peace to the galaxy.
system_batari_key: The home system for Cyro Sunrise. The primary focus of the established democracy in Batri is an analysis of why republican-representative democracy has succeeded in some areas while failing in so many others.
system_bava_key: The Misfit's of Science and Research were started on Asellus Primus in response to the growing number of Thargoid and Guardian Site encounters around the galaxy.
system_baxbakaeris_key: Baxbakaeris Scarlet Star Gazers is a small group that has taken up the role of gazing at the Scarlet Stars, visible from the Baxbakearis system. Their goal is to make the system thrive.
system_beagle_point_key: Beagle Point marks the end point of a galaxy-spanning expedition undertaken by Commander Kamzel in 3301. At the time, the system was known as Ceeckia ZQ-L c24-0, but Kamzel nicknamed it Beagle Point after his beloved beagle Jack, who had passed away a short time before. One year later, the system was chosen as the final destination of the first Distant Worlds expedition, resulting in an influx of over 500 pilots in April 3302. In recognition of these events, Universal Cartographics officially renamed the system Beagle Point on the 26th of May 3302.
system_belarsuk_key: The Wolf Society is a coalition of mercenaries and bounty hunters.
system_belgeth_key: The Xukong Nexus have vowed to destroy as many pirate factions as they can whilst embracing exploration in their search for alien contact.
system_belgitan_key:
The home of The Xenomorph Research Institute.
The Belgitan system is home to the Xenomorph Research Institute, which is committed to maintaining human superiority throughout the galaxy. Member pilots fly to advance humanity’s cause throughout the stars. The faction is active across inhabited space in a variety of disciplines.
system_belinjaba_key: The home of Knights of the Black, whose scientists have discovered a high concentration of Ammonia Worlds in the NGC 4463 Sector, and are convinced that a Thargoid wave is imminent from this direction. Their beliefs are to educate and arm the frontier systems in this sector to better prepare for attack.
system_belliya_key:
The home of the Asociacion Elite Independiente. Asociacion Elite Independiente are an independent faction that promote cooperative and democratic values, providing their members consult in and support economy related issues. They encouraging new free merchant ideas and employing security to solve problems, foment trust and avoid longer-term conflicts. 
These commanders, exiled from their original home system, have formally established this democratic faction to fully support their interests.
system_bemberi_key: The home of the Zenith Squadron. Zenith Squadron is a highly experienced rebel group of Elite ranked pilots with a loose allegiance to the Empire. Founded in 3304, a small number of commanders became disgruntled associating with amateurs and drifters, deciding instead to formulate a society for Elite Commanders to work together in unison for agreed goals enforced by their own rules.
system_bestii_key: The Galactic Trade Federation travel the galaxy mining resources, and trading what ever scrap they have to help out any faction in dire need.
system_bhaga_key: In 3301 the citizens of Bhaga established a group of courageous commanders as its defenders and proclaimed themselves independent from their former masters. Thus was born La Guardia Hispana, who oppose anyone who would abuse their power.
system_bhagui_key: Mould Federal Mining Incorporated is a resource extraction organisation with a history of close cooperation with Federal Navy ship builders.
system_bhaguru_key: The home of the TRAVELERS OF INFINITE SPACE. Based in the Bhaguru system in the outer area of the bubble, this faction are ready to fly at short notice. They have enlisted honourable commanders of many types, ready to help any commander who needs it, particularly those who use the Spanish language. They consider loyalty and honour paramount, and will ruthlessly hunt down any who betray them.
system_bharaba_key: Lorcan Syndicate is a crime syndicate with deep ties to the Empire. They a secret society with a strict code of honour and a dedication to turning a profit by any means. Their leader is Darkanis "The Fallen" Koeing.
system_bhare_key: The Imperial Grey Wolves are a detachment of the Imperial Navy who act with a degree of autonomy and are stationed in the frontier of Aisling Duval's domain. Rumour has it they help test some of the Navy's prototype technology. The faction is led by Admiral Sten Kheldar, a proud and level-headed tactical genius.
system_bhati_key: The home of the Wolf Foundation. A group of bounty hunters and explorers who decided to work together to uncover the mystery of the vanishing Guardians.
system_bhava_key: RRRR members are the self-proclaimed ‘fun-loving criminals of space’. The faction is known to accept contracts regardless of the size of the operation. Members prioritise profit and are rumoured to engage in various nefarious activities to obtain it.
system_bhil_mina_key: A hardened group of pilots led by Irina Romanov, the Dark Space Commanders fight against the injustice and protect other spacefarers from piracy.
system_bhotega_key:
The home of the Weeb Alliance.
The Weeb Alliance was founded by a group of pilots in 3300. It is a collective of traders, bounty hunters and explorers who help each other when needed. The faction is also known to accept mercenary contracts if the pay is high enough.
system_bhotho_key: United Bhotho Collective are a loose corporate collective of traders, miners and mercenaries, all united under the banner of the Federation.
system_bhritzameno_key: The Altair Defence Force was established to offer protection from any outside influence seeking to exploit the system's tactical position and prey on nearby targets.
system_bhumians_key: The home of The Blue Brotherhood, who help those in need and keep the peace.
system_bhumliaurt_key: Raven's Agencies Incorporated engages in many activities including bounty hunting, cargo and passenger transport, and exploration.
system_bhutas_key: The Bhutas Hunters started out as a small group of bounty hunters. Their actions were noted by the Empire and they were granted ownership over their system.
system_bibari_key: The Independent Defensive Intervention Fleet is a conglomerate dedicated to the defence and preservation of humanity.
system_bieltani_key: Although the system has a modest extraction operation it does contain considerable wealth within the ring systems of its gas giants.
system_bipek_key: Bipek Labour has a long established presence and is largely credited for the huge amount of terraforming work being undertaken in the system. The faction holds anti-slavery, fair wages and the right to vote as its core values.
system_birjorth_key: The Asylums Rejects Pirate Collective operates from this system. It is a group of ex-soldiers who fought on the losing side of a civil war and are now fighting to rebuild their faction back to its former glory.
system_bishama_key: The home of the Erudite Colonial Forces, founded in 3226 to help independent star systems in defence of their beliefs and ideologies. Today, the ECF helps any independent system or group in need. It maintains the core value that all systems and governments should be allowed to rule in their own way, and not under the control of a higher power.
system_blatrughna_key: The home of Utopian Communist League, who are dedicated to the spread and development of fully automated luxury space communism.
system_bletii_key: The home of the Indigo Technologies. Founded in 3304, Indigo Technologies are an independent company, specialising in in trade operations, interstellar transportation and Xeno research. Their motto is, 'We dare to dream of a stronger galaxy'.
system_bloder_key: This complex star system contains six stars which provide a stunning spectacle when viewed from the lone outpost orbiting the outermost planet. The complex interaction of solar wind from the stars provides an ideal environment for clandestine meetings and operations.
system_bodedi_key: The home of the Mercenaries against criminal organizations. The Mercenaries Against Criminal Organizations are a faction of mercenaries who banded together to combat organized crime, pirate gangs and terrorists. They specialise in bounty hunting, search and rescue, and anti-terrorism operations. They are also known to help other commanders who seek their assistance in such matters.
system_bolos_key: The home of the Bolo Holdings. Bolo Holdings is a permanent coalition of like-minded individuals from all across inhabited space, who strive to bring security, wealth and prosperity to all systems within their scope of influence.
system_boman_key:
The home of the Dark Dragon Triad.
The Dark Dragon Triad is a relentless group of pilots from a variety of backgrounds. It is an independent faction, refusing to answer to anyone, and will participate in any activity in exchange for credits. It makes a suitable ally to anyone that share the same ideals and morals.
system_bongk_key:
A.N.T.R.O. – standing for the Alliance of the Now Truly Reckless and Overpowered - focuses on high-value bounty hunting contracts and mercenary work that offers the chance to make a profit.

Its motto is, ‘They fight together, they die together.’
system_botame_key: The home of the Israeli Space Agency. A faction claiming ancestors of an ancient human civilisation first formed some several thousand years prior to the current date. Their shared theology helps unite them despite how diverse their members may be. They are known for strongly opposing slavery and believing all humans have a right to live on Earth freely.
system_bragurom_du_key: Remlok Industries is a well-known corporation, extending its main economic sphere around the Bragurom Du system. The high-tech station present within the system offers high quality components and modules, as well as Remlok survival products. The corporation is also notable for its contribution to the development of xeno-technology research./n'Bonjour Commander, you are welcome in our borders.'
system_brani_key: Vector Security Solutions aims to be the front line of defence for all citizens. Using cutting edge technologies from restricted engineering personnel, Vector works to keep space safe from any who wish to disrupt the galaxy.
system_bratio_key: Union of Italian Commanders is comprised of pilots who claim lineage originating from the ancient Earth nation of Italy. Members fight for a better and fairer society benefiting all inhabitants of the galaxy.
system_brestla_key:
The Imperial Inquisition is a  group of Imperial fanatics based in this system. They are dedicated to defending the Empire from threats, both internal and external.

Led by their inspiring leader Mavia Kain, they are determined to become a major player on the galactic stage.
system_brians_key:
This is the home system for the Divine Brotherhood of Commerce. They believe that the will of Mammon can be seen in the flow of money as demonstrated by their motto: Sanctum Proficuis (Holy Profits).

The organisation is operated by anonymous members of a leading council (The Apostles) that manipulate their acolytes via religious propaganda into benefiting the organisation and its council members financially.

"He with money has the favour of Mammon. He with the most money has the words of Mammon."
system_brib_key: The Order of Open are a cut-throat organisation which focuses on combat and piracy for leisure, but are involved in other activities for their day to day operations.
system_bridi_key: The home of Independent Network Union, a network of independent pilots working in close ties to the Empire.
system_brihasatsa_key:
The home of the Galaxy Express.
The Galaxy Express is a gathering of independent freelancers. Its premise is based upon the initiative and guarantee of individual rights. 
This corporation aims to ensure the security and the benefit of its shareholders. It follows a code of honour known as Galx. 
The code is composed of several sections, each having devoted to a specific activity. 
Its motto is, ‘As far as humanity will go, it will always find a member of the Galaxy Express to help it.’
system_bugayaman_key:
The home system for Delta Squadron whose motto is "What we do in life echoes in eternity."

They are independent private traders, explorers mercenaries - guns for hire and bounty hunters.
system_bukurnabal_key: Bukurnabal Brokers are based in this system and they transport agricultural produce, machinery and technology.
system_bumbur_key:
The home of The EMW Minining Commune.
The EMW Mining Commune is a peaceful faction whose members only wish is to mine to their heart's content.
system_bunda_key:
This system contains a number of terrestrial worlds supporting a large population and a mixed agricultural and industrial economy. The locals are said to be friendly, but passers through the system have reported a larger than usual number of ships patrolling the system that don't belong to the system's security fleet.

The Bunda Dragoons are a small mercenary unit based out of Bunda and the surrounding area. They mainly offer light-medium escorts for explorers and traders, although they will do almost anything if the price is right. They are also strongly independent, attempting to keep Bunda and the surrounding area outside the influence of the major powers and factions.
system_bunuras_key:
This is the home system of the Stumblingtroop. Once spread all over the Galaxy, the Stumblingtroop finally settled here in 3301 after a long search of their Glorious Leader Randall Flagg. He's well known for his quote "UUUUUUAH, stop shooting at me!". Randall Flagg was formerly known for his rapid retreat manoeuvre the "Rabbit-ensign", with his all knowing pet "The Sheep".

The Stumblingtroop is known for its chaotic flight show in space.
system_bunuson_key: When there is a battle, and the Empire is involved, you will find The Imperial Vanguard on the frontline. They provide protection for the whole Empire, and when there is a job that no one else can handle - you will know where to find them.
system_bunuvivia_key: To protect the Bunuvivia system, Bunuvivia's Hope has elected to shoulder the burden of defending against outside threats. Members will always act in the best interests of the system.
system_buricasses_key: Senator Denton Patreus favours this system with his patronage.
system_buriges_key: Cobalt Imperium recently resurfaced after a prolonged absence. They act as a branch of the Imperial Diplomatic Corps, formed just before the first conflict between Empire and Federation, though little is known about their history. Former Federal Vice Admiral Mirche recently accused this faction of being run by Imperial military intelligence but since his desertion these accusations have been widely ignored.
system_burojinura_key: Originally dispatched in early 3305 to the Liaedin system to help promote an Imperial presence in the area, the 1st Imperium Auxiliary Cohort took its orders a step further and decided to establish a permanent base of operations in the nearby Burojinura system.
system_byel_taca_key: The Orden de Investigacion A-51 is a brotherhood of scientists that study all forms of alien life. Moved by a strong desire for both knowledge and security, members seek the betterment of humanity by helping any in need. It remains vigilant in the face of threats, human or otherwise.
system_caeritis_key:
The home of The SMC Clan.
The Symbolic Metagalactic Conservation Clan of Caeritis, entered into a system conflict that devastated the economy and populace. This travesty birthed the peacekeepers who promised a return to security and a better future.
The SMC Clan has pledged not to stop until every threat to the innocent has been subdued, whether human or non-human.
system_cai_syraze_key:
The Imperial Enforcement Division was originally founded by a mixed group of pilots, traders, explorers and bounty hunters. They banded together under the Imperial banner to fight against the scourge of pirates at the Battle of Chi'lin. After a great victory, pilots from around the galaxy heard of the actions the "brave few" and asked to join.

At this point the division was formed, with the aim of protecting Imperial citizens and interests, but they have been known to pursue other goals.
system_cailla_key: Holo Graphics Corp is one of many galactic corporations that has tried its hand in a variety of economic fields, eventually finding its niche in high-resolution holograms for commercial and military use. It funds this endeavour primarily through trade and exploration work.
system_caleta_key:
The home of Orions Sepulcher.
Orions Sepulcher is a group of explorers and traders. Many members can trace their ancestry back to the earlier generation ships to leave earth. These pilots are known to travel vast distances but always return to this system.
system_california_sector_bv_d_y_c7_key: The Allied Order of Exemplars is a multi-faith organisation specialising in human enhancement, parapsychological research and humanitarian aid. The members of this secretive organisation are bound by oath to be accountable by law and liberty in both thought and action.
system_calili_key: The home of SRN 3302, which was formed by former Imperial enforcers who are now part of the Alliance of Independent Systems and loyal supporters of Edmund Mahon.
system_callerni_key: SWORD is a neutral organisation whose sole purpose is to protect humanity from both itself and from any potential extraterrestrial threats.
system_calor_key:
The home of the Headquarters for the Advancement of the Anarchist Aviation Network & Deathmatch Society. Founded in late 3303, the Headquarters for the Advancement of the Anarchist Aviation Network & Deathmatch Society (H.A.A.A.N.D.S.) is a loosely organized group of pilots that gather once a week to compete against each other in both individual and wing combat. 
These competitions draw pilots from many different factions and backgrounds, and allegiances are often cast aside; this allows pilots to solely focus on combat with few distractions.
system_cama_zotz_key: Black Ares are a small group of expert combat traders specialising in the safe transport of high value cargo. They are called upon where discretion and stealth are key, but the risk of active combat engage is high.
system_can_qing_key: Radiant Incorporated is dedicated to the service of the Empire. Servants of this faction are proud Imperials, ready and willing to serve the Empire whenever and wherever it is needed.
system_candecama_key: The home of Prophets of Orion, a militant culture dedicated to humanity's expansion throughout the galaxy.
system_cantjarisni_key:
The home of Light of Humanity.
Light of Humanity is a group that helps other factions. Its motto states that ‘Anybody who needs help, gets help’. It has selected Cantjarisni as its home system.
system_capa_key: The home of the Elite Defense Force. A group of bounty hunters, mercenaries and highly paid smugglers.
system_carener_key: The sole purpose of the GNDI (Galactic Naval Defence Initiative) is to protect and honour commanders of the Pilots' Federation throughout the galaxy. All are welcome to this faction, as long as they vow to fly by the rules of the GNDI.
system_carns_key: Neutron Exploration Systems is a dedicated security and exploration contractor for the Imperial Navy, specialising in reconnaissance for combat sites, trade routes and deep space intelligence.
system_cartoi_key: The Allied Traders Syndicate is comprised of traders and explorers seeking to help humanity flourish by boosting the economy and population of inhabited systems. It is dedicated to ensuring the delivery of supplies and personnel to any destination, safely and promptly.
system_cartu_key: The home of Society Of Greybeards, who want to make part of the galaxy their own, and to take what they deserve by force if needed.
system_carverda_key: Imperial International Elite Pilots Union is a faction whose main goal is to expand its influence in as many systems as possible, to establish its own rules and regulations, and to uphold the greatness of the Empire and fight against the Federation.
system_caspatsuria_key:
The home of the Imperial School Board. Commanders serving the Imperial School Board strive to maintain the system they reside in and support allies in need via trade, exploration, data delivery, and occasional peacekeeping. 
The Imperial School Board is well respected within education in the Empire, having some influence on the selected curriculum in Imperial classrooms. The current headquarters of the Imperial School Board is Caspatsuria.
system_cate_key: The Vela City Navy was formed in early 3302 by a group of local pilots to protect the lawful people of the Cate system from pirates and terrorists. They routinely patrol nearby resource extraction sites to protect miners and can be seen escorting the various passenger ships that support the booming tourism business in Cate.
system_catucandit_key: The Cerberus Syndicate are nomadic outlaws who rove secluded areas of space in search of loot and plunder. Members seek the salvage of lost wrecks and collection of floating scrap, with suspicions of pirate activity also. Its agenda and ideology mean these outlaws are not afraid to make enemies of those who do not offer anything of worth.
system_catun_key: The Escuadron Centinelas, a Hispanic group loyal to the Empire, is based in this system.
system_cauac_key: The home of Deep Space Privateer, originally founded as a private mercenary organisation to help smaller companies establish their services and colonies. In 3304, after a conflict with a previous client, the organisation settled in the Cauac system and expanded its business to trade and discovery. Its objectives are to create a stable administration and to protect the citizens and institutions in the region.
system_caucuma_key:
The Katamari Group is based in this system and is a loosely organised assembly of explorers and mercenaries drawn from all corners of human space.

They are known as a ragtag bunch of dreamers that invested varying degrees of time and money chasing a dream, which is as yet still unrealised. 

Many of them wonder if the project will ever be fulfilled, and in the manner they originally envisioned - yet have come together in the most unlikely of cohesive groups to shape their destiny and make their mark upon the galaxy.
system_ceeckia_zq_d_l_c24_d_0_key: Beagle Point marks the end point of a galaxy-spanning expedition undertaken by Commander Kamzel in 3301. At the time, the system was known as Ceeckia ZQ-L c24-0, but Kamzel nicknamed it Beagle Point after his beloved beagle Jack, who had passed away a short time before. One year later, the system was chosen as the final destination of the first Distant Worlds expedition, resulting in an influx of over 500 pilots in April 3302. In recognition of these events, Universal Cartographics officially renamed the system Beagle Point on the 26th of May 3302.
system_ceos_key: The home of RSR (Royal Squadron Regiment), an independent organisation that engages in all types of activities.
system_cernobog_key: The 47th Imperial Expeditionary Force (IEF) carries out operations beyond the scope of the regular Imperial military. The division is officially tasked with an exploratory mandate, both of uncharted space and of technological research, but they are often called upon for strategic strikes where precision is paramount.
system_ceronir_key: TBP Solutions is committed to the safe passage of all space-faring transportation vehicles using all of the latest and greatest technology. It is a security solutions company dedicated to the safety of the Empire and its citizens. Under the direct command of Sir William Hastings, Empire space has never been more secure.
system_cerritics_key: The home of the Children of the Sun. The Children of the Sun are experienced in all aspects of space operations, but their main focus is combat and exploration.
system_cerrodi_key:
The home of the Revolutionary Alliance.
The Revolutionary Alliance was founded in the name of liberation. Members participate in trade, combat and exploration. Its intended aim is to organize a space station to establish economic control of frontier areas and foster opportunities for pilots.
system_ch_a_eng_key:
The home of the Imperial Sentinels. Sir Barton Mattis founded this faction in response to the renewed Thargoid threat, with the purpose of defending the interests of Princess Aisling Duval. Their roster consists mainly of independent pilots and mercenaries from all walks of life.
Headquartered in Cheng, the Imperial Sentinels embark on a mission to protect humanity, bring unity to the Empire, and maintain peace throughout the galaxy by any means necessary.
system_ch_a_ol_key: Intersys is an interplanetary courier and passenger travel service.
system_chacocha_key: A crossroads system that provides access to a number of nearby star systems. The system is dominated by four gas giants whose rings support the extraction and refinery economy. A local crime lord is said to operate within this system.
system_chamas_key: Fortunes Corsairs are independent privateers who all have the same goal: making credits. Their current mission is to grow their ranks and their wallets, and there is no job too dirty, no war too bloody.
system_chamunda_key:
The Loan Sharks Mercenary Corps knows that profit is the ultimate motivator, ensuring the proper financial motivation to any pilot willing to fly under contract with it. Aligned with the Federation, Loan Sharks Mercenary Corps supplies armed escort services and weaponry to the highest bidder.

A modest industrial economy can be found on the single planet orbiting the companion star in this binary star system.
system_changgu_key:
The home of the Galactic Anarchists.
This faction is descended from the Founding Fathers Crime Syndicate, and has sworn to uphold the ideals of a true anarchist.
system_chankopa_key: Vikings are renowned for operating on the frontier, and looking for new places to conquer and pillage. This heritage continues on the frontier of human occupied space. They are always looking for opportunities for a proper fight, places to raid and establishing new areas to control, prosper and to make and drink mead.
system_charang_key: The home of The Hitch Hikers Wing. Established in early 3304, The Hitch Hikers Wing is a group of allied commanders dedicated to helping each other, having fun all across the galaxy, and celebrating the ancient Earth culture's science-fiction texts from the 1900s.
system_charunder_key: The Charunder Achievers Collective are dedicated to upholding the values of the Federation through financial, military and diplomatic means. Through individual accomplishments they seek to extend their influence among the stars.
system_chaualkyrja_key: The home of the XCORE Industries. An independent corporation based in Chaualkyrja, operating in a variety of fields: trade, exploration, bounty hunting. They also offer a Science Research Think Tank hosted in Conway City.
system_checha_key: The Dark Armada is a secret society pledged to the Empire. It is under royal charter from Arissa Lavigny-Duval to protect the Empire from aggressively expansionist independent factions.
system_chelka_key: The founder of the Digiel Aggregate was woken from a coma after an escape pod malfunction. He found rage replaced by calm, nihilism by purpose, and the movement that bears his name is committed to equality and opportunity for all.
system_chelmen_key:
The home of the White Knights.
Standing for honour and valour, the White Knights exist to help those in need. The order claims origins stretching back to the Middle Ages. They enjoy a reputation for heroism and brotherhood. All those in need of aid can rest assured that the White Knights will answer their call.
system_chemaku_key: Aeon Astrotech was founded with two things in mind, security and advancement of technology. AA aims to become a frontrunner in the research and development field while also maintaining the backing of the Federation and the security of their home system. In AA's pursuit of better tech they exploit humanity's greatest skill; finding more efficient ways to kill each other.
system_cheneti_key:
IP3X Corporation is strongly focused on the exploitation of star system resources in the pursuit of its corporate interests. It maintains a respectable standing military force to protect its mining and science divisions. The latter can often be found thousands of light years from IP3X’s home system, studying ancient relic sites.

Politically, Interplanetary 3xpeditions have reportedly lobbied the Imperial Senate with the aim of loosening corporate regulations.

A populous agricultural system with extensive corporate interests and a large number of starports and outposts. The outer part of the system contains gas giants with known water and ammonia based life forms in their cloud layers. This is a popular system with traders.
system_chi_suix_key: The home of the Covert Billionaires. A prestigious Brotherhood of Billionaires run this faction.
system_chick_bara_key: The Chibonians were a black ops unit based in Chiboneskhe system, who worked for the Federation and specialised in biological warfare. They were betrayed by the Federation as their research was deemed too extreme for a civilised society. A bounty was issued and half of them were wiped out. After years of drifting through space, working for the highest bidder, the survivors were approached by the Empire who were interested in their special skills. The Empire realised the extent of Chibonian loyalty and gave them a system to conduct their research from.
system_chimba_key: The Pension Plan Commandos are a group of middle-aged space jockeys who value good times over dominance.
system_chimiri_key:
We were born from lack of good trading companies in our system.

We all worked for big companies, we were all underpaid, we all wanted more!
system_chingpho_key:
The home of ThriveNippon Passenger Service Co.
ThriveNippon Passenger service Co. (TNPCo.) is a space liner enterprise aiming to vitalise developing systems. Its policy is to provide a safe journey for all of customers.
Along with this, the company also offers cargo-hauling, data courier services and trading.
system_chnouphis_key:
The home of The Rolentia Conglomerate. The Rolentia Conglomerate started life as a chain of bakeries in the Chnouphis system, serving the local miners. Through mining contacts they eventually started catering for Imperial high society.
With a growing prestige the company began to expand into new areas: personal security, transportation and talk of political influence. 
Despite their Imperial ties, the company is independent, considering it better for business. 
System_Kurughnaye_Key:The home of the Screaming Eagles, The Screaming Eagles are known across the galaxy as a group of handsome, narcissistic pirates whose ranks have only swelled since its foundation. Many pilots arrive at this system in hopes of encountering one of the elusive Screaming Eagles recruiters, wishing to participate in stories recounting daring skirmishes with various military powers and mercenaries attempting to bring these dashing rogues to justice.
system_chnumar_key: The 137th Special Purpose Fleet is aligned with the Empire. It seeks to protect Imperial borders and expand into nearby systems. Members actively promote the benefits of living under the Empire’s rule. It has a zero-policy of aggression against any target who is neither an enemy or a fugitive of the Empire.
system_chnuphis_key: The home of Honey Badger Initiative, an organisation that provides private security solutions for their system. They also provide secure trading routes around neighbouring systems as well as covert ops for high paying organisations.
system_chock_key:
The home of the Fighters For Forlorn Freedom.
The Fighters For Forlorn Freedom are a faction of rare goods traders, long-distance explorers and ace combat pilots who have banded together to find an area of space they can call their own. Members are adept at using knowledge, bribes and violence to gain territory. They do this under the leadership of the First Freedom Fighter, the dictator that founded the faction.
system_chona_key: Chona is the administrative hub for Aisling's Angels, a loosely-organised group of citizens that actively support the People's Princess, Aisling Duval's progressive policies. This group is often involved in humanitarian efforts and anti-slavery rallies. Citizens, from the lowest walk of life to lofty senators, are united in actively supporting the People's Princess, Aisling Duval's progressive policies.
system_chono_key:
The home of Chono Express Trade Inc.
Chono Express Trade Inc is a corporate entity specialising in trade. CEO Zarren Buffet's intent is to boost the Chono system to be the number one destination for trade.
Priorities for member pilots include protecting CETI assets, providing system data for future trade routes, mining operations, and ensuring safe transport of goods and passengers.
The economic prosperity of Chono and the safety of its citizens is the upmost importance to the corporation.
system_chorathia_key:
The home of Echo Squadron.
Echo Squadron formed with the goal of creating a diverse and healthy economy for all those within its territory. It is dedicated to promoting a lucrative and secure trading environment within its area of influence by investing in commodity imports and the destruction of pirate forces. Echo Squadron is motivated to expand its influence in order to broaden the area in which free and safe trade can be found.
system_chotec_key: Heavy Industrial Technologies are committed to the creation and application of military grade technology. They create, test and manufacture all proprietary technology and hardware, and are dedicated to furthering Mankind's expansion into the galaxy.
system_chouvumbia_key: Confederate Space Systems was founded by a small squadron of independent pilots opposed to the influence of the superpowers. It works to support independent systems in building an economy capable of establishing a confederacy of local governments. The faction hosts various professions, with special attention given to interstellar traders.
system_chu_jona_key: The home of Unicorn Commonwealth, a cooperative of like-minded citizens who follow the philosophy of Unicornism. This Philosophy promotes ideals of peace and cooperation to reach common goals and fundamentally teaches that no individual is superior to another inside of the philosophy.
system_chujohimba_key: Crazy pirates and psychopaths. Los Fenicios Espaciales may not be the most powerful faction, but it is one of the richest in the galaxy.
system_chukchu_key:
The home of the Tower of Knowledge.
Founded in the year 3305, The Tower of Knowledge is an independent faction of pilots who chose not to seek personal glory, instead dedicating their careers to showing new pilots how to control their ships efficiently and with grace.
system_chun_tstar_key: The Noble Houses Claymore are based in this system. The sons and daughters of the Claymore bloodline have fallen from their once lofty positions through pursuing their own individual agendas. In the wake of a new Emperor and news of threats throughout the galaxy, Victor Claymore, eldest son of Brandon Claymore, has called in the vassal lords and once again united the noble houses under a single banner.
system_chuntal_key: Caballeros de Sion are a feared mercenary force that sell their services across the galaxy. They provide protection to all the population of their home system.
system_clayagro_key: The home of the Band of Bodacious Allies. The Band of Bodacious Allies began as a small political group interested in expanding democratic ideals and promoting peace throughout their home. As their success and popularity within Clayagro increased, their sphere of influence has gradually grown larger and more bodacious.
system_coelatuvean_key: Imperial Prison and Haulage Services is a private organisation founded around 10 years ago with the goal of providing haulage of slaves, prisoners and general cargo.
system_coma_key: Newton's Fusiliers are a veteran group of combat pilots. Having flown together for years under various flags from different bases of operation, this motley group of fearsome fliers has settled in the Coma system, and seek to spread their renown throughout human inhabited space.
system_condi_key: Anti-Xeno Elite is a veteran group of combat pilots. Having flown together for many years under various factions cooperating on operations, its members are a tight-knit group with no specific allegiance. The group is always ready to honour the call to protect human-inhabited space from potential threats.
system_corbago_key: The Corbago Corsairs operate from this system. They are a group of commanders focused entirely on piracy. They also run a smuggling based crime syndicate specialising in narcotics, illegal weapons and slavery.
system_cordenet_key: The home of WDB Galatic Solutions, which has ties to Achenar aristocracy. Having once favoured government contracts, this growing interstellar corporation have long since branched out from their roots in the Imperial slave trade, and now boasts an impressive list of services and clientele.
system_coriat_key:
The home of the Spiral Spirits Division.
Spiral Spirits Division is aligned with the Empire. Members include a number of combat pilots who will protect their territory and allies above all else. It has pledged to expand and become stronger than ever before.
system_coriccha_key: The home of Cabana Produce, this family run operation has combined a quality service with an excellent and varied product range, to become the preferred supplier of frozen, chilled and fresh food products in this part of the galaxy.
system_cornengu_key: The home of Explorers of the Anarchy, who explore the galaxy and fight for freedom in order to overcome the oppression of big corporations.
system_cosi_key:
The home of the Star Tigers.
The Star Tigers consist of former life-term prisoners offered the chance to commute their sentence in exchange for fighting against invading pirates using non-light speed capable combat ships. While most died quickly, this group of warriors survived, banded together once acquitted and established themselves in Cosi.
system_cotidji_key: The home of Little Boxes Communists, a communistic party led by V. Ivanov, whose great-grandfather founded the faction many years ago during a long period of economic bust. The LBC strives towards the views of the founder, by being as neutral as possible. The LBC is not striving towards great wealth, but towards great welfare for all.
system_cotigagaial_key: After many years of carrying out humanitarian work in the Colonia region, The Black Fingernail has recently returned to Bilonesses system to seek out and fulfil mercenary contracts. Members typically wish to live free from the influence of the superpowers. The faction believes that government only contributes to the suffering of the individual, and value honourable actions over-regulation.
system_cowini_key: Formed in 3301 on the agricultural world of Cowini 7 from a merger between Goginc NanoMan Material Concerns and Cowini Gate Substitute Milk Substitute Ltd, United Dairies were granted an Imperial Appointment by Princess Aisling Duval in 3302, delivering genetically modified milk - and other cargo - throughout inhabited space.
system_crathiganit_key:
A group dedicated to the defence of humanity from external threats, The Hand is a brotherhood of equals who seek to distinguish themselves through skill and discipline.

While the faction operates out of the Crathiganit system its members are known to frequent the Squirrel's Nest Bar, located in the rings of Pleione 4.
system_crom_dubh_key: The home of the Acorn Freelancers Corporate Faction. Acorn Freelancers Corporate Faction are a group of pilots dedicated mainly to bounty hunting and trading. They have been slowly growing in size in recent times, mostly recruiting pilots with plenty of combat experience.
system_cromovii_key: Spearhead Interstellar Corps is the self-proclaimed 'Tip of the Spear' of the bounty hunting industry.  It has publicly stated that no pirate is safe in its sphere of influence. Spearhead prides itself on ensuring safe mining and trading routes.
system_cuachini_key: Founded on May 10 3302, The Explorer's Consortium is corporation based on the exploration and expansion of human knowledge of our galaxy. The corporation strives to maintain a political and military stance.
system_cubeo_key: Home system for the Prismatic Imperium - a confederacy of different groups unified in their support of Aisling Duval for the Imperial throne. The group includes factions from the media organisation the People's Media, the Thirteenth Legion, a military organisation, and a navigator's guild. This confederacy of factions was created by Count Jeffrey Alexander Ryan of Ugain, but is now headed by his younger brother, Lord Corwin Ryan. Their goal is to produce materials and support Aisling Duval's bid for Empress.
system_cubere_key: The Insurectionists aim to help others and bring criminals to justice.
system_cuchua_key: In July 3301 there was an attempt by the Kumo Crew and the forces of Archon Delaine to expand into the Imperial system of Cuchua. This was answered with 'Operation Davy Jones', an Imperial military initiative.
system_cuichit_key: Members of the Great Teuthida Movement believe in a theory in which a benevolent and omnipotent squid is responsible for the preservation of the universe and all life within.
system_cumalam_key: The home system for the 151st Freedom fighters. They are a freelance group seeking to operate without the threat of tyranny or enslavement. They work together to build a strong economic system for all those involved, whatever their specialty.
system_daesi_key: The 6th Interstellar Corps are former Imperial Navy pilots turned privateers. Loyal and eager, they protect their interests with ruthless tenacity and endeavour to expand their protectorate over multiple systems.
system_daesitiates_key: Starstone Enterprises is a sub-division of Starstone Industries, which began as a small, family-run terraforming business in 2270. Starstone Enterprises sees itself as a 'brotherhood' within the still family-run company, proudly claiming that they are 'Making Tomorrow's Worlds, Today'.
system_daibo_key: The Imperial Conquistadors are a faction created for long-range explorers with combat capability. Their objective is to establish long-range trade routes, as well as mapping and expanding the Empire's influence to nearby systems outside the inhabited space.
system_dakshmandi_key: The home of the White Scar Contingency. The White Scar Contingency is a splinter group lacking a firm hierarchy, having spent several months scouring known space for a new place to settle following the break from their prior faction. With their pooled resources, these pilots founded the Contingency on several key principles: Loyalty to the group, earning credits and making sure each individual has the opportunity to leave its mark on the galaxy.
system_dalat_key: The home of NANOBREAKERS INTERSTELLAR, a group of pilots of various backgrounds who banded together at the Battle of Lundji.
system_damna_key: Trading Hyperion Corp is a corporation devoted to the trade of rare goods and mining across the bubble. Their services include exploration, data retrieval and military support.
system_damoorai_key: The Damoorai Brotherhood fight to free Damoorai from the clutches of corporations.
system_daralas_key: With origins in Ekono, HumaneProsperity has always stood for human rights, and was banished from Ekono two years ago for trying to limit Imperial slavery. Now, with Princess Aisling Duval having considerable influence over Ekono and its surroundings, co-founders Andrew Saska and former Alliance follower Thomas Masek have the chance to gain more support.
system_delphi_key:
The home of the Galaxy Rangers.
A rag-tag group comprised of veteran pilots and the rookies deemed worthy of their tutelage. Experts in combat and tactics, the Galaxy Rangers excel in many fields of space combat but focus on xeno defence, since this provides an adequate challenge to keep their skills sharp.
system_devane_key: Founded by Richard Sharpe on 1st August 3300, BFNF Solutions rapidly established itself as a military contractor within Imperial Devane. It soon attracted pilots dedicated to making money through exploration, trading, combat and contract work. Although much of the work that BFNF Solutions carries out appears peaceful and far removed from any conflict that a military contractor might be traditionally associated with, one look at their stern, olive drab and silver offices leaves visitors in no doubt that there is something linking all their operations to a greater cause.
system_devata_baru_key: Deep Space Pirate Federation is a group of pirates looking to change the social and economic situation of its system for the benefit of its members.
system_dhata_key: The home of the Patriarchs, who desire peace, prosperity, and liberty to reign supreme throughout the galaxy.
system_dhathaut_key: Able Company Ltd is an independent business organisation that promotes self-worth within the galaxy. They enable pilots to find their own path within the galaxy, and encourage and support exploration, trading and the defence of their home system. Able Company Ltd discourages aggression between members of the Pilots' Federation, but also encourage the assistance of new pilots, so they can get a foothold in the galaxy.
system_di_yomi_key:
The home of the Di Yomi Praetorian Confederacy.
The Di Yomi Praetorian Confederacy encourage the development of secure and profitable relationships with surrounding systems. As such, it is dedicated to maintaining the safety of Di Yomi and nearby systems. DPC commanders support the system as security, bounty hunters, traders, explorers and more.
system_diabak_key: The home of Leviathan Scout Regiment, who were born from a desire to remain affiliated to the Hudson regime, with the caveat of maintaining their own government, and retaining the authority to assist in Federal matters on their own terms. Engaging in a wide variety of missions, the LSR is fiercely loyal to their leader, and to the wing as a whole.
system_diaguandri_key: The Brotherhood of the Dark Circle is based in this system. They are a self governing, cooperative society. Its members work together to advance the faction through commerce, exploration and conflict.
system_dimaratem_key: The home of the Elite Privateer Group Initiative. Dimaratem is a quiet system on the edge of the so-called Human "Bubble". Taking steps to prevent the economic impact of the Thargoid threat, the Elite Privateer Group Initiative aims to thrive. Newly founded and fresh in the business, EPGI seeks new adventures amongst the stars, both as bounty hunters and traders.
system_dimoco_key: The Zinra Corporation is based in this system. It is a corporate, independent society engaged in a variety of industries. Members are known to be particularly protective of its interests and potential for growth.
system_disci_key: The home system for Dark Echo who stand against pirates and other miscreants. They may be hired to support an honourable cause, or they may simply choose to support a good cause pro bono.
system_ditia_key: The Stellar Conglomerate was founded by several corporations to create a new political entity. Spreading a message of fairness and equality throughout the galaxy is one of its top priorities, with secondary enterprises financing this endeavour. Although the Stellar Conglomerate prefers peaceful operations, its members are known to engage in combat when necessary.
system_ditibi_key: The Down Under Squadron is a group dedicated to the Federation's ideals, and to spreading democracy to every human in the galaxy.
system_djaghom_dun_key: The home of the Formidine Socalists. The Formidine Socalists aim to crush the failed corporate-run system of the Federation and the Imperial monarchy. They aim to create a meritocratic power which rewards people for effort, not luck or status.
system_djiraja_key: The home of the Formidine Bounty Hunters, an old faction, that has been exploring the Formidine Rift.
system_djiwal_key: Revolutionary Elite Volunteer Services are guns for hire in a dangerous galaxy.
system_dobunn_key: Black Aegis operates from this system - it is a worker-owned private military and security corporation. The business includes providing escorts, military engagements, bounty hunting and law enforcement. It is often contracted by major organisations needing extra reach, and smaller groups unable to maintain a large armed force.
system_domoira_key:
The home of The Followers of The All Father.
Curious, vigilant and indomitable are all suitable descriptions for The Followers of The All Father. The group encourages tradition and the search for ultimate knowledge. They have gained experience by exploring remote systems. Followers also extract precious minerals which are then shared evenly.
system_don_key: Wazaaa's Wizards is a family orientated group who specialise in a variety of stellar professions. Members are generally regarded as good mentors to new pilots, with the ability and patience to train any who seek them out.
system_draguan_nu_key: The home of the New Republic. The New Republic aim to growing stronger and better every day through their undisclosed activities.
system_dromi_key: Dromi is the administrative centre of the Pilots’ Federation District. As the location for new Commanders to take their first journey into the galaxy as an independent pilot, the system hosts high tech stations and a lively mission hub.
system_duamta_key: The Order of the Smiling Moose is based in this system. Members of this democratically run order help one another survive and thrive in the unforgiving black of space. They also participate in joint ventures and assist the Federation when needed.
system_dulos_key: The system left the Federation to become independent in January 3301.
