system_duwali_key: The home of the Dingos of Duwali. a small collective, comprised of both veterans and rookies, tracing a lineage back to the outback of Earth, Sol. While they don't focus on any one vocation, the Dingos encourage pilots to blaze their own trail among friends. Reports say this collective now seeks to expand further within the Milky Way.
system_duwaredari_key: This system is home to L.Y.S Corp - an organisation that has been granted the rights of an Imperial corporation. Dealing mainly in defence contracts, they have business interests throughout the region.
system_dvorsi_key: The Guardians are a group loyal to the Empire. Many of their members are recruited to protect the Emperor, using any methods, including subterfuge, to keep a step ahead of any threat.
system_dyaushibi_key: Founded as a clandestine agency by an experienced group of independent pilots, Project Echo emerged as a public faction in 3305 following humanity's expansion to the Witch Head Nebula. Project Echo now operates as a defensive coalition, providing combat support and humanitarian aid across inhabited space.
system_dyavansana_key: The Guardians of Cygnus are a group of privateers from all over the galaxy. Explorers, combat pilots, miners, transporters and traders.
system_dyingia_key: Phoenix Rising is the reformation of a previously defunct organisation specialising in the study of potentially habitable planets. Its main aim is to find earthlike worlds eligible for colonisation, while also identifying high-value mining spots.
system_ebana_key: The Syndicate's home system - "We are pirates, in suits, with business licenses."
system_ebisu_key: The Yaken Resistance mainly consists of workers, miners and bounty hunters. It believes in open access to local resources and is willing to share these with like-minded individuals. While still growing in number, members seek to convince others of the concept of an equal society.
system_ebor_key:
The Cobra Wing is a group of independent pilots founded in the Ebor System, in the year of 3301. Led by the dedicated Commander Cobra, the group is composed of active traders, explorers and experienced combat pilots, that are ready for all types of assignments throughout inhabited space.

With specialised training facilities, capable of turning any novice pilot into a professional commander, the Cobra Wing is always looking for new and enthusiastic pilots to join their cause, whoever they may be!
system_edenapel_key: Seeking a balanced existence in a sometimes teetering universe, Plenorum Core are a group of unified isolationists.
system_edenwi_key:
The home of the Radius Group Inc.
Radius Group Inc's goal is to study both space and alien technologies. It intends to apply such research to weapons development.
system_egovi_key: The home of the Egovi Dominion, which was established through the foresight and sweat of their founding father and leader, Bar Kokhba. They are named after the relentless Israelite leader who waged war against the Romans. Those who follow his wise rule become paragons of the Egovi Dominion, carving their names into the fabric of history. Those who challenge Bar Kokhba's leadership are exiled, or worse. The Dominion seeks to grasp and maintain power in the Egovi system and its environs.
system_ehlanda_key: The Imperial Space Security Force of Ehlanda was founded as a way of keeping the peace inside the Ehlanda system and protect Ehlanda from foreign powers.
system_ekonir_key:
This binary system contains well established extraction and refining facilities around the inner planets of the primary star. The locals enjoy telling stories about a ghost ship said to haunt the ice worlds orbiting the companion star.

Blood Rider is based in this system. It is an organisation in parallel with the current government. They worked secretly until now... Blood Rider now work to rally, or conquer other systems.
system_ekono_key:
The home of the Elite United Worlds.
An interstellar group of pilots aiming to defend humankind from threats both internal and external.
system_eleu_key: This is the home system for the Social Eleu Progressive Party. They seek to create an independent, uncontrolled, indivisible and democratic nation for explorers, and all of those who pursue happiness in a better galaxy.
system_eleutsi_key: This tiny system supports a low level extraction operation. With a population as small as this everyone knows your business. Strangers receive hostile looks when coming here.
system_en_kunthurs_key: The home of House of Kahn. Originally a research and development organisation under the umbrella of the Federation that specialised in genetic manipulation, the House of Kahn has since expanded their remit. They are regularly seen engaging in military activities on behalf of their research benefactors, in order to maintain continued funding and expansion.
system_eol_prou_lw_d_l_c8_d_133_key: The Consortium Pioneers was formed in late 3302 by a rag-tag group from the Paladin Consortium of LFT 37. They were established as an independent cooperative who wanted to find a better world amongst the distant, and then unsullied, systems of Colonia.
system_eotienses_key: Senator Denton Patreus has his home in this system.
system_eravapa_key: Sissy Incorporated operate across the whole spectrum of scientific, industrial and military activities. They see their duty as strengthening the Empire, enforcing the law and defending imperial citizens.
system_eravarenth_key: This sparsely populated system supports a mixed extraction and mining economy. The locals like to tell stories of some of the great pilots that have passed through this system. Some even claim that one of Peter Jameson's descendents lives in the system or nearby.
system_eravate_key:
A modest star system, yet one still capable of supporting a mixed agriculture and industrial economy. It is an unusual system formation as it lacks gas giants. The locals don't seem to mind though.

Home system of Adle's Armada, a Federation aligned securities group founded in Ngaliba in 2900. Currently headquartered in the Eravate system, it was originally formed as a Federal detachment of a classified inter-factional combat force. Post Commander Tyllerius Adle pulled his force out of the secretive organisation in 3200, re-branding his group as "Adle's Armada" in the process. In present day the Armada still shrouds itself in secrecy and only recruits the finest combat pilots into its ranks and pledges safety and security to all citizens living in its protected systems.
system_erdi_key: The home system for Imperator's Shield. The faction is deployed to areas of Imperial control in need of stabilisation. Imperator's Shield has seen activity in several sectors, putting an end to civil wars and criminal cartels, and even helping to stabilise local economies. Having proven its usefulness, Imperator's Shield has been given unilateral control of its own forces, and now chooses its own areas of operation, always acting in accordance with Imperial Law.
system_ese_eyo_key: The Nobles of the Imperial Dominion strives to further Imperial ideology, working tirelessly in establishing new trade routes and suppressing threats to the societies of humanity that exist outside the protection of the Empire.
system_esien_ming_key:
The home of the Prometheus Astro-Logistics Corporation.
A Megacorporation founded on genetic enhancements and pharmaceuticals, the Prometheus Astro-Logistics Corporation seeks to remain at the forefront of technological advancement everywhere in the spirit of the Greek demigod it takes its name from. 
With strong initial ties to several political forces, PAL Corp. aims to become a nexus for diplomacy across the Galaxy and dawn a new age of unity and prosperity.
Its motto is, ‘PAL Corp: We Are the Ambition.’
system_estae_key: Arms of the Panda are experts in combat-related missions. They specialise in trader protection, system security, war and rescue services.
system_etznabal_key: The DeepCore Empire was founded by a small mining group on the outskirts of inhabited space that had been subjected to pirate attacks for years. Tasked with protecting miners, DeepCore Empire now offers a range of services from convoy escort to VIP protection.
system_etznabi_key:
As they say in the Red Stars Squadron: ‘Money is the pillar of strength and power!’

This faction is dedicated to the art of combat while understanding the importance of financial stability. Members are known to participate in trade, mining and exploration operations.
system_evena_key:
The home of The Terminus Syndicate. The Terminus Syndicate is an autonomous organization. The Syndicate is primarily focused on the protection of others. They bring those in need of protection under the banner of the organization. They are focused on cooperation, collaborating with others in a mutually beneficial partnership. The protection of those in the Evena system and neighbouring systems is one of their many duties.
The Council of Administrators is the voice and authority of the Syndicate, enforcing the charter to keep law and order within the people under their rule. The backbone of their forces is formed by Commanders of the Pilots' Federation.
system_falisci_key: In March 3301 Imperial forces fought pirates for control of the system; the Imperials were victorious.
system_fan_chau_key: A small extraction operation can be found in this system and not much else. The home of the Allied Imperial Coalition, technically an independent group, they look to support the Empire and Federation while trying to limit conflict between the two. The system was chosen as the local populace was disgruntled with Federal Corporate governments focusing on the value of resources in the system rather than the people living there, and were willing to accept an alternative.
system_feng_tanga_key: The Imperial Signal Corp is committed to dealing with threats to the Empire, while maintaining a pledge to defend humanity as a whole. It trains groups of pilots to be flexible, multi-skilled and ready to answer the call of duty wherever it is heard.
system_fiden_key: MAIA LOGISTICS provides any kind of transport job, and have built a reputation in the transport industry in a significantly short time period.
system_fintamkina_key: Orion Corporation is a coalition of loosely affiliated traders, mercenaries, and freelance pilots that have banded together for support against more established factions.
system_finteno_key: Aurora Security's main purpose is to protect the people of the Federation and its assets. Though quite small, the Aurorian Security Core wishes to expand and become a major organisation officially sanctioned by the Federation.
system_fintia_key: New Lapland Frontiers of Fintia are settlers with Finnish origins. The Empire assimilated Fintia after a bitter struggle, and now they explore the stars in search of a new home as breathtaking and extraordinary as their ancestral one.
system_fire_fade_key: The home of Fire Fade Hunters Squad, an organisation who primarily works towards cleaning the system of criminals.
system_firenses_key: In order to protect settlers and maintain law and order in the new frontier, the Cavalry Command of Yuma was created.
system_flechti_key:
The home of Gauderios Wing.
Gauderios Wing is a peaceful and friendly group. It believes in justice and democracy, but is willing to defend its independence.
All members are engaged in a variety of activities such as transportation, bounty hunting and exploration. They are prepared to contribute to humanity’s defence.
system_fong_wang_key:
Two asteroid belts border the inner region of this system, populated by a number of terrestrial planets supporting manufacturing and refinery industries. The outer system is a xenobiologist's dream with two gas giants known to support water based life forms in their atmospheres.

The home of Elite Space Rangers, a cross-faction group dedicated to the progress and protection of its members and allies.
system_frendan_key: The home of Sagittarius Coalition, whose members have dedicated their lives to protecting the innocent from the many dangers of the galaxy, from pirates and renegades, to the vicious Thargoid attackers invading human space.
system_freng_key: The home of the Federal Envoys, who help to spread the influence of the Federation.
system_frenis_key: The Court Knights have monitored the galaxy since 3301, waiting for any signs of malevolent extraterrestrial activity. After recent investigations they have begun to prepare themselves for the worst, and are now ready to face any invasion.
system_frey_key: C&S Mining Corp is based in this system.
system_frigaha_key: This system's asteroid belts are rich with metals and minerals supporting an extensive extraction and refinery economy. The outermost gas giant is known to harbour ammonia based life forms and is often visited by researching xenobiologists.
system_frigga_key: SPVK Enterprises seek to uphold the ideal that all persons are created equal, and they consider themselves duty bound to ensure that. They believe that we are not all equal in poverty, but in wealth; and they seek to bring wealth to the galaxy.
system_fu_huacobad_key: The 1st Imperial Trading Party focuses on lucrative trade routes, with involvement in mining and humanitarian aid.
system_futeno_key: The Aberrant Outlaws are an isolated lawless people.
system_gaarnuten_key:
The home of Imperial Dragoons.
Based in the Gaarnuten system, Imperial Dragoons seeks to expand the influence and prestige of the Empire primarily through mining and trade. It believes that honest work merits significant rewards, and successful individuals deserve reverence and respect.
system_gabri_key: The home of the Eol Prou Branch, a corporate unit which provides communication with the core systems. They observe and research alien life forms. Eol Prou Branch also conducts research in various fields of technology.
system_gakia_key:
The home of the Educated Pilots Association.
The Educated Pilots Association (EPA) is a union of independent pilots from all over inhabited space. It was first established during the early stages of deep space exploration.
The EPA found a home in the Gakia system. Traders, bounty hunters and explorers are counted among its ranks, along with those who care about the sector’s inhabitants.
system_galis_key: The home of the RapRod Security Industries. RapRod Security Industries specialise in crime prevention. Their manifesto promotes peace through superior firepower.
system_gandii_key: Home to the Pirates of Gandii, a secretive group of pirates and smugglers that are involved in nearly all forms of criminal activity; the notable exception is the transport of slaves, which it detests. Curiously the faction maintains an affiliation with the Federation. The exact nature of this relationship is a mystery that neither party have yet commented on.
system_gandu_key: The home of The Dark Matter Pirates, a group of independent privateers.
system_gandza_key:
The home of the Federal Security Administration. The Federal Security Administration (FSA) was formed to combat the ever growing threat of piracy and terrorism in Federal space, and defend against incursions from interstellar factions. The FSA are also known to take up clerical tasks for the Federation, including courier services and sourcing materials for public projects to ensure they are safely completed. 
Members of this organization operate on a volunteer basis and are considered free agents, bound by only Federal procedure.
system_gato_key: Gato is known locally for its agricultural output, which is provided by its two terraformed planets. It previously experienced a tourism boom, however this ended when an increased Federal military presence in the system spooked the tourists. It is currently governed by the Gato Confederacy.
system_gatorma_key: The home of Military Gamers, a confederation of current and former military personnel, bounty hunters, mercenaries, and similar like-minded individuals.
system_gaula_wu_key: Exploration and Resource recovery Corp was founded by the Guathit legal PLC, and aligned with the Empire. They specialise in planetary exploration, retrieval and rescue services, as well as striving to collect and distribute new and unknown sources of information across the galaxy.
system_gaura_key: Though the name might suggest it, the Community of the Vault is not a religious faction. It is a fairly random amalgamation of pilots that felt unwanted in any other place they travelled through. The ‘Vault’ is the term given to this feeling of not belonging, having stirred the founders of this group to band together. Members do judge anybody based on their past; providing an individual accepts the community’s rules, they are welcome.
system_gautas_key: Founded in 3305, the Alliance Exploration Corps is a joined collaboration of elite pilots primarily engaged in the exploration of uncharted regions of the galaxy. As a secondary focus, the AEC also engages in mining and security details to fund faction operations.
system_gbekree_key: The Enigma Dyson Syndicate is an independent group of traders, explorers and bounty hunters. They intend to establish a base for all free minded pilots in the Gbekree System. Their main station is "Dzhanibekov Port" in Gbekree.
system_geawetes_key: In 3300 an insurgency  tied up Imperial resources over the world of Bartini. An imperial wing called Imperial Royal Fleet was launched to capture the rebel group.
system_gendalla_key:
The home of the NCA Interstellar Initiative.
The N.C.A.I.I have been cleaning up resource sites and delivering the goods no matter what. It has participated in many dangerous assignments and is known to test the boundaries of legality when necessary.
system_gende_key: Swedish Vikings are a group of people who want to preserve Swedish traditions so that they do not disappear for good. Many historians come to this group in order to conduct research on ancient traditions and customs. The Swedish language is disappearing, so much of the work is also to preserve it and teach it to new generations. The Swedish archive group is also one of the largest in the galaxy, and all of Sweden's history can be read and researched here, but no documents, movies or photos may leave the archive.
system_gendenwitha_key:
Cold Phoenix is now a group of clandestine mercenaries. It includes people who are mostly exiles from neighbouring systems but also includes former military, scientists, researchers and even pirates from the four corners of the galaxy.

They were originally associated with the Empire, however being against slavery their contract was terminated. They also dabbled in more illegal activities such as larceny and smuggling, but still have a military hierarchy and fight against injustice.
system_gender_key:
The home of TASK Defenders.
TASK Defenders is a group of pilots that follow three key principals when deployed. They act tactically, aggressively, and safely to ensure maximum effectiveness. The group remain available to anyone in need.
Its motto is, ‘Tactical, Aggressive, Safe: Knight Defenders.’
system_gerdulla_key: The home of the Gerdulla Pirates. This is the home of the Gerdulla Pirates, a band of ruthless pirates that use Gerdulla as a staging ground for privateering acts against civilised space. The Gerdulla Pirates are declared enemies of society, believing most cultures cannot understand why these pirates take what they want and fear nothing.
system_ghekreep_key:
The home of The Nova Syndicate.
The Nova Syndicate was formed as a corporate entity with the goal of providing multiple services and fulfilling contracts throughout the Milky Way. 
Its motto is, ‘Critical Mass is achieved together.’
system_gilya_key: The Fireflies were once a band of pilots united for their own safety, but have now expanding their operations and influence to combat pirates wherever and whenever they may arise.
system_giryampi_key: Imperial Pilots Coalition is dedicated to helping any pilot who is allied to an Imperial power. They shall not attack any other Imperial faction unless provoked.
system_gladutjin_key: Third Independent Fleet consists of ambitious pilots who have banded together and will not tolerate any affront to the truth, nor any attempt to harass those who seek it out.
system_gluskaiabal_key: DarkFire Corporation is an independent corporation dedicated to the exploration and exploitation of space. Backed by their small private navy, DarkFire Corporation is stubborn in achieving its goals
system_goller_key:
Although involved in countless industries, ExtraCorp is perhaps best known for training pilots of extraordinary capability without reliance on flight automation, saving their clients billions in credits each fiscal cycle.

These pilots, known colloquially as the "Extras", have been witnessed disabling or even destroying ships being piloted by unsupervised "docking computers" in this region of space. There are rumours of an ExtraCorp Combat Computer under development.
system_gommatchal_key: ACME Interstellar corporation was founded by a group of independent commanders frustrated with their careers. They chose to take the plunge and risk massive debt to form their own cooperative. Early operations led them to the Gommatchal system, then under the control of the notorious Silver Brotherhood gang. Responding to pleas from the oppressed citizens, they were able to rally support from the nearby Karamai Patrons of Law, and succeeded in ousting the Brotherhood. This and further activities led to a significant boost to ACME's fortunes, and now the corporation possesses a measurable degree of influence in Gommatchal.
system_grebegus_key:
The home of Spice Smugglers.
The industrious farming system of Grebegus doesn't seem like a haven for crime, but appearances can be deceiving. It is rumoured that the system’s economy relies in part on nameless smuggling operations that bypass restrictions against prohibited crops, tariffs and taxes. One faction, Spice Smugglers, has become profitable enough to be a contender for political control of the system despite criminal accusations from opponents.
system_greila_key:
The home of Deep Space Patrol.
Deep Space Patrol provides security and support in deep space via bounty hunting and trading, looking to inspire optimism with its services. While maintaining uncompromising principles in the face of emergencies, the faction strives to set a new standard of excellence.
system_gridge_key: The home of the Imperial Truckers and Bounty Hunters. This faction is a well-armed and strong headed trading and bounty hunting fleet from Gridge. Local media claim do not fear death to protect those in need; nor are they afraid of pirates while hauling goods across the galaxy. They have pledged their allegiance to Aisling Duval and are devoted to her beliefs.
system_groa_key:
The Cabal is a religious organisation devoted to unravelling the truth behind a mythical artefact known as the Corrupted Chalice. Its sacred texts claim that the appearance of this relic is foreshadowed by wars, famines and other calamities that result in a huge loss of life.

In the past, the Cabal was content in simply researching such events. However, since a new leader came to power, it is rumoured that the Cabal is driven in initiating large-scale disasters in an attempt to force the manifestation of the artefact.
system_grovichun_key: On a station no one talks about, in the lower decks furthest from the more populated areas is a place were "Exotic" goods dealers can go, take a load off and share stories of their exploits. A place known only as, "The Blackhorse Bar."
system_guan_yun_key:
The home of the Imperial Concilium.
The Imperial Concilium of the Guan Yun system governs the citizens within its borders. The Concilium deploys its retinue of bounty hunters, The Armed Concilium, to protect its interests and all trade routes within its territory.
system_guanekagha_key: The home of Freelancers Inc, a security force led by the charismatic and media-shy Quentin Xavier. They specialise in trading, bounty hunting, even mining on occasion.
system_guathiti_key: This is the home system of the Bloodhounds of the Empire. They are a group of former Federation fighter pilots who were betrayed by their leaders. Now allied to the Empire, these ace fighter pilots are a renowned band of bounty hunters with two main missions: earn money by clearing the galaxy of those on the wanted list and vengeance on those that betrayed them.
system_gubian_key: The home of the Imperial Trade Works. Imperial Trade Works are a trading company, mainly based within Imperial territory. While they focus on trade, they also handle a wide range of security and charity projects.
system_gugu_key: The FarStar Foundation is an Imperial organisation conducting biotechnological and pharmaceutical research on death row prisoners for the betterment of mankind.
system_gulngaba_key: A binary system with an extensive agricultural infrastructure on a terraformed world orbiting the primary star. A range of terrestrial planets around the companion star support a secondary extraction economy. There is a fierce rivalry between the two populations despite the gross mismatch in numbers.
system_gundji_key:
The home of the Defenders of The Galaxy. Defenders of The Galaxy specialise in bounty hunting, anti-terror strategies and trade.
This faction was formed by four former Imperial commanders with the stated aim of protecting civilians and establishing peace during an active stellar conflict. Following peace talks, these insurgents maintained this system as a base of operations. Their purpose remains the same: To keep the peace.
system_gunnovale_key: Aurora Corps is a group of mercenaries. It is willing to fight for any cause providing the price is right. The faction has established a base of operations in the Gunnovale system.
system_gurabru_key: Gurabru is the headquarters of Elite Space Corporation, a company active in the areas of space engineering, exploration and terraforming. ESC has long collaborated with the Dukes of Jotun. Several years of alliance allowed the corporation to evolve rapidly and establish its headquarters in the Gurabru system.
system_gurus_key: Federal Galactic Systems was founded to build up and support Federation interests across the galaxy.
system_guttun_key: The Totam Rem Corporation is an independent megacorporation aiming to unite systems and resources under its brand. It is led by a council known as "Unientis", and the organisation is engaged in diverse activities like deep space research, planetary cartography, colonisation and tourism.
system_guuguyni_key: Ilona Ivayeva, patron of Guugyni system, set out on an abolitionist crusade to improve the lot of Imperial slaves. Supported by Princess Aisling Duval through the "Stop Slavery Stupid" movement, Ivayeva built contacts with different politicians, patrons, citizens and independent commanders. From this movement evolved the Imperial Scarlet Society.
system_gwiona_key: The home of the Stargazer Agency. Stargazer Agency allows all members to live with respect for one other's way of life, working together for the success of their organisation. They also pursue exploration with interest, seeking to uncover the mysteries of space.
system_gwyddi_key: The Council of Lords was an organisation founded to uphold Imperial values in the outer systems.
system_hachiman_key: The McCoy Trading Co is a fledgling company whose aim is aiding nearby systems rather than maximizing profit.
system_hai_chan_key: The home system for Dedalo Corp. Interstellar - a group of traders, and their armed escorts, who decided to find their own place in the galaxy, away from the big powers and their expansion plans, living in peace and prosperity, increasing commercial exchanges and defending settlers from external threats. The Dedalo Corp is always trying to expand its influence in order to create safe colonies.
system_hai_ho_key: Members of Hai Ho Silver Linings are actively engaged in the promotion of an anti-slavery political agenda.
system_haitchane_key: Ceres Confederacy was formed to explore unknown space. To fund these expeditions it focuses on regional trade. Mapping the stars have always been this faction’s focus, with particular attention paid to discovering potential terraforming candidate worlds.
system_hajangai_key: The home of the Fatherhood, a band of former traders, mercenaries and military officers.
system_hajonga_key: The home of Legionnaria Protectiva, dedicated to the protection of the Empire.
system_halbangaay_key: The home of the Rebeldes Espaciales. A small group who believe they represent the last piece of honour in the Galaxy. They pay homage to a proud past by looking for their own future, beyond the stars; feeding a passion for science and honing their engineering in the pursuit of success. They are seen as mercenaries for most; as philosophers for the few; but act as rebels for certain, and will scour every corner of the galaxy to vanquish their enemies.
system_halbarapii_key: Red Nemesis consists, for the most part, of pilots, former soldiers and scientific explorers from all over the galaxy. Originally associated with the Empire, its strong opposition to slavery led to the dissolution of this arrangement. The faction now operates as mercenaries, with rumours of member involvement in illegal activities such as theft and smuggling. Despite this, its stated objective is to work against injustice.
system_hamoco_key: The Greenleaf Conglomerate is involved in several industries, from passenger transport to exploration and research, trading, mining and security.
system_hanggardi_key: Eclipse is an enterprise which started out as a simple trade group, but rapidly expanded to cater for most professions. It is rumoured to have been engaged in illegal, and often lethal, practices to get ahead, but its board strongly denies these claims. Its goal is simply to help its pilots gain credits, whatever the job.
system_hania_key:
The home of the Sciurus Democracy.
Seeking peace and harmony with all, the Sciurus Democracy is a collection of pilots specializing in the transportation of passengers to the far-flung edges of the galaxy.
system_hanu_key:
The home of UAlcool Transportation Service.
UAlcool Transportation Service specialises in trade of all sorts, ranging from beer to military equipment.
system_haren_key: The home of the Abyssal Legion. The Abyssal Legion stand to protect one and all out in the endless void of space. The faction started as a small mining/trade group who suffered at the hands of piracy. Those who survived now seek to rid the galaxy of such threats, thus forming the Legion and gathering like-minded mercenaries and bounty-hunters capable of combating such criminal atrocities.
system_harm_key:
Harlequin Dusk Mercenary Corp (HDMC) are an elite mercenary faction based in the Harm system. Their main purpose is to provide effective combat services to the highest bidding factions. However, they have been known to run escort services for freighters when specifically requested.

They pride themselves on having a strict code of honour which states that once a contract has been agreed and accepted then this is binding, and the Corp will not renege on said contract, regardless of any amounts offered by rival bidders.
system_haste_key: Chill Incorporated is a group of open-minded individuals with a long career of trading on the murkier margins of society. They transport troublesome cargo, discreetly remove difficult individuals or acquire merchandise that is not readily available from the usual sources. Operating out of the Haste system, this free wheeling band of freebooters seek to expand their influence over surrounding systems and will let nothing stand in their way.
system_hatmehing_key:
Home of the Archon Horde, a loose confederacy of pirates, brigands, mercenaries and criminals led by the illegitimate son of Archon Delaine. Where once personal debts meant slavery, Archon the Mongrel merely demands his pound of flesh... literally. As such, visitors are advised to stay away from the local casinos and not to buy into the advertisements for loans and credit cards.

While one might think that being taken over by the Archon Horde would put a dampener on Hatmehing's production facilities, this is not the case. Under Archon the Mongrel's leadership, Hatmehing production facilities have increased production of both performance enhancers, progenitor cells and synthetic meat.
system_hau_ku_key: The home of The 104th Humanity Defence Force, which was brought into being due to the Thargoid threat. Their goal is to defend humanity and all of her assets from the Thargoids.
system_havalokul_key: The Data Collectors have deemed this system a place for the worship of pure science and applied mathematics.
system_havared_key: Phantoms of Exile seeks redemption after its original home was rendered uninhabitable. Ever since that tragedy, the faction has been drifting through the galaxy seeking a purpose. It is reported that members commonly engage in combat with a variety of hostile groups and entities.
system_he_pola_key: The home of the Retrotech Collective Agency. Corporation. An organisation focused on the acquisition and distribution of technology.
system_he_pora_key: The home of Forsaken Hunters, an Imperial faction whose orders are to hold Bhutas against the impending Federal forces for as long as possible.
system_he_qiong_key: The home of the Galactic Travellers Organisation. Galactic Travellers Organisation is a high-class cruise liner company. They transport people to wherever they want, all over the Galaxy.
system_hedetet_key:
Blackwater Traditional Defense has established itself in the Hedetet system.  It works tirelessly to protect the system’s inhabitants against any forces that seek to disrupt their lives.

Its motto is, ‘All come under the watchful eye of Blackwater Traditional Defense.’
system_hehe_key: The home of The Old Breed, who honour their roots in the United States Marine Corps and strive to live up to its core values of Honour, Courage, and Commitment. Semper Fidelis - Victoria inter Stellas!
system_helgardu_key:
The home of Sogoe Crew.
Sogoe Crew is a group of pilots pledged to locate its lost leader, whose last transmission mentioned a journey to Cygni X-3.
system_hemang_key: The Hemang system was originally settled to take advantage of the scientific and agricultural benefits of the unique water-based chemistry and carbon-water-based life found within the system. The local population has remained fiercely independent since its original colonisation. At the beginning of 3302 the citizens of Hemang called for political reform within the system due to uncontrollable corruption within the local government that resulted in extreme levels of social inequality and oppressive law enforcement.
system_heng_key: The home of the Cooper Industries. Cooper Industries works hard to make their section of the galaxy a better place, providing peace and prosperity for their people.
system_herme_key: The home of Soul Sector Syndicate, a group of commanders from a wide variety of systems and professions. They originated in the hazardous resource sites of the Soul Nebula, and as their numbers grew relocated within the bubble to continue their expansion.
system_hernkopa_key: Hernkopa Interstellar Logistics' founding principle is the democratic right of its citizens to forge their own path, with a focus on commerce and defence.
system_herthans_key: Founded by Commanders Hazardsix and Blackhat1, Outer Rim Incorporated aim to trade and explore to benefit the galaxy.
system_heverduduna_key: Tell's Wrath of Ugrivirii are a trading and bounty hunting guild who aim to make their home system a secure and prosperous place.
system_hikenk_key: This system was once famous for supporting the liberation of slaves.
system_hilla_key: The home of PLOID. Disillusioned with the ideologies of the Federation and Empire, and believing the Alliance to be entirely incompetent, a small group of independent pilots banded together in an effort to bring stability back to their system.
system_hillaunges_key:
The home of The Universal League of Terrorists, Rebels, and Anarchists.
The Universal League of Terrorists, Rebels, and Anarchists - or U L T R A - is a faction of criminals dedicated to the spread of anarchy, promoting rebellion and terrorism wherever it is present.
system_hip_101846_key: The Pilots and the Holy Grail can be found in this system. They are a group of honourable men, still in search of the Holy Grail.
system_hip_15609_key: The Kingdom of Salvation is a loosely organised group of pilots dedicated to the mentorship of pilots who share the common goal of furthering skills and knowledge throughout human-inhabited space. It has no specific political affiliation nor highly structured leadership, asking instead that pilots abide by a simple code of honour.
system_hiranyaksha_key:
"And I saw, and beheld a pale horse. And his name that sat upon him was Death, and Hell followed with him..."

The creed of The Pale Horsemen is a grim remnant of ancient mythology, used in their propaganda to spread fear and to invoke an otherworldly sensation to their organisation.

Its members consider themselves to have been freed from the shackles that once bound them. Free from laws and corruption of larger factions. They adhere to traditional values such as loyalty towards the syndicate, bravery in battle and a firm belief in free will and freedom of choice for all of mankind.
system_hirapa_key: Astra Militarum was created after the coronation of Arissa Lavigny-Duval. Since its inception it has recruited the best Imperial pilots, whatever their backgrounds, and their membership is guaranteed if they take the oath. Members are ready to defend the Emperor with their lives.
system_hixkar_key: The home of the Hungarian Pilot Syndicate. The Hungarian Pilot Syndicate are an experienced faction, who aim to help rookie pilots get started in the galaxy. They participate in a variety of occupations.
system_hixkaramu_key: Canis Lupus - lords of commerce and masters of technology. A self-reliant force of traders, merchants, mechanics and soldiers, the collective of Canis Lupus stands as a bastion of economic wealth and influence in the galaxy and, when needed, they are the Templar Knights of civilised space. They do not seek, nor thrive on, war. However, when faced with piracy and petty criminals they will kill to survive.
system_ho_hsi_key: Nova Elite is an organisation engaging in activities to further its own goals and to maintain absolute control over its interests.
system_hodur_key: The Black Hand of Orion was originally formed from a conglomerate of disparate, fanatical, quasi-religious organisations, brought together by the common goal of acquiring power and influence. Most member organisations trace their heritage back to isolated systems in the Orion Spur and the Sagittarius Arm sectors of the galaxy, from which the group takes its name. In recent decades, Eric Hobbles the 'Red and Ebony King' has forged a new gospel, and streamlined the conglomerate - robbing each 'satellite' cult of its individuality, but simultaneously instilling them with a renewed purpose and a greater sense of collectivism.
system_holo_key: The home of YoRHa. “For the Glory of Mankind.”
system_hooriayan_key:
The home of the Cerberus Alliance.
The Cerberus Alliance is a privateer fleet and corporation. Its stated mission to expand the Allied sphere of influence in systems that are politically turbulent, while protecting Allied systems from all threats.
Its motto is, ‘No system too big, no enemy too large.”
system_hou_mayo_key: The home of the Red Saints, a team of pilots who follow their own path as bounty hunters, mercs and hired guns.
system_hr_5307_key: The Vail's home system is rich in resources, which has led to an ongoing conflict between pirate and Federal forces. The Vail's ruthless efficiency has made the populace rich throughout their home system.
system_hranit_key: The home of The Guardians of AeSir. The public face of 'The Guardians of Aesir', a nomadic tribe of space travellers dedicated to the furtherance of science and technology through peaceful means across the galaxy... unless provoked.
system_hruntia_key: The Imperial Privateers are a group that is actively engaged in the time honoured tradition of privateering. Representatives of this group should be treated with the respect that befits Natasha Lavigny, who is the younger cousin of the Emperor, and their patron. Natasha Lavigny may be young but is ear-marked for great things, so she has been appointed patron to keep the Privateers on task in the service of the Empire as she learns the tools and ways of statecraft.
system_hu_jona_key: The home of Spectre Corporation, an organisation run by Director Jerreck with the goal of providing work to any pilot needing the funds or reputation. This system is their headquarters, and serves as the main training hub for all their corporate pilots.
system_hualarna_key: The Mecklenburg Corp focuses on the trading of commodities, and offers travel services to all galactic inhabitants. They want to help and support peaceful coexistence.
system_huangais_key:
Impavida Vitus operates out of this system promoting several key values: ‘Together with enthusiasm; Respect everyone; Learn from failure; Defend the weak; Always have a cracking time.’

These values are encapsulated in the 'One Wing Economy' philosophy which encourages Impavida Vitus members to pursue personal goals alongside the faction’s objectives. Impavida Vitus typically avoids political involvement or territorial conquest, preferring to promote its core values of stability and prosperity in its region of space.
system_huldr_key: The home of Relentless Aggression, which sets out to dominate systems through razor sharp politics, shrewd economics and overwhelming military firepower.
system_hun_nu_key:
The home of Tombstone Mining Company.
The Tombstone Mining Company are a group of elite miners originally formed in Colonia.
Its responsibilities include the acquisition, transportation and security of precious minerals and metals. Rumours suggest that the faction also employs trained bounty hunters and assassins.
system_hungalun_key:
The home of the Steven Gordon Jolliffe. This faction's stated goal is to ensure the safety and security of citizens throughout Federal controlled space. Regardless of individual vocation - miner, trader, smuggler, explorer, or combat pilot – they consider all member of the Federal family to be equals, advocating unity and solidarity.
Their motto is, 'We are not the hammers that pound at the doors of our enemies; we are the shield that holds them at bay.'
system_hunnalyeh_key: Two asteroid belts provide the mineral wealth for this system's extraction based economy. Despite its small population it has a competitive choral combat league with several major teams.
system_hunza_key: The Arthelan Principality strives to uphold the independence of its system. While not affiliated with any particular superpower, members of the group are considered to be well connected both with the Federation and the Empire. What they lack in brute force, they compensate for with diplomatic prowess, good administration and an excellent nose for business. The faction focuses on extraction and colonisation, as well as trade, and is currently led by Duke Nidaren Far.
system_hurukuntak_key: The home of IMPERIAL HONOR CORPS, a syndicate of the Empire's most elite fighters and traders.
system_hyades_sector_zu_d_y_d117_key:
Home to the Buckyball Racing Club, formed in 3301 by a group of participants in the Buckyball Run series of races, after it was announced that the original organiser of the Buckyball Run was taking an indefinite break from doing so. The aim of the club is to continue to organise and race in Buckyball-style challenges.

The Buckybot Bar at Rebuy Prospect is fully licensed, unlike our races, and we have a wide selection of beer mats, badges and stuffed bears in our gift shop.
system_hyel_yeh_key: The Independent Pilots of Hyel Yeh, in association with corporations in Hyel Yeh, established them selves as an organisation dedicated to exploration and commerce.
system_hyldeptu_key: Morlocks Corp is a group of businessman who see opportunities all over the galaxy.
system_iapo_vuh_key:
The home of Galactic 911.
Galactic 911 are highly respected pilots in command of engineered ships. This social group are willing to help others across the galaxy with tasks ranging from ship maintenance to pirate hunting.
system_iapori_key:
The home of The Qushji Research Council.
The Qushji Research Council is searching for the most beautiful habitable systems to help humanity expand and survive in a wild and vast galaxy.
system_iconti_shi_key: For generations inquisitors and scribes have taken leaves of absence in this distant system to study the revered Codex. Over time a community of retirees developed, their fond memories of tranquillity and fraternity drawing them back here.
system_idini_key: The Hessian Conglomerate is based in this system.
system_ienpalang_key: The Devenport Corporation, founded in 3295, specialises in the manufacture of heavy weaponry and large-scale ship armour. It obtains the materials needed from the Ienpalang system, which is shipped locally to various production facilities.
system_igboniu_key: The home of Opulence Management Group, an organisation that aims to further peace and prosperity through the acquisition of wealth.
system_iman_caber_key: The home of the United Systems Rangers. The United Systems Rangers are an independent private military company, currently working as peacekeepers and security for various groups and organisations.
system_imango_key:
The home of Hyperion.
Hyperion was created by several renegade pilots from both the Federation and the Empire, who believed that their skills would be better used making their own mark on the galaxy rather than be regarded as mere tools of the superpowers. Hyperion pilots hunt the targets which bring the most credits, human or otherwise.
system_imeutsu_key: The home of the FoXRay. FoX-Ray was founded to secure peace on the edge of Federation space, believing bounty hunting is an important factor in keeping the civilians safe and the crime rate low. Some formidable fighter pilots were hired to do this job. The faction are also willing to hire new recruits.
system_inara_key: The Inara Nexus was as a home for those who wish to be free from the politics of the rest of the galaxy. More recently, it has served as a refuge for those weary of galactic strife, welcoming those from all walks of life. In exchange for a voice in everyday affairs, new citizens are asked to respect the principles of neutrality and peacefulness. All are welcome regardless of affiliations, though tolerance and civility is expected of guests and residents alike.
system_irula_key:
The home of Irula B4 Ltd.
Irula B4 Ltd. specialises in trading and bounty hunting. It seeks to promote and improve the economy and security of the Irula system.
system_irusan_key: The Candy Crew Guild (CCG) was originally formed more than a millennium ago. Over time the CCG has evolved into a high tech corporation that builds and maintains some of the galaxy's fastest vehicles, though many aspects of the organisation are shrouded in secrecy.
system_itza_key: Home system of the Guardians of the Core - a group of explorers, traders and fighters united under the common goals of keeping deep space free from conflict, and supporting the exploration of the galaxy.
system_itzamnets_key: The home of The Emporium, a group of like-minded pilots who came together by happy accident. The tenets of the group are fair play, cooperation and mutual support. Their pilots fulfil many roles, from trader to explorer, bounty-hunter to miner, pirate to passenger pilot, and all are experts in their field.
system_ix_key: The Eleusinian Initiative is an advanced-tech research institute committed to the progression of science. Based in the high-tech system of IX, the Initiative operates several sites and facilities integral to the furtherance of that ideal, and in working with the Initiative anyone can help secure a vision for a greater future.
system_jaaka_key: The Black Hand operates from this system. It is a splinter group of the Dukes of Jaaka. Its economic struggle for power emerged in 3196 as Duke Khala Baaht and allied families formed an alliance to remove the elder Dukes of Jaaka after raising them to power through various trading endeavours and the extermination of opposing factions. Now in 3301 the Black Hand of Jaaka is ready to push the Dukes of Jaaka out of power, led by Khala Baaht's son: Duke Aza Baaht of Jaaka.
system_jaakari_key: Team Rocket aims to protect worlds from devastation, to unite all people and to extend their reach to the stars above.
system_jadlillke_key: The home of the 4 Stars Research Syndicate. The 4 Stars Research Syndicate are a band of scientists and adventurers from a multitude of adventitious origins, focusing on meaningful work in a variety of fields. Attempting to exemplify the ideal of an Elite pilot, they exist to provide a meeting place for individuals from all walks of life and the cultivation of skills necessary to thrive in a dangerous galaxy.
system_jakaliki_key: It is unknown how Triarii of the Old Worlds was formed. This group is a mix of experienced and rookie pilots; some are rumoured to have supposed Kaeso Mordanticus during battle of Paresa in 3305. The faction reportedly seeks to introduce its own interpretation of the ethos of the Old Worlds, believing humanity would benefit from a new philosophy. How this change would manifest itself is yet to be revealed.
system_jamanu_key: The home of the Portuguese Royal Navy. The Portuguese Royal Navy claim their traditions from an ancient Earth naval force. They seek to conquer the stars as their namesake once did the seas of humanity's homeworld.
system_jang_di_key: The Bonarda Corkscrews consist of former commanders who were committed to helping revolutionary parties against dictatorships around the galaxy. After being betrayed and forced to flee they have given birth to something different; a faction shaped around their own ideals of justice.
system_janguti_key: The Knights of the Prismatic Circle are a freelance fleet formed by a coalition of former Imperial Navy pilots dedicated to providing a haven for those outside traditional Imperial societies where the government's control is limited. The fleet provides its pilots with work through an extensive list of governmental and naval contacts.
system_jarorotri_key:
The home of the Explorers of Nabudis.
The Explorers of Nabudis are a small crew of people who are fascinated with the Milky Way. Members endeavour to find new homes for humanity amongst the stars.
system_jarowair_key: StarLight Utopia is an assembly whose goal is to build a new society based on the principles of freedom, equality and fraternity.
system_jeterait_key:
The home of the Ancient World Order.
A new dictatorship based in the Empire, with pro-slavery views and conservative policies. It is ruled by a charismatic king who offered promises of a better economy under his stewardship.
system_jeti_key: The Colonial Outer Planet Alliance (COPA) is a loosely affiliated network associating under a common Federal ideology. Formerly a labour union advocacy group, it now fights for the interests of all those within inhabited space.
system_jiman_key: Founded in 3301 by Gabriel Starhunter with a focus on prospecting and geological survey. By the end of 3302 the corporation has expanded into a Research and Development think-tank, renowned for quick and efficient problem solving and unconventional solutions. Their main contractors include colonies, industrial developers and of course private militaries.
system_jinicoch_key: The Eden Industrial Coalition is a mega-corporation specialising in the fields of trade and mass shipping, providing infrastructure across the galaxy with occasional involvement in large scale mining operations.
system_jirara_key:
The home of Aqua Galactic.
In the year 3305, a small research party was founded but lacked strong organisation. Soon afterwards the Aqua Galactic group reformed as new faction. Members from the research party joined, an event that marked the birth of the current version of Aqua Galactic.
system_jita_key: The New Imperial Order has risen to fight against the Empire's current leaders in an attempt to gain control over their territory and create a new united Empire.
system_jitabos_key: The L.O.S.P. are based in the system. They are a confederacy of free and professional pilots promoting the ancient customs of their French ancestors. They are united in defence of their own interests and to preserve their independence. Like their ancestors, their motto is: "One for All, All for One."
system_jonai_key:
The Wolves of Jonai are based in this system. They are a loosely organised independent dictatorship led by a mysterious commander known only as The Alpha.

 Little is known of this group's aims and motivations except their fierce defence of their territory.
system_jormor_key: The home of the Organisation Shadows of Victory, a group focused on fulfilling confidential tasks, which fully supports the Kumo Crew and its leader Archon Delaine.
system_jou_tung_key: The home of Wurlay Cartel, a group of Imperially-aligned mercenaries.
system_juan_key: The home of The Misfits of the Galaxy, a small group of pilots from across the galaxy, in search of riches and renown.
system_juipedun_key:
The home of the Way of Scarcity, In 2009, a theory of everything was published that's come to be known as 'The Scarcity Hypothesis.' Not much is known about the author, but historians began to seriously investigate upon discovering this individual created a successful cryptocurrency sometime in the 21st century.
Over a millennia later, evidence has emerged that this author also founded a secretive group known as Crimson Hex 5225, to establish the foundations of a theoretical branch of science referred to as Unology. Rumours persist that adherents of 5225's historical research continue their work in Juipedun.
system_jukagha_key:
The home of the Accidental Pirates. While essentially a salvage operation, the activities of Accidental Pirates are quite broad. Explorers seek out salvage opportunities, traders deliver goods and combat pilots protect assets. Following involvement in salvage and rescue efforts from stations targeted by recent xeno attacks, they have also expanded into passenger transportation.
The faction name derives from a pilot named Jay Harper, charged with piracy for attempting to salvage a derelict warship. His lawyers argued that as no markings were visible and Harper followed all prescribed guidelines, he was at worst an ""accidental pirate"" and successfully sued for compensation. The phrase stuck, and was adopted by this faction.
system_jukundji_key:
The home of Trans Galactic Operations.
Trans Galactic Operations are an organization which actively hunts bounties in an effort to maintain law and order in the galaxy.
system_jukurang_key:
The home of the Sons of Jud.
The Sons of Jud stand for peace, honour and a sense of justice. They look to lead by example, living and acting in a way that upholds those principles.
system_jupanisage_key: The home of the Kingdom of the Elysian Fields. Far in the outskirts of the Empire lies a system hosting a verdant world. The locals call this planet Elysium. Here, Imperial nobles with distinguished careers enjoy their retirement, pursuing whatever pastimes they find pleasure in. The Elysian Monarchy is responsible for providing a safe and discreet environment for them. Although many personal freedoms are respected under their jurisdiction, Imperial law is swiftly enforced by the royal court.
system_juparoin_key: A relatively simple system which contains a binary pair as well as a handful of other terrestrial planets. There is sufficient mineral wealth here to support both extraction and refinery economies. There is an intense rivalry in Zero G combat bouts between the two outposts in this system.
system_jura_key: The home of Ravagers Resurrection, an interstellar syndicate founded in 3304, consisting of smugglers, mercenaries, bounty hunters and buccaneers.
system_juro_key: Galactic Anarchist Company is a group fed up with the perceived regulation of the superpowers, declaring that everyone should be free to govern themselves. The faction reportedly promotes trade as a foundation for prosperity.
system_kafigelabon_key: This quiet refinery system supports a small population but is known as the base of operations for a brutal pirate gang.
system_kagutsuchi_key: The Close Encounters Corps protects inhabited sectors from unknown lifeforms, controls any possible contact points and is involved in researching unknown technologies.
system_kairi_key: The home of the Order of The Black Lion, a faction deeply rooted in history, whose battle cry is 'Roar in his Glory'.
system_kairrodo_key:
The home of the Hot Lava Bad Guys.
A consortium of smugglers, thieves and worse. The Hot Lava Bad Guys originally formed thanks to the sheer will of Persuvious Starbreaker, a pirate from the bubble's edge. Word of Starbreaker's ambition moved through the galaxy's underbelly, with many ne'er-do-wells and miscreants choosing to work alongside him. The Hot Lava Bad Guys are now determined to carve out a section of the galaxy to call their own.
system_kakas_key: In 3302 the Commonwealth of Kakas banded together to overthrow an oppressive communist regime and liberate the system in the name of democracy and freedom.
system_kakmbul_key:
The home of Legendary Order of Mercenaries.
Legendary Order of Mercenaries is a group of pilots from all walks of life. No job is too big or too small, and the legality of its work is rumoured to relate to how many credits are on offer.
Members can be found aiding in transport logistics of commodities, security contracts and peace-keeping exercises.
system_kakmburu_key: TX-125 is a syndicate established to advance the interests of the people of Kakmburu.
system_kakmbutan_key: The Kakmbutan Camonna Tong Syndicate (KCTS) is notoriously intolerant of any who dare challenge its progress. It rejects all forms of government. Members of KCTS takes great pride and passion in striving to take from corporations and government entities, claiming to distribute resources to those in need. To opponents, however, the KCTS is a faction known to conduct piracy and smuggling operations.
system_kalaa_key:
The home of the EGO-9 Initiative.
The EGO-9 Initiative seeks to gain influence through trade, warfare and the promise of security.
The purpose of the EGO-9 Initiative is to enforce healthy democratic standards, while also providing cultural and scientific enrichment to the galaxy. To facilitate democracy it enforces order in its territory; piracy is not tolerated and any attempt to undermine the people's power will meet with swift judgement.
system_kalak_key: The home of MediCorp. “Whatever you do, whoever you are, we shall come to the rescue.”
system_kaleke_key:
The home of Nova Lucitanea.
Nova Lucitanea is a group of avid freelancers that seek riches throughout the galaxy. After roaming among the stars earning fortunes for their various employers, they decided to establish a base of operations in the Kaleke system and work for themselves instead.
system_kaliki_key: Quantum Intelligence Enterprises (QiE) was founded in 3305 for the purpose of research, reconnaissance and logistical analytics for the use of the imperial fleet. QiE forms part of the empires interstellar intelligence division. To support the wing the enterprise consists of commanders fully capable of providing logistics, combat, research and anti-xeno endeavours.
system_kaline_key: The Imperial Pilots Union is an Imperially-aligned pilots union whose main goal is to expand its influence to as many systems as possible. It seeks to establish its own rules and regulations, and fight against the Federation.
system_kalvaitu_key: Geni United Industries is a corporation with the backing of a large scientific committee, which helps further the military achievements of the Empire.
system_kamadhenu_key: The home system of the Chapterhouse of Inquisition. The Chapterhouse seeks to uphold Arissa Lavigny-Duval's vision of an Empire free of injustice and political corruption. Inquisitors promote order and the traditional Imperial values espoused by their patron.
system_kamas_key: The home of ORION, a tight-knit band of mercenaries and traders who joined together to fight for the good of the galaxy.
system_kamcha_key: Nix Gravis Galactic is based in this system. It is an organisation with the rights of an Imperial corporation. It was sent to this sector to promote economic growth and uphold Imperial traditions.
system_kamchaa_key: The Norwegian Imperial Society is a group preserving the Norwegian culture of ancient Earth within the Empire. They also seek to establish new and beneficial trade routes.
system_kamchadals_key: The members of Sektion 20 work as explorers and researchers.
system_kamito_key: The home system for Traxus Industries - an inter-system corporate entity committed to the interests of its members and to maintaining consistent cash flow, while remaining totally self-sufficient and independent through the deployment of privately owned and operated tactical and expeditionary vessels.
system_kamocan_key: Comunidad Hispana is based in this system.
system_kanagoto_key: Imperial Iron Wings Operations has one goal - to fight for the glory of the Emperor, no matter the cost.
system_kano_key: The Dukes of Hazard are mercenaries who sell their guns to the highest bidder!
system_kappa_key: The home of New Horizon Brotherhood, an exploration and trading faction.
system_karama_key:
The home of the Lynx Company Corporation. The Lynx Company operate across the Imperial systems to defend the galaxy from any who dare to compromise the Empire. They aim to achieve this by increasing commercial relationships and fighting to protect Imperial space.
Their motto is, 'We will stand between our enemies and the Imperial ménage.'
system_karbon_key: The home of Shadow of the Phoenix, whose goal is to provide a place where humans can work out their differences peacefully. A home from home for diplomats, hustlers, entrepreneurs and wanderers.
system_karbudj_key: The Crimson Cult is a military dictatorship focused on the protection of its trade routes. It is overseen by a select few officials to ensure both influence within the faction’s home system and a proper military focus in decision making. The Cult was formed after countless pirate raids on a former regime’s trading fleets resulted in a massive shift towards military strength as a primary edict.
system_karid_key: Nuevo Orden de Comandantes Imperiales are a Hispanic feudal-knight minor faction loyal to the Empire.
system_karka_key: In 3303 the SANCTIS faction was created. It established a democratic and independent government and has strong financial resources guaranteeing its infrastructure.
system_kata_key: Vox Universum is a for-hire corporation that specialises in various services. From the merchant elite to master mercenaries, Vox Universum employs highly experienced adherents to strengthen its foothold in the world of corporate politics.
system_katuri_key: Section 31 are rumoured to have once been an autonomous and clandestine organisation protecting the security interests of the Federation.
system_kaukamine_key:
The home of Cerberus Interstellar Corp.
Cerberus Interstellar Corp is organized in several branches. Each of these branches is specialized in a particular field; these include biomedical research, military technology and political science. All such research is intended for the benefit of humanity.
There have been unconfirmed reports that Cerberus Interstellar Corp employs undercover agents in other corporations.
system_kaukhe_key: Valkyrie Galactic Security is a privately owned security force, founded by a group of veteran pilots in 3297. It has since gained a reputation for being extremely supportive of the Empire, though independent groups may hire its services. Members have a wide range of experience including high-value cargo transportation, VIP protection and armed security. All contracts are carried out by the best the Valkyries has to offer.
system_kaushi_key: The home of the Rainbow Unicat Corps. Rainbow Unicat Corps, a loose collection of former local trade pilots interested in trading and bounty hunting in the quieter areas of the galaxy. They are notable for their enthusiasm in pursuing the finer things in life.
system_kaushpoos_key: Wolfram Security is a provider of high-end logistics management and asset defence. "You've got the cash, we've got your back."
system_kehperi_key: It is a dangerous, unstable galaxy, and nobody knows that better than Teamsters Logistics Corporation. Specialising in haulage, mining, security and logistics, Teamsters Logistics Corporation ensures the stability and prosperity of Kehperi and the surrounding systems.
system_kekenk_key:
BlueSun Corp seeks to wield influence across political, social and economic sectors to keep its home system from falling further into the hands of the Empire. They use any means and seek allies to maintain their independence and increase their influence and profits.

 BSC was recently formed by seventh generation Kekenk citizen and business mogul Malkovich Vane. This was a reaction to a sudden increase in Imperial intrusions into the Kekenk system by the Birhodiweu Emperor's Grace group, on behalf of Senator Patreus.

Although Vane already wields substantial financial power in the system it is rumoured he has reached out to more nefarious groups such as the Kumo Crew to provide the martial support he requires.

The on-going Pegasi Pirate War has placed a strain on the Kekenk system as the Empire, and Patreus in particular, demand more and more resources from the smaller systems for so called “protection”.  There are as yet unconfirmed rumours that Vane has pledged financial support to the Emperor's Dawn in exchange for their assistance.
system_khakya_key:
The home of Hastati Astral Liberation Party.
The Hastati Astral Liberation Party is a confederate union of traders, militia members, political activists, and pilots- all of which share the common goal of abolishing slavery in the Empire. It also offers protection to those that cannot fend for themselves.
Originally focused solely on slavery, it quickly took up the banner of all those suffering oppression under the galactic superpowers. Wherever opportunities seem scarce, HALP attempts to better the lives of those who appeal for aid.
system_khamataman_key:
This is The Guild of Calamitous Intent's home system. They are an ancient organisation dating back to the early 1900s. Founded on the planet Earth and having since spread its influence throughout the galaxy, the Guild is the self-proclaimed leader in organised havoc. With the best school districts in the galaxy, benefits such as health and dental insurance are offered to all members. On top of its outstanding and rich history - including the home of the Original Rays Pizza - The Guild of Calamitous Intent has become an organisation that all up and coming, as well as veteran, super villains wish to join.

"The Guild of Calamitous Intent. Hate you can trust."
system_khan_key: Something happened here, but the locals won't talk about it.
system_khari_key: The Black Lotus Kabal is a feudal society made up of social outcasts, pirates and mercenaries. Its stated goal is to carve out a small empire using diplomacy, influential contracts and - should the need arise – military action.
system_kharpulo_key:
The home of Argos.
Argos is a mercenary service corporation specialising in trade, bounty hunting, and exploration. The fleet was created by pilots of different expertise who shared the same goal: making credits.
system_kherthaje_key:
Miners and Fighters Inc is a self-proclaimed protector of the people, supporting pilots in the uncertainty of the black. While often see mining planetary rings, members are known to band together to fight against threats ranging from pirates to hostile alien vessels.

Its motto is, ‘MFI has your back.’
system_khona_key:
The home of Shadow of the Panda.
Shadow of the Panda is a private security force that provides convoy protection, military support and mercenary contracts for system conflicts.
system_khonti_key:
The home of the Sidus Rising. Sidus Rising commanders have settled in this system. As advocates for free will, they offer refuge for all pilots who wish to free themselves from any political, economic, military or religious powers. Their community is based on the open cooperation of its members, while ensuring respect for individual rights. Knowledge is their preferred method of protecting their independence, but they are fierce fighters ready to defend their liberty. They pledge to rise up against oppression regardless of the cost.
Their motto: 'We are strong, we are free, we are united. We are Sidus Rising!'
system_kini_key:
This small binary star system contains only a single planet orbiting the shared centre of gravity between the two stars. A low level extraction facility is located here, but little else.

It is the home system for the TitanStar Alliance, a small, independent faction noted for its clear ideals about free trade and freedom of information. Nothing is restricted; everything can be traded or sold.
system_kirram_key: Independent Trading and Security seeks to improve humanity's living conditions all over the galaxy.
system_kisatsya_key: Flynt Ryder is a former commander of the Imperial Navy's 75th Ranger fleet, who left to establish his own faction after surviving repeated suicide missions and witnessing immoral acts by the Empire. Ryder's Rangers follow Old World traditions, offering a safe haven for all pilots seeking asylum from war. Flynt has vowed to defend the spaceways to allow free trade, using his Rangers as peacekeepers throughout the galaxy.
system_kistsi_key: The Biowaste Extraction And Supply Team deals in biowaste transport, sales and service.
system_kitae_key: A dangerous system which has seen the start of many pirates' careers. Its planetary system is comprised of a complex trinary planet which supports an industrial economy and a modest population.
system_kitaki_key:
The home of the United Countries Collective. The UCC is a committed organisation formed to prevent the Thargoid spread throughout the galaxy. With the agreed pooling of resources and military strength, the UCC acts as benefactor of research into advanced weaponry for the protection of mankind.
Their ultimate mandate is to follow the teachings of the ancient Guardians, with the aim of becoming the new Guardians of our time, learning from the mistakes of their past.
system_kitchang_mu_key: The Occitania Pioneers are a group of explorers fascinated by the immensity of space and its mysteries. They are a multidisciplinary faction, even if exploration and tourism remains their favourite activity.
system_klamath_key:
The home of The Colonial Fleet. The Colonial Fleet is an independent faction, focused on the growth and prosperity of its people. Their stated mission is to provide aid and wisdom to all who seek help in the darkness of space.
The purpose of the Fleet is to colonise, industrialise and prosper."
system_klikis_key:
The home of Last Constellation.
Last Constellation was created to bring people together, believing that humanity has grown harsh and unwelcoming in the age of colonising space. Pilots working for the Last Constellation faction seek to offer protection, support and hope for a brighter future.
The faction is based on the edge of the inhabited space and is always ready to welcome lost souls. But troublemakers are warned that even the most peaceful community can defend itself.
system_koara_key: Glimpse into the Future is a small group of separatists dedicated to developing new technologies. Its ultimate goal is to surpass all its rivals and become the most technologically advanced faction in the galaxy.
system_koch_key:
The home of The Directive.
The Directive is an elite espionage and tactical strike team whose origins are unknown. It believes necessary evil must be both controlled and exploited to maintain balance in the galaxy.
system_koenpa_key: The Goddard's Pilgrims arrived in a generation ship in 3303. After hundreds of years isolated from civilisation, the Goddard's Pilgrims have developed a unique culture, and a true communist society.
system_kokobii_key: The Hydrium Squadron consists of bounty hunters, traders and smugglers. They seized the opportunity to take control of the KOKOBII system, and established a corporation that works under the jurisdiction of the Empire.
system_kokoimudji_key: A trinary system which includes a brown dwarf star. It has a modest sized population whose favourite pastime is a daily show called 'Tim's Adventures'. Visitors to the system rarely comprehend what the locals find so great about the show. The system supports a mixed industrial and extraction economy.
system_kokojawa_key: People's Dictatorships Union (or PDU) is a collection of labour unions, cooperatives and socialist parties led by a popular assembly. The PDU is based on a reformed socialist system, in which the accumulation of wealth is allowed below a value voted by the assembly. In this system, patronage is replaced by a worker's congress.
system_kokojina_key:
Kokojina Expressways is a corporation dedicated to the transportation of goods and passengers. They will deliver anything anywhere for a modest fee and also provide bespoke tours, bulk transport flights, ship transportation, and the procurement and delivery of goods.

"Got a special order? No problem! Need a quick courier to deliver some documents? No problem! Have a T-9 that needs delivering to Colonia? That might take a while."
system_kolaga_key: The home of the Tachyon Syndicate, a conglomerate of smaller corporations that have grouped together under one umbrella to advance their research and development efforts. Their goal is to pioneer new developments and breakthroughs in the ever-expanding realms of science and technology.
system_kolhynichi_key: The home of the PRYSM Organization. PRYSM Organization was founded by survivors of various Thargoid attacks taking place in 3304, all coming from different backgrounds and professions. They have combined their strengths and skills to combat the growing alien threat.
system_komotae_key: The home of Order of the Crow. Much like the French Foreign Legion of old, the Order of the Crow is a military sect of the Empire.
system_komovoy_key:
The home of Lux Viator.
Lux Viator is a Federal bounty hunting group based in Komovoy. It works to keep order and balance in the system, acting as a security force to allow traders and miners to reach the local starports safely.
system_konduwa_key: The home of the UAF Ltd. Once a band of farming technicians, the United Alliance Farmers Limited (UAF Ltd) were driven out from their section of the bubble by theological extremists. It was during this exodus that they reorganized into the group now found in the system of Konduwa. They defend their holdings as tenaciously as they work their lands, their tireless working leading to many bountiful harvests in both areas.
system_kongan_key: In 2320 the Shield of the Empire was formed as a loyalist group pledged to defend the Empire. Their conviction and beliefs were challenged during the great Battle of Achenar, when the Federation attempted to force the Empire back into its fold through brute force. Shield of the Empire has had strong ties with the Duval family ever since its formation, and is currently working alongside the Emperor, Arissa Lavigny-Duval.
system_konsaxa_key: The home of Bastogne Private Security Firm, a security company comprised of mercenaries, soldiers of fortune and former military from all over the galaxy.  Bastognes mission is to provide security, cargo transport, long range recon, and wetwork for its clients.
system_korovii_key: The home of Crimson Phoenixes, who seek to protect everyone in their space and further the cause of the Federation.
system_korubures_key: The home of the ARCH. The Archangels (ARCH) are a group of pilots claiming ancestors from Brazil, Sol. They are a good-natured group seeking to make life in space safe, encouraging their pilots to have fun.
system_korwei_key:
The home of the Galactic Federal Guard.

The Galactic Federal Guard is a collection of paramilitary soldiers whose sworn credence is to enforce the law. With active branches in bounty hunting, non-human combat and general protection contracts, the GFG has established a reputation as a specialised defence service.
Under the command of President Sykmade, the Guard continues its ongoing mission to defend those that cannot protect themselves.
system_kotilekui_key: The home of the Turkish Galactic Power. The Turkish Galactic Power announced their intentions to those who cross into their controlled space: They are watching, they are defending and they are protecting. TGP claim to be the 'true power' in the galaxy.
system_kou_hua_key: Founded by a group of nobles in 3301, Orbis Sphera's members are dedicated to helping and protecting the citizens of the Empire by any means. Their methods range from charity work to supplying deliveries to engaging in active patrols against anyone that would harm the Empire or its citizens.
system_koyans_key: The home of the Brotherhood of Ohm. The Brotherhood of Ohm is a group of nomadic combat pilots that have finally settled down to make the Koyans system their home. This faction promotes its ideals through loose organization, offering discretionary jobs and contracts to their pilots.
system_krangwe_key: The Krangwe Institute is dedicated to protecting the galaxy through education and information.
system_kraurno_key: Raxxla Research is dedicated to exploring the unknown. All secrets and mysteries can and will be unlocked.
system_kremainn_key:
This modest system supports both industrial and refinery economies around its gas giants. Substantial mineral and metal deposits are said to be found in its inner asteroid belt. The two innermost gas giants form a binary pair with one of the gas giants supporting ammonia based life.

After a long journey the remaining members of the House of Grebmo settled down in the system of Kremainn. The group was formerly part of the Empire, but after a conflict on their old home planet of Grebegus they defected to Federation space.
system_kui_xiani_key:
The home of the Greater Bureau Investigators.
Greater Bureau Investigators are a secretive corporate organisation,  operating from the shadows. It is believed to enforce all standards of system law.
system_kui_xing_key: The Terran Empire is a militaristic governmental authority intent on galactic expansion and control.
system_kuligans_key: The home of the Nib Doodle Alliance, a democracy that believes everyone has a voice and everyone's life is worth more than wealth.
system_kulingga_key: The home of the Lost Souls of Tionisla. The Lost Souls of Tionisla are a group of like-minded pilots who relish all aspects of life in the void.
system_kumokum_key: This binary star system has refining facilities around both of its stars. The locals have an optimistic outlook and are usually welcoming to travellers.
system_kung_te_key: The Kokoda Cartel is a loose affiliation of assassins and smugglers.
