system_kunggi_key: The Lost Legion - consider themselves the enemy to all - for the right price.
system_kuntae_key:
The home of The Galactic Archive.
The Galactic Archive’s primary purpose is the recording and storage of the galaxy’s history. Its database, in the event of catastrophe, is intended to act as an ark of human knowledge. Member pilots offer their experience and wisdom to anyone who needs it.
system_kunti_key: Kunti is a rough neighbourhood. EDA Kunti League was founded when some tough Kuntis got together with some reckless Kuntis to spread their message: "Oi Kunti, it's time to harden up!"
system_kupol_bumba_key: The home of the Astral Legion. Astral Legion is faction of diverse misfits, specialising in passenger transport, bounty hunting and exploration. Though originally an Imperial Corporation, Astral Legion has since focused on its independence from politics and preventing interference from external forces.
system_kureserians_key: The home of the United Freelancer Flotilla, a group of pilots interested in maximising profits.
system_kurui_xee_key: The Black Adder Armada was created for bounty hunting, trade and exploration contracts. Members seek to find the most beautiful stars and planets the galaxy has to offer, discovering new worlds along the way.
system_kurumian_key: The Stars of Duval operate from this system. They were founded by a group of like-minded Imperial nobles and are comprised of royalists pledged to the Duval line.
system_kusha_key: The Dangerous Independent Space Association was created to train pilots for the most different and stressful situations. They support an anarchist system and deliver rare resources anywhere in the galaxy.
system_kutenis_key:
The home of PACK-HOUND PARTY.
The faction known as PACK-HOUND PARTY was founded in 3304 by independent bounty hunters aiming to expand its influence across the galaxy.
system_kutkha_key:
The home of the Royal Federation.
The Royal Federation is a political, commercial and military organization founded in 3305. Its stated purpose is to unite all territories and pilots against common enemies.
Its  motto is, ‘"United we stand; divided we fall.’
system_kuwair_key: The Elite Deep Space Research Front is a peaceful group of pilots who react in the proper manner if threatened. Their main aim is to provide assistance and counsel to resolve exploration-related disputes between factions. Their secondary goal is to establish peaceful contact with any unknown life forms that may be out there.
system_kuwemargl_key: The home of the Loosely Organized Lunatics. The Lunatics originated in Luyten's Star as a bounty hunting wing. They grew in numbers and were drawn to the Imperial lifestyle and relocated into Empire space. They can be found bounty hunting, hauling needed cargo, and deep into space exploring the unknown.
system_kuwembe_key:
The home of Sapphire Horizons.
Sapphire Horizons is a group of explorers with the objective of discovering peaceful alien life. It hopes to establish new alliances and allow humanity to maintain its survival in our galaxy.
The pilots of Sapphire Horizons explore space in search of new worlds capable of welcoming life and potential colonies.
system_kuyu_key:
This system is favoured by Aisling Duval.

Home of the Zeta Corporation, The Zeta Corporation belongs to the Zeta Horologii system. Previously governed by Imperial mandate from Achenar, they have since decided to act as an independent faction, separate from the conflict between the superpowers. Its members are made up of defectors from adjacent factions who found themselves in conflict with their respective leaders, and decided to detach themselves from these factions; establishing a new faction intent on making the Zeta Horologii system a better place both for their Guild and the system's inhabitants.

Their system of government is feudal and their sectors are governed by vassals.
system_la_tenha_key: The home of the Hellemus Universal. Hellemus Universal is a group of experienced traders with a deep understanding of the galactic economy.
system_lacani_key: Space Dogs declares its core pillars as science, technology and military power. They always invest in new technologies that help science to discover the secrets of universe and its military power so that we can defend our interests.
system_laifangyi_key: The home of Falcons' Nest. “The price of Freedom is eternal vigilance.”
system_lak_key: A dull, but mildly prosperous system with a mixed extraction and refinery economy. It is on a well flown trade route, but visitors tend to refuel and move on rather than stay the night.
system_lakho_key: The home of Fallen Wings PMF, this faction defends those that can't defend themselves.
system_lakluita_key: Asgard is a faction of peace-loving technocrats. Its technological fascination and innovative ideas have proven useful to pioneers and colonists in several recently inhabited systems.
system_lakshma_key: The Knights of Balance is cooperative group of scientists, historians, freethinkers, philosophers and dreamers, who believe in balance.
system_lamaku_key:
The home of the Chaotic Overlords of Ra. The Strix dynasty rose to prominence in Ra by utilising advanced terraforming techniques to develop radical new agricultural systems. However, a hostile take-over within Ra ago drove the original dynasty out of the system.
Following the first Thargoid invasion, Strix dynasty members instructed their officers to abandon fleet operations and rally near the Lamaku system. Equipped with a battle fleet of experienced military officers the reborn Chaotic Overlords of Ra now seek to reclaim their original home system.
system_lao_yano_key: The Eternal Guardians have existed for generations and have dedicated their lives to bettering the Human race. They are a small but dedicated group of individuals working together to ensure the safety of the galaxy. They protect other commanders from pirates and act as guardians and bodyguards.
system_lardhampt_key: The home of Trident Fleet, which has risen from a group of rag-tag bounty hunters to become a independent navy in its own right.
system_largarayu_key: The home of ADLG, whose mission is to explore the galaxy and help anyone in need.
system_latjil_key: The Federal Armada is an elite task force of the Federal Navy, under the command of Admiral Andrew Sheldon. When the Federation needs quick effective military action the Armada is the first to be deployed.
system_latuba_key: The establishment of First Legion of Latuba dates back to 3300 when its original members starts to settle in the system. At this point they started to protect traffic routes, traders and citizens.
system_latugara_key: The Wealth Redistribution Party are a noble band of entrepreneurs looking to 'redistribute' wealth in a rough galaxy.
system_laukese_key: The home of the Honey Badgers' Corp. Aimless and unafraid, these pilots happened upon each other. Entrepreneurs at heart, they forged their bond. Once driven from their home, they rallied. Pushed around by larger, more organized factions, they persevered. Amongst the dregs, they thrive with dignity. They are the Honey Badgers.
system_laur_key: The home of Odin's Spearhead, a cooperation of explorers, bounty hunters and traders. Organised in the year 3303 with no more than a handful of warships and trade vessels, this faction was formed to take control of the Odin's system. Today Odin's Spearhead stands as the system's leading military force.
system_lelalites_key: Pilots from various backgrounds united in friendship within the Lelalites system. The new faction, known under the acronym ACE, have organised into a cooperative to preserve its freedom and democratic ideals. ACE participates in trade, exploration and the occasional bounty hunt.
system_lembava_key: The MMU is based in this system and provides materials to the highest bidder.
system_lesche_key:
The home of Fight For Fun.
A band of ex-mercenaries seeking a peaceful way of life, this faction named itself Fight For Fun to separate it from the oppressive theological government which ruled their former home. It has since established itself in Lesche. 
Rumours persist that the group has a darker side and will work with underworld factions for the right contract.
system_lhs_28_key: The Star Dragons hunt down pirates and their ilk for the rich rewards involved.
system_liu_yines_key: The Ryders of the Void are dedicated to the gaining and sharing of knowledge, and the economic, political and military advancement of their organisation, its members and allies.
system_liv_key: The home of the Dark Space Corporation, an independent faction which is actively involved in space research.
system_loko_oh_key: The mantra of the Monks of Purity: Perform purification of the atmosphere, which leads to automatic purification of the mind. Practice the sharing of assets in a spirit of humility to reduce attachment to possessions. Practice becoming better managers of energy expenditure by training the body and mind to react to all circumstances in life with total love. Perform every action for self purification only and thus harbour no expectations that bind us to the material galaxy.
system_loperada_key: The home system for the Essential Services Society. They are a humanitarian and liberal party, formed in 3301 as an amalgam of various socialist groups, supporting the interests of organised labour and advocating democratic socialism and social equality. Committed to restoring dignity and self-reliance, the ESS is a galaxy-wide symbol of hope and renewal for those seeking freedom.
system_lovedui_key: Based out of the Almad system, the Almad Adventure Gang is an organisation driven by money and the thrill of making it. This rag-tag group consists of explorers, assassins, traders and thrill seekers. Veterans and new commanders all reaches of the galaxy work together to raise the gang's standing in the galaxy. New commanders are trained quickly and efficiently, while the veteran wings pulls in the credits and patrols the systems.
system_ltt_2337_key: The Nova Alliance operates in this system and is an independent group with no direct link to any of the superpowers. It primarily operates in Imperial space and tries to maintain good relations with local factions, but is not afraid to fight for its own interests.
system_lu_dis_key: Synergy Corp is a private research company, originally formed to study the galaxy and its oddities.
system_lugger_key: The home of the Renegades, outcasts, outlaws and other pilots united under one banner, the Black Flag.
system_lugul_key:
CONVoY is a group dedicated to economic expansion through cargo transportation for the purpose of exploration and increasing humanity's presence throughout the galaxy.

"We reach for the stars... and we bring the pork and potatoes with us."
system_luma_key:
The home of Black Rebel Ltd.
Black Rebel Ltd is a community of pilots who have pledged to face all the challenges of the galaxy.
system_lumastya_key:
The Phantom Fleet is comprised of pilots sent on a deep-space operation years ago. Having disappeared without a trace, the squadron was assumed lost in action due to unknown circumstances and written off by its former leaders.

Now the remnants of this mission have unexpectedly returned from the void, seeking vengeance on those accused of abandoning them to their fate.
system_lumbla_key: The home of the Omega Merchant Command. Omega Merchant Command is an independent merchant corporation specialising in transport and exploration.
system_lunda_key: The Necromonger Empire is known to actively recruit new members regardless of experience. It is believed this is an effort to acquire the necessary personnel to achieve its stated goal of expanding in influence across the galaxy.
system_lunguni_key: The Knights of Isarian engage in exploration, mining, anti-xeno combat and mentoring activities. Its philosophy is underpinned by a code of selflessness and the tradition of the knight errant, with members journeying to seek alliances with other factions. Isarians will not attack without provocation and embrace collective efforts to achieve their aims.
system_luvalla_key: The Spartan Order's relentless ambition and iron discipline ensures their existence. They are reluctant to conform to the worship of corporate power and continue to honour their ancient traditions. The faction is ruled by their fearless leader; King Atreus, son of Arkaidos II.
system_luyten_a_s_star_key: The Red Squadron is based in this system.
system_lwalama_key: A mildly complex system which includes three brown dwarfs. A single outdoor world supports a large population and agricultural economy. Industrial facilities can also be found here. Although generally a well ordered system a significant criminal element does exist.
system_ma_a_a_key: The independent security and combat specialists Marquis Du MA'A are based in this system. The organisation's firm stance against piracy leaves little room for mercy when it comes to criminals.
system_mabe_key:
The home of the Capsule Corp Interstellar. Capsule Corp Interstellar was created in 3232 in response to tenders from the shipyards of the Alliance, in collaboration with Argent Amalgamated Aerodynamics Inc.
Originally specialising in the development of survival capsules, CCI diversified and today trade in high-tech products. They offer a multitude of services; of note are system security, and the recovery of Thargoid items and artefacts for the Alliance.
CCI is reportedly stable and prosperous, which is attributed to their desire for independence and skilled diplomacy. CCI maintains excellent relationships with any supporters wishing to make a profit.
system_mac_cimi_key: The home of Masters of Mac Cimi, a band of pilots for hire.
system_macoc_key: Legionem Ethicam is a mercenary group that offers assistance in a variety of professions: alongside combat, members are known to help with mining, trade and scouting operations. It is rumoured members have even helped overthrow system governments for the right price.
system_macuayan_key: The home of Basilic Federal Corp, a military force established to overthrow the Empire in this region.
system_madon_key: The home of Raiders of Epsilon, a coalition of privateers within Madon who aim to grow their power through trade or war.
system_madutja_key: The Flesh Tearers formed the congregation called "Home of Light" and accepts all who want to live a life in peace and security.
system_madyanmana_key: The Crimson PMC is dedicated to protecting the personal liberty of its citizens. The CPMC achieves this goal through strict enforcement of its carefully legislated laws, minimising bureaucracy with a streamlined militaristic command structure; this also grants rapid reaction to potential threats. Primarily known for its capable bounty hunters, the CPMC has begun expanding into trade and exploration in recent years.
system_mahara_key:
This is Mahara's home system - a government led by unqualified citizens chosen through patronage by hereditary leaders.

The Mahara Absolute Kakistocracy  is based in this system. They are a government led by citizens chosen through patronage by hereditary leaders.
system_maiki_key: After several years of working on asteroid fields, a group of specialists decided to found the 48 Turtles. They are an independent faction led by Gordon O'Reilly.
system_maikpod_key: Tom Paine's Crew work to develop democratic governance in an environment where too many people are valued as commodities rather than free-thinking human beings.
system_maiku_key:
Though originally a privatised military corporation, the Stoopwaffen Corporation now focuses on services which are in high demand.

"Is it security you desire for a simple hauling trip? Or do you want a professional agent to guard your mining operation? Or even assist you with maximising profits? Stroopwaffen does it all! Feel free to contact us for a full list of our services."
system_main_key:
The home of Mass Locked Mafia.
Mass Locked Mafia is an independent organisation rumoured to feature prominently in the criminal underworld.
system_mako_key: The Aisling Duval Foundation was formed in honour of Her Imperial Highness, Princess Aisling Duval. Whilst the AD Foundation is primarily a political organisation, it is most well known as a charitable foundation helping citizens of the Empire who feel they have no choice but to sell themselves into slavery, or are addicted to narcotics: both subjects that Princess Aisling feels very strongly about.
system_malaikudi_key:
The 9th Legion was formed in 3145, by an Imperial Decree by then Emperor Hender Saik Duval, as an Imperial Special Operations unit. It was tasked with furthering the interests of the Emperor by overt and covert military action, and the defence of Imperial space. Originally headquartered in Facece, the unit was moved to Kamadhenu following tension with the regular Imperial Navy, who found its irregular (but highly effective) methods irksome. It continued to operate in a special operations role, and saw several battle honours added to its colours. All actions of the 9th are still highly classified, but it is rumoured that every major conflict has seen the unit involved. 

As a result of the sacrifices of the 9th, and the distinction with which it served, Emperor Hesketh Duval granted it the system of Malaikudi as headquarters in 3218. Around this time, the existence of the unit was publicly acknowledged, for the first time, in a session of the Imperial Senate. Currently, the 9th continues to operate as a special operations unit, and in addition is often tasked with protecting Imperial border worlds from Federal incursions. Due to its nature, the 9th has often had individual Inquisitors of the Chapterhouse of Inquisition among its ranks, and it is rumoured that this is currently the case. It also has strong links with Lavigny's Legion, and the two units have fought together on several occasions against the enemies of the Empire.
system_malanges_key: Hellraiser Inc. was founded by a handful of veteran pilots originating from Founders World to establish the financial resources necessary to maintain a modern squadron. Various profitable business fields are included in this endeavour, ranging from the perfectly legal to the ethically questionable. With greater ambitions declared in recent times, Hellraiser Inc. points to its progress since formation as proof of a commitment to expanding in influence through the galaxy.
system_malangga_key:
The home of The Sacred Knights.
The Sacred Knights are a diverse faction of pilots of all ages and backgrounds. Through time and effort they have grown by inspiring pilots towards their goals. The Knights are highly experienced in many trades and can help with most contracts.
system_malarhones_key:
The home of the Dark-Armada.
The Dark-Armada fights for the Empire. It focuses on trading and fighting and is comprised of former Imperial Navy pilots who are known to be welcoming to new pilots.
system_malayamatha_key:
The home of OMEGAS.
OMEGAS is an Imperial force. It supports the idea of Imperial expansion while protecting the borders of the Empire from hostile craft and piracy. The faction also provides sanctuary to less capable pilots.
system_maljang_key:
The home of the Peoples Socialist United Republic. The P.S.U.R (Peoples Socialist United Republic) was formed by a group of like-minded people who had one major trait in common: their shared hatred for the established galactic superpowers. These individuals could no longer sit idly as the superpowers seemed to endanger its citizens, while fighting each other for political gain.
Some would call them rebels. Yet, they banded together and made a promise to all independent systems and their inhabitants:  to unite as one and take the fight to the superpowers.
system_maljenni_key: The home of Lux Eternalis Research and Defense, who search for the truth, explore new worlds and fight against those who oppress the weak.
system_mambojas_key: The home of United Socialist Space Republics, a faction founded to support the workers of space.
system_mandal_key: The Clans of Mandalore promote the instruction of military training and culture alongside their everyday lives, calling their best warriors and sentinels the Death Watch and Mandalorian Protectors.
system_mandhrithar_key:
Formed in 3272 the Independent Pilots Consortium also known as the IPC are a private military organisation of unified commanders and ordinary pilots from all political affiliations, as long as they have not participated in any piratical activities.

The Independent Pilots Consortium are the sworn protectors of the Mandhrithar System and keep it a bastion of freedom and security. They strive to maintain the freedom of any system that wants to keep its independence. Mandhrithar has encountered many threats to its independence, which have been thwarted thanks to the Consortium.

'Good business is where you find it.'
system_manji_key:
The home of the Global Defense Initiative.
The GDI was founded by former special forces pilots, logisticians and engineers drawn from the armed forces of all three superpowers. The Initiatives’ goal is to claim the outer systems of the bubble and secure the trade and economic progress of the smaller star systems.
system_manktas_key: The home of the Spearhead Charter. House Eardley leads Spearhead Charter under a humanitarian regime, with a complex House-based political structure which promotes equality whilst maintaining many Imperial values.
system_mannovalo_key: The Faithful Cult of Mannovalo is a theocratic faction that is not part of an officially sanctioned religion. They believe in confronting evil with evil, bringing systems to breaking point by allowing them to participate in every illegal undertaking and shadowy endeavour until they collapse under the weight of their own mismanagement.
system_mantxe_key:
The home of Rayyan Empire.
Rayyan Empire is a faction of dedicated pilots. It explores the galaxy and often helps others who wish to share such journeys.
system_maorsi_key: Imperial Navy Australia is a faction of pilots that has come together under the banner of the Empire. They are a brotherhood that stands by each other and would protect the ideals of the Empire with their lives.
system_map_colonisation_intial_station_d: This site has been selected as the location for the primary port in this system.
system_map_colonisation_slot_description: This site is suitable for a new orbital facility. The system architect can start a new construction here.
system_map_installation_description: Installation are faction-owned orbital facilities. These structures are of vital importance to local factions, providing benefits to system infrastructure. They can be targeted by opposition forces, making them a good place to find mercenary work.
system_map_maelstrom_description: Thargoid Titans are gigantic capital-class vessels located within vast caustic clouds designated as Maelstroms. They reside in orbit around ammonia worlds. Each is believed to direct a Thargoid invasion force towards the core systems. Exploration of this area is a priority for the ongoing war effort, but is highly dangerous. Pilots are advised to outfit their ship for anti-xeno operations before venturing here.
system_map_player_has_no_object_friends: You have no friends at this location
system_map_player_has_object_friends: You have friends at this location
system_map_prices_unavailable: Market data for this selection is unavailable.
system_map_prices_unavailable_desc: This is either an invalid market, or you have not docked in this system.
system_map_usable_colonisation_slot_desc: This site is suitable for a new orbital facility. You can start a new construction here by selecting the $Colonisation_Orbital_Construction_Toggle_Label; button.
system_mapod_key: The home of the Soulless Bakers Cooperative. This cooperative was created, has thrived, & survived by reportedly utilizing creative ways of smuggling goods. Local authorities claim that The Acadian Guard do not discriminate again those that require such goods, but will protect all carried cargo fiercely.
system_marichi_key: This system is home to the Kirisame University of Borrowing. The university was founded in mid-21st century Japan as a flight school, following the teachings of ace pilot M. Kirisame. All members are dedicated to upholding the same ideals as their late master but over the centuries the university evolved into a very chaotic organisation, often at odds with the rest of the Federation due to the mayhem it caused.
system_maridal_key: The home of the German Pilot Lounge. The German Pilot Lounge (GPL) is an independent player group from Maridal, notable for their assistance in the Great War of Lugh. The GPL has pledged to form a free and independent community which does not follow the laws set by the Galactic Superpowers. To that end, they view Maridal as an ideal system for travelling pilots to rest and refuel, due to its favourable position within inhabited space.
system_marines_key: The Galactic Fleet Marine Force is a coalition comprised of Imperial, Alliance and Federation pilots. Selection for its ranks is a distinguished honour, and its directive is to serve as a joint task force in times of crisis against any threats to humanity. This unified front was first proposed by Major General Deadeye Snipes as a vanguard against common enemies, and as a stabilising element between superpowers in their stand against terrorism, piracy or even alien aggression.
system_maris_key:
The home system for the Demons of Praetoria.

"Watching the galaxy burn, one ship at a time."
system_marizi_key:
The home of Unrepentant Enterprises.
Following a system conflict which nearly eradicated them, an exhausted group of refugees took what was left of its fleet and set out to find a new home and identity.
From this exodus Unrepentant Enterprises was born. The faction has established divisions for trade, exploration and bounty hunting - reflective of its ambitions to build and protect.
system_marki_key: The home of the Daily Routine Incorporated. Daily Routine Incorporated is rooted in Imperial values and beliefs with one major goal in mind, helping pilots find their way. What commanders' want is the freedom and knowledge to be a successful career pilots. DRInc commanders' want to show pilots the opportunities there are in the galaxy so they can influence it. We the pilots, after all, are the ones that influence and control the galaxy; we only need to know how.
system_maroine_key: This system was once famous for supporting the liberation of slaves.
system_marrallang_key: Dedicated to protecting colonised space from pirates and other threats, the BWSF operates from Coggia Terminal in the Marrallang system. The BWSF is split into four fleets: the Royal Fleet, the Warfleet, the Merchant Navy and the Recon Corps, and they are always recruiting.
system_marule_key: Militia Imperialis is a clandestine security and internal affairs organisation, believed to be involved in the investigation of potential threat to mankind or the Empire. Reports indicate members also seek to identify any corruption within Imperial governance.
system_matet_key: Matet is the agricultural foundation of the Pilots’ Federation District, providing food for district residents along with a healthy surplus for export to neighbouring systems.
system_matipu_key: The home of the Democratic Cooperative, a faction created by the people, for the people. Its main purpose is to bring democratic groups together and put allegiances aside, in order to maximize the fight against anarchy, dictatorship and the corporate manipulation rife across populated space.
system_matyar_key:
The home of the Myakka Minutemen of Matyar. A governing body formed by the first colonists of Matyar A4, the Myakka Minutemen began as the rapid reaction force for the colonies of technicians, scientists and engineers terraforming the water world. The dredging operations in the rich Myakka ""Big Water"" sector of Matyar A4 quickly attracted the attention of marauding pirates, unscrupulous corporate mercenaries and other interstellar threats.
The Minutemen earned their nickname after proving they could go from planetary stand-by to orbital combat ready in under one terran minute. Arriving quickly and delivering overwhelming force is the signature of the MMoM.
system_maunggu_key:
The home of the Outer Worlds Network (OWN).
OWN is focused on profiting from the destruction of xeno and pirate assets. OWN also participate in limited trade and salvage operations to provide funding for its military ventures.
The faction employs several slogans:
 ‘We turn mayhem into money.’
‘Universal trade and security is our craft! Profit and adventure is our Goal!’
‘It's not personal, It's just good business.’
system_mauninovit_key: Mauninovit As One Cooperative's motto is: "As one we move forward."
system_mazahuanses_key:
The home of the Resonance Fleet. Resonance Fleet was formed by a small group of Commanders who once called the Fusang system home. They were forced to flee Fusang following the formation of Pheonix Legion, and the few remaining have bonded together, determined to prevent a repeat of the events which led to their evacuation. 
They strive to continuously better themselves, eliminating the weak and the illogical; forging the perfect future for our kind. Resonance Fleet look towards the future, remembering the past.
system_mbukas_key:
The home of the Eclipsis Dynasty.
A group of pilots pledged to defend the Empire's rights and interests.
system_mbukuravi_key: This low-populated system supports a mixed extraction and refinery economy. The innermost gas giant is known to support ammonia based life.
system_medu_key: The home of Carl Sagan Legends, a group of scientists, explorers and adventurers.
system_meenates_key:
The home of Alyat Resorts Sightseeing & Exotravel Solutions.
Alyat Resorts offer tour options for discerning travellers within the bubble. Agents are expert travellers and work to find premium journeys to all areas of the galaxy.
system_mehet_key: Free Spirit Pilots is a corporation gathering most experienced pilots in the galaxy. Built on independence, strong will and high standards, the Free Spirit Pilots claim to be one of the most notable consultancy and contracting corporations. They provide a wide range of services to all three superpowers, and have partnerships with other factions.
system_mehimurt_key: This system features the corporate headquarters of Interstellar Incorporated. It is prominent in the political landscape within Mehimurt and strives to expand its influence in an ever-changing galaxy.
system_mehit_key:
The home of Expanders Corp.
Expanders Corporation is the political extension of the similarly-named company that offers highly specialized services in the fields of exploration, trade and security.
To date, the aims of Expanders Corp includes technological and scientific progress through research and unveiling secrets scattered across the universe.
system_mehuenomici_key:
The home of the Terra's Ade Sentinels.
Formed in mid-3304, the Terra's Ade Sentinels is a confederacy of members from all walks of life. Setting aside these political differences, the TAS focuses on safeguarding all regardless of border or faction. It does so in the hope of proving that humanity can live and work together with duty, honour, and loyalty regardless of ideology.
system_mehurs_key: The home of the Errantry Alliance of Mehurs. The Errantry Alliance of Mehurs is a loose organisation of pilots from a wide range of backgrounds. Driven by the twin principles of democracy and self-determination, these pilots can call upon a considerable amount of military experience and fleet power to bear during times of trouble.
system_meneratunu_key: The home of The Ungud. The UnGud are a large group of mercenaries who are known to enslave and sell off those who refuse to pay them their dues.
system_menguru_key: The home of 1st Galactic Line of Defence, whose mission is to protect the weak.
system_messi_key: The Angelic Church of Messi has been a reclusive faction within its home system for hundreds of years. Recently it has begun to spread its faith across the galaxy, revealing the miracle of the Messi faith. The Angelic Church receives anyone looking for guidance and who wants to express their faith, live in harmony with the galaxy and worship the mighty and beloved Messi.
system_miansis_key: Aisling's Imperial Gladiators investigate corporations to ensure responsible governance in accordance with the principles of Princess Aisling Duval. Their strict discipline ensures social values and promotes ethical practices, while protecting profits and ensuring wealth distribution is carried out in a meritocratic manner.
system_michel_key: The Likedeeler are a loosely organised guild of privateers, who sometimes turn to piracy and smuggling. They see themselves in the tradition of the "Victual Brothers" of the 14th century. They affected maritime trade during the 14th century in both the North and Baltic Seas. The successors to the Victual Brothers gave themselves the name Likedeeler ("equal sharers") because they shared their spoils with the poor population.
system_mikunn_key: After having fled the Empire from the wrath of a senator, the brothers known as the Dukes of Mikunn set up an operation on the edge of civilised space to mine and expand humanity's borders through colonisation. Starting with the humble system of Mikunn, they have built up a significant sphere of influence throughout the sector, leveraging their portfolio of assets against local leaders to acquire a network of systems.
system_mildanji_key: Spectrum of Justice is an independent faction that prides itself on helping out the community. Established by Alliance and independent commanders, they try to bring peace to the colonies.
system_mill_key: The home of United Systems Space Command, who journey the cosmos in search of alien life and to plant new colonies.
system_millese_key:
The popular magazine Sagittarius Eye is produced in this system. Based out of the Printworks since 3305, Sagittarius Eye offers commentary, analysis, news and entertainment in the Milky Way.
Its motto is, ‘By Commanders, for Commanders.’
system_miromi_key: The home of the Tricell Corp. a multi-industrial conglomerate, prominent in the field of interstellar transport and logistics. Tricell utilises three organised commander wings, each focused on a different tenet of life in space: transport, exploration and combat.
system_misir_key: Inferno Syndicate is a diverse outfit of pilots formed after years of civil turmoil in several systems. These commanders have banded together to forge a new path among many pursuits, with a shared hope for galactic peace and prosperity.
system_mitanja_key:
The home of the Dragon Guard.
The Dragon Guard was formed in 3304 to defend human systems at the edge of inhabited space. It offers protection to explorers, traders and miners operating in deep space. Inspired by ancient Earth legends, the Dragon Guard defends the weak, the innocent and lonely travellers.
system_mitnahas_key: The 10th Hawk Squadron are from all walks of life, from all over the galaxy. Their squadron includes fighters, explorers, traders and even smugglers, united by one purpose - to ensure safe passage for the peaceful and to deal justice to those whose only aim is to seed chaos and havoc.
system_miwodigi_key: The Axiom of Ishtar is a collective of fanatics shrouded in a veil of secrecy. The group is said to defend knowledge and artefacts dating back to earth's ancient Sumerian civilization. Although outwardly friendly and mostly civil, the Axiom of Ishtar is best left to their own accord rather than provoked. A few superstitious commanders believe the knowledge the group protects would have dire consequences throughout the galaxy if it fell into the wrong hands, but this is just an unsubstantiated rumour and is most likely untrue.
system_mjolnir_key:
The home of The Vanguard. The Vanguard is a human survivalist faction dedicated to the preservation and advancement of humanity. Influential citizens and sympathetic companies throughout human space donate generously to the organisation, supporting a covert military force, science team and a nationalist political arm.
Founded by an unidentified reclusive tycoon, information about the group, its history and its current leader are shrouded in secrecy and myth. The Vanguard's long term objectives and loyalties are unknown, and conspiracies persist regarding the unethical practices of the organisation.
system_mohan_key: The Acolytes of Okami define themselves as pioneers and contractors in search of new horizons. Members claim an array of backgrounds but are united by the faction’s vision. The ‘Kami’, as they are colloquially known, plan to accomplish their goals through multiple disciplines including trade, exploration, and mining.
system_momoirent_key: Technora Solutions is an interstellar company specialising in mining operations and space debris cleanup. While a chain of command exists within Technora Solutions it reportedly suffers from frequent turmoil as various departments seek to outperform each other, creating a highly competitive environment.
system_mool_key: The home of Imperial Deathwatch, a mercenary group.
system_morixa_key: Morixa Logistics con is a conglomerate based at Wetherbee Gateway around the Morixa system. Founded by former Morixa Labour CFO, Elisa Korvin, MLc is the go-to Logistics company for anyone looking to contract delivery and security services from Morixa to the Sol system.
system_morowari_key: The Spacing Guild is an organisation of traders, miners and mercenaries on the edge of the galactic bubble.
system_mosche_key:
The home of the Buckleigh Interstellar Traders. From the Duke of Buckleigh's rare coin collection and valuation service, Buckleigh Interstellar Traders was formed. They have grown to become experts in the galaxy for the trade of rare goods, discreet deliveries and long distance haulage.
Although their formal allegiance is with the Empire, their regular clients are rumoured to include both established factions and wealthy individuals, many of whom reportedly remain anonymous.
system_motilekui_key: The Steel Brotherhood is a clan which respects other minor factions. It opposes any restrictions on sovereignty or freedom of thought, with members known to ready to respond violently towards any such attempts. The faction is active in mining, trade and scientific research.
system_moyot_key: Permanent Eclipse are a peaceful mining/trading/escorting faction.
system_mudrama_kaze_key: The House of Etherin is based in this system and is a powerful family loyal to the Empire. It has links to Arissa Lavigny-Duval and the Chapterhouse of Inquisition.
system_mukhang_key: The RLL Mukhang Symposium came together as a group when their previous home on the Edge of the bubble was foolishly shut early. After trawling the known galaxy for a new home they stumbled across Mukhang and knew it could only be destiny calling. They bundled together what little they had, formed a committee and headed out for their new home. Despite some early trepidation about joining the Empire's glorious hegemony, they decided to throw their lot in and became loyal servants.
system_mulayo_key:
The home of the Spaceway Airlines. Spaceway Airlines is a 'Starliner' faction based around the discovery and exploitation of markets, often trading goods and transporting passengers across the Milky Way with skilled freighter and commercial pilots.
Wherever this faction are present, there is cargo to be shipped and passengers to fly. Spaceway Airlines take pride in ensuing these shifts are conducted by pilots in an orderly fashion while maintaining a passion for their work.
system_muri_key: Muro Independents are traders, explorers and bounty hunters sharing the forgotten language and cultural heritage of a small northern land on ancient Earth. Despite the group having strong roots on Earth, Muro Independents are affiliated with all the superpowers. They are said to follow the teachings of technomage Zambi Guri, the great computer hardware prophet back on Earth.
system_musubia_key: DOSA Corp est. 3126, Performance Racing Parts Manufacturer & Cerac Canyon Cup Organisers
system_mutj_key: This system was once famous for supporting the liberation of slaves.
system_na_chun_di_key: Na Chun Di is the home of the Spicers, who mainly flock around a station referred to as the Teahouse. They are a small group of pilots originating from various sectors of the galaxy and possessing diverse sets of skills. They are united under a common cause: to provide the best transportation services, regardless of the nature, origin or legal status of the cargo. Any commander is welcome to come by the Teahouse for a relaxing cup of unique spiced tea, and perhaps a fruitful business conversation.
system_nagnatae_key: The Nagnatae's Nightingale consists of former Imperial slaves looking for revenge.
system_nakako_key: Elite Command is a faction established by a close group of commanders, and has the sole goal and ambition to conquer the galaxy.
system_namab_key: The home of the Namab Purple Brothers. After falling out with Archon Delaine over the true meaning of 'anarchy', the Namab Purple Brothers set to establishing a power free zone in the space between ADL and Zachary Hudson. Having expanded into five other systems, all was going well, until Yuri Grom set up camp just a few jumps from Namab, and the superior firepower of the EG Pilots swamped the area, despite fierce opposition. Namab was taken as a Yuri Grom-controlled system, putting all the Namab Purple Brothers' systems into exploited status. The Namab Purple Brothers mission is to oppose the expansion of any major powers into power-free space.
system_nambal_key: The home of Stellar Winter Squadron, whose only objective is to protect Imperial space from any unwanted intrusion.
system_namon_key: Planet Express is based in this system. Quick and Reliable delivery services. 'We deliver anything, anywhere.' In a coalition with the Protectores Zemina Nostri.
system_namte_key:
The home of the Scythe Legion.
The Scythe Legion is a corporate entity centred on the fundamentals of independence and free trade. The Commanders of Scythe Legion act as a stabilizing force in the region by offering support to local economies, advancing system security, and expanding democratic institutions.
system_nan_yamanes_key: The United Systems Cooperative is an organisation of independent pilots operating across the galaxy. Little is known about this group’s motives or plans, though conflicting reports are offered by multiple systems. A common note among these reports is that members of this group are fiercely loyal to one another and the organisation as a whole.
system_nanabozho_key: The Elite Orange Cross aims to provide food to factions experiencing famine, and medicine to factions experiencing outbreaks. This is all regardless of which power they are allied to or what kind of government is present.
system_nang_di_key: The Nang Di Empire was founded by a mercenary group known as the Steel Wolf Brigade, based out of Nang Di. The Steel Wolf Brigade was retained by Aisling Duval to supplement her own forces, which elevated the group and allowed it to expand its holdings to include intelligence, logistics and mining fleets. Eventually the economy of Nang Di boomed thanks to new expansion by the Nang Di Empire.
system_nankul_key: Archons Wolves are a criminal organisation loyal to Archon Delaine. They control their home system with an iron fist and anyone that finds a way into their den will pay the tax or be destroyed.
system_nanoai_key:
This is the home system for Blikege Services Ltd.

"We got what you're looking for... If we don't - you don't need it!"
system_nanomam_key: The N7 Alliance Navy serves and protects the Milky Way from all who endanger factions and interstellar peace.
system_nanto_key: The Knights of Commerce is an organisation which contains pilots of all types. Its main focus is stopping illegal actions within a system, and protecting pilots from pirates and bandits.
system_napitic_key: The home of the Order of the Astrum Invictus
system_naraka_key: A like minded collection of reject pilots from the Federal Navy. Naraka Cartel seeks to provide a haven for those in search of credits and camaraderie, whilst still supporting the Federation where it can.
system_narasa_key: Jamaica Inn Movement consists of smugglers that banded together to form an organised gang. Although early enterprises involved transporting everything from guns to wanted criminals, it has evidently expanded into hiring pilots for legitimate business. Rumours persist that Jamaica Inn Movement still employs bootleggers and contraband couriers, however.
system_naren_key: Contagion Confederation was founded by the mysterious "Toxic" and is a group of pilots looking to gain wealth and influence.
system_nariyot_key: The home of the Blue Angels, Blue Angels are a squadron of elite pilots, specialising as a fast response wing. Wherever and whenever swift action is required, the Blue Angels are highly valued. Only the finest applicants are considered, with recruits expected to be of impeccable service history and unquestionable fidelity.
system_narri_key:
The home of the Zentech Enterprises. Zentech Enterprises began as a research and technology corporation in the year 3148. As the company grew over subsequent decades, they expanded into more areas of business. Even though Zentech Enterprises at its core is still the same company, they now participate in almost anything they deem profitable. Their four main branches are science, exploration, trade and mining, while also offering tourism services as a secondary operation.
This faction are also known amongst diplomatic circles, where they sometime act as mediators when disputes arise.
system_narvert_key: The Errantry Alliance of Narvert is a loose organisation of pilots from a wide range of backgrounds. Driven by the twin principles of democracy and self-determination, these pilots can bring a surprising amount of military power to bear during times of trouble.
system_nauani_key: Imperial Ghost Division was once a unit of experienced fighters advocating equality and justice for all. Composed of fierce pilots drawn from across inhabited space, today it has become a private military enterprise affiliated with the Empire. It commonly deploys sophisticated ships and weaponry to hostile areas.
system_naunei_key: This system enjoys the patronage of Senator Zemina Torval.
system_nauni_key: The home of the Sunflex Group Limited. Sunflex Group Limited is an organization that is proudly Federation, but sometimes acts at odds with Federal law enforcement. Their primary stated goal is to rid the galaxy of slavery. They also claim to turn a blind eye to criminal activities with the exception of slave trading.
system_naunin_key: The home of Fathers of Nontime, a heterogeneous pilot group operating under their own laws. Due to the Mirinda Family Reconciliation Act of 3301, all pilots are required to spend 80% of their time in their family home, so it is not common to see them for long in the galaxy.
system_nauri_key: Newton's Gambit pilots fly wholly without the aid of onboard flight assist, the software modules being permanently disabled on their ships. Newton's Gambit provides an underlying network for these pilots to execute operations, sometimes rumoured to be clandestine, across the known bubble and beyond.
system_nawa_key: The Irony of Fate’s stated mission is to expand the influence of the Empire by any means necessary. In practice, this involves trade and mining operations throughout inhabited space and military action against the enemies of Imperial rule. Irony of Fate members are described as fervent in their dedication to the faction’s cause.
system_ndrian_key: The home of The Phoenix knights, who risen from the ashes having been betrayed by former allies and driven away from their ancestral home.
system_neche_key: The home of Latam Space Force, united to fight threats against humanity and expand their faction.
system_nehet_key: Virtuous Phalanx is an independent enforcer group within the system of Jotunheim that targets lawbreakers.
system_nemehi_key:
The home of Arbor Caelum Internal Defense.

Arbor Caelum Internal Defence was established in 3305 to represent the vocational and expansionary branch of its parent organization. It provides support via direct mentoring and access to resources for any pilot committed to its cause. Members are known to collaborate with other organizations when mutual benefits are available.
Not much is known of the faction’s internal composition, other than the credo, 'Arbor and Ardour.'
system_nepi_key:
The Convergence was founded by an informal group of pilots working for humanitarian aid and relief efforts. Concluding that its impact would be greater with focused political advocacy, this faction now seeks to establish itself to achieve these aims.

Over time the Convergence has attracted many new members of various talents. Today it remains committed to humanitarian missions and inter-faction collaboration.
system_nervi_key: The Independent Pilot's Armada is a paramilitary organisation of unaligned commanders who seek their fortune among the stars. They are a coalition of pilots without borders, warriors without masters, and owe allegiance only to themselves and the highest bidder.
system_nervir_key: The Sons of Ikarus consists of free pilots who have pledged to act as a quick intervention team when it comes to the welfare of Earth. Members are reportedly experienced in a wide variety of combat situation.
system_ngaliba_key:
A dangerous system with refinery facilities around its two gas giants. The home of the Space Deamons.
Space Deamons is a group of bounty hunters, traders and explorers that has slowly grown in number over time. It recruits pilots that want to engage with the galaxy and make a difference.
system_ngalinn_key:
The home of the Imperial Wargrannys.
This faction consists of miners and bounty hunters fighting to keep systems safe from pirates. Members mine resources and trade to keep the Empire happy. They also hunt down any dangerous elements to protect those in need.
system_ngalites_key: The home of the Empire Wolves, a group of mercenaries, previously nomadic, eventually decided to pledge service to the Empire. This faction took the opportunity to found a solid corporation. They now seek to expand via large scale trading and mining operations, but will fight like wolves when threatened, in accordance with their namesake.
system_ngam_key: The home of the Wardens, who use authoritarian leadership to bring justice to the stars, eliminating all who seek to profit from deplorable acts of piracy.
system_ngandins_key: The Stellar Cartographic Institute is a loose and open association of scientists, explorers and travellers, meeting occasionally at their secluded headquarters to swap stories and theories over lunch and a bottle of Lavian Brandy.
system_nganji_key: There are many in the galaxy who wish only harm and misfortune on others. There are few who would stand up to protect the common pilot, and to hunt down those who walk a shameful path. The Saints of Solitude were founded in 3302 to combat renegades within the Pilots' Federation and seek vengeance for the many who are helpless against their unprovoked violence. Out here, at the edge of civilised space, they prepare and wait for the time to strike back.
system_ngarabal_key: Jeykel Performance Division was established by two top engineers who united with the same goal - to ignore all regulations and push the potential of common ships. They managed to win several prestigious Imperial galactic races and develop a business that became one of the most renowned engineering companies within the Empire.
system_ngarawe_key: Camax Samaritans of Moondark consider exploration their primary goal.
system_ngbato_key: Band of Outlaws is a coalition of pirates and bounty hunters drawn from several star systems. Its goal is to exploit any vulnerable system for profit, pooling resources to create a vast network of outlaws and renegades to enforce its demands.
system_ngoma_key: This small system has enough mineral wealth to warrant both extraction and refining facilities. There is an interesting planet which supports water based life nearby that is visited by the occasional xenobiologist.
system_ngorowai_key: The Nova Astra Militarum was created in 3301 after the coronation of Arissa Lavigny-Duval as Emperor. Since its inception, the faction has grown and has recruited the best pilots in the Empire.
system_ngulungbara_key: Senta a Pua is the symbol and rallying cry of the 1st Fighter Aviation Group of the Brazilian Air Force, having its origins in the Second World War and its ending in 1945. In 2400 Senta a Pua was founded with a view to keeping the peace between Empire and Federation systems. Now the faction defends independent corporations from the governmental tyranny of the three Great Powers.
system_ngun_key: This system is favoured by Aisling Duval.
system_ngurii_key: Oddyssey Explorers are a friendly exploration and trade group, with trade, rescue, exploration and internal security wings.
system_nisgayo_key: The Achenar Workers Party fights for equality and to banish dictatorships from the galaxy.
system_niu_anang_key: The home of the Ares Predators. Ares Predators are led by freelancer commanders who call themselves Predators: always hunting for a good profit.
system_njiri_key: Black Ram is one of the most infamous branches of the Imperial Navy. Their courage and renown are without equal.
system_njokujinun_key:
The home of the Astron Research Stellar Exploration Syndicate. Astron Research has its origins as a land-based planetary combat unit which reinvented itself as a spacefaring cooperative after completing a lucrative terrestrial contract for stakeholders from Universal Cartographics. The syndicate was initially dedicated purely to intergalactic exploration, profiting by selling stellar research data to Universal Cartographics.
In recent times Astron Research's business interests have broadened to include freight operations, asteroid mining, search and rescue missions and a variety of combat orientated roles.
system_njorog_key: The Brazilian League of Pilots is based in this system. They are well trained pilots seeking glory in battle. Sometimes they fight for the galaxy's common good.
system_njunmin_key: The Elite Division is an organisation of independent pilots. Their goals are unknown and their actions are controversial. Most members are mercenaries, but the group´s leaders claim that the faction is much more than a simple joint venture between bounty hunters in search of power.
system_noatiaca_key: The Public Service Announcement group are protectors of Federation space and their allies.
system_noneskit_key: The home of the Interstellar Cowboy Posse, a small group of Federation pilots intent on delivering peace and prosperity to their systems.
system_nora_key:
Alsciaukat Trading Imperium is a faction dedicated to supplying any necessary logistical needs.

Its motto is, ‘Utmost discretion is guaranteed.’
system_norwar_key: The home of United Imperial Loyalists. Not much is known about the U.I.L. other than they roam from system to system routing out evil wherever it's found.
system_novas_key: Emperor`s Grace operate in this system. It is a military faction led by Vaarwen Mako Brennus and is answerable solely to the Emperor's direct agents. They are renowned for their fervent loyalty to the Empire.
system_nu_guang_key: The home of Black Void Syndicate, a faction of pirates, smugglers, information brokers and slavers.
system_nuenets_key: This busy trinary system has terrestrial planets orbiting the two companion stars. The locals aren't particularly friendly and appear to be harbouring a dark secret.
system_nulis_key:
The home of Absolute Horizon Enterprises.
Absolute Horizon Enterprises has declared that for all representative pilots to have the freedom to operate however they wish. It intends to bring this directive to all systems it controls. Policy dictates that any who resist must be taught the ‘correct path’, be it by diplomacy or by conflict.
system_nummitra_key: The home of the Intergalactic Starship Pilots Confederacy. The Intergalactic Starship Pilots Confederacy formed as an Imperialist group roughly a century ago to support the Empire at all costs. Nowadays the ISPC maintains good relations with law-abiding freelancers, and are known for offering protection to them where necessary.
system_nungk_key: The home of Wulf Wing Corp, originally an underground movement, who eventually moved out of the slums by engaging in black market smuggling and bounty hunting.
system_nunus_key: The Guardians of the Galaxy were former Imperial aces that started their own mercenary group. They are led by 'Rob Granfors the Supreme Commissar'.
system_nut_key:
The home of The Aces Association. As of 29 April 3304, The Aces Association has been established to protect occupied space from the growing Thargoid threat.
They compromise an elite squadron, made up of highly skilled pilots and defectors from the Emperor's Dawn. Unlike their former faction then now wish to serve Emperor Arissa Lavigny-Duval, the Empire and defend humanity from all threats, foreign or domestic.
system_nyament_key:
The home of Terrestrial Coalition.
Terrestrial Coalition represents a number of different systems, intended to create a private military organization to protect independent interests. It invites pilots to contact them for further information.
system_nyokomici_key: The Pirate Bay organisation, located in the Nyokomici system, is a band of pirates and other criminal elements brought together by Pilots' Federation members who are dissatisfied with a moral lifestyle. Currently led by Commanders Hagglebeard and Lateralus, they're known to be reliable contacts for any thrill-seeking entrepreneurs.
system_nyora_key:
The home of Atlantis Space Corporation.
Atlantis Space Corporation is a faction of proud bounty hunters and miners with a passion for uncovering ancient lore. Their democratic rules attract pilots from across inhabited space, uniting them in a common goal: making Atlantis Space Corp. a force to be reckoned with.
system_nyororor_key: With the rumoured threat of the Thargoids return, some of those 'old timers' have now returned to once again deal with the Thargoid menace. This is their home system.
system_nzambassee_key:
The home of the Kingdom of Thoth.
The Kingdom of Thoth, established by officers from the Imperial Navy that defected from the Empire, lives for the pursuit of knowledge and advancement of humankind. Now counted as members of the Alliance, the Kingdom of Thoth investigates and develops new technologies for both research and defence. Citizens in this faction specialise in exploration.
Its motto is, 'Illuminate the black.'
system_obambivas_key: The home of the F1 HDK's Mine Launcher Militia. The Mine Launcher Militia is a group specialising in the use of mine launchers and a variety of associated experimental effects. As the founder always says, "Never forget your lateral thrusters!
system_obambojas_key: The home of the Ghosts of the Federation. The Ghosts of the Federation is an independent bounty hunting group who have associated themselves with Federal interests. They hunt all pirates regardless of faction, often far across the stars.
system_obassi_osaw_key: Federal Dragon Armada has committed to the security of systems considered less prominent in human-inhabited space. It currently operates out of the Obassi Osaw system.
system_obotrimpox_key: The Specialist Mining and Refining Corporation is based in this system.
system_ocairi_key: DSA Galactic Academy was established to train young aspiring pilots with the aim of delivering knowledge and skill, without bias towards any given ideology. Many graduates from the DSA Galactic Academy pursue careers in the highest ranks of the Alliance, Empire and Federation.
system_ochoshei_key: The home of the Terran Core Mining Corp. As a deep space mining corporation, the Terran Core Mining Corp send explorers out to find the richest ore, so their miners and combat pilots can extract and return it for sale within industrial markets, helping their citizens to prosper.
system_odins_key: The Creed of Valhalla is based out of the Odins system, on a life long journey to achieve the ultimate victory and reach Valhalla. Through glorious battle they focus on gaining wealth and power. Led by their god, Odin, they are the source of power in their system.
system_oduduro_key:
Space Cow Truckers Ltd primarily consists of traders that specialise in the operation of the Type-9. It is known to offer assistance to pilots in the early stages of their career. Although trade is its specialisation, members are very protective of each other and will engage in combat when necessary.

Visitors to systems where the Truckers operate have described them as welcoming and willing to help others.
system_okinura_key: The Earth Defence Fleet is an independent military corporation dedicated to protecting the interests of the Federation throughout the galaxy. It was established in 3284 by the venerable Sky Marshall Vicktore Beskor.
system_okond_key:
The home of Black Wolf Sect.
A secretive organization operating in the private sector of the corporate world. Black Wolf Sect’s objective is to fulfil lucrative contracts and expand into deep space.
system_okua_a_gsa_key: The home of Linera INC, a corporation that has been working for the Empire on cybernetic implants and other technologies.
system_oleles_key: Estra Haven was founded by a handful of pilots defecting from several major factions. It originally worked on developing unique combat tactics to defend against the mercenaries subsequently sent after its members. These tactics proved successful, allowing Estra Haven to begin a peaceful and prosperous new life free of political corruption.
system_olokulu_key: Dark Star Interstellar Logistics (DSIL) is a small employee-owned corporation. DSIL focuses on the high quality, reliable and punctual deep space transportation of goods, information, passengers and services to any system.
system_omagatae_key: The home of PVC Collective, a small, ragtag team of misfits working together to provide a better economy for the future of Jambavan, and neighbouring systems.
system_omega_sector_od_d_s_b4_d_0_key: The United Systems is a democratic political body run as a republic, in which members are free to elect representatives based on their suitability for the collective need. It is focused on economic advancement, being primarily involved in the high tech and industrial sectors. The faction is motivated to provide freedom, equality and independence for all those within its borders.
system_ondi_key: The home of the Octavian Vanguard. The Octavian Vanguard formed in 3285 following an initiative by Imperial systems in this region to create a rapid response militia force, protecting local commerce by aggressively deterring pirate activity. They have since grown politically and militarily into a notable faction with far-reaching interests beyond their initial self-defence remit, cultivating close ties with the Imperial Navy who they often support on operations throughout the known galaxy.
system_ongkuma_key: An unsuccessful slave rebellion took place in January 3301.
system_onuros_key: The home of Omega Corps, a private security corporation aligned with Federation goals. As a top security service provider in Onuros and the surrounding systems, Omega Corps offers private security services for events, valuable cargo transport, relocations and construction.
system_oppidavasti_key: The Royal Ricochete Rangers are a coalition of traders who took control of the system.
system_orannika_key: The home of Orannikan Eternal Armada. The system of Orannika provides a safe haven for Imperial and Federal travellers alike.
system_orna_key: Orna provides the setting for the Wargames exercise, which simulates a system-wide faction conflict. While the system offers valuable conflict zone experience to new Commanders, it is considered somewhat dangerous due to the use of live weaponry.
system_orobu_key:
The home of the Romanian Remnants Assembly.
The Assembly was formed by wandering pilots claiming Romanian ancestry. Founders of the faction met by chance in Orobu and now work to find others sharing a similar heritage, in the hopes of supporting them through the challenges of spacefaring.
system_orulendiji_key: Knights of the Blue Cloth is a society based on an ancient chivalric order. It seeks to protect local trade vessels passing through its territory.
system_osermians_key: WWLL Systems Cooperative is an independent cooperative formed as a reaction to the perceived poor leadership and over-regulation of the superpowers. The faction’s founders persuaded its core membership to establish a new home from which to consolidate power, offering a platform for expansion. The political agenda of the cooperative prefers diplomatic solutions but does possess a military force.
system_oshanla_key: The United Confederacy of Oshanla are a group who support governments that stay out of local affairs, and have armed forces that are raised and funded at the local level to keep separation of military and political power.
system_osiris_key: The home of New Kingdom of Osiris, whose economy and culture are built upon the regenerative qualities of progenitor cells and the rare minerals of their home system. Their sacred king, addressed as Osiris, leads the people in their day to day lives and instructs them on the paths of regeneration and immortality, while his warlord Seth dictates military operations and brings ruin to enemy worlds.
system_osissi_hua_key: Rynnzler Corporation is a company specialised in mining, trade and transportation. It has established a base of operations in the Osissi Hua system.
system_otegine_key: Otegine contains a base built into a large asteroid, which serves as the main ore refinery for the Pilots’ Federation District. New Commanders may outfit ships here to perform mining tasks in the associated planetary ring.
system_othime_key: The home of The Forgotten Initiative. The Forgotten Initiative is a living legacy of explorers, privateers, and scientists who follow three main tenets: pushing the limits of exploration, defending the human race against galactic threats, and developing new technologies in search of intelligent life.
system_otohime_key:
The home of Lemon Drop.
Lemon Drop, founded as a constitutional republic, believes in protecting inalienable rights to life, liberty and property through a robust checks and balances system. The faction’s founders, seeking no glory for themselves, remained anonymous and signed the original form of its constitution only with code names.
system_oxosso_kait_key: The Brotherhood of Exiles was formed when one of the Empire's premier special forces battle-groups, the Black Fleet, was suddenly declared excommunicado and banished to the remote Oxosso Kait system. No longer officially part of the Imperial Navy, the Brotherhood is still well led, armed and supplied.
system_pa_pa_pole_key:
The home of the Coalition des Loups Solitaires.
Coalition des Loups Solitaires specialises the study of civilisations and advocates unity and coherence.
Its motto is, ‘No glory without daring.’
system_pachanwen_key:
The home of the Loose Deuce Navy.
The Loose Deuce Navy is an independent pirate fleet. It is known to rail against governments aligned with the superpowers.
The LDNA is focused on the independency of pirate life, and is openly hostile to those who work for the Empire and Federation.
This brotherhood of pilots has a background of members from across the galaxy.
Its motto is, ‘Parley or die!’
system_pachita_key: The home of the Ursa Ultra. Founded in 3303. Ursa Ultra started as a small private military policing local resource sites.  As more pilots were hired, Ursa Ultra began pursuing logistical ventures as well. Their pilots stand ready to assist in ventures they deem a worthy cause, as well as those with a significant reward.
system_pai_shihil_key:
The home of Harbingers of Atrocity.
Harbingers of Atrocity are lawless mercenaries and pirates of the vacuum who consider themselves a brotherhood. 
Their motto is, ‘Submit to atrocity.’
system_pallaeni_key: Born out of the Colonia Militia Forces (CMF), the Colonial Marines are a special unit of distinguished pilots who have demonstrated commitment above and beyond the call of duty. They are a joint task force made up of divisions from many different groups, all committed to defending the Colony. This prestigious unit is the Colony's first line of defence.
system_pancienses_key: The Camori Collective is a small group trying to carve out a piece of space to call their own.
system_pand_key: Far Bound Enterprises wishes to explore and colonise star systems outside of populated space. They intend to build a collective of pilots with all possible skill sets, and perhaps one day lay the foundations for new spaceports. The ultimate dream is to build a highway of settled systems that leads to the galactic core! “A road through the heavens.”
system_pangilagara_key: Pangilagara is the headquarters of the Crystal Armada. The Armada uses their mastery of propaganda, backed by a sizeable military presence, to increase their own influence as well as that of Princess Aisling Duval. While the Armada is a constant presence under the leadership of Queen Jezebel Taylor, they rely heavily on volunteers and temporary members as an alternative to having a large standing fleet.
system_paras_key: This system falls under the jurisdiction of His Excellency Elenar and his ancient order of fanatical loyalists, the Achenar Immortals. It was granted to the Immortals by the Grace of Emperor Arissa Lavigny-Duval, for their unwavering loyalty, honour and valour in combat.
system_pareco_key: The home of the Pareco SCIEnCE Institute. The Pareco Scholarly Collective of Inquiry, Experimentation and Cosmic Exploration Institute - also known as the Pareco SCIEnCE Institute, or PSI - is a collective of Commanders that work to search out the mysteries of the universe no matter where it leads.
system_pared_key: The home of Galactic Unlimited Cooperation, founded by several pilots trying to make the universe safer, and spread justice and freedom to many systems.
system_pareda_key: Corvus Corporation is an independent initiative of scientists, engineers and veteran pilots dedicated to promoting diplomacy. It has a paramilitary element to ensure its presence and ambitions are reached, combined with a lucrative business program with several notable customers.
system_parezmia_key:
The home of the World Eaters.
Mercenaries for hire, the World Eaters offer their services whenever something needs to be smuggled, destroyed, pirated or blockaded.
system_parsaka_key: This tiny backwater extraction system isn't really known for anything much. You can refuel here if you need to.
system_parthians_key: The home of Outer Rim Militia, an insurgent movement based in the Parthians, focused on overthrowing dictatorships.
system_parutis_key: The home of Firehawk UTF, a private military corporation, loyal to the highest bidder.
system_pathamon_key: The Dogs of Lore is a confederation of independent pilots committed to expanding humanity’s knowledge of the universe. This is achieved through the historical study and deep-space exploration of the galaxy. Members are known to act as mentors for new pilots.
system_pathan_key: The home of Draconian Federal Republic, a revolutionary order of anarchists, engaged in the promotion of a democratically approved political agenda, the result of an enduring agreement of employment between the Federation and a subdivision of the Dragons of Nastrond.
system_patocuda_key: A mercenary group, the 8th Dragon Squadron is loyal only to itself and its current contract. Their motto, 'Ubi Concordia - Ibi Victoria' (meaning 'where there is unity, there is victory'), reflects the solid foundations on which the group is built.
system_pauang_key: The home of Hunters of the Void, who search out those who prey on the weak and defenceless.
system_pechua_key: The Pechuan Corporate Alliance was established to secure peace and tranquillity to a broken system and those around it.
system_peckollerci_key:
The home of Razorback Astronautics.
Razorback Astronautics has been a long-standing member of the Alliance, priding itself on developing technology for ships manufactured by Allied-aligned companies. In recent times Razorback Astronautics has decided to take a more prominent political stand.
system_pera_key: A small system supporting a refinery economy. A rising criminal element is active here.
system_peraesii_key: Empire Consulate Ltd is dedicated to establishing safe trade routes in troubled areas.
system_peramongan_key:
The home of the Phobyn Corporation.
Officially, the company deals in import/export as well as security consultation on an interstellar scale. However, it is rumoured that the corporation is a front for a shadowy organization seeking to establish an influence across the galaxy.
system_perkana_key: Jade Constitutional Republican Society is an order tasked with the spread of democracy, constitutional order and the rule of law. This is enforced through extensive combat operations.
system_phiagre_system_key: The Sovereign Justice Collective is an independent, self-governing group whose primary function is to maintain peace and order. Advocates for the law, the collective also ensure the adherence to rules and regulations set forth by interstellar law.
system_phra_lak_key: Orion's Guardians are a faction of combat and defence-orientated pilots, fighting along all fronts of the galaxy and all new frontiers. They get their name from their original system, deep within the Orion Nebula.
system_phracani_key: The home of the 12th Legion, hand-picked veteran pilots, loyal to the Empire.
system_pi_dimshi_key: The Galactic Freelancers were established in 3301 to fight against any threat to peace in the galaxy.
system_picaurukan_key:
The MooP Interstellar Confederacy stands as a powerful squadron ready to conquer new territories.

"We are the danger. We are the ones who knock. We are the masters of our own puppets."
system_pikum_key: AG Industries focus on trading and improving the local economy.
system_pipi_key:
The home of Olwynn Inc.
Olwynn INC is a group of pilots committed to helping revolutionary parties fight against dictatorships around the galaxy. They also offer a cooperative and innovative response to galaxy-wide calls for traders. Members settled in the Pipi system, drawing support from the local population.
system_pira_key: Ordo Corona Stellarum seeks to lead galactic reform through virtue. It is dedicated to the expansion of dignity and prosperity in all systems where it has a presence. The primary means of achieving this is through trade, infrastructure development, crisis aid and system security.
system_pirigen_key:
The home of Whitetip Operations.
A group operating under a banner displaying the eponymous reef shark of Earth. Founded in 3300, the faction has since grown with its primary goal being to locating habitable worlds for human settlement out in the depths of the Milky Way. It sees strength with working in numbers and often operate in large groups, ready to help those in need.
system_pleiades_sector_hr_d_w_d1_d_41_ke: The home of the Operation Ida. Operation Ida was formed in early 3304 in response to a need for coordinated repair efforts in the Pleiades. The Operation is made up of dedicated traders who are focused on repairing starports. Large quantities of goods are moved for the Operation, often at the expense of far more lucrative trade routes.
system_pleiades_sector_oi_d_t_c3_d_7_key:
The Marauder Corps is comprised of pilots from systems found along the outskirts of inhabited space. Founded by combat pilot Jonah Winters, the Corps main is the defence of human territories from external threats. It also provides humanitarian support to systems in need.

An independent organisation, the Corps tends to avoid involvement with the larger political factions.
system_pleiades_sector_pd_d_s_b4_d_0_key:
The home of the Supporters for Sagittarius A.
The Supporters for Sagittarius A was founded in support of the establishment of Explorer’s Anchorage near the centre of the galaxy. The faction is committed to the further expansion of the human race into the endless void of space.
system_polahukuna_key: Excalibur Arms and Munitions rose from a resistance against piracy in Polahukuna. Taking advantage of the rich resources in the system, a few commanders assisted the people of Polahukuna in the manufacturing of arms and munitions to fight the raider gangs. Production continued after the pirates were defeated and a publicly owned corporation was born from it. The stock of the company was distributed amongst the previously oppressed people of Polahukuna. They chose the name 'Excalibur Arms and Munitions' as a reference to an ancient Earth legend where the drawing of a sword from a stone ushered in an era of peace.
system_polevnic_key: The home of the Polevnic Justice Party, formed by steadfast supporters of the Simguru and their ideals. Their directive is to maintain security in systems close to the headquarters of the present Simguru, Pranav Antal.
system_pomeche_key: The home of the Double Dragon Wing. A group of Commanders that decided to migrate from Federal space and settle away from the influences of the major powers. Dragons Wing are loosely organised corporation with a prominent military history, demonstrating a fondness for engaging both hostile Xenos and human pilots. They claim ancient Welsh ancestry, and now seek to leave their mark on the galaxy.
system_popongo_key:
The home of the Worldwide Partisan Delta. With a dark and mysterious reputation, Worldwide Partisan Delta's origins are currently unknown.
Their motto is, 'We hide in the shadows and strike while you sleep. You won't see us coming!'"
system_poseno_key: Aitken's Guard is a small organization that aims to increase the Empire's influence and protect its people
system_potriti_key:
A small system containing extraction and refinery facilities. A criminal gang is known to operate in this system.

The Order of Justice are a group of commanders setting out to fight for free and safe trade across populated space.
system_primi_key: The Panacea of the Princess supports princess Aisling Duval and her territories.
system_primuni_key:
The home of Garuda Ved.
Garuda Ved occupies frontier systems and looks to boost economies to encourage human expansion. Privately funded and owing allegiance to no power, it acts free from political bonds and seeks to ensure the survival of humankind.
system_priva_key: Home system for Bacon Cats Arbitration and Transport Services. It is a cooperative of independent pilots known for its strictly apolitical and charitable activities.
system_priviatem_key:
The Home of the Interstellar Beer Runners. Formed during the 'great beer blockade' of 3104, the Interstellar Beer Runners became stout defenders of a CMDR's right to enjoy a cold one. The skills of those pledged to the IBR ensure their code of honour remains forever true. Now, as one of the galaxy's premier purveyors of the finest beers, the Interstellar Beer Runners work to both acquire the rarest of beverages and supply them at very reasonable prices.
