Their motto is, 'No distance to great, no party too small, if its beer you're after, we're ready to haul.'
system_q_a_eqchilir_key: The home of KNIGHTS OF DEEP SPACE, a democratic mercenary faction.
system_qa_a_wakana_key: The Knights of Karma provide assistance to pilots who have hitherto been traversing the stars without any support.
system_qahamoano_key: The Galactic Communist Alliance states: "The Milky Way stands at our feet and should be shared by one and all for the greater good of humanity, and all peaceful species beyond. The GCA strives to ensure this through by whatever means necessary. Let us put the bloody and exploitative history of humanity behind us and colonise this wondrous galaxy as equals."
system_qama_key: Mercenaries Corporation includes ex-pilots from the superpower navies.
system_qi_yomisii_key: SkyForge co consists of soldiers and pilots of the superpower navies who have become disenchanted by the actions of their leaders, and so they came together to fight for a unified humanity.
system_quaoar_key:
The home of German Space Cruisers Inc.
German Space Cruisers Inc. is committed to fighting against piracy, believing such a cause to be as that beneficial to humanity as any other. 
The faction has stated that peaceful coexistence, commerce and discovery are the foundation for increasing the power and prosperity of all people.
system_quikil_key: The home of The Grey Wolves. Gathering of trustworthy commanders specialised in transport wing missions, bounty hunting and exploration.
system_quikindji_key: Quikindji Phantoms are assassins, pirates, soldiers, smugglers... basically anything that pays the bills.
system_quile_key:
This system enjoys the patronage of Senator Zemina Torval.

The home of the Ravagers, an interstellar crime syndicate comprising of thieves, smugglers, criminals, bandits, mercenaries, bounty-hunters and pirates.
system_qunice_key: The Holistic Education Foundation was established with the intention of collecting  the galaxy's knowledge and making it freely available to all mankind. This also includes discoveries on alien worlds.
system_rabay_key:
The home of the New California Republic founded in 3304 by a group of high ranking Alliance officers. Under the leadership of Kyle Marx and support from the other founding members, the community prospered. Interstellar trade led to cultural blend, and a movement to form a national entity gradually took root and won popular acceptance.
The New California Republic is a paragon of economic success, working to provide a high level of justice, security and standard of life for its citizens.
system_raidar_key: This expansive binary system contains a tiny extraction operation. One of the system's gas giants is a favourite for travelling xenobiologists with low order ammonia based life forms living in one of the gas giant's upper atmosphere.
system_rain_key: The Lunar Veils is a dedicated group of explorers and traders seeking out the mysteries of the galaxy. Following the foundations set by earlier proponents of interstellar exploration, members work to reveal the truth of the universe… no matter the consequences.
system_rajita_key: This dull system contains a handful of terrestrial type planets and a small extraction facility. There's little fun to be found here.
system_rajukru_key: Rajukru Widdershinners were originally a group of traders who set up shop on the edges of the rim.
system_ramit_key:
The home of The Ghosts of Lopez.
The Ghosts of Lopez are a private corporation focused on profit. They are experts in bounty recovery but have recently branched out into exploration and trade. The Ghosts are known to seek out the most dangerous contracts and are highly respected as a security force due to their reputation for getting things done quietly.
system_rauta_key:
Home system for the Varangian Syndicate:

As long as there is a profit to be made, this mercenary privateer group will be ready to put its assets on the line.
system_remines_key: A security detail intended for Zachary Hudson was instead assigned to Rear Admiral Zachary Rhodes due to a clerical error. The error was quickly realised, but the Admiral discovered the security detail's potential as trained combat pilots for hire, and Orion Space Security was formed.
system_renetes_key:
The home of the LBR Brotherhood.
The LBR Brotherhood is a caste of assassins. While its primary activities involve contract targets and piracy, members are known to raid merchant convoys from time to time.
system_reshas_key: A system known by many as the launch point for exploration into deep space. It is a simple system with just a few terrestrial planets but it supports an extraction and refinery economy. A local museum claims to have a piece of armour from Peter Jameson's Cobra Mk III - apparently lost during an encounter with local pirates.
system_robigo_key: The CdE Corporation is based in this system and provides bounty hunting services to protect travellers here.
system_rong_key: The home of the Minerva Corporation. A corporation that specializes in both private military contracts and exploration.
system_rungu_key: The home of the Anticorp Deep Space Socialist Collective, whose aim is to join arms with comrades and overturn corporate tyranny. Capitalism is the unequal sharing of blessings; socialism is the equal sharing of miseries.
system_rutena_key:
This is the home system for CHIMERA. The CHIMERA group invests massive resources in stellar exploration, with the aim of expanding mankind's frontiers.

They believe in the freedom of choices, the right to live without restraints, and very low 'maintenance' taxes are universal law for CHIMERA's space!
system_saga_key: Founded on 24th April 3302, the Brazilian Trading Company was established by commanders from the Brazilian League of Pilots. Each of them had extensive experience in trading and mining and decided to use that knowledge to set up their own independent faction.
system_saisiyat_key: The home of the Artemis Corporation, an Empire-affiliated organisation committed to diversifying its portfolio into profitable ventures independent of the constraints of galactic politics. The corporation is likewise committed to establishing a professional reputation as it forms alliances with like-minded minor factions and expands its influence in the galaxy. It provides combat, passenger transportation, cargo delivery, cargo escort, material gathering, and exploration services, but does not condone or engage in any illegal activities regardless of the politics or profit at stake.
system_saktsak_key: The home system for A Different Kind, a political group that was originally a large group of avid space gamers back in the early 21st century. Over time they gained massive political control and expanded their boundaries, until they now push for their own goals while encouraging young people to become pilots.
system_salarhul_key: The home of People's Republic United Front, a faction devoted to the idea that all people should have equal opportunity and none should go hungry.
system_salikians_key: Solar Transit Dynamics is an elite colony of miners, traders and explorers searching to unlock the secrets of the universe.
system_san_camasir_key: This small system contains a modest industrial economy. Xenobiologists also visit to research the water based life living in the upper atmosphere of the system's only gas giant.
system_san_davokje_key: The home of the Empires Fleet, founded by a coalition of the Imperial factions in year 3302. Its main goal is to protect citizens from foreign forces in the Empire and beyond.
system_san_huang_key: Vandenberg LLC pursue an open research and manufacturing model to ensure their place in the constantly growing technology sector. They are consistently improving their approach to new technologies and manufacturing processes. Their corporate concept includes sharing the knowledge and discoveries obtained from their research initiatives with the public, to ensure a healthy and prosperous galactic technology union.
system_san_key: Headquarters of SIRIUS INC, a mercurial organisation on the rim of human-occupied space. This fledgling democracy has recently gained independence after years of benign neglect by their parent corporation. The people of San feel a strong affinity with their "corporate founders", and preserve the trappings of corporate governance (including corporate name, titles and other IP). The parent corporation has yet to comment on this rather egregious trademark infringement.
system_san_xiang_key: The home of Samara Wing's, a faction created by a group of entrepreneurs from Russia, for the development of mineral deposits on the expanses of the universe.
system_san_zaihe_key: The Aphelion Adventure Society is a collective of space pilots and explorers that shared a common vision to increase interstellar knowledge. The Society believes in the power of science, exploration and observation to improve humanity's standing in the universe. They sponsor and fund scientific research and exploration expeditions to the farthest reaches of space.
system_san_zangjel_key:
The home of Void Exiles' Tribunal.
Void Exiles' Tribunal comprises exiled former subjects of Baron Ryder's feudal kingdom. When Ryder sought to align with the Empire, these individuals rebelled and were subsequently exiled. It is now based in San Zangjel, where it has sworn to remain independent.
system_sanda_key: DRTY Company is a group of mercs, bounty hunters and outlaws, brought together by the thrill of the hunt and strength in numbers.
system_sarana_key: The pilots of The Eldaren hire out their services to anyone with the credits to pay them, while remaining dedicated to bringing democracy and growth to their system.
system_sauri_ho_key:
The home of Le Legion de EX99.
Le Legion de EX99 is dedicated to everything. Members participate in a variety of professions while maintaining a competitive mindset.
system_savantzil_key: The First Contact Defence Initiative, or FCDI, was set up as a response to the possibility of 'first contact' with an alien species. The FCDI is an independent minor faction, and does not affiliate itself with any of the major powers.
system_scirth_key: This system was once famous for supporting the liberation of slaves.
system_seagull_sector_dl_d_y_d3_key: Black Rock Military is an independent faction based in the Seagull Nebula. The organisation provides military and exploratory services and operates out of Hell's Port. It is also rumoured that Black Rock has ties to the Children of Raxxla, often providing them with support for deep space black-ops missions.
system_secoya_key: The home of the DAM Collective. Hailing from all parts of the galaxy, these spacers refer to themselves collectively as "Tenno", and believe it is their mission to hunt down anything that isn't human.
system_sefrys_key: A sub-faction of the Dukes of Mikunn under the patronage of Tiberius, the Mercs of Mikunn are a security and mercenary organisation that has primarily earned its wealth acting as the private military of the Dukes of Mikunn. Headquartered in Mercenary's Respite in the Sefrys system, they oversee several systems as part of The Dukes of Mikunn's feudal network.
system_segestani_key: The Empyrean Realm is a strictly hierarchical militaristic society, whose totalitarian government aims to establish an empire throughout the galaxy. It is ruled by a ruthless but benevolent Thearch who values scientific progress and meritocracy above everything else. The armed wing of the Thearch is led by the firm hand of the Exarch, the most capable and loyal subject of his Holiness. The Empyrean Trade Company and Empyrean Exploration Company are two other vital branches of the faction, managed by the Exarch's subordinates.
system_segon_key: The home of Astrobiology Research Cooperative. Founded in 3302 by Dr. Amelia Dirichlet, PhD, of Dirichlet Laboratories LLC, the faction was started in the hopes of creating an independent humanitarian collective, focused on aiding humanity's fight for survival across space, be it through the eradication of disease, creating hardier crops, or genetically and physically altering humans to their fullest potential.
system_segoveduwa_key: The home of the Deep Space Penetrators. D.S.P. is a special operations squadron which operates on commission from the upper echelon of Imperial military officials, while retaining a tremendous degree of independence. Unconfirmed reports suggest the squad is utilised by the Imperial Navy for sensitive missions the Empire seek to remain officially detached from.
system_sekh_key: The home of the Independent Heavy Haulers. The Independent Heavy Haulers are a group formed from pilots hailing from all areas of inhabited space, pledging to help humanity flourish. They are dedicated to getting supplies and personnel delivered to any destination, safely and on time.
system_sekhenses_key: Influence, Control, Expand, Repeat. The Diplomacy's only focus is to become the most powerful and influential minor faction. If there is an obstacle in its way, the Diplomacy powers through it.
system_sekhereke_key:
The United Galaxy Independent Corps champion fair trade, research and the exchange of information. This is achieved through military engagements with any potential threats to its supporters; members are known to be particularly aggressive against non-human targets.

Its motto is, ‘Prosperity, peace and security for the entire galaxy!’
system_selkadiae_key:
The home of the Suzhou Congressional Republic.
The Suzhou Congressional Republic rose from the ashes of a small resistance movement on the fringes of civilization. Protesters, reformers and freedom fighters opposing various regimes banded together to seek liberty, promoting common law and democracy.
A subsequent series of wars and persecutions nearly destroyed them, until the exiles finally found a place to call home. Selkadiae became the birthplace of the Suzhou Congressional Republic. Its constitution reads like a call to arms - pledging to stand together in defence of human rights, due process and representative government.
system_selkit_key: The Bureau of the Bureau of Selkit Bureau were established to support their system after it was overwhelmed by anarchist factions, and enslaved by a brutal pirate boss. It is determined this sector of space will be returned to Imperial sovereignty.
system_sentei_key: This independent corporation of traders, Harrison Space Industry, was founded in 3302. It is engaged in carrying out ceremonial services on elite yachts, with a secondary business in premium transportation.
system_serktomes_key: The Basking Imperium Conglomerate is aligned with the Empire due to shared interests and shared ideals, and will often support the Emperor's efforts to expand. The group pours resources into scientific advancement and believes knowledge of the mysteries of the galaxy belong to all of humanity.
system_sesur_key: Omni Omega Division is a group of mercenary pilots ready to take on the jobs other pilots may baulk at.  No job is too big; no fee is too vast.
system_shamo_key: The home of the Federal Dark Overseers. Established by a group of tight-knit supporters of the Federation, the Dark Overseers' mission is to promote Federation interests in and around the Shamo system, as well as support its allies.
system_shana_bei_key: Evangeline's Elite Expeditionary Force is dedicated to exploring the farthest reaches of space.
system_shanhauls_key: Interstellar Time Lords seek to promote peace and tranquillity across the galaxy. It has established a base of operations in the Shanhauls system.
system_shapsugabus_key:
The home of Bluestar PMC.
The Bluestar Corporation was originally a loose band of traders that joined together to protect convoys. Its ethos is based on community goals derived from capitalistic ideals, and a strong sense of self-dependency is expected of pilots.
system_sharamo_key: The home of the Alianza Nova. Alianza Nova are ready to engage with multiple tasks, including combat, exploration and tourism. They are known to defend their system and principles wherever necessary.
system_sharur_key: Sharur is home to the Raven Corsairs, an adversarial faction maintained by Pilots’ Federation personnel. New Commanders can participate in individual combat assignments, such as bounty hunting.
system_shasil_key: The home of Silver Thrusters Inc, a group of independent traders and explorers.
system_shebkauluwa_key: Heij-Corp Galactic specialises in trade. Its stated goal is to be the largest trading company in the galaxy. While the faction will defend its interests and investments it is typically is not hostile towards others.
system_shenich_key: Republic of Rogue Commanders is an organisation of like-minded pilots and support personnel, joined together to explore the unknown, establish galactic relationships, build trade networks and fight for those who cannot fight for themselves.
system_shoki_yine_key:
The home of the Shemworld Squadron.
Shemworld Squadron fights pirates, mines everything its can and will accept long-haul transport contracts.
Its motto is, ‘No guts, no glory!’
system_shokwa_key: The home of The Seventh Fleet, a militaristic group of pilots who have banded together to defend humanity from any threat.
system_shona_key:
The home of Space Nomads.
Space Nomads live a life of relative loneliness, peacefully wandering through space while profiting from trade. But they can act as a military community and should be considered a danger to any potential attackers.
Their motto is, 'Born in space, die in space!'
system_shonpono_key: The home of the redback consortium. Once lawless pirates, Redback Consortium is now a confederation of older, experienced members who seek a more structured existence compared to their past exploits. Rumours indicate that in times of strife or hardship, this group can call upon a younger group of dangerous zealots to do their bidding.
system_shoribelu_key: The Independence Separatist Fleet work to support independent groups seeking to remain free from the dominance of the galactic superpowers. It works closely with allied groups to keep popular travel routes safe.
system_shorodo_key:
The home of The Void Walkers.
The Void Walkers were formed in the year 3305 by a group of elite pilots. While their primary focus is vocational in nature, it is rumoured they have influence in the political sphere. Anyone can seek out the Void Walkers for advanced training but it is rumoured that full membership is by invitation only.
system_sieni_key:
The home of Sieni Mafia.
Sieni Mafia aims to expand its refined business operations to an interstellar scale.
system_siksikas_key: Imperial Galactic Investments Inc was formed in 3305 and is an investment corporation whose assets and interests are spread across a variety of fields, from trading and mining to bounty hunting. Some reports have suggested members participate in more clandestine work when necessary.
system_siluror_key: Once a company of brave commanders committed to helping revolutionary parties against dictatorships around the galaxy, they were betrayed and forced to flee and are now trying to give birth to something different, shaped on their own ideals of justice.
system_singarli_key:
The home of the 13th Legion.
An Imperial combat wing that acts as both sword and shield to the Empire. Under the leadership of the Lord Commander, these hardline Imperial loyalists boast an impressive armada.
The 13th Legion's extreme actions against those it considers enemies of the Empire have fuelled a controversial reputation across the galaxy.
system_siriaba_key: Fleet Command of the Devil's Advocates is comprised of and former government officials who decided to found a faction aligned with the Empire. Employing pilots who specialise in trade and combat, it has established itself in the Siriaba system and now seek to forge a new legacy in the Milky Way.
system_sitakapa_key: Originally a branch of the Sitakapan Imperial Navy, the Expeditionary Force is responsible for supporting the political and economic pursuits of Sitakapa beyond its domestic borders. It achieves this by enforcing Imperial stability throughout frontier systems, and ensuring Imperial interests are represented amongst foreign powers.
system_sitlanei_key:
The home of the Sovereign Estates of Kiai.
The Sovereign Estates of Kiai represents the unification of 8 clans under a singular goal: The prosperity and protection of the Sitlanei system. This society is encouraged and guided in all of its endeavours by 8 virtues: Justice, Valour, Compassion, Respect, Honesty, Honour, Loyalty, and Discipline.
system_skeggiko_o_key: A populous binary system supporting extensive agricultural and industrial operations. The planets around the companion star are icy worlds, devoid of life. Local rumours hint at secret meetings in the far reaches of their system.
system_skogulumari_key: The home of the Palatine Imperium. The Palatine Imperium was founded by the fabled Paladin Squad, as they sought to make a name for themselves within Imperial space. Led by Archpaladin Rex, unverified rumours suggest the Paladins may exert some influence over high society within the Empire.
system_skollung_key:
The home of the Acheron Syndicate.
The Acheron Syndicate is an independent cooperative group of pilots dedicated to unearthing mysteries throughout the galaxy, using research data for its development programs.
It also works as a mercenary group to ensure the security of its territory.
system_snoquot_key:
The Pan Galactic Mining Corp. have their headquarters in this system. They are a mining-focused group with ties to Sirius Corp and Li-yong Rui.

As well as mining they conduct operations like bounty hunting; keeping the spaceways safe for mining and trade.

Employees of Pan-Galactic Mining Corp are free to follow whatever political beliefs they wish.
system_sokaram_key:
The home of the 13th Vendetta Fleet.
A private security fleet with trained special operatives that has pledged to protect democracy. It specialises in bounty hunting and system security.
system_sokariang_key: Which Space are a faction travelling through space, hoping to find our own home.
system_songala_key:
The home of the Horizon Defense Agency. The Horizon Defense Agency is a private military corporation assembled to help protect the galaxy. This faction has close ties to the Federation, but remains independent.
Reports state the HDA will help anyone for the right price.
system_songzi_key:
The home of the Decimus Imperium Lex. Decimus Imperium Lex is a group of commanders who perform whatever action is necessary for the greater glory of the Empire. They were established by a traditionally influential Imperial family who seek to bring a new era of renewal, peace and security in territory under their control.
They have stated that whoever shares these principles will have unconditional allies at their side, while those who oppose them will face relentless enemies.
system_sons_key: Founded in 3302, Leviathan Shipyard Corps was originally formed from a collective of smaller shipyards and mining companies in the Sons system. It adheres to the main principles set down by the Alliance and is mainly concerned with combating the increased threat of Federal and Imperial naval expansion on the galactic stage.
system_sorbacoc_key: The Knights of Cydonia are a group of bounty hunters and slave smugglers.
system_sorbago_key:
Site of a slave rebellion in December of 3300.

The home of MLC Incorporated.
MLC Incorporated started in the pharmaceutical industry, but eventually specialised towards the study of mental health problems caused by space exploration and combat. It rapidly grew into a corporation researching equipment to improve the mental health of pilots.
The faction now aims to extend its reach to other systems. Its goal remains to enhance the life of the population of these systems with its philosophy of mental wellbeing.
system_sosong_key: The Mining Industries and Commerce Association is a commodity trading and mining corporation. It has established a base of operations in the Sosong system.
system_sothis_key: The home of the Overlord Armada. The Overlord Armada seeks to hunt down all those deemed to be evildoers, and any who stand on the opposite side of the law.
system_sounti_key: The Terrahawks Defense Directorate strives to bring humanity to new heights of peace, prosperity and innovation. It is comprised of traders, combat pilots, miners and explorers that support each other in their respective endeavours. Adhering to a code that requires members to protect any in need, the Terrahawks hope to be a major faction in the galaxy.
system_sun_takush_key: Valyn's Dragons are a ragtag group of freelancers led by Valyn Eritai, who are blazing their own trail across the galaxy.
system_sun_wen_ho_key:
The home of the Viatori Patuit Explorer Crew.
The Viatori Patuit Explorer Crew (Short VPEC) is a small group which explores the distant Viatori Patuit region.
system_sun_wen_key: This rich system contains a terraformed planet supporting an extensive agricultural economy. A second world is in the process of being terraformed. This is an important provider of foodstuffs in the local sector.
system_sungai_key: Luockhund Conglomerate is a privately owned corporation, made up of many smaller organisations that participate in all types of activities. It mainly fulfils transportation contracts to different star systems.
system_surti_key:
The home of Orange Logistic Solutions.
Orange Logistic Solutions is an ambitious corporation of service providers, structured to act within federal law. It offers both logistical and security solutions.
system_susa_key: The stated mission of NODE 6 [NODE] is to promote innovative advances in research and analytics by serving as a platform for collaborative efforts fostering the interaction between combat, technology and exploration data. It hopes to develop advanced defensive countermeasures, combat strategies and hardware.
system_suta_key: The home of Pneuma Exploration, a faction that thrived under the rule of President Jasmina Halsey. After her disappearance however Pneuma left the Federation, refusing to serve under Zachary Hudson's control. Now residing in the Suta star system, Pneuma Exploration focuses not only on the exploration of the Milky Way, but uses the tourist trade to showcase the galaxy's true beauty.
system_sutekh_key: Hightower Defense Consultancy is a paramilitary organisation founded in the year 3304 by a group of ex-pirates and former Federal navy pilots. HDC maintains a simple policy towards its operation: if the pay is good enough, members will set aside their morals to ensure success.
system_suteni_key: The home of the Space Truckers Inc. A group that is actively engaged in the governance and trade of local Imperial clients. Representatives of this group expect to be treated with the utmost respect, believing their status affords them such courtesies.
system_syntec_key: The home of Artemis Interstellar Corporation, a private corporation owned by Romeo Artemis, making advances in the research, protection, and trade sectors.
system_synteini_key:
Senator Zemina Torval's fabulous estate can be found in this system.

Chenzo's Privateers are a small faction, and originaly formed in Synteini.
system_syntes_key: The Church of The Space Doggo is committed to bringing The Word of the Space Doggo to all corners of the galaxy. They preach a life of simple trading and exploration, contemplating the eternal mystery of the Space Doggo, who only appears to those who have simultaneously sampled the delicate tastes and aromas of MATea.
system_synuefai_rj_d_f_d12_d_51_key: The Oryx Resource Development Group investigates the viability of planets for colonization. They invest in exploration and terraforming, as well as mining and the refinement of rare materials.
system_synuefe_bt_d_f_d12_54_key: Sacra Oculus is a theocracy dedicated to the Creator, and is actively preparing for the end of days.
system_synuefe_ky_d_h_c26_d_4_key: The Bi-Neutron Syndicate seeks to establish a small but notable foothold on the edges of inhabited space. Its stated ultimate objective is the construction of a starport close to a cluster of neutron stars. Members are known to be a tenacious force of independent pilots with varying goals, aspirations and ideals.
system_t_a_ieni_key: T'ieni Holdings Company was founded in 3305 by a group of colonists concerned with a decline in property ownership, trade rights and economic freedom in T'ieni, as well as the perceived corruption of law enforcement in the sector. T'ieni Holdings Company and its subsidiaries are bound by oath to promote peace, free trade, economic security and civil liberty to all citizens of the Federation.
system_t_a_iensei_key: After gaining influence and wealth from several powerful and influential sources throughout human occupied space; the founding members of HCT invested heavily in supermax prisons and the procurement of armaments. Taking on big contracts with bounty hunting and the holding of highly dangerous individuals, with occasional involvement in military operations such as the Lugh War in support of CSG, Emperors Dawn defence and other noted conflicts. Lately they've grown to become indifferent to both the Empire and Federation and are set to pave their own vision for society.
system_taexalk_key: The home of the Aspect of Light Inc. Aspect of Light Inc research innovative, reliable and advanced technologies, developing solutions with a special mix of engineering and application expertise. At Aspect of Light Inc, wares are delivered by an experienced professional trade team and protected by the Aspect of Light Inc security fleet. Our motto: Sapere aude!
system_tago_key: An independent media organisation broadcasting music, news and gossip to commanders across the galaxy. Members of this group are actively engaged in the promotion of free speech and great tunes, guiding and entertaining commanders across the universe.
system_tagoman_key:
The home of 63rd Expeditionary Fleet.
63rd Expeditionary Fleet’s primary goal is scientific exploration, seeking out new life and the documentation of stellar phenomena.
system_tahuara_key:
The home of Furiian Heavy Industries.
A conglomerate of like-minded, deep space miners and businessmen founded by Aleksander "Geph" Furiia in 3303. Furiia Heavy Industries was created to meet the growing demand for construction materials in frontier systems and is known for operating primarily heavy freighters and repurposed mining ships. The corporation sells to all regardless of affiliation.
system_tai_si_key: The home of the Talon Security. Talon Security is a group of Commanders, whose stated purpose is to intercept and destroy any potential threat to them or their as-yet-unannounced goals.
system_taleo_key:
The home of Xeno Malice LLC.
Xeno Malice LLC was founded on a ‘Be, Know & Do’ philosophy, described as follows:
‘Be where you need to be.
Know what you need to know.
Do what you need to do to get the mission completed.’
system_tamar_key: The home of the Imperial Defence Force. The Imperial Defence Force were established to defend the system of Tamar from wanted pilots when needed, while also acting as a larger-scale system military force when required.
system_tangpho_key: The Galacticons are a band of adventurers specialising in many different fields including exploration, bounty hunting and trade.  A multitude of member origins motivates the group to achieve a common goal: a truly utopian galaxy.
system_tao_key: The Ancient Order of Tao exists to battle corruption and conflict within the three major human powers. Its goal is to unite the Federation, Empire and Alliance under a single banner and bring peace to the galaxy.
system_taosha_key: The home of The Phantom Nation, a faction dedicated to bounty hunting, trade and mining.
system_taoshamorio_key: The Epsilon Eunoia Corporation is an independent business partnership created by pilots sharing a unified vision of a “Better Utopia”. Their mission is to bring industry, solidarity and safety to fledgling solar systems through aggressive economic expansion and active paramilitary patrols.
system_tapoya_key: Formidine Greybeard Guild was formed by a group of explorers who became lost on an expedition to the Formidine Rift. Despite its predicament, the Guild's formed a plan to home. Ultimately it was successful, returning to inhabited space with a new sense of independence. Deciding not to align with any of the superpowers, it instead seeks to continue exploring the edges of the galaxy.
system_tata_key: The home of Crimson Corsairs, a group of mercenaries dedicated to making credits by any means necessary.
system_tauni_key: Founded in 3305, the RDF Defence Syndicate seeks to ensure security and stability for the systems it holds a presence in. Focused primarily on providing mercenary and bounty hunting services, the organisation has grown to include mining and trade services in more recent times.
system_taurina_key: The United Workers of Taurina is a union consisting of working-class inhabitants of the Taurina system. Members seek to push back against the influence of rampant corporatism, having pledged to spread socialist independence to as many systems as possible.
system_tawilo_key:
The ancestors of the Sons of the Seven Lords were reputable warriors who obtained their homeland after wandering the galaxy.

Their descendants formed the Sons of the Seven Lords Interstellar PLC (in short [SSL Interstellar PLC]), to provide an organised and legal framework for their organisation as a paramilitary faction investing in a wide range of research, including biotechnology.
system_te_kaha_key: The screaming Bishops originated in the Hyel Yeh, they took a vow of silence in an effort to fight corruption. This failed to spread awareness of their cause so they took a vow of screaming.
system_tehuevi_key:
The home of Falcon Nebula Trading Inc.
Formed in 3302, Falcon Nebula Trading Incorporated was set up to supply colonies on the route between Colonia and the core systems. The faction provides transportation, trade and mined resources.
system_telin_key:
For generations the Flying Circus has been roaming the galaxy searching for inspiration for your entertainment. Now the legendary Flying Circus daredevils are back on the space stage with the greatest show in the Big Black!

Marvel in amazement at astonishing flying Asps and extraordinary stunts performed by magnificent Space Cows. Dance with Anacondas and acrobatic Keelbacks in a unique performance you'll never forget!
system_tembala_key: The Orange Society is developing modern technologies and exploring the secrets of the galaxy.
system_tenche_key: Verucas Merchant Enterprise thrives from trade and bounty hunting. With its growing political influence, members have been known to use lethal force if necessary for the betterment of the corporation. Staying independent and true to their values, they refuse to be dictated to by the major galactic powers.
system_tepehuacoc_key: Originally, the North Wall Alliance Embassy was an informal relationship between leaders of Arany and Helvetitj. It was established as a clearing house for diplomatic and economic issues between the Alliance and independent systems in the region. It gives a unified voice for scores of independent Alliance-controlled systems while preserving their autonomy.
system_tepertsi_key: The Iron Dragoon Merchants Guild is based in this system. They are known to be fair and decisive. They are said to treat friends with equity and enemies with caution. Caution, instead of aggression simply because they could bring business to their merchant guild in the future. The Guild shouldn't be taken for pacifists, as they are willing to respond in kind to any aggression.
system_tewanta_key:
The home of The Buurian Protectorate.
The Buurian Protectorate is a band of independent pilots. It is self-funded and engages with a wide variety of opportunities and professions.
system_thari_key: A cabal of former entrepreneurs looking to expand the interests of the Empire as well as their own. The Rogue Traders operate with no direct oversight and each individual member is free to act as they see fit for the glory of the Empire.
system_tharu_key: The Despair Owls consist of free people proclaiming liberty and autonomy. It seeks to exist without regulation, without a leader, governed only by the code that everyone is free to live their life as they want. To simplify communication with other groups a few spokespersons are selected periodically.
system_thernobo_key: The Independent Combat & Logistics Conglomerate is a corporation that strives to fill any role required of it. Its lack of allegiance allows a flexibility and efficiency incomparable with any other group when it comes to completing a task. The I.C.L.C stands for itself; a proud beacon of independent strength and forward-thinking direction. It remains untouched by external politics and answers to no one other than its members.
system_thiana_key:
The home of INSPIRE Corp.
INSPIRE Corp.’s mission is to bring pilots together, cherishing those who come together for adventures. It protects members and administered stations with military divisions offering private system security.
INSPIRE takes security very seriously, rigorously testing its ships to ensure all members and investments are optimally protected.
Its motto is, ‘Making the universe a better place, one inspired commander at a time.’
system_thiansi_key: The home of the Killer Elite. Killer Elite is an exclusive guild of some of the finest combat pilots in the galaxy. Forged from the flames of war and conflict, pilots are advised to give them a wide birth.
system_thoth_key: The New Britannia Communist Party was formed to provide citizens with a fair and equal society.
system_thras_key:
The Galactic Academic Training Group is based in this system.

"Citizens of the Empire, Peoples of the Federation, the Alliance and those from the independent worlds - welcome to our system. The training group has been forged for the purposes of educating novice and intermediate commanders as well as flight crew with the intent of improving their skills and bringing about a sophisticated and safer galaxy."
system_tibila_key: The Sub-Net Syndicate was founded by impoverished Imperials who chose exile over slavery. Originally members were forced to become adept at smuggling and piracy as a survival tactic. In recent times the Syndicate’s operations appear legitimate. It has never forgotten these origins, however, and retains a poor view of Imperial factions.
system_timbalderis_key: The home of ZFE Corporation, who have established themselves as leaders in mineral extraction and other private contract operations for numerous high profile customers. Through years of experience the motto, "If you can't beat them, buy them out", has always driven the management of this shady organisation.
system_tinigua_key: The home of the Silver Hunter Order, which was created with one thing in mind: the defence of Imperial borders and its citizens against those seeking to spread chaos. Be it at home or abroad, these stalwart defenders stand ready to show the galaxy the true meaning of Imperial justice.
system_tiveronisa_key: The home of the Newtons Erben. A group of courageous pilots who joined forces to fight for the good of humanity. Whether in science, trade or combat, 'Newtons Erben' are always focused on a peaceful solution and act according to the old values.
system_tjakiri_key: Black Omega provides military equipment and security services to the governments and corporations struggling for survival on the dangerous fringes of the Pegasi Sector. Despite an outwardly professional appearance, rumours of narcotics smuggling, human trafficking, piracy and racketeering are abound.
system_tjindjin_key:
The Tjindjin system is famous for the breathtaking landscapes of its natural water-world, and as one of the last high tech outfitter's before the frontier. It is also the adopted home of The Shadow Navy.

Little is known about this mysterious organisation aside from its fierce loyalty to the Federation. This was typified during a brief moment in history when the existence of one of their operations around the Volungu and Liaedin systems became public.

There are few confirmed members of the Shadow Navy around the galaxy, though many have never been revealed and almost all value their anonymity.
system_tjinia_key:
The home of the Thieves of Horizon. Living on the margins of society, this group of thieves take advantage of all opportunities to recover the necessary materials and data required to build and strengthen their fleet. They respect their own code; reports claim they do not destroy merchant ships while seizing their cargo, but indicate that any craft identified attacking a thief of Horizon will become a priority target to all.
Though pirates, they are also excellent explorers, in search of new planets or forms of life to register as a first discovery, increasing the reputation of their faction to those who want to buy their data.
system_tjiwuar_key: Sent by the Federation to the system Tjiwuar to build an outpost outside the "influence zone" of Zachary Hudson and Felicia Winters, the Federal Rangers' mission was to investigate spy activity by the Empire, and dismantle it. Once the mission was complete they were rewarded with this system to raise a CQ, based on their own legislation. They remained loyal to the Federation, and eventually the Federal Rangers became Axis Republica; a militaristic and scientific nation helping defend the Federation.
system_tobala_key: The home of Casual Crew, a loosely knit collection of friends, mainly ex-military types, with some former explorers, traders and miners.
system_todzhinas_key: The home of the Nova Research Group. Nova Research Group performs deeps space exploration, research and rare item recovery for private clients and corporations.
system_toluku_key: EoT is a free coalition of like-minded people with a common goal to pursue exploration. The Explorers on Tour share a passion to uncover the mysteries of the universe and discover unknown worlds. Everyone who is, or was, on a long voyage in space can consider themselves a member of this group.
system_tonesh_key:
The home of the Dawn's March, an elite mercenary established as far back as the first Thargoid Invasion. Dawns March have been known to take no prisoners, no matter the situation. Having no known allegiance, Dawns March are only concerned with finding the best price for their skills.
Although previously thought to have disbanded, reports claim they have merely reformed with a new leader while displaying the same lust for credits.
system_tong_key: Moonlight Mercenary Corp is a small group of pilots dedicated to going where the money takes them, and gathering the supplies and funds needed to keep their ships available for hire. Whether its cleaning up pirates or fighting on the front lines of a war, this company is available to the highest bidder.
system_toroesing_key: Milkyway Miners Union, or MMU, is an independent mining cooperative. Cobbling together a few small ships from meagre beginnings, they have risen to become a large fleet, helping their allies across the stars to make the galaxy a safer more stable place.
system_tote_key: The origins of Beasts of Bestia can be found in Tote. A clan of adventurers joined with a group of refugees from Phanes, and in October 3302 they settled in Bestia to found the faction as it is today.
system_tpheirset_key: Green Planet is an environmental movement that promotes the blossoming of the human race.
system_trocmii_key: The home of The Tragak Horde, a merciless dictatorship in the Trocmii system, led by Warboss Weeder.
system_trukampasuk_key: The home of Knights of the Realm, a group of nobles who united under five virtues: valour, honour, compassion, generosity and wisdom. Thanks to a healthy relationship with the Empire, the group now acts as a bastion for all who seek guidance and help.
system_tsim_binba_key: Imperial Self Defense Force is actively engaged in the governance of local Imperial interests. Representatives of the group expect to be treated with the respect that befits the rank of the organisation's commanding officer.
system_tsohoda_key: The home of the Reborn Phoenix, an academy for young pilots dedicated to the protection of the weak.
system_tsu_key:
The home of Sol's Salutis Aeternum.
Sol's Salutis Aeternum is united in the task of keeping humanity's light burning, guarding against external threats and fighting for those who cannot fight for themselves.
The faction’s name represents its vow, translating as ‘Sol's eternal salvation’.
system_tu_tu_key: The T'u Tu Venator League is an Imperial group dedicated to the defence of T'u Tu and surrounding systems through trade and combat.
system_tumuzgo_key:
The home of MIRAI Group.
Established in Medupe City in Cubeo in 3304, MIRAI Group is a PMC that operates in numerous fields outside of combat, including logistics and civil affairs.
The corporation seeks to expand its influence in Imperial space while collaborating with allies from across the galaxy.
system_turbo_key: Mesk Corporation BR is a group formed of scientists and military personnel, led by Commander Mesk Rodrik. They research new technologies, currently focusing on the study of secret military weapons. These are usually provided to law enforcement agencies.
system_turd_wu_key: The home of the Binary Interstellar Therapy Syndicate. The Binary Interstellar Therapy Syndicate state their goal as, 'bringing rehabilitation to the stars.'
system_turir_key:
A system specialising in high tech output supporting a moderate population. Two of its three gas giants attract scientific interest with water based microbes forming vast spreads in the upper cloud layers.

The home of the Black Heart Crew, a ruthless group of mercenaries who rose to infamy by way of their readiness to take part in any war if enough credits were involved. Though their ambitions are huge, as is their greed, the Black Heart Crew has a very strict sense of loyalty to their own, and will refuse to take up arms against crew-mates. Other than that, any enemy is fair game and remember: "Credits speak louder than honour".
system_turona_key:
The Dukes of Buckleigh consider themselves the protectors of Turona, and strive to bring prosperity and riches to the system, whilst warding off bounty hunters and pirates.

"The Dukes are at your service for combat and trade missions. Welcome to our home, spend your money and help our economy to flourish."
system_tutumu_key: The Faceless Knights are freelancers who value honour highly. They do not seek fame and glory, instead preferring to remain 'faceless', and appearing anywhere at any time. Their motto is "Achieve More - Be Faceless".
system_tz_a_utuls_key: The Sanctum Accord consists of a disparate group of starship commanders, drawn from across human-occupied space.
system_tzu_i_key:
The home of Guardians of Valhalla.
Guardians of Valhalla is a group of pilots who specialise in goods transportation. It is aligned with the Federation and works to defend traders along their routes, remaining vigilant and prepared to fight against any who can threaten its interests.
system_udegoci_key:
The home of the Allied Banking Clan.
The Allied Banking Clan is a fledgeling group of freelance pilots who formed there own private trading business in the year 3305. It focuses on trade deals with nearby independent systems, at times deploying mercenary support to fight piracy.
system_udihikoja_key: The Interstellar Hydra Collective is a group of private individuals with similar goals and legal business ventures spanning several fields of expertise. The collective was formed under the pledge that all members work together in pursuit of achieving their shared goals.
system_ugrivirii_key: Noctilucent Dyn's main mission is supporting, and protecting Imperial assets. They accomplish this through running cargo, bounty hunting and recon.
system_uibuth_key: Uibuth is the home system of the 3S Peoples Union, an organisation under the guidance of Prismatic Imperium officers in the interest of managing the integration of freed slaves (and Imperial slaves) after the freedom effort in Uibuth in February of 3302.
system_umaitis_key: Humanity has abandoned its instinct for technology. Scipio Corp aims to cultivate a group who share their skills for the benefit of the galaxy. They live by the following words, written by Scipione the African: "Maior ignotarum rerum est terror: The terror of the unknown is greater."
system_umastae_key: The Congressus Tenebris was an independent faction forced to quit its system. Years later, former members re-established the faction to reclaim what was lost. A corporate government has been established with The Phoenix Consul as its political arm and the Legio X as its military.
system_unegak_maku_key:
The home of the S.T.A.R.S.
Special Tactics And Rescue Squad is a Federal unit, that specialises in search-and-rescue and defensive combat. While they are openly hostile to Imperial-aligned craft, they do collaborate with most other forces.
system_unktock_key: The Quebecois Patriots are farmers and traders who reportedly adhere to an ancient military tradition. With members widely spread across inhabited space, it practices ecological high-tech farming technologies, the cultivation of medicinal herbs, and political activism. A joke among rivals paints the faction as ‘a group of farmers with guns who grow angry when someone treads on their plants.’
system_uracenufon_key: The home of the Serenity Mercenary Company. The Serenity Mercenary Company has accepted pilots from all areas of inhabited space, utilising them for a variety of operations. They state their motto to be, 'If you call us, we fly for you.'
system_urvane_key:
The home of Heaven's Judgment.
Heaven's Judgment is a band of bounty hunters and miners who took up the mantle of their old militia group. Offering refuge to those seeking shelter, it chooses to protect those within its territory from all manners of hostilities.

This modest system also contains two worlds that interest xenobiologists because of the unusual life found there.
system_urvantju_key:
HFR Corp was created by an association of like-minded French entrepreneurs, specialising in the manufacture, assembly and transportation of high tech hardware. Their motto is: "bringing hardware where no one dares."

The company later expanded its activities to exploration and has also developed biomorphic mercenary assistants to help protect its assets.
system_urvasini_key: The home of the Dead Horse Raiders, a group of malcontents and misfits, dissatisfied with the civilised state of the major factions. They have dedicated themselves to seeking out the wild edges of space, testing their mettle in combat, and seeking out skilled pilots that value the freedom of the void.
system_uzbekree_key: Originating from the Barnard's Star system, Bedroc Security Corp. has set its sights on new horizons. Having secured a notable counter-piracy contract, the company has settled on the outer reaches of inhabited space in the Hirani system. The bounty hunting outfit intends to bring order to its new territories.
system_uzumeru_key: This modest system supports both extraction and refinery economies. Its central gas giant is often visited by xenobiologists studying the water based life found in its upper cloud layers.
system_vagho_key: Terra Formations Industries is a mining corporation born in Vagho A4 and dedicated to the extraction of metals and other materials required for the fabrication of strong alloys used in ship hulls. Born as a small corporation of a few members, it reached a funding agreement with the Federation to expand its influence in the system in exchange for spreading Federation values and a contribution to the Federation military.
system_valac_key: The Illuminates of Valac trace their lineage to the most powerful families of the early Empire. Now almost entirely ostracised from Imperial society, the Illuminates have used their remaining resources to establish a foothold in Colonia, where they hope to resume their religious and spiritual practices away from the prying eyes of the Empire. The Illuminates of Valac are controlled by a council of 'Magi', made up of the heads of each of its noble houses. In times of crisis or upheaval, a 'Hierophant' with total control over the faction may be voted into power temporarily.
system_valhaling_key: From distant and nigh forgotten tales of bloodshed and fear, hail the Galactic Vikings. They leapt from the dark past into one of the most violent frays in the galaxy. Their footprints in the galaxy will transcend their previous deeds. Be wary not to be caught in their wake.
system_valtam_key: The Argus Initiative, established in the year 3305, is a united civilian-led effort towards human expansion and exploration. The Initiative has incorporated other supplementary duties to protect its operation from external threats. These include anti-piracy operations, trade and the secure transport of valued personnel.
system_varam_key: The home of Independent Defence Agency, a group dedicated to making human-occupied space a safe environment.
system_varati_key: The home system for The Canonn. Originally drawn together from the four corners of inhabited space to investigate the unknown artefacts, the Canonn consists of commanders from all professions, all allegiances and all walks of life. One common goal unites them: to seek the truth behind the galaxy's mysteries at any cost.
system_varpet_key: The home system for The Black Fleet - they are the special operations division of the XYZ group whose presence is only announced by the dark, imposing silhouette of their warships.
system_vasa_key: The Alvastra Alliance was founded after a terrible civil war. It aims to protect the system's integrity and support the populace.
system_velabri_key:
The home of The Alpha Legion.
The Alpha Legion was created to safeguard Imperial borders, patrolling local star systems and hunting for enemies of the Empire. It also works to support the Imperial economy.
system_veli_key:
The home of the Systems Alliance Sentinels.
A paramilitary group of bounty hunters who uphold Allied values and employ a strict top-down management style to ensure a tight hold over its assets.
system_velliep_key: The home of The Galactic Consortium of Billionaires, who are miners, haulers, mercenaries and investors. Their goal is to be the banking clan of the Imperial navy.
system_venetet_key: Dark Phoenix Corporation is a small group of independent pilots who found their rightful place in Venetet.
system_venexo_key: The home of Knights of the Empire, a military group of Imperial veterans who still defend the honour and interests of the Empire.
system_veroklist_key: Moritasgus Imperial Corporation has become the fastest growing Imperial corporation in the region for trading and exploration. It is responsible for the running of several Imperial prison colonies and is still active in Imperial governance in many systems.
system_vesuvit_key: The home system for Time of Chaos. One cannot shape the galaxy without being reshaped in the process.
system_virudnir_key: Virudnir InterSolar Ltd specialises in scientific and exploratory voyages, galactic surveyance and planetary science work on the periphery of inhabited space.
system_vish_key: The home of the VLM Corp. VLM Corp is the space division of the VLM Enterprise Group, a service company specializing in tourism and commerce. This company is not limited to just these two businesses, however; they also operate a space exploration business unit, a protection service for customers and a consulting service for rookie commanders.
system_vitri_key: Headquarters of SI Terraforming, an industrial powerhouse on the rim of human-occupied space. This corporation enjoys virtual autonomy and a controlling stake in various infrastructure projects. The people of Vitri are incredibly optimistic, and have a large speculative real-estate market. Foreign nationals are advised to seek reliable local counsel before investing here, as many properties do not have a clear title.
system_vodnirtama_key: In the year 3300 the brothers Sven and Olaf Svensson discovered the system Vodnirtama and since then the Svenssons have run a lucrative natural resource extraction colony.
system_vodyanoa_key: The driving force behind the Dengist-style socialist revolution aiming to end the age of entitlement and create a new socialist republic where each citizen is equal. It started the Drakonia uprising when the revolutionary force revolted and captured the city of Drakonia, where the largest interstellar ship factory on the planet is located. Afterward, the People's republic of Drakonia was founded on the planet Vodyanoa 1, attracting workers, farmers, scientists and former imperial slaves.
system_volcae_key: The Galactic Vanguard of Independent Colonies' sole purpose is to protect humankind from all threats in the galaxy, both human and alien alike. They send out exploration teams in the hopes of establishing contact and peace with any alien races they might meet in the vast galaxy. If they cannot find a way to bring about peace and alliances with any of the alien races then they are prepared to react and combat any hostilities.
system_volkhab_key: United Citizen Federation is an independent, militarist coalition of former Federation personnel. Ascending to power after displacing the previous government through a coup d'état, UCF differs from the Federation, whose values are corporatist while the UCF leans toward socialism. The UCF's motto is "Citizens, we fight for what is right!"
system_voltrigones_key: The home of the Retro Faction Of Voltrigones. The Retro Faction Of Voltrigones are primarily a trade faction who started operating 30 years ago, trading consumer electronic items that, at the time, were considered cutting edge. They used the profits from these electronics to grow and expand their commercial operations, including bounty hunting, mining and tourism
system_vorden_key: TGNO Corp aims to provide resource for resistance. It will use currencies exchange among the other factions in order to sustain the resistance.
system_votadja_key: Barons Contracting is a former extraction gang that arrived in the Votadja system on a mining expedition. Over time members came to call the system home and have taken it upon themselves to improve the lives of its inhabitants in any way they can.
system_wababa_key: The Imperial Armada is a faction whose stated aim is to help and mentor new pilots whilst ridding the galaxy of criminals. Members strive to make the galaxy a better place for all while documenting their experiences to pass on to future generations.
system_wailladyan_key: A squadron of rogue pilots left the upper echelons of their local brigade and took to the stars, forming the faction DasAnfall. Members welcome the chance to skirmish with other combat pilots in search of a rich bounty. The group’s thirst for victory at all odds is reportedly considerable.
system_wakawal_key:
The home of the Dutch Elite Force. In the year 3303, a handful of commanders established the Dutch Elite Force. These commanders are practiced in a variety of ship operations, the acquisition of wealth and the protection of their territory and citizens.
Since the discovery of nonhuman life and subsequent assault on starports, these commanders reached out to help survivors and fight back against any who oppose them. With their knowledge of the galaxy, healthy economy and willingness to co-operate with most governments, the Dutch Elite Force are well prepared.
system_walka_key: A trinary system supporting extraction and industrial concerns. This system is governed by a brutal dictatorship and isn't the most welcoming place for traders.
system_walmiri_key:
The home of the Black Universe Gazers.
The Black Universe Gazers is a faction of explorers, researchers, and scientists priding themselves on knowledge above all else. Their primary role is exploration and trade, but they do command a small defence fleet.
system_wangal_key: Under Argon Armrend's leadership, Angeli Imperial Enterprises seeks to counter-balance the cronyism, nepotism and stagnation of the cliens system by ensuring that Imperial corporations are given more control over the day-to-day running of Imperial worlds, thus providing Imperial citizens with the means and opportunity for advancement regardless of wealth, connections or social status.
system_wapiya_key: The United German Commanders group is based in this system. They are known for maintaining their ancient native German tongue.
system_waq_key: Azure Enterprises is one of the most discreet private corporations in the galaxy. They live by the words, "If the money is good, consider it done".
system_waras_key: Empire's Twilight is a small group that is fiercely loyal to Arissa Lavigny-Duval. As well as public work, Empire's Twilight have been known to take part in covert actions against the enemies of the Empire.
system_wargis_key: A community of miners, traders and smugglers that have learned to co-exist with all other factions by exchanging goods and services, mostly by legal means. They earn an honest day's pay the old-fashioned way... they work for it!
system_warnates_key: The famed band 'Darkness Awakes' was formed in this system.
system_warnones_key: The War Pigs are former war criminals that took over their prison colony. They now operate as mercenaries.
system_warwa_key: The home of Torval Strategic Services. A model of organisational efficiency and governmental competency, it enforces a strictly capitalist economic policy without social safeguards.
system_wei_chang_key: Ray City Guardians is a faction dedicated to protecting and expanding the interests of the Empire in Wei Chang and surrounding systems.
system_wheemez_key: Steadfast in the separation of the galaxy and independent governments from the tyranny of the Federation, the 8th Imperials are dedicated to bringing the word of the Empire throughout the edges and outer reaches of civilized space and enforcing the word of our Emperor. The Syndicate continues to work on training and reforming the hardest criminals the Empire has seen. Some of the Empire's and Pilots' Federation's best pilots have come from the hard working prisons of the 8th Imperials. The 8th Imperials continue to work on reforming all its prisoners to fight for the Empire or better their own lives through dedication and reform.
system_wicca_town_key:
The Alliance Office of Statistics strives to bring direction and guidance to the Alliance by providing accurate and up-to-date information on events in Alliance and Mahon space as well as the wider galaxy. They give no orders and do not consider themselves leaders (though they gladly offer suggestions if asked), but they make it possible for others to make informed decisions based on the information they provide.

Their goals are the safety and prosperity of the Alliance and Mahon space. They are peaceful at heart, but if threatened are willing to leave their spreadsheets behind and saddle up in fighting ships with weapons of significant size to defend what they hold dear.
system_wikanawal_key:
The home of IMC Remnant Fleet.
The Interstellar Mining Cooperative Remnant Fleet work together to bring mined goods into circulation to help the manufacture of parts for ships and stations.
system_wikegarak_key: The Tzimisca Order is a respected chivalric order in its sector of space, located on the edges of human-controlled territory. Notorious for its effective and sometimes brutal methods, the Knights of the Tzimisca Order patrol local systems to protect its subjects from the threat of pirate gangs and hostile local factions.
system_wilintae_key: The home of Interstellar Freelance Coalition, founded by famed explorer, trader and combat ace Nolan Yeager, is a loosely governed confederacy of pilots hailing from all corners of the known galaxy. An IFC pilot will take on any job that they deem suitable or lucrative, and they offer aid to anyone who petitions for support.
system_willapa_key:
The home of Redsheep Corporation.
Once a family-owned business, a change in leadership led to rapid growth for Redsheep Corporation. Pursuing expansion at any cost, it is known for employing ruthless tactics to press ahead of the competition.
system_windit_key:
The home of Aurora Legacy.
Aurora Legacy is an alliance of pilots actively fighting corruption, hunting pirates in Imperial space. The faction’s founder selected this system as its home, from where it fights to expand influence.
system_woda_key:
The home of the New Woda Democratic Defensive. N.W.D.D is a private security force situated in the system of Woda. Its primary function is to bounty hunt throughout the local star cluster.
The faction was established in response to all-time high levels of criminal activity in the Woda system. A few skilled pilots came together and formed the faction with the aim of fighting back against established criminal organisations.
system_wogam_key:
The home of the Orion Knights.
A corporation working in the name of Federal supremacy.
system_wolfsegen_key: Wolfsegen hosts the Pilots’ Federation District’s sole detention centre, used to process Commanders who break the law and acquire a bounty prior to losing their ship.
system_wolonir_key: Sigma Convoys LLC is a transportation and mining enterprise operating out of the Wolonir system. It is involved in trade and mining, operating convoys with specialised personnel to enhance security and minimise technological delays. Sigma Convoys is seeking to expand across inhabited space.
system_wong_guin_key: The Legion of the Black Sea is primarily composed of former security members who specialise in hunting down high profile criminals and bringing them to justice. They are led by 'Imperator' Lucretia Brande, but are primarily controlled by specialised 'Legates' who operate individual wings of pilots when performing hunts.
system_wong_sher_key:
The home of Flotta Stellare.
Flotta Stellare brings together numerous independent pilots specialised in exploration. It was founded to make exploration journeys safer and less solitary for members.
system_wonga_key: Remus Salvus Mortem is an independent theocracy, which observes ancient and secretive beliefs. Master traders and deadly warriors, their unmarked and unranked ships can be found in all corners of human space.
system_wosyra_pao_key:
The home of the Vega Cartel.
The Vega Cartel is a criminal syndicate of smugglers, assassins and terrorists who have aligned with Archon Delaine. Founded by Sindel Vega, a shadowy and ruthless trafficker, it has clawed its way out of obscurity with a lust for wealth and an insatiable thirst for power.
system_woyo_mina_key: Home system of the 104th Phoenix Discovery Group.
system_wu_guan_key: The Black Knights Brigade (also know as B.K.B.) has been keeping an ever watchful eye out for those in need, while helping the intergalactic community with what ever combat needs arise.
system_wu_guinagi_key: Once a thriving religious community of industrial importers and exporters, the Lords of the DarkStar Imperium are all that remain of the once great House of DarkStar.
system_wu_jinifex_key: The home of Platinum Imperia Mining Ltd, whose support of the Empire has given them local power and allowed their venture to become an endorsed Imperial corporation. However, perceived as an increasing threat to their interests, their former partners Paesia Corporation, exiled Platinum Imperia due to their continuing association with the Empire. From exile, the corporation vows to return and reclaim their lost home.
system_wu_kich_key:
The home of Channel Zero.
Channel Zero is the only surviving department of a now-defunct interstellar intelligence agency. The remaining pilots now use their training to survive as soldiers of fortune.
system_wu_kong_key:
The home of the Voidsreach LLC. Voidsreach LLC was founded in an effort to improve the quality of life across the galaxy wherever possible. Offering services such as bounty hunting, exploration services, armed escorts, and logistics; there's not much that the pilots of Voidsreach LLC will not do to live up to their mission statement. 
Their motto is, 'From the void's reach to the settled systems, serving the galaxy as one.'
system_wu_kuku_key:
The home of Syndicate of Free Traders.
 Syndicate of Free Traders is a cooperative organisation that wants to expand its influence through trade - occasionally in illegal goods, it is rumoured - and cooperation with factions which advance its own interests.
system_wulganda_key: The home of the Wing legion. The Wing legion have only one confirmed objective: To explore the black.
system_wuonanie_key: The home of the ScyCo. The home system of ScyCo, a law enforcement agency and defence contractor. They actively hunt down criminal elements and strive to bring all outlaws to justice. The Technologies Division of ScyCo sells specialised defensive systems and services to the law enforcement and military agencies of both the Federation and Empire.
system_wurango_key: The home system of the Federal Tactical Force. This faction is known for carrying out scientific research for the good of humanity and allied factions, and also has participation in high-risk missions.
system_xerebaye_key:
The ACE Photographics group is registered as a coalition of scientists and expert photographers, studying the wonders of the galaxy. More recently, reports have emerged about the faction which implicates it as a surveillance cell known as ACE7.

ACE7 was believed to be defunct following a serious of unproven allegations of sabotage made several years ago. Whether Ace Photographics is truly a new iteration of ACE7 is yet to be determined.
system_xinca_key: Excellence Proven In Combat is charged with the protection of the system Xinca and all systems within its influence. Its pilots trained at the Imperial naval training facilities of Facece, and experienced battles against the Federation. Fiercely loyal to their Emperor, they are ferocious fighters and well versed in a wide variety of tactics and strategy.
system_xiri_key: The home of the Freelancers Alliance. Freelancers Alliance are the 'grey hats' in the abyss, consisting of outcasts, misfits, and rebels. Only those endeavours which serve the interest of this faction are ever subscribed to. Individually, each pilot is their own free-agent, available to come and go at will. However, in times of oppression or opposition, this group can band together to form an overwhelming force. The Freelancers may simultaneously be seen as heroes of one system while cast as the villains and pirates of another. Strength, profits and freedom call to this alliance and consolidate it.
system_xuanduna_key: Italian Battlestar Corporation are a faction of freedom and democracy, and open to all.
system_xuangu_key:
The home of the Ace Pilot Wing. Ace Pilot Wing state that combat is in their nature. They call for pilots to join them in their hunt for battle.
Their motto is, 'Our Conquest Is the Sea of Stars.'
system_yakabugai_key: A quasi-religious group inspired by obscure legends of giant deep-space creatures, the Quantum Whales of Yakabugai revere fair play, good humour and plentiful food and drink.
system_yan_crua_key:
The home of the As One Cooperative. The As One Cooperative is an autonomous association of commanders; a workers cooperative, united voluntarily to meet common economic and social needs. AoC believes in democratic collective ownership. As a jointly owned enterprise AoC engages in the distribution of goods and the supply of services for the mutual benefit of all. AoC opposes slavery in all its forms and currently operates in concert with the Mauninovit as One faction, but also counts many other factions that share a similar vision as friends. 
Their motto is, 'As one we move forward.'
system_yan_musu_key: The Enlightened Ones is a group that seeks to eradicate immorality within the Empire. This group naturally opposes piracy, smuggling, slavery and other actions and organisations deemed "immoral".
system_yapelici_key:
The home of Militia of Madmen.
Militia of Madmen is a faction of independent pilots who enjoy ‘enlightening’ systems, freeing them from tyranny of the superpowers.
system_yaque_key: Haven Corporation provides high security cargo services, protected by their private military company, and memorable and exciting experiences for tourists.
system_yaricans_key: Federal Liberal Command is a corporate organisation that funds and supports the agenda of the Liberal Federal Party throughout the galaxy. It offers private scholarships and medical aid to all Federal systems, new and old alike, and its command centres coordinate deadly strikes on the enemies of the Federation.
system_yarrite_key: Twilight of the Gods Yarrite Corp. is based in this star system. It is an association of people following a common vision in a tough and often inexorable universe.
system_yarruci_key: Formed during the Yarruci labour revolution of 3305, United Coalition of Boonta's mission is to provide a safe haven to all who need it. As a group comprising many identities and backgrounds, it promotes a common vision for the future. Members are known to be fundamentally sociable, but will not hesitate to use force against those who seek to oppress others.
system_ye_a_kuana_key: The Space Boiz are a group of individuals who claim to always get the job done. Not necessarily done well, some contractors say, but to a certain level of completion. Members specialise in trade and mining and are motivated by the simple goal of getting through the day intact.
system_yembo_key: The home system for the Elysium Corp. which is an influential corporate force that derives the majority of its power from commerce and lobbying, although there has been speculation about more clandestine activities.
system_yemojong_ku_key: Freedom Luck are a faction dedicated to teaching new pilots about mining, bounty hunting and trading.
system_yenistani_key: Hunt Pirate Wing are a Pirate Faction governed by the Yenistani Articles of Agreement set forth by the founders. The morally flexible and morally bankrupt are always welcome to fly in their wing.
system_yi_trica_key:
The home of the Eternal Sunrise Association.
A team of research enthusiasts made a decision to start the Eternal Sunrise Association. Its intention was to create an association which could achieve respective member's goals. The association engaged in research, funding by earnings gained from trade and tourism. Only time will tell what this research focus yields.
system_yimanbin_key: Founded in 3301, Zemina Torval expressed the need for a covert specialist group to secure her interests. Its original purpose is still considered highly classified, but the group is now under command of Commander Percivil Mohair, and assists all those allied with Zemina Torval.
system_yngvir_key: The home of the Chnouphis Alliance Navy. The edge of civilisation is underdeveloped, and the Chnouphis Alliance seeks to strengthen ties with systems they view as left behind by the galactic superpowers, intending to colonise new systems and resume terraforming once again. The Chnouphis Alliance Navy is the diplomatic and militaristic arm of this organisation.
system_yorua_key: The home of The Crimson Dawn Elite, a bounty hunting faction.
system_yu_di_yi_key: The home of the Dragons Edge Elite. "We will fight and we will conquer."
system_yugur_key: The Great Collective is an Imperial aligned faction who prefer peaceful relations with others. The group focuses on both geological and astronomical data collection in an attempt to better understand the origins of the universe.
system_yukpenon_key: The Black Hand Syndicate is an elusive group of experienced pilots with various skill sets. Members participate in most stellar professions, though their true allegiance may not be easy to identify. Rivals to the syndicate's territory have been known to act as though there is always a Hand member nearby.
system_yun_tzu_key: The home of the Union of Stellar Socialist Republics. The Union of Stellar Socialist Republics is a communist faction consisting of several groups of mostly Imperial defectors, disenfranchised by the galactic superpowers. They believe both trade and combat are equally vital components for enforcing their presence, pushing back against the perceived greed of corporate entities.
system_yurok_key: The Order of the Owl of Minerva is a military and humanitarian organisation, which seeks to protect the people under its rule, be it by military might or economic aid.
system_zandu_key: The home of the Star Chasers. The Star Chasers are a group of pilots focused on exploration; dedicated to discovering the galaxy, searching for new lifeforms and chasing the stars.
system_zaragas_key: The Intergalactic Nova Republic is made up of refugees from a system destroyed eons ago when its main star went super nova. The few that escaped travelled thousands of light years to the system now known as Zaragas, where they trained in combat and engineering to protect themselves from threats both human and extraterrestrial.
system_zarya_manas_key: The home of the Watchtower, a confederacy that maintains a certain level of independence from the three Great Powers by cultivating political relationships with other independent groups. Its purpose is to maintain peace and liberty within human occupied space, at any cost, from all acts of aggression, by any group.
system_zelano_key: The G.O.M. Collective is a consortium of pilots from across populated space and from all walks of life - they are traders, explorers, soldiers. They are looking for a way to bring good will and prosperity to a region of space that is in constant flux. The organisation works to uphold and enforce system laws and helps to enable positive trade and growth for their home. They will defend their own and those in friendly systems, and exist to make our worlds a better place.
system_zemetii_key: Zemetii Corporation specialises in the manufacture of industrial equipment. The company was established to increase overall productivity in the Zemetii system.
system_zhang_yu_key: The home of German Seed, an organisation of Imperial pilots.
system_zhi_key:
The home of the Boop Brigade.
The Boop Brigade initially started as a collective of pilots interested in exploring the galaxy and its wonders. However, it is not to be considered weak. Many of its members are retired military pilots, mercenaries, or pirates; they are not afraid to defend themselves or their territory.
system_zhuaruparci_key: The Procyon Intrigue is an enigmatic faction whose members operate in a variety of professions but whose true purpose is unknown. Rumours persist of a sacred vow to achieve this mysterious aim, to which the Intrigue is utterly devoted.
system_zi_yomi_key:
The home of Galactic Outcasts.
Galactic Outcasts offer refuge for everyone who hasn’t yet made their mark on the galaxy. The group claims to have acquired many talented and notorious individuals to its banner.
Usually, this faction stays low-profile and provides shelter to its members. Despite the faction appearing moderate, rumours indicate it could quickly become a serious threat to a potential aggressor.
system_zochna_key: The Khanfederation was formed by a group of pilots on the foundation of Federal representative democracy. The economic management of the Khanfederation funds a well-equipped Federal auxiliary force, which reinforces its values and influence.
