systemcolonisation_surfacefacilityplacem:
Using the Surface Facility Placement camera mode, you can view the planet’s surface without the need to also pilot your ship. This camera mode allows you to select the location you want to place your facility; locations must be selected in proximity to your ship. It is possible to change the facility you wish to construct from this view. Additional facilities must be placed more than 200km away from any existing construction sites and completed facilities.  A visualization of the selected facility will show you where it will be placed, this can be moved around and rotated to get the exact orientation you want.

Initially the selected location will be the location of the construction site. On completion it will be replaced by the final facility, in both cases terrain will be altered to accommodate the new buildings. Commanders must leave the vicinity of the construction site for it to be deployed and for the construction itself to be finalised.
systemcolonisation_systemcolonisationcon:
The 34th century has seen humanity stagnate in its expansion efforts. With the close of the 2nd Thargoid War Humanity finds itself in urgent need of new territory.

Factions throughout human space are looking for Commanders to help drive System Colonisation ventures. Commanders will be given the opportunity to guide the development of these new territories, select the major facilities and establish system economies.

All System Colonisation efforts start from a System Colonisation Contact, these can be found in most ports and allow commanders to expand to an uninhabited system within range. System Contacts give information about ongoing claims, such as the stage of the claim and how to proceed.

Once a system is selected the Primary Port can be configured. Each Port type provides different benefits to the system and requires varying amounts of commodities to be delivered to complete.

Upon selection a System Colonisation Beacon will be assigned, and must be deployed via the System Colonisation Suite internal module to the designated location around the primary star.

Delivery must be completed within 24 hours of making the claim or it will be revoked. No refund will be offered but commanders may attempt the claim again or attempt to claim a different system. Should a claim fail to complete on the same system for a second time that system will not be claimable by the same commander for a number of days.

This map mode allows commanders to see available locations within range for System Colonisation. The mode will show which systems can and cannot be expanded into and why.

If System data is available, it will highlight the number of orbital and planetary construction sites. System data is not required to make a claim.

Data can be acquired by travelling to the system and using the FSS, see Pilot's handbook for more information on using the FSS.

Claimable systems must be uninhabited and within range of the system to be expanded from.

After selecting Begin Claim the Primary Port must be configured.

The Primary Port selection screen will provide information about resource costs and system effects.

Upon selection a System Colonisation Beacon will be assigned, and must be deployed via the System Colonisation Suite internal module to the designated location around the primary star. After deployment a System Colonisation Ship will jump to the Primary Port's construction location allowing for the delivery of resources to complete construction. Resources for the primary star port include additional commodities needed to support the infrastructure for future system development.

Should the Primary Port construction fail to be completed within the designated time the System Colonisation effort will fail and all commodities delivered up to that point will be lost.
systemcolonisation_systemcolonisationsys: The system map highlights active construction projects in the system, showing where commanders can deliver resources to help complete facilities. These construction sites will pay above the galactic average for delivered resources and when completed will provide benefits for the system.

Using the Architect view mode in the system map shows the locations where facilities can be placed and in progress construction projects. Information about ongoing projects, including the goods required to complete them, is also found here.

The system architect can use this view mode to select a construction site and choose a facility to build. Only a certain number of construction projects can be active at one time in a system, as facilities are completed this number increases up to a maximum.

The location of facilities placed in orbit and the type of facility to be created is performed directly in the architect view. The availability of sites on planetary bodies is shown in the architect view but to place the facility the architect must travel to the body and manually select and position the facility using the Colonisation Suite internal module.

Facilities can influence the economy of markets near the local body, these economies are boosted by the population of the system. System statistics such as security can also be affected by facilities. Refer to the System Colonisation article in the Pilot's Handbook for more information on Facilities.

When selecting a site to begin a construction project Architects will need to select a facility type from those available. Once the facility type is selected Architects will then select the specific facility that they wish to build, facilities are arranged in Tiers.

Tier 1 facilities require no prerequisites to select for construction and each produce Tier 2 Construction Points upon completion.

Tier 2 facilities require Tier 2 Construction Points to be built, these points are consumed when the project starts, some also require a specific facility to already exist within the system, upon completion Tier 2 facilities produce Tier 3 Construction Points.

Tier 3 facilities require Tier 3 Construction Points to be built, these are the most impactful facilities that can be built in a system and as such have the largest resource requirements, they represent the height of a systems development.

Tier 2 and 3 port Construction Point costs increase as more are built in a system, this increase starts after the second port has begun construction and continues to increase for every subsequent Tier 2 or 3 construction started.

Markets exist wherever a commander can trade commodities. A market’s strength is determined by a System’s associated Population size, Characteristics and supporting Economies.

Ports include Outposts, Coriolis, Orbis, Ocellus Stations, Asteroid Bases, and Planetary Ports, and offer extensive trading options and can supply a larger volume and variety of commodities if adequately supported.

Supporting facilities are any facilities that supply a Port with a market economy. These can include Settlements, Installations and Hubs. Their primary function is to support commodity trading of the Port’s economy. Ports can also act as Supporting Facilities under certain conditions.

Markets can benefit from multiple economy types simultaneously. The strength of an economy determines the supply of commodities available; the stronger the economy, the more quantity of a given commodity is produced.

Weak Links: Supporting facilities, such as Settlements, create Weak Links to all Ports within the System that are not on the same planetary body, or within the same orbit. These supporting economies provide small boosts to those Ports, affecting all equally.

Strong Links: Supporting facilities that produce an economy will form a strong link with a single Port on or orbiting the same body. Ports on a planetary surface will pass these links to a Port orbiting the same body, whilst retaining the benefits for themselves.

Strong Links follow a priority system where multiple Markets exist.

Ports in the same relative location, whether in orbit or on the surface, will receive priority over the other.

If a Tier 1 Port exists with Strong Links, and a Tier 2 Port is built in the same relative location, then those Strong Links will be redirected to the new Tier 2 market. The Tier 1 market will begin to support this new market.

If a Tier 2 Port exists with Strong Links, and a Tier 1 Port is built in the same relative location, then the Tier 1 will support the Tier 2 without taking its Strong Link.

If two Markets of the same Tier exist in the same relative location, then the first built will retain the Strong Link.

Planetary facilities will pass these links to a major market in orbit following the same prioritisation rules for Tier and build order. These surface markets retain the benefits of their strong links.

Population size associated with a Market within a System affects the availability of commodities and their supply. The higher the Population, the greater the Supply. To achieve significant increases in available Supply requires an exponential increase in Population growth.

A System’s physical characteristics can boost or hinder the type of economy supported by Strong Links. Favourable conditions, such as orbiting an earth-like world, which boosts Agricultural economies, will strengthen the type of economy passed through Strong Links, while unfavourable conditions, such as being on or orbiting an icy body, which reduces agricultural economies, will reduce a Strong Link’s effectiveness (although it retains a higher proportion than a Weak Link).

Facilities which have markets but start with a colony economy will derive their starting economy from the body they are on or orbiting. Some of these characteristics can combine, for example, a Rocky Body with Rings will have both Refinery and Extraction economies.

Refer to the System Colonisation article in the Pilot's Handbook for more information and a full list of System Characteristics.
systemcomms_thargoid_alliance_001: All independent pilots are welcome to make use of the Salote Charm’s rearm, refuel and resupply facilities. Please follow standard docking practices on approach.
systemcomms_thargoid_alliance_002: Alliance Defence Force pilots should switch to secure channel zeta-zero-two and prepare for broadcast.
systemcomms_thargoid_alliance_003: ADF squadrons have been deployed to counter recent Thargoid sector reinforcements. Good luck, everyone.
systemcomms_thargoid_alliance_004: Emergency broadcast to the Salote Charm. Several ADF squadrons have taken heavy casualties. Requesting immediate support.
systemcomms_thargoid_combat_001: Thargoid forces are regrouping. Naval combat ships should return to their designated rally points.
systemcomms_thargoid_combat_002: Attention: Long-range sensors have detected incoming Thargoid reinforcements.
systemcomms_thargoid_combat_003: Approach vector locked. Multiple targets acquired. All ships, you are weapons free.
systemcomms_thargoid_combat_004: Thargoid scouts are active in this system. These vessels should be considered extremely hostile.
systemcomms_thargoid_combat_005: Medusa and Hydra variant Interceptors have been sighted in this system. These should not be engaged by lone pilots. Seek teammate support wherever possible.
systemcomms_thargoid_combat_006: All anti-xeno vessels should outfit their ships with shutdown field neutralisers where possible.
systemcomms_thargoid_combat_007: Proximity to Thargoid vessels is causing interference on lower-band frequencies. Comms officers, switch to delta-plus bands.
systemcomms_thargoid_combat_008: Be advised that anti-xeno conflict zones are active in this system. Thargoid forces are inflicting heavy losses.
systemcomms_thargoid_combat_009: We’re taking heavy damage! All personnel to escape pods! Eject! Eject!
systemcomms_thargoid_combat_010: Attention: The Thargoid presence in the system is increasing. All combat-capable ships should engage in anti-xeno operations as soon as possible.
systemcomms_thargoid_empire_001: All pilots loyal to the Emperor are advised to familiarise themselves with the latest Imperial Navy security protocols.
systemcomms_thargoid_empire_002: This is the Imperial flagship. Naval military vessels must submit docking codes via standard channels before approaching.
systemcomms_thargoid_empire_003: Thargoid vessels identified. Approach at full speed and focus fire with squadron ships. Long live the Emperor!
systemcomms_thargoid_empire_004: Imperial squadron requesting urgent assistance. The number of Thargoids in our sector is overwhelming. We need auxiliaries to cover our retreat.”
systemcomms_thargoid_federation_001: New Federal Navy orders are being broadcast on secure channels. Stand by for further instructions.
systemcomms_thargoid_federation_002: Federal auxiliaries: be advised that the no-fly zone around Federal capital ships is still in effect.
systemcomms_thargoid_federation_003: Federal Navy strike force deployed, weapons hot. Let’s roast some Thargs!
systemcomms_thargoid_federation_004: Federal Command, are you receiving? There were too many of them. Damn it, there’s Thargoids everywhere. We need help!
systemcomms_thargoid_generic_001: Access corridor remains secure. Primary supply route is operational.
systemcomms_thargoid_generic_002: Human reinforcements have arrived. Conflict zones are being assigned.
systemcomms_thargoid_generic_003: Reminder that all Thargoid engagements must be reported through the proper channels.
systemcomms_thargoid_generic_004: Commanders are to be treated as autonomous agents. Do not assign fleet duties to them.
systemcomms_thargoid_generic_005: Taskforce VIP shuttle now on final approach. Return to base, escort wing.
systemcomms_thargoid_generic_006: Sector One squadron returning to dock. Have those repair crews ready.
systemcomms_thargoid_generic_007: Sector Two squadron returning to dock. Several Thargoid kills confirmed.
systemcomms_thargoid_generic_008: Sector Three squadron returning to dock. We have wounded inbound.
systemcomms_thargoid_generic_009: Sector Four squadron returning to dock. It’s been a long shift.
systemcomms_thargoid_generic_010: Sector Five squadron returning to dock. The Thargoids aren’t backing down from anything.
systemcomms_thargoid_generic_011: Sector Six squadron returning to dock. Looking forward to some sleep.
systemcomms_thargoid_generic_012: Sector Seven squadron returning to dock. It’s a nightmare out here.
systemcomms_thargoid_generic_013: Sector Eight squadron returning to dock. We’re holding steady for now.
systemcomms_thargoid_generic_014: Sector Nine squadron returning to dock. They just keep coming.
systemcomms_thargoid_generic_015: Attention: Fleet manoeuvres are ongoing in this system. Be alert for capital class signatures in your vicinity.
systemcomms_thargoid_generic_016: Independent fleet carriers are not permitted to enter this system. This embargo will remain until further notice.
systemcomms_thargoid_generic_017: Comms channels in the epsilon-one-six, epsilon-one-seven and kappa-zero-four bands are restricted for priority use.
systemcomms_thargoid_generic_018: All licensed journalists must register with the naval press officer assigned to their organisation.
systemcomms_thargoid_generic_019: The safety of independent pilots cannot be guaranteed in this system. Extreme caution is advised.
systemcomms_thargoid_generic_020: Squadron shift rotation has begun. Active pilots, dock and report for debriefing. New pilots to your ships and prepare for launch.
systemcomms_thargoid_generic_021: Attention: Thargoid hyperdictions have been reported when entering or exiting this system.
systemcomms_thargoid_salvation_001: This is the Bright Sentinel. We are continuing to hold position above primary site. All systems green.
systemcomms_thargoid_salvation_002: Modified gauss cannons, plasma chargers and shard cannons are available for purchase from the technology broker aboard the Bright Sentinel megaship.
systemcomms_thargoid_salvation_003: Commodore Halloran has requested that fleet status updates are submitted every three hours. Reports of immediate importance should be made on the appropriate channel.
systemcomms_thargoid_salvation_004: Seconded naval crews from Allied vessels, check in with the Musashi for assignment.
systemcomms_thargoid_salvation_005: Seconded naval crews from Federal vessels, contact the Heart of Taurus for assignment.
systemcomms_thargoid_salvation_006: Seconded naval crews from Imperial vessels, report to the Glorious Prospect for assignment.
systemdescription_alliance_anarchy:
Anarchy

A group that refuses to recognise the legal construct as defined by the Alliance of Independent Systems. Often, but not always, these groups act as a front for some form of organised criminal syndicate.
systemdescription_alliance_communism:
Communist

A group that promotes the idea that all members are created equal, even though clearly some members are more equal than others.
systemdescription_alliance_confederacy:
Confederacy

An organisation that engages in activities designed to strengthen ties with other independent groups in order to increase the influence of the Alliance of Independent Systems.
systemdescription_alliance_cooperative:
Cooperative

A faction that actively engages in alliances with a wide variety of other organisations in order to incubate and influence local enterprise.
systemdescription_alliance_corporate:
Corporate

An interstellar business organisation that has incorporated in accordance with the terms laid out by the Alliance of Independent Systems.
systemdescription_alliance_democracy:
Democracy

A faction that is known for actively following the ideal that all members should be able to influence how their organisation operates.
systemdescription_alliance_dictatorship:
Dictatorship

A faction that employs a strict top-down management style in order to maintain a tight hold over its assets.
systemdescription_alliance_feudal:
Feudal

A group that leverages land based assets and corporate investments to exert control over the systems that fall within their reach.
systemdescription_alliance_patronage:
Patronage

A group that is known for leveraging its economic resources in order to influence the actions of others.
systemdescription_alliance_prison:
Detention Centre

An organisation commissioned by Alliance authorities to oversee the security and administration of a penal ship.
systemdescription_alliance_theocracy:
Theocracy

An organisation that has been recognised as an official religion by the Alliance of Independent Systems.
systemdescription_alliance_undefined:
Unknown

Your Universal Cartographic Module appears to have malfunctioned. Please alert Technical Support as soon as possible.
systemdescription_empire_anarchy:
Anarchy

An organisation that is engaged in activity that goes against the Imperial status quo. Members openly defy Imperial law, although not all known associates are involved in criminal activity.
systemdescription_empire_colony:
Colony

As one of the first groups to establish an Imperial presence in the sector, this faction is well respected for the hardships that they were able to overcome during the struggle to establish civilisation in an untouched system.
systemdescription_empire_confederacy:
Confederacy

A faction which adheres to a rare confederacy-style government under Imperial influence.
systemdescription_empire_cooperative:
Cooperative

A faction that works toward the common goals of its members. It is considered unusual in Imperial space, but not unknown.
systemdescription_empire_corporate:
Corporate

An organisation that has been granted the rights of an Imperial Corporation. They are likely to have business interests that extend beyond a single station or planet.
systemdescription_empire_democracy:
Democracy

As staunch believers in representative democracy, this faction often finds itself at odds with more traditional Imperial factions. Despite frequent clashes with members of the old guard, this group continues to try and implement various systems for devolving social responsibility to duly appointed members of the community without openly going against the established status quo.
systemdescription_empire_dictatorship:
Dictatorship

A faction that has been granted absolute power over a specific area of influence by decree of the Imperial Senate.
systemdescription_empire_feudal:
Feudal

A faction which actively attempts to ensure that Imperial Corporations are ceded more control over the day to day running of Imperial worlds.
systemdescription_empire_imperial:
Imperial

True traditionalists in every sense of the word, this faction has always unquestioningly supported the Duval line. Well respected amongst members of the old guard, their rise to power has been a textbook example of how to succeed in Imperial Society.
systemdescription_empire_none:
None

A traditional Imperial organisation, this faction has been quietly working away at expanding their influence throughout the system.
systemdescription_empire_patronage:
Patronage

A group that is actively engaged in the governance of local Imperial clients. Representatives of this group should be treated with the respect that befits the rank of the organisation's master.
systemdescription_empire_prison:
Detention Centre

An organisation commissioned to ensure that the Emperor's justice is meted out onboard an officially sanctioned Imperial megaship.
systemdescription_empire_prisoncolony:
Prison Colony

An organisation commissioned to ensure that the Emperor's justice is meted out at an officially sanctioned Imperial penal facility.
systemdescription_empire_theocracy:
Theocracy

A faction that has been recognised as a Theocracy by decree of the Imperial Senate.
systemdescription_empire_undefined:
Unknown

Your Universal Cartographic Module appears to have malfunctioned. Please alert Technical Support as soon as possible.
systemdescription_federation_anarchy:
Anarchy

A faction that engages in activity that quite often places them at odds with members of Federation law enforcement agencies.
systemdescription_federation_colony:
Colony

Experienced in the realm of high powered corporate plays, this faction has formed a unified confederation with many other like minded organisations, which has provided them with a significant advantage over their competitors in terms of both resources and regional clout.
systemdescription_federation_confederacy:
Confederacy

A faction that, in conjunction with a number of similarly aligned organisations, promotes their agenda by manipulating the application of capital being channelled to local business and social ventures.
systemdescription_federation_corporate:
Corporate

A business orientated organisation that has been incorporated as per the Federation Charter of Free Commerce. Members of this faction are representatives of a Corporate Entity and are seen as such in the eyes of the law.
systemdescription_federation_democracy:
Democracy

Members of this group are actively engaged in the promotion of a democratically approved political agenda.
systemdescription_federation_dictatorshi:
Dictatorship

A faction that has managed to become a household name in their local sector, allowing them to drive off all major rivals and establish complete dominance over their chosen sphere of influence.
systemdescription_federation_none:
None

When Federation sociologists talk about the normal organisational behavioural baseline, they're really talking about factions just like this one. Members of this faction engage in the typical capitalistic behaviour displayed by people raised on Federation controlled worlds, have an average number of children and generally do everything they can to ape the trends set in Sol.
systemdescription_federation_prison:
Detention Centre

A faction specially commissioned by the Federation to detain and rehabilitate prisoners aboard a sanctioned capital ship.
systemdescription_federation_theocracy:
Theocracy

A faction that has been recognised as a Religious Organisation under Federation law.
systemdescription_federation_undefined:
Unknown

Your Universal Cartographic Module appears to have malfunctioned. Please alert Technical Support as soon as possible.
systemdescription_independent_anarchy:
Anarchy

This group is known to have a disdain for any laws outside of those it has laid down to govern its members' behaviour.
systemdescription_independent_communism:
Communist

A faction that believes all assets should be communally owned and that resources should be fairly divided amongst all members by judging each individual's true needs.
systemdescription_independent_confederac:
Confederacy

An organisation that engages in activities designed to strengthen ties with other independent groups in order to maintain a certain level of independence from the three great powers.
systemdescription_independent_cooperativ:
Cooperative

An organisation that specialises in promoting synergy between disparate groups in order to incubate social and commercial growth.
systemdescription_independent_corporate:
Corporate

An Independent business organisation that has incorporated its respective home government.
systemdescription_independent_democracy:
Democracy

A faction that actively follows the ideal that all members should be able to influence how their organisation operates.
systemdescription_independent_dictatorsh:
Dictatorship

An organisation that engages in authoritarian activities in order to establish and maintain absolute control over its chosen field of interest.
systemdescription_independent_feudal:
Feudal

A faction which has built up a significant sphere of influence in the sector through a series of investments and acquisitions. As such they are able to use their portfolio of assets as leverage against local leaders.
systemdescription_independent_megaconstr:
Megaconstruction

Megaconstruction factions are primarily focused on the manufacture, construction and trade of colossal technical marvels such as starports, fleet carriers and capital ships. Market rules, employment and the economic focus of systems controlled by this faction work to facilitate these enormous construction projects.
systemdescription_independent_patronage:
Patronage

A group that invests significant resources into Independent projects in order to incubate the growth of civilisation in the supposedly untamed areas of space.
systemdescription_independent_prison:
Detention Centre

An organisation commissioned to detain prisoners aboard a specially designed capital ship.
systemdescription_independent_prisoncolo:
Prison Colony

An organisation that has been formed to maintain control over a specific independent penal colony. Often such groups have sponsors that are decidedly not independent in nature.
systemdescription_independent_theocracy:
Theocracy

An Independent group that claims to be religious in nature. It is possible that this group may not be an officially sanctioned religion.
systemdescription_independent_undefined:
Unknown

Colony

A faction simulating unlawful operations, used as antagonists within the Pilots' Federation District.
systemdescription_pilotsfederation_coope:
Cooperative

A faction forming one side of a wargame scenario within the Pilots' Federation District.
systemdescription_pilotsfederation_corpo:
Corporate

An organisation responsible for the management and key functions of the Pilots' Federation District.
systemdescription_pilotsfederation_democ:
Democracy

A faction that is known for actively following the ideal that all members should be able to influence how their organisation operates.
systemdescription_pilotsfederation_patro:
Patronage

A faction forming one side of a wargame scenario within the Pilots' Federation District.

taaffeite_info_short: Produced by: Planetary Mining Consumed by: Service (Orbital) and Tourist Taaffeite, BeMgAl4O8.
tacticaldata_info: Encrypted documents detailing logistics, armament control points and infrastructure. Possession of such documents is illegal, due to their sensitive nature. There is a limited black market demand for these items as their military grade encryption makes them almost impossible to crack.
tacticaldata_info_short: Encrypted documents detailing logistics, armament control points and infrastructure. Possession of such documents is illegal.
tacticalplans_info: An outline for a military or security operation intended to achieve a stated objective.
tacticalplans_longinfo: An outline for a military or security operation intended to achieve a stated objective.
tacticalsuit_class1_info: Manticore's first entry into the tactical suit market, the Dominator enhances a user’s combat effectiveness with superior weapon capacity and increased shield performance at the expense of some utility options.

An infusion of native herbs renowned for its sedative effects.

This rare good is legal in all markets.
tanmarktranquiltea_info_short: An infusion of native herbs renowned for its sedative effects.
tantalum_info:
Produced by: Refinery
Consumed by: High Tech and Industrial

Tantalum, Ta, atomic number 73. Melting point 3290K. Used to make capacitors and high melting point alloys in reactors, and by the military for specialist alloys used in weapons for armour penetration.
tantalum_info_short: Produced by: Refinery Consumed by: High Tech and Industrial Tantalum, Ta, atomic number 73. Melting point 3290K.
tarachtorspice_info:
Made from crushed beetles, this mild euphoric drug has a number of side effects including turning the whites of addicts' eyes a subtle shade of green. Widely illegal, but favoured in many anarchic systems where the green eyes are seen as a badge of an extreme lifestyle.

This rare good is legal in all Imperial markets except Prison Colony; Allied Feudal and Theocracy markets; and Independent Dictatorship markets.

Please note that if a market’s controlling faction changes, some formerly legal rare goods may become illegal. Should this occur the rare good will be unavailable for sale or purchase at that market for the duration of the prohibiting faction’s tenure.
tarachtorspice_info_short: Made from crushed beetles, this mild euphoric drug has a number of side effects including turning the whites of addicts' eyes a subtle shade of green.

These hand crafted wind chimes are specially tuned to stimulate a variety of spiritual and physical responses. They are known for helping people find inner peace, or direction, and are guaranteed to keep your chakras aligned.

This rare good is legal in all markets.
taurichimes_info_short: These hand crafted wind chimes are specially tuned to stimulate a variety of spiritual and physical responses.
taxrecords_info: Details of an organisation's tax payments and related documentation.
taxrecords_longinfo: Details of an organisation's tax payments and related documentation.
tdtype_asteroidcluster_text: An asteroid cluster. These hold potential rewards for miners. Check the system map to review the cluster's type. To find out more about mining check the Pilot's Handbook link below.
tdtype_belt_text: An asteroid belt. These hold potential rewards for miners. Check the system map to review the belt's type. To find out more about mining check the Pilot's Handbook link below.
tdtype_colonisationmegaship_text: System colonisation ships facilitate the initial efforts in colonising a system. Commodities required for the efforts' completion can be sold here.
tdtype_constructiondepot_text: A construction depot that will purchase construction commodities to build a new facility.
tdtype_outpost_sar_text: An outpost. These have less docking capacity than starports, with no large landing pads. Currently recovering from an attack by xeno forces.
tdtype_outpost_text: An outpost. These have less docking capacity than starports, with no large landing pads. They also offer fewer station services. Check the system map to confirm which services are provided by this particular outpost.
tdtype_planetengineer_text: A special port owned by an Engineer. Engineers are unique individuals with a talent for making adjustments to ship modules. Unlocking their services provides access to certain modifications.
tdtype_planetlandable_miner_text: A planetary body with one or more rings which can be mined for resources. Ships fitted with a planetary approach suite can also explore its surface. To learn more about exploration or mining check the Pilot's Handbook links below.
tdtype_planetlandable_text: A planetary body. Ships fitted with a planetary approach suite can explore its surface. To learn more about exploration check the Pilot's Handbook link below.
tdtype_planetother_miner_text: A planetary body with one or more rings which can be mined for resources. Explorers can map this body using the Detailed Surface Scanner. To learn more about exploration or mining check the Pilot's Handbook links below.
tdtype_planetother_text: A planetary body. Explorers can map this body using the Detailed Surface Scanner. To find out more about exploration check the Pilot's Handbook link below.
tdtype_planetpoi_text: A planetary point of interest. These indicate locations of note on the surface of a planetary body. They can be of interest to a variety of pilots and sometimes offer resources, credits or discoveries.
tdtype_planetpoiartificialstructure_text: A building or other structure has been detected here, but the location has not been registered as a settlement or expedition.
tdtype_planetpoicrashsite_text: The wreckage composition and surface disturbance patterns found here are consistent with a crashed spacecraft.
tdtype_planetpoidistressbeacon_text: A distress beacon is active at this location. The status of the individual(s) in need of assistance is unknown.
tdtype_planetpoiimpactsite_text: The location of a surface impact involving a piece of technology such as a human satellite.
tdtype_planetpoiirregularmarkers_text: Scan results at this location show surface disturbances consistent with human activity. The purpose of this activity is unconfirmed.
tdtype_planetpoiminorwreckage_text: Metallic debris and other objects at this location suggest small-scale wreckage.
tdtype_planetpoinonhumansignature_text: A signal commonly associated with the presence of a nonhuman object. Caution is advised
tdtype_planetpoipowersource_text: Signs of at least one power source in the area, indicating technological activity.
tdtype_planetpoisurfaceexcavation_text: Powerful resource extraction machines are in operation here, indicative of a mining operation.
tdtype_planetport_text: A planetary port. Offers safe harbour and a series of services to pilots granted docking access. Check the system map to confirm which services are provided by this particular starport.
tdtype_planetsettlement_text: A planetary settlement. These settlements typically serve a specific economic or corporate purpose and are owned by a local faction. Small-scale cargo trades can be completed here at competitive market prices. To find out more about trading check the Pilot's Handbook link below.
tdtype_poicodex_text: Notable Stellar Phenomena. Locations of interest to explorers, potentially containing entities which can be scanned and logged. To find out more about exploration check the Pilot's Handbook link below.
tdtype_poicombat_ax_text: An anti-xeno conflict zone. These are battles between human and xeno forces. Of particular interest to xeno hunters, these zones are highly dangerous yet rewarding for survivors. To find out more about xeno hunting check the Pilot's Handbook link below.
tdtype_poicombat_pp_text: A conflict zone. Scans indicate that supporters of two Powers are engaged in active warfare. The intensity of the zone denotes how many ships are present. To find out more about Powerplay check the Pilot's Handbook link below.
tdtype_poicombat_text: A conflict zone. These are battles between two factions engaged in active warfare. Attractive to mercenaries looking for work, the intensity of the zone denotes how many ships are present. To find out more about mercenary work check the Pilot's Handbook link below.
tdtype_poigeneric_text: A point of interest. They can be of interest to a variety of pilots and sometimes offer resources, credits or threats.
tdtype_poiinstallation_text: A faction-owned installation. Structures of vital importance to local factions which can be targeted by opposition forces, making them a good place to find mercenary work. To find out more about mercenary work check the Pilot's Handbook link below.
tdtype_poimegaship_ax_text: A megaship. Huge ships that travel between local systems. This megaship has been involved in an altercation with xeno forces. To find out more about xeno hunting check the Pilot's Handbook link below.
tdtype_poimegaship_sar_text: A megaship. Huge ships that travel between local systems. This megaship has been involved in an altercation with hostile forces.
tdtype_poimegaship_text: A megaship. Huge ships that travel between local systems. Due to their importance to the local economy they are sometimes targeted by opposition forces; mercenaries can find work in the engagements that occur. To find out more about mercenary work check the Pilot's Handbook link below.
tdtype_poinavbeacon_colonisation_text: Provides system information to pilots when scanned. These beacons act as Navigation Beacons for a system while a colonisation effort is ongoing and will deploy fully if the effort is successful.
tdtype_poinavbeacon_colonisationdeployme: Deployment site for a system colonisation beacon. Commanders deploy a colonisation beacon here to begin system colonisation efforts. Once the system colonisation effort is complete these sites become the location of the system's Nav Beacon.
tdtype_poinavbeacon_text: Provides system information to pilots when scanned. As such they are natural gathering points, and commonly visited by both pirates and bounty hunters. To find out more about these professions check the Pilot's Handbook links below.
tdtype_poiresourceextractionsite_text: A resource extraction site. Popular mining spots due to the high yield of resources available. The potential for valuable cargo attracts pirates to these areas, which in turn draws in bounty hunters. To find out more about these professions check the Pilot's Handbook links below.
tdtype_poitouristbeacon_text: A tourist beacon. These are special locations that typically hold historical significance, and are often sought out by explorers. To find out more about exploration check the Pilot's Handbook link below.
tdtype_poiuss_axships_text: Indicates the presence of human AX ships, usually either patrolling or preparing for deployment.
tdtype_poiuss_axweaponsfire_text: Scanners have detected recent AX weapons fire at this location. Caution is advised - xeno ship activity is expected.
tdtype_poiuss_capitaldistress_text: A capital class distress signal was activated here. Scanners indicate a significant weapons fire exchange occurred recently.
tdtype_poiuss_ceremonialcomms_text: Indicates a ceremony, most commonly related to weddings or funerals, is occurring here.
tdtype_poiuss_combataftermath_text: Signifies recent combat. There is the potential for debris to be found here.
tdtype_poiuss_convoydispersalpattern_tex: This signal indicates a transport convoy has been detected here, likely with an armed escort.
tdtype_poiuss_degradedemissions_text: These signal sources often contain debris, abandoned cargo or other salvage.
tdtype_poiuss_distresscall_text: This signal represents an urgent call for assistance.
tdtype_poiuss_encodedemissions_text: Indicates the presence of a beacon signal, or potentially recent debris.
tdtype_poiuss_highgradeemissions_text: Often indicates debris of unusually high quality objects.
tdtype_poiuss_missiontarget_text: This signal is related to an active mission assignment.
tdtype_poiuss_nonhumansignalsource_text: Indicates the presence of xeno ships. Caution is advised.
tdtype_poiuss_powerconvoy_text: This signal indicates a transport convoy pledged to a Power has been detected here.
tdtype_poiuss_poweremissions_text: Indicates the presence of a beacon signal, or potentially recent debris. The signal carries a Power allegiance marker.
tdtype_poiuss_powerplayconvoydistresssig: A convoy pledged to a Power has made an urgent call for assistance from this location.
tdtype_poiuss_powerweaponsfire_text: Scanners have detected recent weapons discharge at this location. Telemetry suggests Power-aligned vessels were responsible.
tdtype_poiuss_refugee_text: This signal indicates a passenger convoy has been detected here. It is likely to be transporting refugees from the system.
tdtype_poiuss_roguesignalsource_sc_text: A nonhuman signal source of a previously unclassified scale. Fluctuating energy readings have been detected. Extreme caution is advised.
tdtype_poiuss_roguesignalsource_text: A Thargoid Titan in a vast caustic Maelstrom. Extreme caution advised.
tdtype_poiuss_salvagehaulagewreckage_tex: Signifies recent combat. There is the potential for debris to be found here.
tdtype_poiuss_text: An unidentified signal source. These represent various occurrences that offer a number of potential activities. Scanning these will provide additional information on the signal type.
tdtype_poiuss_tradingbeacon_text: Indicates the presence of a trader looking to make transactions.
tdtype_poiuss_weaponsfire_text: Scanners have detected recent weapons discharge at this location.
tdtype_smallbody_miner_text: A planetary body with one or more rings which can be mined for resources. Explorers can map this body using the Detailed Surface Scanner. To learn more about exploration or mining check the Pilot's Handbook links below.
tdtype_smallbody_text: A planetary body. Explorers can map this using the Detailed Surface Scanner. To find out more about exploration check the Pilot's Handbook link below.
tdtype_star_text: A star. Most commonly a massive ball of burning plasma held together by gravitational forces. This category also includes stellar remnants, such as neutron stars and black holes. The following star types are compatible with a fuel scoop: O,B,A,F,G,K,M.
tdtype_stationasteroidbase_sar_text: A starport built within an excavated asteroid. Currently recovering from an attack by xeno forces.
tdtype_stationasteroidbase_text: A starport built within an excavated asteroid. Offers a number of station services granted docking access. Check the system map to confirm which services are provided by this particular starport.

tdtype_stationbernalsphere_text: A starport. Offers safe harbour and a series of services to pilots granted docking access. Check the system map to confirm which services are provided by this particular starport.

tdtype_stationcoriolis_text: An iconic starport. Offers safe harbour and a series of services to pilots granted docking access. Check the system map to confirm which services are provided by this particular starport.
tdtype_stationfleetcarrier_dc_text: A decommissioned fleet carrier. This carrier no longer provides docking access.
tdtype_stationfleetcarrier_text: A fleet carrier. Check the system map to confirm which services are provided by this particular carrier.
tdtype_stationmegaship_sar_text: A dockable megaship. These huge ships are utilised as mobile ports. Currently recovering from an attack by xeno forces.
tdtype_stationmegaship_text: A dockable megaship. These huge ships are utilised as mobile ports. Offers a number of station services to pilots granted docking access. Check your system map to identify the services offered by this particular megaship.
tdtype_stationoneillcylinder_sar_text: A starport. Currently recovering from an attack by xeno forces.
tdtype_stationoneillcylinder_text: A starport. Offers safe harbour and a series of services to pilots granted docking access. Check the system map to confirm which services are provided by this particular starport.

tdtype_stationoneillorbis_text: A starport. Offers safe harbour and a series of services to pilots granted docking access. Check the system map to confirm which services are provided by this particular starport.
tdtype_system_text: A nearby star system. Check the galaxy map to review this system's details.

Technetium, Tc, atomic number 43. Melting point 2430K. Technetium in various isotope forms is used in medical imaging technology. It is also used as a catalyst. Its stable beta decay makes it suitable for calibration and radioactive testing.
technetium_info_short: Collected on planet surfaces. Technetium, Tc, atomic number 43. Melting point 2430K.

telemetrysuite_info_short: Used by factions as a reward for mission contracts. Consumed by: High Tech and Military Telemetry suites provide access to information flows relating to specific components within a system.
tellurium_info:

Tellurium, Te, atomic number 52. Melting point 722K. Tellurium is used in alloys as well as semiconductors and other electronic applications.
tellurium_info_short: Collected on planet surfaces. Tellurium, Te, atomic number 52. Melting point 722K.
temperedalloys_info:

Tempered alloys are refined alloys used for their enhanced strength and impact resistance.

terrainenrichmentsystems_info:
Produced by: High Tech
Consumed by: Terraforming and Agricultural

A soup of carefully designed archaebacteria, lichens, and micro-fauna and their dispersal equipment. Used in terraforming or enriching agricultural land.
terrainenrichmentsystems_info_short: Produced by: High Tech Consumed by: Terraforming and Agricultural A soup of carefully designed archaebacteria, lichens, and micro-fauna and their dispersal equipment.
terramaterbloodbores_info:
A potent physical stimulant produced using extracts of a native Terra Mater carnivorous plant. When added to the user's circulatory system, it allows a human to exert themselves far beyond their normal capabilities. The side effects are often permanent with increased likelihood of haemorrhaging and weight loss.

This rare good is legal in all Dictatorship markets as well as Imperial Confederacy and Independent Cooperative markets.

Please note that if a market’s controlling faction changes, some formerly legal rare goods may become illegal. Should this occur the rare good will be unavailable for sale or purchase at that market for the duration of the prohibiting faction’s tenure.
terramaterbloodbores_info_short: A potent physical stimulant produced using extracts of a native Terra Mater carnivorous plant.

terrorattack_02: Everything they've built shall be laid to waste!
terrorattack_03: From the ashes we will build this world anew!
terrorattack_04: To move forward, we must turn our back on the past...
terrorattack_06: We must reset the scales of this corrupt system!
terrorattack_07: To build a new world, we must destroy the old one.
terrorattack_08: We're done playing their game, we're knocking all of their pieces from the board!
terrorattack_09: History will mark this as the beginning of a new era.
terrorattack_10: Make way for a new order!
terroristleader_arrival01: Free yourselves from the chains of corporate servitude!
terroristleader_arrival03: Join me brothers and sisters, together we can change the universe!
terroristleader_niggledbynewship01: Another agent of oppression! Where do they get you people from...
terroristleader_onauthoritydetection01: I have seen what power does, and I have seen what power costs. The one is never equal to the other.
terroristleader_onauthoritydetection03: Oh good... more fuel for my fire!
terroristleader_onauthoritydetection05: Agents of tyranny, prepare to meet your final fate!
terroristleader_ondeclarepiracyattack01: This is what you get for being part of the status quo!

tgsite_clue001_001_body: ...Joci...under attack...not responding to hails...distress call was a trap...damn it...I can't...fell for it...guys are some military out...someone doesn't want the...found...message...it's in HIP 17694...
tgsite_clue001_002_body: ...know if I'm getting through...comms are being jammed...claim is on Planet B 7 f...trying to lose them...get closer to the planet surface, I might be able...
tgsite_clue002_001_body:
This signal is incredible. The behaviour is almost organic.

We can't isolate it, every time we think it's gone it shifts to a new frequency band.

If I didn't know better I'd say it's...alive, maybe some military experiment. But it's illegal to hack the public comms network.

I've never seen anything like it. I've got to get to the bottom of this.
tgsite_clue002_002_body:
It's not military, at least not our military.

This code might not even be human.

We managed to track it to the point of origin, seems to be coming from a system here in the Pleiades sector.

This is too big for us now, I've put in a report to head office, with luck they'll let us take some credit for the discovery. I mean finding alien life has become a big thing lately, there's got to be some kind of payout for information like this.
tgsite_clue002_003_body:
They arrived this morning, apparently on company orders to shut us down. They said they were going to make the station fully automated.

This makes no sense. We've just stumbled upon the discovery of a lifetime and now they want to automate this place!?

Oh, and another thing. They're armed! Well, some of them at least. They say that head office has sent them here for our protection. Something's not right here. Every time we ask for details we get the brush off, or just some more vague reasons for them being here.

They've taken copies of all our research and wiped any data concerning the signal from our systems. They're wiping everything!
tgsite_clue002_004_body:
These guys didn't come from head office. I overheard a conversation between the operation lead and his superiors. They're some kind of private military outfit. I've got to contact someone, ask for help.

I managed to get these logs and some of our data onto a data core. If anything happens to us maybe someone will find it and get the truth out.

I've encoded the location data into one of the beacons outside. Should just seem like a stream of numbers if they don't look too closely. I've rigged it to go off at 10 minutes past the hour.

We've all been called to the docking bay. They say we're being sent home, but I don't believe them for a second. Everyone is really scared.
tgsite_clue003_001_body:
Some of the crew are not happy we're working for the Feds, but this deal is too good to pass up.

With all the expansion going on in this region, we need to make sure we're in at the beginning to secure the contracts we need.

This Survey mission is just that. A simple rock hop, scanning for minerals.
tgsite_clue003_002_body:
We arrived in orbit around planet A 7 A a day ago, it's been all hands on deck to make sure all the equipment is ready for launch down to surface.

While the majority of our planet scans just showed the usual mineral data, there is one area on this rock that is giving off some unusual readings.

If there is any profit to be made from this trip, I'll bet my ship it's going to be found there.
tgsite_clue003_003_body:
We've stumbled onto something big. I don't know what it is, or who built it, but we've definitely hit the mother load.

Aries Dark Region DB-X d1-63 is gonna have our names on it.

First things first, I've got to make sure all this is by the numbers. I don't want this going south because we didn't fill in the correct paperwork.

I'm calling it in.
tgsite_clue003_004_body:
Security vessel, please respond... Hold your fire! This is a registered survey mission, we have all the correct paperwork... Listen to me! You can't just arrest us...we haven't done anything wrong, we have rights.

Repeat we're an unarmed survey team on a registered mission.

We surrender! Please!
tgsite_clue004_001_body:
This is the Survey Vessel Pandora, requesting update to mission parameters

We've detected an unidentified signal on the surface of a nearby planet. Request permission to investigate.

...Mission Critical Update...

Permission granted. Updating registration.
tgsite_clue004_002_body:
We've tracked the signal to planet AB 4a in the Col 285 Sector CV-Y d57 system.

I've put a mission update request in, but I'm not waiting to hear back before we take a look. For all we know, we could be sitting on something special here.

Anyway, by the time we get there, we should have received the relevant permissions. No harm no foul."
tgsite_clue004_003_body:
This is interesting, our long-range probes have pinpointed the source of the signal. It's coming from what we suspect to be a a huge structure.

The permissions have arrived, just one more day and we'll be in orbit and ready to go down.
tgsite_clue004_004_body:
Unidentified ship, this is the Pandora. We are a registered survey vessel on an authorised research mission. Cease fire!

Repeat we are a survey vessel. Halt your attack!

They're not responding, we have to get out of here!

Attention all crew, abandon ship, abandon ship. Proceed to your assigned li..."
tgsite_clue005_001_body: ...Command...Recon 6...Target...being followed...it's catching up me...we can't avoid it ...at Pleiades Sector OS-U c2-7..... I repeat site is awake...Command come in!
tgsite_clue006_001_body:
Command to Recon 6

Come in Recon 6! Please respond!

Sir, we've lost contact with one of our recon ships. Last known location HIP 17746.

Final transmission indicated an encounter of some kind. Recon 6 bugged out to rally point echo, but it looks like they didn't make it.

There's something else. We detected a signal that exceeds our language parameters; It was embedded in 6's last transmission. It's the same signal that we detected in Pleiades Sector AB-W B2-4

Awaiting your orders.
tgsite_clue006_002_body:
Acknowledged Black Flight 12, mission is a go.

Target is Survey Vessel Victoria's Song. Security systems adjusted for your cover. Apprehend if possible for questioning at Overlook, destroy if necessary.

Command out.
tgsite_clue006_003_body:
Affirmative Recon 2 data received

:12 15 3 1 20 5 4:UKHKMWK RFDKLI RMUQCT: RYRSTJ BFN 19026:NILKTS O 1 C:ILS JFKUR 17:IMKD JFKUR 152:NITLRT QTJTJOTQ UR:DTS SBT JTRRLDT MUS:

Head to Overlook and await further orders.
tgsite_clue006_004_body:
Command to Black Flight 22.

Regret to inform that survey ship Pandora suffered catastrophic systems failure. All hands lost. Please acknowledge.

Roger, Command, orders understood, no survivors. On intercept course.

22 out.
tgsite_clue006_005_body:
Communication Officer's Report.

Sir, we've been monitoring the frequencies provided in the data package and it looks like we've found one located in the Merope system.

The signal is slightly different from the others we've identified.

Should I send a recon flight out to investigate?

Awaiting orders.
tgsite_clue006_006_body:
Mission Authorisation report.

A maintenance crew linked to our comms corp. has intercepted a foreign signal inside the civilian comms network they operate.

Primary objective is to shut down the Zeta 12 communication hub being used by the company to decode the signal and gather all associated data.

All signals to and from the station have been rerouted to our network so we can monitor their comms traffic. We'll pose as a team from their head office. Cover is the shut-down of the facility, as part of an automation versus human workforce issue.

This is a code red clean up operation with zero tolerance for this data making it into the public eye. All steps are to be taken to ensure nothing makes it off that station.

Made from the salvaged frame shift drive plates of ships that run out of fuel before reaching the station, this is purely a vanity item commemorating the epic journey. theocraticnapolice_arrivereinforcement02: It's good to see you, brothers.
theocraticnapolice_arrivereinforcement05: There's still time to resolve this peacefully.
theocraticnapolice_attack01: Bad things happen to bad people.
theocraticnapolice_attack02: This is an act of love... just not for you.
theocraticnapolice_attack03: I am merely a conduit of the balance.
theocraticnapolice_attack04: I won't let you prey on innocent people.
theocraticnapolice_attack05: I welcomed you with peace... now I drive you away with violence.
theocraticnapolice_neardeath02: Your actions only weigh down your own progress.
theocraticnapolice_neardeath03: Mercy is good for the soul.
theocraticnapolice_neardeath04: For your own sake, I beg you to turn from your current path...
theocraticnapolice_neardeath05: If this is how it ends... then so be it.
theocraticnapolice_special_scan01: Commencing Kirlianic scan... think positive thoughts, Commander.
theocraticnapolice_special_scan02: Scanning for unsanctioned entropics... we thank you in advance for your cooperation.
theocraticnapolice_thankyoupassedstopand: You seem okay... don't make me regret letting you go.
You're clear. Go in peace, Commander.
Everything's good here. Enjoy your stay.
theocraticpolice_arrivedatinvestigationl: Let the light shine on the unbelievers.
Those who have sinned will now be judged.
Halt and allow His light to cleanse you.
theocraticpolice_destroyillegalgoods01: This unholy contraband will be cleansed from the system.
theocraticpolice_destroyillegalgoods02: Fire will remove this blight from our space.
theocraticpolice_destroyillegalgoods03: Cargo drop contains heretical materials, commencing cleanse.
theocraticpolice_finishedatinvestigation: Order is restored, be on your way.
No more undesirables detected, this area is clean.
All heretics have been removed, be about your business.
theocraticpolice_hostilescan02: You're treading on shaky ground there pilot.
theocraticpolice_hostilescan03: Do not judge lest you be judged, citizen. Stop. Now.
theocraticpolice_hostilescan04: You are not the power here, Commander, cease your scans.
theocraticpolice_needbackup01: I call upon the holy brothers and sisters for assistance.
theocraticpolice_needbackup02: We need more warriors here, this is not enough.
theocraticpolice_needbackup03: Come brothers! We need assistance at once!
theocraticpolice_onhulllowjumpaway01: I shall be saved, but today I shall save myself.
theocraticpolice_onhulllowjumpaway02: Have I been forsaken? I must leave.
theocraticpolice_onhulllowjumpaway03: My life is as precious as the next, for this I will leave.
theocraticpolice_onhulllowjumpaway04: I will not die this day, my holy duty is not over.

thief_chatter_004: I just need to get in range to use my hatch breaker limpets.

Consumed by: Colony, High Tech and Industrial

Tholins are molecules formed when stellar ultraviolet radiation acts upon simple organic compounds like methane.
tholin_info_short: Produced by: Mining Consumed by: Colony, High Tech and Industrial Tholins are molecules formed when stellar ultraviolet radiation acts upon simple organic compounds like methane.
thorium_info:
Produced by: Refinery (Surface) 
Consumed by: High Tech and Military

Thorium, Th, atomic number 90. Melting point 2023K. A radioactive actinide metal. It was once used in ancient fission reactors. It is still used by some medical technology and as a component in advanced ceramics.
thorium_info_short: Produced by: Refinery (Surface) Consumed by: High Tech and Military Thorium, Th, atomic number 90. Melting point 2023K.
thortveitite_info:
Produced by: Surface Mining only
Consumed by: Industrial

Chemical formula (Sc,Y)2Si2O7. Thortveitite is an ultra mineral composed of scandium yttrium silicate. It is primarily used in the production of scandium for ship and vehicle paints.
thortveitite_info_short: Produced by: Surface Mining only Consumed by: Industrial Thortveitite is an ultra mineral composed of scandium yttrium silicate.
throttleaxis_description: Analogue input axis for setting the desired speed (normal flight) or desired thrust (flight assist off).
throttleincrement_description: Set what increments the desired speed is changed by when using $FORWARDKEY; and $BACKWARDKEY; inputs ($ThrottleIncrement_Continuous; will emulate an analogue scale).
throttlerange_description:
Sets how to map the $ThrottleAxis; to speed

$ThrottleMode_fullRange; uses the throttle range to map to the entire speed range (i.e. -100% to +100% speed).

$ThrottleMode_forwardOnly; uses the throttle range to map just the forward speed range (0 to +100% speed).
thrutiscream_info:
A curious mix of fermented Thrutis Giant Rat milk and raw turtle egg yokes produces a potent mix similar to Ancient Advocaat. Each bottle is provided with a ceremonial tasting spoon, to ease the pouring of this viscous but delicious drink.

This rare good is legal in all markets except for Prison Colony markets and Federal and Allied Theocracy markets.

Please note that if a market’s controlling faction changes, some formerly legal rare goods may become illegal. Should this occur the rare good will be unavailable for sale or purchase at that market for the duration of the prohibiting faction’s tenure.
thrutiscream_info_short: A curious mix of fermented Thrutis Giant Rat milk and raw turtle egg yokes produces a potent mix similar to Ancient Advocaat.
tiegfriessynthsilk_info:
Spun from atoms using a number of interconnected particle colliders, this silk is almost indistinguishable from the real thing.

This rare good is legal in all markets.
tiegfriessynthsilk_info_short: Spun from atoms using a number of interconnected particle colliders, this silk is almost indistinguishable from the real thing.
timecapsule_info: These canisters are of historical interest and highly collectable although sometimes the contents have turned to dust with age.
timecapsule_info_short: These canisters are of historical interest and highly collectable although sometimes the contents have turned to dust with age.
tin_info:
Collected on planet surfaces.

Tin, Sn, atomic number 50. Melting point 505K. Tin is one of the first ever metals used in an alloy - notably with copper in prehistory. Its modern day usage is primarily for certain specialised alloys.
tin_info_short: Collected on planet surfaces. Tin, Sn, atomic number 50. Melting point 505K.
tiolcewaste2pasteunits_info:
The original and best, turning all your waste into a nutritious and wholesome paste.

This rare good is legal in all markets.
tiolcewaste2pasteunits_info_short: The original and best, turning all your waste into a nutritious and wholesome paste.
titanium_info:
Produced by: Refinery
Consumed by: Industrial and Military

Titanium, Ti, atomic number 22. Melting point 1941K. A lustrous, silver-grey, low density, high strength metal that is used in a great many industrial applications, including high-spec spacecraft hulls.
titanium_info_short: Produced by: Refinery Consumed by: Industrial and Military Titanium, Ti, atomic number 22. Melting point 1941K.
titaniumplating_info: A strong, low-density metal that is highly resistant to corrosion.
tobacco_info:
Produced by: Agricultural
Consumed by: All
Prohibited in Imperial Prison Colony and Corporate markets; most Federal worlds; and Independent Theocracy and Corporate markets.

A naturally occurring plant the leaves of which, when dried and shredded, are a source of nicotine, a mild and expensive organic narcotic. Usually chewed or smoked, and used in ancient rituals. Illegal in many jurisdictions.
tobacco_info_short: Produced by: Agricultural Consumed by: All Illegal in Prison Colony and Corporate markets; Federal and Independent Theocracy markets; and Federal Democracy markets.
toggleadvancemode_description: Toggle between Zoom and Blur Controls.
togglebuttonupinput_description: Toggle silent running on or off. While enabled, the shield system will automatically shut down and all heat radiators are disabled to ensure the ship has a near-zero signature. A low signature will prevent others from detecting the ship on their sensors. However, with no radiators enabled, heat will build up within the ship and can reach dangerous levels.
togglecargoscoop_buggy_description: Toggles the deployment of the SRV's cargo scoop (if available). Once deployed, any cargo canisters targeted will result in a cargo scoop widget being displayed on the cockpit GUI for aiding scooping.
togglecargoscoop_description: Toggles the deployment of the ship's cargo scoop (if available). Once deployed, any cargo canisters targeted will result in a cargo scoop widget being displayed on the cockpit GUI for aiding scooping.
toggleflightassist_description: When used, will disable the flight assistance system responsible for countering thrust and ensuring the ship travels at the desired speed in the ship's current direction. When disabled, the pilot will need to counter any thrust (both linear and angular) to achieve the desired facing and velocity.
togglefreecam_description: Enter free camera mode from position of current camera view. Restricted movement is also available for internal cameras in this mode.
toggleheatradiators_description: Toggle the heat radiators on or off.
togglelandinggear_description: Toggles the landing gear up for use while docking. While deployed, the flight controls change to that of the landing-specific controls where set. This allows pilots to control their ship differently when docking if desired.
togglemouselookinput_description: Enables the mouse as a headlook device.
togglereversethrottleinput_description: When $ThrottleRange; is set to $ThrottleMode_forwardOnly; this will allow reverse movement when toggled in place of forward movement.
togglerotationlock_description: Toggle between the camera rotating with the ship and rotating independently.
toggleshields_description: Directly toggles the shield module on or off without needing to go through the cockpit interface.
togglethrottlemode_description: Alters the way desired speed is handled. When enabled, the desired speed will always reset to the cruise value (defined below; zero by default) once throttle input is ceased.
togglevanitycamera_buggy_description: Switch between the helm and camera suite while driving a ground based vehicle.
togglevanitycamera_description: Switch between the helm and camera suite.

Tourist Spot 0001

The locals are particularly proud of this beauty spot, and all visitors are encouraged to appreciate it.
tourism_generic_fumerole_description:
Tourist Spot 0001

This is a fine example of a fumerole field.
tourism_generic_geysers_description:
Tourist Spot 0001

People come from light years away to watch these gas vents.

tourism_generic_historicalsite_descripti:

Tourist Spot 0001

Visitors come from all around to see the magnificent lava spots.
tourism_generic_player_description:
Tourist Spot 0001

Tourist Spot 0001

Tourist Spot 0001

tourism_generic_surface_description:

tourism_generic_tubers_description:
Tourist Spot 0001

tourist_0001_description:
Tourist Spot 0001

Commander Ziljan recommends this tourist destination as "A little known gem in an inhabited, ringed, Earth-like world, discovered in the heart of the human bubble, orbiting a blue ringed gas giant."
tourist_0002_description:
Tourist Spot 0002

This system was recommended as a must see destination by Commander Draco25240 for its bountiful collection of stars.
tourist_0003_description:
Tourist Spot 0003

Commander Demilikos suggests this magnificent vista with multiple stars in close vicinity, and just a jump away from Lembava.
tourist_0004_description:
Tourist Spot 0004

The 69 Upsilon Tauri system is a travel destination recommended by Commander Scott because of its array of stunning celestial features. It contains a number of stars, including a close binary of class A and G stars.

Perhaps most spectacular of all is the ninth "moon" of the fifth brown dwarf, which is a water world currently being terraformed. In this vast ocean there is an archipelago of islands.
tourist_0005_description:
Tourist Spot 0005

Achenar is the home system for the Empire, one of the interstellar superpowers. Its administrative capital is on Capitol, and is ruled by the current Emperor, Arissa Lavigny-Duval.
tourist_0006_description:
Tourist Spot 0006

The renowned explorer, Commander Ozric, suggests that within this system you get the most amazing view of virtually all the companion stars stretching out above you.
tourist_0007_description:
Tourist Spot 0007

The Alliance of Independent Systems (usually referred to as just 'Alliance') was founded on Alioth in early 3230. Over the next two decades, more than twenty systems went on to join. Some were independent, others revolted from Imperial and Federal control. For nearly a thousand years, colonial settlements could only choose between Imperial tyranny or Federal interference. Alioth and the Alliance provided a third way, more supportive and less conditional on cultural alignment.
tourist_0008_description:
Tourist Spot 0008

Commander Darius Torkalar recommends this tourist destination for its rare and beautiful ringed binary planets.
tourist_0009_description:
Tourist Spot 0009

This rare treasure of an ammonia planet with a ring system was suggested by Commander Arkadi Kreven.
tourist_0010_description:
Tourist Spot 0010

Commander 5Paxxor states that this beautiful system, located inside the Dumbbell Nebula, has a lot to offer. As well as a landable planet and two landable moons, it also contains a terraforming candidate! By far the biggest attraction is the waterworld that offers a stunning view of the stellar nebula itself.
tourist_0011_description:
Tourist Spot 0011

This giant star is a favourite destination for Commander Rebecca Lansing. The scale of this star has to be seen in person to be truly appreciated.
tourist_0012_description:
Tourist Spot 0012

Lava worlds are often places of great beauty, and this one orbits close to one of the largest known stars. Commander GTR 2014 rates this as a great location for celestial sightseeing.
tourist_0013_description:
Tourist Spot 0013

Commander Grievstar chose this destination for the amazing views of the twin binary stars in this distant system.
tourist_0014_description:
Tourist Spot 0014

This ringed Earth-like planet is the only body rotating around this neutron star. Commander Dragongard states that because it is hard to find, it's one of the few places humanity could hide if there was ever a danger of extinction.
tourist_0015_description:
Tourist Spot 0015

In Commander Alex Traut's opinion, when it comes to near-bubble tourist spots, one of the most scenic is CD-26 1339. Its location at the heart of a planetary nebula provides some of the most amazing views found anywhere.
tourist_0016_description:
Tourist Spot 0016

Commander Expugnax shared his opinions on this remarkable tourist destination - "Don't miss the amazing views of Barnard's Loop and the other stunning nebulae in this region of space. CD-39 6137 also contains a large number of landable moons and many fine ringed planets, including two incredible ringed stellar dwarves, giving off a soft warming glow to their accompanying moons."
tourist_0017_description:
Tourist Spot 0017

An enthusiastic Commander Rojo Habe declares that this spot is so far off the beaten track that it promises to be the trip of a lifetime! He promises that this will be one of the grandest ring systems you will ever see.
tourist_0018_description:
Tourist Spot 0018

Here's what Commander Newman1702 says about this beauty spot: "This curious ringed Earth-like moon orbits a local brown dwarf. It shares its orbit with three other small moons, and you can clearly see the brown dwarf through the rings there."
tourist_0019_description:
Tourist Spot 0019

Commander Bier00t declares this tourist destination as one of rare water worlds where there is actually some land. It is famed for its single massive ocean and complex weather systems in the dense atmosphere.
tourist_0020_description:
Tourist Spot 0020

Commander Byrne has named this location Zen Crater. He sees this as an ideal place for Zen tourists to sit and watch the galaxy through the ring system overhead.
tourist_0021_description:
Tourist Spot 0021

This is a destination for tourists happy to experience some real heat! This example of a hot Jupiter was suggested by Commander Raumfahrer Spiff, and pilots are warned to keep an eye on their hull temperature when in this area.
tourist_0022_description:
Tourist Spot 0022

Known to Commander Sand dan Glokta as the Patchwork Plains, this is the only landable planet of a large, bright Wolf Rayet star, which is currently in the process of blowing off its outer layers in a distinctive red and blue pattern. Enjoy a weekend of camping, hiking and dune-bashing in high gravity.
tourist_0023_description:
Tourist Spot 0023

This exceedingly rare trio of planets is recommended by Commander Title. It features two Earth-like worlds orbiting an ammonia water world.
tourist_0024_description:
Tourist Spot 0024

According to Commander Newman1702, this is one of his favourite finds: Earth-like twins in a black hole system!
tourist_0025_description:
Tourist Spot 0025

Commander Zapness considers this rare, ringed Earth-like planet orbiting a neutron star an impressive sight.
tourist_0026_description:
Tourist Spot 0026

Intriguing system with an Earth-like world, three water worlds and rich in resources. And all of these while orbiting a K-class red giant.
tourist_0027_description:
Tourist Spot 0027

The rich red and green colours of this planetary nebula inspired Commander Exar SPIRE to make this a celestial sightseeing location.
tourist_0028_description:
Tourist Spot 0028

This trio of Earth-like worlds in an intricate orbital dance is one of Commander Bartizan's wonders of the galaxy.
tourist_0029_description:
Tourist Spot 0029

Three small planets (landable) for clear views of the Elephant's Trunk nebula
tourist_0030_description:
Tourist Spot 0030

Emperor Arissa Lavigny-Duval was born in this system in the year 3243. She was crowned emperor in 3302.
tourist_0031_description:
Tourist Spot 0031

Commander Newman1702 has stated that this is one of the most beautiful locations in the galaxy. This tiny icy moon orbits a ringed gas giant while almost touching its rings, providing some incredible views from the surface. There's also an Earth-like world in the system to admire.
tourist_0032_description:
Tourist Spot 0032

Commander CrossFire Walli recommends this small red planet orbiting near a beautiful orange-red K type star as a trip worth making for the view alone.
tourist_0033_description:
Tourist Spot 0033

Gacrux, also known as Gamma Crucis, is one of the bigger stars in the galaxy and the nearest red giant star to the Sol system. Commander AreZee informs travellers that despite the orbital distance of Hopkinson's Inheritance, the star is clearly visible from the surface port and is a sublime spectacle.
tourist_0034_description:
Tourist Spot 0034

Commander Philip Lynx suggests that is view of an Earth-like planet orbiting a giant S-class star, is a very rare and unique sight for travellers to enjoy!
tourist_0035_description:
Tourist Spot 0035

This tourist beacon was set up in September 3307 as part of the Saud Kruger Exploration Campaign in conjunction with Astrogator Tours.
The location was identified by Commander Angantyr.

Both Saud Kruger and Astrogator Tours extend their thanks to Commander Angantyr for contributing to the success of this initiative.
tourist_0036_description:
Tourist Spot 0036

This huge planet in a system with multiple stars, providing once-in-a-lifetime vistas, was suggested by Commander Red Anders. This destination is definitely one for the adventure tourists. The less experienced should be careful of the planet's strong gravity!
tourist_0037_description:
Tourist Spot 0037

Commander Solaris suggests this stunning view of a neutron star with a ring system as an ideal location for celestial sightseers.
tourist_0038_description:
Tourist Spot 0038

Helium rich gas giants are a rare occurrence in the galaxy, and because of this one's close orbital motion to a B class star Commander Vitamin Arrr recommends this spot as an astronomical tourist location. The best views can be found in the ring system.
tourist_0039_description:
Tourist Spot 0039

Commander Canonn extols the amazing views within the icy rings of this moon.
tourist_0040_description:
Tourist Spot 0040

Commander Lance 'Spacecat' D. calls this system 'the ten-ringed wonder'! Located a scant hundred or so light years from the bubble, this system contains points of interest, both visual and scientific, beyond the magnificent ring systems.
tourist_0041_description:
Tourist Spot 0041

This tourist beacon was set up in September 3307 as part of the Saud Kruger Exploration Campaign in conjunction with Astrogator Tours.
The location was identified by Commander Zulu Romeo who made the following observations: A busy system of 36 bodies, six with rings, orbiting a large Class A star. The prize jewel of the system is the beautiful 7 F, a ringed Earth-like world with spectacular night-sky views of its parent ringed brown dwarf star. While you're here, stop by the Mars-like 9 G planet which teems with biological life together, or its unique moon, 9 G A, one of several geologically active worlds.

Both Saud Kruger and Astrogator Tours extend their thanks to Commander Zulu Romeo for contributing to the success of this initiative.
tourist_0042_description:
Tourist Spot 0042

This tourist destination was set by Commander OptimusGrind. It shows a stunning scene with a binary planet system orbiting close to an O class star. Both planets have ring systems.
tourist_0043_description:
Tourist Spot 0043

This complex system, featuring three black holes, is a recommended destination by Commander Ashtaraa.
tourist_0044_description:
Tourist Spot 0044

Commander Turjan has this to say about this star system:

"This was one of the first systems I mapped in detail and it's still one of the most beautiful I've seen on my travels. The sheer variety and colour of the gas giants makes this system a one stop treasure trove for exotic planet hunters!"
tourist_0045_description:
Tourist Spot 0045

Commander location describes this world of contrasts as "A beautiful planet of ice, with giant lave fissures".
tourist_0046_description:
Tourist Spot 0046

This system was recommended by Commander Lance 'Spacecat' D. He describes it as a system dominated by a bright blue star, surrounded by protostars and Jovian with the odd planet thrown in. There are many moons and an incredible eleven stellar objects. In this maelstrom of dust and gas, an Earth-like planet formed with a nearly perfect atmosphere. It probably has the craziest sky of any Earth-like world in the galaxy.
tourist_0047_description:
Tourist Spot 0047

Commander Kintch Dempsey reports that this moon orbits so close to a ring system that the views must be experienced personally to be properly appreciated.
tourist_0048_description:
Tourist Spot 0048

Commander Mephane shared this tourist destination simply for its amazing views.
tourist_0049_description:
Tourist Spot 0049

Experience this stunning view of an unnamed planetary nebula, with the compliments of Commander Kosh_EG.
tourist_0050_description:
Tourist Spot 0050

This lovely view of a class Y dwarf with a massive ring system is recommended by Commander Luca.
tourist_0051_description:
Tourist Spot 0051

Commander Jak suggests this location as one of the nearest neutron stars to the human bubble.
tourist_0052_description:
Tourist Spot 0052

Commander Jak offers this location of a black-scorched planet that's lit purple by the only Wolf-Rayet star in the bubble.
tourist_0053_description:
Tourist Spot 0053

View this black hole at the centre of a planetary nebula at Commander Titler's recommendation.
tourist_0054_description:
Tourist Spot 0054

This tourist beacon was set up in September 3307 as part of the Saud Kruger Exploration Campaign in conjunction with Astrogator Tours.
