tutorial_failure_enduranceelitechallenge: You were destroyed, but take heart, Commander. Though many have tried, few have managed to break this challenge.
tutorial_failure_enduranceexpertchalleng: You have been destroyed, Commander. Shield management is crucial in this scenario, try to optimise on your shield cell bank.
tutorial_failure_endurancemissiontutoria: You were destroyed, but take heart, Commander. Though many have tried, few have managed to break this challenge.
tutorial_failure_endurancemostlyharmless: You were destroyed, Commander. Balance your weapon usage to deliver the right damage at the opportune moment.

tutorial_failure_miningtutorial: Collision damage has caused a critical hull failure. Be careful with your ship around asteroids, Commander.
tutorial_failure_multishipcombattutorial: You were destroyed. Engaging multiple targets is daunting, but keep your cool and use your weapon synergy: lasers are great for taking down shields, while multi-cannons devastate ship hulls.
tutorial_failure_onfoottutorial: You have failed the mission. Would you like to reset from the last checkpoint?

type6_info:
Manufactured by Lakon Spaceways, the Type-6 Transporter is seen by many independent pilots as a natural progression from the versatile Cobra Mk III. When appropriately outfitted, the ship offers sufficient cargo space for the profitable trading of standard commodities, precluding the need to transport rare commodities long distances. The Type-6 has limited combat ability, however, and pilots who expect conflict are advised to upgrade the ship's shields and hull.

The Type-6 Transporter has been designed for medium-size landing pads.

This freighter provides a notable jump range and vast internal space, while also offering flexibility for traders who like to service outposts as well as starports. The Type-9 Heavy is one of the largest cargo ships on the market. While it lacks the carrying capacity of the Imperial Cutter, it is significantly less expensive and can be purchased without acquiring ranks in the Imperial Navy. Furthermore, the ship's ability to equip a vessel bay makes it popular with traders looking to protect their cargoes from criminals.

Boasting greater speed, acceleration and manoeuvrability than the Type-9 and a more focused hardpoint loadout, it was envisaged principally as a combat vessel, but its sizeable cargo hold makes it equally useful to traders.

A modified version of the Alliance Chieftain, the Alliance Challenger has been envisaged as a frontline combat vessel. With a generous complement of hardpoints, the Challenger can more than hold its own in a fight, and although it weighs more than its sister ship, it has retained the Chieftain's characteristic agility. It also has stronger armour than the Chieftain, allowing it to soak up a significant amount of punishment.

Manufactured by Lakon Spaceways, the Chieftain is more manoeuvrable than ships of similar size and weight, and its combat profile means it can more than hold its own in a fight. uraninite_info:
Produced by: Extraction
Consumed by: Refinery

Uraninite: chemical formula UO2. A radioactive ore, principally due to the small amount of the isotope U235 present. Refined into uranium at some refineries. Uranium was used for power in early human history, using refined U235 in fission reactors, but now is used mainly for biotech applications. Prohibited in some jurisdictions.
uraninite_info_short: Produced by: Extraction Consumed by: Refinery Chemical formula UO2.
uranium_info:
Produced by: Refinery
Consumed by: High Tech and Industrial

Uranium, U, atomic number 92. Melting point 1405K. Uranium is a silvery-grey metal, usually found as a mix of isotopes, mostly U238, and typically less than 1% of the radioactive U235. As a whole it is only weakly radioactive. It is chemically toxic but a useful element in industry, mainly because of its density. In early human history it was used as a power source in fission reactors. Standard canisters offer sufficient protection from the low level of radiation.
uranium_info_short: Produced by: Refinery Consumed by: High Tech and Industrial Uranium, U, atomic number 92. Melting point 1405K.

useboostjuice_description: Uses energy from the engine capacitor to overcharge the main drives providing a temporary boost in acceleration, maximum velocity and manoeuvrability. While in Supercruise this will activate Supercruise Overcharge if the appropriate module is installed.
useshieldcell_description: A dedicated input for using a single available shield cell provided there is a shield bank module installed and powered. There is no need to have the shield cell bank bound to the current fire group to enable this functionality. Shield cells provide a significant recharge to all active shields.
uss_convoy_attack_convoy_accept: We appreciate the help. Now take out those ships before they do any serious damage!
uss_convoy_attack_convoy_intro_boominv: Calling all ships. We have hostile vessels on an approach vector. Can anyone help us?
uss_convoy_attack_convoy_intro_famine: This is a civilian supply ship. We have been targeted by hostile forces. Requesting assistance from any nearby pilots.
uss_convoy_attack_convoy_intro_generic: Hailing all ships. We have hostile vessels on approach. Any help would be appreciated.
uss_convoy_attack_convoy_intro_outbreak: This is a medical ship on a mission of mercy. Hostile vessels sighted. Requesting immediate assistance.
uss_convoy_attack_convoy_progress_a: Hull integrity dropping fast. Keep those raiders off us!
uss_convoy_attack_convoy_progress_b: Nice shooting! That'll teach them to target innocent civilians.
uss_convoy_attack_convoy_progress_c: Scanner shows just one left. Take them out!
uss_convoy_attack_convoy_success: That's the last of them. You saved our lives, Commander. We can't thank you enough.
uss_convoy_attack_pirates_accept_boominv: We need you to blow the cargo hatch, then cover us while we grab the goods. Believe me, the people we're taking it from have more than enough.
uss_convoy_attack_pirates_accept_famine: We need you to blow the cargo hatch, then cover us while we scoop the goods. The people of this system are starving. They need those provisions.
uss_convoy_attack_pirates_accept_generic: We need you to break open the cargo hatch, then cover us while we grab the goods.
uss_convoy_attack_pirates_accept_outbrea: We need you to blow the cargo hatch, then cover us while we scoop the cargo. The people of this system are dying. They need those meds.
uss_convoy_attack_pirates_progress_a: Got one! So far so good.
uss_convoy_attack_pirates_progress_b: We just lost a ship! You're supposed to be covering us, Commander.
uss_convoy_attack_pirates_progress_c: We've got most of the cargo. Just a few more to go.
uss_convoy_attack_pirates_progress_d: They're tearing us apart! Where's our cover?
uss_convoy_attack_pirates_success: That's the last one. Thanks for the help, Commander. We couldn't have done it without you.
uss_distress_deliver_distressedship_acce: I wish there were more people like you in the galaxy. If you drop the cargo, I'll pick it up.
uss_distress_deliver_distressedship_atta: What the hell are you playing at?
uss_distress_deliver_distressedship_decl: That's too bad. I guess charity really is dead.
uss_distress_deliver_distressedship_intr: Got a moment, stranger? Just wanted to ask if you had any narcotics going spare. Always a demand for them around here.
Hey there, Commander. Any chance you could spare a little food? I hate to ask, but I'm running low on provisions.
You've come in our hour of need. The system's in the grip of an outbreak, so any medical supplies you could spare would be welcome.
uss_distress_deliver_distressedship_prog: Excellent. I'm locked on. Just going to scoop it.
Just drop the next canister and I'll pick it up.
uss_distress_deliver_distressedship_succ: You're a lifesaver, Commander. I won't forget this.
uss_distress_refuel_distressedship_accep: Thank you so much. I'll write a song about you when I get to port.
uss_distress_refuel_distressedship_attac: What the hell? You're attacking me!
uss_distress_refuel_distressedship_decli: You're going to leave me here? Where's your compassion?
uss_distress_refuel_distressedship_intro: At last! Please tell me you have some spare fuel? I miscalculated the length of my journey and now I'm dry.
Hey there, friend. Any chance you could spare some fuel? I thought I could make the trip with what I had, but I guess I was wrong.
Hey there, Commander. Any chance you could spare some fuel? Forgot to fill up before I left.
Hey there, stranger. Don't suppose you could spare a little fuel? Half the ports in the region have been hit by the outbreak, so I can't set down and refuel.
Hey, could you help me out with some fuel? I was in a hurry to get out of the area and forgot to check my levels.
uss_distress_refuel_distressedship_succe: Looks like we're back in business! Thanks, Commander. I hope I can repay the favour someday.
uss_distress_repair_distressedship_accep: I owe you one, Commander. You can launch the repair limpet whenever you're ready.
uss_distress_repair_distressedship_decli: You're going to leave me here? Thanks for nothing.
uss_distress_repair_distressedship_intro: Hey, great timing! My ship just died on me. Think you could help me out with some repairs? I knew I shouldn't have installed those off-brand modules.
Good to see you. Any chance you could help with some emergency repairs? Ship just died on me.
Boy am I glad to see you. Ship just died on me. Don't suppose you could help me get her running again? Got to get these meds to their destination.
A fellow spacer! Good timing. My ship just cut out on me. Any chance you could help with some emergency repairs?
Hey there. Any chance you could help with some emergency repairs? My ship just died on me – I think someone sabotaged it while I was in port.
Good to see you, Commander – I'm in a tight spot here. Ship's fried and I need to get back into the fight. Think you could help with some emergency repairs?
uss_distress_repair_distressedship_progr: Looks like the limpet is working. A few systems online.
uss_distress_repair_distressedship_succe: Full power to engines! Thanks, Commander. I owe you one.
uss_raid_protest_protestorg_accept: We've been wrongly identified as criminals. We have to defend ourselves!
uss_raid_protest_protestorg_intro_civunr: We've been wrongly identified as criminals and have been targeted by hostile ships. Can anyone help us?
uss_raid_protest_protestorg_intro_generi: Mayday, mayday. We are being targeted by hostile ships. Requesting assistance.
uss_raid_protest_protestorg_intro_warciv: Requesting immediate assistance. Hostile forces on approach vector. Can anyone help?
uss_raid_protest_protestorg_progress_a: Hull integrity isn't looking good. I could use some backup!
uss_raid_protest_protestorg_progress_b: Stick together, team – it's the only way we'll make it out of this.

usscargoancientartefact_info: Highly prized by collectors, the movement of recovered artefacts is strictly controlled by a number of authorities around the galaxy. Fortunately a lucrative black market offers savvy explorers with means to find reliable buyers for any ancient treasures.
usscargoancientartefact_info_short: Highly prized by collectors. Lucrative black market offers savvy explorers with means to find reliable buyers for any ancient treasures.
usscargoblackbox_info: The flight computer from a destroyed ship. Recovered flight computers can contain details on the movements and actions of ships before meeting their demise. If taken as legitimate salvage then reimbursement will be offered from markets. Taking a black box from the scene of an accident without the proper licence is an offence, but can offer lucrative profits on the black market.
usscargoblackbox_info_short: The flight computer from a destroyed ship.
usscargocorpse_info: The bodily remains of an unfortunate, lost to the void. Analysis of recovered bodies can provide useful information for a number of interested parties, but the trade of remains is limited to the black market, due to the questionable nature of the practise.
usscargocorpse_info_short: The bodily remains of an unfortunate, lost to the void.
usscargoexperimentalchemicals_info: Often dangerous and corrosive in nature, experimental chemicals are often created for research and scientific purposes. In the wrong hands they can be turned into dangerous weapons, so trade is strictly controlled. A thriving black market trade has proved difficult to control for authorities.
usscargoexperimentalchemicals_info_short: Often dangerous and corrosive in nature, experimental chemicals are often created for research and scientific purposes.
usscargomilitaryplans_info: Highly confidential documents detailing military movements and military strategy. Possession of such documents is highly illegal, due to their sensitive nature. For the same reason they fetch a large sum for the right seller on the black market.
usscargomilitaryplans_info_short: Highly confidential documents detailing military movements and military strategy.
usscargoprototypetech_info: The latest developments in experimental technology are jealously guarded by the galaxy's various corporations, and unsanctioned possession of prototype tech is severely punished. However, pilots have discovered there is a prosperous black market for stolen tech.
usscargoprototypetech_info_short: The latest developments in experimental technology. Unsanctioned possession of prototype tech is severely punished.
usscargorareartwork_info: Prized and treasured works of art. The galaxy is rife with reproductions and forgeries, and trade in the genuine article is highly controlled, with pieces transported between owners in secure convoys. Occasionally pieces find their way onto the black market, selling for under-the-counter prices. Due to a recent relaxing of the law, selling on the open market has become a viable prospect.
usscargorareartwork_info_short: Prized and treasured works of art. Trade in genuine, original pieces is highly controlled.
usscargorebeltransmissions_info: Transcripts of communications between dissident groups. These documents are highly valued by a number of factions for the intelligence they contain. It is considered highly suspicious to be carrying them, but black market trade in data will always flow.
usscargorebeltransmissions_info_short: Transcripts of communications between dissident groups. It is considered highly suspicious to be carrying them.
usscargotechnicalblueprints_info: Blueprints of patented new machinery and systems that are highly prized on the black market. Copyright theft is frowned upon by the authorities and those carrying illegally acquired blueprints can face extreme application of the law.
usscargotechnicalblueprints_info_short: Blueprints of patented new machinery and systems that are highly prized on the black market.
usscargotradedata_info: The trade manifest data for a ship that met its end nearby. The information contained within can be extremely useful to unscrupulous individuals and fetches a good price on the black market. However, illegal salvage is punishable by law.
usscargotradedata_info_short: The information contained within can be extremely useful to unscrupulous individuals and fetches a good price on the black market.
uszaiantreegrub_info:
This grub was introduced to the system from Lave, in an attempt to create a wildlife reserve for endangered species. Unfortunately the grubs mutated and evolved in their new environment, and the project failed. The evolved grubs were found to have a delicious flavour and surprising texture, and have since become a delicacy.

This rare good is legal in all markets.
uszaiantreegrub_info_short: This grub was introduced to the system from Lave. The evolved grubs were found to have a delicious flavour and surprising texture.
utgaroarmillenialeggs_info:
These eggs have been buried deep in the highly alkaline Utgaroarian soil around its many active geysers, where they are slowly cooked by the natural heat of the planet to take on a distinctive purple colour and their prized bittersweet taste.

This rare good is legal in all markets.
utgaroarmillenialeggs_info_short: These eggs have been buried deep in the highly alkaline Utgaroarian soil around its many active geysers.
utilitysuit_class1_info: The Maverick suit is designed for those who prefer to keep their options open with a greater carrying capacity. It comes equipped with an arc cutter for accessing hard-to-reach components.
utopiandissident_info: Used by Utopian supporters to undermine systems. Deliver these to Power contacts in any rival Power's controlled system. They are of no value to anyone but Pranav's followers.

uzumokulowgwings_info:
Have you ever wanted to fly? Uzumoku Low-G Wings provide you with enough lift and thrust to soar like a bird, and are practical and stylish with their discreet shoulder mounted unit! Sadly they can only function in suitable low G environments.

This rare good is legal in all markets.

v3_abandonedsettlement_message_88_003:
This is Commander Hyford and I fear this might be my last log entry. So far I've been able hide from them, but I don't know how much longer I can go undetected.

I should never have left that message for help. They must have tracked me using the it somehow.

Well if this is it I'm not going quietly.  There is a data cache at the following coordinates Lat:30.1113 Long:37.92. It contains all my ships log and data scans.

This is some kind of private military outfit, they operate outside the realm of the usual powers. I don't know who they answer to but the chain goes up pretty high. They are monitoring for alien encounters and tech. People are going missing. They are taking them and running experiments. That's what I was delivering. Escape pods full of people. I'm sorry for my part in this. It was a job that's all. Oh god help me...

I'm out of time.

v3_as_insideman_004_body:
...Secure Channel Established...

I know what they're saying about me.

I've switched sides, I'm a traitor. It's not true. What I've done I had to do to maintain my cover. And it's got me results.

I've stashed a data packet on a derelict ship on Belu B 1. Lat -40, Long 7.15. It contains a full manifest for the gang's next big deal. The boss is going to be overseeing this one personally. It's big and if we can catch them in the act there'll be no getting out of it.

vanayequirhinofur_info:
Genetically regressive rhinoceroses were originally introduced to Vanayequi to provide a reliable source of leather for nearby industries. The genetic modification was successful in reducing the animal's aggressive tendencies, but had unintended side effects. As the ceratomorphs returned to a more primitive state, they began growing soft, lush fur. This fur is now prized around the galaxy for its resilience and warmth.

This rare good is legal in all markets.

vegaslimweed_info:
Initially thought to be a plant, settlers of the system would swallow it whole for its slimming and appetite suppressing qualities. The revelation that the plant is actually a parasitical life form has not reduced its popularity. Those infested have reported a difficulty in removing the parasite once it has established, but the benefits include an immunity to certain biological poisons. The parasite must be purged before it begins to pupate.

This rare good is legal in all markets.

video_desc_basiccombat:
In this pilot training video you will learn the following:

- How to use the scanner
- How to target ships
- How to divert power around systems in your ship
- Basic flight manoeuvres including turn rates
video_desc_basicflightcontrols: In this pilot training video you will learn basic flight controls and manoeuvres.
video_desc_cqc: In this pilot training video you will learn about The Close Quarters Championship. CQC thrusts players into intense PVP action within the Elite Dangerous galaxy.
video_desc_crafting: In this pilot training video you will learn about crafting module upgrades, from resource collection to the Engineer's construction process.
video_desc_crimeandpunishment: In this pilot training video you will be given information on how the judicial system works throughout the galaxy.
video_desc_docking: In this pilot training video you will learn about the basics of docking with a starport.
video_desc_engineers: In this pilot training video you will be given an overview of the Engineers: a collection of eccentric master mechanics, able to trick out your vessel with unique modifications... if you are able to earn their trust.
video_desc_exploration: In this pilot training video you will learn how to find astronomical bodies, unidentified signal sources, mission targets and other signals using the Discovery Scanner, and how to map astronomical bodies using the Detailed Surface scanner.
video_desc_fighters: In this pilot training video you will be given an overview of how ships can be outfitted with ship launched fighters and how to use them in the field.
video_desc_landing: In this pilot training video you will learn about the requirements and processes of travelling to - and around - planets, along with instructions on how to make landfall.
video_desc_maps: In this pilot training video you will learn basic features of both the galaxy and system maps.
video_desc_mining: In this pilot training video you will learn how to use the Detailed Surface Scanner and Pulse Wave Analyser to find motherlodes, and how to use the new mining tools to extract the materials from them.
video_desc_multicrew: In this pilot training video you will learn about the ability of some ships to support additional Commanders as crew. You will learn about different roles that crew can take on, as well as the benefits of being part of a multi-crew vessel.
video_desc_passengers: In this pilot training video you will learn about new passenger cabin modules and how to use them to successfully transport various types of passengers for profit. You will also learn about tourist spots and their uses.
video_desc_pilots: In this pilot training video you will receive instruction on how to hire, manage and work with fighter pilots. These specialised ship crew are able to fly ship launched fighters and their parent vessels.
video_desc_powerplay_pt1: This is the first part of the Elite Dangerous Powerplay training, with an overview of Powerplay's features.
video_desc_powerplay_pt2: This is the second part of the Elite Dangerous Powerplay training, focusing on preparing star systems for takeover. At the end of each cycle the top 10 most prepared systems will be eligible for an expansion attempt.
video_desc_powerplay_pt3: This is the third part of the Elite Dangerous Powerplay training, looking at how to expand your power's territory. There is also information on how to oppose other powers in their expansion attempts.
video_desc_powerplay_pt4: This is the fourth part of the Elite Dangerous Powerplay training, showing how to control and maintain systems under your power's influence. It is also possible to undermine other powers, using different techniques depending on whether or not they are a part of the same faction.
video_desc_settlements: In this pilot training video you will learn about surface settlements and how to interact with them. Also included are instructions on how to use the SRV's turret.
video_desc_srv: In this pilot training video you will learn how to outfit your ship with surface reconnaissance vehicles, and how to deploy and operate an SRV on a planet's surface.
video_desc_starportservices: In this pilot training video you will learn about services available at starports and outposts.
video_desc_trade: In this pilot training video you will learn how to find trading opportunities on the Galaxy Map.
video_desc_travel: In this pilot training video you will learn about using the Frame Shift Drive (FSD) to supercruise between planets and jump between star systems. The video also explains the nuances of normal flight, supercruise and hyperspace jumps.
video_desc_wavescanner: In this pilot training video you will learn how ship's sensors work near planets. You'll also learn how to operate the SRV's wave scanner and find out how it is used in a new procedure called synthesis.
video_desc_wings: In this pilot training video you will learn about the basics of forming up and working together with other pilots in a co-op team.

viper_info:
The Viper Mk III is a light combat ship manufactured by Faulcon deLacy. Fast and manoeuvrable, the Viper's comparatively low price point makes it a good option for aspiring bounty hunters, while its versatility has made it popular with security forces throughout the galaxy.

The Viper Mk III has been designed for small-size landing pads.

viper_mkiv_info:
The Viper Mk IV is a heavy combat ship manufactured by Faulcon deLacy. Its ability to equip a class-4 power plant makes it ideally suited to long-range combat missions, while its armour allows it to soak up much more punishment than its predecessor, the Viper Mk III. These features come at a cost, however, making the Mk IV heavier and less agile than the Mk III.

The Viper Mk IV has been designed for small-size landing pads.

voxtut_03basiccombat_5_deploy_hardpoints: How do you expect to beat him? Harsh language? Deploy your weapons, pilot!
voxtut_03basiccombat_6_primary_fire_info: Weapons hot. Concentrate your primary fire on the target, Commander.
voxtut_03basiccombat_7_primary_fire_loop: Your little friend here has a combat rank of harmless. Seems to have left the hangar without any shields, so you should be able to make light work of him.
voxtut_03basiccombat_8_wait_for_ship_dea: Just a few hits should do it, Commander. You've got this one.
voxtut_03basiccombat_9_second_fight_expl: Nice work, Commander, you're about three thousand credits richer.
voxtut_04advancedcombat_1_arrival_messag: Bounty hunting can be a lucrative business Commander... if you're willing to put up with the occupational hazards.
You've got a wanted target up ahead. If I'm right, this one should have a hefty bounty on their head in a neighbouring system.
voxtut_04advancedcombat_2_crime_scan_che: Target their ship and move within scanner range. Then use your kill warrant scanner to check if they're wanted elsewhere.
If they are, you'll be rewarded with a few more bounty vouchers to cash in.
voxtut_04advancedcombat_3_crime_scanner_: Scan the target, Commander. There could be some credits to be made here.
voxtut_04advancedcombat_4_first_combat_i:
Good job. As I suspected, this guy is a bit of a troublemaker.

You know what to do, Commander. Take 'em out.
voxtut_04advancedcombat_5_wait_for_ship_: You'll want to plan your attack carefully. Make sure to use your fire groups for quickly switching between different weapon configurations.
Remember, it's best to wait till their shields are offline before hitting them with your missiles.
voxtut_04advancedcombat_6_second_fight_i:
Target is down. 

Don't celebrate just yet though, Commander. You've got multiple hostiles inbound to your location.

This is far from over...
voxtut_04advancedcombat_7_second_fight_l: Pay attention to your radar to get a feel for where your targets are. Keeping them out of your blind spots is always a good plan.
If you find yourself caught up in the fray, switch your fire group and deploy chaff as a countermeasure.
This will prevent gimballed weapons getting a lock on you for a short period.
voxtut_04advancedcombat_8_success_lnw:
That's some good shooting, Commander. All targets have been dispatched. 

Keep this up and you'll have attained Elite status before you know it.
voxtut_05mining_10_primary_fire_info_lnw: Right, let's take a chunk out of this asteroid. Point and shoot, Commander.
voxtut_05mining_11_primary_fire_looping_: What are you waiting for? Just fire the mining laser at the asteroid, Commander.
voxtut_05mining_12_chunk_lock_on_info_ln: Good job. A chunk has broken off. If you target it, you'll then be able to scoop it up.
voxtut_05mining_13_chunk_lock_looping_ti: Come on, Commander. Target the fragment so we can get some ore in the refinery.
voxtut_05mining_14_cargo_scoop_deploy_in:
Palladium! You got lucky, Commander.

You're going to need to deploy your cargo scoop if you want to retrieve the fragment.
voxtut_05mining_15_cargo_scoop_deploy_lo: Time is money, Commander. Deploy that cargo scoop already!
voxtut_05mining_16_scoop_info_lnw: Now, keep an eye on the cargo scooping reticule to the left of your radar. Make sure your speed's under 40 and use this to guide your ship in gently to scoop up the ore.
voxtut_05mining_17_scoop_looping_tip_lnw: Take it slow at first, Commander. You'll get there.
voxtut_05mining_18_refinery_info_1_lnw: Good job, the ore is safely on board. Now you need to fill up your hopper with enough of the stuff to be able to refine one canister.
voxtut_05mining_18_refinery_info_2_lnw: Why don't you keep mining this asteroid until you have enough ore.
voxtut_05mining_18_refinery_info_3_lnw: Once your resource bin is full, your refinery should kick into action, and then, you'll have a canister of pure palladium in you cargo hold.
voxtut_05mining_19_refinery_looping_tip_: You'll need to collect a few more chunks of ore before your hopper is full, Commander.
voxtut_05mining_1_arrival_message_1_lnw: Hello again, Commander. You know, being a combat pilot isn't the only way to make a living.
voxtut_05mining_1_arrival_message_2_lnw: Sometimes it's a good option to retreat to an asteroid belt for some Mining. You never know; if you strike a rich vein of ore, there could be some credits to be made.
voxtut_05mining_1_arrival_message_3_lnw: I've been told this particular belt has some valuable ore on offer.
voxtut_05mining_20_success_1_lnw:
Congratulations on a job well done, Commander. 

This palladium should fetch a good price when you get back to port.
voxtut_05mining_20_success_2_lnw: You know, if you decide to make a go at mining, you might want to think about picking up some collector drones. Believe me, they'll greatly increase your productivity.
voxtut_05mining_2_deploy_hardpoints_info: So let's get to work. If you deploy your hardpoints, I'll wait here and keep an eye out for any pirate activity.
voxtut_05mining_3_deploy_hardpoints_loop: Do you really want to stare at these asteroids all day? We should get to work, Commander.
voxtut_05mining_4_power_priorities_info_: Woah! It looks like you've maxed out your power plant. No need to panic.
voxtut_05mining_5_module_panel_info_lnw: Your ship has insufficient power for all your active modules. The shield generator is probably draining the most juice, so you'd best deactivate this by disengaging it in your modules panel.
voxtut_05mining_6_module_panel_info_loop: Just so you know, your oxygen will eventually deplete. No pressure, but the clock is ticking.
voxtut_05mining_8_asteroid_approach_info: First things first; you need to approach one of these rocks. So pick a rock, any rock.
voxtut_05mining_9_asteroid_approach_loop: Don't be overwhelmed by the options, Commander. They're all pretty much the same.
voxtut_06planetarylanding_10_srv_control: Careful, Commander, stray too far off the path and you could end up a rogue like me.
voxtut_06planetarylanding_11_srv_control: You know, as far as I can recall, there's a great set of canyons nearby if you fancy a bit of stunt driving.
voxtut_06planetarylanding_12_srv_control: This place reminds me of another planet. A long time ago. Back then I was with the Federal Navy, before I went out on my own.
It was a covert mission to liquidate an Imperial asset. Easy right? Never quite turns out that way.
Lost a lot of good people on that rock. But don't listen to me, you go on, Commander. Have a good drive.
voxtut_06planetarylanding_13_approach_se: Okay, I've set a waypoint for the nearby settlement. You're going in under the radar, so try not to draw too much attention.
voxtut_06planetarylanding_14_destroy_gen: Your primary objective here is to disable the powergrid by hacking the data link. Before you do that though, you'll need to take out the local defences.
You can destroy the generator by using your turret-mounted multi-cannon.
voxtut_06planetarylanding_15_destroy_gen: If you're having trouble finding the generator, just follow the waypoint, Commander. It's not far.
voxtut_06planetarylanding_16_data_linkin:
Great work. The generator is offline, you're in the clear.

Now approach the data link and target it.
Then you can switch to turret view and use secondary fire to activate the data link scanner.
voxtut_06planetarylanding_17_data_linkin: Hacking this data link should kill the power grid. Just keep the target visible when you're scanning and wait for the process to complete.
voxtut_06planetarylanding_18_success_1_l:
Power grid is offline. Your work here is done, Commander.

Just remember that data is a valuable commodity, so if you're willing to take the risk, hacking data points can be worthwhile.
voxtut_06planetarylanding_18_success_2_l: But believe me, it always pays to have a plan of attack before you infiltrate a secure facility.
voxtut_06planetarylanding_1_arrival_mess:
I've got another job for you, Commander.

A little clandestine operation. 

You're going to have to get your tyres dirty on terra firma.
voxtut_06planetarylanding_2_deploy_landi: I'll explain the details as we go, but first you'd better deploy your landing gear and get this Diamondback on the ground.
Try to pick a spot out of range of that settlement just ahead of you. You're going to need to infiltrate it later, so if they can't see you coming, it's a bonus.
voxtut_06planetarylanding_3_deploy_landi: Landing this ship is going to be tricky without a fully deployed landing gear, Commander.
voxtut_06planetarylanding_4_land_info_ln:
This is some rugged terrain, so it may take some time to find a suitable spot to touch down. 

Slow incremental movements are best here, Commander.
voxtut_06planetarylanding_5_land_looping: If you're having trouble, just keep an eye on your terrain scanner. When the ship indicator goes blue, it means that you've got a suitable landing area.
voxtut_06planetarylanding_6_srv_panel_de: Great, you're on the ground. Now comes the fun part, Commander. Open up your role-switch panel, select your SRV and deploy it.
voxtut_06planetarylanding_7_srv_panel_de: No time to waste, Commander. Initiate your deployment sequence.
voxtut_06planetarylanding_8_ship_dismiss:
Okay, you've got wheels on the ground. 

Now you need to get the SRV clear of the ship before it becomes fully operational.
voxtut_06planetarylanding_9_srv_controls: Gravity will affect the way your SRV handles. I'm reading only about .1 of a G, so bear that in mind before you hit any bumps.
The more wheels you have on the ground, the easier that thing is to control.
And hey, you can use your vertical thrusters if you get into trouble. Handy way to jump over obstacles too.
voxtut_07shiplaunchedfighters_10_success:
That was a close call. 

I guess this time around, I owe you one.

You've come a long way from that stranded pilot I pulled out of an asteroid field.

It's good to know that I can call on you when things get dangerous.

See you around, Commander.
voxtut_07shiplaunchedfighters_1_arrival_: I've set up a meeting, Commander. We're going to be exchanging some valuable cargo. Our contact should be dropping in any minute now.
But listen, be on the look out for anything strange. I can't say I fully trust who we're dealing with here, and this is a critical mission.
voxtut_07shiplaunchedfighters_2_enemy_sp: Wait a second, something's not right. I wasn't expecting to see a Viper.
They're deploying hardpoints; looks like we're being ambushed.
voxtut_07shiplaunchedfighters_3_fighter_: This Keelback won't be able to hold him off. You're going to need to deploy the fighter to take them down.
Open up the role-switch panel, select the Condor and deploy it. This will engage the telepresence link to the fighter.
voxtut_07shiplaunchedfighters_5_fighter_: Telepresence is offline. The fighter is destroyed.
You'll have to wait for the Constructor to assemble a new one. When it's done, just deploy the new fighter and get back out there.
voxtut_07shiplaunchedfighters_6_fighter_: Another fighter down, Commander. You know the drill by now.
voxtut_07shiplaunchedfighters_7_objectiv: Great. Fighter is successfully deployed. Your gonna need to do your best to protect the mothership, Commander. We can't afford to lose this cargo.
The Condor is much more nimble than a Viper so you should be able to stay out of their firing line.
voxtut_07shiplaunchedfighters_8_objectiv: Fighter is deployed, Commander. You've got work to do.
voxtut_07shiplaunchedfighters_9_objectiv: Clear of the vessel bay. Mothership is hanging by a thread, so make your shots count, Commander.
vulture_armour_grade1_info: Hull reinforcement that provides standard protection against all types of attack.
vulture_armour_grade2_info: Hull reinforcement using an advanced structure and higher quality compounds, offering improved protection against all types of attack.
vulture_armour_grade3_info: Hull reinforcement using an advanced structure and military-grade compounds, offering superior protection against all types of attack.
vulture_armour_mirrored_info: Hull reinforcement using a specially formulated structure, offering superior protection against thermal damage caused by energy weapons. It is vulnerable to projectile weapons and other kinetic attacks.
vulture_armour_reactive_info: Hull reinforcement using a dynamically reactive, impact-resistant material offering superior protection against projectile weapons and other kinetic attacks. It is vulnerable to thermal damage caused by energy weapons.
vulture_cockpit_info: Transparent protective canopy on a ship's cockpit that shields pilots from the many dangers of space travel.
vulture_info:
Core Dynamics pushed its expertise to the limit when creating the Vulture, employing sophisticated techniques to integrate two large hardpoints into the ship's compact frame. The manufacturer also graced the Vulture with powerful lateral thrusters, allowing it to evade incoming fire while dealing significant damage, and making it particularly deadly in combat.

The Vulture has been designed for small-size landing pads.
vulture_taxi_cockpit_info: Transparent protective canopy on a ship's cockpit that shields pilots from the many dangers of space travel.
wakesolutions_info:
Captured from scanning high energy wakes with a wake scanner.

Data for frame shift wake destination solutions usually follows a predictable pattern. The technology is still new enough that oddities can be found.
wakesolutions_info_short: Captured from scanning high energy wakes with a wake scanner.

warzone_convoy_chatter_001: We're under fire but we don't have the complete data package. We'll have to sync up so if one of us makes it out of this the mission is a success.
warzone_convoy_chatter_002: Data Transfer Complete. Lets head out.

waste2pasteunits_info: Highly valued in environments where resources are not readily available, Waste2Paste units are man-portable devices that can recombine most unwanted matter into a thick, viscous substance, which the manufacturers claim has over twenty uses in the modern living space.
waste2pasteunits_info_short: Highly valued in environments where resources are not readily available.
water_info:
Produced by: Agricultural and Extraction (Surface)
Consumed by: All but Agricultural and Extraction (Surface)

H2O. A chemical compound that is vital to human life and useful in a number of industrial processes.
water_info_short: Produced by: Agricultural and Extraction (Surface) Consumed by: All but Agricultural and Extraction (Surface)
waterpurifiers_info:
Produced by: Industrial
Consumed by: All except Industrial

Water purifiers and components and consumables for them. All space installations are reliant on recycled water, so water purification is vital for survival. Some units are set up to medicate the purified water to maintain the correct mood of inhabitants.
waterpurifiers_info_short: Produced by: Industrial Consumed by: All except Industrial All space installations are reliant on recycled water, so water purification is vital for survival.
watersofshintara_info:
The medical qualities of the mineral waters of Shintara are decried by many in the scientific community as nonsense. This has not stopped widespread rumours that water from the planet can cure almost any ailment, and even reverse the ageing process. The company that controls the source of this water is happy to allow the rumours to continue, and people all over the galaxy are willing to pay a small fortune for the real thing.

This rare good is legal in all markets.
watersofshintara_info_short: Rumours say the mineral waters of Shintara contains some kinds of healing power, and even reverse the ageing process.
watertreatment_info: A concoction of chemicals and filtering agents that can purify almost any water source. Its exact formula is a closely guarded secret.
watertreatment_info_short: A concoction of chemicals and filtering agents that can purify almost any water source. Its exact formula is a closely guarded secret.
weaponcomponent_info: A component from a personal firearm.
weaponinventory_info: A comprehensive record of all weaponry and ammunition stored at a facility.
weaponinventory_longinfo: A comprehensive record of all weaponry and ammunition stored at a facility.
weaponschematic_info: A technical blueprint detailing the design and mechaniism of a personal firearm.
weapontestdata_info: Analysis of the performance and effectiveness of newly designed weaponry or related enhancements.
weapontestdata_longinfo: Analysis of the performance and effectiveness of newly designed weaponry or related enhancements.
wheemetewheatcakes_info:
These cakes were originally used as packing material for expensive machinery, but when plant owners realised they were edible, they soon became the workers staple diet. The wheat cakes produced today are made using the traditional recipe.

This rare good is legal in all markets.
wheemetewheatcakes_info_short: These cakes were originally used as packing material for expensive machinery, but when plant owners realised they were edible, they soon became the workers staple diet.
wine_info:
Produced by: Agricultural
Consumed by: All
Prohibited in Prison Colony markets and Federal Theocracy markets.

A luxury drink made from fermented fruits containing alcohol, a mild narcotic, and grown organically. Occasionally illegal because of the alcohol content.
wine_info_short: Produced by: Agricultural Consumed by: All Illegal in Prison Colony markets and Federal Theocracy markets.
wing_full_join_failure: Unable to join Team: Team is at maximum capacity
wingnavlock_description: Slave your frame shift drive to the selected teammate, enabling automatic supercruise and hyperspace jumps when within nav-lock range.
witchhaulkobebeef_info:
A traditional breed from the Tajima strain of wagyu cattle in Kobe in Japan on ancient Earth, they remain the most pampered cattle in human space. Taken from Kobe before the Earth's serious environmental decline, the cattle are hand-fed a secret mix of rare grains and are brushed daily. Now unique to Witchhaul, this is one of the most prized meats there is.

This rare good is legal in all markets.
witchhaulkobebeef_info_short: A traditional breed from the Tajima strain of wagyu cattle originating from Kobe, Japan on ancient Earth. Now unique to the Witchhaul system.
wolf1301fesh_info:
A synthetic psychoactive drug based on a closely guarded secret recipe. While active, it causes the user to lock their teeth together and rapidly exhale, a reaction that led to its street name, Fesh. There are many poor imitations but Wolf 1301 Fesh is the original and remains the most expensive due to its consistent quality. Banned in most jurisdictions.

This rare good is legal in all Imperial markets except for Prison Colony, and Independent and Allied Dictatorship markets.

Please note that if a market’s controlling faction changes, some formerly legal rare goods may become illegal. Should this occur the rare good will be unavailable for sale or purchase at that market for the duration of the prohibiting faction’s tenure.
wolf1301fesh_info_short: A synthetic psychoactive drug based on a closely guarded secret recipe. Wolf 1301 Fesh is the original and remains the most expensive due to its consistent quality.
wood_info: A hard, fibrous structural material found in plant-based organisms. Cheap, renewable and highly useful.
wood_info_short: A hard, fibrous structural material found in plant-based organisms. Cheap, renewable and highly useful.
wool_info: Textile fibre taken from animals. A range of animals can be shaved or shorn to harvest the hairs and furs.
wool_info_short: Textile fibre taken from animals. A range of animals can be shaved or shorn to harvest the hairs and furs.
wornshieldemitters_info:
Component found in ships: frequently used by combat oriented vessels. Known to be salvaged from signal sources.

These are used shield emitters, although the core components can be cannibalised.
wornshieldemitters_info_short: Component found in ships: frequently used by combat oriented vessels. Known to be salvaged from signal sources.
wpn_h_launcher_rocket_sauto_info: This powerful rocket launcher is specifically designed to neutralise vehicles, and must lock onto a viable target before it can be fired.
wpn_m_assaultrifle_kinetic_fauto_info: This automatic rifle is a solid all-rounder with comparatively good power and range.
wpn_m_assaultrifle_laser_fauto_info: This automatic laser rifle compensates for average damage output with excellent accuracy.
wpn_m_assaultrifle_plasma_fauto_info: This automatic plasma rifle balances a high fire rate with comparatively modest damage output.
wpn_m_launcher_rocket_sauto_info: A lightweight rocket launcher that fires dumbfire projectiles designed to take out personnel and SRVs.
wpn_m_shotgun_plasma_doublebarrel_info: This semi-automatic plasma shotgun packs a punch, but has limited ammo capacity and high recoil.
wpn_m_sniper_plasma_charged_info: A semi-automatic, long-range plasma rifle with high damage output and a low rate of fire.
wpn_m_submachinegun_kinetic_fauto_info: This automatic carbine is designed to be fired in short bursts, and is most effective at short range.
wpn_m_submachinegun_laser_fauto_info: An automatic laser carbine with a high fire rate and good short-range accuracy.
wpn_s_pistol_kinetic_sauto_info: A semi-automatic pistol with low recoil and a high fire rate, offset by comparatively low damage output.
wpn_s_pistol_laser_sauto_info: An automatic burst-fire laser pistol with a high fire rate offset by comparatively low damage output.
wpn_s_pistol_plasma_charged_info: This semi-automatic plasma pistol boasts high damage output, offset by high recoil and a low fire rate.
wreckage_already_accessed: Alert: Wreckage Data Core already accessed.
wreckage_full_scan: Decryption Successful, Full Data Package Available
wreckage_searchandrescue_accidentaldamag: Watch what you're shooting. We're not a hostile target.
Hold your fire! Search and Rescue.
We're not the bad guys, please stop shooting us.
Please don't make that mistake again, Commander.
Watch that itchy trigger finger, Commander.
wreckage_searchandrescue_approach_01: Keep your distance, Commander. Search and rescue operation in progress.
wreckage_searchandrescue_approach_02: To approaching vessel, what are your intentions? Please do not interfere with rescue operations.
wreckage_searchandrescue_approach_03: To approaching vessel, this is a search and rescue operation. Please don't interfere.
wreckage_searchandrescue_approach_04: Keep flying, Commander, there's nothing to see here.
wreckage_searchandrescue_approach_05: Please keep out of the area, Commander. This wreckage is highly unstable.
wreckage_searchandrescue_commuterjumpout: We've got to get out of here!
Control, I'm bugging out. Alert security forces target is hot!
Jumping, hold on to your lunch.
wreckage_searchandrescue_hostilescan_01: We have nothing of value on board, Commander. We're just a search and rescue vessel.
wreckage_searchandrescue_hostilescan_02: I don't think you'll find anything valuable here, Commander.
wreckage_searchandrescue_hostilescan_03: If I didn't know better, I'd say you were thinking of robbing me, Commander.
wreckage_searchandrescue_hostilescan_04: What are your intentions, Commander? We have nothing of value on board.
wreckage_searchandrescue_hostilescan_05: Please don't interfere with our job, Commander, we're just here to try to save lives.
wreckage_searchandrescue_largeship_01: Rescue One to all rescue vessels, keep an eye out for cryopods. Maybe someone survived this catastrophe.
wreckage_searchandrescue_largeship_02: Keep scanning, we need to find out what happened here. People are going to want answers.
wreckage_searchandrescue_largeship_03: There were over 300 people on board this thing. You can't tell me none of them made if off the ship before it blew. Keep scanning.
wreckage_searchandrescue_largeship_04: Control, this is Rescue One. It's a complete disaster out here, debris all over the place. Whatever hit this transport made one hell of a mess.
wreckage_searchandrescue_largeship_05: Rescue one to all rescue vessels, I want every inch of this wreckage checked. There might still be some survivors in there.
wreckage_searchandrescue_largeship_06: Dispatch this is Rescue Team 42. Scans show no survivors, it's a total disaster.
wreckage_searchandrescue_largeship_07: Rescue One to Control, it's not looking good, debris all over the system. Some of the escape pods are missing, lets just hope someone managed to survive this thing.
wreckage_searchandrescue_largeship_08: Rescue One to all vessels. Keep looking until we find out what happened to this ship and the people on it.
wreckage_searchandrescue_largeship_09: Dispatch, this is Rescue Team 96. It's a total loss I'm afraid... no survivors. 96 out.
wreckage_searchandrescue_largeship_10: Control, this is Rescue Team 33. Getting some strange readings from the debris. I think this thing blew up from the inside out.
wreckage_searchandrescue_nosurvivors_01: No sign of survivors, looks like it's another clean up operation.
wreckage_searchandrescue_nosurvivors_02: Rescue One to all rescue vessels, keep an eye out for cryopods. Maybe someone survived this catastrophe.
wreckage_searchandrescue_nosurvivors_03: Control, this is Rescue One, have arrived at coordinates. I'm afraid it's a dead stick, no sign of survivors.
wreckage_searchandrescue_nosurvivors_04: Control, this is Rescue One. Salvage team in place and clean up in progress.
wreckage_searchandrescue_nosurvivors_05: Scanning for life signs. I don't think we'll find any, but you never know.
wreckage_searchandrescue_nosurvivors_06: Rescue One to Dispatch. We've reached the ship and found the pilot. He didn't make it I'm afraid.
wreckage_searchandrescue_nosurvivors_07: No sign of survivors. Starting clean up operations. Rescue One out.
wreckage_searchandrescue_nosurvivors_08: No life signs detected. The escape pods are missing, lets just hope someone managed to survive this thing.
wreckage_searchandrescue_nosurvivors_09: Dispatch, this is rescue team 44. Not much left of this one, no sign of any survivors.
wreckage_searchandrescue_nosurvivors_10: Rescue team 77 to Dispatch. Doesn't look like the pilot had time to eject. Salvaging what we can.
wreckage_searchandrescue_survivors01: Control, this is Rescue One. Salvage team in place and clean up in progress. We have two survivors on board.
wreckage_searchandrescue_survivors02: These guys are lucky we got here in time. We can't save their ship, but at least we got their cryopods.
wreckage_searchandrescue_survivors03: Control, survivors collected and salvage in progress. I'll call that a win. Rescue One out.
wreckage_searchandrescue_survivors04: Rescue One to Control, coordinates reached, survivors on board and clean up in progress.
wreckage_searchandrescue_survivors05: Dispatch, Rescue Team 6 here. Get a med bay ready, we've got survivors.
wreckage_searchandrescue_survivors06: Rescue Team 378 to Control. We've got the pilot safe and sound, can't say the same about the ship.
wreckage_searchandrescue_survivors07: Control, we've saved as many of the crew as we could. Looks like a systems meltdown took out the ship before they could all escape.
wreckage_searchandrescue_survivors09: Control, we have survivors. Ship is a total write off. 69 out.
wreckage_searchandrescue_survivors10: Dispatch, this is Rescue One. All hands rescued.
wreckage_searchandrescue_underfire_01: To attacking pilot, we are a search and rescue team. Hold your fire! I repeat. Hold your fire!
wreckage_searchandrescue_underfire_02: Control, we're under attack by a hostile ship. Security forces alerted. Taking evasive action.
wreckage_searchandrescue_underfire_03: Don't shoot, we're search and rescue. I repeat don't shoot!
wreckage_searchandrescue_underfire_04: To pilot of hostile ship. Hold your fire! We're a search and rescue vessel in search of survivors. We mean no harm.
wreckage_searchandrescue_underfire_05: Control, we're taking fire. Bugging out. Alert security forces!
wreckage_searchandrescue_underfire_06: Control, target is hot! I repeat target is hot! Alert security forces!
wreckage_searchandrescue_underfire_07: Control, we're under attack. Taking heavy damage. Going to have to bug out on this one.
wreckage_searchandrescue_underfire_08: To hostile pilot, we are a rescue team and come in peace. Hold your fire!
wreckage_searchandrescue_underfire_09: To hostile pilot. Under section 893 of the Pilots' Federation charter, we request safe passage. Hold your fire.
wreckage_searchandrescue_underfire_10: Hold your fire! We're here to help. Hold your fire!
wreckage_voucher_description_generic: A recovered data package from a piece of wreckage. Can be traded for credits.
wreckagecomponents_info: Accidents in space often leave a lot of debris, some of that wreckage is useful for determining the cause of the accident. They should be handed in to whichever organisation has called for their collection, however they also generate some demand as morbid mementos or simply for scrap.
wreckagecomponents_info_short: Accidents in space often leave a lot of debris, some of that wreckage is useful for determining the cause of the accident.
wulpahyperboresystems_info:
Wulpa Engineering Systems are constantly working to improve and enhance on existing models, with the Wulpa Hyperbore System representing the latest in automated mineral extraction services.

This rare good is legal in all markets.
wulpahyperboresystems_info_short: The Wulpa Hyperbore System represents the latest in automated mineral extraction services.
wuthielokufroth_info:
Not strictly a beer, this light alcoholic beverage is made from fermented frog spawn which is then filtered through rush mats.

This rare good is legal in all markets except for Prison Colony markets and Federal Corporate and Theocracy markets.

Please note that if a market’s controlling faction changes, some formerly legal rare goods may become illegal. Should this occur the rare good will be unavailable for sale or purchase at that market for the duration of the prohibiting faction’s tenure.
wuthielokufroth_info_short: Not strictly a beer, this light alcoholic beverage is made from fermented frog spawn which is then filtered through rush mats.

xihecompanions_info:
We make the most realistic and exclusive animal companions using the latest technology and robotics, better than nature and guaranteed to last. Rigorous testing ensures that all our animals conform to the appropriate legislation on artificial intelligence.

This rare good is legal in all markets except for Independent and Allied Theocracy markets.

Please note that if a market’s controlling faction changes, some formerly legal rare goods may become markets. Should this occur the rare good will be unavailable for sale or purchase at that market for the duration of the prohibiting faction’s tenure.
xihecompanions_info_short: The most realistic and exclusive animal companions using the latest technology and robotics, better than nature and guaranteed to last.
yasokondileaf_info:
A native plant that exhibits similar properties to tobacco, but without the harmful effects. Discovered by observing its effects on the local fauna.

This rare good is legal in all markets except for Prison Colony, Theocracy and Corporate markets and Federal Democracy markets.

Please note that if a market’s controlling faction changes, some formerly legal rare goods may become illegal. Should this occur the rare good will be unavailable for sale or purchase at that market for the duration of the prohibiting faction’s tenure.

Enable a slight yaw action based on roll input:

$YawMode_off; - no yaw into roll functionality.

$YawMode_on_inital; - will apply a slight yaw when you begin a roll.

$YawMode_on_low; - will apply yaw only on a low roll input and roll only on high roll input.

Enable a slight yaw action based on roll input, when flight assist is off:

$YawMode_default; - use whatever option is defined for normal flight.

$YawMode_off; - no yaw into roll functionality.

$YawMode_on_inital; - will apply a slight yaw when you begin a roll.

yttrium_info:
Collected on planet surfaces.

Yttrium, Y, atomic number 39. Melting point 1799K. Yttrium is often used as a strengthening component for various alloys. It also has uses in medicines and superconductors.
yttrium_info_short: Collected on planet surfaces. Yttrium, Y, atomic number 39. Melting point 1799K.
yurigrom_overview_control_ethos: When a system's oppositionists receive enough support, they launch an uprising by turning to Grom for help. Yuri Grom provides military aid via his battlefleet to establish control.
yurigrom_overview_description: A former Admiral of the Federal Fleet, Yuri Grom entered politics in the Euryale system, where the strong morality of his party clashed with corporate Federal doctrine. Increasingly violent political protests culminated in open rebellion against the Federation. Yuri now operates as an independent power, uniting citizens under the slogan “Freedom Among the Stars”.
yurigrom_overview_expansion_ethos: Active counterintelligence helps prevent hostile entities from breaking Yuri Grom's influence in systems under his control.
yurigrom_overview_preparation_ethos: Yuri Grom uses undercover operatives to support insurgent forces in systems he intends to nominate as a potential ally.
yurigrom_overview_quotation1: Freedom does not mean anarchy. Unyielding, lawful rule is crucial to the principle that one man’s freedom ends where another man's freedom begins.
yurigrom_overview_quotation2: Progress in mankind's development is inevitable, but it is imperative that we prevent the lust for innovation from jeopardizing the successes of our past.
yurigrom_overview_quotation3: Though narcotics are an absolute evil, we should not fight them with prohibition, but by improving man’s quality of life. A contented, free citizen has no desire to indulge.
yurigrom_overview_quotation4: To smuggle is to steal from your state, and thus from every law-abiding citizen, whose interests it protects.
yurigrom_overview_quotation5: Slavery, the violation of our most basic right to freedom, is unacceptable in modern society. However, Imperial slaving traditions are different – their citizens choose this fate, we should respect their customs.
zeesszeantglue_info:
Stick anything to everything with this natural glue, made from the cocoons of an indigenous insects. It is non-toxic and can be easily removed using a resin secreted by the queen ant.

This rare good is legal in all markets.
zeesszeantglue_info_short: Stick anything to everything with this natural glue, made from the cocoons of an indigenous insects.
zeminatorval_overview_control_ethos: Viewing unnecessary warfare as a waste of Imperial resources, Zemina has a penchant for achieving her aims through forging financial relationships with prominent individuals. A sympathetic roster of judges, politicians and law enforcement figures provide leverage against those who would resist her influence.
zeminatorval_overview_description: Zemina Torval is an Imperial senator with an immense personal fortune and a redoubtable private army. She is an unapologetic traditionalist, especially where the Empire's use of slavery is concerned. After relinquishing most of her corporate responsibilities to family members, some assumed Zemina would announce her retirement from public service. However, these decisions have seemingly allowed more time to focus on her political ambitions.
zeminatorval_overview_expansion_ethos: Nobody could accuse Zemina of misunderstanding the strategic game of power. She is an example of how to flatter the egos and ambitions of a system’s elite to reinforce her grip on a system – providing said beneficiaries remain useful, of course.
zeminatorval_overview_preparation_ethos: Zemina’s outrageous wealth and decades of political experience provide an advantage in securing the support of prominent entities in a system. Donations, 'gifts' and charitable funding for tactically selected targets all contribute towards expanding her influence in potential new territory.
zeminatorval_overview_quotation1: It is essential to the stability of any state that its members know their place, and that all roles are understood to be equally worthy.
zeminatorval_overview_quotation2: The Alliance lacks decisiveness, while the Federation lacks sophistication. The Empire is the pinnacle of civilisation because it possesses both, combined with a strength of will to do what must be done for the greater good of its people.
zeminatorval_overview_quotation3: Princess Aisling's continued harping about Imperial traditions and heritage being outdated is the height of hypocrisy. It is easy to demand change when you already have wealth, status and every possible opportunity you could ever need - all inherited via the traditions she openly scorns.
zeminatorval_overview_quotation4: Ignorance from outside the Empire is tiresomely common in regard to Imperial slavery. We are honour bound to provide a duty of care to these individuals, along with the right to dignified service while eradicating any personal debts.
zeminatorval_overview_quotation5: In my advanced years, I have come to understand the argument that the wealthy should distribute more of their wealth among the less fortunate. Of course, I do not agree with such a view one iota. But I do understand.
zinc_info:
Collected on planet surfaces and from asteroids.

Zinc, Zn, atomic number 30. Melting point 692K. Zinc is used in various alloys where its low melting point allows the casting of fine shapes. It's also used in some industrial processes and for infrared lasers.
zinc_info_short: Collected on planet surfaces and from asteroids. Zinc, Zn, atomic number 30. Melting point 692K.
zirconium_info:
Collected on planet surfaces and from asteroids.

Zirconium, Zr, atomic number 40. Melting point 2128K. As a metal Zirconium fulfils some niche purposes, but is extensively used in compounds for high temperature applications.
zirconium_info_short: Collected on planet surfaces and from asteroids. Zirconium, Zr, atomic number 40. Melting point 2128K.
